Log in to access the candidate dashboard.
Check the mock seat allotment status, including the probable allotted institute and programme.
Download or save the mock allotment details for future reference.
If not satisfied with the result, go to the "Choice Filling & Display" section and use the "Move Up," "Move Down," or "Swap" options to reorder preferences.
Save every change made before logging out.
Lock the final preference list before August 5, 2026 (2 PM), using OTP verification.

sections.heading: CSAB 2026 Mock Seat Allotment: Important Instructions

items: Checking the mock allotment is entirely online; CSAB will not send email or SMS reminders about the result release.
If dissatisfied with the mock result, reorder preferences by comparing them against last year's college-wise closing ranks relative to your CRL/category rank.
Build a combined preference list covering highly preferred, moderate, and safe institute options.
If already allotted a desired seat, keep the preference sequence unchanged.
Do not remove ambitious/dream college choices just because they weren't allotted in the mock round - the final round may still offer them depending on vacancy movement.
Placing a college higher in the list does not reduce chances of getting a lower-preference seat if higher options remain unavailable.
Avoid listing any institute/branch you are unwilling to join, since accepting an allotted seat is governed by CSAB rules and may involve forfeiting the seat acceptance fee if declined improperly.
Do not log in from multiple devices/tabs simultaneously, as this may cause session timeouts and unsaved changes.
Female candidates should review both Gender-Neutral and Female-Only (supernumerary) seat options, which remain active in CSAB Special Rounds.
Candidates opting for GFTIs should check institute-specific tuition and hostel fee details on csab.nic.in before final locking.
Choice locking requires OTP verification; ensure your registered mobile number is active.
Once locked, choices cannot be edited for Round 1 under any circumstances.
CSAB counselling is conducted exclusively through csab.nic.in - never share login credentials or OTPs on third-party sites or forums.

sections.heading: Important Instructions for WB NEET MDS 2026 Round 2

items: The schedule is tentative and may be revised by WBMCC; candidates should keep checking wbmcc.nic.in regularly for updates.

Candidates who are upgraded to a new institute in Round 2 must return the previously submitted fee and documents, along with a server-generated relieving letter from their earlier college, before admission at the newly allotted institute.

sections.heading: Reservation Policy and Category-wise Rules

items: OBC candidates must belong to the Non-Creamy Layer (NCL) to be eligible as reserved category candidates; otherwise, they will be treated as Unreserved (UR)/General.
OBC-NCL and EWS certificates must be issued in the appropriate format on or after 01.04.2026, as per current Govt. of West Bengal guidelines.
PwD seats are filled on a horizontal basis within the respective category.

Reservation for SC/ST/EWS/PwD follows extant West Bengal Government rules; OBC reservation follows Kolkata Gazette Notification Nos. 944-BCW/MR-23/2026 and 945-BCW/MR-23/2026 (both dated 18.05.2026), and Labr/85-Emp/EC/1M-01/2025 dated 25.05.2026.

If a domicile certificate under Proforma b or e-District shows the parent's domicile, two original ID proofs of the parent (Voter ID, Aadhaar Card, or Passport) showing a West Bengal residential address must be produced during document verification.

If candidates of a reserved category are not available, the posts may be filled from candidates in the unreserved category, subject to their availability, in terms of the explanation to Rule 7 of the Haryana Subordinate Court Establishment (Recruitment and General Conditions of Service) Rules, 1997. content_sections.heading: About AIIMS Kalyani Multi Tasking Staff
content_sections.text: The post is in a research project funded by DHR, entitled "Formulating a lipidomic based diagnostic score for clinical subtyping of non-small cell lung cancer: discriminating adenocarcinoma from squamous cell carcinoma", at AIIMS Kalyani on a tenure basis. The Site Investigator is Dr. Mahesh R Jansari, Additional Professor, Department of Pulmonary Medicine & Critical Care. AIIMS Kalyani is located at NH-34 Connector, Basantapur, Saguna, Kalyani, District Nadia, West Bengal 741245.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: The application is sent only by email. The notice gives these steps: The application form asks for the post applied for, full name in block letters, guardian/spouse name, date of birth, age, gender, permanent and present address, contact number, email id, qualification details (qualification, % of marks, year of passing, board/university), experience details (designation, name of institute, from and to dates) and a signed declaration with place and date.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: There is 01 post of Multi Tasking Staff, for 36 months or completion of the project, whichever is earlier. Educational qualification: 10th (Madhyamik or equivalent board) + Diploma (MLT/DMLT/ITI or equivalent). Experience: At least two years' experience in coordinating projects funded by Government of India. Skills: The candidate must be skilled in preparing project accounting documents, tender preparation and procurement (CPP, Gem, LPC) as per government norms. Essential experience: Experience in bill processing and maintenance of stock registers is essential. Age limit: Not exceeding 30 years (as on last date of application process). The notice does not mention any age relaxation. Pay: Consolidated salary of Rs. 18,000 pm with 5% increment after two years of service. No other allowance or facility other than the consolidated emoluments/salary shall be admissible. Candidates who are residents of Nadia district (for more than 1 year), well versed in the local language (Bengali) and have previous working experience in a similar field are encouraged to apply. The prescribed qualification is the minimum, and merely possessing it does not entitle a candidate to selection. For the full eligibility wording, candidates can check the official notification.

content_sections.heading: AIIMS Kalyani Multi Tasking Staff Job Description
content_sections.text: The job responsibility of the Multi Tasking Staff, as printed in the notice: Collection, processing, and transport of samples from AIIMS Kalyani to IIT Kharagpur. Maintaining records and files. All the other works related to the project / other work assigned for successful completion of the project.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Filled-up application form with a recent photograph Certificate of age (date of birth proof) Qualification certificates Experience certificates Any other important information, as annexures with the application form At the interview, candidates should bring two photocopies of the application form and supporting documents along with the original documents for verification.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection is through screening of applications and an interview. Shortlisting: Who is called for the final interview is at the complete discretion of the Screening Committee. Eligible candidates will be called for interview through email, and the list of shortlisted candidates will be published on the AIIMS Kalyani website before the interview. No individual intimation will be sent by AIIMS Kalyani. Interview: The interview will be conducted through offline mode only. The date and venue will be published on the AIIMS Kalyani website. No TA/DA will be paid for attending. Final decision: The decision of the selection committee, further to approval of the Executive Director, AIIMS Kalyani, will be final, and no representation in any manner will be entertained. Result: The result will be published on the AIIMS Kalyani website after the selection process and communicated to the selected candidate via e-mail. Even after qualifying in the selection process, a candidate may be disqualified at document verification if he/she does not fulfil the essential eligibility criteria.

content_sections.heading: DSSSB Recruitment 2026 Age Limit
content_sections.text: The ordinary age limit is 18 to 27 years for most vacancies. The NDMC Junior Engineer (Electric) post has an age limit of 18 to 32 years . Age eligibility is determined as on 11 December 2026. Important: OBC reservation and age relaxation are available only to candidates meeting DSSSB's notified OBC (Delhi) requirements. OBC candidates from outside Delhi are generally considered under the unreserved category for these benefits. For specified NDMC, MCD, DUSIB and Directorate of Education positions, eligible contractual employees of the same department may receive one-time upper-age relaxation up to the actual period of contractual service, subject to a maximum of five years and the prescribed requirement of at least 180 working days in the relevant year. This concession does not automatically apply to every applicant or department.

content_sections.heading: DSSSB Recruitment 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: DSSSB will conduct separate combined examinations for Junior Engineer and MTS under their respective post codes. The recruitment also involves online e-dossier submission, document verification and department/post allocation based on merit, eligibility, reservation and preferences. Skill, endurance, driving or trade tests may be conducted where required by the job.

content_sections.heading: DSSSB Junior Engineer Electrical Exam Pattern 2026
content_sections.text: Junior Engineer candidates will appear in a Two-Tier Technical Examination . Tier-I is used for shortlisting, while Tier-II marks determine the final examination merit. Tier-I Qualification: Minimum qualifying marks apply separately to Section B (Domain Subject) and to the combined marks of Sections A and B. There is no separate minimum qualifying requirement for Section A alone. Tier-I marks are used only for shortlisting to Tier-II. Tier-II Merit: Candidates must meet the applicable minimum qualifying marks separately in Part-I and Part-II. The combined Tier-II score is used for preparing the final merit list.

content_sections.heading: DSSSB Recruitment 2026 Post Preference and Department Allocation
content_sections.text: The notification provides a combined examination framework for each post code. Candidates who are shortlisted must submit their eligible department/post preferences when DSSSB opens the online e-dossier process. At least one department/post preference must be submitted. Preference submission takes place at the online e-dossier stage. Only departments for which the candidate meets all essential conditions should be selected. Preferences become final after confirmation. Candidates who fail to submit preferences within the notified period will not be considered for nomination/selection. Department allocation is based on merit, available vacancies, reservation and submitted preferences. No waiting panel will be maintained under the combined examination scheme. Important: Candidates cannot claim another department after being allocated their first available preference according to merit. The department preferences should therefore be selected carefully.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required for DSSSB Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Applicants should keep relevant documents ready for registration, application submission and later e-dossier verification. Class 10 / Matriculation certificate and marksheet. Electrical Engineering degree or diploma, for applicable Junior Engineer positions. Relevant electrical installation, maintenance or professional experience certificates where required. ITI certificate, where applicable to the notified qualification route. Valid photo identity proof. SC/ST certificate, where applicable. OBC (Delhi) Non-Creamy Layer certificate, where applicable. EWS Income and Asset Certificate for the prescribed financial year. PwBD certificate, where applicable. Ex-Servicemen service/discharge documents, where applicable. Meritorious Sportsperson certificate, where applicable. Documents supporting departmental or contractual-service age relaxation. Other certificates required by the concerned department and DSSSB.

content_sections.heading: DSSSB Reservation and Eligibility Rules 2026
content_sections.text: Reservation is governed by the applicable Government of NCT of Delhi and Government of India instructions. Only candidates satisfying the notified OBC (Delhi) conditions are entitled to the applicable OBC reservation and age-relaxation benefits. OBC candidates from outside Delhi do not automatically qualify for those benefits. EWS applicants must possess the prescribed Income and Asset Certificate valid for financial year 2026-27 , issued on the basis of income for financial year 2025-26. PwBD candidates must check whether their specific disability category is identified as suitable for the department and post. Suitability is not identical across all Junior Engineer departments. Horizontal reservation figures are included in the published vacancy count and are not additional vacancies.

content_sections.heading: DSSSB Recruitment 2026 Admit Card and Examination Date
content_sections.text: The Board will publish examination schedules, admit card instructions and relevant recruitment updates through dsssb.delhi.gov.in . Candidates should follow the official examination instructions and carry the required admit card and identity document to the allotted examination centre.

content_sections.heading: About Sahebganj Crop Protectors
content_sections.text: The Crop Protectors posts are part of the Jharkhand Department of Agriculture, Animal Husbandry and Cooperative's effort to run crop protection and plant protection work effectively at the local level. The selection is conducted by a selection committee chaired by the District Agriculture Officer, Sahebganj, and the selected candidates will work at the Plant Protection Centres in different blocks of Sahebganj district.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: The application must be sent only by registered post or speed post . Applications received after the last date will not be accepted. The application address is: Office of the District Agriculture Officer, Sanyukt Krishi Bhawan, Sahebganj, PIN Code-816109

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: The 7 Crop Protectors posts are reserved as per the model reservation roster applicable to Sahebganj district. The number of vacancies may change as per administrative need and the decision of the competent authority. The posts are at these Plant Protection Centres: Sahebganj, Borio, Taljhari, Rajmahal, Pathna, Barhait and Barharwa. Minimum Matric/Secondary (10th) pass from a recognised educational institution. At least one training of minimum 5 days under the Directorate of Agriculture and Horticulture, Department of Agriculture, Animal Husbandry and Cooperative is mandatory. Candidates with longer training will get preference accordingly. Knowledge of the local language. It is a qualifying criterion and carries no merit marks. Proficiency in riding a bicycle and climbing trees. Preference to residents of the block concerned with the Plant Protection Centre. All candidates must submit a valid local resident certificate issued by the competent authority in the prescribed format; candidates claiming reservation must submit a valid caste/category certificate in the prescribed format. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions of the Crop Protectors post. Age is counted as on 30 November 2026, and only the date of birth in the Matric marksheet/certificate is accepted. The minimum age is 18 years. Ex-servicemen get an additional relaxation of five years in the maximum age limit, and must submit the ex-serviceman certificate in time. Monthly honorarium: Rs. 11,851/- only. The engagement is honorarium/remuneration based (मानदेय/पारिश्रमिक आधारित). Tenure: one year or until regular appointment, whichever is earlier. The appointment gives no automatic right to regular appointment, confirmation or service benefits like a regular government employee. The contract may be ended on regular appointment, abolition of the sanctioned post or administrative need.

content_sections.text: Crop survey. Spraying of pesticides. Farmer training and awareness. Other work assigned by the office from time to time.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Self-attested photocopies of these documents must be attached to the application: A character/conduct certificate is not needed with the application, but it must be produced at final selection, document verification or joining, as decided by the competent authority.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: All applications will be checked for eligibility and documents. Applications with missing details, without the required certificates, not meeting the essential qualification, or with false or misleading information will be rejected. Valid applications are then evaluated on a total of 100 marks. Training of less than five days is not counted in the merit list, and training days are counted as full days clearly written in the certificate. Where marks are in CGPA/grade, the percentage is worked out by the conversion formula of the board or university concerned. No extra marks are given for a postgraduate or higher qualification, or for more than one degree of the same level. Local language: the declaration in the application is accepted until the provisional merit list. No separate language test is held if the selectable and waiting-list candidates give sufficient proof; otherwise a language test may be held at the discretion of the selection committee/competent authority. Cycling and tree climbing: if the selection committee finds it necessary, a practical test may be taken after the provisional merit list. It carries no merit marks, and a candidate not found capable may be considered ineligible for final selection. A written or oral test may be held at any stage if the selection committee/competent authority finds it necessary. Original certificates of selected/provisionally selected candidates will be verified before final selection, in the format prescribed by the competent authority. When two or more candidates have equal marks, the tie is broken in this order: higher Matric marks/percentage, a valid local language proficiency certificate, higher Intermediate marks/percentage, higher graduation marks/percentage, and higher age. A category-wise merit list will be prepared under the reservation rules, and the final list will be published at the prescribed place. The selection is conducted under the supervision of a selection committee formed by the competent authority.

faq.question: Q1. How many Fasal Rakshak vacancies are there in Sahebganj?
faq.answer: There are 7 Fasal Rakshak posts: 3 for ST, 0 for EWS and 4 Unreserved. The number may change as per administrative need.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date for the Sahebganj Fasal Rakshak application?
faq.answer: The application must be received by 5 PM on 30 November 2026. Applications received after the last date will not be accepted.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed for Fasal Rakshak?
faq.answer: Candidates need at least Matric/Secondary (10th) pass and one mandatory training of minimum 5 days under the Directorate of Agriculture and Horticulture, with knowledge of the local language and the ability to ride a bicycle and climb trees.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for Sahebganj Fasal Rakshak?
faq.answer: The minimum age is 18 years as on 30 November 2026; the maximum is 35 years for UR men, 38 years for UR women and 40 years for ST men and women. Ex-servicemen get five extra years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of a Fasal Rakshak?
faq.answer: The monthly honorarium is Rs. 11,851/- only.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for the Fasal Rakshak post?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form printed with the advertisement, attach self-attested certificate copies and send it by registered post or speed post to the Office of the District Agriculture Officer, Sanyukt Krishi Bhawan, Sahebganj, PIN Code-816109.

faq.question: Q7. How will Fasal Rakshak candidates be selected?
faq.answer: Through a 100-mark merit list: up to 70 marks for 10th, 12th and graduation percentages and up to 30 marks for training. A language test, a cycling and tree-climbing test, or a written or oral test may be held if needed.

faq.question: Q8. Is the Fasal Rakshak job permanent?
faq.answer: No. It is an honorarium-based engagement for one year or until regular appointment, whichever is earlier, with no automatic right to regular appointment or confirmation.

faq.question: Q9. Do candidates from the same block get preference?
faq.answer: Yes. Residents of the block concerned with the Plant Protection Centre get preference, and block allocation considers the resident block and the preferences given in the form.

faq.question: Q10. Does extra training give more marks?
faq.answer: Yes. The first 5-day training gives 15 marks, and each additional day beyond five gives 1 mark, up to 15 more marks; training of less than five days is not counted.

faq.answer: There are 7 Fasal Rakshak posts: 3 for ST, 0 for EWS and 4 Unreserved. The number may change as per administrative need.

faq.answer: Candidates need at least Matric/Secondary (10th) pass and one mandatory training of minimum 5 days under the Directorate of Agriculture and Horticulture, with knowledge of the local language and the ability to ride a bicycle and climb trees.

faq.question: What is the age limit for Sahebganj Fasal Rakshak?
faq.answer: The minimum age is 18 years as on 30 November 2026; the maximum is 35 years for UR men, 38 years for UR women and 40 years for ST men and women. Ex-servicemen get five extra years.

faq.question: What is the salary of a Fasal Rakshak?
faq.answer: The monthly honorarium is Rs. 11,851/- only.

faq.question: How do I apply for the Fasal Rakshak post?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form printed with the advertisement, attach self-attested certificate copies and send it by registered post or speed post to the Office of the District Agriculture Officer, Sanyukt Krishi Bhawan, Sahebganj, PIN Code-816109.

faq.question: How will Fasal Rakshak candidates be selected?
faq.answer: Through a 100-mark merit list: up to 70 marks for 10th, 12th and graduation percentages and up to 30 marks for training. A language test, a cycling and tree-climbing test, or a written or oral test may be held if needed.

faq.question: Is the Fasal Rakshak job permanent?
faq.answer: No. It is an honorarium-based engagement for one year or until regular appointment, whichever is earlier, with no automatic right to regular appointment or confirmation.

faq.question: Do candidates from the same block get preference?
faq.answer: Yes. Residents of the block concerned with the Plant Protection Centre get preference, and block allocation considers the resident block and the preferences given in the form.

faq.question: Does extra training give more marks?
faq.answer: Yes. The first 5-day training gives 15 marks, and each additional day beyond five gives 1 mark, up to 15 more marks; training of less than five days is not counted.

content_sections.heading: About the Recruiting Office
content_sections.text: The recruitment is conducted by the District Programme Officer, Hardoi, whose office (Child Development Department) is in Vikas Bhawan, Hardoi. The posts are in the Child Development Projects run in the urban and rural areas of Hardoi district. The direct recruitment follows the arrangement laid down in Government Order No. 1/1092245/2025/3313/58-1-2025 (1917687) dated 17 September 2025, and a copy of the notice has been sent to the Director, Child Development Services and Nutrition (Bal Vikas Seva Evam Pushtahar), Uttar Pradesh, Lucknow.

content_sections.heading: Hardoi Anganwadi Recruitment 2026 Important Dates
content_sections.text: Applications are accepted only within this period; the notice gives no separate date for submitting documents.

content_sections.heading: Vacancies by Project / Block
content_sections.text: The 20 Child Development Projects of Hardoi district have 329 Anganwadi Worker and 333 Anganwadi Helper vacancies, a total of 662 posts. Kothawan has the most posts (29 Worker and 47 Helper), followed by Shahabad (21 Worker and 46 Helper); Hardoi City is the only urban project. The Gram Sabha/ward-wise details of these posts, with reservation and full eligibility details, will be pasted on the notice boards of the Collectorate, Vikas Bhawan, Tehsil and Development Block offices of the district and uploaded on http://upanganwadibharti.in . The number of vacant posts may decrease or increase in special circumstances.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The same eligibility rules apply to both Anganwadi Worker and Anganwadi Helper posts. Gender: Only women candidates are eligible for the posts in this notification. Residence: The applicant must be a permanent resident of the same Gram Sabha or ward (urban) as the vacant post. Applications from another Gram Sabha or ward will not be valid. Qualification: The minimum educational qualification is Intermediate. The online merit will be prepared on the basis of the maximum educational qualification of postgraduate. Age: Minimum 18 years and not more than 35 years on the cut-off date 01.07.2026. Proof of age: Only the date of birth recorded in the High School marksheet and certificate is accepted. Income limit: Rs. 46,080.00 annual in rural areas and Rs. 56,460.00 annual in urban areas, as per Government Order No. 22/2015/2123/26-2-2015 dated 14 September 2015 of Samaj Kalyan Anubhag-2, Uttar Pradesh Government. Income certificate: only a certificate issued online from the tehsil with a digital signature, issued at the competent level under Revenue Section-9 Government Order No. 3959/1-9-11-Raj-9 dated 30.09.2011 (as amended), that can be verified online. Caste and residence certificates: only certificates issued online from the tehsil with a digital signature that can be verified online. Widow: only a certificate issued by the Gram Panchayat Officer or the concerned urban local body, together with a certified copy of the family register (Parivar Register). Divorced or abandoned woman: only a legal or court order. The notice does not state the age relaxation or the honorarium; the full eligibility and application details are on http://upanganwadibharti.in . Candidates should check the official notification and the Gram Sabha/ward-wise list for the eligibility of each post.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: An online merit is prepared on the basis of educational qualification, from the minimum of Intermediate up to the maximum of postgraduate. Selection for the Anganwadi Helper and Worker posts then follows this order of preference, always within the same Gram Sabha or ward (urban area): Widow BPL candidate Divorced/abandoned BPL candidate BPL candidate Widow APL candidate Divorced/abandoned APL candidate APL candidate on the basis of merit The widow and divorced/abandoned status is accepted only on the certificates listed above.

content_sections.heading: ONGC Apprentice Vacancy 2026
content_sections.text: ONGC has advertised 3,047 tentative apprenticeship vacancies across six sectors. The Western Sector has the highest allocation, followed by the Eastern and Mumbai Sectors. Apprenticeship seats are distributed across ONGC's operational locations. Candidates must meet the domicile or qualification-location conditions specified in Annexure I for their chosen work centre.

content_sections.heading: ONGC Apprentice Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Candidates must possess the educational qualification prescribed for their chosen apprenticeship trade. The available disciplines cover ITI trades, commerce, science, business administration, engineering and other qualifications. Additionally, candidates who have already undergone or are undergoing apprenticeship training under the Apprentices Act are not eligible. Applicants must not have completed three years after passing the qualifying examination as on 29 November 2026. Candidates with one year or more of training or work experience after the prescribed qualification are not eligible for Technician Apprenticeship.

rows.required_qualification: ITI in the relevant prescribed trade
12th Class or two-year ITI after Class 10
Degree in the relevant Engineering discipline
Three-Year Diploma in the relevant Engineering discipline
Graduation with Geology as one of the subjects

content_sections.heading: ONGC Apprentice Age Limit 2026
content_sections.text: The age limit for ONGC Apprentice Recruitment 2026 is 18 to 24 years as on 29 November 2026 . Candidates' dates of birth should fall between 29 November 2002 and 29 November 2008, subject to applicable relaxation.

content_sections.heading: ONGC Apprentice Application Fee 2026
content_sections.text: The official ONGC Apprentice notification does not specify an application fee. Candidates must apply through the respective government apprenticeship portal and follow the instructions displayed there.

content_sections.heading: ONGC Apprentice Stipend 2026
content_sections.text: Selected apprentices will receive a monthly stipend ranging from Rs. 8,200 to Rs. 12,300 , depending on their educational qualification and apprenticeship category. The apprenticeship training period is 12 months for all trades. ONGC will not provide transportation, boarding or lodging expenses. Apprenticeship engagement does not guarantee regular employment with ONGC.

content_sections.heading: ONGC Apprentice Selection Process 2026
content_sections.text: Selection for ONGC Apprentice Recruitment 2026 will be based on the marks obtained in the prescribed qualifying examination. A provisional merit list will be prepared separately for the relevant trades, disciplines and work centres. Application Scrutiny: Verification of eligibility, academic qualifications, age and other requirements. Provisional Merit List: Prepared based on marks in the qualifying examination. Document Verification: Shortlisted candidates must produce original certificates and required supporting documents. Final Merit List: Prepared after eligibility and document verification, considering applicable reservation provisions. Engagement Formalities: Selected candidates must complete the required registration, document and medical fitness formalities. If two candidates have equal merit marks, the older candidate will receive preference. The notification does not prescribe a separate written recruitment examination.

content_sections.heading: ONGC Apprentice Work Centre Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates are eligible for a particular ONGC work centre only if they are residents of an eligible district or have obtained their prescribed educational qualification from an eligible district. For example, the Chennai work centre covers all districts of Tamil Nadu and Puducherry, while the Hazira work centre specifies Surat, Navsari, Tapi, Dang and Valsad districts. Other locations have their own eligibility conditions. Applicants should consult Annexure I of the official notification before choosing a work centre. A candidate should apply for one trade at one work centre, as directed in the application instructions.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply Online for ONGC Apprentice Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates can apply online through the National Apprenticeship Promotion Scheme (NAPS) or National Apprenticeship Training Scheme (NATS) portal, depending on their chosen trade. Offline applications are not accepted. Important: Applications submitted by post, by hand or through any other offline mode will not be accepted. Ensure that the correct apprenticeship scheme and eligible work centre are selected.

content_sections.heading: ONGC Apprentice Recruitment 2026 Apply Online
content_sections.text: The online application process is open from 29 October to 20 November 2026. Eligible candidates should apply through the appropriate portal: NAPS Apprentices: Apply through NAPS Portal NATS Apprentices: Apply through NATS Portal Candidates can check recruitment updates, selection lists and other notifications through the official ONGC apprenticeship website.

basic_details.job_title: RRC Central Railway Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 2 Theatre Actor, Harmonium Player Posts
basic_details.short_information: Railway Recruitment Cell, Central Railway (रेल भर्ती सेल, मध्य रेल), under the Ministry of Railways, Government of India, is filling two Level-2 posts under the Cultural Quota for 2026-27: one Theatre Actor (Male) (थिएटर अभिनेता (पुरुष)) and one Harmonium Player (हारमोनियम वादक). Candidates need 12th (+2), or Matriculation with ITI or Act Apprenticeship, plus a degree, diploma or certificate in the relevant art. Applications are made online on www.rrccr.com from 5 November 2026 (10.00 hrs) to 4 December 2026 (18.00 hrs).

application_fee.all_candidates_except_those_in_fee: Rs. 500; Rs. 400 refunded, after deducting bank charges, to candidates found eligible who actually appear in the written exam
application_fee.sc_fee: Rs. 250; refunded, after deducting bank charges, to candidates found eligible who appear in the written exam
application_fee.details: The fee is paid through the payment gateway integrated with the online application, by debit card, credit card or internet banking; bank transaction charges are borne by the candidate. Ineligible candidates who still apply will not get a refund, and the fee is not refunded if the vacancies are cancelled. Minority candidates (Muslim, Christian, Sikh, Buddhist and Zoroastrian (Parsi)) claiming exemption or refund must give the self-declaration in Annexure 'A' and an affidavit on non-judicial stamp paper at document verification. Economically Backward Class candidates (annual family income below Rs. 50,000) must produce an income certificate in the prescribed proforma from an authorised authority (District Magistrate or revenue officer up to Tahsildar, sitting MPs, Union Ministers, or a BPL card/IZZAT MST certificate) at document verification.

age_limit.details: The age limit is 18 to 30 years (for Unreserved), counted as on 01/01/2027. Date of birth must fall between the dates below, both days included. | Category Born not earlier than Born not later than Unreserved 01/01/1997 01/01/2009 OBC (Non-Creamy Layer) 01/01/1994 01/01/2009 SC/ST 01/01/1992 01/01/2009

qualification.details: 12th (+2 stage) or equivalent from a recognised board with at least 50% aggregate marks. The 50% condition does not apply to SC/ST/Ex-Servicemen/PwBD candidates or to candidates with a qualification higher than 12th; OR Matriculation from a recognised board and Course Completed Act Apprenticeship; OR Matriculation from a recognised board and ITI approved by NCVT/SCVT. | Persons appointed as Clerk-cum-Typist must pass a typing test at 30 words per minute in English or 25 words per minute in Hindi within two years of appointment; their appointment stays temporary until then.

how_to_apply: Go to www.rrccr.com and follow the detailed guidelines given there for the online application.

Log on and fill in personal details/bio-data carefully, including the 12-digit Aadhaar number or the 28-digit Aadhaar enrolment ID (applicants from Jammu and Kashmir, Meghalaya and Assam may enter voter ID, passport, driving licence or another valid Government ID number).
Give an active mobile number and email ID; all RRC messages will be sent by email/SMS.

Upload a colour passport-size photograph (3.5 cm x 3.5 cm, JPG/JPEG, 100 DPI, 20–70 KB, not older than three months, without cap or sunglasses) and a running-hand signature (3.5 cm x 2.5 cm, JPG/JPEG, 100 DPI, 20–30 KB), not in block/capital or disjoint letters.
Upload the documents listed below and enter the details of your desirable qualifications.
Pay the fee through the payment gateway; no change or edit is allowed after payment. Save or print the e-receipt.
Note the registration account ID and take a printout of the application, which must be produced at document verification and practical demonstration. Nothing is to be sent to RRC by post.
Marksheet/certificate of the minimum educational qualification (para 2(a)).
Professional qualification certificate (para 2(b)).
Date of birth proof: Class 10 certificate or marksheet, or school leaving certificate showing the date of birth.
Caste certificate for SC/ST/OBC candidates, where applicable – SC/ST in the Annexure 'C' format; OBC Non-Creamy Layer in the Central Government format (Annexure 'D'), issued on or after 01/04/2026.
The institution recognition certificate described under professional qualification.
For any problem in submitting or printing the online application, candidates can email the help desk at [email protected].
important_instructions: At the exam hall, bring the e-call letter, Aadhaar card or a valid photo ID, one colour passport-size photograph and original SC/ST/OBC certificate where applicable; without a valid photo ID entry is refused. On the practical demonstration day, bring originals of age, qualification, caste and cultural discipline documents, self-attested photocopies, your own cultural kit and four passport-size photographs; certificates in other languages need a certified English/Hindi translation. Candidates may need to stay 2–3 days for the practical demonstration at their own arrangement; no TA/DA or accommodation is given. Candidates already working in PSUs/Government organisations must produce a No Objection Certificate from their employer at the practical demonstration. SC/ST candidates who upload a valid caste certificate (Annexure 'C') can get a free second-class railway pass for the written exam and must carry the original certificate and ID while travelling. Candidates debarred for life by any RRB/RRC, or for a period not yet over, need not apply; multiple applications with different details will be rejected. Mobile phones, calculators, Bluetooth devices and other communication devices are not allowed at the exam venue. Appointment is subject to medical fitness, final verification of educational and caste certificates and verification of antecedents/character. Legal matters fall under the jurisdiction of CAT, Mumbai only.

18 to 30 years (for Unreserved) as on 01/01/2027; SC/ST 5 years and OBC (Non-Creamy Layer) 3 years extra

content_sections.heading: About RRC CR
content_sections.text: The Railway Recruitment Cell (RRC) of Central Railway works under the Ministry of Railways and has its office at CPM Conversion Office Building, P D Mello Road, Wadibunder, Mumbai – 400 010. This notice is its Cultural Quota recruitment for 2026-27. RRC only recommends the names of successful candidates; the appointment process is handled by the Principal Chief Personnel Officer of Central Railway.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The notice offers 2 posts at Level-2 in two cultural disciplines. The posts are open to all; there is no reservation for any caste. If no suitable candidate is available for one of the two disciplines, a suitable candidate of the other discipline will be selected instead, irrespective of gender. The number of vacancies is tentative and may be reduced or even become nil according to the actual needs of the railway administration.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: A candidate must be a citizen of India, or a subject of Nepal or Bhutan, or a Tibetan refugee who came to India before 1 January 1962 to settle permanently, or a person of Indian origin who migrated from Pakistan, Burma, Sri Lanka, the East African countries of Kenya, Uganda, the United Republic of Tanzania, Zambia, Malawi, Zaire, Ethiopia or Vietnam to settle permanently in India. Candidates other than Indian citizens need a certificate of eligibility from the Government of India; they may be admitted to the exam provisionally but must produce it at document verification. 12th (+2 stage) or equivalent from a recognised board with at least 50% aggregate marks. The 50% condition does not apply to SC/ST/Ex-Servicemen/PwBD candidates or to candidates with a qualification higher than 12th; OR Matriculation from a recognised board and Course Completed Act Apprenticeship; OR Matriculation from a recognised board and ITI approved by NCVT/SCVT. Persons appointed as Clerk-cum-Typist must pass a typing test at 30 words per minute in English or 25 words per minute in Hindi within two years of appointment; their appointment stays temporary until then. Candidates must also upload a certificate from the institution confirming that it is recognised by the Central or State Government, or run by a Government body set up under an Act of Parliament or a State Legislature. A candidate who cannot upload it will be treated as provisionally eligible and allowed to sit the written exam, but must submit it on the day of document verification, failing which the candidature will be cancelled. Candidates without the professional qualification need not apply. Preference to candidates proficient in script writing and direction. content_sections.heading: How to Apply for RRC CR Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Go to www.rrccr.com and follow the detailed guidelines given there for the online application. Log on and fill in personal details/bio-data carefully, including the 12-digit Aadhaar number or the 28-digit Aadhaar enrolment ID (applicants from Jammu and Kashmir, Meghalaya and Assam may enter voter ID, passport, driving licence or another valid Government ID number). Give an active mobile number and email ID; all RRC messages will be sent by email/SMS. Upload a colour passport-size photograph (3.5 cm x 3.5 cm, JPG/JPEG, 100 DPI, 20–70 KB, not older than three months, without cap or sunglasses) and a running-hand signature (3.5 cm x 2.5 cm, JPG/JPEG, 100 DPI, 20–30 KB), not in block/capital or disjoint letters. Upload the documents listed below and enter the details of your desirable qualifications. Pay the fee through the payment gateway; no change or edit is allowed after payment. Save or print the e-receipt. Note the registration account ID and take a printout of the application, which must be produced at document verification and practical demonstration. Nothing is to be sent to RRC by post. Marksheet/certificate of the minimum educational qualification (para 2(a)). Professional qualification certificate (para 2(b)). Date of birth proof: Class 10 certificate or marksheet, or school leaving certificate showing the date of birth. Caste certificate for SC/ST/OBC candidates, where applicable – SC/ST in the Annexure 'C' format; OBC Non-Creamy Layer in the Central Government format (Annexure 'D'), issued on or after 01/04/2026. The institution recognition certificate described under professional qualification. For any problem in submitting or printing the online application, candidates can email the help desk at [email protected] .

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Selection consists of a Written Examination/CBT/Tab Mode, then Document Verification, then a Practical Demonstration. There will be no interview. Only candidates who pass the written exam are called for document verification and the practical demonstration. Negative marking: 1/3 of the marks allotted to a question is deducted for each wrong answer. A minimum of 40% marks in the written exam is needed to qualify for the practical demonstration. RRC may, at its discretion, hold the written exam for all or a limited number of candidates. The date, time and venue of the written exam, practical demonstration and document verification will be fixed by RRC and told to eligible candidates in due course; requests for postponement will not be accepted. Eligibility status will be shown on the RRC website, and the e-call letter will be available there about seven days before the written exam; no admit card is sent by post.

rows.what_it_covers: 50 objective multiple-choice questions on General Awareness, Mathematics, Mental Ability and the notified cultural discipline; 60 minutes; English and Hindi
Talent test in the concerned field

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: At the exam hall, bring the e-call letter, Aadhaar card or a valid photo ID, one colour passport-size photograph and original SC/ST/OBC certificate where applicable; without a valid photo ID entry is refused. On the practical demonstration day, bring originals of age, qualification, caste and cultural discipline documents, self-attested photocopies, your own cultural kit and four passport-size photographs; certificates in other languages need a certified English/Hindi translation. Candidates may need to stay 2–3 days for the practical demonstration at their own arrangement; no TA/DA or accommodation is given. Candidates already working in PSUs/Government organisations must produce a No Objection Certificate from their employer at the practical demonstration. SC/ST candidates who upload a valid caste certificate (Annexure 'C') can get a free second-class railway pass for the written exam and must carry the original certificate and ID while travelling. Candidates debarred for life by any RRB/RRC, or for a period not yet over, need not apply; multiple applications with different details will be rejected. Mobile phones, calculators, Bluetooth devices and other communication devices are not allowed at the exam venue. Appointment is subject to medical fitness, final verification of educational and caste certificates and verification of antecedents/character. Legal matters fall under the jurisdiction of CAT, Mumbai only.

content_sections.heading: About JIPMER
content_sections.text: The Jawaharlal Institute of Postgraduate Medical Education and Research (JIPMER) is a medical education and research institute with its letterhead address at Dhanwantri Nagar, Puducherry-6, and a campus at Karaikal. These posts are in an externally funded research project run by the Department of Community Medicine, JIPMER Karaikal. The Project Investigator is Dr L. Karthik Balajee, Additional Professor, and the PREVENT-D Study looks at drowning events and emergency response in Puducherry through multi-source surveillance.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: JIPMER has advertised 5 posts in total in the PREVENT-D Study.

rows.consolidated_pay: Rs 18,000 per person per month plus HRA

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Each post has its own essential qualification, desirable skills and maximum age. The age limit for every post is counted as on the last date of receipt of applications. Qualification and experience should be in a relevant discipline/field and from a reputed institution/organization, and the experience should have been gained after acquiring the essential qualification. Ability to communicate in Tamil and English is desirable for all three posts. Age relaxation: up to 5 years for candidates with experience in a government research organisation, as per ICMR norms (this applies to all three posts). Essential qualification (any one route): Three years' graduate degree in a relevant Subject/field in Public Health, Epidemiology, Social Work, Sociology, Anthropology, Psychology, Nursing, Allied Health Sciences, Life Sciences, Statistics/Biostatistics, Data Science + three years post-qualification experience; or PG in relevant subjects /field; or For engineering /IT/CS: four years' graduate degree. Desirable: Experience coordinating public-health or community research. Experience in supervising field staff and monitoring data quality. Familiarity with spreadsheets, digital data collection and preparation of research reports. Essential qualification (any one route): 12th in Science + Diploma (MLT/DMLT / Engineering or equivalent) + Five years' experience in relevant subject/field; or Three years' graduate degree in relevant subject/field + two years' experience in relevant subject; or PG in relevant subjects /field (work experience is not required under this route). Desirable: Experience entering, checking and managing health-research data. Ability to use spreadsheets and digital data-collection applications. Experience matching records, identifying duplicates and resolving data queries. Familiarity with statistical or GIS software. Essential qualification (any one route): 10th + Diploma (MLT/DMLT /ITI or equivalent) + two years' experience in relevant subject/field; or Three years' graduate degree in relevant subject/field + One year experience in relevant subject; or PG in relevant subjects /field (work experience is not required under this route). Desirable: Experience in community surveys, hospital record review or field data collection. Ability to use a tablet or smartphone for data collection. Familiarity with GPS/location recording. Experience arranging field visits and maintaining study records. The notice states that qualification, experience, other terms and conditions may be relaxed/altered at the discretion of the Principal Investigator. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: All three posts carry a consolidated remuneration plus HRA as admissible at the approved posting location; the notice states that no other allowances are payable. It also says the consolidated salary of the post may vary from time to time, and no other allowance or facility other than the consolidated salary shall be extended.

content_sections.heading: JIPMER Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: Staff will be assigned duties in Puducherry and/or Karaikal according to project requirements. The work includes hospital and administrative record review, community visits, interviews, verification of drowning events, environmental site assessments and digital data collection. Travel between study sites may be required. Coordinate surveillance activities across the study locations. Maintain the site calendar, permission tracker and progress records. Supervise field staff and monitor completion of assigned work. Liaise with authorised hospital, police, rescue service, and community nodal persons. Coordinate resolution of missing or inconsistent information. Assist the investigators with progress reports and stakeholder meetings. Any other project-related work assigned by the PI from time to time. Data entry, cleaning and management of the study database; maintain Case Record Forms and study records. Maintain the multi-source surveillance database. Link records from approved hospital, police, medico-legal and other sources. Identify possible duplicates and maintain linkage records. Conduct completeness and consistency checks. Maintain data-query, correction and backup records. Any other project-related work assigned by the PI from time to time. Identify and document eligible events through authorised study sources. Extract approved information from records using standard study forms. Conduct verification visits and interview eligible adult participants, including adult parents or guardians of child cases, after obtaining informed consent in accordance with the approved protocol. Record locations and complete environmental-assessment forms. Coordinate with approved community informants and institutional nodal persons. Enter data promptly and resolve queries under supervision. Assist with arrangements and documentation for expert-led first-response sessions. Any other project-related work assigned by the PI from time to time. For all three posts, the notice says the duties are indicative and not exhaustive: project staff shall carry out any work assigned by the PI in the interest of the project, including shift duty, field visits and administrative tasks. Refusal to carry out assigned work will be treated as unsatisfactory performance and may lead to termination of the engagement without notice.

Answer the form's question on willingness to undertake record review, participant interviews and field visits, and to travel between study locations in Puducherry and Karaikal. To apply for two or more posts, fill a separate form for each post and send each with its enclosures in a separate email. content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Applicants will be shortlisted based on the details furnished in the application, CV and documentary proof, and the list of eligible candidates will also be displayed on the JIPMER website. Only shortlisted candidates will be called for a written test and/or interview. The final selection will be based on the CV, application, and written test/interview. If the number of applications is very large, more stringent criteria than those specified may be used to determine eligibility. The decision of the Project Investigator will be final. Written test: project-related topics including surveillance, accurate record extraction, consent and confidentiality, digital data collection, data quality, basic interpretation of health information, general aptitude, computer skills and duties relevant to the post. Skill test: record extraction, Tamil interview demonstration, data entry/checking and study documentation, data entry in MS Excel/database software. Interview: subject knowledge, communication skills in Tamil and English, and suitability for the project. The written test and interview will be conducted in person at the Department of Community Medicine, Academic Building, JIPMER Karaikal, FCI Road, Kovilpathu, Karaikal - 609602. The date and time of the interview will be notified one week in advance. No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview.

content_sections.heading: About Janpad Panchayat Bijapur
content_sections.text: Janpad Panchayat Bijapur is the block-level panchayat office in District Bijapur, Chhattisgarh, headed by its Chief Executive Officer. This recruitment follows the instructions of the Commissioner, Viksit Bharat-G RAM G, Nava Raipur Atal Nagar, issued in letter No. 1/702461/2026/वि-7/@VB-GRAMG/स्थापना dated 16.10.2026, to appoint Gram Rozgar Sahayaks on honorarium in gram panchayats under the Viksit Bharat-G RAM G scheme. Reservation follows the roster issued by Zila Panchayat Bijapur in order No. /572/जि.प./मु.का.अधि./स्था./2012, Bijapur, dated 26.05.2012.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Applications must be made in the prescribed form (आवेदन पत्र) printed on pages 4 and 5 of the notice, addressed to: Chief Executive Officer, Janpad Panchayat Bijapur, District Bijapur (C.G.). The notice prints no PIN code. Mode: hand in personally or send by post to the Office of Janpad Panchayat Bijapur. Window: 05/11/2026 to 30/11/2026, from 10.30 AM to 05 PM. On the envelope, clearly write the post name and the name of the gram panchayat you are applying for; otherwise the application may be rejected. Also write the sender's name and correspondence address on the envelope. Paste a self-attested photograph in the box on the form and attach self-attested copies of all educational qualifications. Sign the form and the declaration (घोषणा पत्र), which states that false information can lead to rejection of the application, legal action and cancellation of appointment. The form asks for: the post and gram panchayat applied for, name, father's or husband's name, category (UR/SC/ST/OBC), gender, date of birth in figures and words, age as on 01.01.2026 in years, months and days, permanent address, correspondence address, educational qualifications (examination passed, year, maximum marks, marks obtained, percentage, division and board), other qualifications if any, and whether the applicant has a disability (with percentage if yes).

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: One Gram Rozgar Sahayak is to be recruited in each of the following 23 gram panchayats. In the last column, "Women" means the post is reserved for women of that category and "Mukt" means it is not reserved for women within that category. By category, the 23 posts are: ST 16, UR 3, OBC 3 and SC 1. Of these, 11 posts are reserved for women and 12 are Mukt. Passing the minimum Higher Secondary examination, i.e. 12th pass, is mandatory (10th pass for SC and ST). For the Rozgar Sahayak post in the Bastar and Surguja divisions, the order of priority of educational qualification is: 1. 12th pass, 2. 10th pass, 3. 8th pass. The applicant must be a resident of the gram panchayat for which the application is made. Live registration in the Employment Office is mandatory, and the registration certificate must be attached. As on 01.01.2026, the applicant must be not less than 18 years and not more than 40 years. Candidates of reserved categories get age relaxation as per rules. Gram Rozgar Sahayaks appointed on honorarium will be paid a fixed monthly consolidated amount of Rs. 9960 per month, as determined by the government; no other allowance will be payable. The honorarium appointment will be for 01 year and will be completely temporary. As per the sanction of the posts, the appointment will run from the date of joining up to 28.02.2027; after that the appointing officer may decide to extend it on the basis of work ability, work efficiency, behaviour, the department's need and the suitability of the honorarium appointment. The honorarium appointment will be deemed to end automatically when its period expires. Either party may end the honorarium appointment by giving 1 month's prior notice or 1 month's honorarium. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions of the post.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Attested copies of educational qualification certificates (all marksheets and certificates self-attested). Age certificate (copy of matric certificate). Residence certificate. Caste certificate (if applicable): only a permanent caste certificate issued by the competent authority is accepted, and a caste verification certificate or an affidavit must be attached with it. Employment registration certificate (live registration with the Employment Office). Self-attested photograph on the application form.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: A selection committee constituted at the Janpad Panchayat level will prepare a gram panchayat-wise merit list. After approval by the District Programme Coordinator (Collector), the appointment order will be issued by the Chief Executive Officer, Janpad Panchayat Bijapur. The merit list is prepared out of 100 marks: If no SC/ST woman candidate is available, a male candidate of the same category may be selected. In gram panchayats from which no applications of eligible candidates are received, a candidate of the same category living in a nearby gram panchayat (within Janpad Panchayat Bijapur) may be selected according to merit. The decision of the Collector and District Programme Coordinator, District Bijapur, on applications and selection will be final and binding.

content_sections.heading: ISRO SDSC SHAR Apprentice Vacancy 2026
content_sections.text: A total of 400 apprenticeship positions are distributed across six training categories. Trade Apprentices account for the largest number of positions, followed by Non-Engineering Graduates and DCCP apprentices.

content_sections.heading: ISRO SDSC SHAR Apprentice 2026 Discipline-Wise Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The notification provides separate position counts for each engineering branch, academic discipline and technical trade. Applicants should select the category matching their completed qualification rather than applying for an unrelated trade or discipline.

content_sections.heading: ISRO SDSC SHAR Apprentice 2026 Category-Wise Reservation
content_sections.text: The official notification specifies reservation across Unreserved (UR), Other Backward Classes (OBC), Scheduled Castes (SC), Scheduled Tribes (ST) and Economically Weaker Sections (EWS). Reservation is applied at the apprenticeship category level according to Government of India norms.

content_sections.heading: ISRO SDSC SHAR Apprentice Eligibility Criteria 2026
content_sections.text: Applicants must possess the educational qualifications prescribed for their apprenticeship category. Engineering and Non-Engineering Graduate Apprentices require the relevant degree, while Technician, Trade and Vocational Apprentices must possess the specified diploma, trade or vocational qualification. Important Eligibility Conditions: Graduate and Diploma Apprenticeship candidates must have passed their relevant qualifications in 2022 or later . Applicants with sandwich-course certificates, short-term/certificate courses or those pursuing higher studies are not eligible under the stated conditions. Candidates who have already completed or are currently undergoing apprenticeship training, have one year or more of experience in an organization, or have been terminated from or withdrawn from apprenticeship training are also not eligible. Only Indian nationals may apply.

rows.educational_qualification: B.E./B.Tech in the relevant discipline from a recognized university/institute, first class with at least 60% marks or 6.32 CGPA.
B.Sc in Mathematics, Physics, Chemistry, Electronics or Computer Science, or B.Com/B.A. from a recognized university/institute, first class with at least 60% marks or 6.32 CGPA.
Diploma in the relevant discipline from a recognized university/institute, first class with at least 60% marks or 6.32 CGPA.
SSLC/SSC with ITI/NTC in the relevant trade from NCVT.
Certificate in the relevant vocational course involving two years of study after secondary school education, recognized by AICTE.

content_sections.heading: ISRO SDSC SHAR Apprentice Age Limit 2026
content_sections.text: The uploaded apprenticeship notification does not specify a separate minimum or maximum numerical age limit. Candidates should follow the eligibility requirements under the applicable apprenticeship rules and the official application portals. Applicants should not assume an age relaxation or upper age limit unless it is officially prescribed.

content_sections.heading: ISRO SDSC SHAR Apprentice Salary / Stipend 2026
content_sections.text: Selected apprentices will receive a monthly stipend according to their category during the prescribed training period. The highest specified stipend is Rs. 12,300 per month for Graduate Apprentices, while Trade and Vocational Apprentices receive Rs. 9,600 per month. Note: The notification lists DCCP as a separate vacancy category but does not separately specify its stipend in the educational qualification and stipend table. Candidates should verify the applicable amount through SDSC SHAR.

rows.monthly_stipend: Refer to the applicable category details in the official portal

content_sections.heading: ISRO SDSC SHAR Apprentice Application Fee 2026
content_sections.text: The official notification does not prescribe a separate application fee amount. Candidates should refer to the official apprenticeship registration portals for any applicable instructions before submitting their applications.

content_sections.heading: ISRO SDSC SHAR Apprentice Selection Process 2026
content_sections.text: Selection for ISRO SDSC SHAR Apprenticeship 2026 will be based on academic merit and document verification. The notification provides for category-wise merit lists using the marks obtained in the relevant educational qualification. It does not announce a separate written examination or interview as part of the stated selection procedure. Academic Merit List: Merit lists will be prepared based on academic scores separately for UR, OBC, SC, ST and EWS categories. Discipline-Wise Shortlisting: Applicants will be shortlisted according to their position in the merit list for the relevant discipline, branch, trade or subject. Document Verification: Shortlisted candidates will be required to attend document verification with original certificates. Final Consideration: Only candidates who attend verification and satisfy all prescribed eligibility requirements will be considered for apprenticeship engagement. No travelling allowance will be provided to candidates attending document verification. Selection is subject to satisfactory verification of qualifications, marks and supporting documents.

content_sections.heading: ISRO SDSC SHAR Apprentice 2026 Training Duration
content_sections.text: The apprenticeship training duration is 12 months , commencing from the execution of the apprenticeship contract. Selected candidates must execute the contract in accordance with the Apprentices Act and submit a medical fitness certificate at the time of joining. Completion of apprenticeship training does not provide any claim to temporary, ad hoc or permanent employment at SDSC SHAR or any other ISRO/Department of Space centre or unit.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply Online for ISRO SDSC SHAR Apprentice Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates must complete the prescribed apprenticeship registration before applying for the SDSC SHAR apprenticeship through the UMANG portal. The official notification provides the following procedure. Visit the NATS portal at nats.education.gov.in or the National Apprenticeship Promotion Scheme portal at www.apprenticeship.gov.in , as applicable. Register on the appropriate apprenticeship portal using the required details and upload the applicable Degree/Diploma certificate and valid government-issued identification documents. After successful registration, retain the generated Enrolment Number or Apprenticeship Registration Number. Ensure that your Aadhaar number is linked to your bank account and enabled for Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT). Visit the UMANG portal at web.umang.gov.in/landing/ . Register or log in to UMANG and search for SDSC SHAR Apprenticeship . Select the appropriate apprenticeship position and enter the required details. Upload the relevant supporting documents in JPG, JPEG or PNG format, not exceeding 1 MB per document, as specified in the notification. Upload the required photograph, signature and category certificates in the format prescribed on UMANG. Carefully verify the educational qualification, marks, passing year, category and other details before submitting the application. Submit the online application on or before 26 November 2026 and retain a copy for future reference. Important: No changes will be permitted after final submission. Applications submitted through any mode other than the prescribed online portal will not be accepted.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required for ISRO SDSC SHAR Apprentice 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates should prepare the documents applicable to their apprenticeship category before beginning registration. The notification requires relevant educational certificates, identification documents and supporting category documents, where applicable. 10th / SSC Certificate Intermediate Certificate, where applicable ITI / NTC Certificate, where applicable Diploma Certificate and Marksheets, where applicable B.E./B.Tech, B.Sc, B.Com or B.A. Certificates and Marksheets, where applicable Relevant Vocational Course Certificate, where applicable Valid Government-Issued Identity Proof Recent Photograph and Signature Valid SC/ST/OBC Certificate, if applicable EWS Income and Asset Certificate valid for 2026-27, if applicable PwBD Certificate and Unique Disability Identity Card, if applicable NATS / Apprenticeship Registration Number The notification specifies JPG/JPEG/PNG format with a maximum file size of 1 MB for the listed supporting educational documents. Photograph, signature and category documents must follow the format and size instructions displayed on UMANG.

content_sections.text: Eligible candidates should use the official apprenticeship registration portals and UMANG application portal. The notification also directs candidates to the ISRO/SDSC SHAR website for subsequent updates, corrigenda and additional instructions.

faq.answer: It depends on the post: 12300 for Engineering Graduate Apprentice, 12300 for Non-Engineering Graduate Apprentice, 10900 for Technician Apprentice (Diploma), 9600 for Trade Apprentice, 9600 for Vocational Apprentice.

faq.question: Q5. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?

content_sections.heading: About SVSU
content_sections.text: Shri Vishwakarma Skill University (SVSU) is located at Village Dudhola, Palwal, Haryana. The notice is issued by its Registrar under Ref. No. SVSU/2026/Estt./3576 dated 03.11.2026. The University says the complete details, including eligibility conditions, selection criteria and general instructions, are available on its website www.svsu.ac.in .

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Applicants are to fill the offline application form printed in the notice and send it by the closing date, 26.11.2026 (up to 05:00 P.M.). Each page of the form must be signed by the applicant. The signed copy, along with all supporting self-attested documents, goes to this address: The Assistant Registrar (Estt.), Takshashila Bhawan, Administrative Block, Shri Vishwakarma Skill University, Village-Dudhola, Palwal, Haryana- 121002 The notice names no postal mode and gives no text to write on the envelope. It does not give an email address for applications. Incomplete applications, or those received after the last date for any reason including postal delay, are rejected outright. The notice says the fee is accepted through offline mode only and prints http://forms.eduqfix.com/svsurectff/add in the same sentence. The payment slip must be attached to the application form. Fee once deposited is neither transferable nor refundable or adjustable. The fee relaxation applies to the reserved categories of Haryana State only. Separately, the notice says that if a post is withdrawn from being filled, the University will refund the application fee to the applicants.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Signed application form, with each page signed, and a self-attested coloured passport size photograph pasted on it. Fee payment slip. All supporting documents self-attested, page numbered, with the attached documents listed in the form (item 21). Caste certificate, with a scanned copy for claiming fee concession. Scheduled Caste applicants must submit the certificate strictly as per State Govt. notification no. 22/163/2024-5HR-III dated 13.11.2024, otherwise no DSC/OSC reservation benefit is given and the application is rejected. Disability certificate for persons with disability, as the form asks. Document for conversion of CGPA into equivalent marks, if a Grade Point System applies. Experience certificate showing the period of work and designation with pay scale/pay band/pay level, supported by PF statement/Form 16/Bank Statement/ITR or other valid proof of salary. Permanently employed candidates: an advance copy of the application sent directly to the University by the last date, and an application through proper channel or a No Objection Certificate at the time of interview. The form also asks for the Aadhaar number (desirable, but not mandatory), the names and addresses of two referees, employment record, academic details and, for in-service candidates, a check list to be filled by the employer for the last 5 years.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: The notice describes screening, a written test, a skill test and an interview of shortlisted candidates. The dates of the tests and the interview are not given. Candidates found eligible by the Screening Committee and shortlisted by the University will be called for interview. Those declared ineligible will not be informed. Mere possession of the minimum qualification and experience does not entitle a candidate to be called for the written test or interview, and the University may restrict the shortlisted applicants to a reasonable number. The written and skill tests are two mandatory components. A General category candidate must secure minimum 40% marks, and DSC/OSC/BCA/BCB/PwBD candidates minimum 38% marks, in the written test as well as in the skill test. The selection is made on merit of both tests. The structure and syllabus of the test will be uploaded on the University website in due course. The written test is held first and a candidate must secure minimum 40% marks to qualify. The skill test (stenography) is then held for those who qualify. Candidates who qualify both tests are considered for checking of eligibility and document verification, and the notice says selection is made on merit of the written test. Original documents supporting the claims must be produced for verification before or at the time of interview, if called. No TA/DA is paid for attending any written test, skill test, presentation or interview.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in SVSU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 10 regular non-teaching posts: Assistant 2, Steno-typist (Hindi & English) 2, Hostel Attendant (Male & Female) 2, Sanitary Officer 1, Plumber 1, Restorer 1 and Carpenter 1.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for SVSU non-teaching posts?
faq.answer: The application must be sent by 26 November 2026, up to 05:00 P.M. Applications received after the last date, including by postal delay, are rejected.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for SVSU recruitment?
faq.answer: The age limit is 18 to 42 years as on last date. Age relaxation follows the Haryana Government letter dated 25.03.2022, only for Haryana categories and only where the post is reserved for them.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification for the SVSU Assistant post?
faq.answer: The Assistant post needs a Bachelor's Degree with minimum 50% marks and five years' experience as Clerk or Clerk-Cum-Data Entry Operator, plus Hindi/Sanskrit up to Matric or higher level. Computer and Internet proficiency is desirable.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee for SVSU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The fee is Rs. 1000/- for male General category candidates including DESM of Haryana, and for all candidates of other states. It is Rs. 250/- for Female General candidates of Haryana and for DSC/OSC/BCA/BCB/ESM/EWS candidates of Haryana. It is Nil for Haryana PwD candidates with at least 40% disability.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for SVSU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill the offline form, sign each page and attach the fee payment slip and self-attested documents. Send it to The Assistant Registrar (Estt.), Takshashila Bhawan, Administrative Block, Shri Vishwakarma Skill University, Village-Dudhola, Palwal, Haryana- 121002.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for SVSU non-teaching posts?
faq.answer: The notice describes a written test of 50 marks and a skill test of 50 marks, with a minimum of 40% for General and 38% for DSC/OSC/BCA/BCB/PwBD candidates. Shortlisted candidates are called for interview.

faq.question: Q8. Is there a skill test for the Steno-typist post?
faq.answer: Yes. The Steno-typist written test of 50 marks comes first, with minimum 40% to qualify, followed by a skill test (stenography) of qualifying nature for those who pass the written test.

faq.question: Q9. Are the SVSU posts permanent?
faq.answer: The notice invites applications for the posts on regular basis.

faq.question: Q10. Which posts are reserved in SVSU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Only the Assistant post is reserved, with one of its two posts for Gen and one for DSC (Deprived Scheduled Caste of Haryana). The other six posts are marked Gen.

The notice is signed by Dr. Asok Biswas, CMOH & Secretary, District Health and Family Welfare Samiti, Purulia.
