content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: All applicants must be permanent residents of West Bengal and must possess adequate knowledge of the local language. The notice states that the prescribed conditions are non-relaxable. Each post's own conditions are below. Essential: Graduate from any recognized university and have completed at least 1 year Diploma Course in Computer (including MS Office – MS Word, MS Power Point, MS Excel) from a Govt. registered Institution. Desirable: Exposure in social sector schemes/Govt. Missions at National, State and District level. Age: Minimum 21 years and maximum 40 years as on date 01.04.2026. Essential: Graduate degree in Homeopathy (BHMS) from a recognized university. Desirable: Working experience in Public Health Programme of Government / PSUs or reputed private organization. Desirable: Exposure in social sector schemes/Govt. Missions at National, State and District level; computer knowledge including MS Office – MS Word, MS Power Point, MS Excel. Age: Minimum 21 years and maximum 50 years as on date 01.04.2026. Essential criteria: Retired State Govt. Employees; Computer Literate Person. Desirable: Experience of working in the Health & FW Dept will be given preference (experience of working at clerical posts like LDC/accounts clerk etc.). Age: Maximum age limit 62 years as on date 01.04.2026. Essential: Retired State Government Employees with experiences in the related field. Class X Pass. Computer Knowledge. Must be fit physically and mentally. Age: Maximum age limit 62 years as on date 01.04.2026. Essential: Graduation in Computer Application/IT/Business Administration/B.Tech (C.S) or (I.T)/BCA/BBA/B.Sc-IT/Graduation with one year Diploma/Certificate course in Computer Application from a Government registered institute or university. Working knowledge of computer with operating knowledge of MS Word, MS Power Point, MS Excel, MS Access and Internet. Essential experience: Minimum 1 year of post-qualification experience in a Government or any other reputed organization. Desirable: Typing speed of English – 30 WPM and Bengali – 25 WPM; exposure in social sector schemes at National, State and District level. Residence: Candidates shall be the permanent resident of the district concerned or within the same Revenue Division. Age: Minimum 21 years and maximum 40 years as on date 01.04.2026. Age relaxation for reserved categories shall be admissible as per the prevailing rules/orders of the Government of West Bengal, and only for candidates of the categories for which such relaxation is permissible under the prevailing Government rules. For the full eligibility of each post, candidates should check the official notification.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The pay for every post is a consolidated remuneration per month: Rs. 40,000/- for each Ayush Doctor, 25,000/- for the Data Entry Operator, Rs. 15,000/- for each Multipurpose Worker (MPW), Rs.12,000/- for the Accountant and Rs.10,000/- for the Lower Division Clerk. The LDC and Accountant posts, open only to retired State Government employees, carry the same fixed consolidated amount given in the table. The engagement is purely contractual and temporary in nature. Selected candidates may be posted at any health facility/institution/unit under the administrative control of the District AYUSH Samity/District Health & Family Welfare Samiti, as decided by the competent authority, and no claim for posting at a particular place shall be entertained.

content_sections.heading: About RRC NR
content_sections.text: The Railway Recruitment Cell, Northern Railway conducts this recruitment for posts in Northern Railway against the Scouts & Guides quota for the year 2026-27. The notice is signed by the Chairman, Railway Recruitment Cell, Northern Railway, and the recruitment follows the Railway Board's policy in Master Circular No. 07 dated 13/12/2019, read with later amendments. The RRC website www.rrcnr.org is named as the main source of information for candidates during the selection.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The notice gives 27 posts in total. No post is reserved for SC, ST or OBC; candidates of these categories get only the age relaxation admissible in open market recruitment. A candidate may apply for both Level 1 and Level 2 if eligible, but must submit a separate application form with a separate examination fee for each. Separate examinations will be held for the two levels, tentatively on the same day in two shifts.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Applications are invited from eligible Indian citizens. Each post needs an educational qualification and the same scouting qualification. No relaxation in the educational or Scouts & Guides qualification is permitted, and both must be held at the time of applying. Passed 12th (+2 stage) from a recognized board or its equivalent examination with not less than 50% marks in the aggregate. The 50% marks are not insisted upon for SC / ST / Ex-servicemen for NTPC categories and for candidates with higher qualification such as graduation/post graduation. OR Passed Matriculation from a recognized board plus Course Completed Act Apprenticeship for Technician categories. OR Passed Matriculation from a recognized board plus ITI approved by NCVT/SCVT for technician categories. 10th passed + National Apprenticeship Certificate (NAC) granted by NCVT OR 10th pass + ITI OR 10th Pass or ITI or equivalent or National Apprenticeship Certificate (NAC) granted by NCVT A President Scouts/Guide/Rover/Ranger OR Himalaya Wood Badge (HWB) holder in any section. Should have been an active member of a Scouts organization for the last 5 years, with the Certificate of Activeness as per Annexure-I (signed by the Group Leader, DOC and DC of Scouts/Guides). This certificate must be issued on or after the date of publication of the notification. Should have attended two events at National level OR All Indian Railway's level and two events at State level. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions of each post. The lower and upper age limits will be reckoned as on 01/01/2027. A 10th/Matriculation or equivalent certificate showing the date of birth is mandatory; otherwise the application will be rejected.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Eligible candidates will be called for a written examination (Computer Based Test/Tablet Based Test); those who qualify undergo Document Verification, and the panel is formed on merit of the written examination and the marks on certificates. Candidates recommended for appointment must pass the prescribed medical fitness standards. The examination is in Hindi or English. Negative marking: 1/3rd of the marks for the question deducted for every wrong objective answer. Minimum 40% marks in the written examination are needed for the next stage; relaxation for reserved categories as per Railway Board's rules. Candidates equal to 5 times the notified vacancies will be called for Document Verification on merit. Written Examination and Document Verification will be held in Delhi only. The syllabus (Annexure-II) covers History of Scouting/Guiding; Law & Promise; organisation at district, state and national level; training centres; Scouting for Boys/Guiding for Girls in India; motto, left hand shake, salute, prayer, flag song, National Anthem and flags; social services; hiking; proficiency badges; stages in Scouting/Guiding; Thinking Day; progressive training; pioneering; handicrafts; Indian Railway Jamborette, National Jamboree and Jamboree on the Air; WAGGGS/WOSM; Uprashtrapati Award and Prime Minister Shield competitions; community development programmes; and the aims and methods of Scouting.

content_sections.text: Walk-in interview; selection based on performance in the interview or any other criteria adopted by the selection committee(s) If a large number of candidates appear, the Selection/Screening Committee may shortlist for the interview based on a written exam or any other criteria Panel of suitable candidates, valid for a maximum of one year; empanelment gives no automatic guarantee of engagement Selection is based on performance in the interview or any other criteria adopted by the selection committee(s). content_sections.heading: How to Apply for CSIR-NAL Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Attend the walk-in interview on the date for your specialization with the duly filled application form in the prescribed format enclosed with the notice. The application form is available on the website https://www.nal.res.in. Do not send the application by post, speed post or e-mail. Apply separately for each position you want to be considered for. Report between 9.00 AM and 9.30 AM at the venue for registration and verification of documents; no registration after 09.45 AM. Mention your category (SC/ST/OBC/PH/EWS) clearly and attach documentary proof if claiming age relaxation. Attend on 12 November 2026, reporting at 9:00 AM.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: If the interview is not completed on the indicated day, candidates may have to attend the next day. No TA/DA will be paid for attending the walk-in interview. Director, CSIR-NAL may increase or decrease the number of positions or cancel the recruitment at any stage. Queries: 080-25086048 / 22514032; [email protected] A claimed equivalent qualification needs an order/letter showing the authority, number and date, otherwise the application is liable to be rejected.

basic_details.short_information: The official notification does not specify the pay, the application fee or the website address of the online application.

age_limit.details: Applicants for both posts must be within the age limit of 19-35 years. Persons with disabilities get an age relaxation of 10 years. The notice does not print a cut-off date for counting age.

qualification.details: Post Qualification Required Anganwadi Worker Minimum P.U.C. pass. Must have studied Kannada as first or second language in S.S.L.C. Anganwadi Helper Minimum SSLC or equivalent pass. Must have studied Kannada as first or second language. | Preference for Anganwadi Worker: candidates holding an ECCE diploma course from D.S.E.R.T., JOC course or N.T.T. course from Government-recognised institutions, a Diploma in Nutrition, a Home Science certificate course, or one-year nursery or pre-primary training certificate related to Anganwadi activities get first preference and +5 bonus marks. | Further rules for Anganwadi Helper: | Candidates who passed S.S.L.C. from schools or open schools under the Karnataka Secondary Education Examination Board must have studied Kannada as first or second language and general mathematics and social science; they are considered if the certificate or marks card shows maximum 625 and minimum 219 marks. For candidates who studied in other states with Kannada as first or second language, if the maximum and minimum SSLC marks fixed in that state differ from those fixed in Karnataka, only candidates who studied in Karnataka are considered. Whatever the medium or state of study, Anganwadi Helpers must have studied Kannada as first or second language. For candidates whose mother tongue is not Kannada, the selection committee may hold an interview and, if needed, test reading and writing in Kannada before deciding. | Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility rules of each post.

selection_process: CategoryBenefit
Women who survived an acid attack+5 bonus marks
Residents of the department's reform institutions / State Women's Homes (minimum 3 years)+10 bonus marks; may apply anywhere in the district where the residence certificate is given
Persons with disabilities+5 bonus marks
Daughters of ex-Devadasis, project displaced persons, divorced women+5 bonus marks (subject to an official certificate)
Anganwadi Worker applicants with ECCE / JOC / NTT / nutrition / home science / nursery trainingFirst preference and +5 bonus marks
Selection for both posts is on merit: a combined list is prepared online on the total of the marks in the prescribed qualification and the bonus marks. The notice describes no written examination.

content_sections.heading: About Chamarajanagar Anganwadi Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: The recruitment fills vacant posts at Anganwadi centres run by the Women and Child Development Department in Chamarajanagar district, Karnataka. The Deputy Commissioner's office has asked the National Informatics Centre (NIC), Chamarajanagar, to invite the applications online. Selection follows the Karnataka Government guidelines in Government Order No. ಮಮಇ 154 ಐಸಿಡಿ 2020 dated 03-12-2022 and its modification order dated 18-11-2024, both attached to the notice.

content_sections.heading: Chamarajanagar Anganwadi Recruitment 2026 Important Dates
content_sections.text: The documents are attached to the online application itself, so 4 December 2026 is the single deadline for both the form and the documents.

content_sections.heading: Vacancies by Project / Block
content_sections.text: Most of the posts, 271 of 390, are Anganwadi Helper posts. The vacancies are spread over the 5 taluk Child Development Projects of the district. The notice does not give a project-wise or centre-wise list.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Only women and transgender minority women are eligible to apply for the Anganwadi Worker and Anganwadi Helper posts. Applicants for both posts must be within the age limit of 19-35 years. Persons with disabilities get an age relaxation of 10 years. The notice does not print a cut-off date for counting age. For an Anganwadi centre in a rural area, the applicant must live in that revenue village. For an Anganwadi centre in an urban area, the applicant must live in that revenue ward and must have a residence certificate from the competent authority. Election wards are not considered. Residence is confirmed by a three-year residence certificate from the Tahsildar or Deputy Tahsildar, supported by an Aadhaar card, ration card or voter identity card. Applicants from a local majire, tanda or hadi must get the relevant residence certificate from the competent authority. In Anganwadi centres in areas where the minority community makes up 25 per cent of the population, applicants who know that community's language along with Kannada are selected. Preference for Anganwadi Worker: candidates holding an ECCE diploma course from D.S.E.R.T., JOC course or N.T.T. course from Government-recognised institutions, a Diploma in Nutrition, a Home Science certificate course, or one-year nursery or pre-primary training certificate related to Anganwadi activities get first preference and +5 bonus marks. Further rules for Anganwadi Helper: Candidates who passed S.S.L.C. from schools or open schools under the Karnataka Secondary Education Examination Board must have studied Kannada as first or second language and general mathematics and social science; they are considered if the certificate or marks card shows maximum 625 and minimum 219 marks. For candidates who studied in other states with Kannada as first or second language, if the maximum and minimum SSLC marks fixed in that state differ from those fixed in Karnataka, only candidates who studied in Karnataka are considered. Whatever the medium or state of study, Anganwadi Helpers must have studied Kannada as first or second language. For candidates whose mother tongue is not Kannada, the selection committee may hold an interview and, if needed, test reading and writing in Kannada before deciding. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility rules of each post.

rows.qualification_required: Minimum P.U.C. pass. Must have studied Kannada as first or second language in S.S.L.C.
Minimum SSLC or equivalent pass. Must have studied Kannada as first or second language.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection for both posts is on merit: a combined list is prepared online on the total of the marks in the prescribed qualification and the bonus marks. The notice describes no written examination. When widows apply, they are selected directly at third priority, after acid attack survivors and residents of department institutions, without considering the other applications. A woman who becomes a widow after applying is not considered. Among widows, the widow of a farmer who died by suicide gets first priority. The place where the widow currently lives, as shown in her residence certificate, is taken as her residence. If two widows apply for one post, the one with the higher marks may be selected. Widows must attach the husband's death certificate or the widow certificate. The notice fixes the extent of physical disability as not more than 40 per cent. The place shown in the residence certificate is taken as the candidate's residence. If there is doubt about the extent of disability, the candidate is asked to appear in person before the selection committee, which decides whether she can do the job. The taluk-level verification committee, headed by the Tahsildar, checks the applications and sends the list to the Deputy Director. The district selection committee, chaired by the Deputy Commissioner, meets within 7 working days after the last date. Applications without any required document are rejected; unclear or incomplete documents are not considered. Candidates with the highest marks are selected and a provisional selection list is published on the notice board the same day. Seven days are given for objections; the final selection list is published on the notice board after they are considered. If more than one candidate has equal marks, the older candidate is preferred; if the age is also equal, a widow or divorced woman is preferred. The decision of the selection committee is final.

content_sections.text: Eligibility for TNPSC Group 4 varies according to the post code. Candidates must satisfy the required educational, technical and age conditions for the post they select. content_sections.heading: TNPSC Group 4 Application Fee 2026
content_sections.text: One Time Registration (OTR) is valid for five years from the date of registration. Candidates who already have a valid TNPSC OTR do not need to complete a new registration only for this examination. The ₹100 examination fee must be paid while submitting the application unless the candidate is eligible for an exemption under the TNPSC rules. Applicable fee concessions and free chances vary by category and should be checked in the official notification. Payment should be made through the online modes permitted by TNPSC. Candidates claiming fee exemption must ensure that they satisfy all applicable conditions.

content_sections.heading: TNPSC Group 4 Apply Online 2026
content_sections.text: The TNPSC Group 4 online application process started on 06 October 2026 . Eligible candidates can submit the application until 08 November 2026 at 11:59 PM . Open the official TNPSC examination application portal. Complete One Time Registration if you do not already have a valid OTR. Log in using your registered credentials. Select Combined Civil Services Examination-IV / Notification No. 11/2026. Check the post options carefully before making your selection. Enter the required personal, educational and category details. Upload the required documents in the prescribed format. Pay the examination fee or claim exemption if eligible. Review all entered details carefully. Submit the application before 08 November 2026 at 11:59 PM. Save the application number and submitted application for future reference. Candidates who need to correct eligible details after submission can use the application correction window from 09 November to 11 November 2026 . Important: One Time Registration alone is not an application for TNPSC Group 4. Candidates must separately submit the online application for Notification No. 11/2026.

content_sections.heading: TNPSC Group 4 Photo and Signature Size 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates applying for the TNPSC Group 4 Notification 2026 must upload their photograph and signature in the size, dimensions and format prescribed by TNPSC. Incorrect, unclear or improperly sized images may result in problems while submitting the online application. The photograph uploaded for the TNPSC Group 4 2026 application should be a recent colour passport-size photograph taken in a photo studio against a white background . The candidate should face the camera directly, with both ears and part of the neck clearly visible. The photograph should measure 3.5 cm in width and 4.5 cm in height (130 × 170 pixels) . The image file should be between 20 KB and 50 KB , scanned at 200 DPI and saved in JPG format. The candidate's name and the date on which the photograph was taken should be printed at the bottom of the photograph. For this recruitment, the photograph should have been taken on or after 06 October 2026 , the date of the TNPSC Group 4 notification. Of the total 4.5 cm photograph height, the candidate's image should occupy approximately 3.0 cm (115 pixels) , while the name and date portion should occupy approximately 1.5 cm (55 pixels) . For the signature image, draw a box measuring 6.0 cm × 2.0 cm on a white sheet and sign inside the box using a blue or black ink pen . Scan the signature at 200 DPI and crop the image so that only the signature box is visible. The final signature should measure approximately 230 × 75 pixels and have a file size between 10 KB and 20 KB . Save it as a JPG image before uploading. Photo Size: 20 KB to 50 KB Photo Dimensions: 130 × 170 pixels Photo Physical Size: 3.5 cm × 4.5 cm Signature Size: 10 KB to 20 KB Signature Dimensions: 230 × 75 pixels Signature Physical Size: 6.0 cm × 2.0 cm Resolution: 200 DPI File Format: JPG Important: Avoid selfies, mobile-phone photographs, photocopied photographs or photographs with unsuitable backgrounds. Upload clear images in the prescribed size and format.

content_sections.heading: TNPSC Group 4 Photo Compressor – Resize Photo and Signature Online
content_sections.text: If your TNPSC Group 4 photograph or signature is larger than the prescribed upload size, you can resize and compress the image before submitting the application. Use the TNPSC Group 4 Photo Compressor and Image Resizer to adjust the photograph or signature to the required dimensions and file size. For the TNPSC Group 4 application, resize the photograph to 130 × 170 pixels and 20 KB–50 KB . The signature should be resized to 230 × 75 pixels and 10 KB–20 KB . Open the FreeJobAlert Image Resizer . Upload your TNPSC Group 4 passport-size photograph. Set the required dimensions to 130 × 170 pixels . Keep the final file size between 20 KB and 50 KB . Download the resized image and check that your face, name and photograph date are clearly visible. Upload the final JPG image while filling the TNPSC Group 4 online application. Sign with blue or black ink inside a 6.0 cm × 2.0 cm box on white paper. Scan or create a clear digital image of the signature. Open the FreeJobAlert Image Resizer . Resize the signature to 230 × 75 pixels . Keep the final file size between 10 KB and 20 KB . Save the image in JPG format and upload it to the TNPSC application portal. Tip: After compressing the photograph or signature, open the downloaded image once and make sure it is clear and not blurred before uploading it to the TNPSC portal.

content_sections.heading: About the Project
content_sections.text: The posts are in a research project at the Department of Neurology, Neuro Science Centre, AIIMS, New Delhi, led by Dr. Anu Gupta, Associate Professor, Department of Neurology. The project, funded by the Indian Council of Medical Research (ICMR), is a cluster randomized controlled trial that compares holistic lifestyle education with physical and cognitive training against the existing rural Indian lifestyle, to improve cognition and prevent dementia in cognitively normal, high-risk rural older adults. It is part of the SMRUTHI INDIA initiative.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The notice gives 5 provisional vacancies for Office Attendant, divided by reservation category. Of these, 3 posts are for women under 35% horizontal reservation. The notice states that the number of advertised posts may decrease or increase. Reservation is given only to candidates whose permanent residence is in Bihar. Residents of other states do not get reservation benefit. Reservation must be claimed in the marked column of the online form; the permanent address filled in the online form is taken for reservation purposes. SC and ST candidates claiming reservation must have a caste certificate and a permanent residence (domicile) certificate. For unmarried or married women, the caste certificate must be issued from the father's permanent address. BC and EBC candidates claiming reservation must have a caste certificate, a permanent residence certificate and a non-creamy layer certificate (women: issued from the father's permanent address). EWS gets 10% reservation as per rules when a vacancy is available; the income and asset certificate must be in Annexure-1 (Form-1) of the General Administration Department notification No. 2622 dated 26.02.2019. Women get 35% horizontal reservation as per rules when a vacancy is available. The reservation category cannot be changed while the appointment process is under way.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Nationality: The candidate must be a citizen of India. Educational qualification: By the last date of online application, the candidate must have passed Matric or equivalent from a board recognised by the State Government or the Central Government. The minimum age is 18 years. Age will be counted from the date of birth recorded in the Matric or equivalent examination certificate. Each relaxation requires a certificate from the competent authority. For disability, the certificate must be valid up to the last date of application. For the discipline and post-wise details, candidates should check the official notification.

rows.category: General (Unreserved) women, Backward Class and Extremely Backward Class (men and women)
Scheduled Caste and Scheduled Tribe (men and women)

rows.relaxation: 5 years, allowed only if they have not already used a maximum of 5 attempts
10 years beyond the maximum age limit
3 years plus the period of service in defence, provided actual age is not more than 57 years on the date of application

content_sections.heading: Application Fee
content_sections.text: The fee is paid online by Net Banking, Credit Card or Debit Card while applying, by 6 December 2026. Bank charges are payable on top of the fee. The fee will not be refunded. SC or ST candidates who pay the SC/ST fee and later cannot produce the certificate, or whose certificate is doubted, may be declared ineligible; such candidates may choose to pay the general fee to keep their candidature safe.

rows.category: EBC, BC, EWS and Unreserved men who are native residents of Bihar; candidates from outside Bihar of any category (women or men)
SC, ST and candidates with 40% or more disability who are native residents of Bihar; women of all categories who are native residents of Bihar

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Bihar Vidhan Sabha Office Attendant
content_sections.text: Use the "Apply Online" link given in the notice to register and fill the online application between 7 November 2026 (from 11:00 AM) and 6 December 2026. Enter your own working mobile number and email ID, and keep the email ID, mobile number, User Name and Password safe until the final result. Upload scans of your educational qualification certificate, reservation-related certificates, a recent photograph and your signature, and make sure the images are clear. Pay the examination fee online by Net Banking, Credit Card or Debit Card, and print and keep the bank receipt. After final submission, log in again and download the filled application from "Download Filled Application Section" on the dashboard; print two copies. Check that the Bar Code and Application Number appear on every page of the printout; without either, the application is treated as incomplete and will not be accepted. Detailed instructions for the online application are on the Sabha Sachivalaya website, https://vidhansabha.bihar.gov.in/ . Printed, typed or handwritten applications outside the online form will not be accepted.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Candidates for the Office Attendant post will be interviewed. The interview carries 100 marks, and the merit list will be prepared on interview marks. If applications exceed 40,000, a preliminary examination (OMR answer-sheet based, objective multiple choice) may be held. In that case, about 10 times the number of vacancies, from among candidates who obtain the fixed qualifying marks, will be selected for the interview. Candidates who do not reach these marks will be out of the competition. Equal marks: the older candidate is placed higher. Equal marks and same date of birth: the candidate with the higher educational qualification is placed higher. Still equal: the order follows the Devanagari alphabetical order of the name as written in the Class 10 board certificate. Information on the examination or interview programme will be published on the Bihar Vidhan Sabha website.

basic_details.short_information: The recruitment is being conducted for Despatch Rider (Group-C) positions at the Aizawl Bench of the Gauhati High Court. Selected candidates will receive remuneration under Pay Level-2. The important recruitment details are provided below.

application_fee.details: Candidates must pay the prescribed application fee according to their category. The fee must be paid before the notified deadline. | Fee Payment Last Date: 27 November 2026, within bank transaction hours. | Note: The application fee is non-refundable and cannot be carried forward to another examination or selection process.

age_limit.details: The minimum age for applicants is 18 years. The maximum age limit depends on the candidate's category and will be calculated as of the last date for receipt of online applications, 21 November 2026. | Age Calculation Date: 21 November 2026. | Candidates should check the official notification for all applicable eligibility and category-related conditions before submitting their applications.

qualification.education_qualification: Middle School Leaving Certificate
qualification.details: Applicants must satisfy the educational qualification, driving licence and language requirements prescribed under the Mizoram Despatch Rider Recruitment Rules, 2002. | Important: Possessing both the prescribed driving licences and working knowledge of the Mizo language is essential. Candidates who do not meet these requirements should not apply.

salary_details.details: The notification specifies the pay structure but does not provide an exact in-hand salary figure.

selection_process: Stage Selection Test Marks
Stage I Written Examination 60
Stage II Two-Wheeler Skill Test 40
Stage III Interview / Viva-Voce 20
Subject Marks
Road Sign Recognition 10
General English (Middle School Standard) 20
General Knowledge 10
Mizo Language Proficiency 20
Total 60
Skill Test Component Marks
Starting 10
Riding 10
Parking 10
After Riding 10
Total 40
The selection process consists of three stages: a Written Examination
a Two-Wheeler Skill Test and an Interview/Viva-Voce. Final selection will be based on marks obtained in the prescribed stages
subject to the qualifying conditions.
The written examination will be an objective-type test conducted on an OMR sheet. The duration is 60 minutes
and the paper carries 60 marks.
The Mizo language proficiency section is qualifying in nature. Candidates must obtain at least 40% marks
equivalent to 8 out of 20
in this section. Marks scored in the Mizo language segment will not be considered while preparing the merit list.

Candidates shortlisted in a ratio of 1:5 based on their written examination merit will be called for the skill test. The skill test carries 40 marks and evaluates practical two-wheeler riding abilities.
The riding test will be conducted using a two-wheeler vehicle with or without gear. Candidates must secure at least 50% marks
equivalent to 20 out of 40
to qualify for the skill test.
Candidates will be shortlisted for the Interview/Viva-Voce in a ratio of 1:3 based on their performance in the written examination and skill test. The interview carries 20 marks.
Applicants must secure at least 12 out of 20 marks (60%) to qualify for the interview stage. Document verification will also be conducted as part of the selection process.
Final selection will be based on the combined marks obtained in the written examination
skill test and interview
excluding the qualifying Mizo language component from the merit calculation.
In the event of a tie
preference will be given first to the candidate securing higher written examination marks
followed by higher skill test marks. If a tie still remains
the older candidate will receive preference.
The Gauhati High Court reserves the right to fix or modify the cutoff marks for the selection stages.
how_to_apply: Eligible candidates can submit their applications online through the Gauhati High Court website or the Aizawl Bench website. Applicants must have an active email address and mobile number before starting the registration process.
Visit the official website at ghconline.gov.in or ghcazlbench.nic.in.
Find the link titled "Online application for the post of Despatch Rider (Group-C) in the Aizawl Bench of the Gauhati High Court".
Open the application portal and complete registration using a valid email address and mobile number.
Note down the Registration Code generated during registration.
Fill in the required personal details, educational qualification details and other information in the application form.
Upload clear scanned copies of the required certificates and supporting documents.
Check all entered information carefully before final submission.
Submit the online application before 21 November 2026, within office working hours.
Pay the prescribed application fee before 27 November 2026, within bank transaction hours.
Save the application details, Registration Code and payment confirmation for future reference.
Important: No changes or corrections to the application form will be permitted after submission. Applications submitted through any mode other than the prescribed online process will be rejected.
Candidates must upload the prescribed scanned documents when submitting their online applications.
Age proof such as Birth Certificate or Class X Admit Card
Educational qualification mark sheet or pass certificate
SC/ST Certificate, if applicable
No Objection Certificate (NOC), if employed in Government Service
Applicants must also produce their original certificates and other relevant records whenever required during subsequent stages of the recruitment process.
important_instructions: Candidates must fulfil all prescribed educational, age, driving licence and language requirements. Incomplete applications, including those without the required photograph or signature, may be rejected. All details provided in the online application must be accurate and supported by valid documents. Candidates already employed in Government Service must comply with the prescribed employer intimation and NOC requirements. No travelling allowance or daily allowance (TA/DA) will be provided for attending the written examination, skill test or interview. The number of vacancies may change at the time of final selection. The High Court may publish provisional lists of eligible and rejected candidates on its official website.

selection_process: Category Minimum Qualifying Marks
UR/EWS 40%
OBC (NCL), SC and ST 30%
Selection is conducted through a two-stage process consisting of a Computer Based Examination followed by Document Verification and a qualifying Skill Test.

Stage I: Computer Based Examination (CBE). Stage II: Document Verification and Skill Test. Final Merit: Based on CBE marks among candidates found eligible in document verification and qualified in the Skill Test.
Candidates are generally shortlisted for the Skill Test in the ratio of 1:3 against the available category-wise vacancies for the relevant unit and trade. For a single vacancy in a trade/category
up to five candidates may be shortlisted.
For eligible PwBD and Ex-servicemen candidates
the notification permits further qualifying-mark relaxation under specified conditions
subject to minimum standards of 30% for UR/EWS and 22.5% for OBC/SC/ST.
The Skill Test is qualifying in nature. Final merit is determined by CBE marks after successful completion of document verification and the Skill Test.

content_sections.heading: BHEL Artisan Eligibility Criteria 2027
content_sections.text: Candidates must possess all three of the following qualifications in the relevant trade: Class 10 or Matriculation. National Trade Certificate (NTC/ITI). National Apprenticeship Certificate (NAC). The qualification cut-off date is 1 October 2026 . Candidates must have obtained the required ITI/NTC and NAC certificates or marksheets by this date. Only full-time regular courses will be considered. The National Apprenticeship Certificate must be issued by the competent authority. Special Condition: SC/ST/PwBD candidates applying against vacancies not reserved for their respective categories will be considered under general merit standards, without relaxation in the minimum educational percentage. Eligible Ex-servicemen claiming prescribed trade equivalency may receive the notified exemption from minimum marks requirements. Knowledge of the regional language is desirable for manufacturing units in Tamil Nadu, Telangana, Andhra Pradesh and Karnataka. Hindi knowledge is desirable for the other manufacturing units.

content_sections.heading: BHEL Artisan Age Limit 2027
content_sections.text: The upper age limit for General and EWS candidates is 27 years as of 1 October 2026 . Maximum Age Ceiling: The age of a candidate, including all permissible relaxations, must not exceed 56 years as of 1 October 2026. Applicants claiming work-experience-based relaxation must submit the relevant experience certificate in the format prescribed by BHEL.

content_sections.heading: BHEL Artisan Salary 2027
content_sections.text: Selected candidates will initially work as Temporary Artisans for one year with consolidated monthly wages of Rs. 24,000. Upon successful completion of the temporary period, candidates will be regularized in the Artisan Grade-IV establishment according to the prevailing company rules. Applicable allowances will be provided as per the rules in force at regularization.

content_sections.heading: BHEL Artisan Selection Process 2027
content_sections.text: Selection is conducted through a two-stage process consisting of a Computer Based Examination followed by Document Verification and a qualifying Skill Test. Stage I: Computer Based Examination (CBE). Stage II: Document Verification and Skill Test. Final Merit: Based on CBE marks among candidates found eligible in document verification and qualified in the Skill Test. Candidates are generally shortlisted for the Skill Test in the ratio of 1:3 against the available category-wise vacancies for the relevant unit and trade. For a single vacancy in a trade/category, up to five candidates may be shortlisted. For eligible PwBD and Ex-servicemen candidates, the notification permits further qualifying-mark relaxation under specified conditions, subject to minimum standards of 30% for UR/EWS and 22.5% for OBC/SC/ST. The Skill Test is qualifying in nature. Final merit is determined by CBE marks after successful completion of document verification and the Skill Test.

content_sections.heading: BHEL Artisan Exam Pattern 2027
content_sections.text: The BHEL Artisan Computer Based Examination will contain 120 multiple-choice questions carrying 120 marks, with a duration of 90 minutes . Examination Mode: Computer Based Examination Question Type: Objective Multiple Choice Total Questions: 120 Total Marks: 120 Examination Duration: 90 Minutes Correct Answer: 1 Mark Incorrect Answer: Deduction of 0.25 Mark Languages: Hindi, English and one selected regional language option The examination will be trilingual. Candidates may choose Hindi, English or a notified regional language such as Kannada, Telugu or Tamil. Where the English and Hindi versions differ, the English version will be treated as authentic.

content_sections.heading: CRPF Sportsperson Recruitment 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection proceeds through Identity Check, Documentation, Physical Standard Test (PST), Sports Trial Test, and Detailed/Review Medical Examination, in sequence. All candidates undergo document verification, producing original documents/certificates relating to age, education, sports achievement, domicile and category. Candidates unable to produce the prescribed originals are eliminated at this stage; those qualified proceed to the PST. Marks are awarded for the single highest medal/position achieved during the eligible window (30 September 2024 to 30 September 2026); if a candidate has more than one medal, only the highest-scoring one counts. Sample marking tiers: Height/chest relaxations are available for several categories, including Scheduled Tribes (162.5/150 cm), ST candidates of North-Eastern States (157/147.5 cm), ST candidates of Left-Wing Extremism-affected districts (160/147.5 cm), Garhwalis/Kumaonis/Dogras/Marathas and candidates from Assam, Himachal Pradesh, J&K and Ladakh (165/155 cm), candidates from the North-Eastern States of Arunachal Pradesh, Manipur, Meghalaya, Mizoram, Nagaland, Sikkim and Tripura (162.5/152.5 cm), and candidates from the Gorkha Territorial Administration area of Darjeeling district (157/152.5 cm), with corresponding chest relaxations for male candidates in several of these categories. Candidates who qualify the PST undergo the Sports Trial Test, conducted by a Board of Officers. This test is purely qualifying (pass/fail) – no marks are awarded, and total marks for the merit list come only from the achievement marking scheme above. Candidates may be subjected to a Dope Test on the day of the trial; no appeal for re-conduct of the trial test is entertained. Conducted per the Uniform Guidelines for Recruitment Medical Examination for GOs and NGOs in CAPFs and AR (MHA U.O. No. A.VI-1/2014-Rectt(SSB) dated 20.05.2015 and MHA OM No. E.32012/ADG(Med)/DME/RME/DA-1/2020(Part file)/1166 dated 31.05.2021, as amended). Minimum distance vision required is 6/6 and 6/9 in both eyes without correction; colour-blind candidates are not eligible; candidates must not have knock knee, flat foot, varicose veins or squint. Tattoos are restricted in content (secular/religious symbols only, as per Indian Army norms), location (left forearm inner aspect or dorsum of hands only) and size (less than ¼ of that body part). Candidates declared unfit in DME may undergo RME. Where marks are comparable, preference follows this order: (a) International representation with Department of Sports clearance; (b) Senior/Junior National Championship representation with a medal (Senior preferred over Junior); (c) Inter-University/Khelo India University Games medal; (d) Khelo India Youth/Winter Games medal; (e) School National Games medal; (f) participation at levels (b)–(e) without a medal, in the same order.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for CRPF Sportsperson Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Visit rect.crpf.gov.in and read the instructions carefully before filling the application. Create your profile and upload a copy of the certificate/document for your sports discipline, in support of your highest medal/position or highest level of participation, before applying – applications without this upload will be rejected during scrutiny. Fill the online application form and pay the application fee (where applicable) through the website only. Submit the application before 11 November 2026, 23:59 hrs . Use the correction window (12–14 November 2026) if you need to modify your submitted application. Important: The application must be submitted ONLINE only; no offline application is accepted, and candidature of anyone submitting offline will be summarily rejected. Candidates serving in Government/Semi-Government departments must submit their application through their employer along with a No Objection Certificate (as per Annexure-A format) – applications without an NOC will not be accepted.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required (Original, at Document Verification)
content_sections.text: Educational certificates, Sports certificates, Domicile and Caste certificates, etc. Matriculation/10th class certificate, for verification of Date of Birth OBC (NCL) Certificate (Annexure-F), SC/ST Certificate (Annexure-G), or EWS Certificate valid for 2026-27 (Annexure-H), as applicable – certificates in any other format are not accepted Undertaking for OBC (NCL) reservation claim, as per Annexure-F No Objection Certificate (Annexure-B), for candidates serving in Government service, produced at the time of physical document verification Certificate for claiming height/chest relaxation (Annexure-I), if applicable Four latest passport-size photographs, matching the one submitted with the application form

content_sections.heading: Important Conditions
content_sections.text: Application Fee: Male candidates belonging to UR/OBC/EWS pay Rs. 100/- through the recruitment website; the fee is exempted for all female candidates and for SC/ST/Ex-Servicemen candidates. The fee is neither refunded nor adjusted against any other recruitment process, under any circumstances. Selected candidates must submit a bond to serve the Force for a minimum of 3 years (or a specific period as prescribed), backed by an undertaking bond of Rs. 1,00,000/-, to promote sports in the Force, before they can resign for better employment elsewhere or on any other ground. Posts carry All India service liability; selected candidates are liable to serve anywhere in India or abroad, and will be governed by the CRPF Act 1949 and Rules 1955. CRPF reserves the right to modify, cancel, postpone, or reschedule any stage of the recruitment process, and to change the sequence of the recruitment procedure, without assigning any reason. Submitting fabricated documents, or documents that have been tampered with, will lead to cancellation of candidature at any stage, including at the time of document verification or later. The Board of Officers may also recommend cases of Outstanding Sportspersons who show excellent trial performance but require some relaxation in height/chest/weight for their sport, subject to approval by the Ministry of Home Affairs.

faq.question: Q1. How many posts has CRPF advertised under the Sports Quota?
faq.answer: 521 posts – 182 Head Constable (GD) and 339 Constable (GD) – across 22 sports disciplines.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: 11 November 2026, till 23:59 hrs; the application window opened on 12 October 2026 at 9:00 AM.

faq.question: Q3. Who is eligible to apply?
faq.answer: Meritorious male/female sportspersons who have represented the country, a State/UT, their University, or their School in recognized competitions at specified levels, within the last two years, and who meet the age and educational qualification for the post.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: 18 to 23 years as on the cut-off date of 1 August 2026, with age relaxation of 5 to 13 years depending on category and Ex-Servicemen status.

content_sections.heading: District Police Kondagaon Bastar Fighter Constable Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: Applications are invited only from local residents of Kondagaon district. Candidates must be not less than 18 years and not more than 28 years old on 1 January 2026. SC, ST and OBC candidates: upper age limit relaxed by up to 5 years. Local women candidates of Kondagaon district: upper age limit relaxable by up to 10 years, under the Chhattisgarh Civil Services (Special Provisions for Appointment of Women) Rules, 1997. Permanent government servants: not more than 36 years. Temporary post holders applying for another post: not more than 36 years. This also covers employees paid from contingency funds, work-charged employees and those working under a project implementation committee. Retrenched government servants: temporary service of up to 07 years may be deducted from their age, but the resulting age must not be more than three years above the upper age limit. These relaxations for present or former Chhattisgarh Government employees do not apply to anyone declared unfit for government service. All age relaxations are subject to State Government guidelines. 10th pass from a school located in Chhattisgarh or Madhya Pradesh. Scheduled Tribe candidates are eligible with Class 5 pass. Candidates of all categories from Naxal-affected families in the state, or from families living in relief camps in Naxal-affected areas, are eligible with Class 5 pass. The qualification must be held on the last date for submitting the form, and attaching the certificate is the applicant's own responsibility. All candidates measured for chest must show at least 5 cm of expansion. Women candidates are exempt from this requirement. The selection committee's decision on height and chest measurement is final. Candidates must not be physically disabled and must be medically fit. Knock-knee and flat-foot are not allowed. Candidates must have no eye disease and must be able to distinguish the main colours. The competent officer decides these cases by inspection and may consult the District Chief Medical Officer if needed. Third gender candidates follow the men's standards if their certificate states male and the women's standards if it states female. Producing this certificate is compulsory. See the official notification (PDF) for the full eligibility conditions of this post.

Those who qualify will be called for a Trade Test of 50 marks (minimum qualifying 15, 45 minutes plus 20 minutes compensatory time), which is qualifying only. Ties are resolved by higher marks in Part A, then date of birth (older first), then alphabetical order. faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in Bastar Fighter Constable Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 79 vacancies: UR 16, OBC 11, SC 02 and ST 50.

faq.question: Q2. When do Bastar Fighter Constable applications start?
faq.answer: Applications can be submitted from 2 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date for the Bastar Fighter Constable application?
faq.answer: The last date is 12 December 2026, until 5:00 PM during office hours. Postal applications must reach the Superintendent of Police office, Jagdalpur, by then.

faq.question: Q4. Who can apply for Bastar Fighter Constable posts?
faq.answer: Only local residents of Bastar district can apply, subject to the age, qualification and physical standards in the notice.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for Bastar Fighter Constable?
faq.answer: Candidates must be not less than 18 years and not more than 28 years of age as on 01.01.2026. SC, ST and Backward Class candidates get up to 5 years of relaxation, and local women of Bastar district get up to 10 years.

faq.question: Q6. What is the qualification for Bastar Fighter Constable?
faq.answer: Candidates need a 10th pass from a school in Chhattisgarh/Madhya Pradesh. ST candidates, and candidates of all categories from Naxal-victim families or relief-camp families, are eligible with a 5th class pass.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary of a Bastar Fighter Constable?
faq.answer: The post carries Level-4 of the pay matrix approved by the Government, plus allowances payable from time to time.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for Bastar Fighter Constable?
faq.answer: Selection involves document verification, physical measurement, a 100-mark physical efficiency test, a 50-mark objective written exam and a 20-mark interview. Bonus marks of up to 30 are added, and the final merit list is based on the total.

faq.answer: A heavy motor vehicle driving licence earns 5 marks, an NCC "C" or NSS "C" certificate earns 5 marks, and knowledge of the district's local dialect earns 20 marks. The certificates must be held on the last date of application.

content_sections.heading: Bijapur Police Bastar Fighter Constable Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates must be not less than 18 years and not more than 28 years old on 1 January 2026. SC, ST and OBC candidates: upper age limit relaxed by a maximum of 5 years. Local women of Bijapur district: upper age limit relaxable up to 10 years, under the Chhattisgarh Civil Services (Special Provisions for Appointment of Women) Rules, 1997. Current or former Chhattisgarh Government employees not declared unfit for government service may get relaxation on the conditions below. Permanent government servants must not be more than 36 years old. Candidates holding a temporary post and applying for another post must not be more than 36 years old. This concession also covers employees paid from the contingency fund, work-charged employees and those working under project implementation committees. Retrenched government servants may deduct their full earlier temporary service from their age, up to a maximum of 7 years, even if it was served on more than one occasion. The resulting age must not exceed the upper age limit by more than 3 years. All age concessions are subject to the Chhattisgarh Government's guidelines. 10th class pass from a school located in Chhattisgarh or Madhya Pradesh. Scheduled Tribe candidates are eligible with a 5th class pass. Candidates of all categories from Naxal-affected families in the state, or from families living in relief camps in Naxal-affected areas, are eligible with a 5th class pass. The qualification must be held on the last date for submitting applications. Attaching the qualification certificate with the form is the applicant's own responsibility. Candidates of every category must show at least 5 cm chest expansion. Women candidates are exempt from this standard. The selection committee's decision on height and chest measurement is final. The candidate must not be physically disabled and must be medically fit. Knock-knee and flat-foot are not allowed. The candidate must not have any eye disease and must be able to distinguish the primary colours. The competent authority will examine such cases personally and may consult the District Chief Medical Officer if needed. Third gender candidates follow the male standards if their certificate states male and the female standards if it states female, and must produce that certificate. The official notification gives the full eligibility conditions for this post.

content_sections.heading: About Punjab and Haryana High Court
content_sections.text: The High Court of Punjab and Haryana sits at Chandigarh, and these posts are on its own establishment. Terms not covered in the notice are regulated by the High Court Establishment (Appointment and Conditions of Service) Rules, 1973, as amended from time to time.

content_sections.heading: Punjab and Haryana High Court Chowkidar Vacancy Details 2026

content_sections.heading: Punjab and Haryana High Court Chowkidar Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: Applicants of all categories should be not less than 18 years and not more than 35 years as on 21 November 2026. For Ex-Servicemen, the upper age limit is relaxed by the number of years of their defence service plus 03 years. Only two documents are accepted as proof of date of birth: the Matriculation Certificate from a recognized Education Board, for candidates who are matriculate or above, or the Birth Certificate from the Registrar of Births and Deaths, for those qualified below Matric. Minimum Middle Standard and maximum 10+2 from a recognized School Education Board or recognized School. All eligibility conditions must be met on the last date of online submission. Candidates must also give an affidavit that they are not qualified above 10+2. Concealing a higher qualification can lead to criminal action and termination from service. SC/ST/BC reservation and fee relaxation are only for candidates holding a certificate from Punjab, Haryana or U.T. Chandigarh who are also domiciled or permanent residents there. SC/ST/BC applicants from other areas or states must apply under General Category. BC candidates must not fall in the creamy layer, and their certificate must be the latest one. Reservation, fee and age relaxation under the Ex-Servicemen category are for Ex-Servicemen themselves, not their dependents. No man who has more than one wife living, and no woman married to a man already having a wife living, is eligible for appointment. See the official notification for the full eligibility conditions for the post of Chowkidar.

content_sections.heading: Application Fee
content_sections.text: The fee is paid online and is non-refundable, and online transaction charges are extra. Dependents claiming the exemption must upload proof with the application and produce the original at testimonials checking or when called by the High Court.

rows.category: Dependents of Ex-Servicemen disabled or deceased during the active operation

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Candidates are selected on their performance in the interview. Depending on the number of applications, any suitable shortlisting criterion can be followed, and candidates will be told about it at the appropriate time. Meeting the eligibility criteria does not by itself entitle an applicant to an interview call. The date, time and venue of the interview will be published on the High Court website. Original documents will be checked at testimonials checking. The E-Admit Card link for provisionally eligible candidates will be uploaded on the website, and candidates will also receive an email or SMS. Admit cards are not sent by post. Paste a photograph on the E-Admit Card, attested by a Gazetted Officer or self-attested. It must match the one uploaded with the application, or entry to the venue will be refused. Mobile phones, other electronic devices, watches, ornaments and other baggage are not allowed in the interview center. No TA/DA is paid for any stage of the recruitment process.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: The posts are on the establishment of the High Court at Chandigarh. Duty hours may extend beyond normal working hours and even at odd hours.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Punjab and Haryana High Court Chowkidar Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Open the application link, which is available only on www.highcourtchd.gov.in . Read the detailed employment notice before filling in the form. Use a valid personal email address and mobile number, because recruitment updates are sent there. Do not change them after registration. Fill in all details, including the category. No change is allowed after submission. Upload a recent passport size photograph (not more than 30 days old, white background) and your signatures. An application without a proper photograph and signature will be rejected. Upload scanned copies of any FIR or conviction/acquittal orders, and the document claiming fee relaxation as a dependent of Ex-Servicemen, if these apply to you. Re-check your details and pay the fee through a facility such as internet banking or a debit/credit card. Keep printed copies of the form, and keep five copies of the uploaded photograph for later stages. A candidate may submit only one application for a particular category. If more than one is submitted, only the latest will be considered. Keep the application printout with proof of qualification, date of birth, caste certificate and any NOC. The annexures are in the notice, and Annexures III, IV and V must be attested by a Notary Public. Regular government employees must obtain the NOC when applying and keep it with them. Failure to produce the original when required cancels the candidature. Contract or ad hoc workers in government offices apply as non-departmental candidates. content_sections.heading: About JSV
content_sections.text: Himachal Pradesh Jal Shakti Vibhag is the state department named on this notice, with its Engineer-in-Chief at Jal Shakti Bhawan, Tutikandi, Shimla. These posts are for the operation and maintenance of water supply and irrigation schemes in Kinnaur district. The notice was issued by the Executive Engineer, Jal Shakti Division, Pooh, and the posts were allocated through the Engineer-in-Chief's letters dated 24 March, 6 April and 20 April 2026.

content_sections.heading: JSV Multi Purpose Worker Vacancy Details 2026
content_sections.text: The pay is a monthly honorarium. The notice states that the number of posts shall be increased or decreased at any time.

content_sections.heading: JSV Multi Purpose Worker Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: Age limit: minimum 18 years and maximum 45 years as on 13 November 2026, for all three posts. Essential qualification: minimum Matriculation (10th) with an ITI certificate from a recognized ITI in the trade of Electrician/ wireman/ Diesel Mechanic/ Pump Mechanic/ Motor Mechanic/ Pump Operator-cum Mechanic/ Mechanic (Motor Vehicle / Pump Operation & maintenance/pump operator. Alternatively, a matriculation (10th) certificate in these trades under a Skill Development Scheme of the Government. Essential qualification: minimum matriculation (10th) with an ITI certificate in the trade of Fitter/ Plumber from a recognized ITI/ institute. Alternatively, a matriculation (10th) certificate in these trades under a Skill Development Scheme of the Government. Essential qualification: minimum Middle pass (8th) or its equivalent from a school duly recognized by the State Government. All candidates must submit their 8th standard marks sheet. Experience is not listed as an essential qualification, but it earns marks. It must be in the related field of JSV, HPPWD, CPWD, PSUs or an outsourcing agency providing services in HP Jal Shakti Vibhag, with a certificate issued by the EE (JSV). For a Para Pump Operator, the related field is operating pumping machinery and allied electrical installations of rural water supply or irrigation schemes. For a Para Fitter, it is maintaining village piped water supply infrastructure or the distribution system of these schemes. Candidates should be capable of carrying tools and pipes in hilly areas and should not have any physical disabilities or colour blindness. Check the official notification for the full trade-wise eligibility of each post.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: An initial merit list will be drawn from the documents submitted, based on qualification and experience. The top eligible candidates, at least 5 times the vacancies, will then be called for the skill/physical test by separate call letters. Original certificates and testimonials will be seen at the time of evaluation. Minor repair of pumps, locating faults or damage, and replacing defective parts Knowledge of test pressures and leakages, making adjustments and observing performance for appropriate yield of water Installing pumps at site, connecting them to the motor, basic alignment, and tools such as spanners and keys Locating faults in the electric system and motor Dismantling or partly dismantling equipment, replacing damaged or worn parts, and greasing and oiling moving parts Knowledge of the pump lubrication and cooling system Operating the regulating valves and control mechanism of the pumping system Repairing water supply pipelines, arresting leakage, adding new connections and abandoning defunct ones Basic knowledge of pipe fitting, pipe sizes, operation and maintenance Threading pipes with ratchet and die sets, and fitting specials on pipes using basic tools Managing village water supply infrastructure, pipe distribution layout and flow regulation for equitable distribution in hilly terrain Knowledge of pipe fitting tools and the skill to operate them Behavioural skills in handling grievances, complaints and conflict resolution

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: Posting is under the jurisdiction of Jal Shakti Division, Pooh, in the Yangthang, Pooh and Akpa sub divisions. Selected candidates will be deputed or engaged on schemes already outsourced to firms or contractors. Para Fitters and Para Pump Operators will submit a quarterly self-reporting format to the Junior Engineer concerned. At the end of every financial year, a consolidated report goes for community certification of satisfactory work and conduct. Unsatisfactory performance may result in termination by an order. Termination cannot be completed unless at least 3 notices have been served on a specific charge and service delivery has not improved. The Junior Engineer records the reasons in writing, and the Assistant Engineer countersigns them.

content_sections.heading: Odisha Police Constable Exam Pattern 2026
content_sections.text: The Common Written Examination is prescribed for all posts and consists of 100 multiple-choice questions for 100 marks , with a duration of 120 minutes. The examination carries negative marking of 0.25 marks for each incorrect answer . No marks will be awarded or deducted for unattended questions. Candidates applying for Constable (Communication) must appear in an additional examination based on +2 Science standards. A separate objective examination is prescribed for Firefighting Driver and Driver PMT posts.

faq.question: Q1. What is the conducting organization for OUSSSC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the Odisha Uniformed Services Staff Selection Commission (OUSSSC) to fill various uniformed services vacancies across the state of Odisha under advertisement number 01-CRE-2026/OUSSSC.

faq.question: Q2. How many total vacancies are announced in this notification?
faq.answer: A total of 7268 vacancies have been announced for various posts including Constable (Civil), Constable (Communication), Constable OISF, Firefighter, Firefighting Driver, Driver PMT, and Traffic Constable.

faq.question: Q3. What is the start date to apply online for OUSSSC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The online registration and submission of applications officially commenced on 23 October 2026. Eligible candidates can submit their forms through the official OUSSSC web portal before the closing date.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to submit the online application form?
faq.answer: The last date for the submission of online applications as well as making the online fee payment is 12 November 2026. Applicants should apply well in advance to avoid last-minute server issues.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee for general and backward class applicants?
faq.answer: The application fee is Rs. 500/- for all applicants other than SC and ST categories, which can be paid securely through the online payment gateway using net banking, credit cards, debit cards, or UPI.

faq.question: Q6. Are SC and ST candidates required to pay the application fee?
faq.answer: No, candidates belonging to the Scheduled Caste (SC) and Scheduled Tribe (ST) categories are completely exempted from paying the application fee as per the official notification guidelines.

faq.question: Q7. What are the minimum educational qualifications required for these posts?
faq.answer: The required qualifications range from passing the High School Certificate Examination (10th class) to Higher Secondary (+2) or a 3-year Diploma in engineering, depending on the specific post applied for.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for OUSSSC Various Posts 2026?
faq.answer: The selection process comprises a Common Written Examination, Special Written Examination, Physical Standards Measurement and Physical Efficiency Test, Driving Test, Medical Examination, and Document Verification.

faq.question: Q9. Where can candidates apply for this recruitment drive?
faq.answer: Candidates can apply online by visiting the official OUSSSC recruitment portal at https://ousssc.odisha.gov.in and completing the basic registration, detailed application form, and document uploading steps.

faq.question: Q10. What is the salary structure for the selected candidates?
faq.answer: The selected candidates for various posts will be placed in the pay matrix Level-4 and Level-5 as per the Odisha Revised Scales of Pay (ORSP) Rules, 2017, along with applicable allowances.

content_sections.heading: Kerala PSC Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Eligibility differs across the 12 notified categories. Candidates must satisfy the relevant educational qualification, age limit, service experience, community reservation and physical requirements before applying. Candidates must satisfy the complete educational, professional registration, experience and category conditions of their respective notification. Equivalent qualifications will be accepted only as permitted under the relevant Kerala PSC and Government rules. Both Laboratory Assistant categories require a B.Sc. degree in Chemistry, Biochemistry, Biotechnology or Microbiology . However, Category 163/2026 is restricted to eligible regular employees of MILMA-affiliated member societies with at least three years of qualifying regular service. Separate ranked lists will be prepared for the General and Society categories. The notification specifies a 1:1 apportionment principle when advising candidates against reported vacancies. The Medical Education Department notifications cover postgraduate and super-specialty faculty posts. Applicants must hold the relevant qualifications and meet the prescribed experience, research-course and medical registration requirements. Cardiology: DM/DNB/DrNB in Cardiology, completed Basic Course in Biomedical Research and permanent registration under the prescribed Medical Council. Pathology: MD/DNB in Pathology with one year of prescribed Senior Resident experience or another specifically accepted experience route, and permanent medical registration. Cardiovascular and Thoracic Surgery: M.Ch./DNB/DrNB in the concerned specialty, completed Basic Course in Biomedical Research and permanent medical registration. The Pathology notification provides additional accepted experience pathways for certain tutors, demonstrators, Armed Forces specialists and other qualified medical professionals. Applicants must refer to Category 167/2026 for the exact conditions. Category 172/2026 is for a Police Constable (Trainee) in the Armed Police Battalion, Ernakulam (KAP I) , restricted to eligible LC/AI community candidates. Important: Women candidates and differently abled candidates are not eligible for this particular Police Constable NCA notification, as expressly stated in Category 172/2026. Applicants must also meet the complete medical and physical fitness standards.

how_to_apply: Applications are accepted only online, between 31 October 2026 and 30 November 2026 (23.59 Hrs). Applications sent directly to RRC will not be entertained.
Visit the RRC-SER website, www.rrcser.co.in, and click the "Online/E-Application for Sports Quota(OA) / 2026-27" link, then "New Registration".

Fill in your personal details: Name, Father's name, Date of Birth, Community, E-mail address and Mobile number. These must match your Matriculation or equivalent certificate. Note the registration number and password sent to you by E-mail/SMS.
Log in with the registration number and password, and complete the registration step by step.
Enter your bank account details for the fee refund, or confirm that the refund should go to the account used for payment.
Enter the details of a valid photo identity card and upload it.

Upload the scanned photograph, signature and LTI, and the self-attested certificates for date of birth, educational/technical qualification, caste (SC/ST/OBC/EBC/EWS), income, OBC and minority self-declarations, and sports achievements.
Pay the fee by credit card, debit card or internet banking.
Submit the application. Note the Unique Registration Number generated at submission, which is needed at later stages.
Take two (02) printouts of the completed application form. No change is allowed after final submission, and the hard copy must be the same as the one submitted online.

Use your own mobile number and a valid, active e-mail ID, and keep them active until recruitment ends. RRC sends all communication only by SMS and E-mail and will not accept requests to change them. For help with the online application, use the Help Line Number and E-mail ID shown on the RRC/SER website.
Photograph: colour, passport size, white/light background, 3.5 cm X 3.5 cm, not older than three months from the date of application. JPG/JPEG, scanned at 100 DPI, up to 70 KB.

The photo must show a clear front view, without cap or sunglasses. If you wear glasses, there must be no glare and the eyes must be clearly visible. It must match your appearance at the trial, document verification and medical test.
The same photo must be used at every stage. The notice advises keeping at least 06 (Six) copies.
Signature and LTI: in black ink on white paper, within a box of 50 mm x 20 mm or 140X60 pixels. JPG/JPEG at 100 dpi, file size 10-40 KB. Both must be the applicant's own.

The signature must be in Hindi or English, not in capital or disjointed letters, and the same at every stage. A different signing style at the trial, document verification or medical examination may lead to cancellation.
A self-attested copy of a valid photo identity card issued by a government body (Aadhar card/PAN card/Driving License/Voter ID Card). Carry this card with the e-call letter at every stage.
A self-attested certificate in proof of educational qualification issued by the Board/Council/University (para 3.5).
Sports achievement certificates only for Championships concluded on or after 01.04.2024, from recognised Sports Association of Indian University.
A self-attested certificate in proof of age (Matriculation/10th certificate).
Self-attested certificates in proof of all recognised sports achievements as per paras 3.2, 3.3 and 3.4.
SC/ST: a self-attested community certificate from the Competent Authority (Annexure-I).
OBC-NCL: a self-attested community certificate (Annexure-II) and a self-declaration that the candidate is not in the Creamy Layer (Annexure-IIA).
EBC: a self-attested Income Certificate from the Competent Authority in the Annexure-III format.
EWS: a self-attested EWS certificate from the Competent Authority (Annexure-IV).
Minority: a declaration for the waiver of examination fees (Annexure-V).
Ex-Servicemen: the discharge certificate and pension documents (copy of PPO).
Certificates in languages other than English or Hindi must come with an attested English/Hindi translation.
Serving employees: a No-Objection Certificate from the employer.

Bring the original documents for date of birth, educational qualification, sports achievements and identification. Without them, you will not be allowed to appear in the selection. Also bring the e-call letter, the original photo identity card used in the online application, and 02 self-attested copies of every document uploaded with the application. You must bring your own kit. No TA/DA or accommodation is given for the trial. You may need to stay 2-3 days and must make your own arrangements. SC/ST candidates are eligible for free second-class rail travel to attend the sports trials.
The notice says applications with any of these defects will be summarily rejected (the list is illustrative, not exhaustive):
Applications sent manually and not registered online.
More than one application registered by the same candidate.
Applications received after the closing date.
No fee paid, or less than the prescribed fee paid.
Incomplete, faulty or ineligible applications.
An undated or unsigned application, or a signature in block, capital or disjointed letters.
No proper scanned photograph, signature and LTI or other enclosures. This includes a black-and-white, capped, sunglassed, disfigured, small, full-body, side-view or unrecognisable photo.
No photo identity card or proper certificates of date of birth, education, sports achievement and caste uploaded. Certificates not from the appropriate authority are liable to rejection.
The candidate lacks the prescribed qualification and minimum sports achievements when applying.
Over age, or date of birth not filled in or wrongly filled in.
A compulsory enclosure is missing, or a column is left blank.

content_sections.heading: RRC SER Vacancy 2026
content_sections.text: South Eastern Railway has 54 posts under the Sports Quota for 2026-27: 05 (Five) Group 'C' Level-4/Level-5, 16 (Sixteen) Group 'C' Level-2/Level-3 and 33 (Thirty three) Group 'D' Level-1.
