No post is reserved for SC/ST/OBC/EWS communities. Candidates with the required performance or achievement in the sports discipline will be selected on overall merit, whatever their community. Candidates may still upload the community they belong to, as required by chapter 13 of the brochure published by the Govt. of India, Ministry of Personnel, Public Grievance of Pensions, Deptt. of Personnel Training, New Delhi. For SC/ST/OBC, the caste certificate must be issued by a Competent Authority not below the rank of Tehsildar. OBC candidates must also upload an OBC Non-Creamy Layer certificate in the Central Govt. format, issued not before than 01 year by the competent authority.

content_sections.heading: RRC SER Eligibility Criteria 2026
content_sections.text: Applications are open only to Indian nationals. Candidates must have both the academic qualification and the minimum sports norms for the level they apply for. Candidates who are appearing in, or waiting for the results of, final examinations are not eligible. The educational qualification must be from a recognised institution. Level-2/Level-3 qualification, as printed: Passed class 12th (10+2 stage) or its equivalent examination. The qualification must be from a Govt. recognized Board / Council / Institutions etc. OR Passed Matriculation from a recognized Board plus Course Completed Act Apprenticeship OR Passed class 10th from a Govt. recognized Board / Council / Institutions etc. plus ITI passed OR its equivalent examination OR National Apprenticeship Certificate (NAC) granted by NCVT. The minimum educational qualification should be as applicable to the post offered. Notes on qualification: For a Group-C appointment against the Sports Quota in Technician-III, the minimum educational qualification is 10th pass. The training period for these appointees will follow RBE no. 92/2024, based on the selected candidate's educational qualification. No relaxation in the minimum educational qualification is allowed. Candidates must submit photocopies of the documents for their educational qualification with the application form. They must also produce the original certificate on the day of the trials. (a) Represented the country in Olympic Games (Senior Category) OR (b) At least 3rd Position in any of the Championships/events in the World Cup (Junior/Youth/Senior Category) / World Championships (Junior/ Senior Category)/ Asian Games (Senior Category)/ Commonwealth Games (Senior Category), Youth Olympics, Davis Cup (Tennis), Champions Trophy (Hockey), Thomas/Uber Cup (Badminton). content_sections.heading: RRC SER Application Fee 2026
content_sections.text: The fee must be paid online through Internet Banking or a Debit or Credit Card. Candidates bear the service charges for the payment. Fees paid in Cash, by Cheque, Money Order, Central Recruitment Fee Stamps or Demand Draft are not accepted, and such applications will be rejected. Rs. 400 for UR/OBC and Rs. 250 for SC/ST/Ex-Servicemen/Persons with Disabilities (PWDs), Women, Minorities and Economically Backward Classes will be refunded to eligible candidates who actually appear in the trial. Bank charges are deducted from the refund. In the application, candidates choose whether the refund goes to the account used for payment. If not, they give a beneficiary account: beneficiary name, account number, name of the bank and IFSC code. Candidates seeking a fee exemption as Economically Backward Classes must have Annexure-III filled in and certified by the proper authority. Economically Backward Classes are candidates whose family income is less than Rs 50,000 per annum. Minority candidates must make a self-declaration in the Annexure-V format to claim the fee waiver. They must also furnish a Minority Community declaration affidavit on non-judicial stamp paper of Rs.10/-, sworn before an Executive Magistrate. The notice lists the minorities as Muslim/Sikh/Christian/Buddhist/Parsis.

content_sections.text: Sports Trials, where performance is assessed by the Trial Committee. Selected candidates must also meet the required medical fitness standards before appointment. Selection is purely on merit, against the vacancies notified in each discipline. content_sections.heading: How to Apply Online for RRC SER Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Applications are accepted only online, between 31 October 2026 and 30 November 2026 (23.59 Hrs). Applications sent directly to RRC will not be entertained. Visit the RRC-SER website, www.rrcser.co.in, and click the "Online/E-Application for Sports Quota(OA) / 2026-27" link, then "New Registration". Fill in your personal details: Name, Father's name, Date of Birth, Community, E-mail address and Mobile number. These must match your Matriculation or equivalent certificate. Note the registration number and password sent to you by E-mail/SMS. Log in with the registration number and password, and complete the registration step by step. Enter your bank account details for the fee refund, or confirm that the refund should go to the account used for payment. Enter the details of a valid photo identity card and upload it. Upload the scanned photograph, signature and LTI, and the self-attested certificates for date of birth, educational/technical qualification, caste (SC/ST/OBC/EBC/EWS), income, OBC and minority self-declarations, and sports achievements. Pay the fee by credit card, debit card or internet banking. Submit the application. Note the Unique Registration Number generated at submission, which is needed at later stages. Take two (02) printouts of the completed application form. No change is allowed after final submission, and the hard copy must be the same as the one submitted online. Use your own mobile number and a valid, active e-mail ID, and keep them active until recruitment ends. RRC sends all communication only by SMS and E-mail and will not accept requests to change them. For help with the online application, use the Help Line Number and E-mail ID shown on the RRC/SER website. Photograph: colour, passport size, white/light background, 3.5 cm X 3.5 cm, not older than three months from the date of application. JPG/JPEG, scanned at 100 DPI, up to 70 KB. The photo must show a clear front view, without cap or sunglasses. If you wear glasses, there must be no glare and the eyes must be clearly visible. It must match your appearance at the trial, document verification and medical test. The same photo must be used at every stage. The notice advises keeping at least 06 (Six) copies. Signature and LTI: in black ink on white paper, within a box of 50 mm x 20 mm or 140X60 pixels. JPG/JPEG at 100 dpi, file size 10-40 KB. Both must be the applicant's own. The signature must be in Hindi or English, not in capital or disjointed letters, and the same at every stage. A different signing style at the trial, document verification or medical examination may lead to cancellation. A self-attested copy of a valid photo identity card issued by a government body (Aadhar card/PAN card/Driving License/Voter ID Card). Carry this card with the e-call letter at every stage. A self-attested certificate in proof of educational qualification issued by the Board/Council/University (para 3.5). Sports achievement certificates only for Championships concluded on or after 01.04

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure

Performance will be reviewed every 30 days, and the contract may be terminated on one day's notice if found unsatisfactory.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: A merit list will be prepared based on percentage marks obtained in the Essential Qualification (overall for the course), desirable qualifications, merit, and experience. Based on merit and years of experience, candidates will be shortlisted in a 1:5 ratio per post to appear for an in-person interview. The selection committee reserves the right to conduct a written test, computer exercises, or clinical examination before the interview, and a typing speed test will be conducted for the Data Entry Operator post. Interviews will be conducted in person only; no TA/DA will be provided for attending the interview.

faq.answer: The advertisement invites applications from Indian nationals having permanent residence in Tripura. PRTC is also among the documents to be submitted at verification.

faq.question: Which posts can a Madhyamik pass candidate apply for?
faq.answer: Field Assistant and Junior Store Keeper both require Madhyamik or equivalent. Junior Store Keeper applicants also need computer knowledge and a typing speed of 30 words per minute in English.

faq.question: Is knowledge of Bengali or Kokborok compulsory?
faq.answer: It is listed as desirable for Field Assistant and Junior Store Keeper. However, the Administrative Department may treat it as qualifying in nature in the written test.

faq.question: Is there negative marking in the Extension Officer examination?
faq.answer: Yes. One-fourth of the marks assigned to a question will be deducted for each wrong answer in the 85-question paper.

faq.question: Do I need to upload my certificates while applying?
faq.answer: No. Only the photograph and signature are uploaded online. Certificates are submitted after the written examination result.

faq.question: What must in-service candidates submit?
faq.answer: If the application was not routed through proper channel, they must submit a "No-objection" certificate on the day of interview. It must clearly state that the employer has no objection to their being considered for the post. Without it, the candidature will not be considered for the final merit list.

faq.question: Can I get a refund of the application fee?
faq.answer: No. The Rs.300/- deposited with each application is non-refundable.

faq.question: Where will updates on the examination be published?
faq.answer: The notice directs candidates to check recruitment.industriestripura.in regularly for updates, detailed information and notices issued from time to time.

content_sections.heading: NIT Raipur Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Candidates applying for NIT Raipur Non-Faculty Recruitment 2026 must possess the required educational qualifications for their respective posts. The eligibility requirements vary depending on the position. Superintendent: First Class Bachelor's Degree or equivalent from a recognized University or Institute in any discipline OR Master's Degree in any discipline from a recognized University or Institute with at least 50% marks or equivalent grade. Knowledge of computer applications, including word processing and spreadsheets, is required. Technical Assistant: First Class Bachelor's Degree, Master's Degree, or Diploma in the relevant discipline as per the specific department requirements mentioned in the notification. Senior Assistant: Senior Secondary (10+2) from a recognized board with a minimum typing speed of 35 words per minute and proficiency in computer word processing and spreadsheets. Senior Technician: Senior Secondary (10+2) with Science, including Chemistry as one of the subjects, from a government-recognized board with at least 60% marks. Technician: Senior Secondary (10+2) with Science, ITI, or Diploma in Engineering from a government-recognized Polytechnic, Institute, or Board, depending on the specific department requirements. Office Attendant: Senior Secondary (10+2) from a recognized board. Important: As clarified in the official extension notice, candidates must satisfy the prescribed qualifications, experience, and other eligibility criteria as on 30 October 2026 . The extension of the application deadline does not change this cut-off date.

content_sections.text: Candidates applying for NIT Raipur Non-Faculty vacancies are required to pay the application fee according to their category.

content_sections.heading: NIT Raipur Recruitment 2026 Age Limit
content_sections.text: The maximum age limit for NIT Raipur Non-Faculty Recruitment 2026 varies from 27 to 33 years depending on the post. The age limit will be calculated as on 30 October 2026 , which remains the official eligibility cut-off date. Age Relaxation: The following relaxations apply as per the recruitment notification and applicable rules. SC/ST: 5 Years OBC: 3 Years PwBD: 10 Years Departmental Candidates: 5 Years Note: The age eligibility cut-off date remains 30 October 2026 , even though the online application deadline has been extended to 15 November 2026. Candidates should calculate their age based on the unchanged cut-off date. Candidates can use our Age Calculator to calculate their exact age as on 30 October 2026 before applying.

content_sections.heading: NIT Raipur Recruitment 2026 Salary
content_sections.text: Selected candidates will receive salaries according to the pay levels prescribed for their respective posts. The post-wise pay levels range from Level 1 to Level 6.

content_sections.text: NIT Raipur has extended the online application deadline for its Non-Faculty Recruitment 2026. Candidates can submit their applications until 15 November 2026, 11:59 PM. However, the eligibility cut-off date remains unchanged. Check whether you meet the required qualifications, age limit, experience, and other eligibility conditions as on 30 October 2026. Pay the applicable application fee through the available online payment method. Review all information carefully before final submission. Submit the online application on or before 15 November 2026, 11:59 PM . Download or print the submitted application form for future reference. qualification.details: According to the notice, the following candidates will be considered for the post: | Eminent artists/private persons who meet the essential qualifications and also have the desirable qualifications that apply to an Assistant Professor (Bharatanatyam) level appointee in a Central/State Government/autonomous institution. Assistant Professor (Bharatanatyam) in Central/State Government/autonomous institutions holding analogous posts, or with 8 years' regular service in Pay Level 16 (Rs.36400 - 115700) of the Tamil Nadu Government State Pay Scales, or an equivalent level. | (a) Class X passed (b) Diploma holder or Post Diploma holder from a recognised institution in the particular field (c) Should be able to handle final year diploma and post diploma classes, including the theory (d) Should be able to take part in Kalakshetra productions (e) Able to give a solo performance for about 2 hours (f) Should be able to sing and conduct dance programmes by doing nattuvangam | Graduate of a recognised university or equivalent Knowledge of any of the South Indian languages and Hindi, and ability to write music and dance notations | For appointment on deputation/short term contract, the maximum age limit is not exceeding 50 years on the closing date for receipt of applications, i.e. 23 November 2026. | For the discipline-specific eligibility of the post, see the official notification.

salary_details.pay_scale: Pay Level 22 (Rs.56100-177500) in 7th Pay Commission pay matrix of TN State Pay Scale

selection_process: Selection starts with a scrutiny of applications. Candidates who fulfil the Essential Qualifications in all respects
as per the parameters of the notice
will be shortlisted. Shortlisted candidates may be called for a skill test
if necessary.
how_to_apply: Applications are made offline, using the prescribed proforma in Annexure I of the notice. The steps below come from the notice and its application form:
Fill in the Annexure I application form and mark your applicant type: On Deputation or On Short Term Contract.
Fill in every column, including employment details in chronological order. If the space is not enough, add a separate sheet signed by you.
Affix a recent passport size photograph, then sign the form and add the place and date.
Attach the documents listed in the notice's checklist (see the next section).

Serving officials must make sure that the cadre clearance, the vigilance clearance and copies of their APARs for the last five years are sent through proper channel, together with the employer's certificate in Annexure II.
Put the application in a cover superscribed "Application for the Post of Professor (Bharatanatyam), Rukmini Devi College of Fine Arts".
Send it to Director, Kalakshetra Foundation, Thiruvanmiyur, Chennai 600041 so that it reaches by 5.30 p.m. on 23 November 2026.
important_instructions: Incomplete applications, and applications received after the last date, will be summarily rejected. In the Annexure II certificate, the employer of a serving employee certifies that the applicant's particulars are correct, that no vigilance or disciplinary case is pending or contemplated against the applicant, that the applicant's integrity is certified, that no major/minor penalty has been imposed in the last 10 years, and that the cadre controlling authority has cleared the application. The application form asks applicants to state, Yes or No, whether they meet the requirement of the post based on the details they have entered.

Assistant Professor (Bharatanatyam) in Central/State Government/autonomous institutions holding analogous posts, or with 8 years' regular service in Pay Level 16 (Rs.36400 - 115700) of the Tamil Nadu Government State Pay Scales, or an equivalent level. (a) Class X passed (b) Diploma holder or Post Diploma holder from a recognised institution in the particular field (c) Should be able to handle final year diploma and post diploma classes, including the theory (d) Should be able to take part in Kalakshetra productions (e) Able to give a solo performance for about 2 hours (f) Should be able to sing and conduct dance programmes by doing nattuvangam Graduate of a recognised university or equivalent Knowledge of any of the South Indian languages and Hindi, and ability to write music and dance notations For appointment on deputation/short term contract, the maximum age limit is not exceeding 50 years on the closing date for receipt of applications, i.e. 23 November 2026. content_sections.heading: Kalakshetra Professor (Bharatanatyam) (Group A) Job Description
content_sections.text: The notice lists these responsibilities for the Professor (Bharatanatyam) in RDCFA: To handle Diploma and Post-Diploma practical classes, including theory To complete the entire curriculum within the specified time To assess the learning quality of each student and accordingly supplement additional instructions, if any, as required To hold regular meetings with parents and guardians and apprise them about the regularity in attendance, ability to learn, progress made in learning and any other relevant information about the child To take part in Kalakshetra productions To conduct rehearsals for all the dance dramas To assist in organising art festivals and other functions throughout the year To accompany artists in the performances conducted at Kalakshetra and abroad To choreograph dance dramas To provide guidance for the Costume Department in designing costumes for dance dramas To coordinate with the Dance section in organising art festivals and other celebrations at Kalakshetra To conduct rehearsals for all dance-dramas in co-ordination with the dance section To perform such other duties as may be prescribed by the principal or by the administration of the Kalakshetra Foundation

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection starts with a scrutiny of applications. Candidates who fulfil the Essential Qualifications in all respects, as per the parameters of the notice, will be shortlisted. Shortlisted candidates may be called for a skill test, if necessary.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Kalakshetra Professor (Bharatanatyam) (Group A)
content_sections.text: Applications are made offline, using the prescribed proforma in Annexure I of the notice. The steps below come from the notice and its application form: Fill in the Annexure I application form and mark your applicant type: On Deputation or On Short Term Contract. Fill in every column, including employment details in chronological order. If the space is not enough, add a separate sheet signed by you. Affix a recent passport size photograph, then sign the form and add the place and date. Attach the documents listed in the notice's checklist (see the next section). Serving officials must make sure that the cadre clearance, the vigilance clearance and copies of their APARs for the last five years are sent through proper channel, together with the employer's certificate in Annexure II. Put the application in a cover superscribed "Application for the Post of Professor (Bharatanatyam), Rukmini Devi College of Fine Arts". Send it to Director, Kalakshetra Foundation, Thiruvanmiyur, Chennai 600041 so that it reaches by 5.30 p.m. on 23 November 2026.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: The notice's checklist names these documents: Application form with a recent passport size photo, with all columns filled in and signed by the applicant One extra passport size photo in a cover Copy of Aadhar Proof of all educational qualifications mentioned in the application Proof of age Testimonials for teaching/working experience Caste Certificate, if age relaxation is claimed Certificate of disability, if age relaxation is claimed for Physically challenged Other relevant certificates/testimonials for the essential qualification and desirable qualification Relevant document for provision of a scribe, if required Cadre clearance Vigilance clearance Copies of APARs for the last five years, duly attested Certificate from the Employer / Head of Office / Forwarding Authority in Annexure II

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Incomplete applications, and applications received after the last date, will be summarily rejected. In the Annexure II certificate, the employer of a serving employee certifies that the applicant's particulars are correct, that no vigilance or disciplinary case is pending or contemplated against the applicant, that the applicant's integrity is certified, that no major/minor penalty has been imposed in the last 10 years, and that the cadre controlling authority has cleared the application. content_sections.heading: How Will Kalakshetra Foundation Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Written test (Multiple choice questions) Skill test (Carnatic Music – Vocal/Mridangam/Flute) Written test consists of 200 multiple choice questions for 200 marks with 3 hours duration. Final merit list will comprise 40% of marks scored in written test and 60% of marks scored in skill test.

Super scribe the cover containing the application as 'Application for the post of 'Tutor (Music) in Rukmini Devi college of Fine Arts'. Arranging, coordinating staff meeting of the College and preparation of minutes. Ensuring necessary arrangements for workshops, lecture demonstrations and mentorship programmes. All examination related works such as issue of circulars, examination schedule, question paper setting, answer script collection, mark-list preparation, student performance and report card maintenance. Issuing no dues certificates to students before examination, hall ticket issue, arrangement of external examiners, processing for payment, monitoring Theatre Examination activity, etc. Convocation preparation, printed mark list preparation, issuing of Diploma/Post Diploma certificate. content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: Laboratory Technician: Rs 28000 + HRA, with increments as admissible as per DST Norms. HRA, if admissible under the funding agency's guidelines, will be paid at the rate for Rajkot city (Class 'Y'). Multi-tasking Staff: Rs. 18000, consolidated without any allowances. The appointee is not a regular employee of AIIMS Rajkot or the Government of India. He or she is not entitled to any other financial or non-financial benefits or facilities, or to any special allowances, beyond the fixed consolidated emoluments prescribed by the funding agency. The posts are purely on contract for an externally funded research project. The person engaged will have no claim at any time to a regular post at AIIMS Rajkot, or to continued service in the same or any other project. The assignment is purely temporary for 11 months. It can be extended depending on the candidate's performance, continuation of the scheme and the budget grant from the funding agency. The Principal Investigator may also extend or curtail it at his discretion. The contract ends automatically when the stipulated time is over. It ends earlier if the funding agency withdraws support. Either side can end it at any time with 30 days' notice or salary in lieu of notice. Leave follows the Leave Policy of AIIMS Rajkot for project staff, as amended from time to time. The institute will not provide a hostel or any other accommodation.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for AIIMS Rajkot Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Fill in the prescribed application form on the last two pages of the notice and sign it. Paste a passport-size colour photograph on it; do not staple the photograph. The form is addressed to The Principal Investigator, Viral Research and Diagnostic Laboratory, AIIMS, Rajkot, All India Institute of Medical Sciences, Village Para Pipaliya, Khanderi, Rajkot, Gujarat 360110. Attach one set of self-attested photocopies of the documents listed below. Submit a soft copy of the application, with scanned copies of the attachments, through the Google Form at https://forms.gle/jN2WTanD4sd6GtrT8 by 30 November 2026 till 5 PM. If you apply for both posts, submit a separate application for each post. On 10 December 2026, bring the application and the documents to the written test and interview. Keep the original documents with you for verification. For document verification, bring a physical copy of the form and all documents, with xerox copies and the originals. The institute will not be responsible if a candidate fails to submit the online application through the Google Form within the prescribed date and time, for whatever reason. Applications that are incomplete, unsigned or not in the prescribed format, and those that do not meet the essential criteria, are likely to be summarily rejected. Date of Birth proof Photo ID Proof (PAN Card, Aadhaar, Voter ID, Driving License, etc.) with Date of Birth Educational qualification: 10th/ 12th/ Graduate/DMLT/MLT/PG degree/ diploma certificate etc. as applicable Mark sheets of respective educational qualifications PhD certificate (if applicable) Registration certificate (if applicable) Experience certificates (if applicable) The enclosures list on the application form also names research publications (if applicable), an NOC Certificate (from present employer) and any other relevant document.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: For both posts, selection has three stages: screening of the applications, an MCQ-based written test, and an interview. Selection is based purely on merit. Screening: A screening committee will check all the applications received. Written test: An MCQ-based written test. Candidates with the highest marks are called to the interview, up to six (6) candidates per available post. Interview: The final merit is worked out with a weightage of 80% for the written exam and 20% for the interview. Date and reporting: 10 December 2026, reporting time 9 AM, at Research Cell, Academic block, 3rd Floor, AIIMS Rajkot. What to bring: The documents listed above, in original. Persons working in a Government or Public Sector undertaking, or in any other research project at AIIMS Rajkot, should produce a "No Objection Certificate" at the interview. No request to change the date of the interview will be entertained, and no TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview. Meeting the essential qualification or experience does not guarantee selection. The selection committee's decision is final, and no representation will be entertained.

content_sections.heading: About JPPO Dumka फसल रक्षक
content_sections.text: The Office of the Junior Plant Protection Officer (JPPO), Dumka, is on Bhagalpur Road in Dumka, Jharkhand. It is a district office of the Agriculture Division of the Jharkhand Government's Department of Agriculture, Animal Husbandry and Cooperative. The notice says the Crop Protectors are hired under the Crop Protection Programme scheme (फसल सुरक्षा कार्यक्रम योजना) for the financial year 2026-27. The aim is to run crop protection and plant protection work well at the local level.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Send the application only by registered post to this address, exactly as printed: कार्यालय, कनीय पौधा संरक्षण पदाधिकारी, दुमका (भागलपुर रोड– दुमका, नियर टाटा शोरूम, दुमका, पिन कोड– 814101). In English, this is the Office of the Junior Plant Protection Officer, Dumka, Bhagalpur Road, Dumka, Near Tata Showroom, Dumka, PIN 814101. Get the application form (आवेदन-पत्र). It is printed with the notice and can also be seen on the Dumka district website, dumka.nic.in, and on the notice board of the JPPO Dumka office. Fill in every column clearly and completely. The form asks for your names in Hindi and English, parents' names, gender, date of birth and age as on 30 September 2026. It also asks for your category (UR/ST/EWS), whether you claim reservation, and the district and block on your local certificate. Fill in your Matric, Intermediate/10+2 and graduation marks and the details of your compulsory 5-day training and any extra training. Then answer whether you can ride a bicycle and climb trees, and add your Aadhaar number, mobile, email and addresses. Paste a recent passport-size photograph that you have signed yourself (self-attested), then sign the declaration with the place and date. Attach self-attested photocopies of the documents listed under Enclosures. Send it by registered post so that it reaches the office between 26 October 2026 and 14 November 2026. For more information, call 9304866088. The office email is [email protected] .

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: There is one Crop Protector post at each of 11 Plant Protection Centres: Dumka, Saraiyahat, Ramgarh, Jama, Jarmundi, Masalia, Shikaripara, Kathikund, Gopikandar, Raneshwar and Nonihat. The category-wise split follows the model reservation roster for Dumka district. You can apply only for the centre in your own block: Dumka centre: local residents of Dumka block Saraiyahat centre: local residents of Saraiyahat block Ramgarh centre: local residents of Ramgarh block Jama centre: local residents of Jama block Nonihat centre: local residents of Jarmundi block Jarmundi centre: local residents of Jarmundi block Masalia centre: local residents of Masalia block Shikaripara centre: local residents of Shikaripara block Kathikund centre: local residents of Kathikund block Gopikandar centre: local residents of Gopikandar block Raneshwar centre: local residents of Raneshwar block At least Matric/Secondary (10th) pass from a recognised educational institution. At least one 5-day training from the Directorate of Agriculture or Horticulture under the Department of Agriculture, Animal Husbandry and Cooperative. Knowledge of the local language. Ability to ride a bicycle and climb trees. You must be a local resident of the block whose centre you are applying for. Age is counted as on 30 September 2026. Only the date of birth on your Matric marksheet or certificate is accepted. The minimum age is 18 years for every category. The Crop Protector gets a monthly honorarium of Rs. 11851/-. The appointment is for 11 months, or until a regular appointment is made, whichever comes first. The post is paid fully by honorarium or remuneration. It gives no claim to a regular appointment or to permanency in future, and no automatic right to the service benefits of regular government staff. See the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post.

content_sections.heading: JPPO Dumka फसल रक्षक Job Description
content_sections.text: Spraying pesticides. Raising awareness among farmers and training them. Other work given by the office from time to time.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: You must attach self-attested photocopies of the documents below. If any are missing, the application will be treated as incomplete. Matric/10th certificate and marksheet (compulsory) Intermediate/10+2 certificate and marksheet, if available Graduation certificate and marksheet, if available Certificate for training of at least 05 days Local language certificate, if available (the form also lists an additional language certificate, if any) Valid local certificate issued by the competent authority Caste certificate, where applicable Local resident certificate for Dumka district EWS certificate, where applicable Matric certificate as proof of date of birth Identity card Copy of Aadhaar card (clearly readable) Anyone claiming reservation must attach a caste or category certificate issued by the competent authority in the prescribed format. You do not need to send a character certificate with the application. You must produce it at final selection, document verification or joining, in the format set by the competent authority.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: All applications are first checked for eligibility and required documents. An application is rejected if details are missing, required certificates are not attached, the essential qualification is not met, or the information is false or misleading. Valid applications are then scored out of 100 marks. If your marks are in CGPA or grades, they are turned into a percentage using the conversion formula set by your board or university. No extra marks are given for a postgraduate or higher qualification. No extra marks are given for more than one degree or qualification at the same level. Training length is counted by the full training days written on the certificate. Only training certificates from these bodies are accepted: the Directorate of Agriculture and Horticulture under the Agriculture Department, the Krishi Vigyan Kendras of Birsa Agricultural University, and the ATMA office. If the selection committee thinks it is needed, it may hold a practical test of bicycle riding and tree climbing after the provisional merit list. Original certificates of selected or provisionally selected candidates will be checked before final selection, on a date to be fixed later. The merit list will be prepared category-wise under the reservation rules. The final list will be published on dumka.nic.in and on the office notice board. Centres are allotted first by the block on your local residence certificate and then by the preferences in your form. The final decision rests with JPPO Dumka based on administrative needs, and the allotment may be changed later. Selected candidates must join on the terms set by JPPO Dumka. If you do not join in the given time, your selection ends on its own and the post may be filled from the waiting list.

selection_process: Stage Details
1. Scrutiny of applications Applications are scrutinized and suitable applicants are shortlisted
2. Data Entry Speed Test For shortlisted candidates who applied for Tax Assistant
3. Physical Standards and Physical Efficiency Test For shortlisted candidates who applied for Havaldar
4. Medical fitness Medical fitness of candidates will be ascertained before their formal appointment
Subject to fulfilling the educational qualification

the applications will be scrutinized and suitable applicants will be shortlisted for the further selection procedure. Shortlisted candidates who applied for Tax Assistant will be called for a data entry speed test. Shortlisted candidates who applied for Havaldar will be called for the Physical Standards and Physical Efficiency Test.
The Data Entry test and the Physical Efficiency/Physical Standard test will be held in Lucknow. Shortlisted candidates must appear at their own expenses
and the date
time and venue will be communicated in due course. Success in the test confers no right to appointment unless the Department is satisfied
after such enquiry as may be considered necessary
that the applicant is suitable in all respects for appointment to the post.
The merit of sportspersons who fulfil the eligibility conditions will be considered/decided in the following order of preference:
First preference to those candidates who have represented the country in an International Competition with the clearance of the Department of Sports

Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports. Next preference may be given to those who have represented a State/U.T. in the Senior or Junior level national Championships organized by the National Sports Federations recognized by Department of Sports

Ministry of Youth Affairs & Sports or National Games organized by Indian Olympics Association and have won medals or positions up to 3rd place. Between the candidates participating in Senior and Junior National Championships/games

the candidates having participated and won a medal in Senior National Championship should be given preference. Next preference may be given to those who have represented a University in an Inter-University competition conducted by Association of Indian Universities/Inter University Sports Board or Khelo India University Games conducted with authorization of Department of Sports

Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports and have won medals or positions up to 3rd place in finals. Next preference may be given to those who have represented a State/UT in Khelo India Youth Games (age category above 18 years) or Khelo India Winter Games or Khelo India Para Games conducted with authorization of Department of Sports

Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports and have won medals or positions up to 3rd place in finals. Next preference may be given to those who have represented the State Schools in the National sports/games for Schools conducted by the All-India School Games Federation and have won medals or positions up to 3rd place. Next preference may be given to those who represented a State/Union Territory/University/State Schools Teams at the level mentioned in categories 2 to 5 above but could not win a medal or position
in the same order of preference.
Note 1: In the event of a tie

those who have secured a higher position or won more than one medal may be given the preference. Note 2: Participation in individual and team event/item may be given the same preference. Note 3: No preference may be given for winning more than one medal/position. Note 4: In case of any doubt about the status of a tournament
the matter will be decided by the Department of Personnel & Training in consultation with the Department of Sports
Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports.

content_sections.heading: CGST Lucknow Sports Quota Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: To be considered, a candidate must satisfy the age limit, the educational qualification for the post applied for, and the sports eligibility conditions. The educational qualification must be held on the closing date of submission of the application form. The candidate must be 18 to 27 years of age on 23.11.2026. Relaxation in the upper age limit by five (5) years is allowed in each case. In addition, a further relaxation of five years is allowed only to candidates belonging to Scheduled Caste (SC)/Scheduled Tribe (ST) in each case. A total of 10 years of age relaxation is therefore allowed to SC/ST candidates only. Although the additional age relaxation is provided to SC/ST candidates, the notification states that no post shall be reserved for any category of candidates. Age relaxation is admissible only to sportspersons who satisfy all other eligibility conditions related to education and sports qualifications, backed by a certificate in the prescribed form from the authority detailed in the notification. Appointment can be made of a sportsperson considered meritorious with reference to the following criteria. The sportsperson should have represented: A State or the country in a National or International competition; or medal winners in Junior National Championships; or medal winners in Khelo India Youth Games (age category above 18 years); or Khelo India Winter Games; or Khelo India Para Games; or medal winners in Khelo India University Games; or medal winners in School Games Federation of India (SGFI), in any of the games/sports mentioned in the DoPT Office Memorandum No. DOPT-1720781414772 dated 04.03.2024. Their University in the Inter-University Tournaments conducted by the Inter-University Sports Boards in any of the sports/games specified in the same DoPT Office Memorandum. The State School Teams in the National Sports/games for schools conducted by the All India School Games Federation in any of the games/sports mentioned in the same DoPT Office Memorandum. For Chess: Grand Master (GM) Title, International Master (IM) Title, Chess Olympiad. IM/GM title should be in Open Category like Woman Grandmaster (WGM) etc. While National Open Chess Championship is treated as National Championships, the medal winning performance in National Team Chess Championship will also be considered for recruitment. Only certificates awarded by the authorities listed below will be taken into account as evidence of participation in competitions. The applicant may submit self-attested copies of at least one merit certificate issued by one of these authorities along with the application. The applicant must submit Forms 1, 2, 3, 4 and 5 (whichever is applicable), complete in all respects. Specimens of these forms are given in Annexure B of the notification. Certificates of sports achievements submitted in any other form, or from authorities other than those listed above, will be ignored.

content_sections.heading: CGST Lucknow Sports Quota Selection Process
content_sections.text: Subject to fulfilling the educational qualification, the applications will be scrutinized and suitable applicants will be shortlisted for the further selection procedure. Shortlisted candidates who applied for Tax Assistant will be called for a data entry speed test. Shortlisted candidates who applied for Havaldar will be called for the Physical Standards and Physical Efficiency Test. The Data Entry test and the Physical Efficiency/Physical Standard test will be held in Lucknow. Shortlisted candidates must appear at their own expenses, and the date, time and venue will be communicated in due course. Success in the test confers no right to appointment unless the Department is satisfied, after such enquiry as may be considered necessary, that the applicant is suitable in all respects for appointment to the post. The merit of sportspersons who fulfil the eligibility conditions will be considered/decided in the following order of preference: First preference to those candidates who have represented the country in an International Competition with the clearance of the Department of Sports, Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports. Next preference may be given to those who have represented a State/U.T. in the Senior or Junior level national Championships organized by the National Sports Federations recognized by Department of Sports, Ministry of Youth Affairs & Sports or National Games organized by Indian Olympics Association and have won medals or positions up to 3rd place. Between the candidates participating in Senior and Junior National Championships/games, the candidates having participated and won a medal in Senior National Championship should be given preference. Next preference may be given to those who have represented a University in an Inter-University competition conducted by Association of Indian Universities/Inter University Sports Board or Khelo India University Games conducted with authorization of Department of Sports, Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports and have won medals or positions up to 3rd place in finals. Next preference may be given to those who have represented a State/UT in Khelo India Youth Games (age category above 18 years) or Khelo India Winter Games or Khelo India Para Games conducted with authorization of Department of Sports, Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports and have won medals or positions up to 3rd place in finals. Next preference may be given to those who have represented the State Schools in the National sports/games for Schools conducted by the All-India School Games Federation and have won medals or positions up to 3rd place. Next preference may be given to those who represented a State/Union Territory/University/State Schools Teams at the level mentioned in categories 2 to 5 above but could not win a medal or position, in the same order of preference. content_sections.text: For every post, Punjabi pass up to Matric Standard is essential. The table gives the main requirement for each post. The full conditions for each post follow below the table. The qualifications for Assistant Professor are as per the UGC Regulations 2018. A candidate must meet either condition A or condition B. A. Both of the following: A Master's degree with 55% marks (or an equivalent grade in a point-scale wherever the grading system is followed) in the relevant subject, from an Indian University, or an equivalent degree from an accredited foreign university. A pass in the National Eligibility Test (NET) conducted by the UGC or the CSIR, or a similar test accredited by the UGC, like SLET/SET. Candidates who have been awarded a Ph.D. Degree under the University Grants Commission (Minimum Standards and Procedure for Award of M.Phil./Ph.D. Degree) Regulations, 2009 or 2016, and their amendments, may be exempted from NET/SLET/SET. Candidates who registered for the Ph.D. programme before July 11, 2009 are governed by the Ordinances, Bye-laws and Regulations that applied at that time. They are exempted from NET/SLET/SET only if they meet all of these conditions: The Registrar or the Dean (Academic Affairs) of the university concerned must certify that these conditions are met. NET/SLET/SET is not required for Master's programmes in disciplines for which the UGC, CSIR or a similar UGC-accredited test (like SLET/SET) does not conduct NET/SLET/SET. B. A Ph.D. degree from a foreign university or institution ranked among the top 500 in the World University Ranking, at any time, by any one of these: Quacquarelli Symonds (QS) The Times Higher Education (THE) The Academic Ranking of World Universities (ARWU) of the Shanghai Jiao Tong University (Shanghai) The notice also sets these rules for Assistant Professor: A minimum of 55% marks (or an equivalent grade in a point-scale) at the Master's level is the essential qualification for direct recruitment of teachers. A 5% relaxation is allowed at both the Bachelor's and the Master's level for Scheduled Caste, Scheduled Tribe and Other Backward Classes (OBC) (Non-creamy Layer) candidates. The same 5% relaxation applies to Differently abled candidates: (a) blindness and low vision; (b) deaf and hard of hearing; (c) locomotor disability including cerebral palsy, leprosy cured, dwarfism, acid-attack victims and muscular dystrophy; (d) autism, intellectual disability, specific learning disability and mental illness; (e) multiple disabilities from amongst (a) to (d), including deaf-blindness. The 55% eligibility marks and the 5% relaxation are based only on the qualifying marks, without any grace mark procedure. Ph.D. Degree holders who obtained their Master's Degree before 19 September 1991 get a 5% relaxation, from 55% to 50% of the marks. content_sections.heading: About TISS
content_sections.text: The Tata Institute of Social Sciences (TISS) is at V.N. Purav Marg, Deonar, Mumbai - 400 088. The notice describes it as a Deemed to be University under Section 3 of the UGC Act 1956 and a grant-in-aid Institute under the Ministry of Education, Government of India, established in 1936. It has four campuses: Mumbai (main campus), Hyderabad, Guwahati and Tuljapur (rural campus).

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Only male candidates can apply for this post. The post is unreserved, but it is open to candidates of all categories. Minimum Requirement: 10th standard from a Government recognized School. Literacy: Basic reading and writing skills in Marathi/Hindi/English to understand safety labels, chemical instructions and guest requests. Preference will be given to candidates who have a certificate in Hospitality/Housekeeping/Hostel Maintenance. Duration: 6 months to 2 years of experience in a similar role. Relevant environments: prior experience working in hostels, hotels, guest houses, hospitals or student dormitories. Key tasks: proven experience in handling industrial cleaning equipment, chemical safety, bed-making and deep-cleaning bathrooms. Candidates with good oral communication skills in Hindi, Marathi and preferably English will be given preference. Physical Stamina: Ability to stand, bend and lift heavy items (like mattresses or laundry bags) for long hours. Interpersonal Skills: A polite, friendly manner, because hostels involve frequent, direct interaction with international and young travellers. Time Management: Ability to prioritize and clean several rooms or floors efficiently within check-out and check-in windows. Attention to Detail: Spotting maintenance issues (like broken lights or leaking pipes) and reporting them to management immediately. Candidates should preferably be below 40 years as on 30 October 2026. The Institute reserves the right to relax any of the qualification, experience or age limit in exceptional cases. It may also relax them for a person who already holds an analogous position in a Government Department, a Research and Academic Institution or Industry. See the official notification for the full eligibility details of the post.

basic_details.short_information: DLSA Palamau Recruitment 2026 is for one Driver (Chalak) for the Mahindra Bolero MUV vehicle of the District Legal Services Authority (Jila Vidhik Seva Pradhikar), Palamau. content_sections.text: To apply for the Driver post, you must meet all of these conditions: You must be a citizen of India. You must have passed the Matric (10th) examination. This is mandatory. You must be of good character and physically able to do the work. You must be at least 18 years old and no older than 35 years on the date of application. The application form also asks for: your driving licence number, its date of issue and validity, the issuing RTO and the vehicle class (LMV/HMV/Transport etc.) your driving experience in years details of any previous or current employer whether a criminal case is pending or registered against you in any court whether you are fully fit, physically and mentally, to drive a vehicle For the full eligibility rules for the post, see the official notification.

It may be extended if your work is satisfactory, at the discretion of the District Legal Services Authority, Palamau. The job gives no right to regularisation, permanent appointment or continuity of service under any circumstances. application_fee.details: A non-refundable application processing fee must be paid for each post applied, through UPI or NEFT/RTGS. | Reserved candidates applying against unreserved posts shall pay the full fee. | Write the bank transfer details in the space provided in the online application and attach the transaction receipt. Without bank transfer details/transaction receipt, online applications will be rejected. Candidates bear all applicable service charges, i.e. bank/transaction charges. Online applications will not be considered if the NEFT/RTGS amount is not received by 21.11.2026. Fees and other charges, once paid, will not be refunded in any case/circumstance, nor held reserved/adjusted for any other recruitment process. No refund if a candidate is not screened-in/shortlisted for CWE/Trade/Skill Test; screened-in but did not attend; or attended but not selected. No refund for wrong/incomplete bank/beneficiary details, erroneous/incomplete/rejected applications and applications left in draft mode without final submission.

qualification.details: Qualification and experience differ by post. Candidates should check the conditions for the post they are applying for. | Essential: Bachelor's Degree in Engineering or Technology from a recognized University or Institute in (a) Materials Engineering/Materials Science & Engineering/Metallurgical Engineering/Materials & Metallurgical Engineering, or (b) Mechanical Engineering. Desirable: (i) Master's Degree from a recognized University or Institute in any of the above disciplines; (ii) one year experience in Research and Development in Industry or R&D or Academic Institutions or Science and Technology Organizations. Job requirement: Work in ongoing R&D projects in broad areas of Energy materials and Systems, Surface Engineering, Ceramics, Carbon Materials, Powder Metallurgy etc. | Essential: (i) B.Sc. in Physical Sciences (with Chemistry as one of the subjects) or equivalent from a recognized University/Institute; OR (ii) three (3) years' full-time Diploma in Metallurgy/Mechanical/Electrical Engineering or equivalent from a recognized Board of Technical Education of Central or State Government. Desirable: (i) Prior technical experience in Industry/R&D laboratories; (ii) good interpersonal and communication skills with multi-tasking ability. Job requirement: Attached to one of the Centres to assist and provide technical support to Scientific & Technical Staff in R&D projects/programmes; operate and maintain R&D equipment/instruments; look after laboratory facilities including SOPs and Safety Protocols; assist in other allied works. Note: This is an entry-level post in the technical category. Candidates possessing higher qualifications such as M.Sc./B.Tech./B.E./M.Tech./M.E./M.S./Ph.D. in any subject or discipline as on the crucial date of eligibility will not be considered, and candidates with branches other than those specified will also not be considered. If, after verification of certificates at joining or thereafter, a selected candidate does not fulfil the essential qualifications, possesses higher qualifications, or any claim/certificate/document is found forged/invalid/fraudulent or information is suppressed, the appointment is liable to be cancelled/terminated at any time and legal action may be initiated. | Essential qualification: (i) 10th/SSC pass; plus (ii) 2 years full-time ITI in Fitter/Turner/Electrician trade from a recognized Board of Technical Education of Central or State Government. Essential experience: Three (3) years' technical experience in Industry/R&D laboratories. Desirable: (i) Sound knowledge of industrial equipment used for fabrication of components and assembly of systems; (ii) good interpersonal and communication skills with multi-tasking ability. Job requirement: Attached to one of the Centres/Sections to assist Scientific and Technical staff in operation and maintenance of R&D equipment and instruments including SOPs and Safety Protocols; maintain cleanliness and upkeep of laboratory facilities. Selected candidates may be assigned to any non-technical Centre/Section depending on work requirements and shall be willing to undertake any duties assigned, including work of a non-technical nature. Notes: This is an entry-level post in the technician category. Candidates possessing higher qualifications such as Diploma/B.Sc. or equivalent degree OR M.Sc./B.Tech./B.E./M.Tech./M.E./M.S. in any subject or discipline as on the crucial date of eligibility will not be considered, nor will candidates with branches other than those specified. Appointment is liable to be cancelled/terminated, and legal action may be initiated, if the selected candidate does not fulfil the essential qualifications, possesses higher qualifications, or any claim/certificate/document is found forged/invalid/fraudulent or information is suppressed. Experience includes Apprenticeship training/trainee experience and/or experience in Government Departments/Academic/Scientific Institutions/Autonomous Bodies/Research laboratories/Registered companies/Industries/Societies/MNCs/Private limited companies etc., and shall be supported by NPS/EPF & ESI membership. Without proper experience certificate, or with an experience certificate from unregistered companies/industries and/or individuals, experience will not be accepted. Part-time experience will not be considered for calculating years of experience. | Essential: (i) Pass in 10th/SSC or equivalent from a recognized Board; (ii) valid driving license to drive light and heavy vehicles; (iii) knowledge of motor mechanism (able to identify and rectify minor defects in vehicles); (iv) experience of driving light vehicles for at least three (3) years and heavy vehicles for at least six (6) years; (v) knowledge to maintain vehicle logbooks, journey records, fuel consumption details and other related documents. Desirable: (i) Sound knowledge of traffic rules, road safety regulations, vehicle documents and safe driving practices; (ii) capable of operating material-handling equipment such as forklifts and battery-operated trucks; (iii) basic knowledge of vehicle maintenance and troubleshooting of brakes, clutch, tyres, batteries and engine performance and other essential components; (iv) responsible for upkeep and cleanliness of vehicles operated by the Motor Transport Section; (v) attend official duties on holidays/during odd hours as and when required; (vi) good interpersonal and communication skills (in Hindi/Telugu) with multi-tasking ability. Job description: Attached to the Motor Transport Section; drive staff car, bus and other vehicles as assigned; ensure safe and timely transportation of officers, staff, research students, guests and materials; maintain upkeep, cleanliness and roadworthiness of vehicles and logbooks, journey records and fuel consumption details; promptly report vehicle defects and maintenance requirements; perform other duties assigned. Notes: Total prescribed experience should be after obtaining a valid LMV and HMV license. Experience certificates should only be from Army/Navy/Airforce (for Ex-servicemen)/Government Departments/Academic/Scientific Institutions/Autonomous Bodies/Research laboratories/State Road Transport Corporations/Registered Companies/Industries/Societies/Trusts/MNCs/Private limited companies etc., supported by NPS/EPF & ESI membership. Certificates without proper details or from unregistered companies/industries and/or individuals, and part-time experience, will not be accepted. | The crucial date of eligibility (cut-off date for qualification, experience and age) is not specified in the provided notification pages.

salary_details.details: Salary will be as per government norms in the respective pay level (at the minimum pay level). Monthly gross emoluments include basic pay, DA, HRA and Transport Allowance as applicable. | In addition to emoluments, benefits such as New Pension Scheme (NPS), Gratuity, Group Insurance, Medical Reimbursement, Children Education Allowance and Leave Travel Concession (LTC) etc. are available and will be extended as per prevailing norms.

content_sections.heading: ARCI Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection begins with preliminary screening/short-listing of applications by a Committee constituted by the Competent Authority, ARCI. The Committee considers academic performance, relevance of experience for the post applied, number of years of relevant experience (based on data in the online application) and other parameters as deemed necessary. Screened-in candidates undergo a Computer Based Competitive Written Examination (CWE), followed by Personal Interview/Trade/Skill test (as applicable). ARCI may also administer any other selection method/tool/test at the sole discretion of the Competent Authority. For Officer "B", shortlisted candidates make a crisp presentation highlighting achievements across the broad spectrum of the work experience mentioned for the post, followed by a personal interview at ARCI, Hyderabad. The examination centre for CWE is Hyderabad only for all posts.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Fill in the application in the prescribed proforma (Annexure-1, "Bio-Data/Curriculum Vitae Proforma") printed with the circular. Applicants do not send it themselves. Paste your latest photograph in the box on the proforma and sign the declaration. Attach self-certified photocopies of all educational and other testimonials and certificates. Submit the application to your parent department. The Competent Authority there routes it to AFT Kolkata. The employer or cadre controlling authority completes Part 4, "Certification by the Employer/Cadre Controlling Authority", and countersigns it with its seal. The department forwards the application with the No Objection Certificate, vigilance clearance certificate, a certificate that no disciplinary action or inquiry is pending or contemplated, and photocopies of the ACRs for the last five years. The application must reach the Registrar-in-Charge by 9 December 2026 (Wednesday). Office contact details printed on the circular: Tele 033-22236834, Fax 033-22236832, E-mail [email protected] .

basic_details.job_title: Naval Dockyard Karwar Trade Apprentice Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 210 Posts
basic_details.short_information: The Indian Navy has invited applications for 210 apprenticeship seats for the training year 2027–28/29: 180 at Naval Dockyard, Naval Base, Karwar (Karnataka) across 27 trades and 30 at Naval Aircraft Yard (Goa), Dabolim across 13 trades. ITI certificate holders receive a stipend of Rs. 9,600 per month; three non-ITI trades are open to 10th pass candidates and one (Rigger) to 8th pass, on lower stipend slabs. There is no upper age limit and no fee.

important_dates.last_date_to_apply: Within 30 days of publication: by 9 November 2026
important_dates.exam_date: January 2027 at Karwar (e-admit card by email)

qualification.details: Where the school board awarded grades or CGPA, the equivalent percentage as per that board's norms must be stated; without it the candidature is not considered. Candidates with a grade-point system must get the conversion done by the appropriate authority before applying. | There is no upper age limit (MSDE O.M. dated 20 December 2021). The minimum age is reckoned on the training commencement date of 12 April 2027: 14 years for non-hazardous trades (born on or before 12 April 2013) and 18 years for hazardous trades (born on or before 12 April 2009). The notice adds a caution: the Recruitment Rules for Tradesman Skilled posts in naval establishments do carry an upper age limit, which will apply to ex-apprentices of the Dockyard Apprentice School who later apply for those posts. | Anyone currently undergoing apprenticeship training under the Apprentices Act, or in the three-month waiting period after terminating a contract (no waiting period applies to women). Anyone who has already completed two apprenticeships; a second apprenticeship must be in a different trade, and the Central Government's stipend share is paid only for first-time training. Candidates with 100% disability are advised not to apply; the notice says such applications will be rejected because competent instructors and facilities are not available. | SC, ST and OBC seats are reserved under Sections 3A and 3B of the Apprentices Act. Unfilled reserved seats are not carried forward; they are filled from other categories in the same year. PwBD: 3% of overall seats, horizontal, for candidates with at least 40% disability holding a valid medical-board certificate from a government hospital. Children of Armed Forces personnel / ex-servicemen and ex-servicemen: 3% of overall seats, horizontal. If fewer candidates qualify than the seats in a trade, those seats are re-appropriated to other trades on overall merit, up to 25% above the trade's published number.

salary_details.details: These are the minimum rates under Rule 11 of the Apprenticeship Rules, 1992. Selected candidates sign the apprenticeship contract online through the NAPS portal. The notice states clearly that neither establishment nor any government agency is obliged to offer employment after training.

how_to_apply: Application has two parts: online registration on the national apprenticeship portal, then a printed profile sent by post. Both are required.

Before you start, make sure your name, date of birth and father's name on your Aadhaar card match your 10th certificate (8th certificate for Rigger). If they differ, correct Aadhaar first; mismatches are a listed ground for rejection.
Open apprenticeshipindia.gov.in, choose Candidate Login/Register, fill in personal and contact details and submit. Activate your profile from the email you receive.
Log in with your registered email; an OTP goes to your mobile.

Complete the profile: date of birth (upload only the 10th mark sheet or a birth certificate from a competent authority as proof), father's and mother's names, address, educational qualifications (10th and ITI only), trade preference, bank account details, and validate your Aadhaar number.

Open Apprenticeship Opportunities from the top-right dropdown, enter "Naval Dockyard, Karwar" under Search by Establishment Name, click Apply against your eligible trade, select "Uttara Kannada", and click OK.
Download and print the Candidate Profile from the portal.
Attach self-attested copies of: 10th mark sheet (8th for Rigger); ITI mark sheets, semester-wise and consolidated; category certificate (OBC/SC/ST); disability certificate (PwBD); Aadhaar card.

Add the certificate of undertaking in the notice's proforma, stating whether you are applying for Naval Dockyard, Karwar or Naval Aircraft Yard (Goa), Dabolim. Tick one and strike out the other; sign with date and place.
Send by speed post or registered post to: The Officer-in-Charge, Dockyard Apprentice School, Naval Dockyard, Naval Base, Karwar, Karnataka – 581 308
It must reach within 30 days of the 10 October 2026 publication. Allow for transit time; post by the first days of November at the latest.
One application only. Double or multiple applications are rejected, and the establishment choice is made once in the undertaking. Separate merit lists are drawn for Karwar and Goa.
Apply only for a trade your ITI certificate matches; irrelevance between the applied trade and the ITI trade is a listed rejection ground.
No money is payable to anyone. Report any tout or agent demanding payment to [email protected] with proof; the notice promises confidentiality.
Give a valid mobile number and email; all notices, the admit card and the joining letter come only by email.

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Where the school board awarded grades or CGPA, the equivalent percentage as per that board's norms must be stated; without it the candidature is not considered. Candidates with a grade-point system must get the conversion done by the appropriate authority before applying. There is no upper age limit (MSDE O.M. dated 20 December 2021). The minimum age is reckoned on the training commencement date of 12 April 2027 : 14 years for non-hazardous trades (born on or before 12 April 2013 ) and 18 years for hazardous trades (born on or before 12 April 2009 ). The notice adds a caution: the Recruitment Rules for Tradesman Skilled posts in naval establishments do carry an upper age limit, which will apply to ex-apprentices of the Dockyard Apprentice School who later apply for those posts. Anyone currently undergoing apprenticeship training under the Apprentices Act, or in the three-month waiting period after terminating a contract (no waiting period applies to women). Anyone who has already completed two apprenticeships ; a second apprenticeship must be in a different trade, and the Central Government's stipend share is paid only for first-time training. Candidates with 100% disability are advised not to apply; the notice says such applications will be rejected because competent instructors and facilities are not available. SC, ST and OBC seats are reserved under Sections 3A and 3B of the Apprentices Act. Unfilled reserved seats are not carried forward; they are filled from other categories in the same year. PwBD: 3% of overall seats, horizontal, for candidates with at least 40% disability holding a valid medical-board certificate from a government hospital. Children of Armed Forces personnel / ex-servicemen and ex-servicemen: 3% of overall seats, horizontal. If fewer candidates qualify than the seats in a trade, those seats are re-appropriated to other trades on overall merit, up to 25% above the trade's published number.

content_sections.heading: About LAHDC-KSSRB
content_sections.text: The Kargil Subordinate Service Recruitment Board works under the Office of the Secretary, Ladakh Autonomous Hill Development Council, Kargil, in the Administration of Union Territory of Ladakh. Its job is to select candidates and recommend them to departments, based on the vacancies those departments report. The departments, not the Board, decide the number of vacancies and the reservation roster. The Board's Chairman is the Deputy Commissioner/CEO, LAHDC, Kargil, and its e-mail address is [email protected] .

content_sections.heading: Vacancies by Department
content_sections.text: The notice advertises 181 posts across 20 items in six departments. Category-wise, there are 4 UR, 155 ST, 1 SC, 6 ALC and 15 EWS posts. The horizontal reservation is 5 posts for PwD, 8 for ESM and 5 for OSP. Most of the posts are in the School Education Department (107 posts, 70 of them Class-IV). The Ladakh Power Development Department has the next largest share (47 posts, 45 of them Technician-III). The other departments have 13 posts (Animal Husbandry), 8 (Rural Development Department & PR), 5 (PHE/I&FC) and 1 (Handicraft). Vertical reservation is for Scheduled Castes (SC), Scheduled Tribes (ST), Actual Line of Control (ALC) and Economically Weaker Sections (EWS). Horizontal reservation is 6% for Ex-Servicemen (ESM), 4% for Persons with Disabilities (PwD) and 4% for Outstanding Sportsperson (OSP), vide S.O 247 dated 18.08.2026. The Indenting Departments decide and communicate where it applies. Reservation follows the Reservation Rules notified vide S.O 77 dated 27-06-2025 of the Social & Tribal Welfare Department, read with the Ladakh Reservation (Amendment) Regulation, 2025. A candidate eligible under more than one category (ST and ALC, ALC and EWS, or SC and ALC) must choose only ONE category in the online form, as per section-19 of the J&K Reservation Act, 2004. The choice cannot be changed after submission. Only candidates with a benchmark disability count as PwD. Their selection depends on the posts being identified as suitable for their category and on the vacancies the departments report. Sons, daughters and dependents of Ex-Servicemen get no age relaxation or reservation and should not mark themselves as ex-servicemen. The number of vacancies comes from the departments. The Board is not responsible if a department withdraws or changes them.

content_sections.text: The fee is non-refundable and non-transferable. It is paid online by credit card, debit card, net banking or UPI by 27 November 2026, and the candidate bears all bank service charges. application_fee.details: The NWR Act Apprentice application fee is Rs. 100 for all candidates except those exempted. The fee is non-refundable. | The fee is paid online through the payment gateway after the online application is complete at www.rrcjaipur.in. After a successful payment, the candidate is redirected to the RRC Jaipur website to complete the application and download the application form. Payment can be made by debit card, credit card or internet banking. Transaction charges for online payment, if any, are borne by the candidate. If the amount is deducted but the application cannot be downloaded, the candidate should click the "Verify Payment" button to reconfirm the payment from the payment gateway. An e-receipt is generated on successful payment and should be printed and retained. If the transaction is not completed, the candidate should log in again and pay online. No change or edit is allowed after the fee payment. RRC/NWR is not responsible for incomplete or pending online fee transactions.

content_sections.heading: NWR Act Apprentice Age Limit
content_sections.text: The NWR Act Apprentice age limit is 15 to 24 years as on 22.11.2026. A candidate should have completed 15 years of age and should not have completed 24 years of age on that date. The upper age limit is relaxable as shown below. The Ex-Servicemen relaxation does not apply to Ex-Servicemen who have already joined Government service on the civil side after availing the Ex-Servicemen status. Regardless of community, Ex-Servicemen are considered against the Ex-Servicemen quota, if available. If UR vacancies are not available, only Ex-Servicemen of the communities where vacancies are available are considered against the Ex-Servicemen quota. content_sections.heading: NWR Act Apprentice Application Fee
content_sections.text: The NWR Act Apprentice application fee is Rs. 100 for all candidates except those exempted. SC/ST, Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD) and Women candidates do not have to pay any fee. The fee is non-refundable. The fee is paid online through the payment gateway after the online application is complete at www.rrcjaipur.in. After a successful payment, the candidate is redirected to the RRC Jaipur website to complete the application and download the application form. Payment can be made by debit card, credit card or internet banking. Transaction charges for online payment, if any, are borne by the candidate. If the amount is deducted but the application cannot be downloaded, the candidate should click the "Verify Payment" button to reconfirm the payment from the payment gateway. An e-receipt is generated on successful payment and should be printed and retained. If the transaction is not completed, the candidate should log in again and pay online. content_sections.text: The NWR Act Apprentice selection process is based on a merit list. The notification does not mention any written examination or interview. The merit list is prepared for all candidates who apply, on the basis of the percentage of marks in Matriculation (with minimum 50% aggregate marks) and the ITI marks in the trade in which the apprenticeship is to be done. The final merit list is prepared division/unit-wise, trade-wise and community-wise, equal to the number of slots, in the descending order of the percentage of marks. content_sections.heading: Standards of Fitness for Persons with Disability
content_sections.text: Locomotor Disability or Cerebral Palsy (LD): Only candidates with not less than 40% of the relevant disability are eligible. Hearing Impairment (HI): Loss of 60 decibels or more in the better ear in the conversational range of frequencies. This includes persons who are Deaf, Dumb, Deaf and Dumb. Visually Impaired (VI): For the trades Mechanic (Diesel) and Fitter, low vision means impairment of vision of less than 6/18 to 6/60 with best correction in the better eye, or impairment of field (reduction of fields less than 50 degrees, hemianopia with macular involvement, or altitudinal defect involving lower fields). Multiple Disabilities (MD): PwBD candidates with more than one disability. A PwBD candidate who wants to avail the reservation must produce a disability certificate issued by a competent authority (a Medical Board constituted by the Central or State Government) in the format of Annexure-V(A), V(B), V(C) or V(D).

Final selection excludes candidates with adverse records or disciplinary action.

content_sections.text: The application must be made in the prescribed format, Annexure-A, which is printed with the notice. Fill all columns of the Annexure-A form carefully in your own handwriting: name in block letters, father's or husband's name, gender, marital status, date of birth, age as on 04.11.2026, permanent and present address, mobile number and e-mail ID (if any), religion, nationality, experience (if any) and the list of documents attached. Affix a self-attested recent passport-size photograph in the box on the form, and sign the declaration with place and date. Attach self-attested copies of the relevant certificates and the documents listed under Enclosures below. Superscribe the envelope: "Application for Engagement on Daily Wage Basis" . Send the envelope by Speed Post only (not by any other mode) to: The Registrar, Civil Courts, Balangir (Patnagarh Road), P.O. / Dist. - Balangir, PIN - 767001, Odisha. The application must reach the office on or before 18 November 2026 (by 5:00 P.M.). Incomplete applications or those received after the last date and time will be summarily rejected.

Candidates having proficiency in Cooking (unskilled), Driving (unskilled) and House Chores, and who may have knowledge in Electric work (unskilled) and Plumbing work (unskilled), shall be given preference, subject to overall merit. Payment will be the minimum wages of unskilled labour as fixed by the Government of Odisha from time to time as per the Government Rules/Notifications. Payment shall be made on the basis of actual attendance. No other allowances shall be admissible. The engagement is purely temporary and on daily-wage basis. It shall not confer any right for regular appointment, regularisation or absorption in service. The person engaged may be disengaged at any point of time without any prior notice. content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Selection has two stages: a written examination (Stage-I, 70 marks) and then an interview/viva-voce with document verification (Stage-II, 20 marks). The written examination has objective multiple-choice questions, answered on an OMR sheet. It lasts 1½ hours (90 minutes). The Mizo language part is qualifying only. To pass the written examination, a candidate must score at least 40% in it, i.e. 8 out of 20 marks. Marks from the Mizo part are not counted when the merit list is prepared. Candidates are called for the interview/viva-voce and document verification on the basis of their written-examination merit, in the ratio of 1:3 (3 candidates for each post). To qualify, a candidate must score at least 60% in the interview, i.e. 12 out of 20 marks. Final selection is based on the total marks from the written examination and the interview/viva-voce. If two or more candidates have the same total, the one with more written-examination marks is preferred. If those marks are also equal, the older candidate is preferred. The High Court reserves the right to fix or change the cut-off marks for the written examination and the viva-voce. Selected candidates may be assigned any Group-D position(s) based on administrative convenience.
