content_sections.heading: AEES Teacher Vacancy 2026 - Post-Wise Details
content_sections.text: The Atomic Energy Education Society Recruitment 2026 offers 254 tentative vacancies across teaching, school administration and library positions. The largest number of vacancies is for Primary Teacher (PRT) and Trained Graduate Teacher (TGT) posts. Note: The vacancies are tentative and may increase or decrease according to AEES requirements. There are 27 Post Graduate Teacher vacancies under AEES PGT Recruitment 2026. These vacancies are distributed across nine subjects. AEES has announced 102 TGT vacancies for English, Mathematics-Physics, Social Studies, Computer Science, Science, languages and other subjects. The AEES PRT Vacancy 2026 includes 89 Primary Teacher posts. Candidates must possess the prescribed elementary education qualification and qualify CTET Paper I. The maximum age limit is 30 years, subject to applicable relaxation. AEES has also advertised 10 Primary Teacher (Music) vacancies. The Music Teacher post requires a relevant bachelor's degree in Music or Performing Arts along with the prescribed Class 12 qualification. A diploma in Music alone does not meet the notified requirement. Under AEES Librarian Recruitment 2026 , 13 vacancies have been announced. Candidates must hold a Bachelor's Degree in Library Science or Library and Information Science with at least 50% marks and possess knowledge of computer applications. The maximum age is 35 years, and the pay scale is Rs. 44,900 to Rs. 1,42,400 under Level 7. PwBD reservations are applied horizontally within the advertised vacancies and are not additional posts.

content_sections.text: The educational qualifications vary by post. Important: The above table is a qualification summary. Candidates must verify the exact minimum marks, permitted qualification combinations, subject requirements and experience criteria for the selected post in the official notification. Yes. CTET Paper I is mandatory for the regular Primary Teacher (PRT) posts. Candidates must also meet one of the following qualification combinations: Class 12 with at least 50% marks and a two-year Diploma in Elementary Education; or Class 12 with at least 50% marks and a four-year Bachelor of Elementary Education (B.El.Ed.); or Class 12 with at least 50% marks and a two-year Diploma in Education (Special Education) from RCI. Applicants should check the additional conditions for special education qualifications in the notification. AEES has advertised Computer Science teaching vacancies at both PGT and TGT levels. For PGT Computer Science, the prescribed qualifications include relevant postgraduate computing qualifications and an accepted teaching qualification. For TGT Computer Science, the notification accepts specified undergraduate Computer Science / IT qualifications or equivalent routes with B.Ed.

content_sections.text: The AEES Teacher Recruitment 2026 syllabus covers general knowledge, reasoning, language ability, computer knowledge, teaching methodology and subject-related knowledge. The examination pattern differs between school leadership posts and other teaching posts. content_sections.heading: RIMS Ranchi Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Educational qualifications and experience requirements vary by post. Candidates applying for Operational Manager and Floor Co-ordinator must meet the respective experience requirements, while Ayushman Mitra applicants must satisfy the prescribed education and computer qualification conditions. MBA in Healthcare or Master's degree in Health from a regular university. Minimum five years of experience implementing a Government Health Insurance Programme. Fluent communication skills in English and Hindi. Functional computer literacy, including MS Office and internet portals. Graduation in any discipline. Minimum two years of experience implementing a Government Health Programme or Health Insurance programme in a managerial capacity. Minimum one-year certificate course in Computer Operation. Fluent communication skills in English and Hindi. Computer proficiency, including MS Office and internet portals. Completed Class 12 from a recognized Board of Education. Six-month Diploma in Computer Application (DCA) certificate. Experience certificate as Arogya Mitra will be given preference. Fluent communication skills in English, Hindi and the local language. Computer literacy, including MS Office and internet portals. Important: Candidates applying for Ayushman Mitra must possess both the required 12th Pass qualification and six-month DCA certificate. The notification lists prior Arogya Mitra experience as a preference rather than a compulsory eligibility requirement.

content_sections.heading: RIMS Ranchi Recruitment 2026 Age Limit
content_sections.text: The maximum age limit is 40 years for General candidates , with relaxation for eligible reserved categories. Age is calculated as on the walk-in interview date. content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IHMCT Lower Division Clerk
content_sections.text: Applicant must be citizens of India. The applicants are required to go through the detailed notification carefully and decide themselves about their eligibility for this recruitment before applying online. Application fee shall be paid by online mode only. Candidates have to pay *application fee plus transaction fee as applicable. Applicants must compulsorily fill-up all relevant fields of the online application. Scan the latest photograph of the candidate and upload the same in the space provided in the online application [scanned image shall be less than 200 kB in *.JPG format only]. Candidate shall make his/her signature on a white paper, scan the same and upload it in the space provided in the online application [scanned image shall be less than 50 kB in *.JPG format only]. The signature must be signed only by the candidate, full signature (initials not sufficient, CAPITAL LETTERS not permitted). Submit the online application via www.cmd.kerala.gov.in.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Candidates must upload either the original certificate or the provisional certificate issued by a competent authority when submitting their educational qualification certificates. Uploading mark sheets, consolidated mark sheets, or statements instead of certificates will not be accepted. Candidates must upload No Objection Certificate, in case already employed in Government/ Government undertakings. Candidates seeking reservation benefits available for EWS/ ESM must ensure that they are entitled to such reservation as per eligibility prescribed in the Notice and possess certificates in the prescribed format. Serving Defence Personnel Certificate as per the prescribed format attached (Annexure- I), if applicable (for personnel whose Specific Period of Engagement (SPE) is to be completed on or before 31.01.2027). For Ex-Servicemen (ESM) category candidates must upload: (1) Undertaking as per the prescribed format attached (Annexure- II) & (2) Discharge Certificate / PPO, if discharged from the Armed Forces. For EWS category upload the certificate in the prescribed format attached (Annexure - III) issued by authorized officers (District Magistrate/Additional District Magistrate/ Collector/ Deputy Commissioner/Additional' Deputy Commissioner/ 1st Class Stipendiary Magistrate/ Sub-Divisional Magistrate/ Taluka Magistrate / Executive Magistrate/ Extra Assistant Commissioner, Chief Presidency Magistrate/Additional Chief Presidency Magistrate/ Presidency Magistrate, Revenue Officer not below the rank of Tahsildar, or Sub-Divisional Officer). In the case of latest experience, applicants may upload an AFFIDAVIT with details of employer, designation, period, nature of job, tasks and responsibilities (applicable only for latest experience).

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: CMD/IHMCT reserves the right to determine the selection process based on requirements. The selection process may include application screening, criteria-based screening, a written test and skill test/proficiency test. Only shortlisted candidates will receive intimations via email, SMS, or phone call regarding the selection process.

content_sections.heading: About District Basic Education Officer, Lakhimpur Kheri
content_sections.text: The office of the District Basic Education Officer (Samagra Shiksha) in Lakhimpur Kheri, Uttar Pradesh, runs this recruitment for the Kasturba Gandhi Balika Vidyalayas in the district. These are residential girls' schools. The notice follows Government Order No. I/570148/2024 file No.68-5099/23/2024-5 dated 28.05.2024 and letter No. 68-5099/23/2024, Section 5 (Basic Education), Lucknow, dated 21.10.2024. It also follows a decision of the district selection committee meeting held on 26.09.2026, with the District Magistrate's permission. The vacancies for Classes 6 to 8 follow Government Order No. 1553/68-5-2020 dated 11 December 2020.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection is on merit. A candidate's merit score is worked out from her marks as follows: Applicants for Office Superintendent/Clerk take a computer typing test in Hindi and English at NIC. At the time of selection, the certificates of teaching and non-teaching staff are verified with the board or institution that issued them. The honorarium is paid only after this verification.

rows.merit_marks: Percentage of marks in theory and practical x 30/100

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: The engagement is on contract for the academic session 2026-27. The Care Taker, Peon, Chowkidar, Cook and Assistant Cook posts are full-time, and these staff must stay at the school. The district selection committee may change or correct the notice, or cancel it at any time, and candidates have no claim against this.

content_sections.heading: About JIPMER
content_sections.text: The Jawaharlal Institute of Postgraduate Medical Education and Research (JIPMER) is a medical institute at Dhanwantri Nagar, Puducherry-6. These posts belong to an externally funded research project run by its Department of Emergency Medicine & Trauma. The Project Investigator (PI) is Dr Amaravathi U, Assistant Professor, and the funding agency is ICMR.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Essential: B.Sc. Nursing (four-year course) with minimum second class or equivalent CGPA from a recognised university with registration in the State/Indian Nursing Council. Desirable: Experience in emergency, trauma, critical care or geriatric nursing; experience in clinical research and data collection; fluency in Tamil. Essential: 12th in Science + Diploma (MLT/DMLT / Engineering or equivalent) + Five Years Experience in relevant subject/field, OR Three Years Graduate degree in relevant subject/field + two years' experience in relevant subject. Desirable: Experience in research data management (MS Excel, REDCap/EpiData or similar software); proficiency in Tamil and English. The age limit for each post is counted as on the last date of receipt of applications. For both posts, there is a relaxation of up to 5 years for candidates with experience in a Government research organisation, as per ICMR norms. The qualification and experience must be in a relevant discipline or field and from a reputed institution or organisation. The experience must have been gained after acquiring the essential qualification. For the discipline-specific eligibility of each post, candidates should check the official notification.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The pay for both posts is a consolidated monthly amount that includes 20% HRA. No other allowances are paid. The notice adds that the consolidated salary may change from time to time. No other allowances or facilities are given apart from the consolidated salary.

content_sections.heading: JIPMER Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: Screen adults aged 60 years and above who come to the Emergency Department with trauma to check their eligibility, and assess frailty using the Clinical Frailty Scale (CFS). Obtain informed consent from patients or their legally acceptable representatives (LAR) as per the approved protocol, in Tamil and English. Activate and coordinate the frailty-triggered co-management pathway with the emergency, trauma and geriatric teams, and record time-stamped process measures. Perform daily delirium screening (CAM-ICU) and record clinical data in the Case Record Forms. Provide counselling on transitional care before discharge and make warm referrals. Carry out the community contact 7 to 14 days after discharge and the 90-day structured follow-up by telephone and field/home visits. Work in rotational shifts, including nights, Sundays and holidays, as required by the project. Any other project-related work assigned by the PI from time to time. Data entry, cleaning and management of the study database; maintain Case Record Forms and study records. Extract time-stamped process data from the Hospital Information System; maintain follow-up schedules and tracking logs. Assist with telephone follow-up, report preparation, procurement records and other administrative work for the project. Any other project-related work assigned by the PI from time to time. For both posts, the duties listed are indicative and not exhaustive. Project staff must carry out any work the PI assigns in the interest of the project, including shift duty, field visits and administrative tasks. Refusing assigned work will be treated as unsatisfactory performance and may lead to termination of the engagement without notice. The application form says the project involves field visits for patient follow-up in Puducherry and neighbouring districts.

content_sections.text: Applicants will be shortlisted using the details in their application, their CV and the documentary proof they provide. content_sections.heading: About ICAR IARI
content_sections.text: ICAR-Indian Agricultural Research Institute (IARI), New Delhi-110012, is an institute of the Indian Council of Agricultural Research (ICAR). This recruitment is for its Division of Environmental Sciences. The posts serve the Division's project on the impact assessment and valorisation of iron ore tailing into a mineral-rich, crop-safe soil conditioner for agri-application (Code 79-241).

content_sections.heading: Posts and Eligibility
content_sections.text: The notice offers 7 temporary project positions in two posts. Only candidates who meet the minimum essential qualification will be allowed to appear in the walk-in interview. Essential: B.Sc. (Agriculture), OR BSc. in any discipline of science (medical) with at least six months' research experience after the BSc. Desirable: Experience in field/lab experimentation/microbiology research and data entry. Maximum age: 45 years. Pay: Rs. 30,000 fixed per month. Essential: 12th Pass. Desirable: Work experience on farming and agricultural farm management practices. Maximum age: 45 years. Pay: Rs. 22,000 fixed per month. The desirable qualification is used for scoring only. Candidates who have that experience should bring a certificate of experience. The maximum age limit is 45 years for both posts. The Annexure-I application form asks for the candidate's age as on the interview date (14 December 2026). Eligible candidates get the relaxation only if they provide self-attested documents at the walk-in interview. Both posts carry a fixed monthly payment, Rs. 30,000 for YP-I and Rs. 22,000 for Laboratory cum field Attendant. These are temporary positions under project Code 79-241. The appointment is for one year but may be extended. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post.

rows.minimum_essential_qualification: B.Sc. (Agriculture) or BSc. (in any discipline of science (medical); with minimum six months' research experience, Post BSc.)

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: There is no online or postal application. Candidates bring their application in person to the walk-in interview on 14 December 2026. Fill in the prescribed application form, Annexure-I, printed in the notice. Write the post you are applying for in the "Application for the position of" line. Paste an attested passport size photograph on the form and sign it. Fill in the form's details: name, father's name, date of birth, age as on 14 December 2026, permanent address with PIN code, mobile number, e-mail, sex, marital status and category (SC/ST/OBC/General). Give your educational qualifications from 10th onwards, your work or professional experience, your publications (only published or accepted research papers), your NOC if it applies, and additional information such as a brief note on how you can contribute to the project. Then sign the self-declaration. Fill in the Annexure-II declaration about relatives employed in ICAR/IARI. Candidates whose relative is an ICAR/IARI employee must submit it in advance. All other candidates hand it in at the interview. To apply for both posts, fill in a separate application for each post and mark each one clearly "Application for post of YP-I/Lab cum Field Attendant". Bring the application and your documents to the venue on 14 December 2026 and register between 9.30AM and 11.00AM.

content_sections.heading: What to Bring
content_sections.text: The filled application form in the prescribed Annexure-I format, with photograph and signature The filled Annexure-II declaration form, unless already submitted in advance Self-attested photocopies of the Xth, XIIth, B.Sc, M.Sc and Ph.D mark sheets and degree certificates, as applicable Proof of date of birth Experience certificates, including a certificate of experience for the desirable qualification Proof of training and dissertation, where applicable Original documents for verification A No Objection Certificate (NOC) from your present employer, if you are working elsewhere Self-attested documents for an age relaxation (SC/ST, women, OBC), if you claim one

content_sections.heading: What Happens on the Day
content_sections.text: Registration: Registration at the venue is open strictly from 9.30AM to 11.00AM on 14 December 2026. Only applications in the prescribed Annexure-I format are accepted. Document verification: At registration, your self-attested photocopies are checked against the original documents. Eligibility check: Only candidates who meet the minimum essential qualification appear in the interview. Working candidates without an NOC from their present employer will not be registered. Interview: The desirable qualification (experience) is used for scoring only. The decision of the Interview Committee is final and binding on the applicant.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: An application without a photograph and signature is liable to be rejected. Your candidature or appointment may be cancelled or rejected without notice if any information is found false, incorrect or incomplete, or if you are found ineligible at any time before or after the interview or selection (Annexure-I declaration). Your candidature is liable to be cancelled if the Annexure-II information about relatives in ICAR/IARI is found incorrect or you conceal facts.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: The recruitment process involves two stages. Stage I consists of a Written Test / OMR / CBT comprising objective-type multiple-choice questions covering General Knowledge, General Science, General Mathematics, General English, Official Language, Professional Knowledge, Reasoning, and Aptitude. The duration is 60 minutes with a 1/3rd negative marking for incorrect answers and a qualifying percentage of 40%. content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: Nature of employment: purely on contractual basis for a period of 06 months from the date of joining, extendable depending on the performance of the candidate and at the discretion of the competent authority. No other or additional allowances other than the consolidated salary are admissible. The appointee is not entitled to the benefits available to regular employees of AIIMS Raipur. The appointee performs the duties assigned, and the competent authority reserves the right to assign any duty as and when required, with no extra allowance. The appointee has no right or claim to appointment on regular basis at AIIMS Raipur on any post. The appointee is on whole-time appointment for the project and shall not accept any other assignment, paid or otherwise, or engage in private practice of any kind during the contract. The list of candidates found eligible or shortlisted is displayed on the AIIMS Raipur website, and information is also given by email. content_sections.text: The notice lists these tasks for the post: Conduct site visits and gap assessments across Government Hospitals, Medical Colleges and Institutes; prepare equipment inventories and room-wise requirements. Coordinate with institute departments, stores, purchase, accounts, biomedical teams and suppliers for requirements, training and issue resolution. Maintain complete, audit-ready project records; follow site safety and infection-control rules and report progress and delays regularly. Perform any other duties assigned by management.

content_sections.heading: About NHSRC
content_sections.text: The National Health Systems Resource Centre (NHSRC) is based in New Delhi and issues this Terms of Reference on behalf of the Ministry of Health & Family Welfare. The Senior Consultant (LSCM) will work with the Central TB Division (CTD) on the procurement and supply chain of drugs, lab consumables and other programme logistics.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: B.A / B.Sc. / B.Com. / BBA / B.Tech. from a recognized University with MBA or Post Graduate Diploma in Supply Chain Management. 5-7 years' experience in managing supply chain of drugs & other commodities. Working knowledge of computers. Preference will be given for experience in any public health Programme at National/ State Level. The age limit for the Senior Consultant (LSCM) post is upto 65 years, and the candidate must be ready to travel extensively. The notice does not print a cut-off date for counting age or any age relaxation. For the full eligibility of the post, candidates can refer to the official notification.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The remuneration range for the Senior Consultant (LSCM) is between Rs. 1,00,000/- and Rs. 1,55,000/- per month. The notice does not mention HRA or other allowances. The engagement is purely on a contractual basis; the notice does not mention the length of the contract.

content_sections.heading: NHSRC Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: The responsibilities of the Senior Consultant (LSCM), as printed in the Terms of Reference, are: To maintain and update the international/ national/ regional data base of manufacturers/ suppliers of drugs, lab consumables and other program logistics. To prepare documents for national level procurement including invitation for national/international competitive bids, Direct Shopping or Direct Purchase on a case to case basis. To assist Central TB Division in conducting pre and post procurement quality assessment. To prepare report on national procurement. To track and review the periodic procurement reports from the states/districts and provide feedback. Monitoring and evaluation of state/district level procurements based on the state/district annual action plans. Monitor the performance of manufacturers/suppliers in preventive maintenance of equipment under warranty and initiate statutory procedures on non-compliance. Monitor the states for timely engagement/ renewal of contracts of agencies for preventive maintenance of equipment. To ensure timely action by the states/districts to prevent expiries by monitoring stocks at each stocking point in collaboration with the SC manager. To train the state program managers and state nodal officers for PSM in collaboration with the SC manager. To conduct supervisory visits to state/district stores. To facilitate change management with respect to use of ICT & Nikshay tools for concerned data entry, validation & its use for public health action. Any other relevant job as and when assigned by CTD.

content_sections.text: If the recruitment process includes a written test, a minimum qualifying mark will be 70%. Applications in any format other than the prescribed online application are not accepted. The candidate must be ready to travel extensively, including supervisory visits to state/district stores.

Maintain audit-ready records and submit regular project progress, cost and risk reports to management. Monitor warranty and CAMC activities and ensure proper handover of service. Supervise, guide and monitor the performance of Biomedical Engineers and site-level teams, ensuring effective coordination, smooth project execution and timely completion of assigned activities. content_sections.heading: About HLL
content_sections.text: HLL Lifecare Limited is a Government of India enterprise under the administrative control of the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare. According to the notice, it commenced operations on 5 April 1969 and now works across healthcare manufacturing, retail pharmacy, diagnostics, imaging services, healthcare infrastructure development, procurement consultancy, hospital management and other allied services. The notice gives the HLL Group's annual business turnover as approximately ₹6,500 crore.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Only Indian Nationals are eligible to apply. The essential qualification is BE / B.Tech in Mechanical OR Diploma in Engineering (Mechanical). The experience required depends on the qualification held. For both groups, the experience must be post-qualification experience in mechanical engineering, as printed in the notice: Planning, design, development, execution, installation, commissioning, qualification and maintenance of vaccine and biologicals manufacturing facilities, pharmaceutical or biotechnology facilities, similar institutes. Experience in cleanroom HVAC, GMP-compliant utilities and industrial process systems, and in project execution, installation, commissioning and facility maintenance. Knowledge of WHO-GMP, Schedule M, biosafety and contamination control requirements. The notice lists these essential technical competencies: Cleanroom HVAC and controlled environmental systems GMP-compliant process utilities WFI and Purified Water Systems Steam, Pure Steam and Compressed Air Systems Chillers, Boilers and Industrial Utility Systems Biological manufacturing equipment integration Equipment qualification and commissioning Preventive and predictive maintenance Technical tendering, procurement and project management AutoCAD, P&ID and engineering drawing interpretation SC/ST/OBC/PwD candidates are eligible for relaxation as per Government of India directives; the notice does not print the amount of relaxation. content_sections.heading: HLL Operations Manager (Mechanical) Job Description
content_sections.text: Facility Development & Project Execution: Review designs, specifications, BOQs and P&IDs; supervise mechanical installation, testing and commissioning; coordinate with EPC contractors, consultants and vendors; monitor progress, quality, cost and timelines. HVAC & Cleanroom Engineering: Review and execute HVAC for classified areas, covering HEPA filtration, air changes, pressure cascades and environmental control; coordinate testing, commissioning and qualification. Process Utilities: Supervise installation, commissioning and maintenance of chillers, cooling towers, AHUs, steam and pure steam, WFI, purified water, compressed air and gases, boilers, ETP, exhaust systems and cold storage. Equipment Integration: Coordinate mechanical and utility requirements for bioreactors, fermenters, purification systems and filling lines; ensure hygienic design and maintainability; support qualification documentation. Maintenance & Facility Operations: Develop preventive, predictive and corrective maintenance programmes; ensure utility availability; maintain equipment records and asset plans; implement AMC/CAMC; coordinate calibration and statutory compliance; support deviations, change control and CAPA. GMP, Qualification & Compliance: Ensure compliance with WHO-GMP, Schedule M, biosafety and contamination control; support DQ, IQ, OQ and PQ; coordinate with QA, QC, Validation and Production; support inspections and audits. Tendering & Contract Management: Prepare specifications, BOQs, DPRs, estimates and tender documents; evaluate bids and vendors; monitor contractor performance and handover of completed facilities.

content_sections.heading: HLL Operations Manager (Electrical) Job Description
content_sections.text: Design: Prepare and review electrical designs, SLDs, load calculations, BOQs and estimates, coordinating with architects and other engineering teams. HT/LT systems: Design, supervise and commission 11/33 kV substations, transformers, panels and LT distribution, with proper earthing and IS compliance. Critical power: Ensure uninterrupted, redundant supply (DG, AMF, ATS, UPS) to OTs, ICUs, cath labs, MRI/CT, emergency and other critical areas. Building services: Coordinate power needs for HVAC, lifts, fire-fighting, labs (BSL-2/3) and ELV systems such as fire alarm, CCTV, BMS and nurse call. Execution: Supervise contractors, review submittals and drawings, run integrated testing and commissioning, and ensure handover documentation. O&M: Plan preventive and predictive maintenance, monitor load and energy use, manage AMC/OEMs and keep statutory records. Tendering: Prepare specifications and tenders, evaluate bids and monitor contractor performance. Safety and compliance: Follow CEA, NEC and IS standards, obtain statutory approvals, and implement LOTO and permit-to-work.

content_sections.heading: About RLDA
content_sections.text: The Rail Land Development Authority is a Statutory Authority of the Ministry of Railways, constituted in terms of the Extraordinary Gazette Notification dated 31.10.2006, with its office at Konnectus Tower-II, Ajmeri Gate, New Delhi. The notice describes its work as land management and station re-development, contract management, finance management, and valuation and marketing. RLDA projects are presently being developed at Delhi, Chandigarh, Mumbai, Chennai, Lucknow, Nagpur, Secunderabad and other places (illustrative locations), and the notice states that manpower shall be required Pan India.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Only officers already working in the cadres, pay levels and organisations named for each post can apply, as the posts are filled on deputation. The essential qualification and desirable points for each post are below; the service conditions follow post by post. JGM: Working in analogous posts, or a Group 'A' officer working on regular posts in Pay Level 13 / Level 12 of the IRSSE cadre of Indian Railways, or Electronics / Electronic & Communication / Electrical & Electronics Engineering officers having corresponding grade and 9 years Group 'A' or equivalent service on regular posts in the Signal & Telecom Cadre of Central Government / State Govt. / PSUs / Statutory Authorities. DGM: Working in analogous posts, or a Group A or Group B Gazetted officer working in a regular post in Pay Level 12 / Level 11 from the Electrical / Electronics / Electronic & Communication / Electrical & Electronics Engineering Cadre of S&T of Indian Railways / Central Govt. / State Govt. / Statutory Authorities. DGM, or: Officers having a Degree in Electronics / Electronic & Communication / Electrical & Electronics/ Electrical Engineering in the S&T Cadre of Central Govt. / State Govt. / PSUs / Statutory Authorities with 6 years of service in Group 'A'/ Group 'B' or its equivalent. DGM, or: Officers having a Diploma in Electronics / Electronic & Communication / Electrical & Electronics Engineering of the S&T Cadre of Central Govt. / State Govt. / PSUs / Statutory Authorities with 15 years' service. For PSU officers, the IDA pay scale equivalents of CDA Level-13/Level-12/Level-11 are E-6 (Rs.90000-240000), E-5 (Rs.80000-220000) and E-4 (Rs.70000-200000). JGM: Working on analogous posts, or a Group 'A' officer working on regular posts in Pay Level 13/ Level 12 of Indian Railways in the Civil/Electrical/Mechanical/S&T Engineering Cadre, and 9 years Group 'A' service or its equivalent on regular basis in the Civil/Electrical/Mechanical/S&T Engineering Cadre of Central Government/State Govt./Indian Railways or its equivalent in PSUs/ Statutory Authorities. DGM: Working on analogous posts, or a Group 'A' or Group 'B' Gazetted officer working on regular basis in Pay Level 12/ Level 11 from the Civil/Electrical/S&T/Mechanical Engineering Cadre of Indian Railways/Central Govt./ State Govt./ PSUs/Statutory Authority, having a Degree in Civil Engineering/ Electrical Engineering/Electronics & Communication Engineering/ Mechanical Engineering with 6 years of service in Group 'A'/Group 'B' or its equivalent, or a Diploma in these branches with 15 years' experience. For PSU officers, the IDA pay scale equivalents of CDA Level-13/Level-12/Level-11 are E-6 (Rs.90000-240000), E-5 (Rs.80000-220000) and E-4 (Rs.70000-200000). Manager: Working on an analogous post, or a Group A/Group B officer (Gaz.) working on regular basis in pay level-11/10/09/08 (7th CPC) from the Civil/Electrical/S&T/Mechanical Engineering Cadre of Indian Railways/Central Govt./State Govt./Statutory Authority & PSUs. content_sections.text: Terms of appointment: Normal deputation terms for all three items. Tenure: 5 years (3 years + 2 years). For Manager /Assistant Manager (Projects), the 4th and 5th year are extendable by VC/RLDA. JGM/DGM posts (Items 01 and 02): One scale higher than parent grade is permissible up to Pay Level-12, or deputation allowance if posted in the same grade. Item 01: Railway accommodation/Railway Passes are permissible for Railway Officers; liberal lease facility including self-lease, Conveyance Allowance/Official vehicle, liberal medical facilities, Soft furnishing allowance and electricity allowance are also available. Item 02: Railway accommodation, Railway Passes and TADK are permissible for Railway Officers; liberal lease facility including self-lease, Conveyance Allowance/Official Vehicle, liberal medical facilities, Soft furnishing allowance, Electricity allowance and Caretaker allowance are also available.

basic_details.job_title: IOCL Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 272 Trade Apprentice, Technician Apprentice and More Posts
basic_details.short_information: Indian Oil Corporation Limited (a Government of India Undertaking) has 272 apprentice seats at its Barauni Refinery under Advertisement No. BR/HR/APPR/2026-27/II: 190 for Trade Apprentice (Attendant Operator, Chemical Plant), 38 for Trade Apprentice (Boiler), 21 for Technician Apprentice (Mechanical) and 23 for Technician Apprentice (Instrumentation). Applications are online only, from 6 November 2026 to 6 December 2026, on the NAPS/NATS portals and a Microsoft Form reached through www.iocl.com. Stipend is as prescribed under the Apprentices Act and the Corporation's guidelines.

qualification.details: Code and Trade Qualification Required 101 - Trade Apprentice (Attendant Operator, Chemical Plant), Chemical 3 years B.Sc (Maths, Physics, Chemistry or Industrial Chemistry) 103 - Trade Apprentice (Boiler), Mechanical 3 years B Sc. (Maths, Physics, Chemistry or Industrial Chemistry) 105 - Technician Apprentice, Mechanical 3 years Diploma in Mechanical Engg. 107 - Technician Apprentice, Instrumentation 3 years Diploma in Instrumentation Engg/ Instrumentation & Electronics/ Instrumentation & Control Engg, / Applied Electronics and Instrumentation Engineering | The qualification must be already passed on the reckoning date, 30.11.2026. Candidates whose result is awaited are not eligible. It must be a regular full-time course from a recognised Board/University/Institute, with minimum 50% aggregate marks (45% for SC/ST and PwBD candidates for the seats reserved for them). Where CGPA/OGPA or letter grade is awarded, the equivalent aggregate percentage must be entered in the Microsoft Form, and a certificate from the University/Institute is needed at Document Verification. Only the branch or subjects specified against the trade count; no claim of an equivalent qualification is entertained. Diploma holders under a recognised lateral entry scheme (Class XII (Sc.) or ITI admitted in the 2nd year of the Diploma course) are also eligible, subject to the prescribed percentage on the aggregate of all semesters. A B.Sc candidate (Physics, Mathematics and Chemistry/Industrial Chemistry) may apply for only one of code 101 or 103. Applying for more than one trade leads to summary rejection.

salary_details.details: The stipend per month is as prescribed under the Apprentices Act, 1961/1973, the Apprentices Rules 1992 (as amended) and the Corporation's guidelines. Training lasts 12 months for codes 101, 105 and 107 and 24 months for code 103, and may be extended under Rule 7 of the Apprentices Rules 1992. | One pair of safety shoes and a helmet are provided, returnable on completion of training, wherever applicable. No HRA or company accommodation is provided. General leave is 32 days (8 days per quarter), including medical grounds. Casual leave is 12 days per calendar year (pro-rata). Holidays follow the establishment, and unavailed leave lapses at the end of the apprenticeship. Apprentices are covered under suitable accident insurance and under the Certified Standing Orders applicable to workmen at the establishment.

selection_process: Selection runs through a merit list
Document Verification
pre-engagement medical examination and the offer of engagement. There is no written test.

Candidates are ranked by percentage of marks in descending order in the prescribed qualification for the trade applied for (aggregate of all subjects of all years/semesters). First-time apprentices get preference. A tie is broken by date of birth (senior first)
then by higher Matriculation percentage. PwBD candidates who used the qualification-marks relaxation are considered against reserved seats regardless of position in the select list.
Candidates shortlisted by merit position and seats are called to bring originals and a self-attested copy of each document. One original Photo ID is also required (Aadhar
PAN
Voter ID
Driving License or Passport).
Only candidates declared fit in the pre-engagement medical examination are considered

under the physical fitness standards of the Apprentices Act. Those whose documents and medical certificate are in order receive the offer of engagement. Filling the seats is at the management's discretion
and no claim arises if seats remain unfilled.
how_to_apply: Both Step I and Step II must be completed; the application is considered only then. Applications in any mode other than online are rejected.

Hold a valid and active Apprentice Registration/Enrolment Number on the NAPS/NATS portal, with the profile 100% correctly updated. Keep an active e-mail ID and mobile number valid for at least the next one year.
Visit www.iocl.com between 06.11.2026 and 06.12.2026 and go to What's New, then Engagement of Apprentices at Barauni Refinery 2026-27(II).
For codes 101 and 103, register on the NAPS portal https://apprenticeshipindia.gov.in/, choose Apprenticeship Opportunities, search the IOCL refinery location and trade, and apply.
For codes 105 and 107, register on the NATS portal https://nats.education.gov.in and apply to the IOCL Barauni Refinery advertisement on the dashboard.

Apply with the Barauni Refinery Establishment ID: NATS EBRBEC000003, NAPS E11191000001. Check that profile details and aggregate percentage appear correctly; corrections go through the NAPS/NATS office.
Step II: submit the Apprenticeship Additional Data Form: Barauni Refinery 2026 on Microsoft Forms, once only. Enrolment/registration numbers must match in Step I and Step II.
Use the same e-mail ID and mobile number as on the NAPS/NATS portal; they must stay valid for the entire apprenticeship.
Queries: [email protected], 06243-275258 and 275240. Information on Document Verification calls and results will be on www.iocl.com or by e-mail.
important_instructions: Documents for verification: 10th/Matriculation certificate; CGPA/OGPA-to-percentage conversion certificate if applicable; Principal's certificate of result publication date if the marksheet lacks it, which must also state regular full-time mode and good conduct; SC/ST/Disability/OBC (NCL) certificate with Declaration or EWS Income & Asset Certificate; print of NATS/NAPS registration; Annexure-A affidavit; any other document specified. Candidates must declare ailments or abnormalities in the application. They must also declare any earlier UNFIT finding in a medical examination by a refinery unit or PSU, and any arrest, prosecution, detention, fine or conviction, or debarment by a Public Service Commission. SC/ST/PwBD candidates attending Document Verification get single second class railway fare from the nearest railway station of the mailing address and back, on production of the ticket, if the distance is at least 30 KMs. The Corporation has no obligation to offer employment after apprenticeship, and an apprentice cannot claim employment on that ground. False or incorrect information leads to cancellation of candidature and possible criminal prosecution. Candidature is provisional, and engagement is liable to termination if shortcomings are found later. Canvassing in any form can make a candidate ineligible. The management's decision is final on eligibility, acceptance or rejection of applications and mode of selection. Corrigenda or notices will appear on www.iocl.com only. Disputes are subject to the jurisdiction of the local Court at Begusarai. The notice warns against fraudulent agencies and advises relying only on www.iocl.com and Employment News/Press Notifications.

content_sections.heading: About MoFPI
content_sections.text: The Ministry of Food Processing Industries is a ministry of the Government of India with its office at Panchsheel Bhawan, August Kranti Marg, New Delhi - 110049. The Young Professionals will work in the National Programme Monitoring Unit (NPMU) of the PMFME Scheme. The notice is issued under the signature of S. N. Ahmad, Deputy Director, and dated 6 November 2026.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The Ministry has advertised 4 Young Professional positions in three streams. The notice does not give a category-wise break-up.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The upper age limit is 32 years for all three posts. The notice does not print an "as on" date for age or any age relaxation. Each post has its own qualification and experience requirement, given below. Desirable: Experience in Product value chain, backward & forward linkages, Quality assurance, Enterprise Promotion. Desirable: MBA/PGDM specialisation in Business Analytics, Agribusiness, Marketing, Rural Management, Operations, Project Management, Entrepreneurship Management, Supply Chain Management, Finance, Public Policy. The notice lists this experience for the post: Minimum 02 years in graphic design and visual communication. Print, digital, & outdoor campaign and event branding experience. Audio-visual skills in video editing and motion graphics. End-to-end management of creative projects from concept to production. Experience of handling national campaigns in Govt set up will be preferred. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post.

rows.experience: Minimum 2 years of relevant experience

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: Each Young Professional gets ₹60,000 per month. The remuneration shall be consolidated and inclusive of applicable taxes, payable monthly subject to satisfactory services and attendance certification. Income tax and other applicable taxes shall be deducted at source as per prevailing rules; the Consultant/YP is responsible for individual tax liabilities. Extension of the contract and revision in remuneration shall be subject to the prescribed norms in the contract. Official travel needs prior approval of the competent authority. Travel, accommodation and other admissible expenses shall be reimbursed as per the applicable terms and conditions. No other allowances or facilities shall be admissible unless specifically provided. The engagement is purely contractual for two years from the date of engagement. Extension shall be considered based on satisfactory performance and the recommendations of the Performance Review Committee. Leave entitlement is as prescribed under the contractual terms. Unavailed leave shall not be carried forward or encashed.

content_sections.heading: MoFPI Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: Support the NPMU in day-to-day project management and operational activities, including data collection, synthesis and analysis, preparation of reports, presentations, executive summaries and briefing materials. Provide technical and analytical inputs in areas such as Food Technology, Agribusiness, Rural Development, Data Analysis and Project Management. Assist in inter-institutional coordination, knowledge management and monitoring of project progress to ensure timely completion of activities. Undertake review and assessment of proposals relating to the establishment and operationalisation of Incubation Centres, Common facilities in food processing, etc. Undertake special tasks related to project implementation, as and when assigned by MoFPI. Perform any other work assigned by the competent authority. Analyse existing scheme data, generate insights and evaluate trends and projections to support evidence-based implementation of the Scheme and recommend corrective measures, wherever necessary. Conceptualise performance-monitoring parameters for scheme stakeholders and develop standardised reporting formats to track physical and financial progress under the Scheme. Undertake scrutiny, evaluation and assessment of Branding and Marketing proposals under the scheme. content_sections.text: Oil India Limited is described in the notice as a Maharatna Public Sector Undertaking and the second largest national upstream Oil & Gas company, with pan India presence and a global footprint. This engagement is for its Rajasthan Fields (RF) at Jodhpur.

content_sections.text: Send the duly filled application form, in the prescribed format and with self-attested copies of the required documents, to the email id [email protected] on or before 23:59 hours of 05/12/2026. content_sections.heading: OIL Consultant (Electrical Engineering) Job Description
content_sections.text: The Consultant works at Rajasthan Fields (RF), Jodhpur. The notice calls this list indicative and not exhaustive. Technical Support: technical guidance and expertise to the Electrical Engineering Section for managing electrical installations, managing new projects and addressing technical issues. Coordination: liaise with local administration, DISCOM and BSF for timely support to installations in remote locations. Contract Management: oversee and manage services provided through contracts, ensuring required standards and objectives are met. Issue Resolution: work with the team to resolve electrical engineering operational issues, considering constraints of manpower and resources. Handholding and Training: assist new team members in understanding the complexities of managing RF installations. Documentation: maintain accurate records, reports and documentation on installations, technical issues and support provided. Compliance: ensure compliance with company policies, safety regulations and applicable industry standards. Continuous Improvement: identify areas for improvement in processes, procedures and resource utilisation and recommend changes. Stakeholder Engagement: collaborate with project managers, maintenance teams and other departments. Reporting: prepare periodic reports on the performance and activities of the Electrical Engineering Section. Other allied jobs as assigned by the concerned reporting Officer/HoD.

content_sections.text: ICAR-Central Institute for Research on Cotton Technology is an institute of the Indian Council of Agricultural Research, with its office at Adenwala Road, Matunga, Mumbai - 400019. The notice invites engagement for programmes of the Mission on Cotton Productivity (Kapas Kanti) and for the Institute's Finance and Accounts Section. Program 5.2 covers an innovative cotton value chain to enhance farm profitability through circular economy.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Each post has its own essential and desirable qualification. The table gives the essential qualification as printed; desirable points follow below it. Sl. No. 1 SRF: candidates having a post graduate degree in basic sciences with a 3-year bachelor's degree and a two-year master's degree should have NET qualification and 2 years of research experience, as mentioned in the Council's OM dated 13th July, 2015 and 9th October, 2015 and OM SR/59/2-09/2018 of DST dated 30th Jan, 2019. Sl. No. 3 SRF: candidates having a 3-year bachelor's degree and a two-year Master degree should have NET qualification and 2 years of research experience. Sl. No. 1 SRF and YP-II: knowledge of design, development and testing of machinery, machine design software, data analysis, statistical analysis, research paper and report writing skills and field work. Sl. No. 1 YP-I: preference to candidates with knowledge in erection/commissioning of Engineering Plants and machinery or working in industrial scale plants. Sl. No. 2 YP-II: experience in cotton fibre testing, textile testing, data analysis, project management etc. Sl. No. 2 YP-I (a): experience in spinning, weaving, garmenting, cotton fibre testing, textile testing, data entry and analysis, etc. Sl. No. 2 YP-I (b): experience in project management, computer skill, data entry, Advance excel, Telley etc. The candidate will be mainly required for project management and administrative work related to the project. Sl. No. 3 SRF: PhD in Biotechnology/Biochemistry/Microbiology/Life Sciences with experience of molecular biology tools will be given preference. Sl. No. 3 YP-II: post graduate degree / diploma in Instrumentation & control / Sensor technology; experience in sensor fabrication and prototyping, spectroscopic characterization of materials, data acquisition and analysis, exposure to microcontrollers, RFID, signal processing and data handling using open-source software. Sl. No. 3 YP-I: experience in chemical synthesis. Sl. No. 4 YP-II: experience in molecular biology and genetic engineering techniques, fermentation process optimization, and extraction/characterization of biopolymers; knowledge of HPLC/GC analysis and statistical experimental design will be preferred. Sl. No. 4 YP-I: experience in lab experimentation/survey/fibre testing/spinning/waste management. Sl. No. 5 YP-I: knowledge of IT applications, virtual meeting platforms and computer skills (MS Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Tally, etc.) will be an added advantage. The notice prints no "as on" date for counting age. The application format asks for age as on the closing date of application. The notice states these relaxations are "as per govt. rules". Two further notes are printed: for the Commerce and Information Technology category, graduation with a minimum 60% marks; for the Commerce category, a minimum of 1 year of experience in the relevant field. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post.

content_sections.text: The posts are purely temporary and contractual in nature. content_sections.heading: ICAR-CIRCOT Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: The notice prints the nature of work for only the following posts. Molecular Biology work, designing of stable short chains of deoxy-ribonucleotides (marker DNA sequences) using bioinformatics tools. PCR-based analysis and validation of marker DNA sequences for cotton identification and traceability. Encapsulation of marker DNA sequences using suitable encapsulating agents for improving its stability. Screening of microbial strains for PLA production. Optimization of culture media and fermentation conditions. Molecular characterization and genetic modification of selected strains, as required. Laboratory scale fermentation; recovery and purification of PLA. HPLC analysis of fermentation products. The candidate will be mainly required for project management and administrative work related to the project.

content_sections.heading: PMMMH Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: This applies to all the Senior Resident posts. The hospital shall fix the duties and responsibilities of all SRs and JRs from time to time. They will be required to perform such work as may be needed in the legitimate interest of patient care.

content_sections.heading: What to Bring
content_sections.text: Bring all original certificates and testimonials, with self attested copies of all documents, and five passport size photographs. Registering through the Google Form generates an email with a pre-filled application form; bring its printout with the photocopy and original of these documents: Date of Birth (Class X certificate) DMC Registration (as applicable) SC/ST/OBC Caste Certificate issued by the competent authority (if applicable) MBBS degree MD/MS/DNB/PG Diploma certificate (for SRs only) MBBS mark sheets MD/MS/DNB/PG Diploma mark sheets Attempt certificate Copies of any other relevant documents Experience Certificate Undertaking, if any

content_sections.heading: What Happens on the Day
content_sections.text: Report between 09:00 AM and 11:00 AM with the required documents. The notice says entry will not be allowed after 11:00 AM. Take part in the walk-in interview, which is held as per schedule. The decision of the Selection Board/Medical Superintendent PMMMH regarding selection is final and binding, and no representation will be entertained. A panel of waitlisted candidates will be prepared for filling Senior Resident vacancies arising in future. The result will be declared on the website of Deptt. of H & FW, GNCT Delhi. Selected candidates must join duties within 07 days of receiving the offer of appointment, after completion of medical formalities.

content_sections.heading: Terms of Appointment
content_sections.text: The appointment is initially for 89 days, or till a regular candidate joins, whichever is earlier. Extension is subject to satisfactory work conduct report and vacancy. If reserved candidates are not available, posts earmarked for them shall be filled from General/Unreserved candidates on adhoc basis for 44 days. The same applies when SC/ST/OBC candidates are not available. Service will be governed by the Residency Scheme of Govt. of India and Civil Services (Temporary Rules 1978). Appointment is subject to medical fitness and verification of certificates of educational qualifications, age, caste, DMC registration and internship completion. Selected candidates are allowed a maximum of 07 days for joining from the date of acceptance, failing which the offer stands cancelled.

basic_details.short_information: Cochin Shipyard Limited (CSL), a Government of India enterprise under the Ministry of Ports, Shipping and Waterways, is filling 2 supervisory posts at CSL Kolkata Ship Repair Unit (CKSRU), Kolkata. The posts are one Assistant Engineer (Civil) and one Assistant Engineer (Mechanical), both in grade PS1 with the pay scale ₹ 28,000-3%-1,10,000. Applicants need a three-year Diploma in Civil or Mechanical Engineering and seven years of post-qualification experience, and must be within 45 years of age as on 27 November 2026. Indian citizens can apply online only, through www.cochinshipyard.in (Career

age_limit.details: For both posts, the upper age limit shall not exceed 45 years as on 27 November 2026. This means applicants should be born on or after 28 November 1981. Age relaxation for Ex-servicemen is as per Government of India guidelines, up to 50 years. | Ex-servicemen must submit their Discharge Certificate/ Book/ Pension Payment Order from the Armed Forces. With the online application, they must also submit an undertaking (as per Annexure–III) that they have not been re-employed in Government after availing the benefits for ex-servicemen. | Check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions for each discipline.

qualification.details: The qualification must be from a University/Institute/Examination Board recognised by AICTE, an appropriate statutory authority, or a State or Central Government. Applicants who do not have the prescribed qualification but hold higher qualifications such as B. Tech or M. Sc. shall not be considered. Applicants with an equivalent qualification must submit an Equivalency Certificate issued by the Competent Authority. Without it, the application will not be considered. Applicants must fill in the exact percentage of marks in the online application. Where the board gives grade points and does not define a conversion, the Aggregate Grade Points may be multiplied by 10 to get the percentage.

how_to_apply: Read the User Manual and FAQ published at www.cochinshipyard.in (Career page → CKSRU, Kolkata) before you start.
Complete the One-time Registration in the SAP Online portal. You can reach the portal through www.cochinshipyard.in (Career page → CKSRU, Kolkata) from 05 November 2026 to 27 November 2026.
Submit the application against the post. Submit only one application; once submitted, it is final.
Upload certificates in proof of age, educational qualification, experience, caste etc. and a recent passport size colour photograph. Applications without these will be rejected.
Pay the application fee of ₹ 400/- online, unless you are SC/ST.
After you submit, log in to My Applications and check that the status shows "In process". Incomplete, withdrawn and draft-status applications are not considered.
Keep a soft copy or printout of the application with the unique registration number, and quote this number in any correspondence with CSL.

Applications sent directly or by any other mode will not be accepted. You do not need to post the printout, certificates or fee (DD/Challan/Cheque) to Cochin Shipyard Ltd/CKSRU. On the last date, no technical support by email or phone may be available after 1600 hrs.

Applicants in regular Government service or in Government-owned organisations should apply online directly. They must upload a declaration (as per Annexure–II) that they have informed their employer in writing. Their candidature will not be considered if the employer raises an objection.

The fee is paid only online (Debit card/Credit card/Internet Banking etc.) through the online application facility, from 05 November 2026 to 27 November 2026. No other mode of payment is accepted. For applicants who must pay, the application is considered only after the fee is received. Fees are not refunded after submission or withdrawal of an application.

content_sections.text: The notice has 2 vacancies, both in grade PS1 and both unreserved (UR). CSL reserves the right to increase or decrease the number of vacancies, not to fill the vacancy, or to cancel the recruitment process, as per its requirement. Government of India directives on reservation apply. The posts have not been identified as suitable for PwBDs. The notice gives the reason: the work calls for frequent visits to work sites, shops, docks and ships under construction and repair. It also involves climbing vertical ladders, moving through narrow passages and manholes, and working in confined spaces and at heights.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Essential experience: Seven years post qualification experience in supervisory capacity or above in works relating to civil, and to construction and maintenance of Infrastructure projects including housekeeping. This experience must be in a Shipyard, an Engineering company, a Large Civil construction company, or a Government / Semi-Government Company / Establishment. Desirable: Ability to speak in Hindi/ Bengali/ English. Knowledge of civil construction and maintenance practices related to marine/industrial infrastructure. Familiarity with dry dock and berth maintenance activities. Ability to supervise manpower and contractors effectively. Understanding of engineering drawings, estimates, and specifications. Good coordination, communication, and problem-solving skills. Awareness of industrial safety procedures and quality practices. Basic computer knowledge for reporting and documentation. Experience: Seven years post qualification experience in mechanical works in a Shipyard, a Dockyard, an Engineering Company or a Government Establishment. Out of the seven years, two years should be in supervising mechanical works and workmen. Desirable: Ability to speak in Hindi/ Bengali/ English. Experience of working in an ERP/ SAP/ computerised environment. The qualification must be from a University/Institute/Examination Board recognised by AICTE, an appropriate statutory authority, or a State or Central Government. Applicants who do not have the prescribed qualification but hold higher qualifications such as B. Tech or M. Sc. shall not be considered. Applicants with an equivalent qualification must submit an Equivalency Certificate issued by the Competent Authority. Without it, the application will not be considered. Applicants must fill in the exact percentage of marks in the online application. Where the board gives grade points and does not define a conversion, the Aggregate Grade Points may be multiplied by 10 to get the percentage. Only experience gained after passing the prescribed qualification counts. Post-qualification experience is reckoned as on 27 November 2026. Completed Apprenticeship Training in the relevant discipline/trade under the Apprentices Act, 1961 counts as experience, and so does any training with remuneration. Training does not count towards the two years of supervisory experience. For short listing, CSL considers only experience certificates from companies registered under the Companies Act, 1956 or foreign companies of equivalent status. Applicants currently employed without an experience certificate should submit their Appointment / Offer letter and latest Pay Slip / copy of last Pay drawn. For past jobs, the experience certificate must show the dates of joining and relieving. Experience with contractors (Proprietary and Partnership Firms) may be considered if the Principal Employer has endorsed the certificate. Applicants must also give further proof such as ESI/EPF statements. Applicants must state the nature of work and the

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: Both posts are in grade PS1 with the pay scale ₹ 28,000-3%-1,10,000. The notice gives these monthly emoluments as on date: Other benefits listed in the notice, as admissible under CSL rules: New Pension Scheme, Contributory Provident Fund, Gratuity, Accident Insurance coverage, Medical Assistance Scheme, Post-Retirement Medical Assistance Scheme, Earned Leave encashment and Performance related Payment. The selected candidate will be placed at the minimum of the pay scale. Pay protection will not be considered. Posting will be at CSL Kolkata Ship Repair Unit (CKSRU) Kolkata or any other CSL units/project sites as desired by CSL. The candidate is liable to be transferred to different units of CSL depending on project requirements. The appointment carries the obligation to serve in any department of CSL, on board ships, or in any unit, work site or project in any part of India or abroad. CSL will not bear any liability for salary, leave salary, gratuity or pension contribution related to a candidate's previous employment in Government or Public Sector Undertakings.

content_sections.heading: CSL Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: The notice lists job requirements for the Assistant Engineer (Civil) post only. Planning, organizing and coordinating civil engineering works for ship repair infrastructure, including dry docks, berths, workshops, buildings, roads, drainage systems and other allied facilities. Execution and timely completion of civil maintenance, construction and infrastructure development works related to ship repair projects. Supervising and monitoring civil works associated with ship docking, afloat repairs, estate management, housekeeping services, staging/scaffolding activities and vessel accommodation works. Coordinating with production, planning, mechanical, electrical and safety departments, clients, vendors and contractors. Supervising contractors and workforce and ensuring optimum utilization of manpower, machinery, equipment and materials. Ensuring civil works follow approved drawings, technical specifications, quality standards, work schedules and statutory requirements. Conducting routine inspections of civil structures and maintaining records of work progress, site activities, measurements and material utilization. Assisting in the preparation of estimates, work orders, technical reports and project documentation. Ensuring strict compliance with Yard Quality Management System, HSE requirements, environmental regulations and safety standards. Participating in emergency repair works, breakdown maintenance and other urgent civil engineering activities as and when required. Being a good team player, being willing to travel at short notice, and working against set targets within the stipulated time frame. Performing any other duties assigned by the competent authority in the interest of the Company.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for CSL Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Read the User Manual and FAQ published at www.cochinshipyard.in (Career page → CKSRU, Kolkata) before you start. Complete the One-time Registration in the SAP Online portal. You can reach the portal through www.cochinshipyard.in (Career page → CKSRU, Kolkata) from 05 November 2026 to 27 November 2026. Submit the application against the post. Submit only one application; once submitted, it is final. Upload certificates in proof of age, educational qualification, experience, caste etc. and a recent passport size colour photograph. Applications without these will be rejected. Pay the application fee of ₹ 400/- online, unless you are SC/ST. After you submit, log in to My Applications and check that the status shows "In process". Incomplete, withdrawn and draft-status applications are not considered. Keep a soft copy or printout of the application with the unique registration number, and quote this number in any correspondence with CSL. Applications sent directly or by any other mode will not be accepted. You do not need to post the printout, certificates or fee (DD/Challan/Cheque) to Cochin Shipyard Ltd/CKSRU. On the last date, no technical support by email or phone may be available after 1600 hrs. Applicants in regular Government service or in Government-owned organisations should apply online directly. They must upload a declaration (as per Annexure–II) that they have informed their employer in writing. Their candidature will not be considered if the employer raises an objection. The fee is paid only online (Debit card/Credit card/Internet Banking etc.) through the online application facility, from 05 November 2026 to 27 November 2026. No other mode of payment is accepted. For applicants who must pay, the application is considered only after the fee is received. Fees are not refunded after submission or withdrawal of an application.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: The selection for both posts has these stages: Phase I offline test (Objective Type – 40 Marks and Descriptive Type – 40 Marks), then Certificate Verification, then Phase II PowerPoint presentation on work experience (20 Marks). The process will be conducted at CKSRU, Kolkata, or through interview via electronic media. The objective test lasts 45 minutes. It has Part A (General) and Part B (Discipline related). Each question carries one mark, and there is no negative marking. The descriptive offline test is worth 40 marks and lasts 90 minutes, with discipline related questions. CSL will evaluate the descriptive answer sheets only of candidates who reach the minimum pass mark in the objective test and meet the eligibility requirements. The minimum pass mark for all categories (except PwBD) is 50% of the total marks of each test. The syllabus for both tests is in Annexure I, which the notice says is only indicative and not exhaustive. Tests will be held in West Bengal, as decided by CKSRU, depending on the number of applications. CSL alone decides the allocation of exam centres. Depending on the number of applications, CSL may also shortlist applicants by checking the certificates they uploaded. Qualified candidates are called for certificate verification in order of merit/reservation, at a minimum ratio of 6 candidates per post. Candidates must produce all certificates in original. Only those who clear verification attend Phase II, which may go ahead even with fewer than 1:6 candidates. Phase II is a presentation of not more than ten minutes on the candidate's work experience, worth 20 marks. It will be held at CSL-Kolkata Ship Repair Unit, Kolkata. The rank list is based on the total marks of Phase I and Phase II. Ties are broken first by the discipline marks in the objective test and then by seniority in age. Candidates attending the selection at CKSRU, Kolkata get single to-and-fro third AC rail fare by the shortest route from their mailing address, on proof. To claim it, they must submit a copy of the front page of their savings bank passbook with account number and IFSC code at certificate verification. This does not apply to selection through electronic media, or to candidates found ineligible at verification.

Moreover, the expert must have experience of working under PMC services/consultant for a period of minimum 3 years. Shall have experience of not less than 10 years in survey of transmission line at voltage level of minimum 220kV. Experience of Stringing of conductor, erection of special and multi circuit tower and pile foundation in river crossing will be preferred. The expert shall have an understanding of High Voltage Transmission line clearances and safety considerations and knowledge on AutoCAD or similar software. content_sections.heading: SAMEER Recruitment 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: The selection stages depend on the category of post. SAMEER may use academic screening, written examination, online interview, in-person interview or skill test as specified below. Where a written examination is prescribed, it may be conducted online as a computer-based test or in person. Candidates generally need at least 50% marks to qualify for the subsequent stage, subject to the prescribed shortlisting requirements. The written examination syllabus follows the general curriculum of Government-run universities and colleges for the relevant engineering, science, diploma, ITI or graduate qualification. The notification does not provide a common fixed question count, examination duration or negative-marking scheme for all posts. Where applicable, candidates may be shortlisted for online interviews in a ratio ordinarily of 1:6 or more against the advertised vacancies. For in-person interviews, the usual shortlisting ratio is 1:3 or more, as decided by the competent authority. Where no written examination is conducted, academic merit may be used for the next applicable stage. Final selection is based on in-person interview marks and/or skill test/interaction marks only , as applicable to the selected category. Written test and academic screening results are used for qualification or shortlisting and are not automatically added to the final merit score.

content_sections.heading: About LGBRIMH
content_sections.text: LGBRIMH is an autonomous institute under the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, Government of India, located at Tezpur, Assam. The post is part of the multi-centric research project "HEADS – Human-in-the-loop Evaluation of Assisted Depression Screening", funded by the Wellcome Trust, United Kingdom. The project's participating institutions are NIMHANS, Bengaluru (lead institution), IIT Kharagpur and LGBRIMH, Tezpur. Its aim is to develop and evaluate a multilingual, human-in-the-loop, AI-based system for assisting depression assessment, using recorded clinical interviews, automatic speech recognition, machine translation and clinician-led diagnostic reasoning. LGBRIMH, Tezpur, is the implementing site for this notice.

content_sections.text: The notice lists one post with 4 vacancies. It does not give a category-wise break-up, and it states that the number of posts is provisional and may be increased or decreased as per project requirements, without assigning any reason.

content_sections.heading: Qualification and Experience
content_sections.text: Only Indian nationals may apply. All eligibility conditions (qualification, registration, age and experience) are reckoned as on the last date of receipt of applications. Registration and DNB conditions: Valid registration with the National Medical Commission (NMC) or a State Medical Council. It must be valid on the last date of receipt of applications and at the time of joining. For DNB candidates, verification/equivalence of the DNB qualification by NBEMS is as per the prevailing rules and notifications in force. Desirable qualifications: Proficiency in speaking, reading and writing Assamese and/or Bengali, considered crucial for local patient recruitment, clinical interviewing and data collection at the Tezpur site. Experience in psychiatric interviewing and clinical research. Experience in administering structured and semi-structured instruments such as QuickSCID-5 and PHQ-9. Experience in digital data collection, handling of audio recordings, and redaction/de-identification of recorded data. Experience in clinical reasoning annotation and quality control of transcripts and translations. Age limit: the upper age limit is 45 years, reckoned as on the last date of receipt of applications. Age relaxation for SC/ST/OBC (Non-Creamy Layer)/PwBD/Ex-Servicemen and other categories is as per the extant orders of the Government of India. The notice prints no minimum age. content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: The consolidated emolument is ₹1,38,659/- per month, as per the approved project budget and the MoU. It is fixed under the approved project budget. No other allowance, benefit or pay-linked component is admissible over and above it, except as expressly provided in the project sanction. Tenure: initially for 1 (one) year, extendable up to 24 months or the project duration, whichever is earlier, subject to satisfactory performance and availability of funds. Extension beyond the first year is subject to periodic performance review, project requirements and availability of funds from the funding agency. Nature of engagement: purely contractual, temporary and project-funded, and co-terminus with the project. It gives no right or claim to regular appointment, absorption or continuation in LGBRIMH or in any other project or post of the Institute. Full-time work: appointees work exclusively and full-time for the HEADS project and are not deputed to non-project duties of the Institute. Private practice of any kind is not permitted during the tenure. CPD: as mandated by the funding agency, 10 (ten) days per year are available to each appointee for approved Continuing Professional Development activities. Termination: either party may terminate by giving one month's notice or payment of one month's consolidated emoluments in lieu. The Institute reserves the right to terminate without notice in case of unsatisfactory performance, misconduct, or closure/curtailment of the project or its funding. Accommodation: residential accommodation on the campus may be provided subject to availability and on payment of charges as per Institute rules. It cannot be claimed as a matter of right. Leave: regulated as per the rules applicable to contractual/project staff of the Institute and the conditions of the project sanction.

content_sections.heading: LGBRIMH Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: The selected Senior Residents work under the supervision of the Site Principal Investigator at LGBRIMH and are required, inter alia, to: Conduct structured psychiatric assessments and clinical interviews of study participants using standardised tools, including QuickSCID-5 and PHQ-9, in accordance with the approved study protocol. Undertake audio-recording of clinical interviews and ensure the secure storage, handling, transfer and de-identification of all participant interview data, as per the project's data management plan. Carry out diagnostic and clinical reasoning annotation of recorded interviews, and perform quality control of Assamese/Bengali transcriptions and their translations. Participate in inter-rater reliability and harmonisation exercises, multi-centric research meetings (physical/virtual), and training programmes organised by the lead and partner institutions. Contribute clinical inputs to the multidisciplinary AI development and evaluation pipeline in collaboration with the teams at NIMHANS, Bengaluru and IIT Kharagpur. Maintain study records, case report forms and documentation, and perform any other project-related duties assigned by the Principal Investigator from time to time.
