content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: The Junior Faculty receives a consolidated remuneration of ₹50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand only) per month. Initial engagement is for a period of up to 06 months. The engagement may be extended, if required, for further periods of up to 06 months at a time through fresh engagement, subject to institutional requirements and approval of the competent authority. Performance and compliance with assigned responsibilities are reviewed periodically by the management, and the reviews are taken into consideration while assessing any requirement for re-engagement. Two Casual Leaves per month. Unutilized Casual Leave may be carried forward within the current engagement period of six months. Casual Leave not availed during the engagement period lapses. No Earned Leave or Leave Encashment is admissible. No entitlement towards HRA, House Allocation, LTC, Medical Reimbursement, or any other benefits not specifically mentioned in the notice. Temporary hostel/house accommodation may be provided, subject to availability and at the discretion of the Institute, on payment of prescribed charges. If allotted, it must be vacated within 15 days from the date of discontinuation of engagement. FDDI attendance rules and travel entitlements for official duties apply as per the norms of the Institute. Attendance is ordinarily required for five working days per week. The engaged person may be required to attend office on weekends or holidays due to operational exigencies. Compensatory Off, wherever admissible, is governed by the prevailing rules of the Institute.

content_sections.heading: FDDI Junior Faculty Job Description
content_sections.text: Perform duties and functions of the assigned role in accordance with institutional requirements and academic objectives. Assist the Head of Academics and/or Head of School in planning, coordination, implementation, monitoring and review of academic programmes and related activities. Liaise with faculty members, students and administrative departments for smooth conduct of academic programmes, examinations, workshops, seminars and institutional events. Undertake any additional responsibilities assigned by the Head of Academics, Head of School or competent authority from time to time. content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: Pay for each post is the revised IDA scale shown in the vacancy table. For deputation, pay is as per standard terms and conditions. Deputy General Manager posts on post-superannuation basis carry a consolidated pay of ₹ 1,00,000 per month. Engagement is for a minimum of 3 years, extendable up to 5 years based on performance, subject to the organisation's standard terms and conditions. For IDA/CDA scale employees, the percentage of HRA may vary according to the place of posting, as per Government guidelines and company policy. Other benefits are paid as per Company Policy. Selected candidates get Group medical coverage and Group personal accident insurance coverage as per GMRCL policies. Selected candidates are likely to be posted at Ahmedabad, Gandhinagar, Surat or any other project of GMRC anywhere in Gujarat.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for GMRC Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Only online applications are accepted, through the "Careers" section of http://www.gujaratmetrorail.com . The online form can be edited before submission but not after it is submitted. Register on the portal with basic details such as name, DOB, category, mobile number and email ID. Log in with the credentials; the passcode is sent to the email ID given at registration. Select the position for which you are applying. Fill in the online application with relevant details, latest to earliest, and complete the form. Check the entered details with the "preview" option. Submit the form after verifying all the information, on or before 18 November 2026. Detailed curriculum vitae. Proof of age: Matriculation/Birth Certificate. Educational qualification: SSC marksheet, HSC marksheets, graduation all year/semester marksheets and degree/diploma certificates. Experience: experience/service certificates of past employments showing date of joining, date of relieving and department, along with pay details clearly mentioning payscale/CTC. Private-sector candidates: copy of the latest CTC break-up with the other documents at the time of online application. Without the CTC break-up the application will not be considered. Form-16 is used to arrive at the current CTC. Current organisation: appointment letter, proof of date of joining, latest payslip and Form-16 of the last three years.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Selection comprises Personal Interviews, followed by Document Verification and Medical Examination as per the category prescribed for the post. The process judges knowledge, skills, experience, expertise, aptitude and physical fitness. Call letters with time, date and venue are issued to shortlisted applicants through registered email. The venue, date and time of interview will be informed in advance; no interview date is printed in the notice. Document verification is done before the interview. Candidates must carry original certificates, otherwise they will not be allowed to attend the interview. Photocopies are to be submitted with the resume at the interview. Preference goes to candidates with experience in the same grade or the immediate lower grade with 2 years' experience in the grade. If enough suitable candidates are not available, candidates from a lower pay scale who meet the prescribed qualifications, total experience and age criteria may be considered. A request to change the date or venue of the interview will not be entertained.

content_sections.heading: About AIIMS Nagpur
content_sections.text: All India Institute of Medical Sciences, Nagpur is located at Plot no. 2, Sector-20, MIHAN, Nagpur – 441108. These posts are in the ICMR-funded multicentre trial "SMRITI: Stratified Multicentre RCT of Intravenous vs Traditional Inhalational Anaesthesia – A Biomarker-Stratified Multicentre RCT Evaluating Propofol TIVA vs Isoflurane for Postoperative Delirium Prevention in Geriatric Surgery". The Principal Investigator is Dr Omshubham Gangadhar Asai, Associate Professor, Department of Anaesthesiology and Critical Care, AIIMS Nagpur.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Essential: Three-year General Nursing and Midwifery course from a recognized institution. Desirable: Valid registration with the applicable State Nursing Council. Experience in perioperative nursing, critical care, geriatric nursing or clinical research. Familiarity with delirium assessment, cognitive screening, patient follow-up and clinical documentation. Good communication skills in Hindi, Marathi and English. Working knowledge of computers, spreadsheets and electronic data entry. Good Clinical Practice training or willingness to complete protocol-specific training before undertaking study duties. Essential: Three-year graduate degree in a relevant subject or field with three years of relevant post-qualification experience, OR a postgraduate degree in a relevant subject or field. For Engineering, Information Technology or Computer Science, a four-year graduate degree is eligible where relevant to the assigned project functions. All qualifications must be from a recognized university or institution. Relevant subjects: Medical Laboratory Technology, Medical Laboratory Sciences, Biochemistry, Biotechnology, Life Sciences or Biomedical Sciences. Engineering / IT / Computer Science qualifications must be relevant to laboratory data systems or sample tracking. Desirable qualifications and skills: Hands-on experience in blood sample processing, serum or plasma separation, aliquoting, ELISA, pipetting, cold-chain management and sample inventory. Familiarity with laboratory quality control, biosafety, laboratory records and computer-based data entry. The notice states that desirable criteria are preferences and do not replace or add mandatory experience to an otherwise eligible qualification route. The stated remuneration includes HRA at the budgeted rate; other allowances, if any, will be governed by the sanction and applicable rules. This is a fixed-duration, purely temporary post under an ICMR-funded project. It is not a regular post of ICMR or AIIMS Nagpur and confers no claim to permanent employment. The initial tenure is nine months in Year 1. Renewal is subject to project requirements, fund availability, performance assessment and institutional approval. The engagement will end automatically upon expiry of its approved term unless renewed. Leave, notice, termination and other service conditions will follow the applicable ICMR guidelines and institute orders.

content_sections.heading: AIIMS Nagpur Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: Screen potential participants and support recruitment, participant information and consent procedures under investigator supervision and documented delegation. Conduct protocol-specified postoperative delirium assessments using CAM or CAM ICU and delirium severity assessments using CAM S, after completing training and competency assessment. Perform scheduled cognitive, recovery and pain assessments, and coordinate participant follow-up. Maintain blinding to treatment allocation and follow the study procedures restricting access to intraoperative allocation information. Maintain accurate case report forms, assessment records, follow-up trackers and source documentation. Coordinate protocol-specified sample collection with the clinical and laboratory teams. Promptly report clinical concerns, adverse events and protocol deviations to the investigator. Undertake related project duties assigned by the Principal Investigator. Clinical diagnosis and treatment decisions remain the responsibility of the treating investigators. Process and aliquot study samples according to SOPs. Maintain sample identification, inventory, temperature and cold-chain records. Assist with ELISA assays and laboratory quality control under supervision. Prepare reagents and maintain equipment logs. Coordinate sample receipt and shipment. Enter laboratory data and assist with consumable stock records. Blood collection, if assigned, requires appropriate training and institutional authorization. The terms and conditions add that the appointee will carry out duties assigned by the PI, including multicentre coordination, trial documentation, data quality oversight and biomarker workflow support.

content_sections.text: Open the online application link for your post: Project Nurse-II – https://forms.gle/npy2XuG73XqmXcrh6 ; Project Technical Support-III – https://forms.gle/D7MU3sPAHYLoG1HRA . Upload your CV in the format given in the notice (Annexure I for Project Nurse-II, Annexure II for Project Technical Support-III). Upload the required certificates: proof of date of birth, educational qualifications and relevant research/clinical experience. Submit the application before 17:00 hr on 16 November 2026. Applications submitted by email or post will not be accepted. Name of the post, name (in block letters), father/mother name, gender, date of birth, age, address for correspondence, mobile number and email ID. Educational qualifications: exam passed, grade, year of passing, board/university and specialization. Nursing registration details (council, registration number, validity) – in the Project Nurse-II format. Work experience: period from and to, post held, scale of pay and name of employer. Prior ICMR project engagements and their duration (Project Technical Support-III format asks for dates and cumulative duration), relevant training and skills (and publications, if any, for Project Technical Support-III), current employment and NOC status, and time required to join if selected. A signed declaration that the information is true and that false information or suppression of material facts may result in rejection or termination.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Applications will be screened for eligibility, and shortlisted candidates will be notified through the AIIMS Nagpur website and/or email. Selection will be through a personal interview at AIIMS Nagpur. If more than 15 applications are received for a post, a written test may be conducted to shortlist candidates for interview. Date of interview: 21 November 2026 Reporting time: 8.00 AM Venue: Department of Anaesthesiology, 1st Floor IPD OT Complex, AIIMS Nagpur Candidates must produce original documents for verification. No TA/DA will be paid for attending the selection process.

faq.question: Q2. What are the posts available in HAL Apprentice Recruitment 2026?

faq.question: Q7. How is the selection of candidates determined?
faq.answer: Selection is completely merit-based, considering 100% weightage of the total aggregate marks secured in the qualifying examination, followed by document verification and medical examination.

content_sections.heading: Zilla Parishad Chandrapur Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: Conduct at least 32 yoga sessions of one hour each in a month, as per the schedule prepared by the Medical Officer of the AYUSH Arogya Vardhini Kendra. Of the 32 sessions, hold 20 at the AYUSH Arogya Vardhini Kendra and the remaining 12 in the field area (schools, ashram schools, colleges, gram panchayats, women's self-help groups, senior citizens' associations and other government/semi-government institutions). Train ASHAs, female health workers, male health workers and other staff in yoga and build their capacity. Help the Medical Officer, ASHAs and health workers organise awareness campaigns. Prepare yoga-related records regularly and help with the monthly report; help ASHAs and female health workers supervise yoga activities in the field. Organise at least two large-scale community-level yoga awareness campaigns in the field area in a year. Ensure that a large number of citizens attend the yoga sessions.

If a YQWP Specialist Doctor takes long leave such as Paternity, Maternity or Child Care leave (other than Casual Leave and Privileged Leave), only the base fixed remuneration is paid and no top-up amount is paid, because the top-up is for providing services at a particular place.

content_sections.heading: What to Bring
content_sections.text: The proposal is handed in on the day of interview in a closed and sealed envelope, in the prescribed format (uploaded on the website and enclosed in the notice), with all required documents and declarations. The notice names these: Proposal Format, filled in: post applied for, name, date of birth, mobile number, email, PG degree/diploma and specialization, permanent address, registration number and council, skills/training, total MBBS marks, working experience and two references (mandatory) Financial Proposal: post applied for, and the monthly top-up amount (INR, in figures and words) for up to three preferred facilities or places, signed with the declaration Detailed CV/ Resume Education documents (degree/ diploma) and mark sheets Document for registration Certificate for working experience Self-declaration for Medical Fitness Self-declaration in the enclosed prescribed format for being in clinical practice/ performing surgeries Affidavit on a non-judicial stamp paper of Rs 10/- for no litigation/ legal case pending in the court of law and of not being employed in Regular Cadre Service/ Bonded category service (format given in the notice) No Objection Certificate (NOC) from the concerned department/ competent authority, only if the candidate is employed in Regular Cadre Service/ Bonded Category Service

content_sections.heading: What Happens on the Day
content_sections.text: Candidates must be present physically at the venue by 09:30 AM. The interview is at 10:30 AM and registration for the interview closes at 11:30 AM. A candidate employed in Regular Cadre Service/ Bonded Category Service who does not submit the NOC will not be allowed to appear for the interview. Proposals are accepted only if they meet the prescribed eligibility criteria and are clear. The notice describes the selection as follows: Facility-wise and speciality-wise shortlisting as per selection criteria, including but not limited to qualifications, working experience and near past work done. The selection committee's decision is final. The lowest financial proposal/ quote from an eligible candidate is offered the quoted facility. When quoted amounts are similar, NHM Uttarakhand decides allocation in this descending order: a) Degree (preference over Diploma), b) Number of years of Experience, c) Experience of near past. If the lowest quoter cannot join the allotted facility, the facility goes to the next proposer (higher than lowest), and this continues until the position is filled or the proposals run out. A meritorious candidate even with a higher financial quote may also be selected by the committee, as quality of services is the prime concern. NHM-UK reserves the right to reject any lowest quoted proposal without assigning a reason, and selection cannot be treated as a matter of right.

how_to_apply: Open the registration format in the Career Section of the RITES website, http://www.rites.com, between 02.11.2026 and 22.11.2026.

Give two preferences for the written test centre.
Upload all documents under the "Upload Document" section.
Pay the fee online under the "Make Payment" section, then download the final application form.
Print, sign and keep a copy of the application form, and carry it if called for selection.
Where a post is not reserved for the SC / ST / PwD category, candidates from that category must also pay the full fee during the online application.

SC/ST/PwBD candidates must submit their certificate through the portal at the time of paying the fee to be considered for a refund.
A fee paid by any other mode is not accepted, and such an application is rejected. An application without successful fee payment is treated as incomplete.

content_sections.heading: About RITES
content_sections.text: RITES Ltd. is a Navratna Central Public Sector Enterprise under the Ministry of Railways, Govt. of India. It describes itself as a multi-disciplinary consultancy organisation in transport, infrastructure and related technologies. The notice was issued from its office at Shikhar, Plot No. 1, Sector – 29, Gurgaon – 122001. This recruitment is for professionals on a contract lumpsum basis in the Southern region.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: All 31 Senior Technical Assistant posts are listed under VC No. CL/12/26 for posting in Andhra Pradesh, Telangana, Karnataka, Kerala, Tamil Nadu, Puducherry & Lakshadweep. Selected candidates are also liable for posting anywhere in India as per Company requirements. The notice states that the number of vacancies may vary. Of these, 02 posts are reserved for PwBD candidates on a horizontal basis: 01 for Cat-b and 01 for Cat-c. No posts are reserved for Cat-a or Cat-d & e.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: General/EWS candidates, and SC/ST/OBC(NCL)/PWD candidates applying against unreserved posts, need a minimum of 50% marks in the minimum educational qualification. Reserved category candidates (SC/ST/OBC(NCL)/PWD, as applicable) need at least 45% marks for consideration against reserved posts. The same applies to candidates with higher qualifications in the same discipline. Candidates with higher qualifications (Degree / PG Degree) in the same discipline are also eligible to apply. The diploma or degree must come from an institution recognised by BTE/AICTE respectively, a university incorporated by a Central or State Act, an institution established by an Act of Parliament, or a university deemed under Section 3 of the University Grants Commission Act, 1956. Sections A & B of the Institution of Engineers (India) examination are also accepted. If a mark sheet does not show the percentage, the candidate must provide the university's conversion formula. If the university has none, an undertaking signed by its authorised representative is required, and a minimum of 5 on a 10-point scale is treated as 50%. Training (except on-the-job training), internship, teaching, academic, fellowship or PhD research experience is not counted as experience. The date of acquiring the qualification is the earliest of the following: the last day of the month of the final examination, the date of the result, the date of the final mark sheet, or the date of the degree. No relaxation is given on this point. The maximum age is 40 years as on the last date of application, i.e. 22.11.2026. Age, experience and all other eligibility criteria are reckoned as on that date. The PwBD relaxation applies whether or not the post is reserved, provided the post is identified as suitable for PwBDs. Only candidates with not less than 40% of the relevant disability get PWD benefits. The post is identified for locomotor disability (OA, OL) and hearing impairment (HI). Physical requirements include sitting, standing, bending, walking, seeing, manipulation by fingers, communication, and reading and writing. Persons with these disabilities may apply even where no vacancy is reserved for them; they are then considered by the general standard of merit. The relaxations are given subject to the required certificates. For the discipline-specific eligibility of the post, candidates should check the official notification.

content_sections.text: RITES gives the following approximate emoluments at the minimum of the pay-scale for the Senior Technical Assistant position: The basic remuneration is revised in line with the minimum wage rates notified by the Central Government from time to time. The appointment is purely on contract basis, initially for one year. It is extendable until completion of the assignment, subject to mutual consent and satisfactory performance. Services may be terminated without notice, or pay in lieu of notice, for unsatisfactory performance, misconduct or discontinuation of services by the client. Offers are issued only according to project or company requirement. Empanelment against a vacancy does not guarantee selection or a right to the job.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for RITES Senior Technical Assistant
content_sections.text: Open the registration format in the Career Section of the RITES website, http://www.rites.com , between 02.11.2026 and 22.11.2026. Note the Registration No. that the system generates on top of the form. Quote it in all further communication with RITES. Fill in the details under "Fill/ Modify Application Form", entering the "Identity Proof" details carefully. The same identity proof must be produced in original at later stages. Give two preferences for the written test centre. Upload all documents under the "Upload Document" section. Pay the fee online under the "Make Payment" section, then download the final application form. Print, sign and keep a copy of the application form, and carry it if called for selection. Where a post is not reserved for the SC / ST / PwD category, candidates from that category must also pay the full fee during the online application. The fee paid by SC / ST / PwD candidates is refunded once they take part in the written exam / interview (as applicable). The refund goes to the source account or card, less GST / bank charges, after the category certificate is checked. SC/ST/PwBD candidates must submit their certificate through the portal at the time of paying the fee to be considered for a refund. A fee paid by any other mode is not accepted, and such an application is rejected. An application without successful fee payment is treated as incomplete. If the invoice cannot be downloaded after payment, email [email protected] with your registration details. For payment problems, contact Helpdesk No: 011 – 33557000, Extension Code - 13221, or [email protected] . High School certificate for proof of Date of Birth Certificates of academic and professional qualifications, with mark sheets of all semesters/years (Xth, XIIth, Diploma / Graduation / Post-Graduation as applicable) Percentage Conversion Document issued by the University / Institute (wherever applicable) EWS/ SC/ST/OBC-NCL/PwBD Certificate in the Govt. of India format (wherever applicable) Proof of Identity & Address (Passport, Voter ID, Driving License, Aadhaar Card etc) and PAN Card Proof of each period of experience in a single pdf in chronological order (offer letter, joining order, relieving letter, service certificate, pay slips etc.) Any other document supporting the claims made in the application Candidature is liable to be cancelled if these documents are not uploaded. Hard copies of documents are not to be sent by post or courier. SC/ST candidates need a caste certificate in the Annexure I format. OBC-NCL candidates need a certificate in the Annexure II format, not older than one year on 22.11.2026, plus an Annexure III declaration at document verification. EWS candidates need an Income and Asset Certificate (valid for FY 2026-27) in the Govt. of India format. If a valid OBC-NCL or EWS certificate is not produced even by the date of joining, the candidate will be treated as UR.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: The RITES Senior Technical Assistant selection consists of a written test followed by document scrutiny. Appointment also depends on medical fitness. The written test has 125 objective type questions of one mark each, with a duration of 2.5 hours. There is no negative marking. PwBD candidates get a compensatory time of 50 minutes. To be considered further, candidates need a minimum of 50% marks (UR/EWS) or 45% marks (SC/ST/OBC (NCL)/PwBD against reserved posts). The tentative test centres are Chennai, Bangalore, Thiruvananthapuram and Secunderabad. RITES may allot a centre that the candidate did not choose. The exact date, time and venue will be communicated separately. Based on the written test result and the number of vacancies, RITES scrutinises the uploaded documents. A merit list is prepared only for candidates who meet the minimum marks and are shortlisted in the document scrutiny. Offers are then issued provisionally. Original documents are verified at joining, and the offer is cancelled if they cannot be verified. Depending on requirement, the written test, document verification or interview may be held at RITES' Regional Offices. Selected candidates must be found medically fit as per RITES Rules.

content_sections.text: Submit only one application per vacancy. An application cannot be altered after submission, and a valid e-mail ID is essential. Current employees must bring a joining letter or experience certificate with the last month's salary slips, or Form 16. An offer letter is not accepted as proof of experience. Management may cancel, restrict, enlarge or modify the recruitment process at any stage. Any corrigendum will be displayed only on www.rites.com . It is responsible for the coordination, determination and maintenance of standards of higher education in India. Its office is at Bahadur Shah Zafar Marg, New Delhi - 110 002, and the notice prints the phone numbers 011-23604181 and 011-23604203.

basic_details.job_title: ECHS Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 3 DEO/ Clerk, Nursing Assistant and More Posts
basic_details.short_information: ECHS Polyclinic Cooch Behar has 3 contractual vacancies, one each for Officer-in-Charge, Nursing Assistant and DEO/ Clerk, at a fixed remuneration of 95,000.00, 36,500./- and 29,200/- respectively. The engagement is for one year, renewable subject to conditions, and each post requires 05 years of experience. Station HQ (ECHS Cell) Binnaguri Cantt of the Ex-Servicemen Contributary Health Scheme, Ministry of Defence, must receive the application by 30 November 2026.

important_dates.interview_date: 2nd week of Dec 2026 (exact date to be intimated via tele call and email)

how_to_apply: Get the application format from the website www.echs.gov.in.
Complete the application in the requisite format, in duplicate.
Attach self attested photocopies of testimonials in support of Educational qualifications and Work Experiences.
Submit the application to OIC, Stn HQs (ECHS Cell) Binnaguri so that it is received by 30 November 2026.
Any application received after 30 November 2026 will not be accepted. The notice does not specify whether the application should go by post or by hand.

For additional details, contact Stn HQ (ECHS Cell) Binnaguri at Mobile No 6005973412 or [email protected]. The letterhead also gives the phone numbers 9682592394/6005973412. Candidates may also approach the concerned ECHS Polyclinic for details.
important_instructions: The selected individual will have to undergo 10 days on the job training (OJT) and obtain a certificate from OIC Polyclinic before signing the contract. The OJT period will remain unpaid and is counted as mandatory before assuming charge as a contractual employee. 10 days of handing/taking over will be carried out between the key appointments (OIC, Nursing Assistant, DEO/ Clerk) at the polyclinic. The Annual Property Return (Declaration of Assets) in respect of Dental Officer, covering immovable and movable property, will be deposited with Stn HQ, Binnaguri before tenanting the appointment. This requirement applies to both initial appointment and extension of tenure. The appointment/extension letter will be issued only after submission of the said document.

content_sections.heading: KEA Junior Engineer Recruitment 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection will be based on the competitive examination conducted by KEA , the compulsory Kannada language examination wherever applicable, and verification of eligibility and documents. Online Application: Candidates submit their applications through the KEA recruitment portal. Competitive Examination: KEA will conduct the prescribed objective examination for the notified technical posts. Compulsory Kannada Language Examination: Candidates who are not exempt under the notified rules must qualify in the Kannada language examination. Document Verification: KEA or the concerned department will verify educational qualifications, age, reservation and other eligibility certificates. Final Selection: Selection will be subject to examination performance, applicable reservation rules and verification of eligibility.

content_sections.heading: KEA Junior Engineer Exam Pattern 2026
content_sections.text: The competitive examination will consist of two papers, each carrying 100 marks . The examination will be conducted in offline OMR format. Paper 1 covers subjects including current affairs, everyday science, geography, Indian Constitution, Indian history, Karnataka history, Karnataka administration, rural development, Panchayat Raj institutions and other general knowledge topics. Paper 2 will assess technical knowledge relevant to the prescribed educational qualifications and the selected post. Candidates should follow the detailed syllabus and further examination instructions issued by KEA. The notification prescribes a deduction of 0.25 marks for each incorrect answer in the competitive examination.

content_sections.heading: KEA Compulsory Kannada Language Test 2027
content_sections.text: The notification schedules the compulsory Kannada language examination for 8 January 2027, from 3:00 PM to 5:00 PM . Eligible candidates who have already qualified in a recognized compulsory Kannada examination or meet the prescribed Kannada-medium educational criteria may be exempt, subject to the notification's conditions. The Kannada language test is qualifying and its marks are not added to competitive examination merit.

faq.question: Q1. Which post has the most vacancies?
faq.answer: Assistant Town Planner has the most, with 105 of the 187 posts. Among Junior Engineer (Civil) posts, the Greater Bengaluru Authority has the largest share with 46.

faq.question: Q2. Can I apply if I am waiting for my final diploma result?
faq.answer: No. You must hold the prescribed qualification and certificate on 26 November 2026, and candidates awaiting results are not eligible.

faq.question: Q3. Can I pay the fee after the application closes?
faq.answer: Yes, by one day. Applications close on 26 November 2026, while the fee can be paid online until 27 November 2026.

faq.question: Q4. Do I need AUTOCAD training for the Junior Engineer post?
faq.answer: It is not mandatory, but the Greater Bengaluru Authority gives preference to candidates trained in AUTOCAD. The notice prints no such preference for the other organisations.

faq.question: Q5. What is the qualifying mark in the competitive examination?
faq.answer: Candidates need at least 35% marks to qualify, and merit is prepared from those who reach it. In the Kannada Language Test, the qualifying score is 50 out of 150 unless the candidate is exempt.

faq.question: Q6. Will I lose marks for leaving a question blank?
faq.answer: Yes, if you do not shade the 5th option on the OMR sheet. An unshaded question costs 0.25 mark, the same as a wrong answer.

faq.question: Q7. Can I correct a mistake after submitting the application?
faq.answer: No, nothing can be edited once the application is submitted. The one exception is a wrongly claimed reservation, which can be deleted from the Candidate Verification Slip before mock allotment begins.

faq.question: Q8. Can I be selected under both KEA notifications?
faq.answer: No. A candidate can get only one post across this notice and notification No. ED/KEA/40/Ne.Vi/2026 (KK), decided by the options entered, eligibility, reservation and merit.

faq.question: Q9. Which ID should I carry to the examination?
faq.answer: Carry one original ID from the accepted list, such as a PAN card, Aadhaar card, passport or voter ID, along with your admit card.

faq.question: Q10. Does the National Pension System apply to every post?
faq.answer: No. It does not apply to the 12 Junior Engineer (Civil) posts at Karnataka Rural Infrastructure Development Limited, but it applies to the other organisations listed.

content_sections.heading: How Will KEA Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Competitive examination: Paper-1 and Paper-2 (Offline OMR) Qualifying Kannada Language Test, unless exempted Merit or rank based on percentage of total marks Online counselling with option entry, Candidate Verification Slip and mock allotment Provisional selection list in 1:1 ratio Final selection list and additional list Verification of original documents by the appointing authority Selection is on total marks in the competitive examination, eligibility and reservation rules, through online counselling. Options are entered online through login after the result; they cannot be submitted by hand or post. Each candidate may be selected for only one post through counselling. If marks tie, the older candidate ranks higher; if age also ties, higher marks in the qualifying examination decide.

content_sections.heading: KEA Exam Pattern 2026
content_sections.text: Offline OMR examination with objective multiple-choice questions and 4 answer options. Minimum 35% marks required to qualify in the competitive examination. 0.25 mark deducted for each wrong answer. A fifth OMR option must be shaded for unanswered questions, or 0.25 mark is deducted per question. Five extra minutes are given after the last bell for shading the fifth option. Compulsory Kannada test: maximum 150 marks, minimum 50 marks; marks do not count for selection or seniority.

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Original marks cards and qualification certificates at document verification. Caste or reservation certificate in the prescribed form, with RD number. Rural candidates: Form-1 (where applicable) with RD number and Form-2 certified by the headmaster and countersigned by the Block Education Officer. Kannada medium certificate for Classes 1 to 10, signed and sealed by the school headmaster. Original photo ID at the exam centre, with the admit card.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for KEA Recruitment 2026 Online
content_sections.text: Open the KEA website https://cetonline.karnataka.gov.in/kea/ and select the link provided. Read all eligibility instructions, then fill in the online application. Enter the correct RD number when claiming reservation. Check every detail, because no information can be changed after submission. Pay the fee online by 27-11-2026. Apply on or before 26 November 2026.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: Post-wise and category-wise details are published separately, are provisional and may be revised on Government orders. Exam centre details will be announced later, and the centre cannot be changed for any reason. Reservation not claimed in the application cannot be added later. A wrongly claimed reservation can be deleted in the Candidate Verification Slip only before mock allotment begins. KEA does not verify original documents; the appointing authority does. This notification is linked in counselling with KEA notification ED/KEA/41/Ne.Vi/2026(RPC) dated 30-10-2026 for posts with the same syllabus.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection will be made on the recommendations of an Experts Committee constituted by the institute. Shortlisted applicants may be invited for a personal interaction or presentation at a specified place and date, if required. Original or provisional certificates showing that you meet the eligibility criteria must be produced during the personal interaction and at the time of joining. Selected candidates will receive engagement letters and must report for duty within the time stated in the offer, failing which the offer shall be treated as cancelled.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: Tenure: The engagement is initially for 01 (one) year. It may be extended year to year as per requirement, satisfactory performance and administrative exigencies. Nature of engagement: It is purely temporary and contractual, and it shall not be considered a case of re-employment. The notice says it does not constitute a job and gives no assurance or claim for future employment, regularization or appointment to any post in the institute. Other work: Officers shall not take up any other assignment, consultancy or employment, paid or unpaid, without prior written approval of the competent authority. Working hours: Normal hours are 09:00 AM to 05.30 PM, and officers may be required to sit beyond these hours to complete time-bound works. Attendance is through the Biometric Attendance System. Leave: Leave is admissible at 08 days in a calendar year on a pro-rata basis, subject to prior approval of the Controlling Officer. Unused leave cannot be carried forward or encashed. Performance: The institute will define the scope of work, deliverables and performance indicators at the time of engagement. The Controlling Officer will review performance every quarter, and continuation depends on satisfactory performance and the institute's functional requirement. Termination: The institute may terminate the engagement at any time without assigning any reason. Secrecy: Data, information and deliverables, including Intellectual Property, remain the exclusive property of the institute. Any violation invites action under the Official Secrets Act, 1923, and relevant service rules under the DoPT guidelines. Disputes: Unresolved disputes go to the Director, IIIT Bhagalpur, whose decision is final and binding. Legal proceedings fall under the exclusive jurisdiction of the Courts at Bhagalpur/Patna only. The Competent Authority may modify, cancel or withdraw the engagement process, wholly or partly, without assigning any reason.

faq.answer: Yes. The notice accepts a Diploma, BE or B.Tech in Civil Engineering for this post. The Executive Engineer (Civil) post requires a BE or B.Tech in Civil Engineering.

faq.question: Q2. Which rank must I have held at retirement to apply for Executive Engineer (Civil)?
faq.answer: You must have retired as Executive Engineer (Civil) (Regular), or from an equivalent or higher post.

faq.question: Q3. How will my monthly pay be worked out?
faq.answer: Your basic pension is deducted from the pay you drew at the time of retirement, and the balance is your monthly remuneration.

faq.question: Q4. Can I apply by email instead of sending a paper application?
faq.answer: Yes. Scanned copies of the application and self-attested supporting documents may be sent to [email protected], and they must reach the office by 20 November 2026.

faq.question: Q5. Can the contract continue after the first year?
faq.answer: It may be extended year to year, depending on requirement, satisfactory performance and administrative exigencies.

faq.question: Q6. Will this engagement lead to a regular post?
faq.answer: No. The notice states that the engagement gives no claim for regularization or appointment to any post in the institute.

faq.question: Q7. Will I get TA/DA for attending the personal interaction?
faq.answer: No. TA/DA is not admissible for attending the personal interaction or for joining the assignment.

faq.question: Q8. How much leave is allowed during the contract?
faq.answer: Officers get 08 days of leave in a calendar year on a pro-rata basis, and there is no leave encashment at the end of the contract or on termination.

content_sections.heading: Duties of Each Post
content_sections.text: Plan and monitor preventive and corrective maintenance of medical equipment across designated healthcare facilities. Coordinate with facilities, Jr. Equipment engineers, suppliers and authorised service providers for timely servicing and repair. Monitor breakdowns, downtime, warranty coverage, AMCs and CMCs. Keep an updated equipment inventory and prepare periodic reports on equipment status and pending repairs. Coordinate inspections, calibration, performance assessments and safety checks. Recommend repair, replacement or condemnation of obsolete, non-functional or irreparable equipment. Give technical inputs for maintenance planning, budgeting, spare parts and service contracts. Make regular field visits to healthcare facilities and manage a team of Jr. Equipment Engineers. Oversee and coordinate MMDSL operations across the Garo Region, working under the State Manager. Make regular field visits to district hospitals, healthcare facilities, warehouses and other designated locations. Monitor the availability and distribution of medicines, medical supplies, equipment and other resources with the relevant divisions. Coordinate with Medical Superintendents, Medical Officers, hospital administrators and district officials. Resolve regional operational problems within delegated authority and escalate matters that need State Office intervention. Submit periodic reports and keep records of field visits, meetings, issues and follow-up actions. Maintain confidentiality of operational records, employee information and other official information. Assist doctors and nursing staff in delivering critical care, including during emergencies and resuscitation, within the scope of training. Operate, monitor and help maintain multiparameter monitors, ventilators, infusion and syringe pumps, suction apparatus and oxygen delivery systems, as per training and authorization. Assist in monitoring and recording vital signs as assigned by supervising clinical staff. Prepare beds, equipment and supplies for new admissions and emergency cases. Clean, disinfect and store equipment according to infection prevention and control protocols, and follow biomedical waste guidelines. Report shortages, malfunctions, safety hazards and incidents, and maintain equipment logs. The ICU Technician works under the designated medical officer, ICU in-charge, nursing in-charge or other authorized hospital personnel, as applicable.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: All applications go through a screening process constituted for the purpose. Candidates may have to undergo a written and/or practical test. Shortlisted candidates attend an interview and produce all relevant certificates and testimonials in original. Candidates will be intimated in due course after screening. Future updates will be made known via appropriate channels.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: The appointment is on a contractual basis and is renewable. A selected ICU Technician will perform duties at the location assigned by MMDSL and must comply with hospital protocols, infection control measures and patient safety standards. The ICU Technician must work within the scope of their qualifications, training and authorization, and maintain discipline, confidentiality and punctuality throughout the engagement. The office may reject any or all applications without assigning any reason, and may cancel, extend or advertise the recruitment at its own discretion.

content_sections.heading: About NPCC
content_sections.text: National Projects Construction Corporation Limited is a Government of India enterprise and a Mini Ratna Category-I, Premier Schedule 'B' CPSU. It is a subsidiary of WAPCOS Limited and works in engineering, construction, planning, operation and project management consultancy. Its corporate office is at Plot No.148, Sector-44, Gurugram, and it has offices across India.

content_sections.heading: Duties of the Posts
content_sections.text: General Manager (HR): Administration Department and Human Resource functions at the corporate office, including planning, organizing, staffing, development, coordination and periodical review of policies, systems and procedures. The post also handles Bi-partite/Tri-partite Settlements, adjudication, labour law cases and service matters. Manager (Finance): Institutional Finance, Budgetary Planning and Control, Central Treasury Management, Resources Generation, control of Accounts, Investment Planning, Auditing, Financial Analysis and Reporting, Taxation, Finance and Costing of Projects and MIS. The post also covers Income Tax and coordination with statutory/Govt. Auditors. Dy. Manager (Fin.): the same finance areas, from Institutional Finance through to Costing of Projects and MIS. Manager (HR): support, direction and advice to other division managers on HR procedure, policy, hiring, recruitment, training, compensation and promotion, plus IR matters, welfare, labour laws and related legal issues. Manager (IT): management and upkeep of information and communication systems, including software, hardware, networks and allied equipment. Manager (Raj Bhasha): compliance with the Official Languages Act and rules, including English-Hindi translation, preferably of technical and contractual documents. Dy. Manager (Law): managing all litigation filed by or against the company, managing related documents, drafting agreements and advising on compliance and regulatory issues.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: NPCC will decide the selection procedure depending on the response received. Selection can be by Personal Interview or by any other appropriate way, and NPCC's decision is final. The Offer of Appointment follows the final selection, which is based on performance in the interview or the other method used. Meeting the criteria and applying does not give a right to be called for interview.

faq.question: Q1. Can private-sector employees apply for NPCC posts?
faq.answer: Yes, if they have drawn the CTC listed for the post for at least two years, such as Rs. 8.97 Lakh per annum for Dy. Manager, and meet the other criteria.

faq.question: Q2. Do I need to post a hard copy of the application?
faq.answer: No. Clause 23 of the general conditions says not to send any original documents, certificates or a hard copy of the application at this stage.

faq.question: Q3. Is the application fee refundable?
faq.answer: No. The fee will not be refunded under any circumstances, and it will not be held in reserve for a future selection.

faq.question: Q4. Are part-time or distance degrees accepted?
faq.answer: Yes. Qualifications may be full-time, part-time, regular or distance, from an institution recognised by UGC/AICTE or an Indian or foreign institution granted equivalence or recognition by AIU.

faq.question: Q5. From when is experience counted?
faq.answer: Experience counts from the date of declaration of the result or the date of issue of the final mark sheet, provisional certificate or degree, whichever is earliest, up to the cut-off date.

faq.question: Q6. I work in a PSU. Do I need a No Objection Certificate?
faq.answer: You should apply through proper channel or furnish a No Objection Certificate at the interview. If that is difficult, you must produce a relieving order at joining, but you will not get service transfer benefits or pay protection.

faq.question: Q7. Does NPCC pay travel fare for the interview?
faq.answer: Shortlisted candidates are paid to and fro rail fare from the nearest railway station of their declared residence, by the shortest route beyond 30 km, on producing the rail ticket. The entitlement is 2nd AC Sleeper for E-6 level and 3rd AC Sleeper for E-2 and E-1 levels.

faq.question: Q8. Where will corrections to this advertisement be published?
faq.answer: Any corrigendum, addendum or errata will appear only on www.npcc.gov.in, and no further press advertisement will be given.

faq.answer: Candidature can be rejected at any stage, even after recruitment, for false or fabricated information, suppressed facts or failure to meet the eligibility criteria. Canvassing, direct or indirect, also disqualifies a candidate.

content_sections.heading: CSIR AMPRI Recruitment 2026 Salary
content_sections.text: Selected candidates will receive pay according to the applicable 7th CPC pay matrix level, along with admissible allowances under CSIR rules. Applicable benefits may include Dearness Allowance (DA), House Rent Allowance (HRA), Transport Allowance (TA) and other facilities according to CSIR rules.

content_sections.heading: CSIR AMPRI Recruitment 2026 Application Fee
content_sections.text: Applicable application fees must be paid online through SBI Collect or the prescribed payment gateway. The fee is non-refundable. Candidates applying for more than one post code must follow the separate application and fee requirements.

content_sections.heading: CSIR AMPRI Recruitment 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: The selection procedure depends on the post applied for and may include screening, trade tests, physical tests, skill assessments and competitive written examinations. Technical Officer: Screening, qualifying Trade Test and Competitive Written Examination comprising Paper I (Mental Ability), Paper II (General Awareness and English Language) and Paper III (Concerned Subject). Final merit is based on the prescribed written examination papers. Security Officer: Screening, physical standards and physical tests, followed by written examination covering mental ability, personality assessment and security-related subjects. Security Assistant: Screening, qualifying skill / physical and personality assessment tests, followed by a competitive written examination. Technician (1): Qualifying Trade Test followed by a competitive written examination covering mental ability, general awareness, English language and the relevant trade subject. Multi-Tasking Staff: Competitive written examination consisting of General Intelligence (25 questions, 75 marks), Quantitative Aptitude (25 questions, 75 marks), General Awareness (50 questions, 150 marks) and English Language (50 questions, 150 marks). The examination comprises 150 questions carrying 450 marks , with one negative mark for each incorrect answer.

content_sections.heading: IISER Pune Job Description
content_sections.text: Technical Officer / Lead (Science Communication & Technical Writing) Lead the content creation team at SMC. Conceptualize visual storytelling frameworks. Write and review scripts for video series and online modules. Prepare grant applications and institutional annual reports. Oversee digital media communications and media relations. Technical Assistant – Video Post-Production & Editing Edit video lectures, MOOC content, and institutional outreach videos. Handle audio synchronization, basic motion graphics, and multi-cam footage assembly. Archive project media files. Technical Assistant (Graphic Design & Science Illustration) Design high-quality scientific diagrams, publication graphics, cover art, and visual assets for digital media and educational modules. Support the SMC team in visual design projects.

content_sections.heading: Post-wise Details
content_sections.text: Qualification required: Master's degree in Science in any discipline / Mass Communication / Journalism / Content Writing from a recognized University / Institute. Experience required: Minimum 3 years of demonstrated leadership experience in science communication, scripting educational video content, writing grant proposals, drafting institutional reports, and managing digital outreach strategies. Age limit: Maximum 35 years. Pay: Rs. 45,000 to Rs. 50,000 based on qualification/s & experience/s. Qualification required: Bachelor's degree in Visual Communication / Mass Communication / Media Production OR Any Graduate degree with a Diploma in Video Editing / Post-Production from a recognized Institute. Experience required: Minimum 1 year of hands-on experience in video editing, audio mixing, color grading, and asset management. Proficiency in Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, or Final Cut Pro is essential. Age limit: Maximum 30 years. Pay: Rs. 32,000 to Rs. 35,000 based on qualification/s & experience/s. Qualification required: Master's degree in Fine Arts / Visual Communication / Graphic Design / Science OR Bachelor's degree in Fine Arts / Visual Communication with a Diploma in Animation/Graphics. Experience required: Minimum 1 year of proven experience in creating scientific illustrations, schematics, cover art for peer-reviewed journals, infographics, and 2D/3D visual assets. Hands-on experience with Adobe Illustrator, Photoshop, Blender, or Maya. Age limit: Maximum 30 years. Pay: Rs.32,000 to Rs.35,000 based on qualification/s & experience/s.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: The appointment is purely temporary and on a contractual basis. Initially for a period of one year, extendable subject to satisfactory performance and the requirements of the position. The appointed person shall have no claim of absorption in IISER Pune.

content_sections.heading: About DHSGSU
content_sections.text: Dr. Harisingh Gour Vishwavidyalaya is a Central University at Sagar, Madhya Pradesh. This engagement is in its Department of Ancient Indian History, Culture & Archaeology.

content_sections.heading: DHSGSU Curator Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: The maximum age limit is 40 years. Age, qualifications and experience are counted as on the last date of application. Relaxations are provided as per the existing Govt. of India / UGC policy. Candidates must meet one of these two routes: Masters' degree with 55% marks in Museology / History of Art from a recognized University or equivalent. Masters' degree with 55% marks in Ancient Indian History / Sanskrit / Pali / Prakrit / Persian / Arabic / Archaeology / Anthropology / Fine Arts or equivalent or other allied subjects from a recognized University, with a diploma/certificate in Museology of a recognized Institution. 3 years' experience in a Museum of National or Regional importance under the control of Central/State Govt. or Union Territory. This must include one year of practical experience in collection, conservation/preservation and exhibition of art objects. Research experience in a Museum of published research work. Practical training and experience in the relevant field. Check the official notification (PDF) for the full eligibility conditions of this post.

rows.event: Hard copy must reach the University

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Screening: a Screening Committee devises its own criteria to scrutinize applications and restrict the number of candidates called for interview. Interview: meeting the minimum qualification alone does not entitle a candidate to a call. Call letters go to eligible candidates by email only, and no TA/DA is paid for attending. Candidates must bring all original certificates of age, qualifications and experience. A candidate who fails to produce them may not be allowed to appear, and the candidature may be cancelled. The University may draw a panel as a waiting list. If a candidate higher on merit regrets to join or leaves after joining, the offer may go to the next candidate on merit, with the approval of the Competent Authority. The University also reserves the right to fill or not to fill the post.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: The engagement is purely on contract basis for a period not exceeding 12 months. It confers no right to claim regular employment in the University under any circumstances. The terms are sent in an Offer of Engagement. If they are not accepted within the stipulated time, the offer is treated as withdrawn. A duly stamped Contract Agreement is executed between the University and the employee at the time of recruitment. The person appointed is governed by the Rules/Regulations of the University. The engagement stays provisional until the character and antecedents reports are received, and an unsatisfactory report leads to cancellation or termination. The selected candidate must produce a certificate from the Medical Board issued by a Govt. Hospital/Board. False information, fake documents or canvassing lead to disqualification or cancellation, even after engagement.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for DHSGSU Curator Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Open the DHSGSU online application portal , which is live from 1 November 2026, and fill in the form. Upload all necessary documents and certificates. An application incomplete in any respect is not considered. Take a hard copy of the online application form and attach the self-attested testimonials, certificates/educational qualifications and all supporting documents. Place everything in a closed envelope and mark it "Speed Post / Registered Post", with the Advt. No. and the post applied for. Address it to: The Assistant Registrar (Recruitment Cell), Dr. Harisingh Gour Vishwavidyalaya, Sagar (M.P.) - 470003, India. Under "From", write your name, full address and mobile number. Send it by Speed Post or Registered Post only. An application that fails to reach the University in time is rejected, and the University is not responsible for postal delay. Candidates already in service should apply through proper channel.

faq.question: Q1. Is the online application enough for the DHSGSU Curator post?
faq.answer: No. The hard copy of the online form, with self-attested documents, must also reach the Assistant Registrar (Recruitment Cell) by 6.00 P.M. on 7 December 2026.

faq.question: Q2. I applied under the 2025 Curator advertisement. Do I need to apply again?
faq.answer: Yes. Candidates who applied against Advt. No. R/NT/2025/01 dated 14.01.2025 must apply afresh online. They need not pay any fee, but must give the details of the earlier fee and upload a copy of the fee receipt to get the waiver.

faq.question: Q3. Can I apply with a Masters' degree in History or Archaeology?
faq.answer: Masters' candidates in Archaeology, Ancient Indian History and the other listed or allied subjects need 55% marks and also a diploma/certificate in Museology of a recognized Institution. That diploma/certificate is not asked for with a Masters' in Museology or History of Art.

faq.question: Q4. What kind of museum experience is required?
faq.answer: The 3 years must be in a Museum of National or Regional importance under Central/State Govt. or Union Territory control. One of those years must be practical experience in collection, conservation/preservation and exhibition of art objects.

faq.question: Q5. On what date will my age be counted?
faq.answer: Age is counted as on the last date of application, and the upper limit is 40 years.

content_sections.heading: NRLM Karnataka Recruitment 2026 Job Responsibilities
content_sections.text: Implement and monitor farm livelihood activities at block level. Support Mahila Kisan and farm livelihood community resource persons. Coordinate with block, cluster and other departments. Maintain MIS records and submit periodic reports. Support organic farming initiatives, market linkages and buyer-seller meetings. Manage One Stop Facility centre operations and enterprise support services. Assist entrepreneurs with business planning and access to finance. Coordinate among technical support agencies, community organizations and project staff. Support training, enterprise development and market opportunities. Maintain enterprise records, monitoring information and progress reports. Plan and monitor farm livelihood initiatives across the district. Coordinate with Block and Cluster livelihood personnel. Support capacity building, organic farming and community-level activities. Maintain monitoring and MIS reports. Develop market linkages and document successful initiatives. Support social mobilization and institutional development of Self Help Groups. Facilitate training and capacity building for community institutions. Coordinate with banks and other financial institutions for SHG financial inclusion. Monitor activities for vulnerable and socially excluded communities. Prepare programme reports, case studies and development plans. Support district and taluk programme management teams. Maintain office records, reports and files. Assist with MIS data entry and verification. Coordinate administrative activities and compliance requirements. Lead block-level mission implementation teams. Monitor programme activities and community institution development. Coordinate with banks, government departments and other stakeholders. Support annual planning and reporting requirements. Conduct regular field visits and programme reviews. Coordinate skill development awareness and mobilization activities. Support training candidate identification and counselling. Maintain skill registers and programme records. Coordinate with training providers and monitor placements. Track candidates after placement and report programme outcomes. Monitor project Management Information Systems. Ensure timely and accurate data entry. Collect and organize data-entry source documents. Verify entered data against supporting records. Prepare reports based on project performance information. The advertised position concerns non-farm livelihood activities. Candidates should refer to the detailed official listing for the precise responsibilities, reporting arrangements and operational requirements.

content_sections.heading: About the Project and the Role
content_sections.text: The HTAIn Resource Centre aims to: Build HTA capacity for individuals, institutions and governments. Provide technical assistance on HTA to state governments and MoHFW. Complete HTA studies assigned by the DHR, MoHFW. Publish systematic reviews, scientific papers, policy briefs and communication materials for stakeholders. Present HTA findings at national and international forums. Costing and economic evaluation: Collect and analyze cost data, develop economic evaluation protocols and decision-analytic models with sensitivity analysis, validation and calibration, and collect and analyze model input data. Research and data: Contribute to other assigned HTA research, conduct basic statistical analysis, collect data and supervise data collection sites. Training and workshop: Develop training agendas and communication materials, ensure successful delivery of training, and contribute to teaching and training. Reporting and dissemination: Prepare project reports, manuscripts and policy briefs, and present at conferences, workshops and meetings. Other duties: Perform other tasks assigned by the PI/Co-PI.

All educational, professional and technical qualifications should be from a recognized Board/University and be full-time. The required experience should be acquired after obtaining the minimum educational qualifications for the post. Age concession to the extent of service rendered in other research projects may be admissible for experienced and skilled persons on a case-by-case basis. See the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of this post.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Applications are screened, and the list of shortlisted candidates is published on the website. The competent authority reserves the right to conduct a screening/scrutiny test, depending on the number of applicants. Shortlisted candidates are contacted for in-person interviews.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: The initial recruitment is for 6 months and may be extended further based on performance. The position is purely temporary/contractual, based on the project and co-terminus with it. There is no right to claim permanent employment under AIIMS, Jodhpur, or continuation of services in any other project. Contract service does not confer any right to further assignment or regular appointment in the institute. Canvassing in any form will be a disqualification. No inquiries shall be entertained after the due date.

content_sections.heading: RITES AM-Mechanical Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: The maximum age is 40 years. Age, experience and all other eligibility criteria are counted as on the last date of application, 20 November 2026. UR/EWS candidates, and SC/ST/OBC(NCL)/PWD candidates applying against unreserved posts, need a first class degree or minimum 60% marks in the Minimum Qualification. Reserved category candidates need at least 50% marks in the Minimum Qualification for reserved posts. The Diploma or Degree must come from an Institution recognised by BTE/AICTE respectively, or from a University or Institution covered by the notice's other listed categories. Sections A & B of the Institution of Engineers (India) examination, treated as equivalent to a Degree by the Govt. of India and recognised by AICTE, is also accepted. Where a specialisation is required, the candidate must submit a certificate from the University or Institution clearly stating it. The date of acquiring the qualification is the earliest of four dates: the last day of the month of the final examination, the result declaration, the final marksheet issue, or the degree issue. Where the exact date of the written examination is stated, that date is used. No relaxation applies on this point. Diploma Holders: minimum 08 years of post-qualification experience in QA/QC/Testing (destructive/Non-destructive). Degree Holders: minimum 02 years of post-qualification experience in QA/QC/Testing (destructive/Non-destructive). This requirement is the same for all three posts. Experience is preferred in steel plants and rolling, forging or casting industries. SC/ST Category: 5 years OBC-NCL Category: 3 years Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD): 10 years, in addition to the relaxation permissible for SC/ST/OBC-NCL candidates Required certificates must be produced. The PwBD relaxation applies whether or not the post is reserved, provided the post is identified as suitable. Only candidates with not less than 40% of the relevant disability get PWD benefits. Reservation, relaxation and concessions for EWS, SC, ST, OBC (NCL), PWD, Ex-SM and J&K Domicile candidates apply against reserved posts, where applicable, as per extant Govt. orders. Persons with disabilities in the identified category can apply even if no vacancy is specifically reserved for them, and they will be considered by the general standard of merit. Check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions of each post before applying.

faq.question: Q1. Can I apply for both AM-Mechanical-II and AM-Mechanical-III?
faq.answer: You can apply for any number of vacancies separately. However, the written test for CL/10/26 and CL/11/26 is held on the same date and at the same time, so check your eligibility and apply accordingly.

faq.question: Q2. Is there negative marking in the RITES written test?
faq.answer: No. No marks are deducted for an incorrect answer.

faq.question: Q3. How many candidates are called for the interview?
faq.answer: Candidates are called in the ratio of 1:6 to the number of vacancies.

faq.question: Q4. Does training or internship count as experience?
faq.answer: No. Training (except on the job training), internship, teaching, academic, fellowship and PhD research experience are not counted.

faq.question: Q5. Is an offer letter accepted as proof of experience?
faq.answer: No. You must submit a joining and relieving order or an experience certificate to claim that experience.

faq.question: Q6. Will SC, ST and PwD candidates get the fee back?
faq.answer: Their fee is refunded after they take part in the further selection process of written exam or interview, as applicable, and their category certificate is scrutinised. The refund goes to the source account or card used for payment, after deducting GST and bank charges as applicable.

faq.question: Q7. What if my mark sheet shows only CGPA?
faq.answer: You must provide the conversion formula used by your university or institution. If it has no formula, submit an undertaking to that effect signed by its authorised representative. A minimum of 6 on a 10-point scale will then be considered as 60%.

faq.question: Q8. Does RITES pay travel allowance for the test or interview?
faq.answer: No. The notice states that no fares, TA or DA shall be payable.

faq.question: Q9. Does being placed on the panel guarantee a job?
faq.answer: No. Empanelment against a vacancy does not guarantee selection or a right to the job, and deployment depends entirely on project or company requirements.

faq.question: Q10. Where will changes to this recruitment be published?
faq.answer: Any corrigendum or addendum will be displayed only on www.rites.com. Other recruitment updates may be sent to your registered e-mail address or uploaded on the RITES website.

content_sections.heading: About NBPGR
content_sections.text: ICAR-National Bureau of Plant Genetic Resources is an ICAR institute at Pusa Campus, New Delhi – 110 012. These two posts serve the ICAR-CRP Genomics project "Genomics of black pepper, green cardamom and fenugreek for relating genes to traits of economic importance".

content_sections.heading: About IIIT Nagpur
content_sections.text: IIIT Nagpur is one of the 20 Indian Institutes of Information Technology set up under the Ministry of Education's Public-Private Partnership Scheme. Under the IIIT (PPP) Act, 2017, it has been declared an Institution of National Importance. It offers undergraduate and PhD programmes in CSE, ECE, Basic Sciences, AI & ML, Data Science & Analytics, HCI & Gaming Technology and IoT. The campus is about 25 km from Nagpur city, at Survey No. 140,141/1, Behind Br. Sheshrao Wankhade Shetkari Sahkari Soot Girni, Village Waranga, PO Dongargaon (Butibori), District Nagpur – 441108 (Maharashtra).

content_sections.heading: Duties of Each Post
content_sections.text: Both officers assist the Registrar or the Faculty In-Charge (T&P), mainly with student placements and internships. The work covers compiling and analysing student data, dealing with industry, and handling pre-placement procedures, aptitude tests, group discussions, technical and HR interviews, and institute-industry interaction. They also carry out administrative tasks for other sections when required. Both report to the Registrar or as the Competent Authority advises. The counsellor counsels students, mostly aged 18 to 28, as well as adults over 28. The role includes building a counselling programme for the institute, working with volunteer agencies and hospitals, and running workshops, talks and group discussions. The counsellor keeps sessions confidential but must report any extreme case that needs the institution or the family to step in. They also keep a database on the mental well-being of students and employees. The counsellor reports to the Associate Dean (Student Welfare), the Registrar or as the Competent Authority advises. This officer looks after lab and equipment maintenance, IT, networking and email handling. The required knowledge covers system maintenance and troubleshooting, OS and driver installation, server maintenance, Wi-Fi and wired/wireless LAN, routing, and basic programming in Python, Java, C++ and C. The officer reports to the HoD or the Registrar. This officer handles lab work and equipment, IT, networking and email. The required knowledge covers circuit laws, AC fundamentals, sensors and transducers, SMPS and UPS electronics, analog and digital circuits, op amps, the 555 timer, signals and systems, control systems, DSO and PCB rework. It also covers tools such as PSpice, Cadence, MATLAB and network simulators, and newer technology such as antennas, SDR kits, cognitive radio and wireless communication. Candidates with experience in computer networking, LAN/WAN, and maintaining printers and routers will be given preference.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Applications are shortlisted first. The institute may set norms higher than the minimum, and meeting the qualifications alone does not guarantee an interview call. Depending on the number of applications, the institute may hold a written test, interviews or both. Interviews will be held offline. Eligible candidates will be told the dates. Original documents are verified at the interview. A candidate whose documents do not meet the criteria, or who does not bring originals, will not be allowed to take the interview. The institute may offer a lower post to a candidate it finds suitable. No TA/DA or lodging and boarding is paid for attending the interview. Paid guest-house accommodation is offered on a first-come basis, subject to availability. Details are on the institute website.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: The positions are purely temporary and contractual, for 11 months. Extensions may follow under institute policy, depending on performance. Appointments are made through a third-party manpower supply service agency and give no right or preference to appointment on IIIT Nagpur's own rolls. The Student Counsellor attends the institute Monday to Saturday, 09:30 AM to 6 PM, or as the competent authority decides. The counsellor must be available for emergencies during holidays and odd hours, and must counsel online during a lockdown or curfew. The selected candidates will get joining details by email through the third party.

content_sections.heading: CWC Chief Draughtsman Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: Age limit: The maximum age for appointment by deputation is 56 years, counted on the closing date for receipt of applications. Who can apply: Officers of the drawing cadre under the Central Government, State Governments or Union Territories, statutory or autonomous organisations, public sector undertakings, universities or recognised research institutes who meet either condition below: (a) they hold an analogous post on a regular basis in their parent cadre or department; or (b) they have five years of regular service in a post in Level-6 of the pay matrix (Rs. 35400-Rs.112400), or an equivalent post, in their parent cadre or department. Essential qualification and experience: Diploma in Civil or Mechanical Engineering from a recognised university or institute. Three years' experience in the concerned field, gained in Central Government, State Government or Union Territory administrations, statutory or autonomous organisations, public sector undertakings, universities or recognised research institutes. The duties listed below describe what the concerned field covers. Desirable: Six months' experience with Auto-CAD software. Who is not eligible: Departmental officers in the feeder category who are in the direct line of promotion cannot be considered for deputation. In the same way, a deputationist cannot be considered for appointment by promotion. Check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions before you apply.

content_sections.heading: Duties of a Chief Draughtsman
content_sections.text: Administrative supervision of draftsmen of other categories, plus overall supervision, guidance and checking for accuracy. Drafting structural, fabrication, reinforcement and survey drawings with CADD software such as AutoCAD. Checking project estimates. Checking tender documents and construction schedules. Checking topographical contours, maps, GIS and hydrological data. Checking specifications for tenders, NITs and agreements. Checking rate analysis, including rates for non-scheduled items. Keeping drawings in digital form, including uploading and downloading them in the 'Digital Archival System for Engineering Drawings' maintained by CWC. Making sure new drawing staff are fully oriented. Keeping an account of scientific and mathematical instruments.

Posting can be at CWC headquarters, any CWC field organisation or the encadred organisations listed above. Applicants can give three choices of organisation in the proforma. These choices are subject to administrative requirement. Other deputation terms follow the Government of India's orders and rules as issued from time to time. Once you apply, you cannot withdraw your candidature.

content_sections.heading: About DMIL
content_sections.text: Delhi Metro International Limited is a wholly owned subsidiary of the Delhi Metro Rail Corporation (DMRC). It was set up to take on international metro rail projects and national projects in India. Its work covers operations and maintenance, consultancy, design, planning and project development in the metro and allied urban transport sectors. For this recruitment, DMIL is hiring staff for the O&M work of Chennai Metro Rail Limited Phase-II.

content_sections.text: The notice provides a 30% horizontal reservation for women candidates. Shortlisted candidates are placed on a panel, and the panel is used on a merit-cum-reservation basis, strictly according to the vacancies available. DMIL may increase, decrease, cancel, restrict or modify the requirement at any time. Selected candidates may be placed in any department, depending on the requirement and urgency of work. When signing the form, candidates also agree that they may be considered for either Supervisor/Operations or Supervisor/Maintenance, depending on their screening performance.
