The essential qualification is one of the following three-year regular diplomas, passed from a Government Polytechnic or Government Aided Polytechnic of the State of Tamil Nadu: Diploma in any field of Engineering Engineering Diploma in Civil stream Engineering Diploma in Electrical stream Engineering Diploma in Electronics, Computer Engg., Information Technology, Electronics & Communications, Electronics & Communications Industry Integrated, Electrical & Electronics, Electronics / Microprocessor, Electronics & Telecommunications, Instrumentation Technology, or Electronics and Instrumentation Engg. Engineering Diploma in Mechanical stream The aggregate marks in the diploma must not be below 60%. Candidates who passed from private polytechnics will not be considered. The polytechnic must be recognised by DTE, State of Tamil Nadu. Empanelled candidates must meet the medical standards set by the Corporation. Candidates who have had lasik surgery are not suitable for the post of Supervisor. For the full discipline-specific eligibility of the post, see the official notification.

Candidates who studied Tamil as a subject in the 10th standard do not have to take this test. A psycho test held in Chennai. It is qualifying only. Empanelment for 2 years from the date the Competent Authority approves the panel. Only candidates found suitable who pass the psycho test (if applicable) are empanelled. Pre-engagement medical examination. The Corporation pays for the first medical examination. If a candidate asks for a re-medical, the candidate pays for it. The medical standards are given on www.delhimetrorail.com . Verification of character and antecedents before engagement. Clearing any stage, or appearing in the final merit list, does not prove eligibility. Candidature stays provisional, and it may be checked before or after engagement.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: Nature of engagement: Contractual, with no claim to regularisation in the future. Tenure: The initial engagement is for 03 years. It can be cut short or renewed depending on satisfactory service. Pay: The consolidated pay includes all other benefits, such as accommodation, transport, medical, LTA, canteen and insurance. Taxes are deducted from it. Any allowances above the fixed pay are paid under the Rules of the Corporation. PF: The minimum PF under the Code on Social Security, 2020 is deducted from salary, and DMIL pays a matching contribution. The amount built up is paid when the contract ends. Training cost bond: Staff must serve at least three years, not counting any leave without pay. Anyone who leaves within 03 years has to repay the training cost for that position on a pro-rata basis. DMIL will tell staff the amount later. Leave: 08 days of Casual Leave on a pro-rata basis and 18 days of Earned Leave (1.5 EL for each completed month). Termination and resignation: DMIL can end the engagement with 30 days' notice without giving a reason. A candidate who resigns must give 30 days' advance notice or pay in lieu of notice. Place of work: CMRL Phase-II O&M work at Chennai.

content_sections.heading: About THSTI
content_sections.text: BRIC-Translational Health Science and Technology Institute (THSTI) is an institute of the Biotechnology Research and Innovation Council, Department of Biotechnology, Ministry of Science & Technology, Govt. of India. It is located in the NCR Biotech Science Cluster on the Faridabad-Gurugram Expressway in Faridabad. The institute carries out translational research and builds research collaborations to turn concepts into products that improve human health. Its centres include the Centre for Maternal and Child Health, the Centre for Tuberculosis Research, the Centre for Bio-design and Diagnostics and the Clinical Development Services Agency. All the posts in this notice are under research projects of BRIC-THSTI.

content_sections.heading: THSTI Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: Laboratory Operations & Instrumentation: Contributes to the establishment and operationalization of the bioanalytical laboratory, including development and implementation of analytical workflows, laboratory processes, and documentation systems. Operate, troubleshoot, and maintain LC-MS/MS and HPLC systems to ensure reliable analytical performance. Support instrument qualification, calibration, preventive maintenance, and performance verification of laboratory equipment. Maintain accurate laboratory records and ensure adherence to laboratory safety and good documentation practices. Provide routine supervision and technical guidance to junior analysts and laboratory staff. Oversee the maintenance of reference standards, reagent inventory, logbooks and lab notebooks. Bioanalytical Method Development & Validation: Prepare method development, validation, and analytical protocols for new projects after required literature search. Develop, optimize, and validate LC-MS/MS and HPLC methods for quantification of metabolites in biological matrices (e.g., plasma, serum, tissues). Generate analytical summaries, concentration datasets, and bioanalytical study reports in compliance with laboratory quality systems. Familiarity with common laboratory techniques, including gel electrophoresis, molecular assays, and serological assays. Experience in handling small animals, histopathology. Experience in isolating PBMCs and working knowledge of FACS. Familiarity with common laboratory techniques, including gel electrophoresis, molecular assays (PCR, rt-PCR), and serological assays (ELISA, multiplex antibody detection assays), Gene cloning, protein expression. Candidates having work experience in a BSL-3 (Biosafety Level 3) laboratory environment will be preferred. Preparation of recombinant plasmids. Preparation and culturing of Mycobacterium tuberculosis strains in the BSL-3 laboratory. Setting up biochemical, immunological and cell-based assays. Conduct laboratory tests, experiments, and analyses in support of SiB program objectives. Collaborate with researchers and scientists to perform various technical tasks. Maintain accurate records of experiments, data, and results. Ensure compliance with safety and quality standards in the laboratory. Provide support in the development and implementation of research protocols. To assist in any other works like fields/site visits related to projects or other scientific/ technical activities. Conducting/ handling pre-clinical animal studies, expert in cell culture, performing immunological Assays, FACS, Cell sorting etc., data analysis and report writing. Hands-on Experience in conducting/ handling animal studies, cell culture, molecular biology, microbiology, FACS and report writing.

content_sections.text: The District Health Society, Sivagangai works under the National Health Mission – Tamil Nadu. These posts are for its National Tuberculosis Elimination Programme team. The District TB Officer directs the Radiographers' work, and the team runs from the District TB Centre on the Old Government Head Quarters Hospital Campus in Sivaganga.

content_sections.text: Candidates must be below 45 years of age. BSc in Radiography / Diploma in Radiography. Only residents of Sivaganga District are eligible to apply. Candidates who have relevant experience must send their experience certificate with the application. For the full eligibility conditions of the post, see the official notification.

content_sections.heading: Roles and Responsibilities
content_sections.text: Take chest X-rays for TB screening with handheld or mobile X-ray equipment, following the set protocols, radiation safety standards and infection prevention practices. Provide X-ray services during Active Case Finding (ACF), Passive Case Finding (PCF), outreach activities, screening camps, health melas and special drives, as the District TB Officer (DTO) directs. Label X-ray images correctly and upload or transfer them on time through the designated digital platform so they can be read and acted on. Work with Medical Officers, STS, STLS, TB Health Visitors and other field staff on referral, sputum or sample collection and follow-up of people identified as presumptive TB. Keep accurate records and send daily reports to the DTO or NTEP district team: people screened, X-rays taken, activity location and type, presumptive TB cases, referrals and other indicators. Maintain the X-ray equipment, keep it ready for use and report any malfunction, damage, shortage or technical problem straight away. Help the DTO plan and map X-ray-based TB screening activities, and help validate, reconcile and report screening data. Attend NTEP training, review meetings and monitoring activities, and follow the technical, radiation safety, confidentiality and patient privacy rules. Coordinate with the three Directorates at district level and with Block Medical Officers to plan and run camps. Operate HHX Ray units in Active Case Finding campaigns among high-risk and hard-to-reach populations, and make sure screened people are linked to diagnosis and treatment services. Do any other TB screening, diagnosis and case-finding work that the District TB Officer or District Health Officer assigns.

content_sections.heading: AUD Psychotherapist Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: M.A. in Psychology with at least 55% marks or an equivalent GPA from a recognized university. M.Phil in Clinical Psychology / M.Phil in Psychoanalytic Psychotherapy / M.Phil in Psychotherapy and Clinical Thinking, or post-master's training, degree or diploma with specialization in psychotherapy, clinical practice or counselling. At least two years of experience in clinical practice / psychotherapeutic work and/or counselling in the field of mental health, at public or private institutions, universities, hospitals, clinics or NGOs. Internships done as part of an academic programme do not count as valid work experience. You must hold the essential qualifications as on the closing date of application. Ph.D. in Clinical Psychology / PsyD (Doctor of Psychology) / Ph.D. with demonstrable interest in psychodynamic and psychoanalytical work. Experience in teaching and supervising trainee counsellors, psychotherapists or clinical psychologists. Evidence of research or publications in psychotherapy or clinical practice. Well-developed sensitivity, empathy, regard and in-depth understanding of the human psyche. For the full eligibility conditions of the post, see the official notification.

content_sections.heading: Job Description
content_sections.text: Psychometric screening of first-year batches of all programmes to identify psychologically vulnerable students, through a Mentor-Mentee System, a Buddy System and other preventive mechanisms. Psychotherapy and clinical counselling for students. Clinical supervision, administrative and organisational work, and community mental health work. Intellectual and practice-based processes and activities. Adopting and implementing a uniform mental health policy, drawing on the UMMEED Draft Guidelines, the MANODARPAN initiative and the National Suicide Prevention Strategy. Consistent, informal and confidential support to students, especially during examinations and academic transitions. Protocols for immediate referral to mental health services, local hospitals and suicide prevention helplines. Training teaching and non-teaching staff in psychological first aid, spotting warning signs, responding to self-harm and making referrals. Training teaching, non-teaching and administrative staff to work with students from vulnerable and marginalised backgrounds in a sensitive, inclusive and non-discriminatory way. Confidential, accessible mechanisms for reporting, redressing and preventing sexual assault, harassment, ragging and bullying on the basis of caste, class, gender, sexual orientation, disability, religion or ethnicity, and psycho-social support to victims. Sensitisation programmes (physical and/or online) for parents and guardians on student mental health. Adding mental health literacy, emotional regulation, life skills and awareness of support services to orientation programmes and co-curricular activities. Keeping anonymised records and preparing an annual report on wellness interventions, referrals, training sessions and mental health activities. Regular career counselling for students and parents that is inclusive and sensitive to socio-economic and psychological contexts, plus structured academic planning and mechanisms for monitoring and accountability. Any other duties assigned by the Competent Authority.

Essential: First class Bachelor's degree with 6 years of experience in relevant area, OR Post Graduate with 4 years relevant experience. Desirable: Experience in Establishment Matters, Finance and Accounts, Audit, RTI, Stores and Purchase, Administration, Academic matters, Legal matters etc. in Central Government/State Government/Central Govt. Autonomous Bodies/Central University/CFTIs/IITs/NITs/IIITs etc. Essential: Degree in Engineering in relevant field with 02 years experience, OR Diploma in Engineering with 05 years experience. Desirable: Experience in civil engineering works in Central Government/State Government/Central Govt. Autonomous Bodies/Central University/CFTIs/IITs/NITs/IIITs etc. The notice lists building construction and maintenance, estimation and costing, BOQ and quantity surveying, site supervision, infrastructure development, water supply and sanitation, STP/drainage systems, preparation and interpretation of drawings, contract/work management, quality control, CPWD/PWD specifications, horticulture, basic plumbing and carpentry maintenance, and campus infrastructure maintenance. Essential: Degree in Engineering in relevant field with 02 years experience, OR Diploma in Engineering with 05 years experience. Desirable: Experience in the same types of government bodies listed above. The notice names electrical installation and maintenance, LT/HT distribution systems, transformers, substations, DG sets, UPS and power backup systems, electrical panels and cabling, lighting, earthing, fire alarm/ELV systems, central air-conditioning and HVAC systems, VRF/VRV systems, chillers, AHUs, FCUs, cooling towers, ventilation, ducting, pumps, thermostats and associated control systems, estimation and costing, electrical safety, statutory compliance, contract/work management, and campus electrical infrastructure maintenance. Your qualifications must come from a recognised Board, University or Institute. If you claim an equivalent qualification, you must show proof at document verification. If your university has no CGPA conversion formula or definition of First Class, 60% marks or 6.5 CGPA counts as First Class. Only full-time experience counts, and any single period shorter than six months is ignored. Experience certificates must be on official letterhead, signed by the Competent Authority, and must show your designation and pay level or pay. Qualifications and experience are counted as on the last date of online submission. SC, ST, OBC-NCL, PwBD and Ex-Servicemen candidates get relaxation as per Government of India norms for reserved posts. Contractual and outsourced employees of IIIT Pune get relaxation equal to their continuous service in an equivalent post

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: A Screening Committee checks every application. If it asks you for more documents or clarifications, you get three working days to send them. The provisional shortlist is posted on the Institute website, and you then have three working days to raise any grievance by email. Admit cards are sent through the portal or to your registered email, usually at least 21 days before the exam. All tests are held at IIIT Pune, Talegaon, and no TA/DA is paid. Domain Knowledge covers the Constitution and government machinery, the Manual of Office Procedure, FRSR, reservation rules, CCS (Leave, CCA, Conduct, Pension) rules, pay fixation, TA and LTC rules, NPS, GPF, GFR 2017, GeM and CPPP, the RTI, RTE, GST, POSH and Arbitration Acts, NEP 2020, ranking frameworks, Sustainable Development Goals, and e-management systems (Samarth, e-Office, IT Act). The Civil syllabus covers building materials, concrete technology, building construction, estimating and valuation, contracts, surveying, geotechnical, transportation, environmental and structural engineering, RCC design and GFR (Works). The Electrical syllabus covers basic concepts, measuring instruments, electrical machines, generation, transmission and distribution, estimation and costing, contracts, utilisation of electrical energy, HVAC, solid waste management and GFR (Works). Every wrong answer in Stage-I loses 1/4 mark. Up to 8 times the number of advertised posts may be shortlisted for Stage-II. The Institute may shortlist more strictly, for example by higher qualifications, more relevant experience, or experience in government bodies. Ties are broken in this order: higher Domain Knowledge marks, then more relevant experience in a Govt. institution, then the older candidate, then alphabetical order of first name. A waitlist panel may be kept for one year.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IIIT Pune Junior Superintendent and Junior Engineer Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Go to the IIIT Pune E-Samarth recruitment portal and create a login ID and password. Fill in every field, upload your documents, and save your progress as you go. Pay the fee online and submit the form. Write down your E-Samarth Form No.; enquiries about lost numbers are not answered. Print the submitted form, the uploaded documents and the fee receipt. Number every page, sign and self-attest them, and arrange them in the Annexure-IV order: Cover Page/Index first, then the fee receipt, then the signed form, then your supporting documents. On the envelope, write "Application for the post of ______" and "E-Samarth Form No. ______". Send it to The Registrar, Indian Institute of Information Technology Pune, PO - Talegaon, Pune, Maharashtra - 410507, so it arrives by 09 December 2026, 05:30 PM. The Institute is not responsible for postal delays. Once submitted, the online form cannot be changed. Report portal problems to [email protected] . Your form must also give two references, preferably including your most recent employer if you are working. Cover Page/Index and fee receipt Application form, signed on every page, with a recent passport-size photograph Class X certificate showing your date of birth, and Class XII certificate with mark-sheet UG/PG degree or Ph.D. certificate, as applicable, and mark-sheets for every year or semester SC/ST certificate, or an OBC-NCL/EWS certificate in Central Government format valid for the current financial year NOC from your current employer, if applicable, and experience certificates Photo ID: Aadhaar, Passport, Driving Licence or Voter ID Documents cannot be added after the last date. At the Written Test/JoPT, bring all original documents and a signed PDF copy of your online form.

faq.question: Q1. Is a diploma holder eligible for the IIIT Pune Junior Engineer posts?
faq.answer: Yes. You need a Diploma in Engineering with 05 years experience. With a Degree in Engineering in the relevant field, 02 years of experience is enough.

faq.question: Q2. How many Junior Superintendent vacancies are there for each category?
faq.answer: There are six: UR-3, OBC-NCL-2 and SC-1. The Junior Engineer (Civil) and Junior Engineer (Electrical) posts have one UR vacancy each.

faq.answer: If your university does not define First Class or give a conversion formula, 60% marks or 6.5 CGPA is treated as First Class.

faq.answer: For Junior Engineer posts, yes: Stage-I (50) and JoPT (50) are added to make 100. For Junior Superintendent, the JoPT is only qualifying at 50%, and merit is based on the 100-mark written exam.

faq.answer: Up to 5 years, for regular employees with at least 3 years of continuous regular service in the same line or an allied cadre. Contractual or outsourced staff at IIIT Pune get relaxation equal to their service there, up to 10 years.

faq.answer: Yes, but each post needs its own application and fee. For example, a UR candidate pays ₹1,180 per post.

content_sections.heading: Udupi Cochin Shipyard Selection Process
content_sections.text: The selection process comprises Phase I (Offline Written test consisting of an Objective Type Test for 40 Marks and a Descriptive Type Test for 40 Marks) and Phase II (Power Point presentation on work experience for 20 Marks). The objective type test is of 45 minutes duration with 40 total questions carrying one mark each. There is no negative marking. The structure is detailed below: The descriptive type written test carries 40 marks and is of 90 minutes duration, comprising discipline-related questions. For Unreserved posts, candidates must secure a minimum of 50% of total marks. For ST candidates, the minimum pass mark is 40% of total marks. Shortlisted candidates attend Phase II, which is a PowerPoint presentation of not more than 10 minutes highlighting their work experience.

Go through the User Manual and FAQ before filling out the online application. Complete the One-time Registration in the SAP Online portal. Fill in the application form with accurate details and exact percentage of marks. Upload required certificates for proof of age, educational qualification, experience, caste, disability, and a recent passport-size color photograph. Pay the non-refundable application fee of ₹ 400/- online using Debit card, Credit card, or Internet Banking (if applicable). Submit the application and ensure the application status shows "In process". Download and retain a soft copy or printout of the online application containing the unique registration number generated by the system.

content_sections.heading: IIT Tirupati Job Description
content_sections.text: Communication and Analytics Manager Build and document data pipelines (ETL) that consolidate data from MIS, ERP, HR, academic and finance systems into an analytical layer. Integrate and maintain academic and administrative datasets of the Institute. Develop and maintain dashboards and periodic reports for institutional decision-making covering academic performance and programme outcomes. Prepare data submissions and analyses for statutory and ranking exercises (NIRF, AISHE, QS, THE, AICTE) and reporting. Design and execute exploratory and confirmatory analyses to answer specific questions. Any other relevant task assigned by the Advisor/ Dean (CDO) from time to time. Junior Multimedia Specialist Assist in the creation of multimedia content for the Institute, including posters, brochures, social-media creatives, event publicity materials, photography, videography, and basic video editing for official communication channels. Support the Communication and Analytics Manager in managing digital content archives, data collection, and assisting in the scheduling and dissemination of content across social media platforms.

faq.question: Q1. Which engineering branch has the most apprentice seats at BDL Bhanur?
faq.answer: Mechanical Engineering has the most: 40 Graduate seats and 34 Diploma seats. ECE comes next, with 30 Graduate and 15 Diploma seats.

faq.question: Q2. Are there seats for Civil Engineering graduates?
faq.answer: No. Civil Engineering has no Graduate seats. It has 2 seats for Diploma Apprentices only.

faq.question: Q3. I passed my B.Tech in 2022. Can I apply?
faq.answer: No. The notice is open only to candidates who passed in Nov-2023, 2024, 2025 or 2026.

faq.question: Q4. Can I apply if I have already done an apprenticeship or have work experience?
faq.answer: No. You cannot apply if you have done or are doing apprenticeship training under the Apprentices (Amendment) Act 1973, or if you have one year or more of experience.

faq.question: Q5. Is there a written test?
faq.answer: No. Candidates are shortlisted by their marks in the essential qualification, category-wise. Shortlisted candidates are then called for certificate verification, where selected candidates get a Preliminary Offer Letter.

faq.question: Q6. What happens if I don't enter my percentage on the NATS portal?
faq.answer: Your application will not be considered. You must fill in the "% of marks / CGPA x 10" column and upload your provisional certificate or consolidated marks sheet.

faq.question: Q7. Why does the notice say to enrol early?
faq.answer: The NATS portal takes about 2 to 3 days to generate a registration number, and the last date for enrolment is 7 November 2026, three days before the last date to apply.

faq.question: Q8. Will BDL pay travel costs for certificate verification?
faq.answer: No. No TA/DA is paid for certificate verification or joining, and boarding and lodging costs are not paid either.

content_sections.heading: About TNPDCL
content_sections.text: Tamil Nadu Power Distribution Corporation Ltd is a power distribution company. Its Chief Engineer - Personnel works in Chennai. The Board of Apprenticeship Training, Southern Region (BOAT (SR)), Chennai, runs this apprenticeship programme with TNPDCL.

content_sections.heading: TNPDCL Diploma Apprentice Vacancy Details 2026
content_sections.text: Training lasts one year in every discipline. TNPDCL can increase or decrease the number of vacancies, whatever figure the notification gives. Reservation for SC/ST/OBC (NCL)/PwD follows the guidelines under the Apprentices Act. If you claim reservation, you must provide a certificate in the Government standard format. Without it, you will be treated as a 'General' category candidate. BC/MBC candidates who claim the OBC (Non-creamy layer) category must bring an OBC (NCL) certificate in the approved format from the certificate issuing authority. Up to 10% of the vacancies are reserved (horizontal reservation) for wards of regular (permanent) employees of TNEB LIMITED / TNPDCL / TNPGCL / TNGECL / TANTRANSCO. Wards of contract, temporary, casual or retired employees cannot use this quota. Ward quota places that are not filled will go to other available candidates under the usual procedures.

content_sections.heading: TNPDCL Diploma Apprentice Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: Age limit: As per the Apprenticeship Rules. Domicile and year of passing: You must be from Tamil Nadu and must have passed your engineering diploma in 2022, 2023, 2024, 2025 or May 2026. Minimum educational qualification (Category - I Technician (Diploma) Apprentices), any one of: A Diploma in Engineering or Technology (Regular - Full time) in the relevant discipline, granted by a State Council or Board of Technical Education set up by a State Government. A Diploma in Engineering or Technology (Regular - Full time) in the relevant discipline, granted by a University. A Diploma in Engineering and Technology granted by an institution that the State Government or Central Government recognises as equivalent to the above. Candidates with higher qualifications (B.E / B.Tech. and above) are not wanted for Diploma Apprentice selection. Previous training or experience: You cannot apply if you have already done, or are now doing, an apprenticeship under NATS 2.0 / NAPS (Apprenticeship (Amendment) Act 1973) or PMIS Internship Training. You also cannot apply if you have one year or more of work experience. Physical standards: As set out in Clause 4 of the Apprenticeship Rule 1992 and any later amendments. See the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Shortlisting: BOAT (SR) draws up a shortlist from the online application data. It is based on your percentage of marks in the basic qualification for your discipline. Intimation: Shortlisted candidates are told by email, at the email address they registered on the portal. Certificate verification: Shortlisted candidates must attend certificate verification at the TNPDCL office. The shortlist goes up on nats.education.gov.in . To find it, go to the bottom of the home page, then Regional Events, then BOAT (Southern Region), then Apprenticeship News. The notice asks students to check there every day.

content_sections.heading: Training Conditions
content_sections.text: Training lasts one year, as per the Apprenticeship (Amendment) Act 1973. When the apprenticeship ends, TNPDCL (TNEB LIMITED / TNPDCL / TNPGCL / TNGECL / TANTRANSCO) has no obligation to offer you a job. Finishing the apprenticeship does not give you a right to employment. No TA / DA is paid for attending certificate verification, and no boarding or lodging expenses are paid. Incomplete or wrong online applications, and applications received after the due date, will be rejected. No further communication about them will be entertained. Canvassing or putting pressure through any source will disqualify you. Your name will be removed from the records without notice. BOAT (SR) has not authorised any person or organisation to coordinate or liaise its work, so beware of touts.

It handles every stage of a nuclear power reactor in India, from site selection, design and construction through operation, maintenance, life extension, waste management and decommissioning. This intake is for the Narora Atomic Power Station plant site in Narora, Bulandshahr district, Uttar Pradesh (PIN 203389).

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Eligible local candidates living within 16 km of Narora Atomic Power Station get first preference, subject to the reservation rules. If there are not enough eligible local candidates in a category, candidates from outside the area are considered on merit. The shortlist is based on the percentage of marks in the respective trade or discipline. If two candidates have the same percentage, the one born earlier ranks higher. If the date of birth is also the same, the candidate with the higher Matriculation (10th) percentage ranks higher. Candidates graded in CGPA, GPA, SGPA or letter grades must submit the conversion table issued by their institute. If the institute has no conversion formula, NPCIL uses the following equivalents:

content_sections.heading: Training Conditions
content_sections.text: Place of training: Narora Atomic Power Station, Narora, PO NAPS Township, Distt. Bulandshahr, Uttar Pradesh - 203389. Duration: a maximum of 12 months for all three types of apprentice. Each apprentice signs a contract of apprenticeship with NPCIL under the Apprentices Act, 1961 and the Apprenticeship Rules, 1992. The contract ends when the training period ends. Apprentices who stay away from training may have to refund the whole cost of their training, meaning the stipend received, as decided by the Central Apprenticeship Advisor. NAPS is a highly protected area, so apprentices are engaged only after they submit a Police Verification Certificate issued by the District Police Authorities. No hostel or transport is provided. NPCIL is not obliged to offer a job to anyone who completes the training, and apprentices are not obliged to accept one. Completing the apprenticeship gives no right to claim a job at NPCIL. Management may cancel or change the number of seats in any trade or discipline, or cancel the whole process, without giving reasons. Seats may stay unfilled if there are not enough suitable candidates.

content_sections.heading: About CSIR-CMERI CoEFM
content_sections.text: The CSIR-CMERI Centre of Excellence for Farm Machinery was set up in 1965 as an extension centre of the Central Mechanical Engineering Research Institute, Durgapur. It works under the Council of Scientific & Industrial Research (CSIR), an autonomous body under the Ministry of Science & Technology, Government of India. The centre is on Gill Road, Ludhiana, and its current research priority is Smart Farm Machines and Technologies.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Candidates are selected by a walk-in interview before a Selection Committee. They can choose Hindi or English as the language for the interview. The selection process may continue until late evening or into the next day. Candidates who do not meet the eligibility criteria at any stage, during the process or later, will have their candidature cancelled without any reason being given. The decision of CSIR-CMERI on selection is final, and no correspondence will be entertained.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: The engagement is for project work in R&D projects at the centre's laboratories, and it is co-terminus with the project. The tenure shown for each post may be extended or curtailed. It lasts until the project ends or the requirement ends, whichever is earlier, and never beyond a maximum of six years. Offers of engagement depend on the availability of funds and approval by the Competent Authority. No TA/DA is paid for attending the walk-in interview.

content_sections.heading: About SAIL Bokaro Steel Plant
content_sections.text: Bokaro Steel Plant in Bokaro, Jharkhand, is a plant of Steel Authority of India Limited (SAIL). The notice describes SAIL as a Maharatna Public Sector Enterprise and India's leading steel-making company. Bokaro General Hospital (BGH), where these doctors will work, is a 910-bedded multispecialty hospital run by SAIL.

content_sections.heading: SAIL Bokaro Specialist and GDMO Vacancy Details 2026
content_sections.text: B stands for backlog. Vacancies reserved for Persons with Benchmark Disabilities are included within these numbers; the official notice gives the break-up. Post-paid CUG SIM, covering monthly call charges, rental and taxes up to Rs. 350 a month for MBBS doctors and Rs. 500 a month for MBBS doctors with a PG Diploma or Degree in a speciality. Non-SAIL doctors can take company accommodation (2 BHK or equivalent) on payment if they want it, subject to availability. Rent, electricity and water are charged at the rates SAIL employees pay for that category of quarter. Former SAIL employees up to E-7 grade may keep their allotted company accommodation during the engagement, subject to availability, by paying the rent, electricity and water charges. Former employees above E-7 grade, or those holding designated or earmarked accommodation, can only be considered for the accommodation an E-7 executive gets. Medical benefits: former SAIL employees keep the medical benefits they already have as ex-employees. Other doctors get medical benefits for themselves and their spouse at the unit hospital only, and only if their previous organisation does not provide them. No referrals to outside hospitals are allowed. 10 days of leave a year, with prior approval. Maternity leave is given under the Maternity Benefit Act, 1961. No HRA is paid.

content_sections.heading: SAIL Bokaro Specialist and GDMO Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: Registration (all posts): registered with the Medical Council of India (MCI), National Medical Commission (NMC) or a State Medical Council (SMC), or holding a valid practitioner licence and enrolled in the State Register or National Register (as applicable). Candidates must be Indian nationals. Preferred: relevant work experience. Qualification and experience are counted as on 27 October 2026. Ex-employees: former employees of SAIL plants and units, other PSUs and Government can apply as long as they did not leave through voluntary retirement. They must give a self-certificate saying so. Check the official notification for the full eligibility for each discipline.

content_sections.heading: Job Description
content_sections.text: The doctors will work in different departments of Medical and Health Services (M&HS) as needed and do the work assigned to them. The minimum is 8 hours a day, six days a week, or 48 hours a week. Doctors who work fewer hours are paid on a pro-rata basis, and the monthly rate cannot go above the maximum for their category.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Walk-in interview. Medical screening. The engagement starts as soon as selection is complete and engagement orders are issued. All certificates are checked only at the walk-in interview, and candidates who cannot produce them will not be interviewed. BSL may engage fewer doctors than advertised, reject any application or cancel the whole process without giving a reason.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: The first engagement is for one year or until the doctor turns 70, whichever comes first. The Company may extend it one year at a time, up to a maximum of 3 years under the same contract. Re-engagement is allowed, within the age limit. Performance is reviewed every year. Based on that review, the tenure may be cut short or extended. Either side can end the contract with one month's notice. The company can end it for poor performance, moral turpitude, conviction by a court, insolvency, loss of licence to practise, grave misconduct or financial irregularity, or long-term medical unfitness. The engagement is purely on a contractual basis and gives no right to regular appointment in BSL. Any dispute falls under the jurisdiction of the courts at Bokaro Steel City, Jharkhand.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for SAIL Bokaro Specialist and GDMO Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Download the application form (Annexure-I) from the official notification. Fill every field in CAPITAL LETTERS. Paste a recent passport-size colour photograph and sign across it. Go to the Office of the ED (M&HS), Bokaro General Hospital, Bokaro, Jharkhand-827004, on 12 November 2026. Registration runs from 9:30 AM to 2:00 PM. Hand in the filled form with your supporting documents at the walk-in interview. No other way of applying is accepted. Documents to bring (originals and one set of self-attested photocopies): Filled application form (Annexure-I) with one extra recent passport-size colour photograph Pass certificates and mark sheets for your educational qualifications Experience certificate from the employer showing relevant post-qualification experience, if any. Retired employees bring a service certificate from their parent organisation. Proof of date of birth (Matriculation certificate) Valid registration certificate from SMC/MCI/NMC Photo ID proof (Voter ID, PAN, Aadhar Card, Driving License or Passport) OBC (non-creamy layer) or EWS certificate in the prescribed format, issued on or after 01.04.2026 and valid on the interview date Self-certificate for ex-employees saying they did not leave through voluntary retirement No TA/DA is paid for attending the interview. Giving false information can lead to rejection at any stage, even after selection. For questions, write to [email protected] .

content_sections.heading: About AIIMS Nagpur
content_sections.text: AIIMS Nagpur describes itself as an apex healthcare institute set up by the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, Government of India, under the Pradhan Mantri Swasthya Suraksha Yojana (PMSSY). It aims to correct regional imbalances in quality tertiary-level healthcare and to make the country self-sufficient in graduate and postgraduate medical education and training. The institute is located at Plot No. 02, Sector-20, MIHAN, Nagpur – 441124.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Only Indian nationals can apply. Qualifications are counted as on the last date of submission of the application. The age limit for every post is "Upto 40 years". Age means completed age in years as on the last date of submission of the application. Reservation is as per Government of India rules. Essential: B.Sc in Nuclear Medicine Technology from recognized university/institution. Or B.Sc in life sciences with post graduate diploma in Nuclear Medicine [Diploma in Medical Radio-Isotope Techniques (DMRIT)/Diploma in Nuclear Medicine Technology (DNMT)/Diploma in Fusion Imaging Technology (DFIT)]. Desirable: Experience in full-fledged Nuclear Medicine Centre having PET/CT, Gamma camera/SPECT/CT and radionuclide therapy will be preferred. Essential: M.Sc Nuclear medicine technology from recognized university/institution. 5 years of experience as Nuclear Medicine technologist (B.Sc Nuclear Medicine or equivalent + 5 years experience). Desirable: RSO level II certification. Experience in full-fledged Nuclear Medicine Centre having PET/CT, Gamma camera/SPECT/CT and radionuclide therapy will be preferred. Essential: M.Sc Nuclear Medicine Technology from recognized university/institution with 60% marks. Or M.Sc with minimum 60% marks from a recognized university/institution with post graduate diploma in Nuclear Medicine [Diploma in Medical Radio-Isotope Techniques (DMRIT)/Diploma in Nuclear Medicine Technology (DNMT)/Diploma in Fusion Imaging Technology (DFIT)] with minimum 50% marks. Experience required: 02 years' experience. Experience in full-fledged Nuclear Medicine Centre having PET/CT, Gamma camera/SPECT/CT and radionuclide therapy will be preferred. Desirable: RSO level II certification. PhD in Nuclear medicine specialty. The notice says the prescribed qualifications are only the minimum: having them does not by itself entitle a candidate to an interview or to selection. The candidate must not have been convicted by any Court of Law. For the full discipline-specific eligibility of each post, check the official notification.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: Each post pays a consolidated monthly amount as shown in the vacancy table. The pay does not increase during the contract period. The emoluments are consolidated, as decided by the competent authority. The appointee does not get Provident Fund, Pension, Gratuity, Medical Attendance Treatment, Seniority, Promotion or any other benefit given to regular Government servants. The appointee also cannot claim allowances or facilities given to the regular/permanent faculty of AIIMS Nagpur. If extra duties are assigned, no additional allowance is paid for them. Paid leave may be allowed at 01 day for each completed month of service. The appointment is purely on contract for 11 (Eleven) Months, counted from the date of joining. It ends earlier if regular appointments are made against these posts or another arrangement is made. The contract may be extended, depending on the institute's needs and satisfactory performance. If it is not extended, it lapses automatically. The job cannot be regularized at any stage, and the appointee has no claim or right to regular appointment to any post of AIIMS Nagpur. Either side can end the appointment at any time with one month's notice or one month's salary. It can also be ended if the appointee fails to complete the first three months to the satisfaction of the competent authority. The competent authority can also terminate it before the end of the tenure without giving a reason. The appointment is whole-time. The appointee cannot take any other assignment, paid or unpaid, and private practice of any kind is prohibited. An appointee who applies elsewhere or resigns within the first 03 (three) months will not get a No Objection Certificate, a Relieving Letter or an Experience Certificate. Appointment depends on medical fitness, certified by the competent medical board. On appointment, the appointee must take an oath of allegiance to the Constitution of India or make a solemn affirmation. No TA/DA is paid for attending the interview or written test, or for joining.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for AIIMS Nagpur Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Get the prescribed application form from the AIIMS Nagpur website (aiimsnagpur.edu.in). If you are a General/OBC/EWS candidate, pay the non-refundable fee of Rs. 1,000/- by NEFT into the bank account below. PwBD/SC/ST candidates are exempted from the fee. Fill in the application form and attach self-attested copies of all relevant certificates, testimonials and other documents. Send the application, the copy of the payment receipt and the certificate copies through the Google form (forms.gle/6YFqwBs9umvivtgs5). Make sure the application reaches AIIMS Nagpur by 05:00 PM on 10 November 2026. Incomplete applications will be summarily rejected. Documents named in the notice: Application in the prescribed format Copy of the fee payment receipt (also "may bring" it to the interview) Self-attested copies of all relevant certificates/testimonials and other relevant documents All relevant original documents, for verification before the interview No Objection Certificate at the time of interview, for candidates working in Central/State Government, Semi Government or an Autonomous body (without it, the candidature may be rejected) For help or clarification, email [email protected] and put the name of the post you applied for in the subject line, or call 07103-295590.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Selection is based on shortlisting, scrutiny of applications with document verification, and an interview. If a large number of applications is received, a screening test may be held to shortlist candidates for interview. Shortlisting: Candidates are shortlisted for interview on the basis of educational qualification, relevant experience and/or shortlisting criteria decided by the Executive Director, AIIMS Nagpur. Scrutiny and document verification: Before the interview, a duly constituted committee checks each application and verifies documents for qualification, experience, category, age and so on. Only candidates declared eligible after this check can appear for the interview. Interview: The interview will be held at AIIMS Nagpur, or at another place and in another mode if the Executive Director decides so. Candidates must score the minimum qualifying marks (suitability standard) set by the Selection Committee to be placed on the merit panel. Candidates below this standard will not be selected, whatever their merit position. Appearing for the interview does not give anyone a right to selection. The notice says this selection procedure is indicative and may be changed at the discretion of the Executive Director, AIIMS Nagpur. The decision of the Competent Authority on selection is final, and no representations will be entertained.

Choose your sector and your specialisations. The application allows you to select more than one.

Download the "Prescribed CV format" (Annexure-II) from the "Advertisement and CV format" box on the same page and fill it in.
Upload the filled CV with your online application.
Upload an updated CV in the prescribed "Detailed Curriculum Vitae" format (Annexure-II). The format asks for:
Name of Expert, and Specialisation/Applied For
Category (GEN/OBC/SC/ST)

content_sections.heading: About IIM Mumbai
content_sections.text: Indian Institute of Management Mumbai is a management institute at Vihar Lake Rd, Powai, Mumbai - 400087. The Junior Sports Associates will support the sports and fitness activities of the Institute, including its intra-institute events, tournaments and competitions.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The notice lists the following under "Minimum Qualifications & Experience": Bachelor's Degree in any discipline from a recognized University/Institution. Diploma in Sports Management or related field will be desirable. Candidates with relevant experience in sports activities, event coordination or sports administration will be preferred. Participation/experience in organizing sports events, tournaments or competitions. Working knowledge of MS Office, Excel and other basic computer applications. Basic knowledge of social media and digital communication platforms. Preference will be given to persons with work experience in the relevant field. Strong written and verbal communication skills. Experience in any Government/ Semi-Government/ Autonomous/PSU/Private sector in the sporting domain shall be considered. Candidates who have participated in national and international level Olympic Sports Disciplines would be given preference. Knowledge of IT, software applications and social media. The age limit is "Upto 45 years (preferably)". The notice does not print an "as on" date for age. Notice condition 23 says the selection criteria may be relaxed for exceptionally deserving candidates. Candidates from the NC OBC, SC/ST and PwD categories must produce a valid Caste/Category certificate to support their reservation category. The applicable Central Government list as on the last date of application is binding. These candidates must upload valid documents signed by the competent authority. No request to change the category applied for will be entertained. See the official notification for the full eligibility requirements for the Junior Sports Associate post.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: Monthly emoluments: ₹30,000 - ₹35,000 per month (consolidated). Out of Campus Allowance (OCA): ₹3,500 per month. Mobile reimbursement: ₹350 per month. Mode of engagement: fixed-term contract through an Institute contract or an Institute empaneled outsourcing agency. Selected candidates may be hired through an outsourcing agency empaneled by the Institute. Period: initially 01 year. The term can be extended as per the Institute requirement, subject to satisfactory performance and the needs of the Institute. Performance review: performance is reviewed every year and is also evaluated after three months of joining. Continuation in the role depends on meeting performance benchmarks. Nature of the post: purely contractual. Candidates will have no right to claim regularization or absorption in the Institute. Work schedule: six days per week (Saturday, Sunday and four weekdays). Sunday off in lieu: one day off in lieu of Sunday, taken on Tuesday, Wednesday or Thursday of the following week. Casual leave: 1.5 days per month. Working hours: 0600 HRs to 1200 Hrs / 1630 Hrs to 2230 Hrs (Shift Duty).

content_sections.heading: IIM Mumbai Junior Sports Associate Job Description
content_sections.text: Assist in the day-to-day conduct of sports and fitness activities of the Institute. Assist in organizing intra-institute sports events, tournaments and competitions. Coordinate with students and participants regarding sports schedules, registrations and event requirements. Assist coaches and sports personnel in conducting training sessions and sports programmes. Assist in maintaining sports equipment, facilities and inventory records. Support arrangements for transportation, venues, equipment and other logistics for sports events. Maintain attendance, participation records and basic documentation related to sports activities. Assist in preparation of reports, schedules, notices and other sports-related documents. Assist in promoting sports activities through appropriate communication and social media platforms. Perform any other duties related to sports activities as assigned by the Institute.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IIM Mumbai Junior Sports Associate
content_sections.text: Submit the application form online at https://iimmumbai.ac.in/careers on or before 16 November 2026 (5:00 pm). No other mode of application will be entertained. Incomplete applications, or applications without proper supporting documents, will be summarily rejected. Valid Caste/Category certificate signed by the competent authority, uploaded with the application (NC-OBC, SC, ST and PwD candidates only). Proper supporting documents for the application. A correct e-mail ID. All correspondence, including written test or interview call letters, is sent only to the e-mail ID the candidate gives.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Meeting the eligibility criteria does not guarantee that a candidate will be shortlisted for the interview. The Institute may limit the number of shortlisted candidates to a reasonable number based on higher qualifications and/or experience. Selection stages: selection will be through an interview or any other test/selection process that the Institute considers appropriate, for shortlisted candidates only. Depending on the number and quality of applications, the Institute may decide to hold a skill test and/or interview and/or any other test. Information for shortlisted candidates: shortlisted candidates will be told about the selection process separately. The interview date will be sent later to shortlisted candidates through email ONLY. Documents at the interview: bring all original Certificates, Degrees and other documents for your educational qualification, professional qualification, work experience, age etc. for verification, along with one set of photocopies of these documents.

how_to_apply: Candidates must apply online through the O.T.R. based system. Applications sent through any other medium are not accepted. The online application is completed in four stages.
It is mandatory to complete One Time Registration (O.T.R.) and obtain an O.T.R. number before applying.
Candidates without an O.T.R. number must obtain it from https://otr.pariksha.nic.in at least 72 hours before submitting the online application.
Only after obtaining the O.T.R. number can a candidate apply through https://uppsc.up.nic.in.

First Stage: On the Commission's website, click "ALL NOTIFICATIONS/ADVERTISEMENTS" and open the online advertisement (User Instructions, View Advertisement, Apply). Click "Apply" and then "Authenticate with O.T.R." and tick "Yes" or "No" for "Have You Completed Your O.T.R. Registration". If "Yes", enter the O.T.R. number, click "Proceed", and authenticate through the O.T.P. received on the registered mobile number/email ID or the O.T.R. password. Personal details from the O.T.R. are displayed automatically, and the candidate fills only the essential qualification required for the post. If "No", first obtain the O.T.R. number from the O.T.R. portal and then continue.

Second Stage: The Applicant Dashboard is displayed. Click "Submit Details" under "Application Part-2" against the applied post. The permanent and correspondence address and application form appear from the O.T.R., along with the preferential qualifications for the post. Choose Yes or No against each preferential qualification.

Third Stage: In the "Fee Confirmation Window", click "Yes" in front of "Proceed for fee payment". The SBI MOPS page opens with three modes of payment: Net Banking, Card Payments and Other Payment Modes. After payment, a "Payment Transaction Slip" is displayed and should be printed using the Printer Icon. If payment fails, log in through "Candidate Dashboard Login" with the O.T.R. number, authenticate, and click "Pending Payment" to pay the fee.

Fourth Stage: The application form is displayed on screen and its print should be taken and kept safely, as it must be produced in the Commission's office if any discrepancy arises. After applying, a candidate can modify the qualification details of the applied post only once through "Candidate Dashboard Login", until the last date for correction/modification.

On the final application page there is a Declaration. Clicking "I do not agree" drops the application. A Preview is available before final submission, and a successful submission report can be printed.

content_sections.text: Candidates must possess all the requisite qualifications up to the last date for submitting applications. The Commission does not advise candidates about their eligibility. Candidates who are still appearing in the examination of the essential qualification are not eligible and need not apply. Qualification: Bachelor's degree, with specific requirements for some posts (see below). Age: 21 to 40 years on 01 July 2026, with relaxations. Marital status: Male candidates who are married and have more than one wife living, and female candidates who have married a person already having a wife, are not eligible unless the Hon'ble Governor has granted an exemption. Reservation and age relaxation: Candidates of reserved categories who are not permanent residents of U.P. are not given the benefit of reservation or age relaxation. Nationality: Not specified in the pages provided.

content_sections.heading: UPPSC Samiksha Adhikari Qualification
content_sections.text: For the post of Samiksha Adhikari, candidates must have a Bachelor's degree from a University established by law in India, or a qualification recognised by the Government as equivalent, up to the last date for receipt of online applications. Some posts have specific educational qualifications, listed below. Candidates for posts with specific educational qualifications must give their options clearly. The notification gives three qualification entries for the Manager, Care-Taker and Receptionist (Swagati) posts of the U.P. Public Service Commission. The extracted text does not make clear which entry belongs to which post, so candidates should check the PDF (page 3). The entries are: Entry A: Bachelor's degree from a recognised University. Preferential qualifications: (a) one year's course in Cookery, Bakery, Table-laying, Flower-arrangements or an equivalent course; (b) knowledge of Horticulture; (c) knowledge of Accounts rules; (d) administrative experience such as supervision of Furrash, Mali, Chaukidar, Attenders and Sweepers. A note in Hindi lists diploma courses treated as equivalent to point (a), including a minimum one-year Diploma in Food Production, Bakery and Confectionery, Food and Beverage Service or House Keeping, as well as certain other courses. Entry B: Bachelor's degree from a University established by law in India or an equivalent qualification recognised by the Government. Preferential qualifications: (a) three years Diploma in Hotel Management and Catering; (b) knowledge of Horticulture; (c) knowledge of Accounts rules; (d) administrative experience such as supervision of Furrash, Mali, Chaukidar, Peons, Attenders, Sweepers and Drivers. Entry C: (a) Bachelor's degree or its equivalent from a recognised University with History, Geography, English Literature, Anthropology or Architecture as one of the subjects at degree level. (b) Good knowledge of Hindi. For the posts of Samiksha Adhikari, Sahayak Samiksha Adhikari, Samiksha Adhikari (Account), Sahayak Samiksha Adhikari (Account), Care-Taker, Receptionist (Swagati), Manager and Store Keeper, a candidate who has served in the Territorial Army for a minimum of two years, or has obtained a 'B' certificate of the National Cadet Corps, shall, other things being equal, be given preference in direct recruitment. content_sections.heading: UPPSC Samiksha Adhikari Age Limit
content_sections.text: Candidates must have attained 21 years and must not have crossed 40 years on 01 July 2026. They must not have been born earlier than 2nd July 1986 and not later than 01 July 2005. For PH candidates, the maximum age limit is 55 years, meaning they must not have been born before 02 July 1971. Conditions for Chief Minister Fellowship research scholars (as per the Uttar Pradesh Public Services (Relaxation of Age Limit and Weightage for Research Scholars of Chief Minister Fellowship for Competitive Examinations) Rules, 2026): Emergency Commissioned/Short Service Commissioned Officers whose Army service has been extended for rehabilitation may apply for age relaxation only if they obtain a certificate from the competent authority of the Army, Navy or Air Force that their service has been extended for rehabilitation and no disciplinary action is pending, and submit a written undertaking to get released immediately from the Army if selected. These facilities are not admissible if the officer gets a permanent commission in the Army, was released on tendering resignation, or was released on grounds of misconduct or physical disability or on his own request and gets gratuity. Reservation for Scheduled Castes, Scheduled Tribes, Other Backward Class and Economically Weaker Section candidates of U.P. is admissible as per the relevant Government rules. Horizontal reservation is also admissible for Dependents of Freedom Fighters of U.P., Female candidates, Ex-Servicemen of U.P., P.H. of U.P. and Outstanding sports persons of U.P., on settlement of vacancies as per rules. Reservation for P.H. of U.P. is permissible only for the notified or identified posts.

faq.question: Q1. What is the total number of vacancies announced for UPPSC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Uttar Pradesh Public Service Commission has announced a total of 501 vacancies for Samiksha Adhikari, Sahayak Samiksha Adhikari, Manager, Care-Taker, and other various posts under advertisement number A-4/E-1/2026.

faq.question: Q2. When does the online application process start and end?
faq.answer: The online application process commences on 26 October 2026 and the last date for submission of online applications and fee payment is 26 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit required to apply for these posts?
faq.answer: Candidates must have attained the age of 21 years and must not have crossed the age of 40 years as of July 01, 2026. Age relaxations are applicable for reserved categories.

faq.question: Q4. What is the essential educational qualification for Samiksha Adhikari?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Bachelor's degree from a recognized university, an 'O' Level certificate from DOEACC society or equivalent, and a minimum typing speed in Hindi.

faq.question: Q5. Is One Time Registration (O.T.R.) mandatory before applying?
faq.answer: Yes, it is mandatory to complete One Time Registration (O.T.R.) and obtain an O.T.R. number at least 72 hours before submitting the online application form.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for General and OBC candidates?
faq.answer: The application fee for Unreserved, Economically Weaker Sections, and Other Backward Classes candidates is Rs. 125/-.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for UPPSC Samiksha Adhikari Recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process comprises a Preliminary Examination, a Main (Written) Examination, followed by Document Verification for qualified candidates.

faq.question: Q8. Can candidates from other states apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Yes, candidates from other states can apply, but they will be treated under the unreserved category as reservation benefits are restricted to original residents of Uttar Pradesh.

faq.question: Q9. What is the salary scale offered for these positions?
faq.answer: The salary ranges from the pay scale of 29200-64700 (level-5) up to 47600-151100 (level-8) depending on the specific post.

content_sections.heading: NCDC Recruitment 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection will be conducted through screening of applications followed by an interview for eligible candidates. Scrutiny of submitted applications and supporting documents. Shortlisting based on the prescribed eligibility criteria and Terms of Reference (ToR). Interview of shortlisted eligible candidates. Final selection and contractual engagement, subject to applicable conditions. Only eligible shortlisted candidates will receive an email informing them of the interview date and time. The notification does not prescribe a separate written examination.

content_sections.heading: NCDC Recruitment 2026 Apply Offline
content_sections.text: Eligible candidates must submit the prescribed application form through Speed Post or hand delivery to the General Services Section of NCDC, Delhi. Applications must reach the office on or before 9 November 2026 . General Services Section Room No. 202, National Centre for Disease Control (NCDC), 22, Sham Nath Marg, Delhi - 110054. Office Submission Hours: 10:00 AM to 5:00 PM on working days. Important: Applications received after 9 November 2026 will not be accepted. The date of dispatch is not a substitute for timely receipt by NCDC.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for NCDC Recruitment 2026?
content_sections.text: Visit the official NCDC website at ncdc.mohfw.gov.in . Open the Vacancies section under Work With Us. Download the notification for engagement of 30 contractual human resources. Read the post-specific qualifications, experience and age criteria. Print the application form included on pages 10 and 11 of the notification. Fill in the post applied for, personal information, educational qualifications, experience and contact details. Attach a self-attested photograph and the applicable educational, experience, age-proof and supporting documents. Check that the form is complete and that the required copies are self-attested. Send the completed application through Speed Post or submit it by hand at the designated NCDC office. Ensure the application reaches NCDC by 9 November 2026. Check the registered email address for interview communication if shortlisted.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required for NCDC Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates should submit the supporting documents relevant to their qualifications and experience along with the prescribed application form. Completed application form. Self-attested photograph. Degree, diploma and professional qualification certificates. Relevant experience certificates. Age-proof document. Supporting documents for other claims made in the application. The application form also asks for reference details, training or short courses attended, awards or achievements, mailing address, permanent address, phone number and email ID.

content_sections.heading: NCDC Recruitment 2026 Contract Terms and Conditions
content_sections.text: The initial contractual engagement is for one year. Continuation will depend on yearly requirements. Selected candidates must sign a Contractual Service Agreement at the time of joining. Contractual personnel will not be treated as regular NCDC employees. Contractual engagement does not provide any claim for permanent government appointment. No TA will be paid for attending the interview. No separate medical facility or additional financial allowance is provided beyond the consolidated remuneration under the stated conditions. Annual leave of 30 days and 10 days of casual or sick leave are provided as specified in the notice. Either party may terminate the service by giving one month's notice.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: The selection process is a written examination of two hours with objective-type questions, each with only one correct answer. The notice describes this written examination and does not mention an interview. Shortlisting: Meeting the minimum qualifications does not automatically entitle a candidate to be called. If many applications are received, the Institute may restrict the number of candidates called, based on higher qualifications/experience in Government sectors and/or other criteria. Shortlist and communication: The list of candidates shortlisted for the written examination will be published on the Institute website. Successful candidates will also be notified by email, and no other communication will be issued. Candidates must give a working email ID and mobile number. Syllabus: The syllabus is sent to the shortlisted candidates by email. The paper setters decide the weightage for each topic. Question papers are not disclosed, because they form a question bank for future recruitment. Original documents: Shortlisted candidates must produce original documents for reservation, educational qualification, date of birth, experience, etc., before the selection process. Those who do not are not allowed to take part. Employed candidates must produce the NOC and VCC at the written examination, or their candidature will be rejected. Tie in marks: If two candidates get the same marks in the written examination, the older candidate is placed higher in merit, as per Government of India norms.

content_sections.heading: CCI Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: The operational and functional areas of experience defined in the notification for each post are as follows: Operation & Maintenance of any cement, manufacturing, process industries. Production & shut-down planning. Critical spare parts/items planning. Capex/project planning and their further smooth implementation. Smooth coordination among departments for target results. Operation & maintenance of any cement, manufacturing, mining, process industries. Production & shut-down planning. Critical spare parts/items planning. Condition monitoring of plant equipment. Overall knowledge of critical cement plant equipment. Smooth coordination among departments for target results. Working independently in any section for planned & condition-based maintenance. Integrated load management system (ILMS). Switch yard/sub-station of capacity up to 132 KV. Electrical equipment, HT & LT motors, switchgear, transformers. Heavy electrical equipment installations and their alignment for final testing. Overall power distribution in system through PCC/MCC & their control. Basic knowledge of hard-wired interlocks & preparing algorithms. Process instrumentation and computer/microprocessor-based control systems. Structural design and detailing. Execution and implementation of civil projects. Construction and maintenance of industrial infrastructure. Design and construction of large concrete silos or storage structures. Foundation work and related geotechnical aspects. Maintenance of existing civil assets in industrial settings. Sales & Marketing, Sales & Accounts. Market Development and Channel Management. Customer Relationship Management (CRM). Sales Planning & Execution. Competition Analysis & Reporting. Billing & Dispatch Coordination. MIS and ERP Systems. Company Secretarial functions in a company of repute.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Candidates must enclose self-attested photocopies of the following documents along with their hard-copy application form: Proof of Age: Matriculation certificate showing date of birth. Qualification Certificates: All certificates and mark sheets from Class 10th, 12th, Graduation, and higher qualifications. Caste Certificate: For SC/ST/OBC candidates, in the prescribed Government of India format (OBC-NCL certificate not more than one year old as on 16 November 2026). EWS Certificate: In the prescribed Government of India format as per DoPT guidelines (issued not more than one year old as on 16 November 2026). Experience Certificate: Issued by the employer with clear date of joining and relieving in support of experience details furnished in the application. Pay Scale Proof (for Govt./PSU candidates): Latest salary slip. Aadhaar Card. PAN Card. Certificate of CTC (for private candidates) from latest employer, or latest salary slip. Original Demand Draft of ₹100/- towards application fee (for UR, OBC, and EWS candidates).

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: The selection process comprises the following stages as specified in the recruitment notification: Shortlisting: In case a large number of applications are received for a post, candidates will be shortlisted based on relevant experience, current CTC/monthly pay, and higher qualifications. Management reserves the right to conduct a Written Test or Group Discussion for shortlisted candidates prior to interview if required. Personal Interview: Shortlisted candidates will be invited for an interview. Shortlisted candidates called for interview are eligible for reimbursement of sleeper class train fare by the shortest route, provided the travel distance exceeds 50 km. Medical Examination: Shortlisted candidates must present medical examination reports signed by the Chief Medical Officer (CMO) of a Government Hospital in CCI’s prescribed format, which will be examined by CCI’s medical officer. Document Verification: Verification of original documents and certificates against the submitted application.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: The appointment is purely on a Fixed Term Contract basis for an initial tenure of 1 year, extendable up to a maximum period of 4 years; it does not confer any right to regular or permanent employment. Either party can terminate the contract by giving one month’s notice or contractual fee in lieu thereof. Candidates working in Government or Public Sector Undertakings must apply through proper channel or submit an NOC at the time of interview, or submit a relieving letter upon selection. Candidates belonging to UR, OBC, and EWS categories must pay a non-refundable fee of ₹100/- via Demand Draft drawn in favour of Cement Corporation of India Limited, payable at New Delhi. SC, ST, PWD, and female candidates are exempted. Applications received after the cut-off date of 16 November 2026 at 1700 Hrs will not be entertained, and CCI is not responsible for postal delays. Computer knowledge is essential for all advertised posts.

content_sections.heading: About NRL Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Numaligarh Refinery Limited (NRL) is a Navaratna Public Sector Undertaking under the Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas engaged in refining and marketing petroleum products. The company is currently executing a mega refinery expansion project to ramp up refining capacity from 3 MMTPA to 9 MMTPA, which includes crude oil importation at Paradip Port and laying a cross-country pipeline from Paradip to Numaligarh. This recruitment engages experienced retired or serving professionals to support critical refinery operations during this expansion.

Remuneration is an all-inclusive fixed monthly lumpsum with no additional allowances. Statutory deductions such as TDS will be deducted from the monthly remuneration, against which necessary certificates will be issued. Appointees will work in line with the regular officers of the company, observe normal office timings, and may be called upon to attend office on weekly off days or any holiday in case of urgency. content_sections.heading: About GSL
content_sections.text: Goa Shipyard Limited (shipbuilders, shiprepairers and engineers) is a Central Public Sector Undertaking under the Ministry of Defence. It is a Schedule 'A' Mini Ratna Category-I company at Vaddem, Vasco-da-Gama, Goa – 403 802. GSL designs and builds ships for the Indian Navy, the Indian Coast Guard and other customers, including friendly foreign countries. The notice describes it as an ISO 9001-2015, 14001:2015 and 45001:2018 certified company.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The notice lists 40 vacancies: 31 regular employment posts (Part A) and 9 fixed term employment posts (Part B). The vacancies include backlog reserved vacancies. For post 2, GSL reserves the right to offer a grade lower than the one applied for: candidates who apply for Additional General Manager (AGM) may be considered for the Deputy General Manager grade, as per suitability. The post-wise details give 01 vacancy each for Chief General Manager (Business Development)/ General Manager (Business Development) and Chief General Manager (Technical)/ General Manager (Technical). For these two posts (Sl. No. 2 and 3), GSL reserves the right to offer a lower grade: candidates who apply for Chief General Manager (CGM) may be considered for the General Manager grade, as per suitability. In the post-wise details, "SR" stands for Ship Repairs. Abbreviations: UR = Unreserved; SC = Scheduled Caste; ST = Scheduled Tribe; OBC(NCL) = Other Backward Class (Non Creamy Layer); EWS = Economically Weaker Section; PwBD = Persons with Bench Mark Disabilities; HH = Hard of Hearing.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The notice gives each grade's pay scale together with an approximate CTC. Where two CTC figures are printed, the second is for Fixed Term Employment (FTE) posts. Other benefits such as Performance Related Pay, Accident Insurance Coverage, a Contributory Medical Insurance Policy and Welfare items will apply as per Company Rules. Posts A (1 to 18) are Regular Employment Posts. Posts B (1 to 6) are purely Fixed Term Employment, initially for 03 years. This term may be extended by up to 2 years at most, depending on the organisation's requirement and the individual's performance. A fixed term post is NOT against a regular post: the employment ends automatically at the end of the term unless the candidate is told otherwise in writing. GSL does not give any assurance of regular employment after the fixed term ends.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for GSL Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: GSL accepts applications only through its online application system, followed by a hard copy sent by post. Online applications open at 00.00 hrs on 23 October 2026 and close at 17.00 hrs on 22 November 2026. Visit www.goashipyard.in. Under the link Notice Board- 'Careers', click the link 'GSL Careers'. Click the 'Apply Online' button and select the post you wish to apply for. Complete the personal information in the online application form, then fill in the payment details. Pay the application fee of Rs. 500/- online through SBI e-pay (debit card/ credit card/ net banking etc.). Wait for the intimation from the server and do not press back or refresh, to avoid double charges. Download and print the "Fee receipt" generated on successful payment. If no fee receipt is generated, the payment has failed: log in again and repeat the payment. SUBMIT the application form. Without this step the form is treated as incomplete, and it cannot be edited after the online application is completed. Take two printouts of the system-generated online application form. Send one, with all relevant documents, to: General Manager (HR&A), HR&A Department, Goa Shipyard Limited, Vasco-Da-Gama, Goa – 403802. Keep the second copy for future reference. The printout and hard copies of the relevant documents must reach GSL on or before 2 December 2026. Candidates applying for more than one post must submit a separate application, with the prescribed fee, for each post. For difficulty applying online, contact [email protected] . Applications without the prescribed fee are liable to be rejected. The candidature of applicants who pay less than the prescribed fee, or pay by any other method, will be rejected. Fees paid by ineligible candidates are forfeited, and no correspondence will be entertained about them. Keep scanned copies (preferably JPG/PDF) of these documents ready before filling in the online application: Passport size colour photograph with a light background (preferably white), with nothing covering the face and eyes, below 450 KB. Signature in black ink on plain white paper, below 450 KB. It must be a scan of your own pen signature, not a digital signature. SSC certificate as proof of date of birth, not more than 500 KB. Educational qualification mark sheet & degree, not more than 1 MB. Caste Certificate, not more than 500 KB. Experience Certificates, not more than 1 MB. Aadhaar Card, not more than 500 KB.
