content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Selection for all posts except the Junior Manager posts will be through an interview only. For the Junior Manager posts there is a written test and an interview. Management reserves the right to raise the minimum eligibility criteria for shortlisting if there is a large response. It also reserves the right to decide the criteria for screening and shortlisting applications. The written test carries 85 marks and the interview 15 marks. Candidates who score 50% or above in the written test (UR & EWS), or 45% or above (SC/ST/OBC(NCL)/PwBD, when the post is reserved), will be shortlisted for document verification followed by the interview. The qualifying marks for the interview are 50% or above for UR & EWS and 45% or above for SC/ST/OBC(NCL)/PwBD (when the post is reserved). Among the candidates who qualify in the interview, selection is by merit on the overall aggregate of written test and interview marks, following the reservation guidelines. A tie is decided by seniority in age. Call letters will be sent only by e-mail to the registered e-mail ID of shortlisted candidates. GSL is not responsible for non-receipt of e-mail or loss of a candidate's e-mail ID and password. Outstation candidates who qualify for the interview will be paid travelling allowance by the shortest route from their residence (as registered in the Online Application System) to Goa Shipyard Limited. TA is paid only on production of proof of journey (hard copy of tickets), as per company rules:

basic_details.selection_process_brief: Merit Based on Class 10 and ITI Marks, Certificate Verification and Medical Fitness
basic_details.short_information: Hindustan Copper Limited Apprentice Recruitment 2026: Hindustan Copper Limited (HCL) has released Notification No. HCL/MCP/HR/Trade App./01/2026 dated 3 November 2026 for 171 Trade Apprentice seats across 19 trades at its Malanjkhand Copper Project in Balaghat, Madhya Pradesh. Candidates who have passed Class 10 or Class 10 with ITI in the relevant trade can apply, depending on the apprenticeship category. The age limit is 18 to 25 years as on 1 November 2026, with applicable relaxation. Selection will be based on Class 10 and ITI merit, and the training duration varies from one to three years

application_fee.details: The uploaded official notification does not specify an application fee or category-wise fee schedule. | Candidates should follow the official online application instructions and avoid making payments through unverified websites or intermediaries.

age_limit.details: The age limit is 18 to 25 years as on 1 November 2026. Upper-age relaxation is available for eligible SC, ST and OBC candidates. | Candidates should calculate their age using the prescribed cut-off date and provide valid documents supporting any claimed relaxation.

qualification.education_qualification: 10th Pass or 10th Pass with Relevant ITI, Depending on Trade
qualification.details: Applicants must have passed Class 10 or Matriculation under the 10+2 education system or an equivalent examination. For trades numbered 4 to 19, candidates must also possess an ITI qualification in the relevant trade from a recognized institute. | Important: The notice contains a minor inconsistency: the eligibility paragraph explicitly identifies Sl. Nos. 1 and 3 as 10th-pass entries, while the main vacancy table also shows no technical qualification for Sl. No. 2, Shotfirer/Blaster (Mines). The selection paragraph separately confirms that Blaster (Mines) is assessed on Class 10 marks alone. Candidates applying for these three trades should follow the trade-wise qualification table and verify the relevant application instructions. | The notification states that candidates possessing higher professional qualifications such as a Diploma, B.E. or equivalent qualification will not be considered under this apprenticeship engagement. | Candidates with academic degrees such as B.A., B.Sc. or B.Com. will not receive additional weightage in the selection process. | Candidates who passed ITI in 2025 or earlier must upload an affidavit on non-judicial stamp paper, sworn before a Magistrate or Notary Public. | The affidavit must declare that the candidate has neither undergone apprenticeship training previously nor taken employment anywhere. | The required affidavit must be uploaded as a PDF smaller than 1 MB.

salary_details.details: Selected Trade Apprentices will receive a stipend as admissible under the applicable apprenticeship rules. | The notification does not announce a specific monthly stipend for individual trades. Candidates should not assume a fixed amount without confirmation from the company.

selection_process: Qualification Example Marks Weightage Weighted Score
Final Merit Percentage 83%
Selection will be based on a merit list prepared using Class 10 and ITI marks. The official notification does not prescribe a separate written examination or interview.

Online Registration: Candidates complete Government apprenticeship portal registration and HCL online application. Merit Calculation: Marks are evaluated using the prescribed Class 10 and ITI weightage. Shortlisting: The company prepares the shortlisted candidates list. Certificate Verification: Educational and eligibility certificates are verified. Medical Fitness: Candidates must satisfy Hindustan Copper Limited's medical standards. Apprenticeship Engagement: Selected candidates complete the applicable apprenticeship contract formalities.
For ITI-based trades
the merit calculation gives 70% weightage to Class 10 marks and 30% weightage to ITI marks.
Merit Percentage = (Class 10 Percentage x 0.70) + (ITI Percentage x 0.30)
This is an illustrative calculation
not an actual cut-off.
For trades where ITI is not required
the merit list is prepared using 100% weightage of Class 10 Board marks.
The notification specifically identifies Mate Mines and Blaster (Mines) in its merit instructions. The main qualification table also lists Driver-cum-Mechanic (LMV) without an ITI requirement.
If two or more candidates obtain the same merit marks
the older candidate will be given preference.
Where Class 10 results are awarded in CGPA
the notification prescribes conversion into percentage by multiplying the CGPA by 9.5.
For example
a CGPA of 8.0 corresponds to 76% under this prescribed calculation.
how_to_apply: Candidates must complete both stages described below.
Visit the Government apprenticeship portal at www.apprenticeshipindia.gov.in.
Create or access the candidate apprenticeship profile.
Complete the registration using the required personal and contact information.
Ensure the candidate's name, parents' names, date of birth and Aadhaar details match the relevant educational records.
Complete Aadhaar verification and the required eKYC details.

content_sections.heading: HCL Apprentice Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Applicants must have passed Class 10 or Matriculation under the 10+2 education system or an equivalent examination . content_sections.heading: Hindustan Copper Apprentice Selection Process 2026
content_sections.text: Selection will be based on a merit list prepared using Class 10 and ITI marks . The official notification does not prescribe a separate written examination or interview. Online Registration: Candidates complete Government apprenticeship portal registration and HCL online application. Merit Calculation: Marks are evaluated using the prescribed Class 10 and ITI weightage. Shortlisting: The company prepares the shortlisted candidates list. Certificate Verification: Educational and eligibility certificates are verified. Medical Fitness: Candidates must satisfy Hindustan Copper Limited's medical standards. Apprenticeship Engagement: Selected candidates complete the applicable apprenticeship contract formalities. For ITI-based trades, the merit calculation gives 70% weightage to Class 10 marks and 30% weightage to ITI marks . Merit Percentage = (Class 10 Percentage x 0.70) + (ITI Percentage x 0.30) This is an illustrative calculation, not an actual cut-off. For trades where ITI is not required, the merit list is prepared using 100% weightage of Class 10 Board marks . The notification specifically identifies Mate Mines and Blaster (Mines) in its merit instructions. The main qualification table also lists Driver-cum-Mechanic (LMV) without an ITI requirement. If two or more candidates obtain the same merit marks, the older candidate will be given preference. Where Class 10 results are awarded in CGPA, the notification prescribes conversion into percentage by multiplying the CGPA by 9.5 . For example, a CGPA of 8.0 corresponds to 76% under this prescribed calculation.

Candidates with an active contract elsewhere must satisfy the prescribed resignation and acceptance requirements before another contract can be processed.

content_sections.heading: Common Reasons for Rejection of HCL Apprentice Applications

Applying for a trade without the prescribed qualification. Submitting multiple HCL applications. Providing incorrect Class 10 or ITI information. Mismatch between Aadhaar profile and educational certificates. Failing to upload the applicable affidavit for earlier ITI pass-outs. Providing false or fabricated certificates. content_sections.heading: Central Railway Act Apprentice Selection Process 2026
content_sections.text: Selection will be based on a merit list calculated using the simple average of Class 10 and ITI percentage marks . The notification does not prescribe a separate written examination or interview. Online Application: Candidates apply through the RRC Central Railway website. Merit Calculation: Class 10 aggregate percentage and ITI percentage are given equal weightage. Merit List Preparation: Lists are prepared cluster-wise, unit-wise, trade-wise and community-wise. Document Verification: Shortlisted candidates must produce original educational and category certificates. Medical Fitness: Candidates must present the prescribed medical fitness certificate. Apprenticeship Engagement: Eligible candidates are engaged for training after completing the necessary formalities. Important: Although RRC Central Railway has issued a centralized notification, it will not prepare one centralized merit list for all 2,861 slots. Selection is organized according to the relevant cluster, unit, trade and community. The official merit formula is: Merit Percentage = (Class 10 Aggregate Percentage + ITI Percentage) / 2 This is an illustrative calculation, not an actual selection cut-off. Candidates must enter accurate percentages based on the aggregate Class 10 marks and the prescribed consolidated ITI marks. For boards that award letter grades rather than percentages, candidates must calculate the percentage using the midpoint of the marks range corresponding to the overall grade. If the education board does not issue an overall grade, the midpoints of individual subject-grade ranges must be averaged according to the notification's instructions. For example, if the overall grade corresponds to the range 80-89%, the midpoint is 84.5%. Candidates should use the conversion instructions given on pages 2 and 3 of the official PDF. Incorrect calculation may lead to rejection during verification. If two candidates obtain the same merit percentage, the older candidate will receive preference. If their dates of birth are also identical, the candidate who passed the Matriculation examination earlier will be placed higher.

content_sections.heading: Is There a Written Exam for Railway Apprentice 2026?
content_sections.text: No separate written examination is specified for this Central Railway Act Apprentice engagement. Candidates are shortlisted according to their Class 10 and ITI marks, followed by document verification and medical fitness assessment. Applicants should not confuse this apprenticeship selection with Railway Recruitment Board (RRB) CBT examinations conducted for regular railway posts.

content_sections.heading: Central Railway Apprentice Reservation Rules 2026
content_sections.text: Reservation applies to eligible SC, ST, OBC, PwBD and Ex-Servicemen categories according to the relevant notification provisions. SC and ST candidates claiming reservation must upload the appropriate caste certificate in the prescribed Central Government format. OBC candidates must submit a valid caste certificate and Non-Creamy Layer certificate issued on or after 1 April 2026 , in the prescribed Central Government format. Original certificates must be produced during document verification. PwBD eligibility is restricted to the disability categories and trade-specific fitness conditions stated in the notification. The applicable provisions include certain locomotor disabilities, cerebral palsy, hearing disabilities and low-vision categories. Candidates claiming PwBD reservation must possess a valid disability certificate from the competent medical authority. Not every disability category is suitable for every apprenticeship trade, and applicants must check the requirements applicable to their selected trade. Applicants claiming these benefits must upload the required discharge or serving certificate and produce the original supporting documents when called for verification.

content_sections.heading: Central Railway Apprentice 2026 Apply Online
content_sections.text: Candidates can submit online applications through the official RRC Central Railway Apprentice 2026 recruitment portal. The application window is open from 3 November to 2 December 2026. Direct Apply Online: Central Railway Apprentice 2026 Application Portal Official Website: www.rrccr.com Notification Number: RRC/CR/AA/2026. Last Date: 2 December 2026, 5:00 PM. Applicants must select only one cluster and may give unit preferences within that cluster. Multiple applications are not permitted and may result in cancellation of all applications submitted by the candidate.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply Online for Central Railway Apprentice 2026?
content_sections.text: Visit the official Railway Recruitment Cell, Central Railway website at www.rrccr.com . Locate Notification No. RRC/CR/AA/2026 for engagement of Act Apprentices. Download and read the complete notification before applying. Check the available ITI trades, cluster-wise vacancies, age criteria and educational requirements. Click the Apply Online link for the 2026 apprenticeship engagement. Complete the registration process using the information requested on the portal. Enter personal details, including name, parents' names, date of birth and contact information. Provide the required Aadhaar or other permitted identification details. Enter Class 10 qualification and aggregate percentage marks accurately. Enter the relevant ITI trade certificate and marks details. Select only one eligible cluster. Choose the available units within the selected cluster in order of preference. Enter the applicable community, reservation and other eligibility details. Upload the prescribed photograph, signature and supporting certificates. Review the completed application carefully before final submission. Pay the application fee of Rs. 100, unless exempt. Complete the application process before 2 December 2026 at 5:00 PM . Download and print the application form and retain the registration number and payment receipt. Important: Candidates should not submit multiple applications using different mobile numbers, email addresses or personal particulars. RRC Central Railway may reject all applications submitted by the same candidate.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required for Central Railway Apprentice 2026
content_sections.text: Applicants must upload legible scanned copies of the required educational and supporting documents during the online application process. Class 10 or equivalent marksheet. Date-of-birth proof through Matriculation certificate, marksheet or accepted school leaving certificate. Consolidated ITI marksheet covering all semesters of the notified trade. National Trade Certificate issued by NCVT or accepted provisional certificate issued by NCVT/SCVT. SC/ST/OBC caste certificate, where applicable. Valid OBC Non-Creamy Layer certificate, where applicable. Disability certificate for eligible PwBD applicants. Discharge certificate or Armed Forces serving certificate for applicable Ex-Servicemen reservation claims. Prescribed recent colour photograph. Scanned candidate signature. Aadhaar or other permitted identity document details. Original documents must be produced during document verification. Documents issued in languages other than Hindi or English must be accompanied by the required attested translation. Both images must follow the prescribed 100 DPI specification. The colour photograph must have been taken within three months before application and should show the candidate's face clearly without a cap or sunglasses. Applicants should retain two additional copies of the same photograph for document verification.

content_sections.heading: Aadhaar and Identity Requirements for RRC CR Apprentice 2026
content_sections.text: Applicants are generally required to enter their 12-digit Aadhaar number during registration. Those who have applied for Aadhaar but have not received the card may enter the 28-digit Aadhaar Enrolment ID. The notification provides special identification provisions for applicants from Jammu & Kashmir, Meghalaya and Assam. Eligible applicants from these locations may use a permitted Government identity document such as Voter ID, valid passport or driving licence. The original accepted identification document must be produced during document verification.

content_sections.heading: Central Railway Apprentice Document Verification 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates shortlisted through the merit process will be called for document verification in the relevant division or unit according to their selected cluster. They must produce the original educational certificates, ITI marksheets, reservation certificates, identity documents and other applicable records. Shortlisted candidates must bring the prescribed medical fitness certificate in the format provided in Annexure VII of the official notification. The certificate must be signed by a Government-authorized Gazetted medical officer not below the rank of Assistant Surgeon in a Central or State Government hospital. Important: Candidates who fail to produce the required medical fitness certificate may not be permitted to undergo document verification and may have their candidature cancelled.

content_sections.heading: Common Reasons for Rejection of Railway Apprentice Applications
content_sections.text: Applicants should carefully review the following requirements because errors may lead to rejection: Not meeting the minimum Class 10 aggregate marks or prescribed ITI qualification. Selecting a unit where no training slots are available for the applicant's ITI trade. Submitting more than one application. Entering incorrect Class 10 or ITI percentages. Providing personal details that do not match the Matriculation certificate. Uploading unclear, corrupt or incorrect documents. Failing to produce the required original certificates during verification. Claiming reservation without the prescribed supporting certificates. Not meeting the applicable age limit. Failing to produce the required medical fitness certificate. Providing false or misleading information. Applicants should check the complete notification and all entered information before paying the fee and submitting the final application, as editing is not permitted after final submission.

content_sections.heading: Central Railway Act Apprentice 2026 Important Instructions
content_sections.text: RRC Central Railway has announced 2,861 Act Apprentice training slots. The notification number is RRC/CR/AA/2026, dated 3 November 2026. Applications close on 2 December 2026 at 5:00 PM. Class 10 with at least 50% aggregate marks and the relevant ITI certificate are mandatory. The prescribed age limit is 15 to 24 years, with applicable relaxation. Engineering graduates and diploma holders are not eligible under this notification. Candidates already undergoing or having completed apprenticeship should not apply. Applicants must select only one cluster. The selected units must offer training slots for the applicant's ITI trade. Selection is based on the simple average of Class 10 and ITI marks. No separate written examination is prescribed. Merit lists are prepared cluster-wise, unit-wise, trade-wise and community-wise. SC/ST/PwBD and women candidates are exempt from the application fee. The notified monthly stipend is Rs. 9,600. The apprenticeship training duration is one year. Selected candidates must arrange their own accommodation. Original document verification and medical fitness are mandatory. No TA/DA will be paid for attending document verification. Apprenticeship completion does not guarantee regular railway employment. Candidates should regularly check the official RRC Central Railway website for updates.

content_sections.heading: NLC India Apprentice Recruitment 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: NLC India Limited has issued for 1,067 ITI Trade and Graduate (Non-Engineering) apprenticeship training slots at Neyveli and Regional Office, Chennai. The official four-page notification provides the trade-wise vacancies, educational qualifications, stipend, training duration, selection rules, important dates and document-upload instructions. content_sections.heading: NLC India Apprentice Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Applicants must possess the qualification required for their apprenticeship category. Graduate (Non-Engineering) candidates must also meet the prescribed passing-year restriction. Candidates must have passed ITI in the relevant trade from a recognized institute . The notification does not prescribe a qualifying-examination passing-year restriction for ITI candidates. Applicants must possess a regular full-time Bachelor's degree in the relevant discipline from a UGC-approved university . Eligible disciplines include Commerce, Business Administration, Computer Science, Computer Application, Geology, Microbiology, Chemistry, Pharmacy and Nursing, as listed in the vacancy table. Passing Year Requirement: Graduate (Non-Engineering) candidates must have passed their qualifying examination in 2022, 2023, 2024, 2025 or 2026 . This restriction does not apply to ITI Trade Apprentice candidates. Applicants must hail from Tamil Nadu or Puducherry. Candidates must have completed 18 years of age on or before 31 October 2026. Candidates who have already undergone or are undergoing NAPS/NATS apprenticeship training or the PM internship scheme at NLC India Limited or elsewhere are not eligible under the notification. Graduate applicants must have a regular full-time degree in the corresponding discipline. Candidates claiming reservation must produce valid certificates in the prescribed Government format.

content_sections.heading: NLC India Apprentice Age Limit 2026
content_sections.text: The minimum age for NLC India Apprenticeship Training 2026 is 18 years as on 31 October 2026 , under Section 3(a) of the Apprentices Act, 1961.

content_sections.heading: NLC India Apprentice Stipend 2026
content_sections.text: Selected apprentices will receive a monthly stipend between Rs. 12,000 and Rs. 16,678 , depending on their training category and discipline. For Graduate Apprentices, the notified stipend includes Rs. 6,150 payable by the Government through the Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) scheme . The stipend is paid during the prescribed 12-month apprenticeship training period. These are training stipends, not regular employee salary scales.

content_sections.heading: NLC India Apprentice Training Duration 2026
content_sections.text: The notified training locations are Neyveli and Regional Office, Chennai. Completion of apprenticeship training does not provide any right to temporary or permanent employment with NLC India Limited.

content_sections.heading: NLC India Apprentice Selection Process 2026
content_sections.text: Selection will be based on marks obtained in the relevant qualifying examination . The notification does not prescribe a separate written examination for these apprenticeship slots. Trade Apprentices will be selected based on the percentage of marks obtained in the qualifying ITI examination. Graduate Apprentices will be assessed based on the marks obtained in their Bachelor's degree, following the percentage-calculation procedure of the awarding university or institution. Where the university has an established CGPA or grade conversion procedure, that procedure will be followed. If no established conversion system is available, the CGPA or grade will be multiplied by 10 to obtain the equivalent percentage. For semester-wise marks without an established aggregate calculation method, the average of the semester-wise percentages will be used. For year-wise marks without an established aggregate calculation method, the average of the year-wise percentages will be used. If two or more candidates have the same percentage at the cut-off, preference will be given to the older candidate based on date of birth. Candidates may be required to furnish a certificate from their university or institution confirming the equivalent aggregate percentage for CGPA/OGPA-based qualifications.

content_sections.heading: NLC India Apprentice Apply Online 2026
content_sections.text: Apply Online: NLC India ITI and Graduate Apprentice Online Application Last Date: 9 November 2026, up to 5:00 PM. Candidates should read the notification and complete all mandatory details and document uploads before final submission.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required for NLC India Apprentice Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Important for 2026 Graduates: Candidates who completed their course in 2026 but have not received their Provisional Certificate may submit a Temporary Provisional Certificate in the prescribed format. It must be issued on the institution's official letterhead and signed and sealed by the Principal. Graduate applicants must include relevant semester-wise or consolidated marksheets and the CGPA/OGPA conversion certificate, where applicable. ITI applicants must include the relevant trade certificate and marksheets in the prescribed merged file.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by Neyveli Lignite Corporation India (NLC India) for filling various ITI and Graduate (Non-Engineering) apprenticeship positions across multiple disciplines under Advt. No. L&DC/04/2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many total vacancies are available in NLC India Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 1067 vacancies available for ITI and Graduate (Non-Engineering) Apprentices across various trades including Fitter, Electrician, Commerce, Computer Science, and Nursing.

faq.question: Q3. What is the starting and last date to apply online?
faq.answer: The online application process begins on 21 October 2026 and the last date to successfully submit the online application form is 9 November 2026.

faq.answer: Candidates must have passed ITI in the relevant trade from a recognized institute to be eligible for the Trade Apprentice positions offered by NLC India.

faq.question: Q5. What qualification is needed for Graduate Non-Engineering Apprentices?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a regular full-time Bachelor's degree in the relevant discipline from a UGC-approved university, such as B.Com, BBA, BCA, B.Sc, or B.Pharm.

faq.answer: Candidates must have attained a minimum age of 18 years, which must be completed on or before 31 October 2026, as per the official notification guidelines.

faq.answer: Selected ITI Apprentices receive Rs. 12,000/- per month, while Graduate Apprentices receive a monthly stipend ranging from Rs. 14,174/- to Rs. 16,678/- depending on their specific post.

faq.answer: Selection is completely merit-based, determined by the percentage of marks obtained in the qualifying ITI examination for Trade Apprentices and Bachelor's Degree for Graduate Apprentices.

faq.question: Q9. Are candidates from all states eligible to apply?
faq.answer: No, candidates hailing from the states of Tamil Nadu and Puducherry are exclusively eligible to apply for this apprenticeship training program at NLC India.

faq.answer: The apprenticeship training duration for all selected candidates across various trades and graduate disciplines is fixed for a period of 12 months.

content_sections.heading: About DMIL
content_sections.text: Delhi Metro International Limited is a wholly owned subsidiary of the Delhi Metro Rail Corporation (DMRC). It was set up to take on international metro rail projects and national projects within India, covering operations and maintenance, consultancy, design, planning and project development in the metro and allied urban transport sectors. Under this notice, DMIL is hiring staff for the O&M work of Chennai Metro Rail Limited Phase-II.

content_sections.heading: DMIL Technician Vacancy Details 2026
content_sections.text: The notice provides 30% horizontal reservation for women candidates. Selected candidates may be deployed in any department, as the requirement and urgency of the work demand. DMIL may increase, decrease, cancel, restrict or modify the requirement at any time.

content_sections.heading: DMIL Technician Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates must be 18 to 33 years old as on 1 October 2026. Reserved category candidates get the usual relaxation under the Tamil Nadu Government Rules. Your ITI aggregate must be at least 60%. Your ITI must be from a Government ITI or Govt aided ITI of Tamil Nadu. Candidates who passed from a private ITI will not be considered. Candidates who have had lasik surgery are not suitable for the post of Technician. For the trade-wise eligibility of each discipline, check the official notification.

rows.essential_qualification: Matriculation / Class 12th pass and having ITI (NCVT/SCVT) in Electrician, Fitter and Ref. & AC Mechanic Trade from a Govt. ITI or Govt. aided ITI

Matriculation / Class 12th pass and having ITI (NCVT/SCVT) in Electronic Mechanic, Information communication Technology System Maintenance, Information Technology, Computer Hardware and Network Maintenance, Mechanic Industrial Electronics, Power Electronics System from a Govt. ITI or Govt. aided ITI
Matriculation / Class 12th pass and having ITI (NCVT/SCVT) in Plumbers, Welders and Carpenters from a Govt. ITI or Govt. aided ITI

content_sections.heading: Pay and Benefits
content_sections.text: CTC of Rs. 28165/- (Rupees Twenty Eight Thousand, One Hundred Sixty Five only) per month, with no claim of regularisation in the future. The consolidated pay includes all other benefits, such as accommodation, transport, medical, LTA, canteen and insurance. Taxes are deducted from it. Any allowances over and above the fixed pay will be paid as per the Rules of the Corporation. Minimum PF under the Code on Social Security, 2020 will be deducted from your salary, and DMIL will make a matching contribution. The accumulated amount is paid when the contract ends. Leave: 08 days Casual Leave on a pro-rata basis and 18 days Earned Leave (1.5 EL for each completed month of service).

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection is on a merit-cum-reservation basis. Document Verification and Screening, including a Tamil language Reading, Writing and Speaking Proficiency Test that is qualifying only. Candidates who studied Tamil as a subject in the 10th standard do not have to take this test. Candidates found suitable are put on a panel for 02 years from the date the Competent Authority approves it. The panel is used strictly as vacancies arise. Pre-engagement medical examination: empanelled candidates must meet the Corporation's medical standards, which are available on www.delhimetrorail.com . The Corporation pays for the first medical examination. If you ask for a re-medical, you pay for it yourself. Character and antecedents verification before engagement.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: Engagement is contractual, initially for 03 (three) years. It can be cut short or renewed, depending on satisfactory service. Training cost bond: you must serve for at least three years, not counting leave without pay. If you leave within 03 years, the position-wise training cost is recovered on a pro-rata basis. You must give one month's notice before resigning. DMIL can end the engagement without giving reasons by giving 30 days' notice. If you resign, you must give 30 days' advance notice or pay in lieu of notice. Being selected, shortlisted or empanelled gives you no right to engagement. Your candidature stays provisional and can be cancelled at any stage if any information you gave turns out to be false.

content_sections.heading: Screening Schedule and Venues
content_sections.text: The schedule covers all trades: Electrician, Electronic Mechanic, Fitter, RAC, Information communication Technology System Maintenance, Information Technology, Computer Hardware and Network Maintenance, Mechanic Industrial Electronics, Power Electronics System, Plumbers, Welders and Carpenters.

basic_details.job_title: BBMB Lineman Apprentice Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 7 Posts
basic_details.short_information: Candidates who have passed 10th class with at least 40% marks and hold a National Trade Certificate in the Lineman trade can apply for 7 seats of one-year Lineman apprenticeship training with the Bhakra Beas Management Board (BBMB), Construction Division, Dhulkote (Ambala), for session 2026-27, under the Apprenticeship Act 1961. Applications are accepted online only, through the NAPS portal (apprenticeshipindia.gov.in), from 5 November 2026 to 3 December 2026. Selection is on a merit list of 10th and ITI marks, with no written exam and no interview.

how_to_apply: Applications must be received online by the concerned office from 5 November 2026 to 3 December 2026 through the National Apprenticeship Promotion Scheme (NAPS) portal, https://apprenticeshipindia.gov.in. No other mode of application will be accepted. You need your Aadhaar Card to register online.
Documents named in the notice (shortlisted candidates will be called to have them checked):
10th Mark sheet
ITI Certificate and Marksheets (the certificate must be issued by NCVT/SCVT)
Category certificate (SC/ST/OBC, if applicable)
Residence/Domicile certificate, if applicable
Aadhaar Card
important_instructions: Candidates who, after finishing their education, have done apprenticeship training or are doing it now in any other establishment under the Apprenticeship Act 1961 should not apply. Candidates who are already registered and have trained under these schemes will not be considered and need not apply. Selection and deployment of apprentices depend on the detailed provisions of the Apprenticeship Act 1961 and its amendments, if any. The competent authority will decide the place of training based on administrative needs and the candidate's suitability for the area under Construction Division, BBMB, Dhulkote. Requests for a specific place of posting are generally not considered. The result of the apprentice engagement will be uploaded on the BBMB websites through the office of the System Software Manager, BBMB, Chandigarh. Office contact: Addl. Superintending Engineer, Construction Division, BBMB Dhulkote (Ambala City) 134007; Email: [email protected]; Telefax: 0171-2541524.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The notice gives the following eligibility for ITI Trade Apprentices (Lineman): The candidate must have passed the 10th class examination with at least 40% marks from a recognised Board, and must also hold a National Trade Certificate in the notified trade, issued by the National Council for Vocational Training/State Council for Vocational Training in that trade. The candidate must have completed the relevant ITI course. The candidate must have an Aadhaar Card. It is compulsory and is needed for online registration. Age: as per the Apprenticeship Act 1961 and its amendments from time to time. Reservation: as per the Apprentice Act 1961 and its amendments from time to time. Candidates whose results for the qualifying examinations are still awaited on the last date for receipt of applications will not be considered. For the full eligibility for the Lineman trade, see the official notification and the BBMB website.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The seats are for a one-year apprenticeship training under the Apprenticeship Act 1961 for session 2026-27. The stipend amount is not specified in the notice. The notice says the stipend details are on the BBMB website (bbmb.gov.in). The contracts of the selected candidates will be registered under the NAPS Portal. The notice also says that contracts for the 7 Lineman Apprentice seats will be issued as and when a vacancy arises, on the basis of the merit list. That merit list is valid up to 28.02.2027.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for BBMB Lineman
content_sections.text: Applications must be received online by the concerned office from 5 November 2026 to 3 December 2026 through the National Apprenticeship Promotion Scheme (NAPS) portal, https://apprenticeshipindia.gov.in. No other mode of application will be accepted. You need your Aadhaar Card to register online. Documents named in the notice (shortlisted candidates will be called to have them checked): 10th Mark sheet ITI Certificate and Marksheets (the certificate must be issued by NCVT/SCVT) Category certificate (SC/ST/OBC, if applicable) Residence/Domicile certificate, if applicable Aadhaar Card

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: There is no interview and no written exam. Eligible candidates will be selected from the database of the apprenticeship portal (NAPS/NATS). Selection is based on a merit list prepared for all applicants, using the percentage of marks in matriculation (10th) and the ITI course: 25% of the seats available for each trade will be given to candidates who hold a residency certificate of the concerned districts of the State where the Grid Sub Station is located. If any of these reserved seats remain unfilled, they will go to candidates who hold a residency certificate of the State where the Grid Sub Station is located. If seats still remain unfilled, they will be filled through open merit. If two candidates have the same marks, the older candidate gets preference. If the dates of birth are also the same, the candidate who passed matriculation earlier is considered first.

The notification permits experience certificates from Government, Semi-Government, Limited, Private Limited, registered private companies or registered firms, as applicable. | For direct recruitment to the advertised Group C posts, candidates must satisfy the eligibility conditions prescribed by the Uttarakhand Government. The notification states that applicable candidates should fulfil the required Uttarakhand employment registration, domicile/permanent residence or educational conditions prescribed for direct recruitment. | Among the conditions mentioned in the notification are registration with an employment office located in Uttarakhand up to the last date of application, holding an Uttarakhand domicile/permanent residence certificate, or having passed the prescribed school-level examinations from recognized institutions situated in Uttarakhand, as applicable under the rules. | Additional provisions are given for certain Government employees, employees of specified State bodies and their eligible family members. content_sections.heading: About AIIMS New Delhi Senior Project Associate

According to the notice, the laboratory has established patient-derived 3D intestinal organoid (colonoid) models for inflammatory bowel disease (IBD), including ulcerative colitis (UC). (ii) Two years' experience in R&D Industrial and academic institutions or S&T organizations and scientific activities and services. (iii) Nil Practical experience in at least two of the areas listed under the job description below (organoid and cell culture, characterization and assessment, molecular and genomic analysis) will be considered an added advantage. Candidates should check the official notification for the exact discipline-specific eligibility of the post.

content_sections.text: Applications are invited from eligible Indian nationals. The applicant must be a citizen of India. Experience: At least 2-3 years of post-qualification experience in patent filing, IP management, or technology transfer in academic, R&D organizations, or industry. Age: Preferably less than 45 Years as on the last date of application. Persons with higher age and experience may also be considered if found suitable (including recently retired professionals). Preference will be given to candidates having: Patent Agent Certification (must pass the official Indian Patent Agent Examination). Experience in drafting Indian patent specifications and handling IP databases. Familiarity with international patent laws. Drafting experience for Patent Applications for PCT, USPTO, EP etc. Post-graduation from a reputed Institution/ university with relevant experience in an educational institute or industry of higher repute. Coursework or certification in Patent Drafting, IP Management, or Technology Transfer. Working or having experience in IITs/ IIMs/ IISERs/ NITs/ CFTIs/reputed industry. Excellent communication skills, interpersonal skills, and ability to interact with the students and faculty. Proficiency in maintaining databases, OpenAI tools, social media, data management, report generation, and presentations. Readiness to work in flexible office timings and willingness to travel as and when required. The notice also lists these skills and competence: Strong understanding of IPR including patents, designs, copyrights, trademarks etc. Knowledge of IP laws, filing procedures, documentation, and compliance requirements (preferably in India) and IPR policies. Familiarity with patent databases and search tools (such as Google Patents, WIPO, etc.). Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English, and coordination skills. Ability to conduct prior-art searches and analyze patentability and suitability of other forms of IP for filing. Familiarity with innovation ecosystems and technology transfer processes.

how_to_apply: Applications are made online through the portal available in the CSIR-IMMT website (registration/apply link printed in the notice: rects.immt.res.in). The notice does not describe the individual form-filling screens.
Register and apply online through the portal. The process has two parts: one-time registration and filling the online application.
If you wish to apply for more than one post, apply separately for each post code.

If you are currently employed, furnish a No Objection Certificate (NOC) from the current employer while applying online and/or produce it in original at the interview; otherwise the candidature may get cancelled.
Submit the application by 20.11.2026 (up to 05.00 pm).
Take a printout of the application form after successful submission.
For queries, write to [email protected] on or before 19.11.2026 (up to 04.00 pm).
Shortlisted candidates must bring these in original at the interview:
Print out of online application form.
Any ID proof (Aadhaar Card / Voter ID Card / PAN Card / Passport / Driving License).
Mark sheets and certificates of all years and semesters (10th/Matriculation onwards, including CGPA to percentage conversion certificate if applicable).
Category/EWS Certificate (if applicable).
No Objection Certificate (if applicable).
Experience Certificate (if applicable).
important_instructions: Category once mentioned in the online application form is treated as final. No TA/DA is admissible for appearing for the interview. Selected candidates must join duty immediately on receipt of the offer of engagement. Candidates pursuing Ph.D. (AcSIR Ph.D. etc.) can apply only when their Ph.D. research domain is aligned with the research area of the project. They need permission/NOC from the Director/Competent Authority and must produce it at the interview, failing which the candidature may get cancelled. All posts are tenable at CSIR - IMMT, Bhubaneswar. Project staff may be required to travel and stay at places outside Bhubaneswar as per project need. Engagement does not give any right or claim, directly or indirectly, for regularization to a permanent post of CSIR. For non-CSIR funded projects, including those funded by international agencies, the funding agency's guidelines apply; if there are none, CSIR's guidelines apply. Original documents of selected candidates are verified at joining. Candidature is provisional, and false information or suppression of facts leads to automatic cancellation. CSIR - IMMT reserves the right not to fill the positions. The number of positions and the duration of engagement may increase or decrease, and the Director's decision is final. Seeking support by illegal gratification or pressure, or any malpractice, leads to disqualification.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Applicants must be citizens of India. Age, essential qualification and experience are counted on the last date of submission of application. Result awaiting candidates are not eligible to apply. Unless otherwise mentioned, equivalent or higher degrees are not considered as essential qualification. The notice prints each post's age limit as "Max. Age" in years, as on the last date of receipt of application. The maximum age is 35 years for all eight post codes. The notice prints no experience requirement for these posts. The last column is headed "Job Requirement / Desirable Qualification" in the notice. Maximum age: 40 years. Essential qualification, any one of the following, each with experience in Research and Development in Industrial and Academic Institutions or Science and Technology Organizations and Scientific activities and services: M.Sc. in Chemistry with 3 years' experience. Or PhD in Chemistry with 2 years' experience. Or Masters/Integrated Masters in Chemical Engineering with 2 years' experience. Or Bachelor's degree in Chemical Engineering with 3 years' experience. Job requirement / desirable: proficiency in spectroscopic data analysis, with desirable experience in biological assays and material synthesis. Maximum age: 35 years for both post codes. 8710: M.Sc. in Chemistry/ Chemical Science, and two years of relevant experience in research and development in industrial/academic institutions or S&T organizations and scientific activities and services. Desirable: experience in polymer synthesis, organic synthesis, knowledge in characterization of the synthesized molecule through spectroscopy. 8711: M.Sc. in Chemistry/Materials Science with two years of relevant experience in research and development in industrial/academic institutions or S&T organizations and scientific activities and services; Or M.E./M.Tech. in Material Science. Desirable: experience in chemical synthesis of inorganic materials, halide perovskite materials and energy harvesting device fabrications etc. Maximum age: 40 years. Essential qualification: Ph.D. in Chemistry/ Physics/ Materials Science, and five years of relevant experience (post qualification) in research and development in industrial/academic institutions or S&T organizations and scientific activities and services. Desirable: knowledge in hydrometallurgical unit operations, electrochemical leaching, precipitation, roasting and calcination. The relaxation in the age limit is 05 years for SC/ST/PwBD/Women and 03 years for OBC, respectively, or as per Govt. of India instructions issued from time to time. Date of birth in the high school certificate or equivalent is accepted, and no change is allowed after a date of birth is claimed.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Selection is by a preliminary test followed by an interview. Candidates are called for interview after scrutiny of applications, in order of preliminary test merit. The medium is Gujarati unless the Commission decides otherwise. The test is generally held at Gandhinagar/Ahmedabad, and candidates attend at their own expense. A candidate scoring less than 15% in the preliminary test is not eligible for the interview. A Consent Form and Consent Deposit may be taken for appearing in the exam, with detailed instructions published later. The syllabus is on gpsc.gujarat.gov.in and gpsc-ojas.gujarat.gov.in. For 4 or more vacancies, the number of candidates called for interview is 3 times the number of vacancies or 20, whichever is higher. The interview carries 100 marks. Final selection is on 50% weight of the preliminary test marks (out of 300) and 50% weight of the interview marks (out of 100): preliminary marks x 50/300 plus interview marks x 50/100. The final result will be published within 10 working days after the interview is completed.

content_sections.heading: NEDFL Assistant Manager/Deputy Manager-Dairy Plant Job Description
content_sections.text: Monitor processing, quality, maintenance, and dispatch parameters to ensure quality output at minimum cost while adhering to food safety through SOPs. Process milk and milk products by monitoring FAT and SNF input and output to minimize solid loss. Review plant operations continuously and suggest measures for improved productivity. Ensure strict maintenance of product quality and adherence to Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) and Good Hygiene Practices (GHP). Maintain industrial relations, ensure preventive maintenance to minimize breakdowns, and manage pouch milk processing/packaging alongside products like Lassi, Butter Milk, Dahi, Paneer, and Sweets. Work with QA to release products according to specifications, oversee production, QC, and maintenance, and manage inventory of raw materials, packing materials, and finished goods. Facilitate ISO audits, ensure timely statutory requirements, plan and supervise subordinate staff, and monitor civil, mechanical, and electrical project works. Provide technical assistance to dairy infrastructure including BMC centers and arrange employee training.

basic_details.short_information: The ICMR-sponsored NIDAAN project in the Department of Mechanical Engineering, National Institute of Technology Jamshedpur, has one temporary post of Project Research Scientist – I (non-medical) at Rs. 56,000/- per month + 20% HRA if accommodation is not provided. The essential qualification is a Post Graduate Degree, including the integrated PG degrees, or a Four Years Graduate degree for Engineering / IT / CS, as per ICMR non-medical recruitment guidelines. Eligible Indian nationals must email the application to [email protected] on or before 23 November 2026.

how_to_apply: Eligible and interested candidates are encouraged to apply by email for the walk-in interview. The steps below follow the notice.
Fill in the application in the attached format printed on page 2 of the notice.
Prepare the CV and self-attested copies of all supporting documents.
Add a photocopy of the Aadhaar card.
Combine the application, CV, supporting documents and Aadhaar copy into a single PDF file.
Email the PDF to [email protected] with the subject "Application for Project Research Scientist – I under ICMR-NIDAAN".
Send it on or before 23 November 2026.
For more information, Dr. Pranab Kumar Kundu can be contacted at +91 - 8653764707.

The attached format asks for: name, father's or spouse's name, mother's name, gender, marital status, correspondence and permanent address, email ID and phone number, date of birth and age as on the closing date of the advertisement, nationality, category (GEN/SC/ST/OBC, with proof), languages known, and a photograph. It also has a table for 10th, 12th, UG and PG details (university or board, year, subjects, marks or CGPA, class), GATE/NET details if any (score card to be attached), an "any other relevant information" section and a signed declaration.
Application in the attached format
CV
Self-attested copies of all supporting documents
Photocopy of Aadhaar card
Originals of age proof, certificates, degrees, mark sheets and other testimonials, to be presented at the interview

content_sections.text: Provide technical expertise in the planning, design, and implementation of structural mitigation projects funded under NDMF/SDMF. content_sections.heading: SMC Selection Process 2026
content_sections.text: SMC will prepare a waiting list of candidates who meet the prescribed qualification, to fill the currently vacant posts by direct recruitment. The final selection list and waiting list are prepared on the decisions of the Staff Selection Committee under the recruitment rules for each cadre. Candidates attend any test at the place fixed by the Appointment Authority at their own cost; SMC pays no travel expense. If candidates have equal merit, the older candidate gets priority; if age is also equal, educational merit decides.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required

Educational qualification: mark sheets, degree certificate, attempt certificates and registration certificate; a grade-to-percentage conversion certificate of the university where marks are given in grades. Experience certificate on the institution's letterhead with signature and date, showing nature of work and basic and total pay. SC or ST candidates: caste certificate issued by the competent authority of the Gujarat Government. SEBC candidates: Non-Creamy Layer certificate in the Gujarati format of Annexure-4, valid for the financial year and the next three, issued on or after 01-04-2024 and not after the last date. An English Annexure-A certificate is not accepted. EWS candidates: eligibility certificate in the Gujarati format (Annexure-G) issued by the Government of Gujarat, valid for three years and issued by the last date. PwD candidates: disability certificate and UDID (Unique Disability Identity Card). Married women: marriage registration certificate or Government Gazette copy to apply under the husband's name. Candidates in government, semi-government or company service: No Objection Certificate; training or service details; EPIC, PAN card and Aadhaar copies. Originals and one attested copy are submitted at document verification, not at the time of applying.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The payment for services is a fixed monthly amount per post (shown in the vacancy table). The notice also states: Tentative project/work duration is 12 months for each post; the initial tenure of engagement is 12 months, extendable based on the performance of the individual and/or requirement of the project. The engagement may be extended by one year at a time, on the same project only, subject to a satisfactory Annual Performance Review based on Key Performance Indicators. No extension is given beyond the age of 65 years. Where the contract is for more than one year, remuneration may be reviewed annually, based on the escalation received in the client's fee for the previous year. Payment is released within one week after completion of the month, based on attendance registered. There are no statutory benefits such as PF/ESI/Gratuity. Income Tax is deducted at source with TDS certificates issued; Goods and Service Tax, as applicable, is admissible to the consultant. Leave is 1.5 days per completed month, with no accumulation beyond a calendar year; absence up to one month may be considered without remuneration. Women consultants may be eligible for maternity leave under the Maternity Benefit (Amendment) Act, 2017. No TA/DA is admissible for joining the assignment or on its completion. The Individual Consultant has the legal status of an Independent Consultant and is not a staff member or official of RITES Limited; the appointment is of a temporary nature. RITES may terminate the contract at any time without notice or reason, but in the normal course gives one month's notice; the consultant must also give one month's notice to resign.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: The mode of selection is interview only, preceded by document scrutiny. Document Scrutiny/verification: all candidates who submit the online application are provisionally allowed to appear; eligibility for the post applied is verified. Client approval: CVs of candidates found suitable are shared with the client; only those whose CVs are approved receive an Engagement Letter. Actual deployment depends on award of work/project/company requirement. Document scrutiny and interview will be held at RITES Corporate Office, Shikhar, Plot No.01, Sector-29, Gurugram-122001, or through video conferencing/online, with the link sent to the registered email ID/official chat group. content_sections.heading: About NIDM
content_sections.text: The National Institute of Disaster Management is an institute under the Ministry of Home Affairs, Government of India, with its Delhi Campus in Rohini, New Delhi. The post sits in its Building & Maintenance Section, whose purpose is to supervise and coordinate the section's activities and ensure effective maintenance and upkeep of the Institute's assets and facilities.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The notice asks applicants to ensure they meet the eligibility criteria before applying. The post is a single position, and the Terms of Reference list the following. Bachelor's Degree in Civil Engineering from a recognized University/Institution. Serving/Retired Central/State Govt. officers as a Chief Engineer / Superintendent Engineer or in equivalent rank in Pay Level 13 / 14 (7CPC) from PWD/CPWD/DDA and other department. Minimum 25 years of experience in handling in the relevant field, especially projects in Central/State Govt. Proficiency in Computer handling - MS Word, Excel, Power Point, Email. Minimum 25 years' post-qualification experience in maintenance and upkeep of Government buildings, institutional campuses, commercial complexes, or similar infrastructure. Knowledge of Government procurement procedures, General Financial Rules (GFR), 2017, and contract management. Master's Degree in Civil Engineering/ Law/ Management from a recognized University/Institution. Prior working experience in Govt./Training Institute/Disaster Management. Fluency in written and spoken Hindi and English is required. The upper age limit is a maximum of 62 years; the notice prints no cut-off date for counting age and no age relaxation. Candidates should check the official notification for the full Terms of Reference.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: Remuneration, allowances and leave entitlements are as per the provisions laid down in MoF, DoE OM No. 3-25/2020,E.III.A dated 09/12/2020. The notice adds that the remuneration may commensurate with the qualifications, experience and profile of the candidate. The consultancy is initially for 1 year and extendable up to a maximum of 5 years. The engagement is full-time, and the Sr. Consultant shall not take up any other assignment during the period of consultancy in NIDM. The Sr. Consultant reports to the Executive Director, NIDM, and shall complete the assigned tasks in a time-bound manner.

content_sections.heading: NIDM Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: The Terms of Reference list these tasks for the post: Supervise, monitor and coordinate all works for construction, repair, maintenance and upkeep of the upcoming project of the DRR Museum building and café at NIDM, covering civil, electrical, plumbing and other infrastructure works, timely completion, quality control and regular maintenance of the building and its facilities. Oversee the maintenance and upkeep of the Institute's buildings, campus infrastructure and allied facilities. Supervise the operation and maintenance of electrical, mechanical, plumbing, HVAC, fire safety, water supply, sewage and other utility systems. Monitor the execution of annual maintenance contracts (AMCs), comprehensive maintenance contracts (CMCs) and other maintenance works, ensuring compliance with contract terms and conditions. Inspect maintenance works regularly and ensure timely rectification of defects and breakdowns. Coordinate with CPWD, local authorities, service providers, contractors and other agencies for maintenance-related matters. Prepare estimates, technical specifications, maintenance schedules, work orders and inspection reports for routine and special maintenance works. Assist in procurement of maintenance-related materials, equipment and services in accordance with the General Financial Rules (GFR), 2017, and other applicable Government instructions. Maintain records relating to maintenance activities, assets, inspections, repairs, complaints, inventories and contract performance. Ensure compliance with safety standards, statutory requirements, environmental regulations, and fire and electrical safety norms applicable to the Institute. Monitor housekeeping, sanitation, landscaping, waste management and upkeep of common areas. Coordinate preventive and periodic maintenance of Institute assets to ensure uninterrupted functioning of essential services. Prepare periodic reports on maintenance activities, expenditure, pending works and the condition of Institute assets for submission to the Competent Authority. Attend to emergency maintenance requirements and coordinate prompt restoration of essential services. Any other task assigned by the Executive Director, NIDM/Reporting Officer. Promoting the vision of NIDM; advising, leading and supervising; formulating concepts and strategies; managing resources. Demonstrating and safeguarding ethics and integrity; displaying cultural, gender, religion and age sensitivity and adaptability. Ability to work in a team situation and engage diverse stakeholders; ability to plan, organize, implement and report on work. Inter-personal and communication skills; proactive engagement and dialogue; strategic advice and communication; excellent verbal and written communication skills. Proficiency with MS office suite and other software.

content_sections.heading: About the Office
content_sections.text: The notice describes the Office of the Controller General of Patents, Designs & Trade Marks as an office under the Department for Promotion of Industry & Internal Trade (DPIIT), Ministry of Commerce & Industry. It is responsible for the grant of patents and the registration of designs, trade marks, copyright, geographical indications and layout designs of integrated circuits. It also advises the Government on Intellectual Property Rights matters and runs training, capacity building and public outreach programmes. Its office is at Bouddhik Sampada Bhawan, Plot No. 32, Sector 14, Dwarka, New Delhi-110078.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: CGPDTM has advertised 5 positions in total. The notice marks each number with an asterisk and says the competent authority reserves the right to increase or decrease the number of vacancies. It prints no category-wise break-up.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Essential: Master degree in Sciences, or LLM with Graduation in Sciences, or BE/BTech, from an institute of national importance or equivalent reputed Institution/University. Desirable: Ph.D. in Sciences/IPR Management, or MTech/MS. Experience: at least 15 years in handling IPR matters. Upper age: 65 years. Essential: Master degree in Sciences, or BE/B. Tech, or MBA, from an institute of national importance or equivalent reputed Institution/University. Desirable: (a) Ph.D. in Sciences/Law; or (b) professional working knowledge of IPR management, or MTech, M.Sc. with working knowledge in IPR and policy matters. Knowledge of MS Office, PowerPoint presentations with graphs, infographic displays, trend analysis and data governance and quality assessment software tools is preferred; or (c) LLB/LLM, or Degree/Diploma in IPR (full time, at least 1 year), or training and development experience from a reputed institution. Experience: at least 3 years in handling IPR matters. Upper age: 48 years. Essential: Graduation/Post-graduation in Law, or MBA in international business with domain knowledge in required areas, from an institute of national importance or equivalent reputed Institution/University. Desirable: Ph.D. in Law & IP field. Experience: at least 1-year Law & IP field research experience, preferably in IPR matters. The notice adds that the individual should have knowledge of handling legal work, drafting of rules, regulations and replies in court matters. Upper age: 35 years. Essential: MBA or PGDM (full time, 2 years course) in the discipline of Finance from an institute of national importance or equivalent reputed Institution. Desirable: higher qualification in the field of finance. Experience: at least one-year relevant experience, preferably in a government department/institution/office. Upper age: 35 years. Only post-qualification experience gained after completing the minimum essential qualification for the post applied is counted as effective experience. Experience also includes up to 3 years for Ph.D. holders, provided no other work experience is counted during those three years. Candidates who applied under the public notice dated 01.02.2026 or 05.05.2026 need not reapply, as they remain ineligible for the current recruitment year. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility wording of each post.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The notice lists the remuneration per month as ₹1,25,000 for the Consultant, ₹90,000 for each Research Associate and ₹70,000 for each Young Professional. An annual increment of 10% is granted subject to completion of the period with satisfactory performance. If a contract runs beyond one year, the remuneration may be reviewed annually on the recommendation of a Review Committee. The engagement is initially for one year and is extendable up to 03 years, one year at a time, subject to a satisfactory Annual Performance Review based on Key Performance Indicators. No extension will be granted after three years. Payment is released within one week after the month ends, based on biometric attendance or on certification by the concerned Head of Office for staff placed at another location. Tax is deducted at source and a TDS Certificate is issued. GST, as applicable, is admissible to the contractual staff. Working hours are normally 9:30 AM to 6:00 PM on working days. Staff may be asked to sit late or attend on Saturdays, Sundays and other holidays. Paid leave is 1.5 days for each completed month. Accumulation beyond a year may not be allowed. Absence up to one month for a valid reason may be considered without remuneration. Women contractual staff may be considered for maternity leave of up to 26 weeks, without pay. For domestic tours approved by the competent authority, air travel in Economy class or rail in AC Two Tier is allowed. Hotel up to Rs. 2250 per day, taxi up to Rs. 338 per day for travel within the city, and food up to Rs. 900 per day are allowed as per Government of India Level-10 eligibility.

content_sections.heading: About the Centre
content_sections.text: VJTI describes itself in the notice as one of the oldest engineering institutes in India, established in 1887, an autonomous institute of the Government of Maharashtra and affiliated to Mumbai University. The advertised posts sit under its Centre of Excellence in Complex and Non-linear Dynamical Systems, where the work is on securing Industrial Control Systems used in the energy sector against cyber-attacks. The notice names a multi-disciplinary problem covering ICS and SCADA, power systems, drone systems and control technologies, and digital twin for real-time monitoring and predictive analytics in the electricity grid.

content_sections.text: The notice says the essential qualifications are as per lead institute norms. Candidates should have exposure to one or more areas of ICS and SCADA and a Power System background. The candidate should have knowledge of Hardware/Embedded security and some working knowledge in PSSE or PSCAD along with MTech in Power. The period of experience in a discipline or area of work, wherever prescribed, is counted after the date of acquiring the minimum prescribed educational qualification for that position. A candidate who claims a qualification as equivalent must produce the order or letter, with the authority's number and date, under which it is treated as equivalent. The project offers exposure to state of the art technologies, hardware and software tools, and hands-on experience. The candidate works in an interdisciplinary team, with the ability of critical thinking, logical reasoning and an innovative mind-set. The job profile also involves site visits and interaction with the funding agency and research partners. The candidate prepares progress reports, white papers and research publications, and contributes to achieving the deliverables of the project.

content_sections.text: CPCL offers IDA pay scales with initial basic pay ranging from Rs. 30,000 to Rs. 90,000 per month , according to the selected position and grade. In addition to basic pay, eligible employees receive Industrial Dearness Allowance, HRA, cafeteria allowance, conveyance maintenance, performance-related pay, provident fund, gratuity, medical benefits, leave travel benefits and other applicable allowances under CPCL rules. Salary Clarification: CTC includes various employer benefits and performance-related components. It should not be treated as take-home salary. No pay protection is admissible under the notified conditions.

content_sections.heading: CPCL Executive Recruitment 2026 Application Fee
content_sections.text: The application fee is Rs. 500 for General, EWS and OBC-NCL candidates . SC, ST, PwBD, Ex-Servicemen and women candidates are exempt from payment. Payment Mode: SBI e-pay using Debit Card, Credit Card, UPI or Net Banking, as available through the application facility. Payment Deadline: 3 December 2026. The fee is non-refundable, except for applicable reversal of duplicate deductions caused by technical issues as described in the portal instructions. Additional bank charges, if any, must be borne by the candidate.

content_sections.heading: CPCL Executive Recruitment 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: The selection process differs between Post Codes CPCL01 to CPCL07 and CPCL08. Applicants should prepare according to the assessment pattern applicable to their chosen position. Computer Based Test (CBT). Shortlisting based on CBT performance. Group Discussion / Group Task. Personal Interview. Document Verification. Pre-Employment Medical Examination. Computer Based Test (CBT). Skill Test. Personal Interview. Document Verification. Medical Examination. Manager/Senior Manager (Secretarial) candidates will be shortlisted based on qualification, experience and overall suitability, followed by Group Discussion/Group Task and Personal Interview. The official notification does not prescribe a CBT for CPCL08.

content_sections.heading: CPCL Executive CBT Exam Pattern 2026
content_sections.text: The CBT for Post Codes CPCL01 to CPCL07 consists of 120 objective questions carrying 120 marks , with a duration of two hours. The General Aptitude section covers: Verbal Ability General Knowledge Reasoning and Logical Deduction Numerical Ability

content_sections.heading: CPCL Executive Final Selection Weightage 2026
content_sections.text: Qualifying marks must be secured separately in the applicable CBT and Personal Interview stages. Merely obtaining the qualifying marks does not guarantee selection, because final merit depends on the prescribed weighted assessment.

content_sections.heading: CPCL Executive Service Bond 2026
content_sections.text: Selected candidates appointed under Post Codes CPCL01 to CPCL07 must execute a service bond to serve CPCL for a minimum period of three years from the date of joining.

content_sections.heading: CPCL Executive Apply Online 2026
content_sections.text: Eligible candidates can apply online for the 41 Executive vacancies from 4 November to 3 December 2026 . Official Website: Chennai Petroleum Corporation Limited Detailed Notification: Application Last Date: 3 December 2026. Candidates must apply for only one post using their active personal email address and mobile number.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply Online for CPCL Executive Recruitment 2026?
content_sections.text: Visit the official CPCL website at www.cpcl.co.in . Open the Careers or Recruitment section. Find . Open the official Executive Recruitment application link. Read the instructions and accept the declaration checkbox. Click Continue . Select the eligible position from the Post Applying for dropdown. Enter the required basic personal information. Verify the email address and mobile number using OTP. Submit the new user registration form. Save the generated User ID and Password. Log in using the registration credentials. Complete Personal Details, including parents' names, marital status, identity proof and address information. Click Save and Continue. Enter Academic Details and the relevant qualification information. Enter mandatory post-qualification Work Experience details. Upload the scanned passport-size photograph. Upload the scanned signature. Upload the required documents and certificates in PDF format. Open the Preview section and verify all entered information. Use the Edit option to correct mistakes before final submission. Click Proceed to Payment and accept the required declaration. Submit the application. Details cannot be changed after final submission. Pay the applicable registration fee through the payment gateway, if required. Download the submitted application form and payment receipt from the candidate dashboard. Complete all required steps by 3 December 2026 . Important: Do not submit applications for multiple posts. CPCL permits only one post per candidate and does not refund registration fees paid for multiple applications.

content_sections.heading: CPCL Executive Recruitment 2026 Documents Required
content_sections.text: Candidates must upload the documents requested by the application portal and produce original supporting certificates during document verification. Educational degree certificates and all relevant marksheets. Class 10 or Higher Secondary certificate for age verification. Relevant post-qualification work experience certificates. Valid photo identity proof. Recent passport-size photograph. Scanned signature. SC/ST/OBC-NCL/EWS certificate, where applicable. PwBD disability certificate, where applicable. Ex-Servicemen certificate, where applicable. ICSI Associate Membership and examination records for CPCL08. Relevant degree specialization evidence, where required. Official CGPA-to-percentage conversion proof, where applicable. No Objection Certificate for eligible Government/PSU employees. Additional documents requested by CPCL for verification. The final upload requirements should be checked against the Executive Recruitment application instructions and the applicable fields before submission.

content_sections.heading: CPCL Executive Reservation and Certificate Requirements
content_sections.text: Reservation is available according to Government of India rules and the post-wise allocation in the notification. Candidates claiming OBC Non-Creamy Layer reservation must possess a valid Central Government format certificate issued by the competent authority on or after 1 April 2026 . OBC candidates belonging to the creamy layer are not eligible for OBC-NCL reservation benefits. Applicants claiming EWS reservation must provide the prescribed Income and Asset Certificate issued by the competent authority on or after 1 April 2026 . PwBD reservation applies only to identified functional disability categories suitable for each post. Eligible candidates must possess the prescribed disability certificate. As CPCL operates hazardous industrial facilities, the notification specifies post-wise functional requirements and identified disability categories. Applicants must check the relevant table on pages 3 and 4 before claiming suitability or reservation.

content_sections.heading: CPCL Executive Admit Card and CBT Examination 2026
content_sections.text: CPCL will make CBT admit cards available through its recruitment website. The tentative release period is approximately 10 days before the examination . Candidates will be required to download the call letter using the prescribed login credentials and follow the instructions regarding photograph, original photo ID and other documents. Admit cards will not be sent by post. The CBT is tentatively scheduled for December 2026 or January 2027, with Chennai as the proposed examination location.
