content_sections.heading: About IPRCL
content_sections.text: Indian Port Rail & Ropeway Corporation Limited is a Joint Venture Company between 11 Major Ports under the Ministry of Ports, Shipping and Waterways, which hold 90% of the equity, and Rail Vikas Nigam Limited under the Ministry of Railways, which holds 10%. It was set up to provide efficient rail evacuation systems to Major Ports and to raise their capacity and throughput. It was registered on 10th July 2015 as a Public Limited Company under the Companies Act, 2013. Its Corporate Office is in Mazgaon, Mumbai, and its Registered Office is in Lodhi Road, New Delhi.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Applications are invited from Indian citizens. The crucial date for eligibility with reference to age, essential educational qualification and length of experience is 04.12.2026. Full time Degree in Electrical Engineering from a recognized University. The educational qualification is not applicable for candidates applying on deputation. Required experience: Execution of Infrastructure Projects. Only experience gained after the minimum educational qualification counts towards eligibility. Preferred experience: working in Railway Electric Traction Projects, General Power Supply Projects, Air Conditioning, Building electrifications, Roads Lightings etc. Officers should be presently working on regular basis (on absorption) or on contract basis in Railways, other Govt. departments, Central PSUs, Ports, JV Companies under Govt. Control or a Private Company, subject to the following: CDA scale officers: working in PB-3 (15600-39100) + GP 6600/- (pre-revised 6th CPC), revised to matrix level 11 under 7th CPC; OR working in PB-2/3 + GP Rs. 4800/5400 (pre-revised 6th CPC), revised to matrix level 8/9 under 7th CPC, with minimum 04 years in Group 'A' or minimum 08 years of Group 'B' service in the grades. IDA scale officers: working in IDA scale Rs. 32900-58000 (pre-revised 2nd PRC), revised to 80000-220000 under 3rd PRC, with minimum 08 years of Managerial/Executive level service; OR working in IDA scale Rs. 29100-54500 (pre-revised 2nd PRC), revised to 70000-200000 under 3rd PRC, for a period of 02 years and with minimum 8 years of Managerial/Executive level service. Deputation, regular CDA officers: working in Senior Scale, i.e. PB-3/GP 6600 (pre-revised 6th CPC) revised to matrix level 11 (7th CPC), with 05 years of Group A service; or in Senior Scale with 8 years of Group B service; or GP 5400 with 11 years in Group B service. Private company officials: working at the level of JGM equivalent and above with a minimum gross salary of at least Rs.1.25 lacs per month; Managerial level service experience of at least 12 years; and working in a company engaged in Execution of Infrastructure Projects/Railway works whose Sales Turnover for the preceding year is at least Rs. 200 Crs. Higher grade pay or pay scale granted under ACP/MACP/NF by the parent department is not taken into account for these criteria. Employees presently working on the rolls of IPRCL get age relaxation over the upper age limit to the extent of their service in IPRCL, subject to meeting all other eligibility criteria. The applicant should be physically and medically fit. On selection, the candidate will have to undergo a medical examination as per the corporation's policy. Candidates should check the official notification (Annexure-I) for the full eligibility of the post.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: On Absorption: IDA Scale of pay Rs. 80000-220000/- + Applicable Allowances + PRP (for IDA as per Policy). On Deputation: Parent Pay & Allowances + Deputation Duty Allowance + Other Allowances applicable to deputationist as per Company Policy. Statutory deductions for EPF (employees' share), Income Tax, Professional Tax etc. apply as per rules. Terms of appointment: On Absorption OR On Deputation for 03 years, extendable further as per rules, subject to extension of exemption from the rule of immediate absorption beyond 01.11.2028 by Ministry/DPE. Service conditions follow the Offer of Appointment, HR Policies of IPRCL and orders issued by IPRCL from time to time. A three-month advance notice is required before seeking resignation from IPRCL. Posting is tentatively at Mumbai or Bhubaneswar, but the officer can be posted anywhere in India.

content_sections.heading: About IPRCL
content_sections.text: Indian Port Rail & Ropeway Corporation Limited describes itself as a first of its kind Joint Venture Company between 11 Major Ports under the Ministry of Ports, Shipping and Waterways, holding 90% of the equity, and Rail Vikas Nigam Limited under the Ministry of Railways, holding 10%. It was incorporated to provide efficient rail evacuation systems to Major Ports and to enhance their capacity and throughput. The company was registered on 10th July 2015 as a Public Limited Company under the Companies Act, 2013; its Corporate Office is in Mazgaon, Mumbai and its Registered Office is at NBCC Place, Lodhi Road, New Delhi.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Applications go only on paper, by post / courier or dropped personally, to this address: Chief General Manager (HR), Indian Port Rail & Ropeway Corporation Ltd (IPRCL), 4th Floor, Nirman Bhavan, Mumbai Port Trust Building, M.P. Road, Mazgaon (E), Mumbai- 400010. Use Annexure-II (Application Form for applying on absorption only) or Annexure-III (Application Format for Deputation), both printed with the notice. Write "Application for the post of ______" on the top of the envelope, filling in the post applied for. Candidates currently serving in Railways, other Govt. departments, Central PSUs, Ports or JV Companies under Govt. Control must submit the application with enclosures through proper channel only, along with photocopies of their last 05 years APARs. No column of the application form should be left blank; otherwise the form may be rejected. The particulars given in the form are treated as final. A candidate eligible for both posts who wishes to apply for more than one post must submit a separate application for each post. The last date for submission of the application is 4 December 2026. IPRCL will not be held responsible if a candidate cannot submit the application by the last date for whatever reason.

Required experience (both posts): Execution of Infrastructure Projects. Preferred experience (both posts): Experience of working in Railway Electric Traction Projects, General Power Supply Projects, Air Conditioning, Building electrifications, Roads lighting etc. Statutory deductions for EPF (Employees' share), Income Tax, Professional Tax, etc. apply as per rules. The crucial date for eligibility with reference to age, essential educational qualification and length of experience is 4 December 2026. Only experience gained after obtaining the minimum educational qualification is counted. Control or a Private Company, subject to the conditions below. Higher grade pay or pay scale granted under ACP/MACP/NF by the parent department is not taken into account. content_sections.heading: About ABV-IIITM
content_sections.text: ABV-IIITM Gwalior describes itself in the notice as an autonomous institute under MHRD, Govt. of India. The internship sits in a project supervised by Dr. Anjali, Assistant Professor (IT). The Principal Investigators are Dr. Anjali and Dr. Mahendra Kumar Shukla. The project aims to develop an Edge-AI enabled multimodal smart health monitoring system that integrates ECG, PPG, IMU and temperature sensors for continuous physiological monitoring and early anomaly detection. The proposed Cyber-Physical System performs real-time, low-latency analytics on edge devices using lightweight AI models, with secure Edge–Cloud connectivity.

Therefore, only candidates stationed at Gwalior will be considered. For the discipline-specific eligibility, candidates should refer to the official notification.

content_sections.heading: NLC India GET Reservation and Certificate Requirements
content_sections.text: Reservation and age relaxation are governed by Government of India rules. Candidates claiming reservation must upload the appropriate certificates issued by the competent authority. OBC-NCL candidates must produce a valid Non-Creamy Layer certificate obtained on or after 1 April 2026 at document verification. EWS candidates must produce a valid Income and Asset Certificate obtained on or after 1 April 2026 . PwBD candidates must possess the applicable disability certificate or UDID card. Suitability depends on the engineering discipline and the identified disability categories listed in Annexure I. The notification identifies no PwBD suitability category for Mining Engineering.

content_sections.heading: NLC India GET Document Verification and Medical Fitness
content_sections.text: Shortlisted candidates will be called for document verification before the Personal Interview. They must produce original qualification certificates, GATE 2025 scorecard, category certificates and other applicable records. Candidates employed in Government, Central/State PSUs or qualifying organizations must submit the required No Objection Certificate. Finally selected candidates must undergo a pre-employment medical examination and be declared medically fit according to NLCIL standards before appointment.

content_sections.heading: NLC India GET Recruitment 2026 Important Instructions
content_sections.text: NLC India has announced 143 Graduate Executive Trainee vacancies. Recruitment is based on GATE 2025 scores. Only Mechanical, Electrical, Civil and Mining disciplines are notified. Online registration opens on 13 November 2026. The last date for registration is 14 December 2026. The fee payment deadline is 14 December 2026 at 11:45 PM. Eligible registered and paid candidates can complete final submission by 16 December 2026. Qualifications and reservation eligibility are assessed as on 1 November 2026. Minimum aggregate marks are 60% for UR/EWS/OBC-NCL and 50% for SC/ST, subject to the applicable vacancy conditions. The applicant must choose one recruitment area. GATE 2025 contributes 80 marks and the Personal Interview contributes 20 marks. Shortlisting is separate for each area. Training lasts one year in E-2 Grade. Successful trainees are absorbed into E-3 Grade as notified. A Rs. 3 lakh service bond applies for three years of service after training. Transfer requests are restricted during the first three years from joining. Application fees are non-refundable. Original documents and medical fitness are mandatory. NLCIL may increase, decrease or cancel vacancies according to its requirements.

content_sections.heading: About NWDA
content_sections.text: The National Water Development Agency (NWDA) is an Autonomous Body registered under the Society Registration Act, 1860, under the Ministry of Jal Shakti, Department of Water Resources, River Development & Ganga Rejuvenation, Government of India. The Director General is the Executive Head of the Agency. The vacancy notice is issued by the Department from Shram Shakti Bhavan, Rafi Marg, New Delhi.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The NWDA Director General post can be filled in two ways, and each route has its own eligibility. Both routes require the same educational qualification and experience. Officers under the departments of Central Government/State Governments who meet any one of these service conditions: Holding an analogous post on regular basis in the parent cadre/department; or Having 3 years' regular service in the grade rendered after appointment thereto on regular basis in Level-14 of the Pay Matrix (Rs. 1,44,200-2,18,200) or equivalent in the parent cadre/department; or Officers with 25 years' regular service in Group 'A' posts, out of which at least one year regular service should be in Level-14 of the Pay Matrix or equivalent posts in the parent cadre/department; and possessing the following educational qualification and experience: Degree in Civil Engineering or equivalent qualification from a recognized university/Institution. Having worked extensively in the field of Water Resources with at least 20 years of professional experience in surveys, investigations, planning and preparation of project reports, design and construction of major irrigation, hydro-electric, flood control and multipurpose projects, of which at least 10 years' experience should be in the senior management level. Candidates belonging to organisations other than those specified for deputation, possessing the following qualification and experience: Degree in Civil Engineering or equivalent qualification from a recognized University/Institution. Having worked extensively in the field of Water Resources with at least 20 years of professional experience in surveys, investigations, planning and preparation of project reports, design and construction of major irrigation, hydro-electric, flood control and multipurpose projects, of which at least 10 years' experience should be in the senior management level. The maximum age limit for appointment on deputation (including short-term contract) is 58 years as on the closing date for receipt of applications. The notice does not mention any age relaxation. The officer should not have been on Deputation/Foreign Service during the last one year, counted till the last date for receipt of applications. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions of the post.

Period of deputation, including the period of deputation in another ex-cadre post held immediately preceding this appointment in the same or some other organisation/department of the Central Government, shall ordinarily not exceed 5 years. The terms and conditions of the selected officer as Director General, NWDA, shall be governed by the DoP&T's Consolidated Guidelines dated 28.03.2024 on "Regulation of Terms & Conditions Governing Deputation/Foreign Service of Employees to/from Central Government", as amended from time to time. Place of posting: New Delhi.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: The selection process comprises three stages: Shortlisting, Interview, and CTC Negotiation. Shortlisting: Fulfilling minimum eligibility criteria does not guarantee a call for interview. The shortlisting committee constituted by the Bank will decide shortlisting parameters to call an adequate number of candidates. Interview (100 Marks): The interview carries 100 marks. For the posts of GM & Chief AI officer, DGM (Risk and Operational Analytics), DGM (AI Governance and Compliance), and DGM (Data Engineering, Model Application Dev and AI Ops), shortlisted candidates must deliver a 10-minute presentation on their relevant job profile, projects undertaken, or milestones achieved. Qualifying marks in the interview are decided by the Bank. Intimation or call letters for the interview will be uploaded on the Bank's website or sent by email; no hard copy will be sent. CTC Negotiation: CTC negotiation is conducted one-by-one with candidates at the time of interview or separately after the interview process. Merit List: The final merit list is prepared in descending order based solely on scores obtained in the interview. In case of a tie in cut-off marks, candidates are ranked according to age in descending order. Travelling Allowance for Interview: Outstation candidates called for interview after shortlisting will be reimbursed the cost of travelling by Air fare (Economy Class) for the shortest route in India as follows: GM & Chief AI officer and all three DGM posts (Sl. No. 1 to 4): Reimbursement of actual Air Fare (Economy Class). AI Solution Architect and Enterprise AI Architect (Sl. No. 5 & 6): Reimbursement of Air Fare up to Rs. 15,000/- (Total for both sides) or actual fare, whichever is lower. Note: In case a candidate called for interview is found not satisfying the eligibility criteria (Age, Educational Qualification, Experience, etc.), he/she will neither be allowed to appear for the interview nor be entitled to reimbursement of any travelling expenses.

content_sections.heading: About APGENCO
content_sections.text: APGENCO was incorporated under the Indian Companies Act, 1956 as a wholly owned State Government Company and is engaged in power generation in Andhra Pradesh. According to the notification, its installed capacity is 8789 MW, made up of 6610 MW Thermal, 1773.6 MW Hydro and 405.4 MW Solar power stations. Besides operating and maintaining its power plants, it is executing new projects under its capacity addition programme and renovating older power stations. Andhra Pradesh Power Development Corporation Limited (APPDCL) and APSPCL are its subsidiaries.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Bachelor's degree in Engineering i.e., BE/B.Tech (Electrical/ Mechanical/ Mining) from a recognized University/ Institute /equivalent Degree in the subject directly relevant to the position. Post Graduate in Engineering in the same discipline/MBA of 2 years duration/ Ph.D., from a recognised University/institution. At least 25 years of professional experience in the Coal/Thermal sector with Central/State Government/Public Sector undertakings. Of these 25 years, at least 15 years of experience in Construction, Designing, Development, Operation & Maintenance of Thermal Power Plants/Coal mines. Of these 15 years, at least 3 years of cumulative service at senior level positions of General Manager/Superintending Engineer and Chief Engineer/Chief General Manager/Executive Director, or an equivalent rank, in the Central/State Government/Public Sector Undertakings of the Coal/Thermal sector, as on the date of Notification. OR Officers of Organized Group 'A' Services (such as IRTS/IRMS etc.) of the Central Government/State Government working at the appropriate level are exempted from the educational qualifications above. They should have at least 5 years of cumulative experience at a senior level during the last ten years in Coal Procurement/Coal Linkage Management, Coal Mining, Railway Freight and Rake Management, Port Operations, Transportation and Logistics, Fuel Supply Agreements, Coal Quality Management, Materials/Supply Chain Management, and/or associated Commercial and Contract Management functions. They have to work on deputation as per the terms and conditions of deputation of their parent department. The maximum age for the APGENCO Director (Coal & Logistics) post is 65 years, as on the date of Notification (2 November 2026). The notice does not mention any age relaxation. The candidate should have sound health. In the application's declaration, the applicant certifies that he or she has not been disqualified to act as a Director under Section 274 or any other relevant section of the Indian Companies Act, 1956. The applicant also certifies that he or she is not facing any charge of, nor has ever been convicted for, any act of moral turpitude or economic offence. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions of the post.

content_sections.heading: About IOL
content_sections.text: India Optel Limited is a Schedule B Central Public Sector Enterprise under the administrative jurisdiction of the Department of Defence Production, Ministry of Defence, with its registered office at OFILDD Campus, Raipur, Dehradun-248008. It has 3 production units: Ordnance Factory Chandigarh, Ordnance Factory Dehradun and Opto-Electronics Factory Dehradun. Its products include sights for T-90S (BHISHMA), Tank T-72 M1 (AJEYA) and ICV BMP-II (SARATH), along with artillery and surveillance sights, assault rifle and small arms sights, cables, the Commander Thermal Imager and periscopes. As on 31 March 2026, its authorized and paid up capital stood at Rs. 6500 Crores and Rs. 5958.64 Crores, with 04 regular employees at Board of Director level and 2275 employees on deemed deputation.

content_sections.heading: IOL Chairman & Managing Director Vacancy Details 2026
content_sections.text: The vacancy arose on 1 June 2026.

content_sections.heading: Job Role and Responsibilities
content_sections.text: The Chairman & Managing Director is the Chief Executive of the company, accountable to the Board of Directors and the Government of India, and responsible for its efficient functioning and for meeting its corporate objectives and performance parameters. Liaise with important customers and Central Government Authorities, particularly the Department of Defence Production and the Defence Research & Development Organization. Maintain close liaison with the three Service Headquarters on ongoing Defence projects, and develop further business in night vision and laser sighting devices. Liaise with State Government Authorities, heads of other Public Sector Undertakings, customers, collaborators, and commercial and financial institutions. Provide overall leadership on indigenization and import substitution, exports, business development and marketing, defence production, modernization, R&D and innovation.

content_sections.heading: IOL Chairman & Managing Director Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: Age is counted on the date of occurrence of vacancy, and the age of superannuation is 60 years. The same limits apply to internal candidates and others. The applicant should be an Engineering Graduate/ Chartered Accountant/ Cost Accountant/ Post Graduate/Graduate with MBA/ PGDIM from a leading institute. The applicant should meet one of these two requirements: Cumulative experience/exposure for at least 5 years during the last 10 years in Finance, Business Development, Production, Operations, Marketing, Project Management or Research & Development in an Industry of repute. Cumulative 5 years of experience in HR/IR/Personnel Management, along with at least 3 years experience during the last 10 years in any of the above core areas. Applicants with experience in the Electronics/Opto-Electronics/Instrumentation/Communication Industry will be preferred. On both the date of application and the date of interview, the applicant must be employed in a regular capacity, not a contractual or ad-hoc one, in one of the following: A Central Public Sector Enterprise, including as a full-time functional Director on its Board. Central Government Group 'A' service, including the Armed Forces of the Union and All India Services, or a Public Sector bank, Financial Institution or Autonomous Body. A State Public Sector Enterprise with annual turnover of Rs 750 Crore or more. A Private Sector Company, Joint Venture or National or State Level Cooperative Federation with annual turnover of Rs. 750 crore or more. The minimum service required in the eligible scale is one year for internal candidates and two years for others as on the date of vacancy. Eligible officers of the Indian Ordnance Factories Services are treated as internal candidates. See the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of this post.

content_sections.heading: About DA&FW Senior Agricultural Engineer
content_sections.text: The Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare functions under the Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare from Krishi Bhawan, New Delhi. The Senior Agricultural Engineer posts are at its Farm Machinery Training and Testing Institutes: the Central Farm Machinery Training and Testing Institute at Budni (Madhya Pradesh) and the Northern Region, Southern Region and North Eastern Region institutes at Hisar (Haryana), Anantapur (Andhra Pradesh) and Biswanath Chariali (Assam).

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: The application must be routed through proper channel and sent directly to this address: Under Secretary (M&T), Room No. 12A, Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare, Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare, Krishi Bhawan, Dr. Rajendra Prasad Road, New Delhi -110001 The notice does not mention a postal mode or any text to write on the envelope. Advance copies of applications, applications received after the closing date and applications not accompanied by the required certificates/documents are liable to be rejected.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: There are two posts of Senior Agricultural Engineer, classified as General Central Service, Group 'A' Gazetted, Non-Ministerial, in Pay Level - 11 (Rs. 67700-208700) in pay matrix. The number of vacancies is tentative and may be decreased or increased at the discretion of the Competent Authority. Officers under the Central Government or State Governments or Union Territory administrations or public sector undertakings or agricultural universities or recognised research institutions or councils or semi-government or autonomous bodies or statutory organisations who are: (i) holding analogous posts on regular basis in the parent cadre or department; or (ii) with five years' service in the level rendered after appointment thereto on a regular basis in posts in Level -10 (Rs. 56100-177500) in the pay matrix or equivalent in the parent cadre or department; or (iii) with seven years' service in the level rendered after appointment thereto on a regular basis in posts in Level -7 (Rs. 44900-142400) in the pay matrix or equivalent in the parent cadre or department; and who possess the educational qualification and experience below. Degree in Agricultural Engineering or Mechanical Engineering from a recognised University or Institute; and Five years' experience in operation and maintenance of tractors, agricultural machinery and allied equipment's including teaching experience in any Government or private listed organisation; or five years' experience in handling independently testing and evaluation of farm machinery and agricultural implements in any Government or private listed organisation. Post Graduate Degree in Agricultural Engineering from a recognised University or Institute. The maximum age limit for appointment by deputation (including short term contract) shall not be exceeding 56 years as on the closing date of receipt of applications. The notice prints no age relaxation. Departmental Officers in the feeder category who are in direct line of promotion will not be eligible for consideration for appointment on deputation. Deputationists shall not be eligible for consideration for appointment by promotion. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions of the post.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Curriculum vitae (in triplicate) in the Annexure-II proforma. Attested photocopies of Annual Performance Appraisal Reports for the last five years, attested by an officer not below the rank of Under Secretary (Annexure-III also allows the CR Dossier in original). Vigilance Clearance/Integrity Certificate/Cadre Clearance Certificate. Statement giving details of major or minor penalties imposed on the officer, if any, during the last 10 years (Annexure-III). Declaration by Applicant (Annexure-IV). Latest salary slip showing basic pay, Dearness Pay/Interim relief/other allowances and total emoluments, when the applicant's organisation does not follow Central Government pay scales. A separate sheet, authenticated by signature, if the space for employment details or additional information is insufficient.

content_sections.heading: Terms of Deputation
content_sections.text: The deputation will be initially for a period of one year, but is extendable as per DoPT's guidelines. The period of deputation will include deputation in another ex-cadre post held immediately before this appointment in the same or some other organisation or department in the Central Government. The appointment will not give the appointee on deputation any claim for regular appointment. The deputation is subject to DoP&T circulars, especially the terms in DoP&T's OM No. 6/8/2009 Estt. (Pay II) dated 17.06.2010 and its subsequent amendments. Place of posting can be the Farm Machinery Training and Testing Institute at Budni (Madhya Pradesh) or Hisar (Haryana) or Anantapur (Andhra Pradesh) or Biswanath Chariali (Assam) or the Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare (Hqrs).

content_sections.text: The Ministry of Heavy Industries is a ministry of the Government of India. Its HEI Division at GPOA - 3, New Delhi, issued this notice to engage one Consultant Grade-II for specific and time-bound tasks of the Ministry. The work centres on the Electrical Equipment Quality Control Order (QCO) for Low Voltage Switchgears and Controlgears, electrical equipment standardization and trade-related technical matters. The notice states that applications shall be sent through email and through the Google Sheet at https://forms.gle/xz1Z3TPiGA56gUgz9 . The email addresses printed in the notice are: [email protected] – Director (HEI) [email protected] – Deputy Secretary (HEI-Technical) [email protected] – Under Secretary (HEI) The Annexure-I form asks for: name, date of birth, father's name, nationality, address for communication, permanent address, phone number, email address, educational qualification (course, subject, university/institute, year of passing, marks %) and post-qualification work experience (organisation name and contact details for verification, period from and to, post held, job responsibilities, reason for leaving), with a recent photo, the candidate's signature, date and place.

Tech in Electrical / Electronics Engineering (EEE/ECE/EE) or any other branch or equivalent stream from a reputed and Govt. recognized Institution. Desirable: PhD/M. Tech in Electrical / Electronic's Engineering (EEE/ECE/EE) /MBA or equivalent stream from a reputed and Govt. recognized Institution. Minimum of 8 (Eight) years post essential qualification experience relevant to the job description. Preference will be given to persons with sufficient domain knowledge and experience in the implementation of Technical Regulations / Quality Control Orders (QCO) and Electrical Industry Sector / Public Policy domain / International Trade Related matters, monitoring of projects & schemes etc. Under the attached MHI guidelines, experience includes up to 3 years for a Ph.D. holder, provided no work experience is counted during those 3 years. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions of the post. The remuneration is Rs.1,45,000/- per month, released as a consolidated amount on the basis of biometric attendance or certification by the Division. content_sections.heading: MHI Consultant Grade-II Job Description
content_sections.text: Oversee and manage all activities related to the implementation of the Electrical Equipment Quality Control Order (QCO) for Low Voltage Switchgears and Controlgears. Coordinate with industry stakeholders, BIS, testing labs, departments/ministries and other agencies to ensure effective implementation of regulations and policies. Participate, examine and prepare inputs/proposals for BIS Sectoral Committees for electrical equipment standardization. Prepare comprehensive procedures for clarifying QCO product classifications with customs. Examine and prepare proposals or suggest initiatives to address and mitigate the impacts of supply chain constraints. Develop concept notes for initiatives aimed at enhancing the electrical equipment sector. Formulate and evaluate public policy for the electrical equipment industry, including examining draft cabinet notes, policies, schemes, FDI proposals and the registration of bidders under GFR 144(XI). Examine and prepare inputs/proposals related to Technical Barriers to Trade or Non-Tariff Measures for Free Trade Agreements (FTA), Preferential Trade Agreements (PTA) and WTO TBT negotiations for the Department of Commerce (DoC) and DPIIT. Technical examination of Cabinet Notes/EFC/PIB/DIB of all matters except clean technology. Technical examination of Concept Note/Feasibility Report/Bills/Acts/MoU, etc. of all matters except clean technology.

content_sections.text: National Institute of Technology Silchar is an Institute of National Importance in Silchar, Assam. The JRF will work in its Department of Civil Engineering under Principal Investigator Dr. Dinesh P. The notice describes the project as follows: it studies the strength and permeability of geothermal rocks under different heat treatments using laboratory tests, and numerical models will be developed to understand heat, fluid flow, rock behaviour, and possible earthquakes caused by water and CO₂ injection.

content_sections.heading: About BCCL
content_sections.text: Bharat Coking Coal Limited is a Mini Ratna company and a subsidiary of Coal India Limited, with its office at Koylanagar, Dhanbad, Jharkhand. This notification has been issued by the EE Department, Office of the General Manager, and is signed by the Dy. General Manager (HR/EE), BCCL.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The post is open only to retired E-8/E9 grade executives of the Excavation discipline from CIL/Subsidiary Companies or an equivalent Public Sector Undertaking/autonomous organisation of the Central/State Government. VRS optees will not be considered. The cut-off date for eligibility is 30 September 2026. Engineering graduate in Mining Machinery/Mechanical Engineering/Electrical Engineering (BE/B.Tech). Retired E8/E9 Grade executive of Excavation Discipline with experience in the following works/jobs: Extensive work experience in HEMM maintenance and management for at least 25 years in Opencast Mining Projects. Leadership roles in policy-making at corporate level/Head Quarters of CIL/its subsidiaries/any PSU in the capacity of Head of the department (Excavation/Mechanical) for a period of minimum 1 year, with the experience of HEMM procurement and review of HEMM management. Knowledge: Sound knowledge of DGMS regulations, CIL/BCCL policies, HEMM management and relevant statutory guidelines. Desirable: Proven experience in integrating technical mining expertise with excavation planning, HEMM management and productivity improvement. The maximum age limit for eligibility is not more than 65 years during the contract period. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions of the post.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The Full-time Advisor (Excavation) is engaged on fixed tenure basis for two years, which may be extended. The consolidated monthly compensation/honorarium depends on the grade at retirement: Other benefits printed in the notice: Conveyance: The company shall provide conveyance as per availability; where it is not provided, the Advisor is eligible for 5% of consolidated pay per month as conveyance charges. Accommodation: Suitable company accommodation shall be provided on availability; if not available, HRA will be provided as per the applicable CIL HRA rules for X, Y and Z class of cities based on the DoE OM dated 07.07.2017. Mobile telephone: Reimbursement based on actual bills or ₹1000/- per month, whichever is less. Medical: CIL executives covered under the Post Retiral Medical Benefits Scheme continue under that scheme; appointees not on the roll of CIL get the same coverage if they are not covered under any Post Retiral Medical Scheme. Leave: Paid leave of 15 days in every six months in addition to paid holidays, regulated as per EL provisions under CIL Executive Leave Rules; not encashable, and accumulated leave lapses at the expiry of each period of engagement. TA/DA on official tour: As per entitlement on retirement, restricted to air travel by Economy class only. On joining: If travel from out-station is required to join, the cost of one ticket (for self) as per the entitlement above; one ticket (for self) also on expiry of contract. Hotel accommodation: As per entitlement at the time of retirement/superannuation, limited to a single room and to the maximum entitlement of E9 grade executives; DA as admissible at retirement (limited to E9 level) when boarding and lodging is not provided by the company. Tax: Where payment of GST is required, it shall be reimbursed on production of proof of payment.

content_sections.heading: BCCL Full-time Advisor (Excavation) Job Description
content_sections.text: The broad scope of work includes: Advise on excavation planning and optimum deployment of HEMM. Assist in assessment of HEMM fleet requirements, capacity and replacement needs. Advise on fleet optimization, mechanization and equipment standardization. Review availability, utilization and productivity of major HEMM. Identify critical issues affecting equipment performance and suggest corrective measures. Advise on measures for improving equipment productivity and utilization. Provide expert inputs on procurement/replacement of major HEMM. Review technical specifications, equipment capacity and suitability wherever required. Advise on life-cycle considerations and optimum utilization of capital equipment. Assist in resolving critical excavation and HEMM-related issues in coordination with Areas/Projects, CMPDI, CIL, manufacturers and other stakeholders. Provide inputs during review of major excavation projects and equipment deployment. Provide advisory inputs to CMD/Functional Directors/Project Review Committees on critical excavation and HEMM-related matters. Assist Management in policy-level decisions relating to HEMM planning, procurement, deployment and replacement. Undertake any other excavation-related advisory work assigned by Management from time to time.

Nine months in Year 1, extendable subject to project duration, funding, performance and institutional approval

content_sections.heading: About AIIMS Nagpur and the SMRITI Project
content_sections.text: All India Institute of Medical Sciences, Nagpur is a medical institute located at Plot no. 2, Sector-20, MIHAN, Nagpur – 441108. The post sits in the ICMR-funded SMRITI trial, a biomarker-stratified multicentre randomised controlled trial evaluating Propofol TIVA against Isoflurane for preventing postoperative delirium in geriatric surgery. The Principal Investigator is Dr Omshubham Gangadhar Asai, Associate Professor, Department of Anaesthesiology and Critical Care, AIIMS Nagpur.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Postgraduate degree, including integrated PG degree, in a relevant subject (for example life sciences, biochemistry, biotechnology, clinical research or public health) from a recognized university; OR a four-year graduate degree in Engineering / IT / Computer Science relevant to the project. 1–2 years' clinical-research experience, preferably multicentre RCT/ICMR project. Experience in trial coordination, IEC/regulatory documentation, participant recruitment/follow-up, EDC/database management, GCP, statistical software, project reporting and scientific writing. Multicentre trial and peer-reviewed publication experience preferred. Qualifications and relevant subject equivalence are subject to applicable ICMR guidelines, and candidates with higher qualifications may apply. The age limit for the post is 35 years. The notice does not print a cut-off date for counting age. Age relaxation, where applicable, will be as per prevailing ICMR and institute rules. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of the post.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The notice lists the pay as ₹67,200 per month, made up of ₹56,000 plus HRA at 20%. The stated remuneration includes HRA at the budgeted rate; other allowances, if any, will be governed by the sanction and applicable rules. This is a fixed-duration, purely temporary post under an ICMR-funded project. It is not a regular post of ICMR or AIIMS Nagpur and confers no claim to permanent employment. The initial tenure is nine months in Year 1. Renewal is subject to project requirements, fund availability, performance assessment and institutional approval. The engagement will end automatically upon expiry of its approved term unless renewed. Leave, notice, termination and other service conditions will follow the applicable ICMR guidelines and institute orders.

content_sections.text: To meet the CWC eligibility, a candidate must satisfy the nationality, qualification and age conditions as on the last date of application, 15.11.2026. A candidate must be a citizen of India, a subject of Nepal or Bhutan, a Tibetan refugee who came to India before 1 January 1962 with the intention of settling permanently, or a person of Indian origin who has migrated from Pakistan, Burma, Sri Lanka, East African countries of Kenya, Uganda, the United Republic of Tanzania, Zambia, Malawi, Zaire, Ethiopia or Vietnam with the intention of settling permanently in India. Candidates in the last four groups must hold a certificate of eligibility issued by the Government of India. The minimum age to apply for all the posts is 18 years. All qualifications must be from a University/Institution/Board recognized by the Government of India or approved by Government regulatory bodies. Candidates appearing in the final year or final semester are not eligible. Where SGPA/CGPA/OGPA is awarded, it should be converted into equivalent percentage in the online application. No change of category is permitted after registration. The post-wise CWC qualification and experience are given below. For the post of Assistant Manager (Finance), the period of articleship is not counted in the required experience. Only regular employment experience is counted.

content_sections.heading: CWC Recruitment 2026 Age Limit
content_sections.text: The CWC age limit is a maximum of 28 years as on 15.11.2026 for all the posts. Candidates should not have been born earlier than 16.11.1998 and later than 15.11.2008, both days inclusive. The maximum age in Table-A is applicable to UR candidates, and the following relaxation is given on top of it. With cumulative age relaxation, the maximum age limit cannot exceed 55 years as on 15.11.2026. For Ex-Servicemen (post codes 07 and 08), the period of actual military service is deducted from the actual age, and the resultant age should not exceed the maximum age limit by more than 3 years (8 years for SC/ST and 6 years for OBC candidates). The relaxation for SC/ST/OBC (Non-Creamy Layer) candidates is allowed on a cumulative basis with any one of the other categories listed above, except SC/ST/OBC themselves. Departmental candidates (regular CWC employees) get age relaxation only if they have at least 5 years of service left on the last date of receipt of applications. Age concession is not admissible to sons, daughters and dependents of Ex-Servicemen. SC/ST/OBC/EWS candidates applying against unreserved posts get no age or qualifying-marks relaxation.

content_sections.heading: CWC Recruitment 2026 Salary
content_sections.text: The CWC salary for the Assistant Manager posts is Rs. 40000-140000 in the E-1 scale, and for the Junior Executive posts it is Rs. 29000-93000 in the S-V scale (IDA pattern). Besides basic pay and IDA, candidates are entitled to other allowances, perks and benefits as per the policies of the Corporation. The notification also lists CPF, contributory pension, gratuity, LTC, performance related pay or variable pay, and medical reimbursement as admissible for regular employees. Selected candidates are appointed on probation. Assistant Manager candidates have to furnish a bond of Rs. 1,00,000 and Junior Executive candidates a bond of Rs. 50,000, to serve the Corporation for a minimum of two years, at the time of joining.

content_sections.heading: CWC Recruitment 2026 Application Fee
content_sections.text: The CWC application fee is Rs. 850 plus intimation charges of Rs. 500 (Rs. 1,350 in total) for UR, EWS and OBC candidates. SC, ST, PwBD, Ex-Servicemen and women candidates are exempt from the application fee but must pay intimation charges of Rs. 500. The amount is inclusive of GST, and the payment gateway charges are borne by the candidate. The fee is non-refundable and is paid through the online payment gateway only. Payment by DD, cheque or postal order is not accepted. Payment can be made by debit card (RuPay/Visa/MasterCard/Maestro), credit card, internet banking, UPI, IMPS, cash cards or mobile wallets. A candidate applying for more than one post must apply and pay the fee separately for each post. On successful payment, an e-receipt is generated. If no e-receipt is generated, the payment has failed, and the candidate should log in again with the Provisional Registration Number and Password and repeat the payment.

content_sections.heading: CWC Recruitment 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: The CWC selection process depends on the post. Candidates must first register for the online recruitment process for each post. Candidates are shortlisted from the online test in the ratio of 1:5 for the Assistant Manager posts (Interview) and 1:3 for the Junior Executive posts (Document Verification). The Interview and Document Verification are conducted at Delhi. For the Assistant Manager posts, the Interview carries 30 marks. The minimum qualifying marks in the Interview are 50% for Unreserved and EWS candidates, 45% for OBC and 40% for SC/ST/PwBD/Ex-Servicemen candidates. The weightage of the online exam and the Interview is 85:15. For the Junior Executive posts, appointment is based on the marks obtained in the online test, after successful Document Verification. Each candidate must obtain a minimum score in each section and a minimum total score. The minimum qualifying marks for the Professional/Subject Knowledge test (posts 02 to 06 and 08) and for the Language & Comprehension Abilities Descriptive Test (all posts) are 40% for Unreserved and 35% for OBC/EWS/SC/ST/PwBD/Ex-Servicemen candidates. If two or more candidates get the same score, the senior candidate by date of birth is placed higher. A wait list up to 100% of the vacancies in each category may be kept. Cut-offs are applied in two stages, on the scores in individual tests and on the total score. If the exam is held in more than one session, the scores are equated and normalized. The online examination is of 3 hours in total, with each test separately timed. There is a penalty of one-fourth of the marks of the question for each wrong answer, and there is no penalty for an unanswered question. Each post has 202 questions and 230 maximum marks. Assistant Manager (General) Assistant Manager (Technical), (Finance), (Engineering)-Civil, (Engineering)-Electrical and (Engineering)-Mechanical Junior Executive (Technical) Junior Executive (General) CWC reserves the right to modify the structure of the examination. Other details will be given in an Information Handout, available with the call letters on www.cewacor.nic.in. The tentative list of exam centres across states and union territories is given in Annexure I of the notification, and the choice of centre once made is final. The notification says the syllabus is broad and indicative and may change slightly in the examination. The professional/subject knowledge topics are as follows. content_sections.text: Candidates can apply online only from 17.10.2026 to 15.11.2026. No other mode of application is accepted. content_sections.heading: About NIBMG Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: BRIC-National Institute of Biomedical Genomics, Kalyani, describes itself as an institute that has created the physical infrastructure and platform technologies to support research, translation and training in biomedical genomics. These posts are "Project Linked Person" positions for extramural projects carried out by the institute. The posts serve the IndiaCAN-Twin project. Its Principal Investigators are Prof. Nidhan K. Biswas and Prof. Analabha Basu, and its Co-Principal Investigator is Dr. Dilip Kumar. The project studies gingivo-buccal oral squamous cell carcinoma (OSCC), the leading cancer among Indian males. It uses multi-omics profiling, longitudinal cohorts and computational genomics pipelines at NIBMG, together with artificial intelligence and digital pathology. The aim is to build predictive Bio-AI frameworks and to find diagnostic and prognostic biomarkers for Indian oral cancer patients.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: Place of work: MoEFCC, HQ at New Delhi. Tenure: Upto three years (1+1+1), subject to performance and the professional's presence being highly useful to the Division. Continuation for upto two more years will be considered case by case with the approval of the Competent Authority. Nature of appointment: Temporary (non-official), purely contractual and full time, with no other assignment permitted during the consultancy. No request for promotion shall be entertained. Termination: The Ministry can cancel the appointment at any time without assigning any reason. Absence for a continuous period of 8 days without information or valid reason leads to automatic termination. Reporting: Consultants report to the Director/Dy. Secretary under the overall supervision of the Joint Secretary or equivalent. Working hours: Same as regular Government employees in the Ministry, with attendance marked in the Biometric system. Monthly remuneration may be deducted for coming late. No extra remuneration is allowed for working beyond office hours or on holidays, and compensatory leave is at the Divisional Head's discretion. Leave: Paid leave accrues at 1.5 days for each completed month of service. No remuneration is drawn for absence beyond 18 days in a year (pro-rata). Unused leave cannot be carried forward to the next 1-year tenure. Female consultants are eligible for maternity leave under the Maternity Benefit Act, 1961 and the Maternity Leave Rules based on it. Official travel: TA, DA and hotel accommodation for official work are allowed under SR 190 and MoEFCC guidelines Admin-43012/1/2022 – P-II [E-176223] dated 15 April 2025. No TA/DA is admissible for joining the assignment or on its completion. Confidentiality: Consultants are subject to the Indian Official Secret Act, 1923. Internal reports and data cannot be used for research papers or books, and publishing or broadcasting information gathered on the assignment needs the Ministry's previous sanction. Conduct: Engagement is liable to be discontinued without any reason being assigned if services are found unsatisfactory or in conflict with Government interests.

faq.question: How is the last date of 20 November 2026 worked out?
faq.answer: The notice allows 21 days from publication of the advertisement on the Ministry's website and itself fixes that as 20 November 2026.

faq.question: What should I write on the envelope?
faq.answer: Clearly superscribe the name of the post you are applying for, such as Scientific Consultant Grade-I (Solid Waste Management).

faq.question: Are scientific publications compulsory?
faq.answer: Yes. Applicants for both posts must have publications in the relevant areas in recognized peer reviewed scientific journals. The form also has a section for publication details.

faq.question: Does a Ph.D count towards experience?
faq.answer: Up to 3 years of experience is included for Ph.D holders, provided no experience is counted during those 3 years.

faq.question: Will the Ministry pay for travel to the interview?
faq.answer: No. No TA/DA will be provided for appearing in the interview, and it cannot be attended virtually.

faq.question: How long can a consultant stay in this engagement?
faq.answer: The initial engagement is upto three years, renewed in 1+1+1 steps. With approval, it may run for upto two additional years, making five years in all.

faq.question: What must selected candidates submit?
faq.answer: Selected candidates shall provide an integrity certificate from 2 references known to them. They must also give a self-undertaking that they have no criminal record and no criminal case pending in any court.

faq.question: What details does the application form ask for?
faq.answer: Annexure-I has 16 items, including domicile, nationality, essential and desirable qualifications, essential and desirable work experience, training programmes attended, publications and languages known.

Manage project life-cycle through vigilantly monitoring, timely donor reporting, provisioning change management and establishing governance and program management structure as per guidelines. Identifying project dependencies among various departments of the Institutes and mitigating the risk involving all stakeholders. Work with front-line engagement teams to understand and analyse donor feedback and use the insights to create opportunities for fund-raise. Build strong relationships with faculty at IIT Indore and translate ongoing research work at IIT Indore into meaningful opportunities for donor participation. Develop organizational competency for building detailed project plans for different projects being undertaken to deploy the funds coming through various sources. Build a culture of execution excellence by building strong internal relationships and influencing key stakeholders. Own project delivery and ensure collaboration and synergy among internal departments for seamless execution. Ability / interest to travel and working beyond hours to meet the commitment.

content_sections.heading: About DUK
content_sections.text: Kerala University of Digital Sciences, Innovation and Technology is the university issuing this notification, and it refers to itself as DUK in the job descriptions. KSAAC is its project for cybersecurity auditing, with services covering audit, consultancy, training and compliance.

content_sections.heading: Job Duties
content_sections.text: Lead and manage KSAAC's cybersecurity auditing engagements, and plan and supervise audits including web and mobile application, IT infrastructure, VAPT and Secure Code Review work. Define audit scope, objectives, methodology, timelines, resources and deliverables, then allocate work and guide the audit team. Review and validate findings, evidence and risk ratings, and oversee draft and final audit reports, executive summaries and risk registers. Maintain liaison with CERT-In, track its notifications and regulatory developments, and recommend updates to audit practices. Develop audit methodologies, procedures, checklists, templates and quality assurance processes. Mentor security auditors and analysts, coordinate with client organisations and support proposals, Statements of Work and project estimates. Identify delivery risks, resolve technical issues and escalate matters needing management intervention. Design secure architectures and solutions for applications, networks, IT infrastructure, cloud environments and enterprise systems. Analyse client requirements and develop technical approaches and implementation roadmaps. Support delivery of services such as VAPT, security audits, secure code review, digital forensics, governance, risk assessment and compliance. Prepare technical proposals, techno-commercial bids, project estimates, service descriptions and consultancy reports. Support business development for KSAAC and DUK, and build relationships with Government departments, PSUs, universities and industries. Take part in client meetings, presentations, negotiations and proposal follow-ups. Track emerging technologies and market requirements, and help develop service catalogues, pricing models and delivery frameworks. Assist senior forensic professionals in investigations involving computers, storage media, mobile devices, logs and other digital sources. Help identify, preserve, acquire and examine digital evidence, and maintain chain-of-custody records. Perform forensic disk imaging, hash verification, file-system analysis, metadata examination and deleted-file recovery under supervision. Assist in analysing system artefacts, browser history, application artefacts and event logs. Assist in preparing examination notes, evidence inventories and draft forensic reports. Support incident response, cybercrime investigations and malware-related examinations where required. Help maintain forensic laboratory equipment, software, evidence storage systems and case documentation, and take part in internal training. Each post also carries any other related duties assigned by the competent authority.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection will be based on a test and/or interview, held in Thiruvananthapuram district only. The schedule reaches candidates through their registered email only. Any selection or appointment is provisional and subject to physical verification of documents.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: Each appointment is on contract basis for one year. The term may be extended further based on the performance and project requirements. The job location for all posts is Thiruvananthapuram. If suppression of material facts or incorrect information is detected even after appointment, the service is liable to be terminated.

content_sections.heading: About Dhanlaxmi Bank
content_sections.text: Dhanlaxmi Bank Ltd is a bank headquartered at Thrissur, Kerala, where its registered office is also located. The notice describes almost a century of banking heritage and a network of 558 touch points across India, including 269 branches and 289 ATMs.

rows.pay: Depending on the experience, expertise and exposure of the candidate

content_sections.heading: Dhanlaxmi Bank IS Auditor Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: Maximum 35 years as on 30 September 2026. Bachelor's Degree in Engineering (Computer Science, Information Technology, Electronics and Communication Engineering) or equivalent discipline from a recognised university in India. Candidates need 2 to 5 years of relevant experience in Banks/Financial Institutions/audit/consultancy firms in any one or more of the areas below. A. Information Systems Audit IS audit experience in banks, financial institutions or regulated entities. Audit exposure in Data Centre, Digital Payment Security, CBS, LOS, mobile banking, internet banking, customer acquisition and management systems, treasury, forex and other banking applications. Audits of Access Management Systems, including PAM, PIM, Active Directory and related identity management controls. Audits of Data Centre and SOC controls. Audits of UIDAI, SWIFT, NSDL, PCI-DSS and Digital Payment Security controls. Source code review/audit. BCP and DR audits. Audits of IT infrastructure, network, database and application security controls. Third-party/vendor IT risk assessments. OR B. IT Infrastructure / Cyber Security Operations Experience in the implementation, administration, monitoring or maintenance of: Firewalls, routers, switches, load balancers and network security devices. SIEM, DAM, network monitoring tools and security monitoring solutions. Antivirus, EDR, endpoint security and data protection solutions. Patch management, vulnerability management and configuration baseline controls. Server and network hardening activities. Privileged Identity Management (PIM) and Privileged Access Management (PAM) solutions. ISACA, Certified Information Systems Auditor (CISA) certification. Experience in Information System audit. Experience in Vulnerability Assessment and Penetration Testing (VAPT). ISO/IEC 27001 LA, Certified Ethical Hacker (CEH). See the official notification (PDF) for the discipline-specific eligibility of this post.

content_sections.heading: Key Responsibilities
content_sections.text: Identify, assess and report risks relating to IT infrastructure, applications, databases and network environments. Assess compliance with IT Governance, Risk and Compliance (IT GRC) requirements, IT General Controls (ITGC) and application controls. Evaluate compliance with the Bank's Cyber Security Policy, Information Security Policy and regulatory requirements. Assess the adequacy and effectiveness of controls that prevent, detect and respond to cyber security threats. Conduct Information Systems audits of digital payment channels, Data Centre, Security Operations Centre (SOC), Core Banking Solution (CBS), Loan Origination System (LOS) and other banking applications. Assess compliance with regulatory and industry requirements applicable to the Bank's IT environment, including RBI guidelines, PCI-DSS, SWIFT and other relevant standards. Prepare audit reports, document audit observations, validate corrective action plans and track closure of audit findings. The IS Auditor also independently conducts audits of these IT GRC controls: Patch and vulnerability management. Change management. User access management and privileged access management. Backup management. Business Continuity Planning (BCP) and Disaster Recovery (DR) measures. Data security and data protection controls. Configuration management and security hardening.

content_sections.heading: About MMMUT
content_sections.text: Madan Mohan Malaviya University of Technology is a State Government funded university in Gorakhpur, Uttar Pradesh, formerly known as Madan Mohan Malaviya Engineering College. The University set up MMMUT Foundation as a Section-8 company to run its incubation centre. The selected candidates will be employees of the Foundation.

content_sections.heading: MMMUT CEO and Incubation Manager Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: Preferred for both posts: Experience in entrepreneurship, the startup or incubation ecosystem, or in an incubator Experience in facility management, regulatory matters, finance etc. See the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post.

rows.essential_qualification: M.Tech / MBA
B.E / B.Tech

content_sections.heading: Duties of the Chief Executive Officer
content_sections.text: Secure Government funding, beginning with the MSME cluster development scheme and the technology upgradation scheme. Build the Centre into a self-sustaining institution that draws on the University's campus, laboratories and talent. Build the core organisation, structure and processes in line with the Foundation's purpose and vision. Establish the innovation and entrepreneurial ecosystem. Manage incubation, infrastructure and facilities, legal and compliance work, finance, administration, procurement, and IT and lab infrastructure. Raise and manage funds from Government schemes, industry, incubator funds and CSR. Attract grants (for example NITI Aayog, DST, NSTEDB, BIRAC, MeitY, MSME), pitch to angel investors and venture capitalists, and build revenue-generating services. Handle budgeting, reporting, audit and compliance with statutory rules and regulations. Curate programmes, events, engagement activities and marketing campaigns that promote entrepreneurship and the Foundation's visibility. Work with MMMUT faculty and students to incubate startups, steering technologies and IP towards commercialisation through mentoring and venture set-up. Frame and execute the long-term roadmap, business models and annual action plans in alignment with the Board. Send timely reports to the Board, funding agencies and stakeholders. Handle duties assigned by the Chairman, Member Secretary and Directors, and stay current with global developments in the incubator and startup ecosystem.

content_sections.heading: Duties of the Incubation Manager
content_sections.text: Manage the daily operations of the MMMUT Foundation and its incubation facilities. Implement the annual action plan and operational instructions approved by the CEO and competent authority. Maintain records of startups, incubatees, applications, mentoring sessions, programmes, events and facility utilisation. Coordinate the use of office space, laboratories, equipment, meeting rooms and prototyping facilities. Ensure timely execution of assigned activities and maintain operational discipline. Identify promising entrepreneurs, student innovators, faculty innovators and technology-based startup teams.

content_sections.heading: Project and Job Description
content_sections.text: The project is titled "Microseismic Wave Detection in Coal Mines Using Fiber Optic Geophones for Artificial Intelligence-Based Structural Health Monitoring". It focuses on developing fiber optic geophones that detect microseismic waves for AI-based structural health monitoring. The work involves: Designing the optical geophone in related software Collecting data Developing AI/ML algorithms for signal processing and model development

Sc or M. Sc. Tech. in Physics / Electronics or an equivalent degree, with a minimum of first class or above from the reputed Institute In addition, candidates must have qualified the GATE/CSIR-UGC NET examination. content_sections.heading: IIT Gandhinagar Job Description
content_sections.text: Program Associate- II Develop and implement communication plans to promote the research and development activities of the Institute, in line with institutional goals and priorities. Identify newsworthy research outputs, interview researchers, and write press releases, news stories and feature articles for the Institute’s website and for external media. Develop content for the Institute’s R&D social media series, newsletter, annual research compendium, website, blogs and promotional materials. Assist in drafting and editing proposals, concept notes, reports, briefing notes and other documents for the Institute and its leadership, as required. Create supporting visual content, including graphics, short videos and presentations, in coordination with the design and media teams. Plan and support science communication activities, outreach events, workshops and flagship events, including the preparation of event reports and summaries. Aid internal teams in the branding and execution of their flagship events. Undertake any other responsibilities assigned by the competent authority from time to time. Program Associate - I Produce films/videos of various events. Ideate, shoot, edit and produce films for various new projects throughout the institute. Create visually engaging social media content for projects and campaigns. Film and live stream discussions, open houses, etc. Produce creative videos/films for various research initiatives.

content_sections.heading: About DIBD-DIC
content_sections.text: The Digital India BHASHINI Division (DIBD) is an Independent Business Division under Digital India Corporation (DIC), with its Delhi office at Electronics Niketan, Lodhi Road, New Delhi. It manages and executes BHASHINI, the National Language Translation Mission, an initiative of the Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology under the Digital India Program. The BHASHINI platform works with premier academic institutes, including IITs and IIITs, and hosts more than 300 AI-based language models.

content_sections.heading: DIBD-DIC Cloud Engineer Vacancy Details 2026
content_sections.text: The designation is allocated according to the candidate's experience level. The post is in the Digital India BHASHINI Division and reports to the CEO-DIBD.

rows.post: Assistant Manager/ Deputy Manager/ Manager Technical Solutions – Cloud Engineer
rows.pay: Depends on the selected candidate's qualification and experience; fixed as per industry norms

content_sections.heading: DIBD-DIC Cloud Engineer Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: The maximum age for application is 58 years, counted as on the last date of receipt of the applications. A Full time B.S./B.Tech. /B.E. or equivalent degree or B.Sc. (IT/CS) with a Post-Graduation in a Technical Background may be considered. 3+ years of hands-on experience designing and implementing cloud-based solutions using AWS, Azure, or GCP, including compute, storage, networking, and security services. Experience with CI/CD pipelines, monitoring and observability tools, and applying DevOps practices for high-availability and performance optimization. MBA/M. Tech. Strong proficiency with containerization and orchestration technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes, including deployment, scaling and service networking (an added advantage). Proven experience in Infrastructure-as-Code and automation using tools like Terraform, CloudFormation, Ansible, Chef or Puppet. Solid understanding of cloud networking (VPC/VNet, subnets, routing, load balancers, firewalls) and data platforms (SQL/NoSQL databases, caching systems). Formal educational qualifications and experience may be relaxed for exceptional candidates. See the official notification (PDF) for the discipline-specific eligibility of this post.

content_sections.heading: Role and Responsibilities
content_sections.text: The Cloud Engineer will design, implement and manage scalable cloud infrastructure, keeping systems secure, reliable and optimized for performance while supporting application deployment and operations. The notice lists these duties: Design and implement scalable, secure, high-availability technical solutions inspired by large digital platforms. Translate business and functional requirements into end-to-end technical architectures and solution designs. Support onboarding and integration of partner applications and services into the platform ecosystem. Architect and manage cloud infrastructure for AI, data and application workloads. Develop and maintain Infrastructure-as-Code and automation using tools like Terraform, CloudFormation and Ansible. Implement cloud operations best practices, including autoscaling, configuration management and cost optimization. Build and manage CI/CD pipelines for platform and application deployments. Monitor, troubleshoot and optimize cloud and application environments for performance and reliability. Create and maintain technical documentation, architecture diagrams and solution blueprints for internal teams and partners. Work with internal teams to identify gaps, improve processes and enhance solution delivery. Deliver customer service in a client-facing role, using strong communication, analytical and problem-solving skills.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Applications are screened on qualifications, age, academic record and relevant experience. DIBD-DIC may fix a higher threshold of qualifications and experience to limit the number of candidates called for interview. Only shortlisted candidates are invited for selection interviews. DIBD-DIC reserves the right not to select any candidate, and to fill all, some or none of the positions, without assigning any reason. A candidate selected in this interview could also be considered for other vacant positions at DIBD-DIC that require similar skills, at an appropriate level.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: The position is purely temporary, for the project of DIBD-Digital India Corporation. The appointee gets no right or claim to permanent appointment, or to any vacancy that exists or is advertised in future. The appointment can be terminated with one month's notice, or without notice on payment of one month's salary in lieu. The place of posting is Noida/Delhi or other locations as per project requirements. Candidates from other locations may also be considered if deemed suitable. The role requires flexibility and availability to travel as and when business needs demand it.

Fill in the application on the Digital India Corporation online application portal by 15 November 2026. If you are in regular or contractual employment under Central or State Government, a Public Sector Undertaking or an Autonomous Body, apply through proper channel or attach a No Objection Certificate from your employer. You may instead produce the certificate at the time of interview. The only document the notice specifically asks for is the No Objection Certificate, and only from candidates in the employment listed above.

No TA/DA is paid for attending any written test, skill test, presentation or interview. All disputes are subject to the jurisdiction of Palwal Court only.

faq.question: Q1. Which discipline has the most Skill Instructor vacancies?
faq.answer: CSE/IT has the most, with 10 posts under Advt. No. T-42/2026. Agriculture and Medical Lab. Technology follow with 03 each.

faq.question: Q2. Can a diploma holder apply for SVSU Skill Instructor posts?
faq.answer: Yes, in some disciplines. Civil, Electrical, Electronics and Mechanical (RAC), for example, accept a first class three-year Engineering Diploma with six years' experience.

faq.question: Q3. Is a National Trade Certificate accepted?
faq.answer: Yes, for Civil, Electrical, Electronics, Hospitality, Mechanical (RAC) and Printing & Technology. These need eight years' experience, including the training period.

faq.question: Q4. Can candidates from outside Haryana apply?
faq.answer: Yes, but a reserved-category applicant from another state is considered only against General posts and pays Rs. 1000/-.

faq.question: Q5. Can I apply for more than one discipline?
faq.answer: Yes. Each post needs its own application and its own fee.

faq.question: Q6. Is my eligibility checked before the written test?
faq.answer: No. All applicants may appear in the written test, and eligibility is checked only after a candidate qualifies both tests.

faq.question: Q7. What marks must a General candidate score to reach document verification?
faq.answer: A General candidate needs 40% in each test and 50% cumulative marks across the written and skill tests.

faq.question: Q8. I am a government employee and my NOC is delayed. Can I still apply?
faq.answer: Yes. Apply directly with your experience certificate and hand in the NOC from your present employer at Document Verification.

faq.answer: No. The dates of any test or interview and the shortlisted lists will be posted on the University website.

faq.answer: Nursing needs State Nursing Council registration, Pharmacy needs State Pharmacy Council registration, and Physiotherapy needs registration with the State council/NCAHP.

content_sections.heading: About OHPC
content_sections.text: Odisha Hydro Power Corporation Ltd. was incorporated in 1995 as a hydro power generation company of Odisha and functions under the state's Energy Department. Its installed capacity has grown from 1273.53 MW to 2099.8 MW, with 6 projects within the state and one interstate project in operation. This Gold rated State PSU also promotes renewable energy investment through its wholly owned subsidiary GEDCOL and is taking up new hydro projects, including Pumped Storage Projects and Small Hydro Projects.

content_sections.heading: OHPC Managing Director Vacancy Details 2026
content_sections.text: The pay follows a Cost to Company pattern. Over and above the CTC, the post carries an official vehicle, Company accommodation or HRA, Medical Facilities, and other allowances and perks as per the rules of the Corporation. Pay protection will be allowed only to Officers from the Central or State Governments, CPSEs, State PSUs or any other Government Organization. The Managing Director is the Chief Executive of the Company and is accountable to the Chairman, Board of Directors, Government of Odisha. Smooth operation and maintenance, renovation and modernisation of hydro power plants. Interaction with the authorities of GoI, Govt. of Odisha and stakeholders. Planning and execution of new hydro projects and Pumped Storage Projects. Efficient functioning of the Corporation for achieving its vision and objectives, and driving it to a new trajectory of growth with dynamic leadership.

faq.answer: Candidates from Government, CPSUs and SPSUs may be considered on deputation, but the deputation period shall not be less than 3 years.

faq.question: Is it enough to post the application by the last date?
faq.answer: No. The application must reach the Energy Department in Bhubaneswar by 15 December 2026, and late applications shall not be considered.

faq.question: Does OHPC pay for travel to the interview?
faq.answer: Outstation candidates appearing for the interview will be provided economy class air fare for the to and fro journey on submission of original documents.

faq.question: What happens if a selected candidate declines the post?
faq.answer: A candidate who gives unwillingness after the interview or after the offer of appointment shall be debarred for two years from being considered for a Board Level post in any State PSU. No request for relaxation would be entertained.

faq.question: Which pay level counts for the senior-level experience?
faq.answer: The notice uses the scale of Rs.1,23,100-2,15,900/-, level-15 of the pay matrix under the ORSP Rules, 2017, as the benchmark. Internal candidates need 3 years at this level or higher, while other candidates may qualify through 5 years in a senior level position or by drawing this scale, its equivalent or higher.

content_sections.heading: Roles and Responsibilities
content_sections.text: This consultant will provide specialised technical and analytical support on medical devices. The role focuses on regulatory compliance, market analysis, quality standards, manufacturing competitiveness and policy inputs. The duties include: Supporting research on global and domestic policies, industry trends, manufacturing promotion and access to medical devices Assisting with background notes, talking points, briefs, presentations and minutes for meetings, events and conferences Supporting coordination with industry associations and related Departments of the Government of India Providing comprehensive secretarial support, including drafting proposals, handling correspondence, file processing and record-keeping Carrying out other duties entrusted from time to time This consultant will provide technical, regulatory and analytical support for initiatives in the Indian pharmaceutical sector, including policy development, industry competitiveness, trade facilitation, quality compliance and market access. The role requires strong knowledge of India's pharma ecosystem, regulatory frameworks and global pharmaceutical trends. The duties include: Assisting with background notes, briefs and presentations for bilateral and multilateral meetings, trade negotiations and other international engagements Helping to collect and analyse data, especially trade data, and preparing summary notes Supporting research and analytical reports on country profiles related to pharmaceuticals and medical devices, international trade matters, regulations and market access issues Providing comprehensive secretarial support, including drafting proposals, handling correspondence, file processing and record-keeping Carrying out other duties entrusted from time to time
