content_sections.heading: About AIIMS Bhopal
content_sections.text: The All India Institute of Medical Sciences, Bhopal is in Saket Nagar, Bhopal, Madhya Pradesh. Its letterhead describes it as an Institute of National Importance under the Ministry of Health & Family Welfare, Govt. of India. These posts are in its Department of Microbiology. They serve the PM-ABHIM funded research project "Establishing a One Health Sentinel Surveillance System in High Human-Animal Interaction Settings among Selected Zoos in India". The notice's heading calls it an ICMR funded zoonotic research project.

content_sections.heading: About the Zoonotic Research Project
content_sections.text: The project will set up a One Health surveillance system to detect and monitor zoonotic diseases early, where humans, animals and the environment meet in selected Indian zoos. The work covers: human syndromic surveillance animal pathogen screening environmental monitoring vector surveillance molecular diagnostics serology metagenomics genomic epidemiology The aim is to assess and reduce the risk of zoonotic disease. The engagement is purely temporary and co-terminus with the project.

Nature of the job: The posts are purely on contract. They give no right to a regular appointment, or to permanent absorption in AIIMS Bhopal or ICMR/DHR. End of contract: The contract expires automatically at the end of its period unless both sides agree to renew it. Either side can end it at any time with 30 days' notice or salary in lieu of notice. ICMR recruitment: The post continues only as long as the vacancy is not filled through ICMR's central recruitment examination. Posting: Staff can be posted anywhere the project needs them, including rural areas and field sites. Leave: Leave follows ICMR's leave policy for extramural research projects. Accommodation: The Institute does not provide a hostel or any other accommodation. Private practice: Private practice of any kind is not allowed. Conduct: Staff must follow the Institute's rules of conduct and discipline.

content_sections.heading: About TPGL
content_sections.text: Tripura Power Generation Limited is a Government of Tripura enterprise that runs power generating stations and generation projects in the state. content_sections.heading: TPGL General Manager (Technical) Vacancy Details 2026
content_sections.text: The notice states that the number of posts may increase or decrease, and that the Corporation may choose not to fill the vacancy if the circumstances call for it. For in-service candidates on deputation and direct recruits below 60 years of age, pay is fixed at level 20 of the pay matrix under the "Tripura State Civil Services (Revised Pay) Rules, 2018". This corresponds to Pay Band Scale Rs. 37400-67000 (HAG + Scale). The minimum basic pay is Rs. 118500, and these allowances are paid on top of it: Retired candidates and those above 60 years get Rs. 1,00,000 (Rupees one lakh only) a month on a consolidated basis. content_sections.heading: TPGL General Manager (Technical) Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: The maximum age is 65 (sixty five) years, counted on the last date for receipt of applications. The notice states that this limit may be relaxed for a deserving candidate. You need a consistently good academic record with at least 55% marks in B.E. / B.Tech. in Electrical / Mechanical Engineering from a University or Institution recognised by UGC / AICTE. Where a grading system is used, an equivalent grade on a point scale is accepted. You need at least 20 (twenty) years of working experience at managerial level in any Public or Private Sector Power Utility. This must include adequate exposure to installing and commissioning new power projects, and to the operation and maintenance of Generation Systems, including Commercial and System Operation, Tariff and Material Management. For a deserving candidate, the 20-year requirement may be reduced. These job specifications are the minimum. Meeting them does not guarantee a call for interview. The selection committee may relax any of the terms for selection and appointment. For the exact eligibility wording, see the official notification.

content_sections.heading: Job Description
content_sections.text: The General Manager (Technical) works as a Line Manager and reports to the Director (Technical). The managerial duties are: Setting tasks and targets in line with the Corporation's goals and assigning work to Line Managers Running technical and organisational functions with proper systems and controls Building a positive work culture and motivating staff Carrying out programmes of the Central Government and the Government of Tripura Running random checks of offices and project work, collecting feedback and taking corrective action The technical duties are: Keeping power generation uninterrupted and reliable through proper operation and maintenance of generating stations, including all types of transformers, with protection at every level Coordinating Generation, Transmission and Distribution, with proper relay coordination Material management, inventory, disposal of scrap material, and asset creation through TPGL projects Preparing DPRs, finishing tendering on time, and monitoring construction quality under generation projects and schemes Reducing transformer failure rates and working towards zero accidents through safety awareness Any other assignment given by the Director (Technical) or the Managing Director

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection is based on an interview only, and only shortlisted candidates are called. If shortlisting is needed, it may be done through a written test, academic records, higher educational qualifications and experience. The decision of the Screening Committee and the Appointing Authority on shortlisting is binding. The Corporation does not pay T.A. / D.A. for attending the interview. Original documents must be shown at the interview, or at any other time the Corporation decides.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: The appointment is on contract for 3 (three) years. The appointing authority may extend it if both sides agree. No pension is paid by the Government of Tripura or TPGL. EPF benefits are available if you want them and if they apply. Either side can end the contract with 30 days' notice or by paying 1 (one) month's salary. Other service conditions are the same as for Tripura State Civil Service Officers of the equivalent grade. A Government of Tripura officer appointed on deputation stays under the service conditions of their original employment. In-service candidates may apply directly. If selected, they must bring a 'Release Order' or 'Deputation Order' from their present employer when joining. Without it, they cannot join.

content_sections.text: The Indian Institute of Technology Gandhinagar is a technical institute in Gandhinagar, Gujarat. content_sections.heading: IIT Gandhinagar Project Associate II (Chemistry) Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: Eligibility follows Institute norms, not funding agency norms. M.Sc. in Chemistry or B.Tech./B.E. in a Chemistry-related engineering/technical field, with at least 02 years of post-qualification experience, OR B.Sc. with Chemistry as a subject, with at least 06 years of post-qualification experience. Marks: at least 60% or an equivalent grade from graduation onwards, and at least 55% or an equivalent grade in Class 10th and 12th. The institute wants a self-driven, creative chemistry educator with a strong interest in school STEM education through hands-on and inquiry-based learning. The following are preferred but not required: Experience teaching chemistry to students in grades 8-12 (for example as a TGT or PGT, or under CBSE, IB, IGCSE, ICSE and state boards). Good communication and facilitation skills, professional fluency in spoken and written English and in spoken Hindi, and good digital documentation skills. Experience designing and conducting physical experiments and hands-on activities, and using lab instruments. 1 year of experience writing textbook chapters or making learning modules for grades 8-12 in ed-tech. Check the official notification for the full eligibility details for this post.

content_sections.heading: Job Description
content_sections.text: The main responsibilities include, but are not limited to: Creating high-quality, rigorous hands-on chemistry modules for grades 6-12, and updating and organising the resource repository. Adapting, making, testing and optimising activities, models and prototypes. Documenting the work as manuals, chapters, worksheets, presentations, videos and articles. Turning suitable activities into models that schools can use, with product specifications. Coordinating and running the testing of content in schools.

content_sections.heading: About WII
content_sections.text: The Wildlife Institute of India is an autonomous institution under the Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change (MoEFCC), Government of India. It is based in Chandrabani, Dehradun, Uttarakhand. It runs training programmes and academic courses and gives advice on wildlife research and management. content_sections.heading: WII Project Associate I Vacancy Details 2026
Projects, Duration and Duties
content_sections.text: The full title is "Study the Impacts of Morand-Ganjal Irrigation Project on Wildlife and Preparation of Wildlife Mitigation Plan". All three posts on this project last six months. Senior Project Associate: helps manage the team, plans and runs field research and surveys, and does data analysis and report writing. Project Associate II (RS & GIS): does data analysis and report writing. Project Associate I: supports field teams and does field research, surveys, data analysis and report writing. This project is a conservation plan for the critically endangered White Bellied Heron (Ardea insignis) and its habitats in the Lohit River and Noa-Dehing River Basins. The Project Associate I post lasts one year. The work covers field teams, field research, surveys, data analysis and report writing. This project prepares a site-specific wildlife management plan for the Sijimali Bauxite Mines in Rayagada Forest Division and Kalahandi (South) Forest Division, Odisha. The Administrative Assistant gives administrative and logistical support to the Project Principal Investigator for one year. This project prepares a wildlife mitigation and management plan for the Yettinahole Drinking Water Project in Hassan and Tumkur Districts, Karnataka. Both posts last one year. The Principal Project Associate manages teams and plans and runs field research, surveys, data analysis and report writing. The two Project Associates I support the field teams. This project assesses and monitors biodiversity in Saranda Forest Division, West Singhbhum District. The posts last one year and are "likely to be extended based on funding". Vegetation: collects vegetation data for habitat assessment, analyses the data and writes reports. Social: carries out social surveys in tribal-dominated areas, analyses the data and writes reports. Entomology: does pan trapping, light trapping and lab work on the specimens collected, and writes reports.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: WII shortlists candidates for an online interview. Shortlisting looks at the essential qualification, the age limit, your percentage of marks in the Bachelor's or Master's degree, how relevant your Master's specialisation is, your research experience, and your publications (journal papers, books, and papers presented at workshops, seminars, symposiums and conferences). The top ten (10) shortlisted candidates for each project or position are called for the interview. A duly constituted Selection Committee runs the process. Meeting the minimum qualification and experience does not by itself get you an interview call. The screening marks are listed below. A candidate who is not found suitable for the post applied for may be considered for a lower-grade position if the Interview Committee recommends it. content_sections.text: Pay the application or processing fee into the RRP Cell account and keep the receipt. Open the application portal at wiirp.com/application.php , or scan the QR code printed in the notice. Fill in the online form. Enter your educational details exactly as they appear on your board or university mark sheets. Upload the scanned documents and the fee receipt, then submit the form by 13 November 2026. The letter is addressed to the Secretaries of all Major Port Authorities, because the post is open only to their officers.

content_sections.text: The Recruitment Rule in Annexure I gives the number of posts as 2 in its "No. of posts" column. faq.answer: Only eligible and willing officers of Major Port Authorities can apply. They must hold an analogous post or a Superintending Engineer or equivalent post in the Civil Engineering Department, with the service set out in the Recruitment Rule.

faq.answer: The pay is Rs. 80,000 to Rs. 2,20,000. The pre-revised scale was Rs. 16,000 to Rs. 20,800.

faq.answer: You need a degree or equivalent in Civil Engg. from a recognized university/institution. This requirement also applies to absorption.

faq.question: Q7. Where do I send the hard copy?
faq.answer: Send it to The Secretary, Deendayal Port Authority, Administrative Office Building, Gandhidham – Kutch, Gujarat - 370201. It must reach there by 7 December 2026.

faq.question: Q8. Which annexures must go with the application?
faq.answer: Annexure II is the Head of Office certificate. Annexure III is the vigilance clearance proforma, with Part A signed by the HoD and Part B by the CVO.

faq.question: Q9. What happens if I withdraw after selection?
faq.answer: You can be barred from selection to any post in Deendayal Port Authority for two (02) years.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: The written test or skill test will follow University norms. There will be no interview, because this is a Group 'C' post (MHRD, now MoE, Letter No. 19-50/2015-Desk-U dated 22.12.2015). Bring all original certificates of age, qualifications and experience to the test. Without them, you may not be allowed to sit the test. The University may keep a waiting list. If a selected candidate does not join within six months, or resigns or dies within one year of joining, the offer goes to the next candidate on merit. An SC/ST/OBC candidate who is selected on the general standard is counted as a merit candidate against an unreserved point. Outstation SC/ST candidates get to-and-fro sleeper-class rail fare by the shortest route. Where there is no rail link, they get ordinary bus fare on showing the ticket. This does not apply to those already in government, PSU or local-body employment. All other candidates attend at their own cost.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions

The New Pension Scheme of the Govt. of India applies, as extended by the UGC. The University's Act, Statutes, Ordinances and Rules apply, along with the CCS (Conduct) Rules, 1964 and the CCS (CCA) Rules, 1965. Before joining, you must give a medical fitness certificate from a Govt. hospital or a Govt./CGHS empanelled hospital, countersigned by the civil surgeon or the Medical Superintendent/Director. The appointment stays provisional until your character and antecedents are verified.

content_sections.heading: Role and Responsibilities
content_sections.text: The Research Associate will use advanced AI and analytics for sustainability, energy systems, climate risk and green operations. The work covers AI-driven solutions for energy optimisation, emissions analysis, sustainability analytics and climate-related decision support. content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection is by interview, which may be held in person or online. Meeting the eligibility criteria does not guarantee a place on the shortlist. The institute may limit the shortlist to a reasonable number based on higher qualifications and/or experience. The interview date goes to shortlisted candidates by email ONLY, so the application form must include your email ID. At the interview, shortlisted candidates must bring all original certificates, degrees and other documents for their educational qualification, professional qualification, work experience and age, along with one set of photocopies. No TA/DA or other incidental expenses are paid for attending. A panel of waitlisted candidates stays valid for one year from approval by the Competent Authority, and the institute may make appointments from it during that time.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: The job is purely temporary, for an initial period of 6 months. It may be extended based on the candidate's performance and the project's needs, up to a maximum tenure of 2 (two) years. The contract is with the CoE and starts only after Nayara Energy releases the funds and the CoE receives them. The post is purely contractual, so there is no right to claim regularisation or absorption in the institute. The institute may choose not to fill the post. If a mistake in the selection process is found at any stage, even after the appointment letter is issued, the institute may modify, withdraw or cancel any communication to candidates. Canvassing in any form will lead to disqualification. No interim correspondence will be entertained. Any legal disputes fall under Mumbai jurisdiction only. The institute follows the Reservation Policy of the Government of India.

content_sections.heading: About PFI Analyst - Research
content_sections.text: Power Foundation of India (PFI) is a not-for-profit organisation promoted by leading power sector CPSUs to undertake policy advocacy, capacity building, research, knowledge dissemination, and sectoral development initiatives for the Indian power sector. The organisation functions from its registered office situated at B-28, Qutub Institutional Area, New Delhi 110016.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates applying for the Analyst – Research position must fulfill the following criteria: Educational Qualification: Bachelor's Degree in Engineering, preferably in Electrical/Power from a recognized university, and an MBA in Power/Energy/Finance or an M.Tech in an Energy related field. Experience: 2 years of relevant post-qualification professional experience in the power sector, with demonstrated experience in policy research, regulatory analysis, tariff assessment, power markets, or related areas. Applicants must possess experience in analysing power sector policies, regulations, tariff petitions, regulatory orders, and legal judgments, with an understanding of the Indian electricity sector and its regulatory framework. Experience in conducting quantitative and sectoral analysis, preparing research papers, policy notes, reports, and presentations, and providing analytical inputs for policy advocacy and stakeholder consultations is also required. Added Advantage: Exposure to international power sector developments, regulatory practices, and emerging areas such as energy transition, market reforms, and competition will be considered an added advantage. Age Limit: Maximum 28 years as on the closing date of application (30 November 2026). Candidates should refer to the official notification for complete discipline-specific eligibility details.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: Selected candidates will be appointed on a regular, full-time basis, subject to satisfactory verification of credentials and fulfillment of the organisation's applicable service rules. The CTC of the selected candidate shall be protected, and an additional increase of 10% to 30% over the existing CTC may be offered as per PFI policy, depending upon qualifications, relevant experience, competencies, and overall suitability. Candidates will also be entitled to PF, gratuity, medical/insurance coverage, and other applicable benefits in accordance with the rules and policies of PFI.

content_sections.heading: PFI Analyst - Research Job Description
content_sections.text: The appointed Analyst – Research will report to the Head- Regulatory and Research. Key responsibilities and performance areas include: Conducting research on key power sector policy and regulatory issues, including power markets, retail competition, parallel licensing, contracts for difference, and emerging areas. Preparing policy notes, research papers, analytical reports, briefing notes, and presentations based on detailed research and analysis. Monitoring and analysing policies, regulations, guidelines, and orders issued by MoP, CERC, CEA, SERCs, and other relevant authorities. Examining tariff petitions and regulatory filings of GENCOs, TRANSCOs, and DISCOMs, including assessment of tariff structures, cost components, and financial implications. Tracking and analysing judgments and orders of the Supreme Court, High Courts, and APTEL to assess their implications for the power sector and stakeholders. Compiling, analysing, and interpreting regulatory, tariff, financial, and sectoral data to support evidence-based policy research and decision-making. Undertaking comparative research on international practices and regulatory frameworks and assessing their applicability to the Indian power sector. Supporting stakeholder consultations, workshops, expert discussions, and industry interactions on power sector and regulatory matters. Contributing to policy advocacy and preparing comments, submissions, and recommendations on key regulatory and policy issues. Developing and maintaining a strong understanding of the technical, regulatory, commercial, financial, and energy-transition dimensions of the power sector. Supporting the preparation of PFI presentations, reports, knowledge products, and other research outputs for internal and external stakeholders. Providing research, analytical, and cross-functional support to the Regulatory & Research Division and undertaking other assignments as required.

Shortlisted candidates are called for document verification, an online examination and a personal interview. All of these take place at IBPS House, 90 Ft DP Road, Behind Thakur Polytechnic, Off. W E Highway, Kandivali (East), Mumbai 400101. The exam is in English, with a composite time of 90 minutes for each post. IBPS may change the exam structure. Negative marking: 0.25 of the marks for a question is deducted for each wrong answer. Unanswered questions carry no penalty. Cut-off: you need a minimum score in each test, and a total high enough to be shortlisted. IBPS fixes the cut-offs based on the number of vacancies. Interview: candidates who pass the online exam are interviewed the same day, or the next day depending on the response. Merit list: a committee makes the selection, and its decision is final. Provisionally selected candidates are informed later by email or letter. If the process runs into a second day, candidates arrange their own lodging. IBPS does not reimburse travel or boarding costs. Candidates who arrive after the reporting time on their call letter, or who come without the required documents, will not be allowed to take part.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: Probation: 1 year from the date of joining. Confirmation depends on completing it satisfactorily and on the IBPS staff rules. Service bond: Rs. 1 lakh. You must serve at least 2 years from joining or pay Rs. 1 lakh to IBPS. The bond period may be extended by the number of loss of pay (LOP) days. Posting: Mumbai only, as a permanent posting. You must arrange your own accommodation. Candidates from outside Mumbai are welcome if they are committed to relocating permanently. Commitment: all positions require full 24x7 commitment to the Institute. At joining: a medical fitness certificate from a civil surgeon or a doctor empanelled with LIC of India/PSBs, and police verification, are mandatory.

Work at the NHSRC is organised around eight divisions, namely– Community Processes & Comprehensive Primary Care, Healthcare Financing, Healthcare Technology, Human Resources for Health, Information Technology, Knowledge Management Division, Public Health Administration and Quality & Patient Safety.

content_sections.heading: NHSRC Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: The selected candidate will report to the Principal Team Lead- Technical NHSRC and will be responsible for the following roles & responsibilities: Develop responsive web and PWA applications for public health program users. Build reusable Angular components and front-end modules. Create user-friendly interfaces for care delivery, program operations, and reporting workflows. Integrate front-end applications with backend APIs. Collaborate with product, design, backend, QA, and implementation teams.

Preference will be given to candidates residing within Delhi/NCR region. Willingness to travel on need basis from New Delhi work location.

content_sections.heading: Project Details
content_sections.text: The project looks at how developers of utility-scale solar and wind projects in India engage with local communities, handle socio-environmental tensions and mobilise global capital to scale up renewable energy. It uses surveys and interviews in different local settings. The study will add to ongoing research at IIT Delhi on community engagement and equity in siting renewable energy projects.

rows.details: Communities, Developers, and State: Exploring Governance, Risk, and Finance for Indias Net-Zero Transition (RM00125F)

content_sections.heading: IIT Delhi Principal Project Scientist and Senior Project Scientist Vacancy Details 2026
content_sections.text: The notice prints the pay as a slab: Rs. 75,600 to Rs. 1,01,610 for the Principal Project Scientist and Rs. 60,750 to Rs. 79,260 for the Senior Project Scientist. If the selected candidate is a retired or superannuated government employee, the salary will be fixed under the prevailing IRD norms.

content_sections.heading: IIT Delhi Principal Project Scientist and Senior Project Scientist Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: Only Indian nationals can apply. Essential qualification: Ph.D. with first class or equivalent in economics, energy systems, innovation studies, public policy, political science, sociology, engineering, or a related discipline. OR: MTech with 1st class, MSc with 1st class, or an equivalent degree in economics, energy systems, innovation studies, public policy, political science, sociology, engineering, or a related discipline, with 6 years of experience in related areas, from a reputed university. Required skillset: Strong aptitude for independent research. This includes formulating and refining research questions, developing suitable methods, managing research with limited supervision and taking a leading role in producing high-quality academic outputs. Experience of mixed-methods research, such as survey design, interviews, data analysis and conjoint analysis. Desirable: Evidence of independent research through publications, working papers, research projects or similar outputs (highly desirable). Experience in the energy sector, project finance or energy technologies, and industry contacts. Essential qualification: MTech/MS (or an equivalent technical degree) with 1st class, OR BTech/MSc/Post graduate with 1st class in a relevant discipline, with 3 years of experience in economics, energy systems, innovation studies, public policy, political science, sociology, engineering, or a related discipline, from a reputed university. Required skillset: Experience of mixed-methods research, including survey design, interviews, data analysis and conjoint analysis. Desirable: Strong quantitative and data-analysis skills. Experience in the energy sector, financial databases, project finance or energy technologies, and industry contacts. Interest in developing research skills and possibly doing a PhD or following a research career. SC/ST candidates may be given a 5% relaxation of marks. If no candidate is found suitable, the Selection Committee may downgrade a post. Check the official notification for the full eligibility for each post.

content_sections.heading: Duties of the Selected Candidates
content_sections.text: The notice lists the same work for both posts: Examine how environmental, social, permitting and community-related factors affect the development, financing and implementation of energy and infrastructure projects. Help design and run a survey of energy-sector developers to collect primary data on renewable energy firms' cost of capital, financing conditions, environmental and social risks, and community opposition. Combine survey evidence with financial and project-level datasets to study links between cost of capital, project risk, environmental and social factors, and community acceptance. Do literature reviews across energy finance, innovation studies, project development, environmental risk and community acceptance, and contribute to academic papers, reports and presentations. Produce clear visualisations and present the findings to academic and policy audiences (Principal Project Scientist). The notice says the Senior Project Scientist post offers the chance to contribute to academic publications and gain experience in interdisciplinary research on energy, finance, policy, technology and sustainability.

faq.answer: There are 2 posts: 1 Principal Project Scientist and 1 Senior Project Scientist, both in the School of Public Policy.

faq.answer: Use the post you are applying for and your last name, for example "Principal Project Scientist -Khanna.pdf".

faq.answer: Yes. SC/ST candidates may be given a 5% relaxation of marks.

faq.answer: It is a contract, renewable every year or up to the end of the project, whichever is earlier. The project runs until 31 December 2027.

content_sections.heading: NeGD MLOps Lead at a Glance
About NeGD MLOps Lead
content_sections.text: The National e-Governance Division (NeGD) operates as an independent business division under the Digital India Corporation, Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology. NeGD supports MeitY in programme management and the implementation of e-Governance projects across central and state levels, driving innovative initiatives under the Digital India Programme.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: There is a total of 01 vacancy available for the MLOps Lead position.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Educational Qualification B.Tech / M.Tech / M.S. in Computer Science, Data Engineering, AI or related discipline. Certification in cloud DevOps or MLOps platforms (AWS DevOps Engineer, Azure DevOps Expert, GCP Professional ML Engineer) is highly desirable. Contributions to MLOps or DevOps open source projects is preferred Experience: 7–10 years in machine learning operations or DevOps engineering. Minimum 4 years building CI/CD pipelines for AI/ML model deployment in enterprise or government ecosystems. Proven experience with containerized and microservice architectures.

content_sections.heading: NeGD MLOps Lead Job Description
content_sections.text: The responsibilities for the MLOps Lead post include: Design and manage continuous integration and delivery (CI/CD) pipelines for AI/ML models across multiple environments. Establish model versioning, deployment, monitoring, and rollback mechanisms to ensure stability and traceability. Automate training, testing, and serving workflows using containerized solutions. Define infrastructure-as-code templates for scalable AI deployment on on-prem or cloud environments. Collaborate with Data Science and Engineering teams to standardize model input/output formats and performance metrics. Implement logging, monitoring, and alerting for deployed models to ensure high availability and accuracy over time. Ensure compliance with Responsible AI guidelines for deployment, including bias auditing and explainability tracking.

content_sections.heading: About NTTM
content_sections.text: The National Technical Textiles Mission is run under the Ministry of Textiles, Government of India, and has its own Mission Directorate. The Ministry's office named in the notice is at GPOA-3, Netaji Nagar, New Delhi. Both posts are with the Mission and are filled from officers on deputation.

content_sections.heading: NTTM Joint Mission Director and Deputy Mission Director Vacancy Details 2026
content_sections.text: For Joint Mission Director, Level 13 applies to officers drawing the Level 12 pay scale in their parent cadre. Level 13A applies to those drawing Level 13. The pay of officers selected on deputation will be regulated by the relevant instructions of the Department of Personnel & Training, as amended from time to time.

content_sections.heading: NTTM Joint Mission Director and Deputy Mission Director Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: For both posts, the maximum age for appointment by deputation or absorption must not exceed 56 years as on the closing date for receipt of applications. Who can apply: Officers of the Central Government who hold an analogous post on a regular basis in their cadre or department, or who are in Level 13 or equivalent, or who are in Level 12 with three years' regular service in the grade (or equivalent) in their parent cadre or department. Qualifying (mandatory): a Masters Degree in Science/Technology, or a B Tech/BE in Textile with at least 5 years' experience in Technical Textiles. Desirable: a Ph.D in the relevant subject, and at least 3 years' experience in any Scientific/Technology Mission. Who can apply: Officers of the Central Government, Autonomous Bodies or Statutory Bodies who hold an analogous post on a regular basis in their cadre, department or organisation, or who have three years' regular service in the grade at Level 10 or equivalent in their parent cadre, department or organisation. Required: relevant experience in implementing Government Schemes. The official notification does not specify the minimum educational qualification. Check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions for each post.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: Appointment is on deputation. The deputation period, including any time on deputation in another ex-cadre post held just before this appointment in the same or another Central Government organisation or department, lasts up to 31 March 2028. The posting is with the National Technical Textiles Mission under the Ministry of Textiles. Once an officer applies, they cannot withdraw their candidature. When forwarding the application, the forwarding authority must confirm that the officer will be relieved of their duties to join the Ministry of Textiles if selected.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for NTTM Joint Mission Director and Deputy Mission Director Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Up-to-date CR/APAR dossiers, or clear photocopies of your CRs/APARs for the last 5 years, attested by a Group 'A' officer not below the rank of Under Secretary to the Government of India. A statement of any major or minor penalties imposed on you in the last 10 years of service. An Integrity Certificate or Vigilance clearance. Cadre clearance. Applications that arrive after the closing date, come without the CR/APAR dossiers (or attested copies) and other documents, or are otherwise incomplete are liable to be rejected.

faq.answer: Applications are due within 60 days of the O.M.'s issue date. Counted from the O.M. dated 27 October 2026, that is 26 December 2026.

faq.answer: No. Joint Mission Director is open only to Central Government officers. Deputy Mission Director is open to officers of the Central Government, Autonomous Bodies and Statutory Bodies. Both posts are filled only on deputation.

faq.answer: Officers drawing Level 12 in their parent cadre get Level 13. Officers already drawing Level 13 get Level 13A.

faq.answer: No, a Ph.D in the relevant subject is only desirable. The required qualification is a Masters Degree in Science/Technology, or a B Tech/BE in Textile with at least 5 years' experience in Technical Textiles.

faq.answer: Three years of regular service in the grade at Level 10 or equivalent in the parent cadre, department or organisation. You also need relevant experience in implementing Government Schemes.

faq.answer: Up to 31 March 2028. This includes any deputation in another ex-cadre post held just before this appointment.

content_sections.heading: About RECPDCL
content_sections.text: REC Power Development and Consultancy Limited, formerly REC Power Distribution Company Limited, is a wholly owned subsidiary of REC Ltd., a "Maharatna CPSE" under the Ministry of Power, Government of India. It provides consultancy across the power sector. Its work includes project management consultancy, smart metering, smart grid, solar projects, third-party quality inspection, energy audit, DPRs and power transmission projects. It also works with Government of India schemes such as R-APDRP, IPDS, PMDP, RFMS and NFMS.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Benefits
content_sections.text: The pay is a monthly consolidated amount (L5: Rs. 1,55,250 for Compliance and Rs. 1,35,000 for Offset; L3: Rs. 85,000; L2: Rs. 62,000). Other benefits are paid on top of it, as admissible under company policy: Mobile set, laptop and office bag reimbursement Hardship allowance for a Ladakh posting Medical benefits Group Personal Accident Insurance

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Shortlisted candidates are called for a personal interview. It is held at the RECPDCL Corporate Office or online, as the management decides. Offers go out in order of merit, based on the number of vacancies. If many applications come in, RECPDCL may use higher shortlisting criteria. The indicative shortlisting ratios are: Marks are given only for qualifications and experience backed by documents submitted by the last date. Experience counts only if it clearly relates to the advertised post. A tie at the cut-off is broken in this order: Higher marks/CGPA in the essential qualification Longer total post-qualification experience More directly relevant domain experience If the tie remains, all tied candidates may be shortlisted.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: Tenure: 1 year at first, which may be extended based on need and performance, up to a maximum of 4 years and 6 months. Nature of the job: purely temporary and not against any permanent vacancy. It gives no claim to regular employment at RECPDCL. Place of posting: Corporate Office, Gurugram and/or project offices across India. Management may post selected candidates to any office, project or unit. Lead Verifier posts: the posting is decided by organisational and project needs and told to candidates at the interview or at joining. Medical fitness: engagement depends on a medical fitness test, with no relaxation in standards. Travel and stay: interview candidates get to-and-fro fare by the shortest route on proof of journey, as per policy. Lodging is not paid. Government and PSU staff: must apply through proper channel, or give an NOC at the interview or a relieving order at joining. Canvassing: any form of canvassing leads to disqualification.

faq.answer: Rs. 62,000 a month (consolidated) at Level L2. It is negotiable for deserving candidates, and benefits such as mobile and laptop reimbursement are paid on top.

faq.answer: No. Each candidate may apply for only one post. If you apply for more, RECPDCL may consider any one application at its discretion.

faq.answer: Age and experience are counted as on 17.11.2026. The upper age limits are 35 years for L-2, 40 years for L-3 and 55 years for L-5 posts.

faq.answer: No. It is a fixed-tenure engagement of 1 year to start, which can be extended up to a maximum of 4 years and 6 months. It gives no right to regular employment.

faq.answer: Both are in Ladakh. A hardship allowance for the Ladakh posting is paid on top of the consolidated pay, as admissible.

faq.answer: If many applications come in, candidates are scored out of 100. Engineering candidates are marked on qualifying-exam percentage (35), higher qualification (25) and extra experience (40). Shortlisting goes up to 6 or 10 candidates per vacancy.

faq.answer: No. Teaching experience, internships, induction and training periods are not counted as experience.

basic_details.short_information: New Mangalore Port Authority (NMPA) Marine Department has invited applications for engagement to the post of Assistant Manager (VTS) on a contract basis at Panambur, Mangalore. Eligible candidates possessing the required qualifications and experience must submit their applications in the prescribed format along with copies of self-attested documents to the Deputy Conservator, New Mangalore Port Authority, Panambur, Mangalore – 575 010. The last date for receipt of applications is on or before 20-11-2026.

age_limit.details: The maximum age limit for the position is 35 years. The crucial date for determining eligibility criteria, educational qualification, experience, age etc. shall be as on first day for the month in which applications were invited.

qualification.details: Degree in Electrical and Electronics or Electronics and Communications Engineering from a recognized University. | Minimum 2 years work experience in Electrical / Electronic Works. | Candidates having experience in electrical installation, operation & maintenance of Marine communication equipment like VHF, Radar, AIS, DSC, MF/HF Radios etc. Proficient in M.S Office (Word, Excel and Power point). Candidates having work experience in Port sector. | The maximum age limit for the position is 35 years. The crucial date for determining eligibility criteria, educational qualification, experience, age etc. shall be as on first day for the month in which applications were invited.

salary_details.details: The consolidated pay for Assistant Manager (VTS) on contract basis is ₹50,000/-. An increment of 5% on consolidated monthly of remuneration would be considered for every completed year of service, subject to satisfactory performance. The tenure of the engagement shall be for a period of 03 years from the date of joining the duty/service, extendable by 02 years on mutual consent. Your engagement is purely on contract basis and shall not confer you any right to lay claim for permanent absorption in the port service, against any post whatsoever.

selection_process: The candidates possessing requisite qualification and relevant experience will be called for interview. Eligible candidates will be called for interview through e-mail only. The date
time and venue of interview will be informed accordingly. NMPA reserves the right to fix the minimum standard / qualifying marks for selection of position.
important_instructions: The selected candidate shall execute a security bond, before joining to the post, on non-judicial stamp paper of ₹200/-. An amount of ₹5,000/- (Rupees Five thousand only) per month will be retained from your salary, subject to a maximum of ₹50,000/- (Rupees Fifty thousand only) and will be refunded after completion of the contract period without any interest. The duration of working hours will be as per office hours with weekly off on Saturday & Sunday. In exigencies, he/she may require to work beyond officer hours/holidays for which no extra remuneration will be paid. The selected candidate will be permitted to avail 15 days of Casual Leave in a calendar year with the prior permission of the competent authority. No provision exists for the encashment of the non-availed portion of the Casual Leave or for carrying forward the said leave to the next calendar year. In case of absence in excess of 15 days, payment will be subject to proportionate reduction of salary. Entitled to avail free medical facility at Srinivas Port Hospital, Panambur, Mangalore for self with dependent spouse and children to the extent of the In-house facilities available in the hospital. Port accommodation will be provided subject to availability at rent as per NMPA policy, which will be deducted from the consolidated pay. In addition, allied charges such as water charges & Electricity charges shall have to be borne by occupant. For joining the post, no Travelling Allowance will be paid. However, the TA/DA will be paid for official tour during the contract period, as applicable to the regular officers of the equal rank in the port with the same basic pay. No office vehicle will be provided for attending duty at headquarters. Hence, you should make your own arrangement of transportation for attending duty headquarters at Panambur, Mangalore. - NMPA reserves the right to terminate your contract appointment at any point of time by giving one month’s notice without any liability. In the event of misconduct, the contract appointment can be terminated by the port without any notice and without assigning any reason. In case the selected candidate wish to leave the contract appointment at NMPA, he/she shall be required to give one month advance notice in writing. The candidates shall have good health condition, and the original documents should be submitted at the time of interview for verification.

Candidates can apply through the official website.

content_sections.heading: About NeGD Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: The National e-Governance Division operates under the Digital India Corporation, Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology, supporting MeitY in programme management and implementation of e-Governance projects. This recruitment aims to fill AI/ML Lead positions initially for a period of three years, with possible extensions based on project requirements.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: There are a total of 04 positions available for the AI/ML Lead role on a contractual basis.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: B.Tech./B.E., M.Tech./M.S. or M.Sc. in Computer Science, AI/ML, Data Science, Electronics or a related discipline Advanced degree (M.Tech./M.S./Ph.D.) or published work in the chosen specialisation is highly desirable Certifications are not mandatory; demonstrated work, as listed under Minimum Evidence at Screening, shall carry greater weight Candidates from non-traditional backgrounds with strong verifiable work will be considered in lieu of formal qualification Experience 7+ years developing and deploying AI/ML systems (10+ years preferred); minimum 4 years building systems in the chosen specialisation deployed in production (Agentic AI: minimum 2 years building LLM applications or agents in production) At least 2 years leading a team of engineers or data scientists, including setting technical direction and reviewing their work Demonstrable delivery of at least one system in the chosen specialisation used by real users at scale, with documented evaluation: field-level accuracy (NLP & Document AI), word error rate or resolution rate (Speech AI), error rates at operating thresholds (Computer Vision), or task-success rates and safety controls (Agentic AI) Hands-on experience fine-tuning open-weight or foundation models on domain data Experience with Indian languages, scripts or code-mixed data is a strong plus Experience overseeing vendor delivery is desirable

content_sections.heading: NeGD Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: The selected AI/ML Lead candidates will handle technical leadership and specialisation responsibilities across multiple domains: Own the technical roadmap of the team’s reusable services, choosing between prompting, retrieval, fine-tuning and smaller specialised models on accuracy, cost, latency and data governance grounds, and documenting the rationale. Lead in-house engineers and data scientists, review their work, and remain hands-on in code, training and debugging. NLP & Document AI: OCR, layout analysis and parsing for scanned, handwritten and mixed script documents; extraction, classification, PII redaction, summarisation, similarity and deduplication; retrieval-augmented question answering over rules, circulars and case files, with citations and grounding checks. Speech AI: speech recognition, synthesis, translation and language identification for Indian languages, including 8 kHz telephone audio and code-mixed speech; assistants on web, WhatsApp, IVR and mobile with retrieval-grounded answers, human hand-off and safe failure; real-time voice pipelines within latency budgets. Computer Vision: face detection, 1:1 verification, 1:N search, liveness and presentation-attack detection at large scale; tamper, forgery and photo-substitution detection for identity documents and certificates; field-photo and satellite imagery analytics; deployment on server, mobile and edge. Agentic AI: agents for planning, tool use, memory and multi-agent coordination using LangGraph or equivalent and the Model Context Protocol (MCP); least-privilege tool permissions, human approval for every consequential action, audit trails and rollback; reusable agent templates for drafting, document scrutiny and request routing. Evaluation & Safety: Build golden datasets and specialisation-appropriate metrics with the QA Lead, set release thresholds, and run subgroup analysis across languages, document types, demographics or acoustic conditions; test services for prompt injection, presentation attacks, adversarial inputs and leakage of personal data before release with the AI Safety team. Deployment & Reuse: Deploy services through the AI platform and gateway, publish them to the service catalogue with documentation and SLAs, and contribute models and evaluation sets to AIKosh Vendor Oversight; review designs, code and evaluation evidence of vendor teams, and recommend acceptance or rejection of deliverables. Responsible AI & Privacy: Apply anonymisation, data minimisation and DPDPA 2023 requirements, with stricter handling for biometric data in Computer Vision, and document models through model cards and evaluation records.

content_sections.heading: NeGD AI Safety Researcher Job Description
content_sections.text: The responsibilities for the AI Safety Researcher position include: Design and execute adversarial attack campaigns - evasion, model inversion, membership inference, model extraction, data poisoning - against pod deliverables including document intelligence, predictive-analytics and fraud-scoring models, and visual AI, face-embedding and liveness models. Develop and maintain a reusable adversarial ML attack library and test harness for repeatable pre-production evaluation. Produce adversarial-robustness reports for each pod service with quantitative measures, reproducible attack notebooks, and prioritised mitigation guidance. Lead structured red-team exercises against LLM, RAG and agentic AI deployments across the programme, covering prompt injection, jailbreaks, indirect prompt injection via retrieved documents, data exfiltration, unsafe tool invocation, sandbox escape and policy-boundary violations by agents. Develop and maintain red-team playbooks tailored to government AI use cases; publish anonymised playbooks and evaluation sets to AIKosh under standard metadata. Advise pods on guardrail selection, output filtering, RAG source-integrity controls, retrieval provenance, and agent policy design. Design and run hallucination measurement, groundedness checks, and calibration/uncertainty evaluation for RAG systems and generative outputs across teams. Run bias and fairness audits using quantitative metrics - demographic parity, equalised odds, calibration, subgroup accuracy. Conduct explainability evaluation (SHAP, LIME, Captum) and lightweight privacy impact assessments on team deliverables. Author the technical safety evaluation content in model cards, dataset sheets, bias/hallucination/safety evaluation reports, and Responsible AI evidence per the MeitY Responsible AI advisory and the IndiaAI Safe & Trusted AI framework. Own AI-specific threat modelling end-to-end for all pod systems under development - STRIDE, MITRE ATT&CK, MITRE ATLAS and OWASP Top 10 for LLMs - including data pipelines, retrieval sources, model artefacts, prompt paths, tool interfaces and output surfaces. Review deployment configurations across IndiaAI Compute, on-premise/sovereign GPU and CSP-API paths for AI-specific security risks; recommend controls and defensive patterns. Contribute AI security and Responsible AI requirements to NeGD RFQs, RDRs and procurement documents; review empanelled-agency proposals for AI security posture. Advise each team’s AI QA Engineer on safety and Responsible AI test design, sample selection, evaluation metrics and evidence capture. Brief and upskill teams on AI-specific security concerns and Responsible AI controls. Track adversarial ML, LLM safety, agentic-AI safety and Responsible AI research literature; translate relevant findings into team-usable checks, controls and evaluation additions. content_sections.heading: About RGCB
content_sections.text: BRIC-Rajiv Gandhi Centre for Biotechnology is a biotechnology research institute at Thycaud Post, Poojappura, Thiruvananthapuram, Kerala. According to the notice, RGCB has sophisticated scientific equipment that supports research across several divisions, along with technology development units and core facilities. These technical posts provide the hands-on support behind that work.

content_sections.heading: Job Description
content_sections.text: The Technical Officer provides hands-on engineering support to research laboratories, technology development units and institutional facilities. The post needs practical expertise in biomedical instrumentation, electronics, embedded systems and field-level engineering work. The duties include, but are not limited to: installing, operating, maintaining, calibrating and troubleshooting biomedical, electronic and laboratory instruments hardware prototyping, PCB design, circuit debugging, sensor integration and embedded system development for research and translational projects calibration, reliability testing and quality checks of scientific equipment supporting field deployments, mobile laboratory operations and outreach programmes, including installation, testing and user training preparing technical documentation, equipment specifications and procurement notes for engineering components coordinating installation, AMC and compliance of procured systems supporting IT-enabled systems, communication interfaces and sensor-based monitoring platforms training students, researchers and project staff on instrument handling, safety procedures and good operating practice reporting equipment status, updates and replacements in real time, and maintaining all equipment on site The job description also asks for excellent communication skills, including the ability to explain technical problems and propose solutions. This post provides day-to-day laboratory and research support across RGCB's scientific divisions. The duties include: routine laboratory procedures, preparing reagents and buffers, and handling biological and chemical samples assisting scientists with experimental workflows and recording observations accurately operating and maintaining centrifuges, spectrophotometers, incubators, electrophoresis units, microscopes and PCR systems keeping equipment calibrated and clean, and documenting its use sample processing, biochemical and molecular assays, and maintaining cell culture materials where required managing laboratory inventories and stocks, and following safety protocols and biomedical waste disposal norms giving technical help to students and project staff, and coordinating sample submissions with core facilities This post helps with routine work in scientific, clinical and molecular laboratories. The duties include: supporting the Laboratory-in-Charge in day-to-day work keeping the designated laboratory sections running smoothly maintaining laboratory records ensuring safety, hygiene, autoclave and waste disposal compliance general administrative and support work: keeping work logs, processing orders, indents or invoices, and simple clerical and accounting tasks tasks given by the Competent Authority

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: First, an Institutional Screening Committee checks every application against the minimum qualifications. Applications that do not meet them are rejected without further correspondence. Meeting the requirements does not on its own guarantee a place in the selection process. Shortlisted candidates take a three-tier examination, held only in Thiruvananthapuram. Candidates are shortlisted for Tier III based on their combined Tier I and Tier II score (maximum 300 marks). The designated authority decides the cut-off. The list for Tier III is published on the RGCB website and on the notice board at the Main Campus, and no individual messages are sent. Tier III is a qualifying Pass/Fail practical test based on the job description. If you have applied for more than one post, you take a separate skills test for each one. The final merit list ranks candidates who passed Tier III by their total Tier I and Tier II score. Results are published on the Institute's website, and successful candidates are informed by email. At every tier you must bring the RGCB Admit Card and one valid Government of India identity card: Aadhaar Card, Passport, PAN Card, Voter ID or Driving Licence. If you cannot show both, you will be disqualified on the spot.

content_sections.heading: About IRCON
content_sections.text: IRCON International Limited calls itself a Navratna CPSE under the Ministry of Railways. It builds turnkey infrastructure projects in Railways, Highways, Buildings, the Power sector and other areas, in India and abroad. Its registered office is at C-4, District Centre, Saket, New Delhi – 110 017. These posts are for its Northeast Frontier Railway (NFR) Projects under the Lumding and Tinsukia Divisions.

content_sections.heading: Posts and Eligibility
content_sections.text: The only post is Manager/Electrical – on contract. It has 37 vacancies, and the notice divides them by category as shown below. The notice says the number of posts may change after a further assessment of requirement. Full Time Bachelor's Degree in Electrical Engineering with not less than 60% marks or equivalent grade from recognized University/ Institute approved by AICTE/UGC, as on 01.10.2026. The percentage is taken from the consolidated mark sheet issued by the University/Institution. If the university or institute does not issue a consolidated mark sheet, the final percentage is the average of all semesters/years. Candidates must write their percentage without rounding it off. If the mark sheets show CGPA/OGPA/DGPA: If the university/institute has no rule for converting CGPA/OGPA/CPI/DGPA or a letter grade into a percentage, a minimum of 6 on a 10-point scale is treated as 60%. A score on any other scale is prorated. If the university/institute does provide a conversion, the candidate gives the equivalent percentage using that institution's norms. A certificate to this effect may be obtained from the university/institute, and it must be produced at the time of verification. Candidates need at least five years of experience after their qualification, as on 01.10.2026. The experience must be in Electrical construction, Procurement, Installation, Testing and commissioning/TRD Maintenance in Railways, Metro Rail or Power Transmission/Distribution utilities. Experience in Railway OHE/Power Supply/SCADA, E&M or Electrical utility Diversion will be preferred. Teaching, training, consultancy or freelancing experience does not count as relevant experience. The maximum age is 50 years as on 01.10.2026. Age relaxations follow the Government of India's guidelines, as long as the candidate has the required qualification and experience. Candidates should be in sound health and free from colour blindness. No relaxation in health standards will be allowed. Candidates can apply whether or not they are working on the cut-off date, as long as they have the essential qualification and post-qualification experience. Ex-contract employees of IRCON whose services ended because their projects closed can also apply if they meet these requirements. They must send a copy of their termination letter with the application, and the new appointment will be a fresh appointment with no link to their earlier employment in IRCON. For the full eligibility conditions of the post, see the official notification.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Contract Terms
content_sections.text: Pay: a fixed consolidated pay of Rs. 60,000/- per month, plus an annual increment of 5% on the fixed consolidated pay after each completed year of service. There are no allowances on top of the fixed pay. Contract period: initially 18 months, subject to satisfactory performance. The contract may be extended for another year if the candidate's services are satisfactory and the Project requires it. The posts are only for the NFR Projects under the Lumding and Tinsukia Divisions and not for IRCON's regular establishment. The appointment is co-terminus with the Project and gives no right to claim absorption into the regular establishment or appointment in other projects of the company. Medical cover: contract employees must take a Medical Health Insurance Policy of Rs Three Lakhs for themselves, covering Covid-19 and other diseases, with a premium ceiling of Rs 4000/- per annum. The premium is reimbursed when the employee submits a copy of the policy and the original premium receipt. PF: the minimum PF prescribed under the EPF & MP Act 1952 is deducted from the salary, and IRCON makes a matching contribution. The accumulated amount is paid when the contract ends. Leave: one leave for each calendar month of service. Leave can be carried forward and accumulated, but unused leave is not encashed during the contract or on resignation or termination. No other type of leave is admissible. Employees get one weekly off and the public holidays on which the project office is closed. Working hours, working days and offs are the same as for the Project. TA/DA is admissible if the employee is deputed on outstation duty. No other perks or benefits are admissible.

content_sections.heading: What to Bring
content_sections.text: Candidates must bring the originals and one set of photocopies of the following: The application, typed on A-4 size paper in the format attached to the notice. The format asks for personal and contact details, community, whether any relative works or has worked in IRCON, last/present organisation, academic and professional qualifications with marks, and work experience as on 01-10-2026. It also needs a self-attested passport-size photograph and the signed declaration. Experience certificates in chronological order. Candidates in a current job must also bring the last two months' salary slips from their present employer, because an offer letter alone is not accepted as proof of experience. Date of birth/Class X passing certificate as proof of date of birth. Caste certificate/EWS certificate/age relaxation certificate, in the format prescribed by the Government of India's guidelines. Qualification degree/diploma and the mark sheets of all semesters/years, so that the percentage in the qualifying degree can be calculated. For ex-contract employees of IRCON: a copy of the termination letter. OBC candidates need a caste certificate issued by the competent authority for appointment to services under the Government of India, in the Annexure-A format attached to the notice. Only an OBC certificate issued in the current financial year will be accepted as proof of not belonging to the "creamy layer".

content_sections.heading: What Happens on the Day
content_sections.text: Registration opens at 09:30 am at the venue for that date. Candidates can register up to 1:00 pm only. Interviews start at 10:00 AM. Only candidates who meet the eligibility criteria will be interviewed. Candidates must bring the original certificates proving their age, community, educational qualifications and experience. Without them, the interview will not be held. Depending on how many candidates register, the process may take more than one day, so candidates should plan their travel with this in mind. Requests to change the date, time or location will not be entertained.

content_sections.heading: About INFLIBNET Centre
content_sections.text: The notice describes the INFLIBNET Centre as an Autonomous Inter University Centre of the University Grants Commission, with its headquarters at Gandhinagar, Gujarat. The Centre runs programmes to modernise libraries and information centres in universities, colleges, institutes of higher learning and R & D institutes in India using computer and communication technology. Its major programmes include ONOS, Infistats, INFED, Shodhgangotri, Shodh-Chakra, Vidwan, Vidya-Mitra, IRINS, NIRF and SOUL, along with several other national-level projects.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The Centre reserves the right to increase or decrease the number of posts and to fill or not fill some or all of them.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Only Indian Nationals may apply. Qualifications must be from a recognised university, board or institution. Experience and qualification are counted as on the last date for submitting the online application (as amended, if any, on the INFLIBNET website). Essential: A Bachelor's degree of a recognized university with at least second class with five years experience in the field of Purchase & Stores/Accounts/Establishment in a Univ./Govt./Autonomous Body/reputed private Firm. Desirable: (1) B.Com/M.Com; (2) Knowledge of Tally accounting software, PFMS, TDS/GST, Audit procedure/rules, Financial Statements. Where a post requires experience, only relevant experience gained after the prescribed qualification is counted. Relaxation or concession is as per Govt. of India rules/Bye-laws of the Centre, if any. A candidate with a foreign university's degree must submit an equivalency certificate issued by the Association of Indian Universities (AIU) with the application. A candidate whose degree comes from a university that uses a grading system must give the equivalency criteria, or the formula or method, for converting the score into a percentage and Class/Division. A candidate whose degree, diploma or certificate is from an institution declared fake or de-recognised by the University Grants Commission, AICTE or another competent authority is not eligible for any post. A person dismissed by the Union Government, a State Government, a Local Authority, or a Government Corporation owned or controlled by the Central or a State Government is ineligible for appointment. For the discipline-specific eligibility of each post, candidates should check the official INFLIBNET notification.

content_sections.text: The posts carry the usual allowances as per Govt. of India rules, as applicable from time to time. Selected candidates will be covered under the New Pension Scheme (NPS) only. However, selected candidates are liable to be posted for work anywhere in India as and when required.

content_sections.heading: INFLIBNET Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: The Scientist-E will be a senior member of a group of young library professionals. The group's work includes: interacting with and assisting the University Libraries in their computerization work; creation of machine-readable databases; organizing information services; conducting training programs for library professionals in computerized library operation; arranging seminars etc. The Scientist-B will be a senior member of a group of young computer professionals. The group's work includes: development of various library related software packages; setting up of networking facilities; advising and assisting university libraries in computerization process; training the library professionals in use of computer etc. drafting and noting; administrative and establishment matters; finance and accounts; purchase and stores matters.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: INFLIBNET may conduct a screening test, a written test, a skill test or an interview. Meeting the minimum eligibility does not by itself mean a call for the written test or interview. Shortlisting: Duly constituted Scrutiny Committee(s) may limit the number of candidates called for a screening test, written test or interview to a reasonable number. They do this on the basis of qualifications, experience and other criteria higher than the minimum prescribed. Only candidates shortlisted on the basis of qualifications and quality of relevant experience will be called. Call letters: Hall Tickets and call letters will be sent only to shortlisted or eligible candidates, and only by email. Candidates need a valid, active email ID. The Centre is not responsible for bounced emails or emails that land in a SPAM folder. Originals: Candidates must produce original testimonials, certificates and other documents at the screening test, written test or interview, or whenever asked. No TA and no date change: No TA will be paid for attending a screening test, written test or interview. No request to change the date of a test or interview will be considered. Medical fitness: The selected candidate will have to submit a medical certificate of fitness from the Civil Surgeon of a Govt. Hospital.

content_sections.heading: About CURAJ
content_sections.text: Central University of Rajasthan (CURAJ) is a central university in Rajasthan. Its CURAJ Incubation Foundation runs the E-YUVA Center, which is supported by BIRAC. According to the notice, the center's work covers innovation and entrepreneurship in the biotechnology/bio-pharma domain: it mentors fellows and startups, holds technical workshops and supports product-oriented research.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The notice lists three posts without printing the number of vacancies for each one, so the total is counted as 3, one for each post. The University reserves the right to increase or decrease the number of posts.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Applications are invited from eligible and suitable Indian nationals. Each post has its own essential qualification and age limit. The age limit for every post is counted as on the last date of application. Essential: Ph.D. in any branch of Life Sciences/ Biotechnology/ Microbiology/Agriculture/ Pharmacy, with at least: 3 years of post-Ph.D. experience in Teaching / Research / Industry Out of these 3 years, at least one year should be in Innovation, Intellectual property and/or entrepreneurship Desirable: proven experience in setting up startups, due diligence and organizing startup events. The notice also lists these desirable points for the Project Coordinator post: Strong interest and passion for nurturing technology innovation and entrepreneurship Academic background in life sciences, bioengineering, biotechnology, biomedical engineering, medicine or allied disciplines (preferred for bio-incubation activities) Experience/qualification in business management, IP management, project management, technology transfer, incubation, law and agreements Excellent communication skills; experience in scientific/proposal writing is desirable Experience in mentoring students, interns or startups will be an advantage Self-starter with the ability to work independently and deliver project goals Ability to design programs, mobilize applicants and generate revenue through scientific/technology-based workshops Note: research and innovation capacity must be evidenced through publications, patents, or startups created/mentored. Age: maximum 45 years as on the last date of application. Relaxation may be provided for highly experienced candidates. Relaxation for experienced candidates as per norms. content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: All three salaries are fixed monthly amounts. The Project Coordinator (₹75,000) and Project Assistant (₹25,000) salaries come "with scope of 5% annual increment". The notice prints no such line for the Office Assistant (₹15,000). Selected candidates are not entitled to any other benefits that are admissible to the regular employees of the Central University of Rajasthan. Appointments are purely temporary and contractual for one year, extendable up to three years (co-terminus with the project) based on performance. No claim for regularization will be entertained. The engagement gives no right to claim regular appointment in the University or continued services in the University. When the engagement period in the offer ends, the candidate is not required to report for duty unless the University grants an extension. The University reserves the right to terminate the engagement at any time, even before the stipulated period, for unsatisfactory performance, misconduct or any other administrative reasons / compulsions.

content_sections.heading: CURAJ Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: Acts as the overall coordinator of the E-YUVA Center and reports directly to the Chief Coordinator / Principal Project Investigator (PI). Responsibilities include: Administrative, scientific and financial support Applicant mobilization, branding and outreach, revenue generation Mentoring fellows (UG to Post-Doctoral level) Organizing technical workshops and supporting product-oriented research Mentoring startups; assisting entrepreneurs in proposals, pitches, business plans and fund-raising Executing innovation and entrepreneurship activities in the biotechnology/bio-pharma domain Any other responsibility assigned by the Chief Coordinator/PI from time to time Provides scientific and administrative support to the E-YUVA Center and reports to the Project Coordinator/Chief Coordinator/PI. Duties include: Laboratory maintenance and monitoring instruments Coordination with fellows Procurement and project finance documentation Organizing seminars and workshops Assisting in proposal writing and fund-raising activities Maintaining day-to-day project operations Office and laboratory support Maintaining records and documentation Assisting in organizing seminars/workshops Mobilizing candidates Supporting target-based revenue generation activities of the E-YUVA Center Any additional duties assigned by the Project Coordinator/Chief Coordinator/PI Under the general conditions, every candidate will also have to perform other duties and work assigned by the Central University of Rajasthan from time to time.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for CURAJ Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Choose the Google Form for your post: Project Coordinator - https://forms.gle/wysd1FhVJF5ew6XR8; Project Assistant - https://forms.gle/wBQ6LVknYdRUKXLj8; Office Assistant - https://forms.gle/UjGqjJFisgB81HLW9. Fill in the application form completely. Attach the supporting documents. Incomplete applications, or applications without supporting documents, will be rejected. Project Coordinator applicants must show their research and innovation capacity through publications, patents, or startups created/mentored. Submit the form by 15 November 2026, up to 11:59 PM. Applications received after the last date will not be considered and are liable to be summarily rejected. The notice does not list the supporting documents one by one. No interim correspondence will be entertained.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: The University reserves the right to conduct a Written Test, Skill Test, Presentation and/or Interview, as deemed necessary. The interview date will be announced later, and the schedule of interview will be published separately on the university website. No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview. If any dispute or ambiguity arises in the selection process, the decision of the University will be final.

basic_details.short_information: IIT Madras Recruitment 2026 is for 2 Junior Research Fellow (JRF) posts in the Department of Civil Engineering. The pay is Rs 37,000 + 27% HRA per month. The posts are purely on contract, initially for six months, and may be extended later based on performance. Candidates need the four-year bachelor's and two-year master's engineering degrees set out below. They must also have passed GATE or clear the national-level selection process that IIT Madras will conduct for this announcement. Applications are accepted online only, through the IC&SR careers portal, until 9 November 2026.

how_to_apply: Go to the IC&SR careers page at icandsr.iitm.ac.in/careers/current_openings.php. Applications are accepted online only through this website.
Register on the portal. Use a correct and active email address, because the Institute will send all correspondence by email only.
Find advertisement number Advt. 220/2026 on the page and submit the application for the relevant position.

The system accepts only one application per registered login ID (email) for each advertisement. If you want to apply for more than one position, select all of them before you submit. A separate application has to be filled for each post.

Submit the application by 9 November 2026. Once submitted, the application cannot be edited or reverted. Do not apply twice for the same post, because multiple applications from one candidate may lead to rejection.

After you submit online, obtain a printout of the application form. You must hand it in when called for the test, and it will be needed at document verification, the test or the interview. Do not send a hard copy of the application to the Institute.

Candidates may send testimonials from people who know their work and character well. A candidate who is currently employed should submit testimonials from the most recent employer or immediate superior as a referee.

For technical problems with submitting the application, email [email protected] or [email protected], or call 044- 2257 9796. Calls are taken from 9.00 AM to 05.30 PM, Monday to Friday, except National Holidays. Only technical issues are accepted on these contacts, and no interim correspondence about the selection process will be considered.

For them, a certificate of eligibility from the Government of India will be necessary for appointment. For Scheduled Caste/Scheduled Tribe candidates, the experience required is relaxable at the Institute's discretion. This applies if, at any stage of selection, the competent authority finds that not enough candidates from these communities with the requisite experience are likely to be available for the vacancy reserved for them.
