how_to_apply: The notification gives the following application process. Only online applications through the Commission's OTR-based system are accepted. Applications sent by any other means will not be accepted.
Visit the official website www.upessc.up.gov.in.
Complete One Time Registration (OTR). Registration is compulsory before applying.
Read the User Manual (Hindi and English) and watch the tutorial videos available on the website before applying.
Fill the registration and application form in English only.
Upload your scanned signature on a white background and a passport-size photograph, both in JPG or JPEG format with a file size between 10 KB and 100 KB.
Upload certificates and documents in PDF format, with a file size between 20 KB and 200 KB.
Pay the application fee online as per your post (₹2,000 for Principal, ₹1,500 for Headmaster).
Submit the application. Take three printouts for future use and keep the fee receipt safe.
The notification does not give a direct application link or screen-by-screen steps. Candidates should use the official website and the User Manual.
After the application is finally submitted, no change is allowed in category, sub-category, date of birth, gender and similar details. Fill in all details correctly while registering and submitting.
A chance to correct errors will be given until the date fixed by the Commission (25 November 2026). Fees paid for an erroneous application will not be refunded.
If a candidate submits more than one application for the same post, only the last application is accepted and all others are treated as cancelled.
An application will be rejected if the photograph or signature is not uploaded in the prescribed size, or if the declaration is not accepted.

If the declaration made in the application is found to be false, the candidate's candidature will be cancelled. The candidate may be debarred from this and all other selections/examinations and face other penal action.

If at any stage it comes to light that a candidate has hidden information or filled it wrongly, the candidature will be cancelled and the candidate may be debarred from future examinations/selections.
Candidates must keep three copies of the submitted application. Two copies must be submitted to the Commission office at the time of interview, with two separate sets of the documents.
A candidate who tries to cheat, shows indiscipline or misbehaves in the exam hall can have candidature cancelled and may be barred from future examinations.

Bring a black ball point pen to the exam hall. Use only black ball point pen to fill the boxes and bubbles on the OMR sheet. Blue or other colour ball pens, fountain pens, gel pens, sketch pens, H.B. pencils and whitener are prohibited.
Once a bubble is darkened, no change is accepted. If more than one bubble is darkened for a question, it will not be evaluated and no marks are given.
Use of eraser, nail, blade or whitener on the OMR sheet is prohibited. An OMR sheet damaged in any way will be cancelled and not evaluated.

Fill the required information on the OMR sheet correctly and darken only the related bubbles. Do not make any other mark such as dots or ink marks. If the OMR sheet is not evaluated because of a mistake, the candidate is solely responsible.
Candidates can download the OMR answer sheet format from the Commission's website and practise before the exam.

Candidates with disabilities will be given a scribe as per the Government Orders dated 4 December 2019 and 8 September 2022. The scribe must be brought by the candidate. Such candidates must get the written exam scribe details registered at the Commission office at least one week before the exam. An additional 20 minutes per hour is allowed. No travel allowance is paid to the scribe.

The notification states that the requisition list includes posts relating to Special Appeal No. 376/2026 (Rajkumar Singh and others versus State of U.P. and others), in compliance with the order of the Hon'ble High Court dated 15 April 2026. These posts are already counted within the totals above. The notification refers to the requisition list for these posts as Appendix-4 in this clause. Note 2 of the notification quotes the Government Order dated 18 April 2022 (point 5): a person with a disability can be appointed against an unreserved vacancy provided the post is identified as suitable for that person's category of disability.

content_sections.heading: About RGNAU
content_sections.text: Rajiv Gandhi National Aviation University (RGNAU) is a Central University under the Ministry of Civil Aviation, Govt. of India. It was established by the Rajiv Gandhi National Aviation University (RGNAU) Act, 2013 (No. 26 of 2013), and its headquarters are at Fursatganj, Dist. Amethi, Uttar Pradesh. The University describes itself as an institution of higher learning in the aviation field that aims to provide research for the aviation industry in India.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The University is engaging 10 Professional Trainees in three fields. * The number of Electrical Engineering / Civil Engineering positions may increase or decrease at the time of selection. The notice also says that the number of positions advertised may be treated as tentative, and that the University has the right to increase or decrease the number of positions at the time of selection.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Only Indian Nationals may apply. The age limit is the same for every post: candidates should not exceed 30 years as on the last date of submission of the online application (6 December 2026). Age and qualifications are counted as on the closing date for submitting the online application form. The notice does not mention any experience requirement for these posts. The desirable qualifications for each post are listed below. Certifications in Public Policy, Governance, Project Management, or Strategic Management. Academic exposure to policy analysis, organizational management. Proficiency in research methodology, report writing, and policy drafting. Ability to prepare policy notes, briefing papers, presentations, and analytical reports for senior Government officials. Electrical Estimation and Costing: preparation of detailed estimates, BOQ, rate analysis, quantity take-off, material costing, cable sizing, and estimation based on CPWD/DSR rates. Training in estimation, costing and tender documentation. Postgraduate Diploma/Certificate course in Construction Management, Project Management or Quality Control. Certification in AutoCAD, STAAD, Primavera, MS Project or other relevant civil engineering software. Training in estimation, costing and tender documentation. Working knowledge of MS Office and digital inventory logging and fundamental emergency first-aid awareness. A person who has been convicted by any Court of Law, or against whom criminal proceedings are pending. A person who is not a citizen of India. Any other category of person disqualified for appointment by the Govt. of India/UGC. Candidates whose degrees, diplomas or certificates come from an institution that the University Grants Commission, New Delhi, has declared fake or derecognised. Degrees must have been awarded by a recognized University / Institute. Applicants are responsible for checking their own eligibility for the training field. For the discipline-specific eligibility of each post, candidates should refer to the official notification.

rows.essential_qualification: Master's Degree in Business Management or Administration or in a relevant Management related disciplines from a recognized University or Institution, and strong knowledge of MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) and presentation tools.
Degree/Diploma in Electrical Engineering from a recognised Polytechnic/Institute/University approved by the State Board of Technical Education or AICTE or UGC.
Degree/Diploma in Civil Engineering from a recognised Polytechnic/Institute/University approved by the State Board of Technical Education or AICTE or UGC.

Diploma in Pharmacy (D.Pharm) or Bachelor of Pharmacy (B.Pharm) from an institute recognized by the Pharmacy Council of India (PCI), with valid registration as a Pharmacist with the Central or State Pharmacy Council (mandatory).

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: Duration: one year at first, which may be extended by a maximum of one more year. The longest possible engagement is 2 years. Working days: selected trainees must work 6 days a week, in their own field (Management, Electrical Engineering / Civil Engineering or Pharmacy). Leave: 01 day of leave for each completed month of training. Location: Fursatganj, Amethi, Uttar Pradesh, or any other location as the University requires. Termination: any indiscipline or irregularity will lead to the training being cut short without any reason being given and without prior notice. No regular post: a Professional Trainee has no right to claim any benefit, compensation, absorption or regularisation of service with the University, and will not be given seniority in any grade of the University. Offer of appointment: the terms and conditions are sent to selected candidates in an offer of appointment. If a candidate does not accept them within the stipulated time, the offer is treated as withdrawn.

how_to_apply: Open the Online Application Portal (OAP) hosted by the Ministry of Ports, Shipping & Waterways at onlinevacancy.shipmin.nic.in.
Fill in and submit the application for the post of Deputy Chief Mechanical Engineer online between 23 October 2026 and 22 November 2026.
Download and print the completed online application form.
Affix a self-attested recent colour passport size photograph in the space provided on the application form.
Enclose attested copies of educational qualifications, experience certificates, and the signed self-undertaking on non-withdrawal of candidature (Annexure-IV).
Submit the application package through proper channel to the parent Port Authority administration for verification and forwarding.

Ensure the envelope carrying the forwarded application is superscribed with "Application for the post of Deputy Chief Mechanical Engineer under Engineering Mechanical Dept., in Mormugao Port Authority".

Candidates must execute an undertaking (Annexure-IV) confirming that they will not withdraw their candidature if selected by the Services Selection Committee. The parent Port Authority must forward attested copies of ACRs/APARs for the last 5 years (2021-22 to 2025-26), year-wise grading statements, administrative clearance (Annexure-II), vigilance clearance (Annexure-III), a No Objection Certificate (Annexure-V), service particulars (Annexure-VI), and details of any penalties imposed during the last 10 years. The parent Port Authority must verify and certify the veracity of university certificates and recognition of degrees obtained by the applicant. No application other than the application uploaded in OAP will be accepted.

faq.question: Q1. What is OPSC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: OPSC Recruitment 2026 is a combined recruitment conducted by the Odisha Public Service Commission for 758 Assistant Executive Engineer (Civil and Mechanical) posts in Group A of Odisha Engineering Service Cadre.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available under OPSC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 758 vacancies are notified, including 750 vacancies for Assistant Executive Engineer (Civil) and 8 vacancies for Assistant Executive Engineer (Mechanical).

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for OPSC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date for registration and submission of online application is 11 November 2026 up to 5:00 P.M.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for OPSC AEE posts?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Degree in Engineering in Civil or Mechanical from any University or Institution recognised by the Government or Associate Member of Institutions of Engineers of India, along with a valid GATE score in the respective engineering discipline.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for OPSC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates must have attained the age of 21 years and must not be above the age of 42 years on 1st January 2026 (born between 2nd January 1984 and 1st January 2005).

faq.question: Q6. Is there a written examination?
faq.answer: No. OPSC conducts no examination for this recruitment. Selection is on the GATE score (90% weightage) and an interview (10%).

faq.question: Q7. Which GATE years are accepted?
faq.answer: GATE 2024, 2025 and 2026, in Civil Engineering for AEE (Civil) and Mechanical Engineering for AEE (Mechanical). Only one year's QR-coded score card can be uploaded, and the candidate is judged on that one.

faq.question: Q8. Is there an application fee?
faq.answer: No. The advertisement states that no fee applies because the recruitment is GATE-based.

faq.question: Q9. Can candidates from outside Odisha apply?
faq.answer: Any Indian citizen who meets the qualification, GATE and Odia requirements can apply, but reservation and relaxation for SC, ST and SEBC are available only to candidates of Odisha.

faq.question: Q10. How many candidates will be called for the interview?
faq.answer: About twice the number of advertised vacancies in each category, with a minimum of five, chosen on GATE score after document verification.

basic_details.short_information: The notification invites qualified professionals on a purely contractual basis for an initial term of three years, extendable up to two further years, to strengthen actuarial valuation, financial projection, data governance, and analytics capabilities at ESIC Headquarters in New Delhi. qualification.details: Chief Actuary / Actuarial Advisor: Minimum 15 years post-fellowship actuarial experience, including at least 5 years at senior leadership level handling large insurance or social security portfolios. Sr. Actuarial Specialist (Valuation & Projections): Minimum 10 years experience in actuarial valuation, projections, stress testing, or scenario analysis in life, health, or social insurance. Sr. Actuarial Specialist (Policy & Scheme Design): Minimum 8 years post-qualification experience in actuarial work including policy impact analysis or scheme design. Actuarial Analyst / Modeller: 3 to 6 years experience in actuarial modelling, valuation support, or insurance analytics. Statistical / Research Officer (Actuarial Support): Minimum 5 years experience in statistical analysis, experience studies, or analytical research. Chief Data & Analytics Officer (CDAO): Minimum 15 years of post-qualification professional experience, including at least 7 years at senior leadership level in data, analytics, actuarial support systems, large IT/data programmes, or evidence-based policy systems, and hands-on responsibility for enterprise-scale data ecosystems covering architecture, governance, analytics, and institutionalisation. Desirable: Prior leadership role in Government / PSU / Statutory Body / Large Regulated Institution, and experience supporting actuarial valuation, financial projections, formulation, or audit-intensive environments. Data Governance Officer: Minimum 10 years of post-qualification experience, including direct responsibility for data standards, metadata frameworks, data definitions, and governance controls across multiple datasets or organisational units, and experience dealing with audit observations, definitional disputes, and statutory reporting requirements. Desirable: Exposure to nationwide or data systems in Government / PSU / Insurance / Social Security organisations. Data Engineering Officer: Minimum 10 years of post-qualification experience, including design and implementation of enterprise-level data models, ETL/ELT pipelines, data warehouses or analytical platforms, and responsibility for automation, validation, performance tuning, documentation, and auditability of data pipelines. Desirable: Experience handling large transactional or financial datasets in regulated or Government environments. Data Analytics Officer: Minimum 10 years of post-qualification experience, including development of analytical reports, dashboards, trend analysis, and structured datasets for senior management or statutory use, and demonstrated ability to prepare valuation-ready or policy-ready analytical outputs. Desirable: Experience supporting actuarial analysis, social sector analytics, or public finance reporting. Data Protection Officer (DPO): Minimum 8 years of post-qualification experience, including implementation of data privacy frameworks, access controls, audit trails, and compliance mechanisms, and experience handling regulatory compliance, audits, or data-related risk assessments. Desirable: Exposure to Government IT systems, statutory audits, or DPDP-aligned compliance environments. Technical Officer (Data Quality & Metadata): Minimum 5 years of post-qualification experience in data quality checks, validation, metadata maintenance, or data documentation activities. Desirable: Experience working in audit-sensitive or governance-driven data environments. Technical Officers (Data Engineers): Minimum 5 years of post-qualification experience in development and maintenance of data pipelines, extraction, transformation, and validation processes. Desirable: Experience with large administrative, financial, or insurance datasets. Technical Officer (Data Analyst / Statistical Officer): Minimum 5 years of post-qualification experience in statistical analysis, reporting, trend analysis, or analytical dataset preparation. Desirable: Experience in social security, insurance, public finance, or Government data systems. Technical Officer (Data Privacy & Access): Minimum 5 years of post-qualification experience in data access control, audit logging, compliance support, or information security operations. Desirable: Experience supporting privacy audits or statutory compliance reviews. | Candidates must refer to the official notification for discipline-specific eligibility details for each post.

salary_details.pay_scale: Consolidated remuneration from Rs. 80,000 to Rs. 3,30,000 per month
salary_details.details: Remuneration is a consolidated monthly amount fixed within the prescribed range by the Selection Committee or Competent Authority, and shall not be construed as pay in terms of applicable pay rules. No annual increment, Dearness Allowance, pension, gratuity, General Provident Fund, House Rent Allowance, Leave Travel Concession, medical reimbursement, or other service benefits admissible to regular Government servants shall be payable. Consolidated remuneration is subject to tax deduction at source (TDS).

selection_process: Selection is conducted through a two-stage process: preliminary scrutiny and shortlisting
followed by a personal interview. There is no written or online test.

Applications received online within the prescribed period are scrutinized for eligibility based on submitted documents. Eligible applications are assessed on essential and desirable qualifications along with years of relevant post-qualification experience. Candidates are shortlisted in order of merit strictly up to a ratio of 1:10 candidates per vacancy
or such other ratio determined by the Competent Authority. All candidates tied at the cut-off score are shortlisted.
Shortlisted candidates appear before a duly constituted Interview/Selection Committee comprising not less than three members (an odd number)

including the Chairperson (an officer not below the rank of Insurance Commissioner) and at least one external subject-matter expert in Actuarial Science or Data Science/Analytics. The committee assesses educational and professional qualifications
relevant post-qualification experience
domain knowledge
aptitude
and overall suitability.

The final select panel is prepared in order of merit based on committee recommendations and is subject to the approval of the Competent Authority. A reserve panel of up to 3 candidates per vacancy is maintained for up to one year from declaration or until the next selection.
how_to_apply: Visit the official ESIC website (esic.gov.in) or access the online application portal link directly.
Navigate to the engagement recruitment portal for contractual professionals.
Fill in personal, educational, professional, and experience details in the online application form.
Upload relevant documents and certificates supporting age, educational qualifications, experience, and eligibility criteria.
Review and verify all entered details and uploaded certificates thoroughly before submission.
Submit the completed online application form before the portal closing date of 12 November 2026.
important_instructions: The engagement is purely contractual for an initial period of 3 years, extendable up to 2 years (one year at a time), and does not constitute regular appointment or confer any right to regularisation or absorption in ESIC or Government service. The engagement may be terminated by either party with one month's prior notice in writing or payment of one month's consolidated remuneration in lieu of notice, without assigning any reason. ESIC reserves the right to terminate engagement immediately without notice or payment in lieu in cases of misconduct, fraud, breach of confidentiality, conflict of interest, unauthorised absence, or false information. Selected professionals are entitled to leave at the rate of 1.5 days for each completed month, with no accumulation beyond a calendar year on a pro-rata basis, and un-availed leave cannot be carried forward to the next year. Selected candidates must maintain strict confidentiality of official, actuarial, statistical, and data-related information and shall not engage in private practice, parallel consultancy, or outside employment. All work products, models, reports, codes, and analyses developed during the engagement vest exclusively with ESIC. Any dispute arising out of this engagement shall be subject to the exclusive jurisdiction of courts or tribunals at New Delhi.

content_sections.heading: ESIC Salary 2026
content_sections.text: Remuneration is a consolidated monthly amount fixed within the prescribed range by the Selection Committee or Competent Authority, and shall not be construed as pay in terms of applicable pay rules. No annual increment, Dearness Allowance, pension, gratuity, General Provident Fund, House Rent Allowance, Leave Travel Concession, medical reimbursement, or other service benefits admissible to regular Government servants shall be payable. Consolidated remuneration is subject to tax deduction at source (TDS).

content_sections.heading: ESIC Selection Process 2026
content_sections.text: Selection is conducted through a two-stage process: preliminary scrutiny and shortlisting, followed by a personal interview. There is no written or online test. Applications received online within the prescribed period are scrutinized for eligibility based on submitted documents. Eligible applications are assessed on essential and desirable qualifications along with years of relevant post-qualification experience. Candidates are shortlisted in order of merit strictly up to a ratio of 1:10 candidates per vacancy, or such other ratio determined by the Competent Authority. All candidates tied at the cut-off score are shortlisted. Shortlisted candidates appear before a duly constituted Interview/Selection Committee comprising not less than three members (an odd number), including the Chairperson (an officer not below the rank of Insurance Commissioner) and at least one external subject-matter expert in Actuarial Science or Data Science/Analytics. The committee assesses educational and professional qualifications, relevant post-qualification experience, domain knowledge, aptitude, and overall suitability. The final select panel is prepared in order of merit based on committee recommendations and is subject to the approval of the Competent Authority. A reserve panel of up to 3 candidates per vacancy is maintained for up to one year from declaration or until the next selection.

content_sections.heading: ESIC Recruitment 2026 Important Instructions
content_sections.text: The engagement is purely contractual for an initial period of 3 years, extendable up to 2 years (one year at a time), and does not constitute regular appointment or confer any right to regularisation or absorption in ESIC or Government service. The engagement may be terminated by either party with one month's prior notice in writing or payment of one month's consolidated remuneration in lieu of notice, without assigning any reason. ESIC reserves the right to terminate engagement immediately without notice or payment in lieu in cases of misconduct, fraud, breach of confidentiality, conflict of interest, unauthorised absence, or false information. Selected professionals are entitled to leave at the rate of 1.5 days for each completed month, with no accumulation beyond a calendar year on a pro-rata basis, and un-availed leave cannot be carried forward to the next year. Selected candidates must maintain strict confidentiality of official, actuarial, statistical, and data-related information and shall not engage in private practice, parallel consultancy, or outside employment. All work products, models, reports, codes, and analyses developed during the engagement vest exclusively with ESIC. Any dispute arising out of this engagement shall be subject to the exclusive jurisdiction of courts or tribunals at New Delhi.

Must have excellent communication, presentation, negotiation and relationship-management skills. Desirable: experience in securing executive education, management development, leadership development or customised corporate training programmes. Desirable: existing professional relationships with corporates in India and other major business centres. Desirable: experience working with business schools, management institutes, consulting firms, corporate academies or training organisations. Desirable: a demonstrated track record of achieving business development and revenue targets. Experience: relevant experience in executive education, programme management, training administration, event/programme operations or institutional administration. Desirable: experience in a reputed academic institution, executive education centre, training organization or similar environment. Essential competencies: strong programme/project-management capability; excellent planning and organisational skills; experience in managing conferences, training programmes, executive education or comparable institutional events; ability to handle multiple programmes at the same time; strong service orientation and attention to detail; ability to coordinate across multiple administrative departments; vendor-management and negotiation skills; working knowledge of budgeting and financial administration; strong proficiency in MS Excel, Word, PowerPoint and digital collaboration tools; ability to work under pressure and handle programmes outside regular working hours when required. Professional experience: at least 15 years of post-qualification experience in construction, estate management, civil engineering works, or maintenance of buildings and infrastructure. This experience must be in Government departments, reputed educational institutions, universities, colleges, public sector undertakings, or commercial organizations of comparable nature and complexity. The officer acts as a key link with corporates, public sector undertakings, multinational companies, large domestic organisations and other institutions for customised and open-enrolment Executive Education Programmes. The officer reports to the designated authority responsible for Executive Education and corporate engagement. Corporate Relationship Development: identify and build relationships with senior executives, HR heads, L&D heads, business leaders and other decision-makers in Corporates/Government Organizations/MNCs; develop a network of corporate clients; build long-term relationships to generate recurring business. Business Development and Programme Acquisition: identify corporate training needs for MDPs, Leadership Development, Long and Short Duration, Blended Learning and Faculty Development Programmes, Customised Corporate Training Programmes and Consultancy Projects; turn qualified leads into confirmed programmes; understand client requirements, participant profiles, delivery preferences and budgets; work with departments and faculty on proposals. Revenue Generation: achieve quarterly targets for confirmed programmes and revenue, as approved by the Institute; build a sustainable pipeline and repeat engagements; support negotiations, proposal submission, commercial discussions and closure. Programme Coordination: coordinate with the Dean (CR & FA), the Chairperson - Executive Education, faculty and administrative departments for handover and delivery; keep in touch with clients from first enquiry to confirmation and beyond; monitor client feedback. Market Intelligence and Reporting: track corporate learning requirements, industry trends and competing offerings; keep a structured database of clients, leads, proposals, follow-ups and conversions; submit monthly progress reports and quarterly performance reports. content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IIM Trichy Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Applications are accepted only through the Institute's online recruitment portal (www.iimtrichy.ac.in/en/careers-non-teaching), and applications sent any other way will not be considered. The portal opens at 11.00 am on 23 October 2026. Read the notification and the 'Instructions to the Candidates', and confirm you are eligible for the post. Apply online through the portal at www.iimtrichy.ac.in/en/careers-non-teaching within the prescribed period. Give an active e-mail address in the application. All communication, including shortlisting and selection details, is sent by e-mail only. Upload complete and legible documents supporting your age, educational qualifications, experience and any category/reservation claim, along with your photograph and signature. Submit the application by 5.00 pm on 12 November 2026. The Institute will not consider requests to extend the deadline and is not responsible for failures caused by last-minute technical issues. Keep a printout or PDF of the final application. Do not send a hard copy to the Institute unless you are specifically asked for one. Upload the documents that apply to you. When called for verification during the selection process, bring the originals and one set of self-attested copies: SSLC/10th certificate or equivalent proof of date of birth HSC/Class XII certificate, where applicable UG/PG degree/Diploma certificates and relevant mark sheets Experience certificates and salary certificates, wherever required (experience certificates should clearly show designation, period of service and nature of duties) Recent passport-size colour photograph and signature Valid photo identity proof Any other document required to support the information in the application

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Shortlisted candidates have to go through a selection process that may include a written test/skill test and an interview. The Institute or the Selection Committee decides how candidates are shortlisted and the mode and stages of selection. Being eligible, or being called for a selection stage, does not give any right to appointment. Shortlisting and selection details are sent by e-mail, so check the recruitment portal and your registered e-mail regularly. If you cannot produce the required originals at document verification or selection, your candidature may be cancelled.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: All information in the application must be correct and is treated as final. Incomplete applications, false claims, hiding material information, or fabricated or tampered documents may lead to rejection or disqualification at any stage. Candidature may be cancelled at any stage for ineligibility, false or misleading information, suppression of material facts, impersonation, fabricated or tampered documents, getting support through improper means, canvassing, or other misconduct. This may lead to debarment and, where applicable, termination of service and legal action. Canvassing in any form will result in disqualification. Appointment is subject to verification of qualifications, experience, conduct, certificates and medical fitness. A material discrepancy found later may result in termination and/or other action. The selected candidate must submit a relieving letter from the previous employer at the time of joining. The Institute reserves the right to accept or reject applications, shortlist candidates, change or cancel any stage of the recruitment, and fill or not fill any or all vacancies. Its decision is final and binding. Any amendment or corrigendum will be published only on the Institute website. Any dispute about the recruitment falls under the jurisdiction of the courts at Tiruchirappalli or the Madurai Bench of the Madras High Court.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in IIM Trichy Recruitment 2026?

faq.answer: The upper age limit is 55 years for the Corporate Relations Officer, Manager – Executive Education and Consulting and Estate Officer. faq.answer: No. All the posts are on a fixed-term contract, which may be extended based on institutional requirements and satisfactory performance. No claim can ever be made for regularising these positions.

Test/check the measurements recorded in the M. Books and certify. Ensure compliance with all the provisions of the Labor Laws and/or guidelines of the regulatory authorities in respect of the workers engaged by the working contractors in the Institute or workers hired through approved agencies. Advise the Director and Registrar in all technical matters and ensure that all work executed is as per the guidelines prescribed by the MOA/ Bye-Laws/ CPWD/State's PWO and that these works are carried out with the authorization/approval of the Works Committee or Building Committee, etc., as per the prescribed procedure. content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: Basis of appointment: the posts are advertised on a Regular/ Contract/ Tenure basis. The initial appointment will be on tenure/deputation for a period of 5 years. Exceptionally deserving selected candidates may have a tenure/deputation of appointment as per the Institute's requirement. Consolidated pay: the Institute may consider hiring candidates on a suitable consolidated monthly remuneration basis, as it deems fit. Lower post: a candidate may be hired for a lower post if the Institute deems it fit. Deputation: officers holding analogous posts on a regular basis in their parent cadre/department may also apply for appointment on a deputation basis. A deputationist may be considered for absorption, subject to the needs of the post, the officer's suitability, the consent of the lending and borrowing organisations, and the applicable Government of India rules on absorption as amended from time to time. Being considered for absorption gives the deputationist no vested right. Accommodation: selected candidates will be given accommodation on the Institute campus or in leased accommodation, with electricity and water charges paid as actual. A candidate who is given this accommodation will not be eligible for House Rent Allowance. Medical facilities: Institute employees and their dependents get medical facilities as per Institute rules. Children Education Allowance: admissible at the applicable rate for up to two children, as per Central Government Norms. Commitment: all the positions require a full 24x7 commitment to the Institute. Provisional appointment: appointment orders issued to finally selected candidates are provisional. The Institute will verify antecedents and documents (character/antecedent/Police verification, all original documents, experience certificate and other documents). If any fact or document is later found to be fabricated or altered, or a candidate with a doubtful background has hidden it, the candidature will stand cancelled and their services may be terminated.

content_sections.heading: IIM Mumbai Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: Lead and oversee the Career Development Services function, including placements, internships, corporate relations and employer engagement. Develop and implement strategic initiatives to strengthen industry and alumni partnerships, enhance student employability and employer outreach, and promote the Institute's brand among leading recruiters. Establish effective policies, processes and systems for placement operations. Align career development initiatives with industry requirements. Provide strategic insights to senior management based on placement trends and outcomes. Lead initiatives for continuous improvement, innovation and stakeholder engagement. Undertake any other duties assigned by the Competent Authority. Oversee the Institute's Wellness Centre, managing all administrative and functional operations. Provide medical care to students and staff, and maintain health records. Coordinate with hospitals and verify medical claims. Ensure availability of medicines and first aid. Look after campus sanitation and hostel and mess inspections, and ensure overall healthcare readiness. Other duties assigned by the Institute. Maintain, manage, develop and provide technical support for campus physical infrastructure in the respective disciplines. Critically evaluate and provide constructive inputs on all project documentation submitted by internal departments and external agencies to the Administration. Implement and follow up on policy and legal matters pertaining to all construction projects of the Institute, including arbitration and court matters, wherever required. Supervise and monitor civil infrastructure works, including site execution, technical scrutiny of drawings and specifications, quality control, and verification of measurements. Coordinate with contractors, review project progress and provide support in billing certification. Ensure statutory compliance and proper project documentation, and resolve technical and execution-related issues. Any other task(s) assigned by the competent authorities of the Institute from time to time. Maintain, manage, develop and provide technical support for campus physical infrastructure in the electrical discipline. Implement and follow up on the Institute's policies relating to electrical works under construction and maintenance projects. Prepare electrical designs, specifications, load calculations, and tender packages. Supervise execution and ensure quality control of electrical works, and verify contractor bills. Coordinate with architects, civil engineering teams, other agencies, and statutory authorities on electrical installations. Monitor project progress and maintain project records. Promote energy efficiency and net-zero campus practices in electrical installations. Perform any other task(s) assigned by the competent authorities of the Institute from time to time.

Candidates claiming reservation or a fee concession for SC/ST/OBC (NCL)/EWS/PwBD/Ex-servicemen must attach the relevant certificate(s) in the format prescribed by the Central Government. For ST candidates: the caste validity certificate issued by the Scheduled Tribe Certificate Scrutiny Committee of the respective State Government, enclosed with the application. For PwBD candidates: a valid disability certificate issued by a competent medical authority in the prescribed format. Candidates seeking horizontal reservation and/or age relaxation under PwBD must submit it at the time of application and produce the original at document verification/joining. PwBD reservation is given as per the Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016 and the Government of India orders under it, where the post is identified as suitable for or reserved for PwBD candidates. For EWS (where the post is reserved for EWS): the EWS certificate in the Government of India format, produced at document verification by candidates shortlisted for it. EWS covers persons not under the SC, ST or OBC reservation whose family gross annual income is below Rs. 8.00 lakh. "Family" means the applicant, parents, siblings below 18, spouse and children below 18. Income from all sources counts (salary, agriculture, business, profession, etc.) for the financial year before the year of application. A person is excluded from EWS, whatever the family income, if the family owns 5 acres of agricultural land and above; a residential flat of 1000 sq. ft. and above; a residential plot of 100 sq. yards and above in notified municipalities; or a residential plot of 200 sq. yards and above in areas other than notified municipalities. Income and assets must be certified by an officer not below the rank of Tehsildar in the State/UT concerned. content_sections.heading: About IIT Indore Junior Research Fellow (JRF)
content_sections.text: The Indian Institute of Technology Indore is a government technical institute at Khandwa Road, Simrol, Indore 453552, Madhya Pradesh. The JRF post is in an ANRF-PMECRG research project led by Principal Investigator Dr. Vivek Verma of the Department of Metallurgical Engineering and Materials Science. The project aims to unravel thermomigration behavior in high-entropy solder alloy systems through computational thermodynamics, diffusion modeling and experimental characterization, enabling predictive design of thermally stable advanced materials for next-generation electronics.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: A candidate must meet one of these three options: M.Tech./ M.E./ M.S. or equivalent degree in Metallurgical Engineering/ Materials Science and Engineering/ Metallurgical and Materials Engineering/ Mechanical Engineering/ Manufacturing/ Production Engineering. Candidates with MTech/ME/MS degrees in these disciplines should have previously qualified GATE once. OR B.Tech./ B.E. or equivalent degree in Metallurgical Engineering/ Materials Science and Engineering/ Metallurgical and Materials Engineering/ Mechanical Engineering/ Manufacturing/ Production Engineering/ Engineering Physics, with a valid GATE score. OR M.Sc. in Materials Science, Physics, Nanoscience and Technology, with a valid GATE score OR Equivalent Fellowship. Strong foundation in physical metallurgy, thermodynamics and mechanical behavior. Understanding of phase transformations, diffusion phenomena, microstructure–property relationships and strengthening mechanisms in metallic systems. Experience in materials characterization techniques and/or mechanical property evaluation. Proficiency in scientific computing tools, Thermo-Calc and DICTRA. The age limit for the JRF post is a maximum of 28 years. The notice does not mention a date on which age is counted. The notice says strong preference will be given to candidates who are interested in pursuing a PhD at IIT Indore. Candidates with clear research motivation and long-term commitment to doctoral studies will be prioritized. See the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility for the post.

Duration: Initially for one year. It is extendable based on performance and project tenure. Nature of appointment: The position is purely temporary and co-terminus with the project.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in IIT Indore JRF Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 01 Junior Research Fellow (JRF) vacancy in the ANRF-PMECRG project at IIT Indore.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the IIT Indore JRF post?
faq.answer: The deadline to email the application is 10 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is required for the IIT Indore JRF post?
faq.answer: Candidates need one of three options in the listed disciplines: an M.Tech./M.E./M.S. or equivalent with GATE qualified once, a B.Tech./B.E. or equivalent with a valid GATE score, or an M.Sc. in Materials Science, Physics, Nanoscience and Technology with a valid GATE score or an equivalent fellowship.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the IIT Indore JRF post?
faq.answer: The age limit for the IIT Indore JRF post is a maximum of 28 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of the IIT Indore JRF?
faq.answer: The fellowship is ₹37,000 per month + HRA.

faq.question: Q6. Is HRA paid on top of the IIT Indore JRF fellowship?
faq.answer: Yes, the fellowship is ₹37,000 per month + HRA. An institute hostel may be provided subject to availability; otherwise HRA will be applicable.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply for the IIT Indore JRF post?
faq.answer: Email a single PDF with all the required qualification documents to [email protected] with the subject line "Application for the position of JRF (ANRF-PMECRG project)" by 10 November 2026.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the IIT Indore JRF post?
faq.answer: Candidates will be shortlisted based on merit and project requirements, and shortlisted candidates will have an online interview. They will receive the interview details and meeting link by email.

faq.question: Q9. Is the IIT Indore JRF post permanent?
faq.answer: No, the position is purely temporary and co-terminus with the project. It is initially for one year and extendable based on performance and project tenure.

faq.answer: Yes, strong preference will be given to candidates interested in pursuing a PhD at IIT Indore. Candidates with clear research motivation and long-term commitment to doctoral studies will be prioritized.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates must meet the following post-wise educational qualifications and experience requirements: Director (Finance): CA / ICWA or Full-time Degree of Master in Business Administration (MBA) / Post Graduate Diploma in Management with specialization in Finance with good academic record from a recognized University or Institution. Director (Operations): Full-time B.E. / B.Tech. Degree in Mining Engineering (obtained through regular mode only) with 1st Class Mines Manager's Certificate of Competency with good academic record from a recognized University or Institution. Director (Human Resources): Full-time Master in Business Administration / P.G. Diploma in Management with specialization in Human Resources or Full-time Post Graduation in Personnel Management & Industrial Relations with good academic record from a recognized University or Institution. Experience (All Posts): A proven track record of at least 25 years of post-qualification experience in the relevant functional domain. The incumbent must have worked for a minimum period of 3 years at the level of two positions below the Board of Directors level.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: The scale of pay is Rs. 1,35,100-2,16,800/- with an Initial Basic Pay of Rs. 1,81,600/- and DA as applicable. The post carries HRA in lieu of accommodation, Medical Allowance, and other perks at par with an Officer of OMC in E-8 rank. Pay protection will be allowed to selected candidates from Central or State Governments, CPSEs, State PSUs, or any other government organization. The appointment is on full-time contract basis for a period of 5 years or up to the age of superannuation of 60 years, whichever is earlier. Extension of the term for another 5 years or up to the age of 60 years may be considered based on satisfactory performance and approval of the competent authority.

content_sections.heading: OMC Director Job Description
content_sections.text: Director (Finance): Overall charge of Finance and Accounts function including Corporate Accounts, Taxation & Audit, Bills, Treasury, Sales Export & Investments, Financial Concurrence, Costing & Budgeting, Provident Fund & Gratuity, formulation of long-term financial strategies, capital structure optimization, investment planning, resource mobilization, dividend management, financial risk mitigation, ESG reporting, internal financial controls, digital transformation of finance functions, and liaison with banks and statutory authorities. Director (Operations): Overall charge of Regional Offices, production, engineering, mines safety, sales & marketing. Formulation of strategy, systems, policies & procedures to operations of mines as per industry best practices, achieving production targets, ensuring compliance with statutory and regulatory provisions, ESG compliance, adoption of latest mining technology, digital mining, automation, drone-based surveying, decarbonisation, and mine closure planning. Director (Human Resources): Overall charge of entire Personnel & Administration function including HR Development, Industrial Relations & Labour Welfare, Medical, Corporate Communications, Corporate Social Responsibility, Security, Estate, RTI & Administration, organizational HR transformation, talent acquisition, performance management, training & development, compensation & benefits, change management, employee engagement, and DEI initiatives.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for OMC Director
content_sections.text: Download the application format (Annexure-I) from the official websites. Fill in all required details, affix a passport size photograph, and enclose a write-up on significant contributions and suitability for the post. Attach required testimonials, educational certificates, mark-sheets, experience certificates, and organizational charts. Government servants and PSU executives must route their applications through proper channel as specified in the notification. Enclose Integrity Certificate (Annexure-II) and APAR/PAR grading of past five years (Annexure-III) in sealed covers. Superscribe the envelope containing the application as "Application for the post of Director (Finance), OMCL" / "Application for the post of Director (Operations), OMCL" / "Application for the post of Director (Human Resources), OMCL" respectively. Send the complete application by Speed Post, Registered Post, or e-mail to the Special Secretary (FE) to Government in Steel & Mines Department, Odisha, Bhubaneswar-751001 (Email: [email protected] ) to reach by 30.11.2026.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: The selection of candidates shall be made after taking into consideration the overall suitability of the candidates concerned by the Public Enterprises Selection Board (PESB) through an interview.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Applications received beyond the stipulated date (30.11.2026) and incomplete applications shall not be considered. Outstation candidates appearing for the interview will be provided Economy Class air fare for to & fro journey on submission of original documents. If any candidate selected by PESB gives unwillingness after the issue of offer of appointment, they will be debarred for 2 years from being considered for a Board Level post in any State PSE other than the one they belong to. Appointment of selected candidate is subject to medical fitness certified by a Medical Officer of State/Central Govt or OMC. The undersigned reserves the right to accept or reject any or all applications without assigning any reason thereof.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: Faculty members are entitled to Dearness Allowance, Transport Allowance, and other allowances applicable to Central Government Employees. NIT Warangal provides a residential campus with suitable accommodation subject to availability, or House Rent Allowance otherwise. Other benefits include Reimbursement of Children Education Allowance, Reimbursement of Medical expenses including cashless treatment at Warangal and Hyderabad, Leave Travel Concession (LTC), National Pension Scheme (unless governed by CCS Pension Rules), Cumulative Professional Development Allowance (CPDA) amounting to Rs. 3 lakh, and an initial research seed grant of Rs. 5 lakh for newly recruited faculty members.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for NIT Warangal Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Visit the online recruitment portal at NIT Warangal Recruitment Portal . Register and log in to fill out the application form in one or multiple sessions. Upload scanned copies of required documents, category certificates, research statements, and teaching statements along with claimed credit points. Pay the non-refundable application fee online depending on your category. Submit the application form online before 30 November 2026, 11:59 PM IST. Keep a printed or digital copy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is NIT Warangal Faculty Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: NIT Warangal Faculty Recruitment 2026 is an employment notification (NITW/FR-2/2026) issued by the National Institute of Technology Warangal to fill 34 faculty positions across various departments at different pay levels.

faq.question: Q2. How many total vacancies are available in this recruitment?
faq.answer: A total of 34 vacancies are available, comprising 1 for Professor, 3 for Associate Professor, 6 for Assistant Professor Grade I, and 24 for Assistant Professor Grade II.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to submit the online application?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application is 30 November 2026 up to 11:59 PM IST.

faq.question: Q4. What is the essential educational qualification required?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Ph.D. in the respective discipline with First Class in preceding degrees (UG and PG, or direct Ph.D. after BE/B.Tech with First Class at the Bachelor's level).

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee for Unreserved, OBC-NCL, and EWS candidates?
faq.answer: The non-refundable application fee is ₹2000 for Unreserved, OBC-NCL, and EWS candidates, ₹1000 for SC/ST/PwD candidates, and $50 for Indian citizens applying from abroad.

faq.question: Q6. Are allowances like HRA provided on top of the pay?
faq.answer: Yes, dearness allowance, transport allowance, and house rent allowance (if campus accommodation is not available) are provided as applicable to Central Government Employees.

faq.question: Q7. Who is eligible for age relaxations and category certificates?
faq.answer: Candidates belonging to SC, ST, OBC-NCL, EWS, and PwD categories receive age relaxations and reservation benefits as per Government of India norms, subject to submitting valid prescribed certificates.

faq.question: Q8. How are candidates shortlisted for the interview?
faq.answer: The Institute conducts scrutiny, shortlisting based on cumulative essential credit points, written tests, presentations of teaching and research seminars, and personal interviews before a duly constituted selection committee.

faq.question: Q9. Can candidates apply for more than one faculty position?
faq.answer: Yes, separate applications must be submitted if an applicant is applying for more than one faculty position.

content_sections.heading: APPSC AEE Selection Process 2026
content_sections.text: APPSC has announced that the Assistant Executive Engineer recruitment examination will be conducted as a single-level examination in Computer Based Recruitment Test (CBRT) mode. No separate screening test will be conducted, irrespective of the number of applications received. Single-level objective-type written examination. Computer Based Recruitment Test (CBRT) mode. No separate screening test. Normalization may be applied if the examination is conducted in multiple sessions. The notification also includes a Computer Proficiency Test scheme in its annexures. Candidates should follow the detailed notification for its applicability in the final recruitment process.

content_sections.heading: APPSC AEE Exam Pattern 2026
content_sections.text: The APPSC AEE written examination consists of three objective-type papers at engineering degree standard. Each paper carries 150 questions and 150 marks, making a total of 450 questions and 450 marks. Negative Marking: One-third of the marks assigned to a question will be deducted for each incorrect answer. The examination scheme directs candidates to appear for the papers relevant to their engineering degree and post code. The notification states that Paper III for Post Codes 02 and 06 will be conducted in different sessions.

content_sections.heading: APPSC AEE Syllabus 2026
content_sections.text: The APPSC AEE syllabus covers General Studies and Mental Ability along with Civil, Mechanical or Electrical Engineering subjects, according to the post code. The detailed subject-wise syllabus is attached to the brief notification. National, international and Andhra Pradesh current affairs. General Science and Science & Technology developments. Indian History and the Indian National Movement, with emphasis on Andhra Pradesh. Geography of India and Andhra Pradesh. Indian Polity, Constitution, Governance and Public Policy. Indian Economy and Economic Planning. Sustainable Development and Environmental Protection. Disaster Management, Remote Sensing and GIS. Logical Reasoning and Analytical Ability. Data Analysis, Tabulation, Graphs and Basic Statistics. Paper II is common to Post Codes 01, 02, 03, 04, 06, 07 and 08. The syllabus includes: Strength of Materials. Engineering Mechanics and Structural Behaviour. Fluid Mechanics and Hydraulic Machinery. Fluid Statics, Kinematics and Dynamics. Pipe Flow and Boundary Layer Concepts. Hydraulic Turbines and Pumps. Hydro Projects and Power Plants. The Electrical Engineering Paper II applies to Post Code 05. Electric Circuits and Network Analysis. Electrical Measurements and Instruments. Illumination. DC Generators and Motors. Transformers. Three-phase Induction Motors. Three-phase Alternators. Synchronous Motors. Single-phase Induction Motors. The Civil Engineering Paper III applies to Post Codes 01, 03, 04 and 07. Building Materials. Structural Analysis. Design of Steel Structures. Design of Concrete and Masonry Structures. Construction Planning and Management. Hydraulics and Water Resource Engineering. Environmental Engineering. Soil Mechanics and Foundation Engineering. Surveying and Transportation Engineering. For Post Codes 02 and 06, Paper III includes Engineering Drawing, Environmental Science, Electrical and Electronics fundamentals, and Computer Fundamentals. Engineering Drawing and AutoCAD fundamentals. Environmental Science and Natural Resources. Ecosystems and Biodiversity. Pollution and Solid Waste Management. Disaster Management. Environmental Legislation and Social Issues. Electrical and Electronic Engineering Principles. Computer Fundamentals. The Electrical Engineering Paper III applies to Post Code 05. Transmission and Distribution. Overhead Line Insulators. Underground Cables. Fault Calculations. Generating Stations. Power System Protection. Circuit Breakers. Economic Aspects of Power Generation. Utilization of Electrical Energy. The Mechanical Engineering Paper III applies to Post Code 08. Thermodynamics. Heat Transfer. Refrigeration and Air Conditioning. Turbomachines. Theory of Machines. Machine Design. Machine Drawing and Solid Modelling. Engineering Materials. Manufacturing Science. Computer Integrated Manufacturing. Industrial Engineering. Modelling and Simulation. content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The Public Enterprises Selection Board has advertised 1 post for Chairman & Managing Director (a schedule 'A' CPSE) in Power Finance Corporation Limited (PFC).

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: On the date of occurrence of vacancy (01.05.2027), the age of superannuation is 60 years. For internal candidates, the minimum age is 45 years with 2 years residual service as on the date of vacancy w.r.t. the date of superannuation. For other candidates, the minimum age is 45 years with 3 years residual service as on the date of vacancy w.r.t. the date of superannuation. (i) The applicant should possess cumulative experience/exposure for at least 5 years during the last 10 years in Finance or Business Development or Production or Operations or Marketing or Project Management in a large organization of repute. Applicants having experience in Power Sector/ Infrastructure Finance will be given preference. (ii) The applicants should possess cumulative experience of at least 5 years in core HR/IR/Personnel Management along with at least 3 years cumulative experience during the last 10 years in Finance or Business Development or Production or Operations or Marketing or Project Management in a large organization of repute. Applicants having experience in Power Sector/ Infrastructure Finance will be given preference. The applicant must, on the date of application, as well as on the date of interview, be employed in a regular capacity – and not in a contractual/ad-hoc capacity – in one of the following: Central Public Sector Enterprise (CPSE) including a full-time functional Director on the Board; Central Government Group 'A' Officers including the Armed Forces of the Union and All India Services and officers from Public Sector Banks/ Financial Institutions/ Autonomous Bodies, etc.; State Public Sector Enterprise (SPSE) where annual turnover is Rs. 10,000 crore or more; Private Sector Company/ Joint Venture (JV) [50:50 JVs of Central Government/ State Governments and JVs of CPSEs with other CPSEs/ organisations (50:50 JVs)]/ National and State level Cooperative Federations whose annual turnover is Rs. 10,000 crore or more. In case of Private company, preference would be given to candidates from listed companies.

content_sections.heading: Coal India General Manager Vacancy 2026: Post-Wise Details
content_sections.text: Coal India has announced three General Manager vacancies in its Renewable Energy and Thermal Power verticals. All three vacancies are in E8 Grade and are notified under the Unreserved (UR) category.

content_sections.heading: Coal India General Manager Eligibility Criteria 2026
content_sections.text: Applicants must have the specified engineering qualification, minimum 20 years of relevant post-qualification experience and additional eligibility based on their professional background. Educational Qualification: B.Tech, B.E. or B.Sc. (Engineering) in any of the following disciplines: Electrical Engineering Mechanical Engineering Civil Engineering Electrical and Electronics Engineering Electronics and Communication Engineering Experience: Minimum 20 years of post-qualification experience in State/Central power utilities, including power-sector PSUs under Central/State Government, or private power-sector organizations. Of this experience, at least 3 years of cumulative experience during the last 10 years must be in the Renewable Energy sector in Project Development, Business Development, Regulatory Affairs, Commercial or Engineering functions. Role: Overall leadership of renewable energy projects, project planning, policy interface, project execution and strategic planning. Educational Qualification: B.Tech, B.E. or B.Sc. (Engineering) in Civil Engineering. Experience: Minimum 20 years of post-qualification experience in State/Central/Private power utilities. Applicants must have at least 10 years of experience in planning, construction and execution of greenfield or brownfield power projects, including 2 years at senior managerial level. Role: Leadership and supervision of civil engineering activities in thermal power project execution. Educational Qualification: B.Tech, B.E. or B.Sc. (Engineering) in Mechanical Engineering. Experience: Minimum 20 years of post-qualification experience in State/Central/Private power utilities. Applicants must have at least 10 years of experience in the execution of coal-based thermal power projects involving a 500 MW unit or above, including 2 years at senior managerial level. Role: Leadership and supervision of mechanical execution of thermal power projects.

content_sections.heading: Can Private-Sector Employees Apply for Coal India E8 Recruitment?
content_sections.text: Yes. Eligible private-sector professionals can apply for Coal India General Manager Recruitment 2026. However, they must meet additional conditions relating to the employer's turnover, their employment status, CTC and relevant experience. The applicant must have worked in a regular capacity in an eligible private-sector company, joint venture or specified cooperative federation. The organization must meet the prescribed annual turnover threshold of Rs. 1,000 crore or more. The average audited annual turnover of the three relevant preceding financial years will be considered. The candidate must meet the minimum annual CTC requirement of Rs. 52 lakh in the last financial year. Preference will be given to applicants from listed companies in the case of private-sector companies. Important: Meeting the Rs. 52 lakh CTC condition alone does not establish eligibility. Candidates must also satisfy the prescribed engineering qualification, total experience and relevant domain-experience requirements.

content_sections.heading: Is Rs. 52 Lakh CTC Mandatory for Coal India General Manager?
content_sections.text: For applicants from the private sector, the notification prescribes a minimum CTC of Rs. 52 lakh per annum in the last financial year. This is a private-sector eligibility condition. Government and PSU applicants are assessed under the relevant grade and pay-scale equivalence requirements specified in the notification.

content_sections.heading: Can PSU E7 Officers Apply for Coal India General Manager E8 Posts?
content_sections.text: Yes. Government and PSU candidates can apply if they meet the prescribed educational qualification, experience and grade-equivalence requirements. For the notified posts, the additional grade requirement includes a minimum of 2 years in the immediately lower grade under the applicable DPE-notified IDA pay scale, or the corresponding prescribed Government/CDA equivalence. The notification specifies the following reference levels: IDA E7 Pay Scale: Rs. 1,00,000 - Rs. 2,60,000 (2017) IDA E7 Pay Scale: Rs. 43,200 - Rs. 66,000 (2007) CDA / Government: Rs. 37,400 - Rs. 67,000 (PB-4), Grade Pay Rs. 8,900 under 6th CPC, or Pay Level 13A under 7th CPC For Government organizations with non-comparable pay structures, the Selection Committee will determine grade equivalence using hierarchy, responsibility, pay structure, total emoluments and service period, based on supporting documents.

content_sections.heading: Does Contract or Trainee Experience Count Towards 20 Years?
content_sections.text: Coal India has prescribed rules for calculating qualifying experience. Experience is generally counted from the date of acquiring the required engineering degree. Internships and summer/winter training during studies do not count. Ad-hoc, contractual, officiating and ordinary trainee service do not count. Regular Management Trainee, Executive Trainee or Graduate Engineer Trainee service that subsequently leads to absorption in a regular cadre may be counted. Actual service across multiple organizations may be combined. Employment gaps are not counted as experience.

content_sections.heading: Coal India Recruitment 2026 Age Limit
content_sections.text: The upper age limit is 55 years as on 7 October 2026, the notification date. The notification date is also the cut-off date for determining minimum qualification and experience.

content_sections.text: The General Manager posts carry an E8 Grade basic pay scale of Rs. 1,20,000 to Rs. 2,80,000 . Pay fixation will follow applicable DPE guidelines. Candidates appointed from private organizations will have their basic pay fixed at the minimum of the prescribed pay scale without pay protection. The actual total remuneration may vary depending on applicable benefits and company rules.

important_dates.last_date_to_apply: 23-11-2026 (60 days from publication in Employment News/Rozgar Samachar)

qualification.details: post: Qualification Required | deputy director (engineering): Officers under the Central Government or State Government or Union Territory Administrations or Major Ports or public sector undertakings, or autonomous bodies or universities or recognized research organizations possessing: (a)(i) holding analogous post on regular basis in parent cadre or department; or (ii) with 5 years service in the grade rendered after appointment thereto on a regular basis in Level-10 (Rs. 56,100 - 1,77,500) in the pay matrix or equivalent in parent cadre or department; and (b) possessing Bachelor's degree in Civil/Mechanical Engineering from a recognized University or Institute; and (c) 5 years experience in the field of: (i) Design, construction and maintenance of Civil Engineering works including Harbour Engineering; or (ii) Maintenance and operation of different types of cranes, diesel locos, marine engines, winches and auxiliary machinery in a mechanical or marine workshop or organisation.

post_wise_breakdown.classification: General Central Service, Group 'A' Gazetted, Non-Ministerial

how_to_apply: Download the vacancy circular and application format from the official website at https://shipmin.gov.in/.
Fill out the Bio-data / Curriculum Vitae form accurately in all respects.
Ensure the application is duly signed by the applicant and certified by the Head of Office or Employer.
Gather two copies of the signed Bio-data along with complete and up-to-date ACRs/APARs for the last 5 years attested by an officer not below the level of Under Secretary.

Enclose vigilance clearance certificate, cadre clearance, certificate of immediate relieving upon selection, certificate of no major/minor penalties during the last 10 years, and integrity certificate.

Send the complete application "Through proper channel" to the designated address: Under Secretary (Admn.), Ministry of Ports, Shipping and Waterways, Room No. 439, Transport Bhawan, 1- Parliament Street, New Delhi-110001.
Ensure the application reaches the specified address within 60 days from the date of publication of the advertisement in Employment News/Rozgar Samachar.
important_instructions: Candidates applying for the post will not be allowed to withdraw their candidature subsequently. Incomplete applications, applications received after the closing date, or applications not received through proper channel will be summarily rejected. The cut-off date for determining eligibility will be the last date for receipt of nominations in the Ministry (60th day from the publication date in Employment News/Rozgar Samachar). Departmental officers in the feeder category who are in the direct line of promotion are not eligible for deputation consideration, and deputationists are not eligible for promotion. Officers already on deputation must have their applications forwarded by their parent cadre/department along with required clearances.

content_sections.text: Remuneration for Individual Consultants is decided within the corresponding band, based on years of post-qualification relevant experience. Final remuneration for a selected candidate depends on expectations, experience, and expertise, and the decision of IPL is final and binding. Consultants will also be allowed to undertake tours as required by their duties, for which TA/DA and Hotel Accommodation shall be paid or reimbursed as per Company policy.

content_sections.heading: IPL Recruitment 2026 Selection Procedure
content_sections.text: Selection is done by way of Interview. Merely satisfying the eligibility norms does not entitle an applicant to be called for interview. IPL reserves the right to call only the requisite number of candidates for interview after preliminary screening/shortlisting, with reference to qualifications, experience, suitability, city preference, and business requirement. IPL will call only those candidates who match the requirements for the specific grade, position, and IC Code indicated in the application form. Applying for a higher grade does not automatically make the applicant eligible for a lower grade. Applicants must apply separately for each IC Code and Grade Code. Shortlisted applicants will be required to attend an interview in Delhi or in online mode, as decided by IPL in its absolute discretion. IPL will not reimburse any expenditure incurred by an applicant for appearing at the interview. IPL reserves the right to appoint none, one, or more Individual Consultants against any IC Code.

content_sections.heading: Period and Nature of Engagement
content_sections.text: Individual Consultants will be engaged for a fixed period of two years, which may be extended by one year at a time, up to a maximum tenure of five years (2+1+1+1 years), for providing services on specific projects as per requirement. Continuation beyond the first and subsequent years is contingent on a satisfactory Annual Performance Review based on defined Key Performance Indicators. Engagement is on a Contractual and Full-Time basis, during which the selected candidate is not allowed to take up appointment/engagement/assignment anywhere else.

faq.question: Q1. How many specializations (IC Codes) are covered in IPL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The advertisement covers 65 IC Codes across specializations such as Project & Contract Management, Procurement, Finance, Legal, PPP, Energy, Environment, Tourism, Urban Planning, GIS, and MSME-related roles.

faq.question: Q2. Is IPL Individual Consultant recruitment a one-time process or ongoing?
faq.answer: It is on a rolling basis. IPL maintains a database of applications throughout the year and engages consultants from this pool as and when requirements arise in specific areas/specializations.

faq.question: Q3. What is the remuneration for IPL Individual Consultants?
faq.answer: Remuneration ranges from ₹70,000 per month for Young Professionals to ₹2,65,000–₹3,30,000 per month for Senior Consultants (Grade III), depending on post-qualification experience. Final remuneration depends on the candidate's expectations, experience, and expertise, at IPL's discretion.

faq.question: Q4. Can I apply for more than one IC Code?
faq.answer: Yes, but applicants must apply separately for each IC Code and Grade Code, following the application format and subject line convention specified in the notification.

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for IPL Individual Consultant Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must be sent by email to the address corresponding to the relevant IC Code range, or by post to the AGM-HR address in New Delhi, along with the complete set of required documents.

faq.question: Q6. What is the period of engagement for IPL Individual Consultants?
faq.answer: The engagement is for a fixed period of two years, extendable by one year at a time up to a maximum of five years (2+1+1+1), subject to a satisfactory Annual Performance Review each year.

faq.question: Q7. Can an Individual Consultant take up other assignments during the engagement period?
faq.answer: No. The engagement is on a full-time contractual basis, and the selected candidate is not allowed to take up any other appointment, engagement, or assignment elsewhere during this period.

Apply online only through www.missionshakti.odisha.gov.in; applications received through any other mode are rejected.
Follow the detailed instructions on the website for registration, document upload and fee payment.
Pay the application fee of Rs. 500/- online at the time of registration; SC, ST and PwD candidates pay nil.
Submit the application between 06 Nov 2026 and 05 Dec 2026 (11:55 PM).
Apply once per position; if more than one form is submitted for the same post, only the latest correct form is considered.
Attempt the mock test link that will be placed on the website before the CBT.

Apply on or before 5 December 2026.
important_instructions: Application fee is refunded to all candidates who appear in the examination. Exact CBT date, shift and venue will be notified on the e-admit card on the website. Candidates must report with a printed e-Admit Card and a valid original Government photo ID. OLM may change the number of vacancies without notice and may cancel the recruitment process fully or partially. content_sections.text: Candidates debarred, terminated or removed from service by OLM and Mission Shakti Department on disciplinary grounds. Candidates whose age is outside the limit; overage relaxation is not allowed to PwD candidates with less than 40% disability.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Contract is initially for 1 year, which may be renewed based on satisfactory performance and continued as per project requirement. Contractual engagement gives no right to regularisation, permanent absorption or continuation beyond the contractual period. No TA/DA is paid for the examination, document verification or first joining of OLM.

content_sections.heading: How Will OLM Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Computer Based Test (CBT) Publication of provisional merit list Document Verification (three times the vacancy for each position) Final merit list from normalized CBT marks along with document verification Single CBT paper; no group discussion or personal interview. Three times the vacancy for each position are called for document verification. Final merit list is drawn from normalized CBT marks along with document verification. Tie in marks: senior in age first, then alphabetical order of names.

content_sections.heading: OLM Exam Pattern 2026
content_sections.text: Computer Based Test in English language only. Four options per question; one mark for a correct answer. Provisional answer key is published and objections are allowed within the prescribed period.
