faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in OLM Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 1115 vacancies: 1 State Project Manager (Human Resources & Training), 1 State Project Manager (Farm Livelihoods), 1 State Project Manager (Non-Farm Livelihoods), 1 State Project Manager (Value Addition, Market Linkage (Farm & Non-Farm)), 1 State Project Manager (Institutional Building and Capacity Building), 1 State Project Manager (Social Inclusion & Social Development) and 51 more posts.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for OLM Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Apply online through the link in the Important Links table, on or before 5 December 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: All candidates except SC, ST and PwD: Rs. 500. SC / ST / PwD: Nil.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The age limit is must have attained the age of 21 years and must not be above the age of 42 years (as on 1 January 2026). Relaxation: SC/ST/SEBC/Women 5 years, PwD 10 years, Ex-servicemen Period of defence service, limited to maximum age of 59 years, Current OLM staff No age limit.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post: 72,450 for State Project Manager (Human Resources & Training), 72,450 for State Project Manager (Farm Livelihoods), 72,450 for State Project Manager (Non-Farm Livelihoods), 72,450 for State Project Manager (Value Addition, Market Linkage (Farm & Non-Farm)), 72,450 for State Project Manager (Institutional Building and Capacity Building).

faq.question: Q7. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Post Graduate/Master Degree in the fields listed for each position (Graduate with PGDCA for Program Assistant; B.Com with PGDCA/Computer Science/IT for Accountant cum MIS Assistant posts; Bachelor's in veterinary science or Fishery for two State Mission Executive posts), with 3+ or 5+ years of relevant experience. The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q8. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Candidate must be a citizen of India. If married, must not have more than one spouse living, unless exempted by the Government. Must have good moral character. Qualification, experience and other conditions must be met by the closing date of online applications.

faq.question: Q9. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates debarred, terminated or removed from service by OLM and Mission Shakti Department on disciplinary grounds. Candidates whose age is outside the limit; overage relaxation is not allowed to PwD candidates with less than 40% disability.

faq.question: Q10. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Computer Based Test (CBT). Publication of provisional merit list. Document Verification (three times the vacancy for each position). Final merit list from normalized CBT marks along with document verification.

content_sections.heading: NIFTEM Senior Accountant Job Description
content_sections.text: Maintaining complete accounts and ledgers for various funded research and consultancy projects under the Dean (R&O) office. Preparation and generation of project-related bills, vouchers, and sanction orders. Timely preparation and maintenance of Utilization Certificates (UC) and Statements of Expenditure (SOE) for funding agencies (DST, DBT, MoFPI, ICAR, etc). Reconciliation of project funds, grants-in-aid, and bank statements. Coordinating internal/external audits and handling financial documentation for project closures. Documenting financial transactions, and monitoring the efficiency of existing accounting procedures and ensuring they comply with government regulations. Reviewing financial documents to resolve any discrepancies and irregularities, and reconciling already documented reports, statements and various transactions. Creating, reviewing and presenting budgets, recommending financial actions by analyzing accounting options, cooperating with auditors in preparing audit reports, providing guidance on revenue enhancement, cost reduction and profit maximization. Preparing and analyzing financial statements like cash flow statement, balance sheet and profit and loss statement, and submitting annual tax returns.

No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview. The interview date and venue are not specified in the notice.

content_sections.heading: About EAMUL
content_sections.text: East Assam Milk Producers' Co-operative Union Ltd (EAMUL) is a milk producers' co-operative that runs under the Purabi Dairy brand. Its office is at Nilomoni Bhawan, Na-Ali, Jorhat - 785001. The notice is issued by the Head-HR of West Assam Milk Producers' Co-operative Union Ltd (WAMUL), Purabi Dairy, R.K Jyoti Prasad Agarwala Road, Juripar, Panjabari, Guwahati-781037.

content_sections.heading: EAMUL Graduate Apprentice Vacancy Details 2026
content_sections.text: The engagement is for the financial year 2026-27 under the National Apprenticeship Training Scheme (NATS). It follows the Apprenticeship Act 1961, as amended in 1973, 1986 and 2014, and the Board of Practical Training (BOPT), Ministry of HRD, Govt. of India. The notice lists the three locations and four duties side by side for the post. It does not link any duty to a particular location.

rows.role_and_responsibilities: Milk procurement operations; input service activities

content_sections.heading: EAMUL Graduate Apprentice Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: Educational Qualification: B.A B.Com B.Sc Year of passing: Only candidates who passed in 2021, 2022, 2023, 2024 or 2025 can apply. Postgraduates: The notice says postgraduate candidates need not apply. NATS registration: Every applicant must register on the NATS portal and keep the Enrollment ID. See the official notification for the full eligibility details of the post.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Applications are shortlisted from the CVs received. Shortlisted candidates are contacted by email only and called for an interview. At the venue, candidates must have their NATS Enrollment ID with them.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: This is apprenticeship training under the Apprenticeship Act 1961. It is not a regular appointment. The training lasts 1 (one) year, in the financial year 2026-27. Apprentices are placed at the EAMUL Head Office (Jorhat), Darrang or Bokakhat.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for EAMUL Graduate Apprentice Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Register on the NATS portal at https://nats.education.gov.in/student_type.php and note your Enrollment ID. This step is mandatory. Prepare your CV and make sure the email ID on it is current, because shortlisted candidates are contacted by email only. Email the CV to [email protected] with the subject line "Apprentice for Graduate level". Send it by 9 November 2026. If you are called for interview, bring your NATS Enrollment ID to the venue.

faq.question: Q1. Which degrees are accepted for the Purabi Dairy Graduate Apprentice post?
faq.answer: B.A, B.Com and B.Sc graduates can apply.

faq.question: Q2. Can I apply if I graduated in 2020?
faq.answer: No. Only candidates who passed in 2021, 2022, 2023, 2024 or 2025 are eligible.

faq.question: Q3. Can postgraduates apply?
faq.answer: No. The notice clearly says postgraduate candidates need not apply.

faq.question: Q4. What subject line should the application email have?
faq.answer: Use "Apprentice for Graduate level" when you email your CV to [email protected].

faq.question: Q5. Is NATS registration compulsory?
faq.answer: Yes. You must register at nats.education.gov.in/student_type.php and bring your Enrollment ID to the interview if you are called.

faq.question: Q6. How long is the apprenticeship?
faq.answer: It lasts 1 (one) year and is part of EAMUL's apprentice engagement for the financial year 2026-27.

faq.question: Q7. Where will apprentices be posted?
faq.answer: At the EAMUL Head Office in Jorhat, at Darrang or at Bokakhat. The work covers billing and accounts, field-level monitoring, milk procurement operations and input service activities.

faq.question: Q8. How will shortlisted candidates be informed?
faq.answer: By email only. Make sure the email ID on your CV is current.

faq.question: Q9. What is the stipend?
faq.answer: Rs. 12,300/- per month.

content_sections.heading: HPRCA Teacher Recruitment 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Himachal Pradesh Rajya Chayan Aayog has released for 2,423 teaching vacancies in Government CBSE-affiliated schools. The official 23-page notification contains the subject-wise and category-wise vacancies, eligibility criteria, age limits, honorarium, temporary engagement terms, application fee, selection process, examination syllabus and online application instructions. Official Notification Source: HPRCA Recruitment Notifications

content_sections.heading: HPRCA Teacher Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Applicants must possess the post-specific educational qualifications by 5 December 2026 . Most subjects require a relevant Master's degree, B.Ed. and Teacher Eligibility Test (TET), while some specialized teaching posts have alternative qualification pathways. English and Mathematics Teacher candidates must meet the specific graduation, postgraduate and teacher-training requirements prescribed in the notification. The applicable relaxation in minimum marks for eligible Himachal Pradesh reserved categories must be checked against the detailed qualification conditions. The Computer Teacher post provides multiple educational qualification pathways, including: B.E. or B.Tech. in Computer Science or Information Technology with the prescribed marks. B.E. or B.Tech. in any stream with a recognized postgraduate diploma in Computer Science, Technology or Applications. M.Sc. Computer Science or MCA with the prescribed marks. Postgraduate degree in Mathematics or Physics with a postgraduate diploma in Computer Science or Computer Applications. DOEACC 'B' or 'C' Level qualification from the recognized authority, meeting the notified marks requirements. Candidates must also meet the prescribed proficiency requirement for teaching in Hindi and English. The Physical Education Teacher post accepts specified professional qualifications recognized under the relevant NCTE regulations, including the applicable B.P.Ed., integrated Physical Education degree and other notified training routes. Applicants should carefully compare their qualification, course duration and minimum marks with the detailed notification. Applicants may qualify through a recognized Master's degree in Fine Arts or Visual Arts, including Painting and Sculpture, with the prescribed minimum marks. The notification provides up to 5% relaxation in minimum educational marks for eligible SC, ST, OBC and PwD candidates of Himachal Pradesh, where specified against the qualification. Applicants should not assume that the same minimum marks or relaxation applies identically to every educational route.

content_sections.text: Selected candidates will receive a fixed honorarium of Rs. 30,000 per month for 10 months in an academic year , under the notified teacher engagement scheme. Salary Clarification: The honorarium is not a regular government teacher pay scale. content_sections.heading: HPRCA Teacher Selection Process 2026
content_sections.text: Selection will be based on a Computer Based Test (CBT) or Written Screening Test carrying 120 marks , followed by verification of the prescribed eligibility documents. Online Application: Candidates submit their Online Recruitment Application through HPRCA. CBT / Written Screening Test: Eligible applicants appear in the examination conducted by the Aayog. Merit Preparation: Candidates are ranked according to examination performance and applicable selection rules. Document Verification: Shortlisted candidates produce original certificates and self-attested photocopies. Final Selection: HPRCA prepares the selection recommendations according to vacancies, eligibility and reservation requirements. The notification does not prescribe a separate interview as a general selection stage for these posts.

content_sections.heading: HPRCA Teacher Exam Pattern 2026
content_sections.text: The HPRCA Teacher screening examination will contain 120 objective-type multiple-choice questions carrying one mark each . The examination duration is 90 minutes. The examination will assess subject knowledge up to the level of the prescribed qualification and general knowledge topics. Subject-specific knowledge relevant to the selected teaching post. General Knowledge of Himachal Pradesh. Current Affairs. Everyday Science. Logical Reasoning. Social Science. General English at Matriculation level. General Hindi at Matriculation level. The detailed subject-wise syllabus is available in the Downloads section of the official HPRCA website. Candidates should follow the syllabus corresponding to their specific post.

content_sections.heading: HPRCA Teacher Recruitment 2026 Domicile and Reservation Conditions
content_sections.text: The notification contains important eligibility and reservation conditions for candidates from Himachal Pradesh and other states. Applicants must generally have passed Matriculation and 10+2 from an institution situated within Himachal Pradesh. This condition does not apply to bona fide Himachali candidates, as provided in the notification. State reservation benefits are available to eligible bona fide Himachal Pradesh residents who satisfy the applicable caste, category and certificate requirements. Reserved category candidates belonging to other states will be treated as General (Unreserved) candidates for this recruitment. OBC-NCL, EWS, BPL, Ward of Freedom Fighter and other relevant category certificates must meet the notification's validity requirements. Certain certificates must remain valid both on the application closing date and at document verification.

content_sections.heading: HPRCA Teacher Apply Online 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates can apply for the 2,423 Teacher vacancies through the official HPRCA online recruitment website from 10 November 2026 at 10:00 AM to 5 December 2026 at 11:59 PM . Apply Online: HPRCA Teacher Recruitment Official Portal 14/2026. Application Status: Opens on 10 November 2026. Last Date: 5 December 2026. One Time Registration (OTR) is mandatory before filling out the Online Recruitment Application. Candidates applying for different eligible teaching posts must follow the separate post-wise application requirements.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required for HPRCA Teacher Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Applicants must possess the required certificates supporting educational qualifications, age, category, professional training and other claimed eligibility conditions. Matriculation certificate for age verification. 10+2 qualification certificate, where applicable. Graduation certificate and marksheets. Relevant postgraduate qualification certificate and marksheets. B.Ed. or other prescribed professional training qualification. Teacher Eligibility Test certificate, where required. Relevant subject-specific professional certificates. Valid SC/ST/OBC/EWS/BPL or other category certificate, if applicable. Bonafide Himachali certificate, where applicable. Ward of Freedom Fighter or other supporting certificate, if applicable. Valid identity and other documents required by HPRCA. Recent passport-size photograph. Scanned signature. The photograph must be a recent passport-size image, not older than one month, as specified in the notification. Shortlisted candidates must produce original documents and self-attested photocopies at the time of document verification.

content_sections.heading: HPRCA Teacher Application Correction 2026
content_sections.text: HPRCA will provide a four-day application correction window after the closing of the Online Recruitment Application period. Candidates should not depend on the correction facility to fix all application errors. Certain category claims and other details may be subject to restrictions after submission.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: NABCONS has advertised 02 posts of Associate Consultants as Core Contract Staff. The company reserves the right to increase or decrease the number of posts or not to fill up any of the posts.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Only Indian Citizens may apply. The minimum educational criteria for each post are listed below. Experience: minimum 3 years of post-qualification experience handling HR matters in the HR department of an established organization/Public sector/Banking and Finance Sector. Good written and oral business communication skills and analytical skills. Should be a team player, energetic, with excellent presentation skills. Knowledge of practical use of tools such as MS Office, including advanced Excel features for day-to-day functioning. Problem-solving skills. An eye for accuracy and attention to detail. Experience: at least three years, post CA/CFA/ICWA/MBA-Finance/M.Com qualification, in Accounts, preparation of financial statements and Balance Sheet, direct and indirect taxation etc. in a reputed organisation. Work experience in various types of accounting software such as ERP, Tally etc. Proficiency in reading, writing and speaking in English and Hindi. Excellent knowledge of MS Office with proficiency in MS Excel and PowerPoint. An eye for accuracy and attention to detail. For both posts, the age is preferably below 35 years as on 31 October 2026. The notice does not mention any age relaxation. Candidates should check the official notification for the full post-wise eligibility of each post.

rows.essential_qualification: Regular Graduate in any subject with minimum 60% or equivalent grade points in CGPA from a reputed institution, and Regular MBA or PGDM or equivalent in HR with major subject as HR/Industrial relations from a reputed management institution with minimum 55% or equivalent grade points.

Bachelor of Commerce/Bachelor of Commerce (Honours) with minimum 60% or equivalent marks in CGPA from a reputed institution, and CA/CFA/ICWA/MBA-Finance/M.Com qualification having registration with ICAI/ICWA or equivalent.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: Both posts carry a consolidated monthly remuneration "As per NABCONS Policy and Industry Standards". The remuneration would be considered based on relevant experience, qualification, last drawn salary etc. Tax is deducted at source as per the Income Tax Act and Rules in force. Besides the remuneration, the candidate is also eligible for other facilities/allowances as per NABCONS policy. The vacancy is for Core Contract Staff, who manage multiple assignments; their tenure of service is full-time in nature. Core Contract Staff are eligible for benefits such as Provident Fund, Gratuity, Leave Encashment and other benefits. The engagement would be continuous in nature and will be renewed annually based on performance. After completion of the first year, the contract will be renewed for another one year and then annually in a block of 3 years. Performance is reviewed quarterly in the first and second year of engagement, and annually in the following years. NABCONS may terminate the contract at any time without prior notice and without giving any reason; in the normal course, it may terminate the engagement by giving one (01) month notice in advance within the contract period. Contractually engaged staff have no legal claim to regular absorption during or after the contract, and no claims as to seniority.

content_sections.heading: NABCONS Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: Manpower management, recruitments, hiring, empanelment, coordination with Zonal Offices and Regional Offices, terminations, HR compliances viz, PF, Gratuity, leave management, Performance management, renewal of contracts, training, Salary management and RTI replies etc. Implementation of HR policies, systems & processes in line with the aggressive growth strategy. Proficient in liaising with business and vertical heads along with employees at different levels to design and implement Talent Development Strategy. Possess expertise in identifying training needs across levels. Manage End to End Recruitment Cycle & Manpower Planning. Initiating various recruitment reports, analysis and dashboards and managing & delivering them on a periodic basis. Compliance of historical data for migration to new software. Absence Management. Administration and HR related data management procurement of dead stock items. To coordinate CSR activities of the company including project management. Develop programme, retention strategies and attrition management. Any other work as assigned from time to time. Maintenance of accounts. Preparation of Financial Statements. Preparation and review of budget estimates. Handling Accounting Software (ERP). Responsible for the monthly/quarterly/Annual closing as well as maintenance of all accounting ledgers, review of all account reconciliations/journal entries. Provide accurate, timely and relevant recording, reporting and analysis of financial information. Keeping account books and systems up to date. Complying to Statutory requirements and reporting to Credit Information Companies. Preparation of Bank Reconciliation statements. Computation and payment of applicable taxes e.g. GST, PF, TDS, Income Tax and filing of returns. Coordination for various types of audit, etc. Recording Receipts and Payments. Attend to work related to invoicing/income booking, review of sundry debtors. Managing staff/vendor payments, related entries in Bank Portal. Funds management and investment of surplus funds in various instruments, maintenance of records of investments. Any other matter/work assigned by the Management from time to time in line with the changing evolving business demands on an on-going basis.

content_sections.text: Applications are accepted only online, in the prescribed format, from 2 November 2026 to 9 November 2026 (midnight). Applications by hand or any other mode will not be entertained, and applications received after the due date will be rejected. Open the application link for the post you are applying for: Associate Consultant-HR – https://forms.cloud.microsoft/r/9mMYzF5NkT ; Associate Consultant – Finance & Accounts – https://forms.cloud.microsoft/r/T3N3VRzFLL . Give the declaration in the online form about your educational qualification and experience. Submit the form successfully; only applications submitted successfully will be considered. The notice also says candidates should apply only online through the NABCONS website ( www.nabcons.com ) or Naukri.com, and that no other mode of submission will be accepted. Self-attested copies of educational qualification certificates, to be compulsorily submitted at the time of the interview. Self-attested copies of experience certificates, to be compulsorily submitted at the time of the interview. Original documents for verification at the interview; a candidate without them will not be allowed to attend the interview.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Candidates shortlisted as per the eligibility criteria may be subjected to a qualifying written test, if required, followed by a Personal Interview. Shortlisting: meeting the eligibility criteria does not by itself entitle a candidate to an interview. NABCONS reserves the right to call only the requisite number of candidates, depending on the number of responses, after preliminary screening/shortlisting with reference to qualification, suitability, experience, etc. Written test: qualifying in nature and held only if required. Personal Interview: only shortlisted candidates will be called. The place, location and process of the interview will be indicated in the call letter. Any cost incurred for attending the interview will not be reimbursed by NABCONS. Eligibility is verified at the interview/joining stage, based on the information given in the online application. The final appointment will be based on the decision of the selection committee constituted for the purpose.

Monitor sanctioned allocations, funds received, expenditure, committed liabilities, available balances and re-appropriation or adjustment under approved budget heads. Assist the Principal Investigator in correspondence and coordination with ICMR, the AIIMS Nagpur Accounts Section, Administration and participating centres. Maintain electronic and physical records of sanctions, approvals, procurement documents, salary records, participant payments, travel claims and audit documents. Facilitate audit, financial review, procurement, salary processing and timely submission of project reports. Perform data entry and other project-related administrative, financial or documentation work assigned by the Principal Investigator.

content_sections.heading: About AIC STPI Bengaluru
content_sections.text: AIC STPI Bengaluru is an incubation centre in Bengaluru, Karnataka. It works under STPI and STPINEXT Initiatives, whose logos appear on the notice. It runs incubation programmes and Open Challenge Programs (OCPs) for startups, gives marketing assistance to the startups it incubates, and manages AIM/STPI grants.

content_sections.heading: AIC STPI Bengaluru Administrative Executive and Marketing & Project Coordinator Vacancy Details 2026
content_sections.text: STPI reserves the right to fill all, some or none of the advertised positions without giving a reason.

content_sections.heading: AIC STPI Bengaluru Administrative Executive and Marketing & Project Coordinator Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: Age limit: below 35 years for both posts. Age is counted as on the last date for receiving applications. The notice says relaxation is permissible for deserving candidates. Experience in the relevant field counts only from the date you obtained the minimum essential qualification. The Administrative Executive role needs strong financial expertise, Tally/ERP accounting, and good Excel, data management and MIS reporting skills. The Marketing & Project Coordinator role needs business development, startup ecosystem engagement, digital marketing, social media management and AI-enabled communication skills. Read the official notification for the full eligibility of each post.

rows.qualification_and_experience: B.Com / M.Com / MBA (Finance) or equivalent; 2-3 years of experience
MBA – Marketing / Business Development / Communications or equivalent; 2-3 years of experience

content_sections.heading: Duties of Each Post
content_sections.text: This post handles the centre's administration, finance and grant management from start to finish. Finance and accounts: vouchers, ledgers, bank reconciliation, vendor payments, bills, invoices and reimbursements; Income & Expenditure and Receipts & Payments statements; MIS reports; budget-head-wise expenditure tracking. Grant and government finance: AIM/STPI grant use and balance tracking; Utilization Certificates (UCs); PFMS-related processes and grant releases; financial reporting for AIM, STPI, PMG, the Governing Board and audits. Statutory compliance: GST, TDS, PF and ESI; coordination with the Chartered Accountant, the auditor and statutory consultants; keeping audit records up to date. Administration and procurement: day-to-day administration of the Incubation Centre; vendor records, quotations, work orders and contracts; procurement under government/STPI procedures; asset and inventory records. e-Office: e-Office/Parichay file creation, movement and tracking; notes for internal approvals; following up on pending approvals. This post supports the centre's startup outreach, partnerships, marketing, digital presence and programmes. Startup outreach and OCP: outreach for Open Challenge Programs and incubation programmes; startup databases; coordination with universities, incubators, accelerators and startup communities; application campaigns and screening. Business development: partnerships with corporates, GCCs, industry, academia, investors, hospitals, technology companies and CSR organisations; proposals and MoUs; CSR support, sponsorships and investor roundtables. Marketing and digital presence: LinkedIn and other social media channels, website content and newsletters; startup and founder stories; press releases; content calendars and engagement analytics; working with photography, video and agency vendors. Digital marketing: tools such as Canva for communication material, and analytics tools to measure campaigns. Programmes and events: OCPs, workshops, Demo Days, hackathons and investor engagements; an annual/quarterly events calendar; post-event reporting. Startup marketing assistance: putting marketing assistance in place for incubated startups and tracking its use and results.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: A Screening Committee checks the applications received by the last date. It looks at qualifications, age, academic record and relevant experience. Candidates who meet the advertised qualifications and experience may be screened in. Screened-in candidates are called for a personal interview before a Selection Committee on the scheduled date and time. The Selection Committee recommends a candidate or a panel of candidates, in order of merit, for appointment. Applying does not by itself mean you will be called for a test or interview.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: The contract runs for 3 years or until the end of AIC STPI Bengaluru, whichever is earlier. It may be renewed based on performance, subject to the project tenure being extended. Both posts report to the CEO or the STPI Jurisdictional Director, as the STPI Jurisdictional Director decides. The job is based in Bengaluru, Karnataka. The work location can change by mutual agreement. If a candidate is found ineligible on any ground after appointment, their services may be terminated without a reason being given. Any litigation is subject to the jurisdiction of Delhi courts.

content_sections.text: Send the application directly to the Secretary of the Commission by registered post or speed post. It must reach on or before 10 December 2026; applications received after the last date will not be considered. Address: Secretary, Jharkhand State Electricity Regulatory Commission, 1st Floor, Jharkhand State Housing Board (Old Headquarter), Harmu Housing Colony, Ranchi - 834002. Use the Application Format printed with the notice (it carries the line "Applied for the post of" and a place for a self-attested recent photograph). Attach full bio-data and a copy of the degree on the basis of which you are applying. A working or serving officer must also send a second copy of the application through the employer or last employer on or before 10 December 2026, with the documents listed below. The notice gives the Commission's email as [email protected] and its website as www.jserc.org ; it states that application is through registered/speed post only. It does not give a subject line or envelope wording. The notice says the details of the post, age, tenure and pay are also on the Commission's website at www.jserc.org/ombudsman2026.pdf .

content_sections.text: The Commission needs to appoint one Electricity Ombudsman; the number of posts is not printed. The notice does not name a separate educational qualification, but applicants must enclose a copy of the degree on the basis of which they apply. The Ombudsman holds office for a term of five years or Sixty-Five years of age, whichever is earlier. The initial appointment is for three years, extendable up to a further two years on satisfactory service. basic_details.job_title: IIIT Pune Junior Research Fellow Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: The Department of Electronics and Communication Engineering at the Indian Institute of Information Technology Pune (IIIT Pune) has invited applications from Indian nationals for one Junior Research Fellow (JRF) post in an ISRO-sponsored project under the RESPOND Programme. The fellowship is ₹37,000 per month + 30% HRA (as per ISRO norms) for a project of two years. Applications go by email to [email protected] or through a Google Form, and the last date is 25 November 2026 (tentative). The interview is tentatively on 7 December 2026.

how_to_apply: Prepare a single PDF file containing the documents listed below.
Email the PDF to [email protected] with the subject "Application for JRF Position – ISRO RESPOND Project".
Alternatively, fill and upload the completed application form and all supporting documents through the Google Form: https://forms.gle/18NDdn1m6TyAcRUUA
The application form is placed at the end of the advertisement.
Documents named in the notice:
Duly filled Application Form.
Updated Curriculum Vitae (CV).
Self-attested copies of all educational certificates and mark sheets.
GATE/CSIR-UGC NET score card.
Experience certificates (if any).
List of publications along with copies of the first page of each publication (if any).
Any other supporting documents relevant to the project.
Undertaking (Annexure I).
For queries, the Project Investigator Dr. Dheeraj Dubey can be reached at [email protected] or 8840677530.
important_instructions: Meeting the minimum eligibility criteria does not guarantee shortlisting for the interview. IIIT Pune reserves the right to restrict the number of candidates called for interview based on academic performance and relevant experience. The Institute reserves the right not to fill the advertised position if suitable candidates are not found. The selected candidate shall not claim any regular appointment in IIIT Pune by virtue of this fellowship. No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview. Original documents have to be produced for verification at the time of interview/joining. Incomplete applications or applications received after the due date will not be considered. Canvassing in any form will lead to disqualification. The decision of IIIT Pune regarding selection is final and binding.

rows.details: Indian Institute of Information Technology Pune

Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO), under the RESPOND Programme
Project duration two (02) years; initial appointment of six months
₹37,000/- per month + 30% HRA (as per ISRO norms)
Indian Institute of Information Technology Pune
Email in a single PDF file, or the Google Form

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Only eligible Indian nationals may apply. The essential qualification is a Postgraduate Degree in Basic Science OR a Graduate/Postgraduate Degree in a Professional Course, selected through a process described in either of these: (a) Scholars selected through National Eligibility Tests such as CSIR-UGC NET (including Lectureship/Assistant Professorship), or GATE. (b) Selection through National Level Examinations conducted by Central Government Departments and their Agencies/Institutions such as DST, DBT, DAE, DOS, DRDO, MoE (formerly MHRD), ICAR, ICMR, IITs, IISc, IISER, etc. Preference will be given to candidates having one or more of the following desirable qualifications: Strong background in Digital Communication, Wireless Communication, Information Theory, Channel Coding and Error Control Coding. Knowledge of Optical Communication and Free Space Optical (FSO) Communication. Experience with MATLAB, Python, or similar simulation/programming tools. Knowledge of communication system design and performance analysis. Good programming, analytical and technical writing skills. Research publications in relevant areas will be an added advantage. The notice does not mention a minimum experience. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The fellowship is ₹37,000/- per month + 30% HRA (as per ISRO norms). The JRF will be appointed for an initial period of six months. Based on satisfactory performance, the appointment will be extended for the remaining duration of the project (up to two years), subject to the availability of project funds and institute/ISRO guidelines. The position is purely temporary and co-terminus with the project.

content_sections.heading: IIIT Pune Junior Research Fellow (JRF) Job Description
content_sections.text: Conduct research related to high-speed channel coding for classical RF and Free Space Optical communication systems. Design, simulate and evaluate communication algorithms. Develop software models and validate system performance. Assist in preparation of project reports, technical documents and research publications. Participate in meetings and other project-related activities assigned by the PI.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IIIT Pune Junior Research Fellow (JRF)
content_sections.text: Documents named in the notice: Duly filled Application Form. Updated Curriculum Vitae (CV). Self-attested copies of all educational certificates and mark sheets. GATE/CSIR-UGC NET score card. Experience certificates (if any). List of publications along with copies of the first page of each publication (if any). Any other supporting documents relevant to the project. Undertaking (Annexure I). For queries, the Project Investigator Dr. Dheeraj Dubey can be reached at [email protected] or 8840677530.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Applications are first screened on eligibility and suitability for the project. Only shortlisted candidates are invited for the interview, and they are informed by email about the schedule. The interview may be conducted offline at IIIT Pune or online, depending on administrative requirements. Final selection is based on the candidate's academic credentials, research aptitude, technical competence and interview performance.

content_sections.heading: About ISM
content_sections.text: India Semiconductor Mission was established by MeitY as an independent business division within M/s Digital India Corporation, with administrative and financial autonomy, to drive India's strategies for developing the semiconductor and display manufacturing ecosystem. It is the nodal agency for implementing semiconductor and display schemes and is located at Electronics Niketan, 6, CGO Complex Lodhi Road, New Delhi – 110003.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Bachelor's Degree in Business Administration/ Management/ Public Administration/ any relevant discipline from a recognized university. Post Graduate Degree or Diploma in Business Administration/ Management / Public Administration / any relevant discipline from a recognized university. Professional Certification or Training in office management/secretarial practices etc. Minimum 4 years of experience (post EQ) for bachelor's degree OR 02 years of experience (post EQ) for master's degree. Ph.D experience may be considered as relevant work experience, depending on the field of study and its relevance to the role. Relaxation in the prescribed experience may be considered for candidates from top-ranking Colleges/Universities (Bachelor's/Master's/Ph.D.) in the relevant discipline, as per NIRF 2025 Ranking or the latest available ranking. Relevant experience in executive assistance, secretarial support, or office management, preferably supporting senior leadership in Government / PSU / Autonomous Bodies / Corporate organizations. Excellent drafting and communication skills. Strong organizational and coordination abilities. Proficiency in MS Office applications (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook). Ability to manage multiple assignments and work under strict timelines. High level of professionalism, discretion, and confidentiality. Strong interpersonal and stakeholder management skills. The age of the applicant as on the last date of receipt of the applications will be considered. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions.

content_sections.heading: ISM Executive Assistant Job Description
content_sections.text: The Executive Assistant will give administrative and operational support to senior leadership, including managing schedules, coordinating meetings, handling confidential documents, facilitating communication and ensuring smooth day-to-day functioning of the executive office. The post reports to Advisor (Technology) / CFO. Key responsibilities as printed: Provide comprehensive administrative support to senior management. Manage calendars, appointments, and travel arrangements. Prepare correspondence, reports, presentations, and official documents. Organize meetings, prepare agendas, and record minutes of meetings. Coordinate with internal departments and external stakeholders. Follow up on action points and ensure timely completion. Draft official communications, letters, and emails. Maintain confidential records, files, and documentation. Manage information flow between executives and other departments. Assist in organizing official events, meetings, and conferences. Monitor deadlines and ensure timely submission of reports. Support administrative and operational activities of the office. Handle sensitive information with the highest level of confidentiality. Maintain professional communication with senior officials and stakeholders.

content_sections.text: Sardar Patel University is a university at Vallabh Vidyanagar in Anand district, Gujarat; its notice states that it is NAAC accredited with Grade 'A' (10-01-2023 to 09-01-2028). Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions of the Warden post.

basic_details.short_information: The District and Sessions Court, Nandurbar (Jilha va Satra Nyayalay, Nandurbar) is preparing a selection list of 04 candidates for the post of Contractual Employee for Porta Cabins of e-Seva Kendras (E-Seva Kendranchya Porta Cabinssathi Kantrati Karmachari). The posts are under the third phase of the e-Court Project and are for 11 months or until the grant is available, whichever is earlier. Applications in the Annexure A format must reach the Registrar, District and Sessions Court, Tokar Talav Road, Nandurbar by post or by hand on or before 20 November 2026, 05:00 PM.

post_wise_qualification.post_name: Contractual Employee for Porta Cabins of e-Seva Kendras

qualification.details: The pay is an honorarium / salary of Rs.15,000/- per month. No other allowances will be given in addition to this pay. | Para Legal Volunteers (PLV) will be considered on priority. A certificate of Marathi and English typing knowledge, if held, can be enclosed with the application. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility of the post. | The candidate must be willing to work as per items 4 and 5 of the guidelines issued by the e-Committee of the Hon'ble Supreme Court dated 25/04/2020 for implementation of the e-Seva Kendra project. The notice says a copy of items 4 and 5 is attached to it. The bond attached to the form states that the appointee may be given responsibility for important work of the District Court and will be trained in the court's procedures and policies.

selection_process: Selection is by scrutiny of applications
a shortlist where needed
a practical test if necessary
and an interview.
Applications received in time will be scrutinised. If the number of eligible applications is large
the Computer Committee
District Court
Nandurbar will prepare a shortlist on the basis of merit

applying suitable criteria. All rights to prepare the shortlist and run the selection rest with this committee. The list of candidates eligible for interview will be published on 23 November 2026 on the district court website. The interview date and time will be given in that list and will not be communicated separately. A practical test will be held if found necessary. Selection will be on merit
based on the marks in the practical test (if held) and the interview. The list of selected candidates will be published on the notice board of District Court
Nandurbar and on the website.
Candidates called for interview must bring the originals of the documents submitted with the application for verification
and the original of the photo ID attached (Voter card
PAN card
Aadhaar card or Driving licence) to the practical test and interview. Candidates attend at their own cost; no expenses will be paid by the office.
important_instructions: The appointment is contractual and temporary, limited to the next 11 months or until the grant is available, whichever is earlier; no claim can be made on the appointment. The appointment will be made considering the candidate's work and the directions received from the Hon'ble High Court from time to time. The Principal District and Sessions Judge, Nandurbar has the right to terminate the service at any time. Any pressure or request about the place of posting will lead to cancellation of the selection. A selected candidate who does not join within the period stated in the appointment order will have the appointment cancelled. If false information or concealment of facts is found at any stage, the candidature will be cancelled, or the candidate removed from the post if already appointed. Merely applying gives no right to a test, interview or appointment. The Computer Committee reserves all rights to change the type of test, postpone, cancel or partly change it, and its decision is final. The bond signed with the application makes the candidate liable to pay a penalty fixed by the District Court as liquidated damages for breach of the conditions of the work. All updates will appear only on the District Court, Nandurbar notice board and website; no one will be informed individually, and complaints about missing a test or interview due to late information will not be heard.

content_sections.heading: About CTUAP
content_sections.text: Central Tribal University of Andhra Pradesh functions from its Transit Campus at Cantonment, Vizianagaram-535003, Andhra Pradesh. This recruitment is for the ICMR-NHRP-SAHAY Project run by the Department of Biotechnology under Principal Investigator Dr Parikipandla Sridevi. The project studies an optimal model for sickle cell disease screening, diagnosis, treatment and care in tribal areas.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: *Age relaxable by 3 years for OBC. The notice also states that OBC, SC, ST and women candidates are encouraged to apply.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Essential qualification: Professionals with Post-Graduation in Anthropology/ Social Work/ Sociology / Public Health/ Social Welfare and Rural Management/Rural Development or any other subject of life sciences. Experience: a minimum of two (02) years of post-qualification experience exclusively in community-based health research with publications. Age: maximum 35 years. Essential qualification: MA/MSc in Anthropology/ Social Work/MPH/ Social Welfare and Rural Management/Rural Development other social sciences, or life sciences, with experience in community-based health research. Alternatively: Graduates in Nursing/Dental Sciences with three years of experience in community-based health research. Age: maximum 35 years, relaxable by 3 years for OBC. Telugu speaking candidates will be preferred as the field area is in Andhra Pradesh. Qualifications and experience should be from recognised organisations with valid certificates. All the project staff should stay in the tribal area of Alluri Seetharama Raju (ASR) district. The notice does not print an "as on" date for counting age. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: Project Research Scientist-I (Non-Medical): Rs. 56,000/- per month + HRA as admissible. Project Technical Support-III: Rs. 28,000/- per month + HRA, as admissible. The initial appointment will be for a period of six months or co-terminus with the project, whichever is earlier. The post may be extended for a further period based on satisfactory performance and project requirements. Benefits of provident fund, Leave Travel Concession, Medical Claim, etc. are not applicable. The posts are purely temporary, and the selected candidates will have no claim for regular appointments under ICMR or in the Central Tribal University of Andhra Pradesh, or for continuation of their services in any other project.

content_sections.heading: CTUAP Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: The notice prints one job description for all the project staff, covering both posts: The project involves extensive fieldwork in the tribal areas of Alluri Seetharama Raju (ASR) district of Andhra Pradesh. All the staff should stay in the tribal area for coordination with the Govt. health system, data collection, sensitisation and community mobilisation activities. Working with the Govt. health system and collecting data regarding the national sickle cell disease mission from Primary Health Centres and Health & Wellness Centres in tribal areas. Conducting trainings and sensitization programs in the health facilities and the community.

content_sections.heading: About PSB
content_sections.text: Punjab & Sind Bank describes itself as a Govt. of India Undertaking, with its Head Office HRD Department at NBCC Building Block 3, Kidwai Nagar, New Delhi - 110023. The Chief Risk Officer will oversee risk management across the Bank, including at group level covering Domestic Operations, Domestic Subsidiaries and Branches.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: A candidate must be a citizen of India, a subject of Nepal or Bhutan, a Tibetan refugee who came to India before 1 January 1962 intending to settle permanently, or a person of Indian origin who migrated from Pakistan, Burma, Sri Lanka, Kenya, Uganda, the United Republic of Tanzania, Zambia, Malawi, Zaire, Ethiopia or Vietnam intending to settle permanently. The last four groups need a certificate of eligibility issued by the Govt. of India. Graduate Degree from a university/institution recognised by the Government of India or its regulatory bodies. At least five years' experience in Corporate Credit and Risk Management at the level of Assistant General Manager or above in one or more Public Sector Banks; or in an equivalent senior position, with similar roles and responsibilities, in one or more regulated lending entities, as may be determined by the Bank and the CRO Selection Committee, with minimum experience of one year in Corporate Credit and one year in Risk Management. Along with any one of: (a) professional certification in financial risk management from the Global Association of Risk Professionals; (b) Professional Risk Management Certification from the PRMIA Institute; or at least two years' experience as Chief Risk Officer in a regulated lending entity where the CRO must be appointed with Board approval under a regulatory requirement. Preference may be given to candidates with one or more of the following: Chartered Financial Analyst charter from the CFA Institute. Chartered Accountant qualification from the Institute of Chartered Accountants of India or an equivalent qualification obtained abroad. Cost and Management Accountant qualification from the Institute of Cost Accountants of India or an equivalent qualification obtained abroad. Postgraduate degree in Finance, Economics, Banking, Risk Management, Business Administration or a related field. Certification or specialised qualification in treasury risk, credit risk, operational risk, cyber risk, climate risk, data analytics or model-risk management. Desirable experience: good understanding of market risk and/or liquidity management and/or operational risk, with exposure to analytics an added advantage. Minimum 40 years of age and less than 55 years of age (as on 01.11.2026). The notice prints no age relaxation. Date of birth as per the Secondary School Certificate (SSC)/School leaving certificate must confirm age eligibility.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: Pay: the compensation and terms and conditions will be negotiated/finalised depending upon the suitability of the candidate. Tenure: the CRO may initially be engaged for a fixed contractual tenure of three years, extendable by one year at a time, up to a maximum of five years, subject to annual performance review by the Board/Risk Management Committee of the Board. The engagement is purely contractual and gives no right to claim regular employment or absorption in the Bank. Working hours and weekly off/holidays are as applicable to the Bank's serving employees. Leave: 30 days' paid leave per calendar year, not more than 05 days at a time. Absence beyond 30 days in a contract year leads to a proportionate deduction from the consolidated payment, and unavailed leave lapses at the end of the contract year. PF, Gratuity, Pension etc. do not apply, and no other allowance, payment, benefit or facility is payable beyond what the notice mentions. Location: preferably Head Office/Corporate Office; the Bank reserves the right to post the candidate to any office in India depending on administrative requirements.

content_sections.heading: PSB CHIEF RISK OFFICER Job Description
content_sections.text: The CRO oversees the entire risk management process of the Bank, including at group level, reviews risk models, and develops policies, procedures and pricing models. The role is grouped under credit risk, market risk, operational risk, and liquidity and interest rate risk management, and also includes RBI guidelines applicable from time to time. Annexure I of the notice lists these duties: Act as risk assessor and overall in charge of the Bank's Risk Management function, and advise top management. Implement and maintain an enterprise-wide integrated risk management and governance framework covering credit, investment, operational, market and compliance risk. Report the Bank's risk profile periodically to Risk Committees, top management and the Board, and implement BASEL guidelines as per RBI directives. Oversee the Fraud Risk Management Department (FRMD) and strengthen frameworks including EIRMS, policy and cyber risk governance. Credit risk: bank-wide credit risk management, risk limits and risk appetite, stress testing, preparation of the Annual ICAAP document, monitoring of large exposures, and validation of Credit Risk Assessment (CRA)/scoring models. Market risk: turn the Board's framework into policies and procedures, and guide the market risk team on interest rate risk, equity price risk, derivatives, country limits, counterparty bank limits and stress testing. Operational risk: supervise the ORM Cell, review operational risk policies, conduct the Product and Process Approval Committee, Credit Policy Committee, ALCO and ORMC meetings, oversee AML/CFT controls and IT security risk, and ensure Board RMC meetings are held as scheduled. Liquidity and interest rate risk: oversee the liquidity position of all PSB Zones and departments, supervise the ALM Cell and review the Asset Liability Management Policy. The notice adds that any other roles and responsibilities may be assigned by the authorities/Bank.

content_sections.text: Log on to the Bank's website https://punjabandsind.bank.in/ and, on the Home Page under the link "Recruitment", click the relevant Notification. No other mode of application is accepted. Before registering, keep a valid personal email ID and mobile number active until the appointment process ends. Call letters are sent to the registered email ID. Spell your name and your father's/husband's name exactly as in your certificates, mark sheets and identity proof. Any change found may disqualify the candidature. Pay the application fee online only. Cash, Demand Drafts, Cheques, Money Orders and Postal Stamps are not accepted. Submit the application by 17.11.2026. Applications received after the stipulated date and incomplete applications are rejected. The fee is Rs. 1000/- + GST as applicable. The table prints Rs. 1180/- (including CGST and SGST) for New Delhi and Rs. 1180/- (including IGST) for out of New Delhi. Transaction charges are borne by the candidate. The fee is non-refundable and cannot be held in reserve for any other selection. An application cannot be withdrawn once made.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: The selection process may broadly comprise preliminary scrutiny of applications, shortlisting, a personal interaction/interview before the Selection Committee, and verification of credentials. Final selection is on marks obtained in the interview, by merit ranking. Scrutiny: applications are checked against age, qualifications, experience and other eligibility conditions. content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: Pay: consolidated Rs. 57,700/- per month. Contract: the initial period is six months. It can be extended on the basis of performance and work, or till the regular appointment is made, whichever is earlier. The University may re-engage the Skill Assistant Professor if further staff is required, based on performance and the work and conduct report. This cannot be claimed as of right. No claim of regularization or extension will be entertained. The University may terminate the contract without assigning any reason. Allowances, provision and gratuity admissible to regular teachers are not given. Medical Reimbursement and LTC are not admissible. Casual leave is one day per month, up to a maximum of 5 days in the six-month contract. Medical/sick leave is one per calendar month, up to a maximum of 5 days. Maternity leave is as admissible under the Maternity Benefit Act, 1961. No contract amount is payable for absence from duty. Continuous unapproved absence of more than 5 days ends the service automatically. The engagement can be ended on one month's notice or one month's salary in lieu of notice, on either side. TA/DA is payable for official tours at par with other employees, as per University policy. No TA/DA is payable for attending any test or interview. No No Objection Certificate is issued for Ph.D. enrolment. Registration in a Ph.D. in this University or outside ends the engagement automatically.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: The notice describes a written test, scrutiny of those who qualify, shortlisting on academic score, and a final selection on a composite score that includes a PPT presentation and an interview. All applicants are first allowed to appear in the written test without checking eligibility. Securing minimum 40% marks is mandatory (38% for DSC/OSC/BC/PwBD). Only applicants who qualify are scrutinised for eligibility. The structure and syllabus of the test will be uploaded on the University website in due course. Only eligible and test-qualified applicants are considered for shortlisting on an academic score out of 100: academic record 80, research publications 10, teaching experience 10. Shortlisted candidates are called for interview in a ratio of 1:15 for the first post, and the University decides the number called. Graduation: 80% and above = 15; 60% to less than 80% = 13; 55% to less than 60% = 10; 45% to less than 55% = 05. Post-graduation: 80% and above = 25; 60% to less than 80% = 23; 55% (50% for SC/ST/OBC non-creamy layer/PWD) to less than 60% = 20. M.Phil.: 60% and above = 07; 55% to less than 60% = 05. Ph.D. = 30. M.Phil. plus Ph.D. maximum 30. NET with JRF = 07; NET = 05; SLET/SET = 03. JRF/NET/SET maximum 07. Research publications: 2 marks for each paper in peer-reviewed or UGC-listed journals, maximum 10. Teaching/post-doctoral experience: 2 marks for each year, maximum 10, reduced proportionately for less than a year. Awards: national/international level 03; state level 02; maximum 03 in the awards category. A candidate who fails to secure at least 50% composite marks (47.5% for DSC/OSC/BC/PwBD) is not considered suitable. A tie in composite score goes to the older applicant, and if the date of birth is the same, to the candidate who acquired the essential degree earlier.

basic_details.short_information: The Department of Genetics and Plant Breeding, CCS Haryana Agricultural University (CCS HAU), Hisar, has one Young Professional-II (YP-II) post on a contractual basis under scheme 3828-C(g)-PB-124-OA. The post pays ₹42000/- p.m. fixed and runs up to 31 March 2027, which the notice says is likely to be extended. The essential qualification is an M.Sc. in Genetics and Plant Breeding or a graduate degree in Agricultural Sciences. Applications on the prescribed proforma (Annexure A) must be received by 20 November 2026, and the interview is on 21 November 2026 at 3:30 pm.

how_to_apply: Candidates apply offline on the prescribed proforma (Annexure A) printed with the notice. The complete application must be received in the office of the Professor & Head, Department of Genetics and Plant Breeding, CCS Haryana Agril. University, Hisar - 125004, by 20 November 2026. No application received after that date will be entertained for any reason. The notice does not specify the mode of sending.
The Annexure A form asks for:
Full name in block letters, father's name, date of birth, age as on the interview date, sex and marital status
Permanent address with PIN code, mobile number and e-mail address
Category (SC/ST/OBC/General)
Educational qualifications from Matriculation to Ph.D., with board or university, year of passing, marks and percentage
NET status, computer knowledge, work experience and publications
A brief note on how the candidate can contribute to the present project, and a signed self-declaration
Attested passport size photograph, fixed on the form
No objection certificate from the present employer, if applicable
Original certificates at the interview
Certified true copies or original certificates, to be submitted to the University
NOC from the Dean PGS, for Ph.D. students, at the interview

The selected candidate can leave after one month's notice or by paying one month's emoluments. When the project ends, the candidate will be relieved. An agreement on non-judicial stamped paper of Rs. 15/- must be signed before joining. The candidate must report within 15 days of the appointment order. The Park runs the DAY-NRLM Incubator Programme, Odisha, with the Odisha Livelihoods Mission (OLM), to support growth-oriented micro-enterprises. The notice describes the positions as purely temporary/project-based and co-terminus with the programme, subject to the availability of funds and continuation of the project.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Only eligible Indian Nationals may apply. For both posts the essential qualification is Post-Graduation in Business Management, Development Studies, Rural Management, Accounts, Economics or related fields, or a professional qualification such as CA/ICWA or equivalent. Age, qualification and experience are reckoned as on the last date of submission of applications. The notice prints no age limit. Experience: minimum 12–15 years of relevant experience in setting up and/or managing a manufacturing/business enterprise, preferably in food processing, handicrafts or related sectors, with experience in a leadership position. Demonstrated expertise in overall business operations, particularly sales, business development, accounts and enterprise management. Desirable: experience of working with government programmes, development institutions, entrepreneurship/incubation programmes or rural enterprises. Preferred: candidates with extensive industry/business networks and stakeholder-management experience. Experience: minimum three (03) years of experience in enterprise promotion/management in a functional area such as production, sales, procurement, business development or related functions. Preference may be given to candidates having experience in sales/business development. Candidates from premier institutions such as IRMA, IIMs, IITs, NITs and other institutions of similar repute may be preferred. Candidates must be willing to travel extensively within Odisha and provide hands-on mentoring and support to approximately 60–75 enterprises. Higher relevant qualifications and experience may be considered. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility details of each post.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The remuneration is consolidated and stated per annum: up to ₹10,00,000 for the Project Lead and up to ₹12,00,000 for each Business Manager. It is subject to the applicable DAY-NRLM project norms, actuals-based reimbursement provisions and approval of the competent authority. The initial engagement is ordinarily for 12 months, extendable annually up to a maximum of three years, subject to satisfactory performance, achievement of approved KPIs, availability of funds and continuation of the programme. Selected personnel are engaged in accordance with the qualification and experience requirements of the DAY-NRLM Incubator Guidelines and are subject to approval by OLM before formal onboarding.

content_sections.heading: IIT Bhubaneswar Research and Entrepreneurship Park Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: The notice calls these responsibilities indicative and says they are not limited to the points below. Provide overall direction and guidance to the incubation team. Coordinate and supervise the work of Business Managers, Mentors and other project personnel. Interface with OLM, government officials, industry experts, financial institutions and other key stakeholders. Guide Business Managers in providing hands-on mentoring and support to incubated enterprises. Facilitate enterprise growth through business development, technology access, market linkages, standardisation, finance and other appropriate interventions. Review enterprise-level business and governance KPIs and ensure systematic monitoring of programme outcomes. Guide preparation and implementation of enterprise growth plans. Oversee the project MIS, reporting, documentation and knowledge products. Coordinate challenge fund-related activities and other programme activities as required. Participate in review meetings with OLM and other programme stakeholders. Ensure timely implementation of programme activities and achievement of approved project targets. Provide hands-on mentoring and handholding support to growth-oriented SHG enterprises. Assist enterprises in preparing and implementing business growth plans. Support enterprises in improving sales, production, procurement, financial management and business processes. Facilitate access to markets, finance, technology, registrations, certifications and other business-development services. Monitor enterprise performance against approved monthly, quarterly and annual KPIs. Identify enterprise-level gaps and facilitate appropriate technical/functional support. Coordinate with Mentors, functional experts and the Project Lead. Maintain enterprise-level records and contribute to project MIS and reporting. Undertake extensive field visits and provide regular enterprise-level support.

content_sections.text: Indian Bank has announced 1,500 apprenticeship seats across 30 States and Union Territories . Uttar Pradesh has the highest number of seats with 285, followed by Tamil Nadu with 270 and West Bengal with 145. District-Wise Vacancies: Annexure III of the official notification provides the district-wise distribution of apprenticeship training locations. content_sections.heading: Indian Bank Apprentice Stipend 2026
content_sections.text: Selected apprentices will receive a monthly stipend of Rs. 15,000 in Metro/Urban branches or Rs. 12,300 in Rural/Semi-Urban branches during the 12-month training period. Stipend Clarification: The stipend is not a regular bank employee salary. Apprentices are not eligible for additional allowances or regular employee benefits under this engagement.

content_sections.heading: Indian Bank Apprentice Training Duration 2026
content_sections.text: The apprenticeship duration is 12 months of on-the-job training under the Apprentices Act, 1961. Apprentices are entitled to bank holidays and one casual leave after completing each month of training. A maximum of four casual leaves may be taken at one time. The notification requires more than 338 paid days during the 12-month period to become eligible for the Certificate of Proficiency, subject to the prescribed assessment and completion conditions. After successful training and assessment, the Board of Apprenticeship Training (Southern Region) will issue a digital Certificate of Proficiency through NATS 2.0. No. Apprenticeship is a fixed-duration training arrangement. Indian Bank has no obligation to provide regular or contractual employment after completion of training, and apprentices do not have a right to claim employment with the bank.

content_sections.heading: Indian Bank Apprentice Application Fee 2026
content_sections.text: The application fee is Rs. 800 plus GST for General, OBC and EWS candidates . SC, ST and PwBD candidates must pay Rs. 175 plus GST. Fee Payment Period: 5 November to 25 November 2026. Payment Mode: Online through Debit Card, Credit Card or Internet Banking using the available payment gateway. The application fee is non-refundable. Applicable bank transaction charges are additional.

content_sections.heading: Indian Bank Apprentice Selection Process 2026
content_sections.text: The selection procedure includes an online objective examination and a Local Language Proficiency Test (LLPT) . Indian Bank may also conduct an interview at its discretion. NATS Registration: Eligible candidates complete their apprenticeship registration and profile. Online Application: Candidates submit the application and pay the applicable fee. Online Written Test: Candidates appear in the 100-mark objective examination. Local Language Proficiency Test: Qualified candidates must demonstrate proficiency in the selected State/UT language unless exempt. Interview, If Conducted: The bank may include or dispense with an interview. Merit List: Candidates are ranked according to the applicable State/UT and category-wise merit rules. Document Verification: Eligibility and supporting certificates are verified. Medical Fitness: Engagement is subject to the bank's prescribed medical fitness requirements. Apprenticeship Contract: Selected candidates receive their digital engagement through NATS 2.0.

content_sections.heading: Indian Bank Apprentice Exam Pattern 2026
content_sections.text: The online examination consists of 100 multiple-choice questions carrying 100 marks , with a composite duration of 60 minutes. Indian Bank will determine the minimum qualifying marks on the aggregate examination score. There are no separate minimum qualifying marks for individual sections. SC, ST, OBC and PwBD candidates receive a 5% relaxation in the prescribed aggregate qualifying percentage. The bank will prepare merit lists State/UT-wise and category-wise according to online examination performance. Candidates will be ranked in descending order of aggregate marks. If candidates have identical marks at the cut-off, the older candidate will receive preference. Where examinations are conducted in multiple sessions, scores will be normalized using the equi-percentile method. A State/UT-wise and category-wise waiting list may also be prepared to fill unoccupied apprenticeship seats.

content_sections.heading: Indian Bank Apprentice Local Language Test 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates must be able to read, write, speak and understand one of the specified local languages of their selected State or Union Territory. The Local Language Proficiency Test will be conducted after the online examination. Candidates who fail to qualify will not be engaged as apprentices. Candidates who provide Class 8, Class 10 or Class 12 marksheets or certificates proving they studied their selected local language are exempt from appearing in the Local Language Proficiency Test. Important: Candidates without the prescribed language-study evidence must qualify in the LLPT. The test will be held at a centre decided by the bank in the relevant State/UT, and candidates must bear their own travel expenses.

content_sections.heading: Indian Bank Apprentice State and District Preference 2026
content_sections.text: Applicants can apply for only one State or Union Territory . During registration, candidates may choose three preferred districts within the selected State/UT. The bank gives the applicant's resident district the first preference in the applicable merit arrangement, while candidates may select two additional neighbouring districts. Important: District preferences do not guarantee posting in a particular branch or district. Indian Bank may allot candidates to any district within their selected State/UT according to availability and operational requirements.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required for Indian Bank Apprentice Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates should keep the following documents and records available for registration, application and subsequent verification, as applicable. Graduation degree certificate and marksheets. Proof showing the graduation result was declared on or before 1 November 2026. Date-of-birth proof. Valid identity proof. NATS 2.0 Enrolment ID. Recent passport-size colour photograph. Scanned signature. Left thumb impression. Handwritten declaration. SC/ST/OBC-NCL/EWS category certificate, if applicable. PwBD disability certificate or UDID card, where applicable. Class 8, 10 or 12 certificate showing study of the selected local language, if claiming LLPT exemption. Other applicable documents requested by the bank during verification. Documents must be uploaded in the prescribed JPG/JPEG format. Candidates must also capture a live photograph through a webcam or mobile phone using the application portal's facility. The handwritten declaration must be written in English on white paper using black ink. It must be written in the candidate's own handwriting and must not be written entirely in capital letters. The official declaration is: Candidates should reproduce the declaration exactly as prescribed in Annexure II of the official notification.

content_sections.heading: Indian Bank Apprentice Exam Centres 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates can indicate their preferred examination centre while applying, subject to the options provided by the application form. However, Indian Bank may allot a different centre according to availability. Requests for examination centre changes will not be entertained. Candidates must bear their own examination-related travel expenses.

content_sections.heading: Indian Bank Apprentice Admit Card 2026
content_sections.text: Indian Bank will issue examination call letters through its official website or other recruitment-related portals identified in the notification. Candidates must download their call letters using the registration number or roll number and the required login credentials. Call letters will not be sent by post. Applicants should regularly check their registered email and the official bank recruitment website for examination updates.

content_sections.heading: Indian Bank Apprentice Certificate and Contract Conditions
content_sections.text: Selected candidates will receive a digital apprenticeship engagement offer through NATS 2.0. The apprenticeship contract is normally for 12 months and terminates automatically after completion of the prescribed training period. Candidates must report at the allotted bank branch or training venue on the specified joining date. Failure to report may lead to termination of the apprenticeship contract. A candidate who voluntarily leaves the training before completing the contract may be required to pay an amount equivalent to one month's stipend, under the notified conditions. Separate provisions apply to termination after securing gainful employment or due to medical grounds. Candidates should read the full contractual conditions before accepting the apprenticeship.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Selection is through a competitive examination of two papers, held online (CBT) or in Offline-OMR mode. Candidates who are not exempt must also qualify in the compulsory Kannada Language Examination. Paper-1 covers the following topics: Current events, general science, geography and social science. History of Indian society and its development; history of India and Karnataka; the Indian Constitution and public administration. Practical knowledge and mental ability (SSLC level). Social and cultural history of Karnataka, and land reforms and social change in Karnataka after independence. Karnataka's economy, its strengths and weaknesses; rural development, Panchayat Raj institutions and rural co-operative institutions. The role of science and technology in effective governance in Karnataka; environmental problems and development of Karnataka; mental ability. Rules for the competitive examination: A minimum of 35 percent marks in the competitive examination is compulsory to qualify. Each question has 4 options. 0.25 mark is deducted for each wrong answer. The OMR sheet has a 5th option for unanswered questions. Five extra minutes are given after the final bell to shade it. If no option is shaded for a question, 0.25 mark is deducted. The Kannada Language Examination is a multiple-choice paper of 150 marks, set to the standard of SSLC first-language Kannada. The minimum qualifying mark is 50. Candidates who are absent or score less than 50 are not eligible for selection. The marks are not counted for selection or seniority. The following candidates are exempt from this examination: Those who studied Kannada as a first or second language in the SSLC examination of the Karnataka Secondary Education Examination Board, or in an equivalent or higher examination. Those who passed such examinations in the Kannada medium. Those who passed the compulsory Kannada examination held earlier by the Commission or another selection authority. Sports achievers will be given weightage marks as specified in Government Notification No. ಸಿಆಸುಇ 295 ಸೇನೆನಿ 2023.
