content_sections.heading: What to Bring
content_sections.text: Duly filled biodata in the application format Annexure-I and Annexure-II, with a photograph affixed on it and signed. The notice says a duly filled application form is compulsory. Self-attested scanned copies (PDF/JPEG) of the relevant documents, as printed in the notice. Original testimonials (date of birth, degree certificate, experience certificate, etc., if any), to be shown, plus a set of attested copies of all certificates for verification at registration and again before joining, if selected. Complete bio data and duly self-attested certificates and mark sheets from class 10th onwards, and experience certificates. A no objection certificate from the current employer, for candidates who are employed. Documentary proof of prior experience, which the Annexure-I form says is mandatory. Annexure-I asks for name in block letters, parent or spouse name, date of birth and age, present and permanent postal address, mobile number, Aadhar number, email, educational qualifications (Matriculation/SSC to Doctorate/Ph.D.), prior experience, additional information, and whether the candidate belongs to SC/ST/OBC/OC/PH/Ex-servicemen. It also asks whether the candidate is willing to be considered for a lower post if the application for the applied post is ineligible or not shortlisted for further scrutiny (Yes/No), and ends with a self declaration. Annexure-II is a declaration that no near or distant relative is an employee of ICAR-IIMR, or, alternatively, a statement of the name, designation and relationship of relatives working in ICAR.

content_sections.heading: What Happens on the Day
content_sections.text: Report at the venue by 10:15 AM; the 15-minute grace period is the only extra time allowed. Submit the filled Annexure-I and Annexure-II and show the originals at registration, along with a set of attested copies. Only candidates having the essential qualifications will be allowed to attend the interview, which starts at 10:30 AM. The notice does not describe marks, shortlisting or the way the interview decides the selection. It says the decision of the Director, ICAR-IIMR is final and binding in all respects.

The recruitment includes Junior Translator (Hindi), Chief Law Assistant, Public Prosecutor, Senior Publicity Inspector, Staff and Welfare Inspector, Scientific Assistant (Training) and Lab Assistant Grade III (Chemist & Metallurgist). Candidates with the prescribed 12th Science, Bachelor's degree, postgraduate degree or professional qualifications ca

application_fee.details: The examination fee is Rs. 500 for most candidates and Rs. 250 for the eligible concession categories. | Fee Payment Last Date: 6 December 2026 at 11:59 PM. | Payment Mode: Internet Banking, Debit Card, Credit Card or UPI. Applicable transaction charges are additional. | Candidates who appear for the Computer Based Test are eligible for a partial or applicable fee refund after deduction of bank charges. | The refund will be credited through the prescribed Aadhaar-seeded bank account mechanism. Candidates who do not appear for the CBT or whose applications are rejected are not entitled to the applicable refund. | Economically Backward Class (EBC) candidates may qualify for examination fee concession where their annual family income is below Rs. 50,000 and they satisfy the documentary requirements. | Economically Weaker Section (EWS) is a separate category used for reservation under applicable Government rules. | Claiming EBC fee concession does not automatically provide EWS reservation or an OBC benefit.

age_limit.details: The minimum age is 18 years for all seven categories. The upper age limit varies between 30 and 40 years, calculated as on 1 January 2027. | Important: When a candidate qualifies for age relaxation under more than one provision, the maximum applicable relaxation is allowed rather than automatically adding different relaxations together. Detailed conditions are given in Section 5.2 of the notification.

qualification.education_qualification: 12th Science / Relevant Degree / Postgraduate or Professional Qualification, Depending on Post
qualification.details: The educational qualification differs substantially across the seven posts. Applicants must meet the specific academic and professional requirements listed in Annexure A by 4 December 2026. | Candidates must possess a university degree in Law and have at least three years of standing practice as a Pleader at Bar. | Serving Railway employees with a Law degree may also apply if they have completed at least five years of service in any branch of Railway Administration, subject to the notification's conditions. | Applicants must have a recognized Bachelor's degree in Law and five years of standing as an Advocate at Bar. | Important: A Law degree alone is not sufficient. The prescribed professional practice requirement must also be satisfied. | Candidates need a recognized university degree together with a Diploma in Public Relations, Advertising, Journalism or Mass Communication from a recognized institution or university. | Two years of experience in a relevant field is desirable, not mandatory. | Junior Translator applicants must satisfy one of the prescribed Master's degree language combinations involving Hindi and English, along with an additional translation qualification or experience. | The academic requirement may be fulfilled through a recognized Master's degree in Hindi or English with the other language as a compulsory/elective subject or medium of examination at degree level, or through the alternative Master's degree language combinations specified in Annexure A. | In addition, candidates must possess either: | A recognized Diploma or Certificate Course in translation from Hindi to English and vice versa; or Two years of translation experience between Hindi and English in Central or State Government offices, including Government of India undertakings. | Important: A general Master's degree or Hindi/English language proficiency alone does not automatically satisfy this post's eligibility conditions. | Applicants must have graduation along with at least one of the following qualifications: | Diploma in Labour or Social Welfare. Diploma in Labour Laws. LLB with papers in Labour Laws. Postgraduate Diploma in Personnel Management. MBA with papers in Personnel Management. MBA in Human Resources. Postgraduate Diploma in Human Resource Management with relevant Personnel Management papers from a Government-recognized institution. | Candidates must possess a Master's degree in Psychology with at least 50% marks in aggregate. | Specialization in Industrial, Organisational or Clinical Psychology; experience in counselling or guidance programmes; and working computer knowledge are desirable qualifications. | Candidates must have passed Class 12 (+2 Stage) or an equivalent examination with Physics and Chemistry as subjects. | This is the only post category in CEN 09/2026 for which the stated essential educational qualification is at the 12th-standard level. | No. Candidates awaiting their final examination results for the prescribed essential qualification are not eligible. The required qualification must have been obtained by 4 December 2026.

qualifications

At least 50% of the questions will assess language proficiency, including approximately 20% English and 30% Hindi. | Remaining questions cover General Knowledge, General Intelligence, Simple Arithmetic and basic computer knowledge. | Important: Translation Test marks are not added to the final merit score. syllabus.details: The CBT includes common subjects and post-specific Professional Ability questions. Detailed professional syllabi are provided in Annexures IX to XV of CEN 09/2026. | Mathematics: Number system, percentages, ratio and proportion, algebra, geometry, mensuration, profit and loss, time and work, time and distance, interest and elementary statistics. Reasoning: Analogies, number series, coding-decoding, syllogism, relationships, Venn diagrams, decision-making, classification, data interpretation and analytical reasoning. General Awareness: Current affairs, Indian history, geography, Constitution, economy, sports, environment and scientific developments. General Science: Physics, Chemistry and Life Sciences up to Class 10 CBSE level. Professional Ability: Questions related to the academic or professional qualification prescribed for the selected post. | Candidates should study the relevant syllabus annexure rather than relying on a generic Railway examination syllabus.

how_to_apply: Visit www.rrbapply.gov.in.
Find the application facility for CEN 09/2026 - Isolated Categories.
If you already created an RRB account for a previous CEN in 2024, 2025 or 2026, log in using the existing account credentials.
New applicants should select Create an Account.
Enter personal details exactly as recorded in the Class 10 certificate or equivalent record.
Provide an active personal email address and mobile number.
Complete account creation and the required verification steps.
Log in and select CEN 09/2026.
Choose one RRB and review the vacancies available under it.
Enter the educational qualifications and professional experience required for the selected posts.
Provide the applicable community, reservation and relaxation details.
Choose the preferred examination language.
Enter the order of preference for eligible posts and Railway Zones or Production Units.
Complete Aadhaar/DigiLocker verification where available and applicable.
Capture a live photograph through the application portal.
Upload the scanned signature according to the prescribed specifications.
Upload other mandatory documents, including the applicable SC/ST certificate when requesting a free railway travel pass.
Preview the application carefully.
Submit the application by 4 December 2026.
Pay the prescribed application fee by 6 December 2026.
Save or print the submitted application and payment acknowledgement.

Important: Only one application is permitted for CEN 09/2026. Submitting multiple applications to different or the same RRB can lead to rejection of all applications and debarment from future Railway recruitment examinations.
important_instructions: RRB CEN 09/2026 announces 191 isolated-category vacancies. Applications are open from 5 November to 4 December 2026. The application fee payment deadline is 6 December 2026. The modification window is 7 to 16 December 2026. Candidates may select only one RRB. Multiple applications can result in rejection and debarment. Educational qualifications must be completed by the application closing date. Candidates awaiting final results are ineligible. Age is calculated as on 1 January 2027. Post-specific medical standards are mandatory. The standard CBT contains 100 questions for 100 marks. Negative marking is one-third of the marks for each wrong answer. Junior Translator candidates must qualify in the additional Translation Test. Exam fee refunds depend on CBT attendance and the notified conditions. Live photo capture is mandatory during application. The scanned signature must meet the prescribed specifications. Official communication will be published through the RRB websites and registered email/mobile channels. All vacancies are provisional and may change.

content_sections.text: The Railway Recruitment Boards have issued the detailed Centralised Employment Notification No. 09/2026 for 191 isolated-category vacancies. The official 59-page PDF provides complete post-wise qualifications, age limits, initial pay, category and RRB-wise vacancies, examination fees, selection procedures, medical standards, CBT syllabus, application instructions and certificate formats. content_sections.heading: RRB Isolated Category Vacancy 2026 - 191 Posts
content_sections.text: CEN 09/2026 announces 191 vacancies across seven categories . Junior Translator (Hindi) has the highest number of vacancies with 79 posts, followed by Lab Assistant Grade III with 36. Important: Candidates must examine the post-wise and Railway Zone/Production Unit-wise vacancy distribution in Annexure B of the detailed notification before selecting an RRB. A chosen RRB may not have vacancies for every post category. The category-wise vacancy distribution is based on Annexure B. Ex-Servicemen and Persons with Benchmark Disabilities reservations are horizontal and included in the notified vacancies wherever applicable. RRB-wise and category-wise vacancies are provisional and may change according to Railway Administration requirements.

content_sections.heading: RRB Isolated Category Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: The educational qualification differs substantially across the seven posts. Applicants must meet the specific academic and professional requirements listed in Annexure A by 4 December 2026 . Candidates must possess a university degree in Law and have at least three years of standing practice as a Pleader at Bar. Serving Railway employees with a Law degree may also apply if they have completed at least five years of service in any branch of Railway Administration, subject to the notification's conditions. Applicants must have a recognized Bachelor's degree in Law and five years of standing as an Advocate at Bar. Important: A Law degree alone is not sufficient. The prescribed professional practice requirement must also be satisfied. Candidates need a recognized university degree together with a Diploma in Public Relations, Advertising, Journalism or Mass Communication from a recognized institution or university. Two years of experience in a relevant field is desirable, not mandatory. Junior Translator applicants must satisfy one of the prescribed Master's degree language combinations involving Hindi and English, along with an additional translation qualification or experience. The academic requirement may be fulfilled through a recognized Master's degree in Hindi or English with the other language as a compulsory/elective subject or medium of examination at degree level, or through the alternative Master's degree language combinations specified in Annexure A. In addition, candidates must possess either: A recognized Diploma or Certificate Course in translation from Hindi to English and vice versa; or Two years of translation experience between Hindi and English in Central or State Government offices, including Government of India undertakings. Important: A general Master's degree or Hindi/English language proficiency alone does not automatically satisfy this post's eligibility conditions. Applicants must have graduation along with at least one of the following qualifications: Diploma in Labour or Social Welfare. Diploma in Labour Laws. LLB with papers in Labour Laws. Postgraduate Diploma in Personnel Management. MBA with papers in Personnel Management. MBA in Human Resources. Postgraduate Diploma in Human Resource Management with relevant Personnel Management papers from a Government-recognized institution. Candidates must possess a Master's degree in Psychology with at least 50% marks in aggregate . Specialization in Industrial, Organisational or Clinical Psychology; experience in counselling or guidance programmes; and working computer knowledge are desirable qualifications. Candidates must have passed Class 12 (+2 Stage) or an equivalent examination with Physics and Chemistry as subjects . This is the only post category in CEN 09/2026 for which the stated essential educational qualification is at the 12th-standard level. content_sections.heading: RRB Isolated Category Salary 2026
content_sections.text: The initial basic pay ranges from Rs. 19,900 to Rs. 44,900 under the 7th Central Pay Commission, depending on the post and pay level. Salary Clarification: The figures are initial basic pay, not monthly take-home salary. Applicable allowances and deductions will be governed by Railway rules and the employee's posting and service conditions.

content_sections.heading: RRB Isolated Category Application Fee 2026
content_sections.text: The examination fee is Rs. 500 for most candidates and Rs. 250 for the eligible concession categories . Fee Payment Last Date: 6 December 2026 at 11:59 PM. Payment Mode: Internet Banking, Debit Card, Credit Card or UPI. Applicable transaction charges are additional. Candidates who appear for the Computer Based Test are eligible for a partial or applicable fee refund after deduction of bank charges. The refund will be credited through the prescribed Aadhaar-seeded bank account mechanism. Candidates who do not appear for the CBT or whose applications are rejected are not entitled to the applicable refund. Economically Backward Class (EBC) candidates may qualify for examination fee concession where their annual family income is below Rs. 50,000 and they satisfy the documentary requirements. Economically Weaker Section (EWS) is a separate category used for reservation under applicable Government rules. Claiming EBC fee concession does not automatically provide EWS reservation or an OBC benefit.

content_sections.heading: RRB Isolated Category Selection Process 2026
content_sections.text: The recruitment involves a single-stage Computer Based Test (CBT) , followed by a Translation Test for Junior Translator candidates, where applicable, and subsequent Document Verification and Medical Examination. Computer Based Test: Eligible candidates appear for the prescribed objective examination. Translation Test: Junior Translator (Hindi) candidates shortlisted from CBT must qualify in the translation test. Document Verification: Candidates are shortlisted according to merit, vacancy availability and applicable reservation rules. Medical Examination: Candidates must meet the medical standards applicable to their selected post. Final Empanelment: Subject to merit, qualifications, medical fitness and successful verification. RRBs reserve the right to conduct additional recruitment stages where necessary under the notification.

content_sections.heading: RRB Isolated Category CBT Exam Pattern 2026
content_sections.text: The standard CBT consists of 100 objective questions carrying 100 marks , with a duration of 90 minutes. Eligible candidates using a scribe receive 120 minutes. The notified subject-wise distribution is indicative and may vary slightly in the actual question paper. These are minimum eligibility percentages, not guaranteed selection cut-offs. A relaxation of two marks may be allowed for PwBD candidates where a shortage exists against reserved PwBD vacancies, as prescribed.

content_sections.heading: RRB Junior Translator Hindi Exam Pattern 2026
content_sections.text: Junior Translator (Hindi) candidates will appear for a specialized CBT followed by a qualifying Translation Test. The CBT is designed to assess knowledge of both Hindi and English. At least 50% of the questions will assess language proficiency, including approximately 20% English and 30% Hindi. Remaining questions cover General Knowledge, General Intelligence, Simple Arithmetic and basic computer knowledge. Important: Translation Test marks are not added to the final merit score. Candidates who fail to obtain 60% in the Translation Test will not be considered for further selection even if they performed well in CBT.

content_sections.heading: RRB Isolated Category Syllabus 2026
content_sections.text: The CBT includes common subjects and post-specific Professional Ability questions. Detailed professional syllabi are provided in Annexures IX to XV of CEN 09/2026. Mathematics: Number system, percentages, ratio and proportion, algebra, geometry, mensuration, profit and loss, time and work, time and distance, interest and elementary statistics. Reasoning: Analogies, number series, coding-decoding, syllogism, relationships, Venn diagrams, decision-making, classification, data interpretation and analytical reasoning. General Awareness: Current affairs, Indian history, geography, Constitution, economy, sports, environment and scientific developments. General Science: Physics, Chemistry and Life Sciences up to Class 10 CBSE level. Professional Ability: Questions related to the academic or professional qualification prescribed for the selected post. Candidates should study the relevant syllabus annexure rather than relying on a generic Railway examination syllabus.

content_sections.heading: RRB Isolated Category Medical Standards 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates must satisfy the medical fitness standards prescribed for their post. Failure to meet the required standard may result in rejection without an alternative appointment. Important: The medical standards include prescribed visual acuity and fitness requirements. Candidates who have undergone LASIK or other refractive surgery should check Annexure VII and the applicable medical conditions before applying.

content_sections.heading: RRB Isolated Category Apply Online 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates can apply for CEN 09/2026 through the official Railway Recruitment Board application portal from 5 November to 4 December 2026 . Apply Online: RRB Recruitment Application Portal Notification Number: CEN 09/2026. Application Last Date: 4 December 2026 at 11:59 PM. Fee Payment Last Date: 6 December 2026 at 11:59 PM. Important: Candidates can choose only one RRB. Once selected, the RRB cannot be changed during the application process or modification window.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply Online for RRB Isolated Category Recruitment 2026?
content_sections.text: Visit www.rrbapply.gov.in . Find the application facility for CEN 09/2026 - Isolated Categories . If you already created an RRB account for a previous CEN in 2024, 2025 or 2026, log in using the existing account credentials. New applicants should select Create an Account. Enter personal details exactly as recorded in the Class 10 certificate or equivalent record. Provide an active personal email address and mobile number. Complete account creation and the required verification steps. Log in and select CEN 09/2026. Choose one RRB and review the vacancies available under it. Enter the educational qualifications and professional experience required for the selected posts. Provide the applicable community, reservation and relaxation details. Choose the preferred examination language. Enter the order of preference for eligible posts and Railway Zones or Production Units. Complete Aadhaar/DigiLocker verification where available and applicable. Capture a live photograph through the application portal. Upload the scanned signature according to the prescribed specifications. Upload other mandatory documents, including the applicable SC/ST certificate when requesting a free railway travel pass. Preview the application carefully. Submit the application by 4 December 2026 . Pay the prescribed application fee by 6 December 2026 . Save or print the submitted application and payment acknowledgement. Important: Only one application is permitted for CEN 09/2026. Submitting multiple applications to different or the same RRB can lead to rejection of all applications and debarment from future Railway recruitment examinations.

content_sections.heading: RRB Isolated Category Photograph and Signature Requirements
content_sections.text: The application system captures a live photograph. Candidates are not required to upload an existing passport-size photograph during registration. Use a computer webcam or mobile front camera. Choose a plain white background. Wear non-white clothing, preferably a plain dark colour. Ensure the entire face is visible and centered. Do not wear spectacles, caps or masks while capturing the photograph. Follow the portal's positioning and lighting instructions. Do not photograph a printed or digital copy of an existing photograph. Important: Blurred, incomplete, incorrectly formatted or non-standard signatures may lead to application rejection. Eligible SC/ST candidates requesting a free railway travel pass must upload their valid category certificate in PDF format, with a file size below 400 KB .

rows.specification: Running Handwriting, Not Capital or Block Letters

content_sections.heading: RRB Isolated Category Application Correction 2026
content_sections.text: The application modification window is scheduled from 7 to 16 December 2026 . The modification facility is available only for permitted application fields. Candidates should verify their permanent account information and RRB choice before submitting the original application.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required for RRB Isolated Category Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates must keep the relevant documents ready for online application and original document verification. Class 10 certificate or equivalent proof of name and date of birth. Class 12 Science certificate and marksheet, where applicable. Degree and postgraduate qualification certificates, where required. Professional diploma or certificate relevant to the selected post. Advocate practice or professional experience certificates, where applicable. Valid photo identification. Scanned signature meeting RRB specifications. SC/ST certificate, where applicable. OBC-NCL certificate in the prescribed Central Government format, where applicable. EWS Income and Asset Certificate, where applicable. EBC income or other prescribed certificate for fee concession, where applicable. PwBD certificate and scribe-related records, where applicable. Ex-Servicemen service documents, where applicable. Minority declaration, where required for fee concession. No Objection Certificate from the current employer, where applicable. Application confirmation and fee payment acknowledgement.

content_sections.heading: RRB Isolated Category Recruitment 2026 Important Instructions
content_sections.text: RRB CEN 09/2026 announces 191 isolated-category vacancies. Applications are open from 5 November to 4 December 2026. The application fee payment deadline is 6 December 2026. The modification window is 7 to 16 December 2026. Candidates may select only one RRB. Multiple applications can result in rejection and debarment. Educational qualifications must be completed by the application closing date. Candidates awaiting final results are ineligible. Age is calculated as on 1 January 2027. Post-specific medical standards are mandatory. The standard CBT contains 100 questions for 100 marks. Negative marking is one-third of the marks for each wrong answer. Junior Translator candidates must qualify in the additional Translation Test. Exam fee refunds depend on CBT attendance and the notified conditions. Live photo capture is mandatory during application. The scanned signature must meet the prescribed specifications. Official communication will be published through the RRB websites and registered email/mobile channels. All vacancies are provisional and may change.

content_sections.heading: About MbPA
content_sections.text: Mumbai Port Authority (MbPA) is a port administration body headed by a Chairperson and a Deputy Chairperson, with its Human Resource Division in the General Administration Department at Port House, Ballard Estate, Mumbai. This notice is issued by its Manager (HR). The Principal Advisor works under the direct supervision and administrative control of the Chairperson/Deputy Chairperson.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: The notice asks for the application in the prescribed format, sent to the address below. Applications are by post or paper submission; the notice names no email address and no online portal for submission. The form asks for name in block letters, gender, communication and permanent address, landline, mobile and email, date of birth and age, nationality, SC/ST/OBC status, marital status, name of father/spouse, qualifications table, employment and experience table, other skills, outstanding achievements, other information, contact details of two references (email and mobile) and enclosures, followed by a signed declaration. A passport size photograph is to be affixed.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: Educational qualification: Bachelor's Degree from a recognized University. Desirable: Master's Degree in Management/ Public Administration/ Engineering/ Maritime Studies or equivalent. Desirable: Training in Port Management, Infrastructure Management or Public Administration. Retired Port/Government/PSU Officer in the level of Head of Department (HoD) or above of a Major Port Authority/Government/PSU. Minimum 25 years' progressively responsible experience in Port Administration, Port Operations, policy formulation, strategic planning, project monitoring or institutional governance. Thorough knowledge of the Major Port Authorities Act, Government Rules, Port Administration, Contract Management, Vigilance, Finance and Human Resource systems. Proven leadership, coordination and decision-making abilities. The upper age limit is 65 years, relaxable as per Board approved Guidelines. The notice does not give the details of the relaxation. The remuneration is consolidated. For a retired Government/Port Officer, the remuneration excluding vehicle transport allowance shall not exceed the last pay drawn minus pension. Age, qualification and experience are reckoned as on the last date of application. Only experience gained after acquiring the essential qualifications is counted. Percentage of marks must be clearly shown in the form; CGPA grades must be converted into percentage as per the criteria of the university or institution. Qualifications must be from recognized Indian Universities approved by the UGC, recognized Indian Institutes or recognized International Universities. Candidates should check the official notification for any further eligibility details.

rows.pay: Rs.1,80,000/- per month plus Transport Allowance of Rs.35,000/- per month

content_sections.heading: MbPA Principal Advisor (Port) Job Description
content_sections.text: Annexure-A says the Principal Advisor shall: Advise the Chairperson on strategic matters relating to Port Management and Operations. Review organizational systems and recommend administrative reforms for improving efficiency and governance. Assist in implementation of Government policies, Board decisions and Ministry directives. Monitor important operational initiatives, modernization projects and institutional reforms. Facilitate coordination amongst various departments for timely execution of strategic assignments. Advise on operational optimization, productivity enhancement and business process improvements. Provide strategic guidance in policy formulation, administrative restructuring and change management. Liaise with the Ministry of Ports, Shipping & Waterways, Major Port Authorities, Government Departments and other external agencies whenever required. Mentor senior officers and assist in capacity building of management personnel. Undertake any other strategic assignment entrusted by the Chairperson/ Dy. Chairperson. Function under the direct supervision and administrative control of the Chairperson/ Dy. Chairperson.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Self-attested copies of documents and certificates relating to age and qualification; the form also asks for self-attested proof of date of birth and self-attested qualification certificates. A "No Objection Certificate" from the employer, for candidates serving in Government/ Semi Government, Public Sector Undertakings/ Autonomous Bodies, at the time of application. Without it, the candidature may not be considered. Necessary documents for any outstanding achievement recognized by a higher authority, if claimed. Details of two reference persons with contact details (email and mobile number). Passport size photograph affixed on the form. Original certificates must be produced for verification at the time of interview.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: The notice says that, depending on the response, the Administration reserves the right to restrict the number of candidates called for a written examination and/or interview. The notice does not describe the syllabus, marks or dates of either stage. No TA/DA is paid for appearing in a written examination or interview, if called. Decisions on eligibility, shortlisting and engagement are final, and no representation will be entertained.

rows.event: Last date for receipt of applications

content_sections.heading: Contract Terms
content_sections.text: The engagement is initially for one year, extendable at the discretion of MbPA with the Chairperson's approval, subject to satisfactory performance review. MbPA will not provide regularization or permanency. Leave: 20 days Casual Leave in a year and Public Holidays. For other absence, pro-rata deduction is made from the consolidated remuneration. Duty hours: 10.00 A.M. to 6.00 P.M. or as decided by the Administration, with a weekly off on Sunday normally. Work beyond normal hours carries no other compensation. Accommodation: MbPA quarters subject to availability. If availed, rent is 10% of consolidated remuneration plus licence fees, with electricity and water charges on actual consumption. Medical: emergency treatment in case of accident on duty at MbPA hospital/dispensary; no other medical facilities for the person or family. Termination: either side can end the contract with one month's written notice. If the person leaves without notice, the pay due is forfeited to the extent of the notice period.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Selected candidates must submit a discharge/relieving letter from their employer at joining; without it they will not be allowed to join. Engagement is subject to medical fitness, service and contract rules of MbPA, and police verification of antecedents. The selected person may not take up any other assignment during the engagement and is governed by the Official Secrets Act, 1923. Records of the assignment must be handed over before the contract expires and before final payment. Canvassing in any form disqualifies the candidate. MbPA may change the number of vacancies or any clause, or cancel the recruitment at any stage, without assigning reasons. Updates and corrigenda appear only on www.mumbaiport.gov.in ; no separate communication is sent to applicants. Legal disputes fall under Mumbai courts only.

content_sections.heading: NICL Graduate Apprentice Vacancy 2026 - 200 Seats
content_sections.text: National Insurance Company Limited has announced 200 apprenticeship training seats across 14 states . Assam has the highest allocation with 30 seats, followed by Gujarat with 22 seats. Vacancy Clarification: The 200 seats are provisional and may increase or decrease according to NICL's requirements. content_sections.heading: NICL Graduate Apprentices Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Candidates must have completed a regular, full-time graduation degree in any discipline from a university or institution recognized by AICTE, DOTE or UGC. They must have passed their qualifying examination and possessed their degree certificate by 1 April 2026. The notification includes graduation qualifications such as B.E., B.Tech., B.A., B.Sc., B.Com., BBA and BCA in its NATS application instructions. Candidates must satisfy the recognition, completion and other eligibility conditions. The official notification specifically excludes the following candidates: Candidates holding a postgraduate degree. Candidates who have completed an integrated postgraduate course. Candidates who graduated from an institution not approved by AICTE, DOTE or UGC, as applicable. Candidates who have previously undergone apprenticeship training with NICL or another organization. Candidates currently undergoing apprenticeship training. Candidates whose previous apprenticeship training was terminated midway. Candidates with one year or more of work experience in a Government, public-sector or private organization as on 1 April 2026. Candidates without a fully completed NATS profile. Candidates who do not meet the prescribed age or graduation completion requirements. No. Candidates who already possess a postgraduate degree or have completed an integrated postgraduate course are expressly excluded under this notification, even if they also hold an eligible Bachelor's degree. Yes. Candidates who completed regular, full-time graduation by 1 April 2026 and meet the other eligibility conditions can apply without prior employment experience. Candidates with one year or more of work experience as on 1 April 2026 are not eligible. Those with less than one year of experience are not excluded by this particular condition but must satisfy all other prescribed requirements.

content_sections.heading: NICL Graduate Apprentice Age Limit 2026
content_sections.text: The age limit is 21 to 30 years as on 1 April 2026 , with applicable upper-age relaxation for eligible reserved categories. Both dates in the notified General/EWS date-of-birth range are inclusive. The applicable relaxation is subject to Government of India guidelines and submission of valid supporting certificates.

content_sections.heading: NICL Graduate Apprentice Stipend 2026
content_sections.text: Selected apprentices will receive a fixed monthly stipend of Rs. 15,000 during the 12-month apprenticeship period. The Government component will be credited directly to the apprentice's bank account through Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT), in accordance with applicable guidelines. Stipend Clarification: The Rs. 15,000 is an apprenticeship stipend, not a permanent employee salary. Apprentices are not entitled to other NICL employee allowances or benefits.

content_sections.heading: NICL Graduate Apprentice Training Duration 2026
content_sections.text: The apprenticeship period is 12 months . Selected candidates will receive practical training at the NICL office allotted within their selected state. Apprentices are entitled to one day of leave for each month of training, credited at the beginning of the following month and subject to prior approval. Unused eligible leave may be carried forward. A maximum of four days of leave may be taken at one time. Unused accumulated leave expires when the contract ends. Approved leave does not result in stipend deduction. Other absences may result in proportionate stipend deductions. No. NICL clearly states that it has no obligation to offer regular employment during or after apprenticeship training. The contract ends after 12 months, and apprentices cannot claim permanent absorption on the basis of completing the programme.

content_sections.heading: NICL Graduate Apprentices Recruitment 2026 Application Fee
content_sections.text: The official six-page notification does not specify an application or examination fee. Candidates should complete their application through the official NATS portal and follow the instructions displayed there. They should not make payments to unverified recruitment agents or intermediaries.

content_sections.heading: NICL Graduate Apprentice Selection Process 2026
content_sections.text: NATS Registration: Candidates register and complete their NATS student profile. Online Application: Eligible candidates apply for the National Insurance Company Limited apprenticeship opportunity. Merit-Based Shortlisting: BOPT (Eastern Region) shortlists candidates using graduation percentage marks. Email Intimation: Shortlisted candidates receive instructions through their registered email address. Document Verification: Candidates appear in person at the designated NICL office with original certificates and self-attested copies. Final Engagement: Selection is subject to eligibility verification, state-wise seat availability and approval of the apprenticeship contract in NATS. NICL will use the percentage of marks obtained in the qualifying graduation examination, calculated up to two decimal places . Where the university awards CGPA, OGPA or GPA, the candidate must convert the score into a percentage using the official conversion formula prescribed by that university. Important: Candidates must enter their graduation percentage in the prescribed NATS profile field. Applications without the percentage information will not be considered. If two or more candidates obtain the same graduation percentage, the older candidate will receive preference in the merit list. No written examination is mentioned in the notification. Shortlisting is based on graduation marks, followed by physical verification of original documents.

content_sections.heading: NICL Graduate Apprentices Apply Online 2026
content_sections.text: Eligible candidates can submit online applications for the 200 NICL Graduate Apprentice seats through the NATS portal from 4 November to 18 November 2026. Apply Online: NATS Apprenticeship Portal Establishment Name: NATIONAL INSURANCE COMPANY LTD NATS Enrollment / Establishment ID: EWBPNC096867 Last Date: 18 November 2026. Candidates must apply specifically against the NICL advertised vacancy. Creating a NATS student account alone is not sufficient.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply Online for NICL Graduate Apprentices Recruitment 2026?
content_sections.text: The application procedure differs slightly for candidates who already have a NATS account and candidates registering for the first time. Visit the official NATS website at nats.education.gov.in . Click Student . Select Regular Student . Choose Student Registration . Complete the registration form with accurate personal, contact and educational details. Complete the NATS enrolment process. Save the generated 12-digit Enrollment Number . Log in and complete all required student profile sections. Ensure the NATS profile reaches 100% completion . Log in to the NATS portal using the registered email ID and password. Open Apply against advertised vacancies . Search for NATIONAL INSURANCE COMPANY LTD . Verify the available apprenticeship opportunity and establishment details. Select the applicable opportunity. Choose the eligible state for apprenticeship engagement. Check that your graduation details and percentage marks are entered correctly. Ensure the required certificates and supporting documents are uploaded in the NATS profile. Click Apply . Confirm that the application status displays Applied . Complete the application before 18 November 2026 . Retain the NATS Enrollment Number and application details. Important: Candidates already registered on NATS do not need to create another student account. They can log in with their existing credentials, complete their profile and apply to the NICL opportunity.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required for NICL Graduate Apprentices Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Applicants must upload the relevant documents clearly in their NATS student profiles. The notification identifies the following records. Applicants must ensure their name, parents' names, Aadhaar number and educational details match their certificates and identity records. The company specifically requires candidates to enter the graduation percentage in the % of marks / CGPAx10 field in the NATS portal. Candidates with CGPA-based results must use their university's prescribed percentage conversion formula. Applications without the graduation percentage will not be considered.

content_sections.heading: NICL Graduate Apprentice Document Verification 2026
content_sections.text: Shortlisted candidates must attend document verification in person at the NICL office assigned to them. The date and location will be communicated through their registered email address. Applicants must carry original certificates and self-attested photocopies supporting their age, educational qualification, identity and other eligibility claims. Travel and Accommodation: NICL will not pay TA/DA for document verification. Boarding and lodging expenses are also not admissible. Being called for document verification does not guarantee final engagement. The company will verify the details entered in NATS against the original records before approving the apprenticeship contract.

content_sections.heading: NICL Graduate Apprentice Reservation Rules 2026
content_sections.text: NICL will follow the applicable reservation guidelines under the Apprentices Act for SC, ST, OBC and PwBD candidates. OBC candidates claiming reservation must possess the prescribed Government of India Non-Creamy Layer certificate. The notification specifies that the certificate must be issued during the period from 1 April 2026 up to the date of engagement , if selected. OBC candidates belonging to the creamy layer are not entitled to OBC reservation benefits and should apply as General or General-PwBD, as applicable.

content_sections.heading: NICL Apprentice Contract and Service Conditions
content_sections.text: Selected candidates must enter into a formal apprenticeship contract with NICL, approved through the NATS portal. Apprentices are trainees and will not be treated as regular employees of NICL. Employee benefits such as PF, ESI and bonus do not apply to this apprenticeship engagement as stated in the notification. The contract normally terminates automatically after 12 months. Misconduct, false information, failure to meet eligibility conditions or prolonged unauthorized absence may lead to earlier termination. If an apprentice remains absent without authorization for more than 15 consecutive business days, NICL may issue a three-day notice by email. If no satisfactory explanation is received, the company may terminate the apprenticeship contract under the notified conditions.

content_sections.heading: About ABV-IIITM Gwalior
content_sections.text: Atal Bihari Vajpayee-Indian Institute of Information Technology and Management Gwalior is an Institute of national importance established by an act of Parliament under the Ministry of Education, Government of India. Its address is Morena Link Road, Gwalior, Madhya Pradesh, India - 474015. Only candidates of Indian nationality may apply, and the notice also encourages candidates from overseas to apply.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: First class means at least a 6.5 CGPA on a 10-point scale or 60% marks at the Bachelor's and Master's level, from a recognized Technical Institute/University. CGPA/percentage relaxation is as per GOI norms. Candidates whose PhD thesis has been submitted may also apply. If selected, they must produce the certificate of award of the PhD before joining the PDF program. At least one degree from graduation onward, or work experience on a regular pay scale/guest faculty, should be from CFTIs (preferably IISc/IITs/IIITs/NITs/IIMs/ISI/IISERs) or a foreign university with QS rank 500 or better (QS rank 500 or below in number). At least 3 publications in SCI/SSCI/SCIE, of which at least one must be indexed in the Q1 journal list as per the latest JCR. Age: at most 35 years at the time of submission of the application form, and the application must be made within 5 years from the date of award of the PhD (defense date). A PhD holder from ABV-IIITM Gwalior can apply for IPDF after 1 year of completion of the PhD defense viva-voce approval date. The notice prints no separate qualification, age limit or pay for EFPDF; the guidelines of the sponsoring agency apply to a candidate admitted under the EFPDF category. The general requirement of a Ph.D. in the relevant discipline with first class in the preceding degrees applies to all candidates. CGPA/CPI to percentage conversion (or the reverse) by the individual Institute/University is allowed for determining eligibility. If the CGPA/CPI is on a scale other than 10 points, a certificate from the authorized signatory (not the Mentor/Supervisor/Head of the Department) of the Institute/University showing first class must be attached, or the CGPA/CPI may be converted to a 10-point scale. Qualifications, experience and age limit are determined on the closing date, that is the last date of submission of the application form. Experience on a part-time or daily-wage basis is not counted for shortlisting.

Eligible to co-guide B.Tech./M.Tech. students in BTP and MTP along with the mentor, with the approval of the DoAA on recommendations from the mentor, HOD and DoRC. content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: A Screening Committee short-lists applicants on set criteria; these norms may not be uniform across departments and bind all applicants. Selection is based on a personal/technical interview before the Selection Committee, with a technical presentation. Meeting the minimum qualification and experience does not entitle a candidate to be called. The Institute reserves the right to restrict the number of candidates called for interview to a reasonable limit, based on qualifications, area of expertise, research outputs and experience higher than those prescribed. An interview invitation only indicates suitability and gives no assurance of selection. The date and time of the interview are informed only through the institute website or email. The Institute holds web interviews for overseas candidates. Originals of all documents and a valid photo ID (Passport/Voter-ID/PAN Card/Aadhar Card/any Government issued ID) with a photocopy must be produced at the technical presentation and interview; without ID proof the candidate is not allowed to attend. Appointment of selected candidates is subject to being found physically fit by a medical examination by the Institute's medical Board/Senior Medical Officer/Medical Officer.

content_sections.text: Family Court, Devbhumi Dwarka is preparing a panel of Counsellors for the Family Courts in Devbhumi Dwarka district, located at Khambhaliya, Okha-Mandal and Kalyanpur. The empanelment is made under the Gujarat Family Court (Amendment) Rules, 2023. The Family Court functions from the New District Court Building, Salaya Road, Khambhaliya.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: An applicant must possess the following qualifications as on the last date of application: Degree of a recognized University, preferably with Social Science or psychology as one of the subjects. Minimum experience of 02 (Two) years in Social Work, Child Psychiatry or Family Counselling. Impeccable integrity. The application form asks for educational qualifications from the Bachelor's degree onwards, with certificates attached, and for experience in the field of social and family welfare with certification as required under Rule 5(B) of the Gujarat Family Court (Amendment) Rules, 2023. Where other things are equal, preference in appointment shall be given to a woman candidate having the requisite qualification. Preference shall also be given to a candidate who has been a Judge or has experience of counselling in family matters. The length of the term is not specified in the notice.

content_sections.heading: Devbhumi Dwarka Family Court Counsellors Job Description
content_sections.text: The Counsellor works in association with the Family Court to promote conciliation and secure speedy settlement of disputes relating to marriage and family affairs and connected matters. The Counsellor shall not act or plead for a party to a case or proceeding, but shall generally assist the Court in reaching a peaceful and amicable settlement of the dispute. A Counsellor entrusted with any petition shall: attend the Court as and when required by the Judge of the Family Court; aid and advise the parties regarding settlement of the subject-matter of dispute or any other part thereof; help the parties in reconciliation; submit a report or interim report, as required by the Court to which he or she is attached; perform such other functions as may be assigned by the Family Court to which he or she is attached, from time to time.

content_sections.text: Applicants must have completed graduation from a Government-recognized university or institution and possess the specified experience as commissioned officers in the Armed Forces or officers in paramilitary forces. content_sections.heading: SBI Security Officer Job Responsibilities
content_sections.text: Selected Manager and Deputy Manager (Security) officers will be responsible for improving security arrangements at SBI branches and offices. Conduct periodic security audits of branches and offices. Review existing security arrangements and recommend improvements. Organize security drills, lectures and employee awareness programmes. Monitor security systems and reduce incidents caused by security lapses. Support implementation of disaster management plans. Visit branches and other administrative units to assess security requirements. Coordinate with civil, military, police and other Government authorities. Perform additional security administration duties assigned by SBI. Selected officers may be posted or transferred to SBI offices anywhere in India according to the Bank's requirements.

content_sections.text: Bank of Baroda has released for recruitment of 837 professionals on fixed-term contractual engagement in the Wealth Management Services Department. The official 24-page notification contains position-wise and category-wise vacancies, age criteria, education and professional certification requirements, work experience, application fees, remuneration provisions, selection procedure, online application instructions and detailed job responsibilities. content_sections.heading: Bank of Baroda Professionals Vacancy 2026 - 837 Posts
content_sections.text: Bank of Baroda has announced 837 contractual positions in its Wealth Management Services Department . Of these, 791 vacancies are for Senior Relationship Manager under the Deputy Manager designation. Vacancy Clarification: Senior Relationship Manager and Deputy Manager refer to the same advertised position and designation in this notification. They are not separate vacancy categories. The 791 openings are included within the total of 837. The notification identifies 35 vacancies under the horizontal reservation provisions for Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD) , including 32 in the Senior Relationship Manager category. The remaining three PwBD provisions are distributed across Group Head and Territory Head positions. The applicable disability categories and post suitability conditions are specified in the official notification. Important: PwBD reservations are horizontal and are included within the advertised 837 vacancies. They must not be added separately to the total. The number of advertised vacancies is provisional and may be revised by the Bank.

content_sections.text: Candidates must possess a graduation degree from a recognized university or institution , along with the required professional certifications and post-qualification experience for their selected position. The minimum relevant experience ranges from three years for Senior Relationship Manager to twelve years for Group Head. Experience must be relevant to the advertised wealth management, investment advisory, portfolio management or financial services responsibilities. Applicants must also satisfy the detailed employer, certification and role-specific requirements in the notification.

content_sections.heading: Bank of Baroda Senior Relationship Manager Recruitment 2026 - 791 Posts
content_sections.text: The Senior Relationship Manager (Deputy Manager) position accounts for 791 of the 837 advertised vacancies. Candidates must be graduates with the prescribed certification and at least three years of relevant post-qualification experience. Candidates must have at least three years of post-qualification experience as a Relationship Manager in Wealth Management, Investment Advisory or Portfolio Management. The experience may be with eligible organizations such as: Public Sector Banks. Private Sector Banks. Foreign Banks. Broking Firms. Securities Firms. Asset Management Companies. Other relevant Financial Services organizations. Important: Experience in a clerical cadre, teaching or training is not counted for determining the prescribed eligibility. The Bank also excludes post-qualification employment periods of less than six months in an organization when calculating experience. The notification lists the following preferred qualifications: Two-year full-time postgraduate degree or diploma in Management. MBA in Finance, Marketing or Banking. Certified Financial Planner (CFP). Chartered Financial Analyst (CFA) or equivalent qualification. NISM XIII and NISM Series XXI-A certifications. Qualification Clarification: An MBA is preferred, not mandatory, for the Senior Relationship Manager position. However, graduation alone is insufficient because the prescribed professional certification and work experience are mandatory. Selected candidates will manage customer relationships, support wealth management business growth and provide appropriate investment solutions to clients. Acquire and manage affluent, High Net Worth Individual (HNI) and other wealth management customers. Build and maintain long-term client relationships. Increase Assets Under Management (AUM) and investment product business. Understand customer financial goals and investment requirements. Promote suitable mutual fund, insurance, portfolio management and other investment products. Conduct customer portfolio reviews and financial planning discussions. Support business development and customer retention. Maintain customer service, documentation and regulatory compliance standards.

content_sections.heading: About NaBFID
content_sections.text: The National Bank for Financing Infrastructure and Development (NaBFID) has been set up under an Act of Parliament, the NaBFID Act, 2021, as the principal entity for infrastructure financing in the country. It is regulated and supervised as an All-India Financial Institution (AIFI) by the Reserve Bank of India (RBI). According to the notice, NaBFID supports infrastructure funding by developing innovative financing instruments, bond and derivatives markets, and data-driven risk management.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: NaBFID accepts applications for this post only by email. The notice states that no other mode of application will be accepted and hard copies are not to be sent. Visit the link given against the job position for the detailed role description. Prepare your CV, including a passport sized photograph. Send the CV by email to [email protected] . Write the subject line strictly as "APPLICATION FOR THE POST OF <Job Code>". The job code printed for this post is NABFID/EVP/16. Make sure the email is received on or before 24 November 2026 by 06:00 pm IST. Candidates should have a valid email ID and keep it active till the declaration of result, as call letters and interview advice will be sent by email.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: Graduate /Postgraduate in any discipline from a recognized University / Institution or a Chartered Account. Preferred: Certification in Financial Risk Management from Global Association of Risk Professionals (GARP) OR Professional Risk Management Certification from PRIMA Institute. Minimum 20 years of experience in financial sector. Of these, 5 years should be in risk management function (in RBI regulated entity). Of these 5 years, 2 years should be at senior management level. Experience in the infrastructure domain will be preferred. The notice invites applications from Indian Citizens. Remuneration will be offered based on qualifications, experience, suitability, last drawn salary and market benchmark, and shall not be a limiting factor for suitable candidates. No fixed amount is printed in the notice. Contractual engagement will be for a period of 5 years, which may be renewed for additional terms at the discretion of the Bank. Location of position: Mumbai. Selected candidates may be posted in the Bank's establishment in Mumbai/New Delhi/Anywhere in India, as per the Bank's discretion and requirement. Engagement of the selected candidate is subject to being declared medically fit as per the requirement of the Bank. Candidates should check the detailed role description linked in the official notification for the full eligibility of the post.

content_sections.heading: NaBFID Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: Responsible for developing and implementing NaBFID's enterprise-wide risk framework. Ensuring that the Bank's portfolio is built within the defined risk parameters. Building appropriate mechanisms to measure risk. Providing advice and structuring risk mitigation into the business operations at NaBFID. A detailed role description is available as a separate document on the NaBFID website, linked from the notice.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: CV including a passport sized photograph (with the email application). No Objection Certificate from the employer at the time of interview, for candidates serving in Govt./Quasi Govt. offices, Public Sector undertakings including Nationalised Banks and Financial Institutions. Details of criminal case(s) pending, if any, at the time of interview. Proper relieving letters from the employer at the time of taking up the appointment, in case of selection.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Applications will be screened and shortlisted on the basis of eligibility and relevant experience, and the requisite number of shortlisted candidates will be called for interview. Screening and shortlisting: based on eligibility and relevant experience. Merely satisfying the eligibility norms does not entitle a candidate to be called for interview. Additional assessment: shortlisted candidates may undergo psychometric tests and/or assessment centre and/or any other selection method deemed suitable by NaBFID, in addition to the personal interview. Personal Interview: conducted by a committee constituted for this purpose. Final selection: made on the basis of eligibility, experience, qualification and performance during the Personal Interview. Selection is solely at the discretion of NaBFID's Selection Committee, and its decision will be final. The intimation or call letter for interview will be sent by email or uploaded to the Bank's website. No hard copy of the interview letter will be shared.

content_sections.heading: About WCD Raigarh Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: The Government of India has started "Mission Shakti", an umbrella scheme for the safety, protection and empowerment of women under the integrated women empowerment programme. Under it, a State Hub for Empowerment of Women (SHEW) has been set up in the state and a District Hub for Empowerment of Women (DHEW) in every district. The two contract posts in Raigarh are for running this Hub for Empowerment of Women, and the eligibility table is given for the district-level hub (DHEW).

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: District Programme Officer, Women and Child Development, District Raigarh (C.G.), PIN 496001 Postal mode: only registered post, speed post or courier. Applications sent any other way are not accepted. Deadline: the application must reach the office by 30.11.2026, till 05:30 office time. Applications received after this date will not be considered. One post, one application: a separate application is required for each post. On the envelope and in the form: write the name of the post applied for; otherwise the application may be rejected. Also on the envelope and in the form: the sender's name and full correspondence address, including email address and mobile number. Enclose a blank self-addressed envelope with a Rs. 10 stamp. Paste a self-attested photograph on the form; certificates and mark sheets must be attested by a gazetted officer or self-attested. The office email printed on the letterhead is [email protected] ; the notice does not ask for applications by email.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: For both posts the notice requires good knowledge of computer and MS Office and the ability to work in computer typing, and a minimum of 03 years' work experience. There will be no relaxation in the essential educational qualification; the minimum experience may be relaxed only in special cases, with the Collector's permission, when suitable applicants are not found. Educational qualification: Graduate degree in Social Work / other social fields. Essential skill: good knowledge of computer and MS Office and ability to work in computer typing. Experience: at least 03 years of gender-related work in government / semi-government institutions, and at least 03 years' experience of women's issues. Desirable: postgraduate degree holders will be preferred; experience of working on computer in English language. Age: not less than 21 years and not more than 45 years as on 01.01.2026. Local residents of Chhattisgarh get age relaxation as per State Government instructions, but the maximum age including all relaxations will not exceed 50 years. Residence: being a resident of Chhattisgarh is not mandatory, but Chhattisgarh residents get preference through 02 bonus marks in the merit. Category: 01 post, Unreserved (UR). Educational qualification: Graduate degree in Computer / IT field. Essential skill: good knowledge of computer and MS Office and ability to work in computer typing. Experience: at least 03 years of work in data management / process documentation, web-based and web-based reporting formats in government / semi-government institutions. Desirable: experience of working on computer in English / Hindi language. Age: not less than 21 years and not more than 35 years as on 01.01.2026. Age relaxation as per State Government instructions applies, but the maximum age including all relaxations will not exceed 45 years. Residence: the candidate must be a native (mool niwasi) of Chhattisgarh; only a residence certificate issued by the competent authority is accepted. Category: 01 post, Scheduled Tribe (ST). Employees of government / semi-government institutions must apply with their employer's No Objection Certificate; otherwise the application will not be considered.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: A merit list is prepared on a marking system, and selection is made through walk-in interview / written and skill test (if necessary). The marks are distributed as follows: If many applications are received, 10 candidates per post will be called for the skill test, according to the merit list based on the marks for essential qualification, experience and Chhattisgarh domicile. content_sections.heading: Terms of Appointment
content_sections.text: Selection is initially on contract / consolidated pay for a maximum of 02 years. After that, the District Collector may extend the contract by 1 year each time, based on work ability, performance, conduct, the department's need and the controlling officer's recommendation; otherwise the appointment ends automatically. The appointment is fully temporary and may be ended without giving a reason; during the contract either side can end it with one month's notice or one month's pay instead. The posts last only as long as the Government of India runs the scheme; the department has no responsibility for the staff after the posts end. Staff are governed by the Chhattisgarh Civil Services (Conduct) Rules, 1965. Leave is as admissible to contract staff under the Chhattisgarh Civil Services (Contract Appointment) Rules, 2012, as amended. Travel allowance as for an equivalent post is payable, after approval, when sent on tour or training. Selected candidates must submit a fitness certificate from the District Medical Board, Raigarh within 1 month; anyone found unfit for government service will have their services terminated.

Collaborate with international banks and financial institutions on tie-up arrangements. Stay up to date on regulatory changes in NRI transactions and compliance requirements. Develop marketing strategies and work with internal teams on sales, trading and other portfolio management. Promote NRI products such as NRE/NRO accounts, remittance services and loans. Take on any other role assigned by the Bank.

content_sections.heading: About GeM
content_sections.text: Government eMarketplace is a Government Company registered under Section 8 of the Companies Act, under the Ministry of Commerce & Industry, Government of India. It is a single digital platform that government departments, organisations and PSUs use to buy goods and services from sellers across India. It covers the whole process, from vendor registration and item selection to delivery and payment.

content_sections.heading: GeM Manager (Buyer Management- MoD and MHA) Vacancy Details 2026
GeM Manager (Buyer Management- MoD and MHA) Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: Eligibility is judged as on the last date for receiving applications, which is 8 November 2026. GeM's selection committee may relax or extend the eligibility criteria and educational qualifications. Essential: Graduate Degree in any discipline from a recognized University Desirable: Post Graduate degree in any discipline from a recognized university Essential: At least 11 years of experience in business development, key account management or a similar role. Preferable: A strong understanding of Government procurement processes. Preferable: Knowledge of GFR, DoE procurement guidelines and the GeM procurement framework. Preferable: Ability to analyse procurement cases and provide practical solutions. Strong people management, relationship management and leadership skills Capability to work in a fast-paced, high-growth environment Result oriented, with a high bias for action and sharp business acumen Empathetic, positive attitude and a desire to help clients progress towards their goals Ability to influence decision making for win-win results High on ownership and self-motivation Knowledge of MS Office (PowerPoint and Excel) Ability to perform data analytics and generate reports using a BI Tool Proficient in handling confidential and restricted communications Ability to analyze tenders and prepare detailed reports Strong verbal and written communication skills Before applying, check the full eligibility for the post in the official notification.

content_sections.heading: Role and Responsibilities
content_sections.text: The Manager is the single point of contact (SPoC) for Defence (MoD) and MHA organisations and their buyers and consignees on GeM. The duties are listed under these heads: Buyer Management: help these organisations get onboarded, build their capacity and use GeM well. Track procurement trends and GeM adoption, and work with the relevant GeM verticals to resolve systemic issues. Procurement and Policy Advisory: examine cases against GFR, GeM GTC, DoE Manuals, DPM and other applicable Government rules. Advise on procurement modes such as Category, Bid, RA, Custom Bid/BOQ and PAC/STE/LTE, and recommend Defence-specific clarifications. Integration and Stakeholder Management: coordinate with MoD and MHA organisations, engage with senior officials, and prepare briefs, presentations, notes, ATRs and inputs for leadership. Procurement Case Examination: handle complex cases involving technical or financial evaluation, RA/L1, MSE/MII, post-bid changes, price matching, quantity distribution, contract amendments or cancellation, and EPBG/performance security. Recommendations must be documented and defensible. Monitoring and Performance Management: track GMV, orders, buyer participation, savings and other KPIs, ministry by ministry. Prepare dashboards, MIS and briefs, and monitor high-value procurements. Policy, Process and System Improvement: work with the Product, Technology, Policy, Category, Legal and other verticals. Support Defence-relevant GeM functions and collect structured feedback from users. Capacity Building and Outreach: run buyer workshops, training programmes, buyer meets and awareness sessions. Write advisories, FAQs and guidance notes, and support Defence-specific campaigns. Issue Resolution and Escalation: act as the escalation point for critical buyer issues, keep records of decisions, and escalate systemic or policy matters with clear recommendations. Key Shared Accountabilities: work with the tech and customer experience teams to communicate MoD and MHA buyer needs, for example integrated payment systems and value-added services.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: GeM may shortlist candidates for an interview. Meeting the minimum eligibility does not guarantee a place on the interview shortlist. GeM will not take part in any correspondence about selection, and its decisions are final in all matters.

content_sections.text: The engagement is contractual, under GeM's Project Management Unit (PMU). The initial period is 5 years. It can be extended depending on performance and GeM's needs. The place of posting is New Delhi.

content_sections.heading: About DCCM Nilgiris
content_sections.text: The District Climate Change Mission (DCCM) is the district-level climate mission of The Nilgiris district in Tamil Nadu, working with the Department of Environment and Climate Change (DoE&CC) of the Tamil Nadu Government at the State level. The Technical Assistant post is being filled under G.O. (2D) No.144, dated 16.09.2026, released by the Department of Environment and Climate Change, Tamil Nadu Government. Its office for applications is at the District Forest Office, Nilgiris Division, Ooty.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: The notice allows two ways to apply. Eligible and interested candidates may send their updated CV/Resume: By email to [email protected] By post to District Climate Change Mission, District Forest Office, Nilgiris Division, Ooty- 643001 The application must be sent on or before 9 November 2026 . The notice does not prescribe an application form, an email subject line or any wording for the envelope. The Tamil version of the notice asks applicants to send the updated Resume/CV with details of their educational qualification and work experience, and names only the email route.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: There is one Technical Assistant post, offered on contract basis. As per the G.O., a job period of 19 months is allotted for the post. Undergraduate Degree in the field of Life Sciences, Environmental Sciences, Ecology, Forestry, Wildlife, Public Policy and Similar Fields. Basic Type Writing skills in both Tamil and English. The Tamil version of the notice also lists basic computer knowledge and skills in MS Word, Excel and PowerPoint as necessary. Experience is not compulsory. Candidates who have work experience for at least one year may be given first priority. Candidates must be residents of the Nilgiris district. A candidate may not exceed the age of 40 while applying for the post of Technical Assistant. The notice does not mention any age relaxation. In addition to the monthly pay, a travel allowance of Rs.25,000 per year is provided. The Tamil version describes this as a travel head for official travel connected with the mission's environment and climate change work, as per Government rules. For the full wording of the eligibility conditions, candidates should check the official notification.

content_sections.heading: DCCM Nilgiris Technical Assistant-1 Job Description
content_sections.text: The notice lists these roles and responsibilities for the Technical Assistant: Promote coordination and synergy among line departments for effective environmental protection and climate action. Coordinate DCCM activities, organize capacity-building programmes and document successful climate initiatives. Act as a link between DoE&CC at the State level and the District Climate Change Mission at district level. Conduct DCCM Meetings once every two months and submit the Minutes of Meeting to the Government through the Director, DoE&CC within 15 days. Review innovation, monitor existing schemes and plan upcoming activities and stakeholder engagement during each meeting. Maintaining Government records. The Tamil version also mentions collecting climate change and environment data, preparing reports, official letters, statistics and PowerPoint presentations, coordinating meetings, trainings, seminars and awareness programmes, and carrying out work assigned by the District Climate Officer/Director.

content_sections.text: Updated CV/Resume Details of educational qualification and work experience (named in the Tamil version of the notice)

The Tamil version lists the same stages, with the written test/interview before the typing test.
