Any appreciation or outstanding work recognised by higher authority. A list of enclosures and a signed declaration that the candidature will not be withdrawn if selected. A passport size photograph affixed to the form.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: There is one post of Senior Deputy Secretary. It is a Class I post filled by selection by merit. The pay scale is Rs. 80000-220000 (pre-revised Rs.32900-58000) (pre-pre-revised 16000-400-20800). The Recruitment Rules state that the qualifications prescribed for direct recruits also apply to absorption. These are: Essential (I): A degree from a recognized University. Essential (II): Twelve years experience in Executive cadre in the field of General Administration, Personnel, Industrial Relations, etc., in an Industrial/ Commercial/Government Undertakings. Desirable: Post graduate degree/diploma in Personnel Management/ Industrial Relations / Social Work/Labour Welfare or allied subjects or degree in Law from a recognized University/Institution. Under the Recruitment Rules, two groups of officers are eligible. The first group covers officers holding the post of Senior Deputy Secretary or Deputy Secretary. It also covers officers in the respective discipline of General Administration Department, such as Chief Public Relation Officer, Deputy Estate Manager, Deputy Chief Law Officer or Personnel Officer. These officers must be in the scale of Rs. 60000-180000 and have 3 years regular service in the grade in a Major Port Authority. The second group (the "OR" option) covers Deputy Secretary and Senior Deputy Secretary in the respective discipline of General Administration Department. These officers need 2 years regular service in the grade. They also need a combined regular service of 7 years in the scales of Rs. 50000-160000 (pre revised Rs.20600-46500) and Rs. 60000-180000 (pre-revised Rs.24900-50500) in the respective discipline of General Administration Department in a Major Port Authority. The Recruitment Rules give an upper age limit of 42 years for direct recruitment. The same Rules say the age limit prescribed for direct recruits does not apply to absorption ("Age: No"). The circular fixes 02/12/2026 as the crucial date for determining eligibility with regard to qualification, experience, age, etc. The period of probation is shown as "Not applicable" in the Recruitment Rules. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of the post.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: The following documents must go in the envelope with the Annexure-II Proforma: Copies of APARs for the last 5 years (2020-2021 to 2024-2025), attested on each page by an officer not below the rank of Dy. HoD. If the APAR for a particular year is not available, the last available APAR may be furnished with a non-availability certificate. A statement showing the year-wise availability of APARs and grading, duly signed by the HoD or Secretary. Attested photocopies of all certificates and proof of educational qualification, and of present and past work experience in the respective post, pay-scale wise. These must be duly verified by the Port while forwarding the application. A No objection certificate from the respective Port. Vigilance and Administrative Clearance of the concerned Port. A certificate from the Head of the Office in the Annexure III proforma. This certificate confirms that the particulars and eligibility are correct and that the qualification and caste certificates have been verified. It also confirms that no disciplinary or vigilance case is pending or contemplated, that the officer's integrity is certified and that no Major/Minor penalty has been imposed in the last 10 years. APAR copies for 2020-21 to 2024-2025 are enclosed with this certificate. A vigilance report in the format prescribed by Ministry of Shipping's letter No.C-31018/5/2020-Vigilance dated 15/02/2022 (Annexure IV), furnished and signed by the CVO or HOD. It covers the positions held in the ten preceding years and whether the officer is on the "Agreed List" or the "List of officers of Doubtful Integrity". It also covers any misconduct allegations, punishments and pending proceedings, actions contemplated, and the annual immovable property return under Rule 18 of the CCS (Conduct) Rules, 1964. An undertaking by the applicant that the candidature will not be withdrawn, if selected. Certification that the veracity of the qualification certificates and the recognition of the degree have been ensured. Two passport size photographs.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: The selection is by merit. Overall grading in the APARs must not be below "Very Good". The Recruitment Rules name the following Departmental Promotion Committee: Chairperson – Chairman Deputy Chairperson – Member Head of Department in charge of the Department in which the vacancy occurs – Member Head of the Department in charge of the Personnel – Member Representative of Scheduled Caste/Scheduled Tribes & Other Backward Class nominated by the Chairperson – Member Ministry's letter No. A-29018/4/2018-PE-I dated 30.05.2022 and 01.06.2022 covers all Dy. HoD level posts. Under that letter, the Appointing Authority and the Disciplinary Authority is the Central Government, i.e. Secretary (PSW). The recommendations of the Service Selection Committee are therefore conveyed to the Ministry for approval before the appointment order is issued.

content_sections.heading: About IRMA
content_sections.text: The Institute of Rural Management Anand (IRMA) describes itself as a premier national institute for postgraduate, doctoral-level and mid-career/in-service education, research and consulting in rural management. Founded in 1979, it aims to promote sustainable rural development through professional management. It now functions under “Tribhuvan” Sahkari University, an Institution of National Importance under the Ministry of Cooperation, Government of India. The Field Investigator / Field Enumerator will work on IRMA's project on sustainable dairy farming and value chain development through Primary Dairy Cooperatives, which studies livelihood diversification strategies for small and marginal dairy farmers in rural Uttar Pradesh, Bihar, Madhya Pradesh and Rajasthan. This recruitment is for field work in Bihar and Madhya Pradesh.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The notice lists the following selection criteria for the Field Investigator / Field Enumerator post: Education (preferred): A candidate with a post-graduate degree in Social Sciences, Rural Management, Agriculture, Dairy Management, Development Studies or allied disciplines will be preferred. Experience (preferred): Relevant field experience, particularly in household surveys, rural fieldwork or working with dairy farmers/cooperatives, will be preferred. Language: The candidate should be fluent in Hindi and English. Skills (desirable): Good communication, coordination and fieldwork skills are desirable. Travel: Candidates should be willing to travel extensively within the assigned districts of Bihar and Madhya Pradesh. The educational qualification and experience are written as preferences, not as compulsory conditions. The notice also says that the Institute reserves the right to relax the prescribed selection criteria in case a suitable candidate is found. The candidate's age should preferably be below 40 years. The notice prints no cut-off date for counting age and lists no category-wise age relaxation. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions of the post.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The selected Field Investigator / Field Enumerator will receive a consolidated remuneration of ₹20,000/- per month (inclusive of all). No separate payment towards any additional allowance shall be admissible unless specifically approved under the project norms. The contract is purely on a temporary basis for two (2) months. No claims can be made about permanent employment, as the post will not turn into a permanent role under any circumstances. The notice states that the contract may be extended based on performance, availability of project funds and requirements, and also states that the contract will automatically conclude upon completion of the two-month period and will not be extended further.

content_sections.heading: IRMA Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: The key duties and responsibilities printed in the notice are: Conduct midline surveys of dairy farming households using structured survey tools. Undertake primary data collection through household surveys, interviews and Focus Group Discussions (FGDs), as required. Coordinate and assist in training and capacity-building programmes conducted under the project. Coordinate with dairy farmers, Primary Dairy Cooperative Societies (PDCS) and other relevant local stakeholders for field activities. Assist in field-level activities and ensure timely and accurate collection of project data. Assist in data verification, documentation and preparation of field reports. Support the research team in other project-related field activities as assigned.

content_sections.heading: About RCF
content_sections.text: Rashtriya Chemicals and Fertilizers Limited (RCF Ltd) is a Government of India Undertaking with its Administrative Building at Chembur, Mumbai. It manufactures and markets Fertilizers and Industrial Chemicals, reports revenues from operation of around Rs. 18690.90 Crores and was given "Navratna" status in August 2023. Its manufacturing units are in Maharashtra at Thal (Dist. Raigad) and at Trombay (Chembur, Mumbai), with a national marketing network.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: The application must be sent by email only to [email protected] . The subject of the email should be: "Post applied for - Advisor – Electrical on contract basis". The notice says applications sent to any other e-mail id will be rejected and a physical form of application will not be accepted. Candidates should have a valid email ID. It cannot be changed after the application is submitted, and all communication about the selection process will be sent to that email address.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: The single post is Advisor – Electrical on contract basis (1 post), advertised for ex-employees of RCF. The eligibility criteria are counted as on 01.11.2026, which the notice names as the cut-off date for determining eligibility. Retirement grade: The applicant should have retired from the post of Chief Manager or above from RCF. Experience: Hands on experience in Maintenance and operations in Electrical department within RCF for not less than 10 years. Educational qualification: The official notification does not specify the minimum educational qualification. Age: The applicant's age shall be below 65 years while applying. A superannuated employee shall be engaged as an Advisor maximum up to the age of 65 years. Candidates should check the official notification for the complete eligibility conditions of the post. An Advisor staying in RCF Township may retain the Township accommodation for a maximum of one month from the last day of the contract and will be charged ALF, water charges and electricity charges etc. as per company rules. In that case the remuneration is 70% of last drawn Basic + DA. Where company quarters are not available at the place of posting but bachelor guest house accommodation is, the guest house will be provided free of charge. Tax on township accommodation and other perquisites, if any, is borne by the Advisor. The payment is subject to TDS. Casual leave accrues at 1 day per month; the Advisor is also eligible for RCF Holidays. Facilities such as medical, TA/DA, Sports Club etc. are given as applicable to the Advisor's last regular employment in RCF. The Advisor will not be eligible for other benefits like PF, Gratuity, Earned Leave, Medical Leave, PRP etc. GST, if applicable, will be paid by RCF under the Reverse Charge Mechanism (RCM), and RCF will avail the Input Tax Credit. The appointment shall be for a period of six months. The appointment can be terminated by giving one month's notice from either side. The appointment will not establish a relationship of employer and employee in any way.

Knowledge of relevant laws Understanding of quasi-judicial procedures Transparency Administrative leadership and decision-making ability An affidavit must accompany the application. It must state that no criminal offence has been registered against the applicant and that no criminal case is pending. Persons in Government or semi-Government service must also state that no disciplinary proceedings are pending or proposed against them. See the official notification for the full eligibility conditions of each post.

Deposited in the Treasury under Head of Account "0070 - Other Administrative Services, 60 - Other Services, 119 - Fines and Penalties under Right to Public Services, (01) Maharashtra Right to Public Services Act, 2015 - Fines and Fees (0070086901)." content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Applications received up to the last date are scrutinised by the Secretary-level Scrutiny Committee constituted under Government Circular No. RTS-1120/CR-55/18 (RWK), dated 23 October 2020. The shortlist prepared by this committee is submitted to the Committee constituted under Section 13(3) of the Act, chaired by the Hon'ble Chief Minister, for the final selection process.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: A State Commissioner holds office for five years from the date of assuming office, or until attaining the age of 65 years, whichever is earlier (Section 14(1) of the Act). A State Commissioner is not eligible for reappointment. Where a Commissioner receives pension or retirement benefits, these are adjusted in accordance with the applicable provisions (Section 14(4) of the Act).

content_sections.heading: About RCF
content_sections.text: RCF Ltd is a Government of India Undertaking and describes itself as a profit-making "Navratna" company that manufactures and markets Fertilizers and Industrial Chemicals, with revenues from operation of around Rs. 18690.90 crores. Its manufacturing units are in Maharashtra, at Thal in Raigad district and at Trombay in Chembur, Mumbai, and it has a National Level Marketing Network. Its administrative office is at Administrative Building, Chembur, Mumbai- 400 074.

content_sections.heading: RCF Assistant Officer Vacancy Details 2026
content_sections.text: The number of vacancies is tentative and may increase or decrease at the discretion of RCF Ltd. A panel of candidates shall also be proposed for unforeseen vacancies arising within one year from the date of empanelment. The approximate gross figure includes Basic pay, VDA (55.7%), Perks (34%) and HRA (30% for class A cities and applicable rates for other cities). HRA will be as per the rules of the company. Initial pay will be fixed at the lowest of the pay in the grade, and no protection of pay is admissible to candidates joining from other PSUs, Central Government or State Government. Ensuring compliance with regulations laid down by PESO, and managing and coordinating the transportation of Ammonium Nitrate (Melt.) Monitoring statutory and regulatory compliance as per PESO guidelines Ensuring accuracy and completeness of all compliance-related documentation Liaison with regulatory authorities for smooth operations Ensuring adherence to prescribed safety standards and transportation norms

rows.pay: Pay scale Rs. 30000 to Rs. 120000; minimum total monthly gross salary approximately Rs. 65,000

content_sections.heading: RCF Assistant Officer Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: The upper age limit is 46 years for the Unreserved category as on 01 August 2026. This cut-off date also applies to the minimum educational qualification and will remain unchanged. Three years Regular and Fulltime Graduate in any discipline from a university recognized by UGC/AICTE. Candidates should have secured minimum 55% in Final Year / aggregate of Last Two Semesters of the graduation degree. Where a CGPA/OGPA grade is awarded, the candidate must obtain the equivalent percentage from the University/Institute and mention it in the application. If no conversion norms exist, the grade will be presumed to be on a 10 points scale. Conversion norms, or proof that there are none, must be produced at the Skill Test. Candidates must have minimum 15 years' relevant post-qualification experience as on 01 August 2026. Training, internship and apprenticeship periods are not counted. Preference will be given to candidates having experience in explosive industry and Ammonium Nitrate compliance. Children/family members of the victims of 1984 riots get an additional concession of 5 years. Reservation and relaxation for SC/ST/OBC (NCL)/EWS/PwBD candidates are as per DPE guidelines. Reserved category candidates applying for a post with no vacancy in their category will be treated as General candidates, and no relaxation in any criteria will apply. See the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of this post.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: For E0 Grade, the selection process comprises a Skill Test, which will be conducted on a suitable earliest date. All eligible candidates will be provisionally called, and documents will be verified before the test. Call letters are intimated by SMS and/or email. A candidate has to secure minimum 60 marks out of 100 to qualify. The test is of qualifying nature (Suitable or Unsuitable for the post). Qualifying alone does not mean selection, because the number of candidates empanelled is limited to the number of vacancies and the waitlist. If candidates secure equal marks, merit is decided in this order: Percentage of marks in the qualifying examination Highest percentage in the SSC examination Date of birth, with the candidate born earlier considered senior A waitlist shall be prepared in the ratio of 1:2, meaning 2 candidates for each selected post. It will be valid for one year. Selection is subject to being declared Medically Fit by the RCF Ltd designated Physician. The examination comprises physical examination, audiometry, electrocardiogram, vision and eye tests, blood and urine pathology, chest X-ray P.A. view, lung function test, height and weight, body mass index and any further examination the RCF Medical Officer recommends. Original documents may be required at this stage for final verification. Outstation candidates will be reimbursed to and fro III tier AC Train or Bus fare (restricted to III tier AC Rail fare) from the nearest railway station of their correspondence address, by the shortest route, on production of receipts. The amount is transferred to a bank account. Candidates declared ineligible or without complete original documents will not be allowed to attend and will not get TA.

content_sections.text: Posting may be at the Trombay or Thal units, Area Offices or All India Marketing Offices of the company throughout India, or at any project site decided by the Management. The job requires working in rotating shifts including night shift, and a high level of physical fitness. Candidates may be posted in any plant or location subject to exigencies of work. Candidates possessing a higher qualification will get no consequential benefits for it later in service. No NOC will be provided to a candidate pursuing a higher qualification at the time of joining.

faq.question: Q1. Can a graduate of any stream apply for this post?
faq.answer: Yes, a three-year regular and fulltime graduate in any discipline can apply, provided the marks are at least 55% and the 15-year experience requirement is met.

faq.question: Q2. Does apprenticeship count towards the 15 years of experience?
faq.answer: No. Training, internship and apprenticeship periods are not counted in the experience required as on 01 August 2026.

faq.question: Q3. Can an SC, ST or OBC candidate apply when the only vacancy is Unreserved?
faq.answer: Yes, reserved category candidates meeting the eligibility criteria may apply for a UR post. They will be treated as General candidates and no relaxation in any criteria will apply.

faq.question: Q4. Do women candidates pay the Rs. 1000 fee?
faq.answer: No. Female candidates are exempt from the fee, along with SC, ST, PwBD and ExSM candidates.

faq.question: Q5. What marks are needed to clear the Skill Test?
faq.answer: A candidate needs minimum 60 out of 100 marks, and the largest share, 70 marks, is for practical job knowledge and handling of the role.

faq.question: Q6. How will I know if I have been called for the Skill Test?
faq.answer: Call letter details come by SMS and/or email, and the Application Numbers of those called are displayed under "HR RECRUITMENT" on the RCF website. If you hear nothing within 90 days from the publication of the advertisement, it may be presumed that you have not been shortlisted.

faq.question: Q7. I work in a PSU. Do I need an NOC?
faq.answer: Yes. Candidates in Central or State Government, Quasi-Government bodies, Public Sector Undertakings or Autonomous Bodies must apply through Proper Channel or produce an NOC at the Skill Test, otherwise they will not be allowed to appear.

faq.question: Q8. Can I change my details after submitting the form?
faq.answer: No. Requests to change the correspondence address, email address, mobile number, category or post will not be entertained, so check everything before pressing "Submit Form".

faq.question: Q9. Which court handles disputes about this recruitment?
faq.answer: The court of jurisdiction for any dispute arising from this recruitment process is at Mumbai only.

content_sections.heading: AIIMS Gorakhpur Project Research Scientist and Project Technical Support Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: Age is counted as on the last date of application, which is 15 November 2026. Essential: Postgraduate degree in Public Health / Biostatistics & Demography / Population Studies / Geography or a relevant discipline from a recognized university, with five years of research experience in a relevant field. Desirable publications: Five original research publications in MEDLINE/PubMed-indexed journals in the relevant area. The journals should be listed in the Science Citation Index (SCI). Desirable experience: Prior experience in community-based studies. Research skills: Advanced data analysis, scientific report writing, manuscript preparation and publication, team management, and field-level data collection, monitoring and supervision. Candidates should be able to coordinate and carry out research activities independently. Leadership skills: Ability to work in a diverse interdisciplinary environment and to guide other team members. Essential: Three-year graduate degree in Public Health / Medical Social Workers (MSWs) / Sociology / Computer Application / Biostatistics or other relevant disciplines from a recognized university. Experience: Three years of post-qualification experience, or a PG in the relevant subject or field. Mandatory: Willingness and ability to travel extensively for field tasks on a regular basis. Desirable: Experience in field data collection related to Health/Population. Experience is counted from the date of completing the minimum essential educational qualification. Candidates already working against regular or permanent posts in Government departments or organisations are not eligible. Candidates employed in Government settings must submit a No Objection Certificate at the interview. Without it, they may not be allowed to appear. Age relaxation is given as per ICMR/Government of India guidelines. SC/ST/OBC relaxation applies only to posts reserved for that category, not to unreserved posts. Relaxation for Ex-servicemen and departmental candidates, including project staff, follows Government of India/ICMR norms. Check the official notification for the full post-wise eligibility before applying.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Document verification: Only candidates found eligible here may take the interview. Written examination: This may be held before the interview if many eligible candidates turn up. Walk-in interview: Held on 16 November 2026 at 9:00 AM at the Department of Community & Family Medicine, Academic Block (MNC building), AIIMS, Gorakhpur. If there are many eligible candidates, the appointing authority may use higher criteria to shortlist candidates for the interview, written test or personal discussion. Meeting the essential qualification does not guarantee shortlisting. The decision of the Screening Committee, Interview Committee or competent authority is final.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: Both positions are purely temporary and contractual and end with the project. They give no right to a regular post, absorption or transfer at AIIMS Gorakhpur, ICMR or any Government body. The first engagement runs up to 31 March 2027. It may be extended until the project ends, depending on funds, performance and approval. The engagement may be ended at any time, without notice, if performance is not satisfactory. Staff will normally work at the study or project site but may be deputed to other sites. Provident Fund, LTC, medical claims and other regular service benefits are not provided. Leave follows ICMR or project rules. Selected candidates must join within 15 days of the result or offer letter. They must also sign the declaration, code of conduct and confidentiality undertaking. The engagement follows the ICMR Extramural Research Grant guidelines.

content_sections.heading: About THSTI
content_sections.text: BRIC-Translational Health Science and Technology Institute is an institute of the Biotechnology Research and Innovation Council, Department of Biotechnology, Ministry of Science & Technology, Govt. of India. It is part of the NCR Biotech Science Cluster in Faridabad, and its mission is to conduct translational research that turns concepts into products to improve human health. These posts are at THSTI's Clinical Development Services Agency (CDSA). CDSA supports not-for-profit preclinical and clinical product development and clinical research carried out by public agencies.

content_sections.heading: THSTI Data Manager and Project Research Scientist-I Vacancy Details 2026
content_sections.text: Both posts are under the project "Sepsis related mortality in neonates in India: A multi-disciplinary, multi-institutional research program for context specific solutions". The notice says the number of vacancies may change, depending on actual requirements at the time of the written test, skill test or interview.

content_sections.heading: THSTI Data Manager and Project Research Scientist-I Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: The age limit for both posts is up to 35 years. The notice states that age, essential qualification and experience are judged as on the closing date of application, which it calls the crucial date. Essential qualification and experience (either one): Master's degree in any field, preferably in science, with 6 years of experience in clinical data management/clinical research/operations/MIS/data analysis/IT/computer science/healthcare field Graduation degree in any field, preferably in science, with 8 years of experience in clinical data management/clinical research/operations/MIS/data analysis/IT/computer science/healthcare field Desirable: Diploma in Clinical research and clinical data management; familiarity with industry-standard CDMS and some programming skills; preparation of Clinical Study Data Management documents. Skills listed: management and leadership skills; IT literacy (Microsoft applications, data visualization and other CDMS applications); experience in handling databases and query management, which the notice lists as a must; an understanding of clinical trials and clinical data management functions, also listed as a must; good communication, negotiation and organisational skills; time management; and the ability to work independently. Essential qualification: Post Graduate Degree, including the integrated PG degrees. Desirable: Postgraduate degree in Clinical Research, Clinical Trials, Epidemiology, Public Health or a related discipline from a recognised university Additional qualification or prior training in Medical Laboratory Technology or a related laboratory discipline Experience in clinical research, preferably involving the collection, processing, storage and transport of biological samples, and the related documentation Experience in preparing SOPs and study workplans, and in coordinating study activities Good Clinical Practice (GCP) certification Skills listed: computer skills in Excel, Word, PowerPoint and Access; documentation, communication and organisational skills; managing several tasks at once; and working both independently and in a team. All qualifications must be from a recognised Board/University. Experience counts only if it was gained after obtaining the minimum educational qualification for the post. THSTI will not answer queries about eligibility. Candidates must check for themselves that they meet the criteria. See the official notification for the full eligibility details of each post.

content_sections.heading: Job Profile
content_sections.text: Prepare Data Management documents: DMP, DVP/Edit Checks Document, Annotated CRF and Data Entry Guideline Quality-check the database design, validation programs, data extract views and final data listings; design CRFs Handle query management, data cleaning, data freezing, data archival and E/SAE reconciliation Work to GCDMP, CDM SOPs and CDISC & SDTM standards; integrate medical dictionaries and do medical coding Prepare interim reports and datasets for analysis with the statistician; create charts and dashboards Use LIMS to track requisitions and specimen status; handle data requests from third parties Protect data security and the confidentiality of participants Develop SOPs, train study staff and supervise data management activities at the clinical site Support the coordination of clinical studies, including ethics and institutional approvals Monitor laboratory processes from sample collection to testing, following SOPs and GCLP principles Develop and maintain protocols, SOPs, CRFs and trial manuals Support trial close-out, including database lock, site close-out and archiving Conduct site monitoring visits from site initiation through close-out Contribute to manuscripts, grant reports and conference presentations Train study teams, and carry out any other project duties the Principal Investigator assigns

Results and notifications will be published only on the THSTI website, and all communication will be by email.

Appointees will have no claim to regularisation of their employment. Where this notification does not cover a matter, the bye-laws of THSTI and Govt. of India rules apply. Canvassing or giving wrong information in any form will lead to disqualification.

Aid and advise the parties on settling the dispute or any part of it, and help them reconcile. Submit a report or interim report when the Court requires one. Perform any other functions the Family Court assigns from time to time.

content_sections.heading: About DSLSA
content_sections.text: The Delhi State Legal Services Authority was set up under the Legal Services Authorities Act, 1987, an Act of Parliament, and works under the administrative control of the High Court of Delhi. Its Central Office is on the 3rd Floor, Rouse Avenue District Court Complex, Pt. Deen Dayal Upadhyaya Marg, New Delhi-110002.

rows.vacancies: 1 (the notice does not print a number)

content_sections.heading: Work Profile
content_sections.text: Analytical study and research for future planning, so that the schemes of NALSA and DSLSA are implemented better. Support and assistance to victims in matters under the Delhi Victim Compensation Scheme in the District Legal Services Authorities. Legal assistance to victims of human trafficking, and looking after their welfare and rehabilitation together with NGOs working in the field. Preparing PowerPoint presentations, flyers, pamphlets, newsletters and information material for awareness and legal literacy programmes.

content_sections.heading: DSLSA Law Clerk-cum-Research Assistant Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: You must not have reached 27 years of age on the last date for receipt of applications, 16 November 2026. You must be a law graduate who passed the LL.B./Law Graduation degree after March 2023, with at least 60% marks. The degree must be from a Law School, College, University or Institution recognised by the Bar Council of India for enrolment as an Advocate. Final-year LL.B. students may also apply. They must show proof of having the law degree at the interview. If they cannot, they may not be called for interview and their application may be rejected. You need good knowledge of MS PowerPoint, Word and Excel. With your application form, you must attach a PowerPoint presentation of at least 15 slides on one of these research topics: Provisions of Legal Services Authorities Act - 1987 Research Methodology Victimology Victim Compensation Rights of under Trial Prisoners Rights of Children Right of Persons of LGBT Community You must meet every eligibility condition on the last date for applications. For the full eligibility conditions of the post, see the official notification.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Candidates are selected on the basis of an interview only. No TA/DA is paid to candidates called for interview.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: Nature of engagement: a full-time job, but purely contractual and temporary. You cannot take up any other profession, service or engagement while you work for DSLSA. Period: the first engagement is for three months. It may be extended from time to time, up to a maximum of one year. Extensions depend on your work assessment, performance and conduct, and on what the Authority needs. No claim to a regular post: the engagement gives no right to a regular appointment or to continue in service at DSLSA. The Authority may end the engagement at any time without giving reasons. Leave: 12 days a year, with no more than 3 days in a calendar month. Leave above these limits is deducted pro rata from your pay. Leave you do not use cannot be carried forward to an extended period or encashed. Notice period: you must give one month's notice before leaving. Otherwise, one month's pay is deducted or recovered. Working hours: you may have to work beyond office hours, and no overtime is paid.

Attach your PowerPoint presentation of at least 15 slides on one of the listed research topics. Submit the form before 5:00 PM on 16 November 2026. Applications sent any other way, such as a hard copy or by e-mail, will be rejected without consideration. Final-year students must bring proof of their law degree to the interview.

content_sections.heading: Duties of the Consultant
content_sections.text: The Consultant will deal with Court Cases, VIP Matters and Finance. The Consultant will also help run the office's day-to-day work across its areas of activity, in line with its mandate.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: The terms follow Department of Expenditure Office Memorandum No. 3-25/2020-E.IIIA dated 09.12.2020. The engagement is purely on contract. It does not count as re-employment. The first term is one year. It may be extended after review, at the sole discretion of the Office or Ministry. The post is full-time. During the contract you may not take any other assignment in a public or private organisation. The place of work is the CRCS office at World Trade Centre, Nauroji Nagar, New Delhi. There is no accommodation and no allowance, including Dearness Allowance, transport, residential accommodation, personal staff, CGHS and medical reimbursement. There is no Provident Fund, pension, insurance or gratuity. Leave is 1.5 days for each completed month. Leave cannot be carried beyond a calendar year, unused leave is not paid for, and no single spell of leave may be longer than three days. The Department can end the engagement at any time without notice or reason. The Consultant can resign by giving 15 days' notice or paying the consultancy fee instead. The Consultant must keep the Department's information confidential, avoid conflicts of interest and keep absolute integrity. The Department may review the Consultant's work at any time. If any information you give turns out to be false, or you hide a material fact, you can be removed from the engagement. The Department is not responsible for any loss, accidental damage or injury that happens during the work, including travel.

Attach a copy of your PPO or Pensioner card. Send the application to Shri Gaurav Bisht, Section Officer (Admn.), O/o CRCS, 9th Floor, Tower-E, World Trade Centre, Nauroji Nagar, New Delhi-110 029. You can send it by Dak, deliver it by hand, or email it to [email protected] . Make sure it reaches the office by 15 November 2026. Name, father's name, date of birth and age Contact details and address for communication Date you joined Government service and date of retirement Post you retired from and the department you retired from Last pay drawn PPO number (attach a copy) Experience details (you may attach a separate sheet) A signed declaration that you accept the general terms and conditions

faq.question: Q1. Who can apply for the CRCS Consultant post?
faq.answer: Retired Central Government employees, and those about to retire, who held a post of at least Assistant Section Officer in the CSS or a Non-CSS cadre.

faq.question: Q2. Is a degree compulsory?
faq.answer: No. Graduation in any discipline from a recognised university is only listed as desirable.

faq.question: Q3. How is the Consultant's pay worked out?
faq.answer: Your pay is your last basic pay minus your pension. It does not change during the contract, and there is no annual increment.

faq.question: Q4. What documents must go with the application?
faq.answer: The filled-in Bio-data form from Annexure-II with a passport-size photo, and a copy of your PPO or Pensioner card.

faq.question: Q5. Where do I send a paper application?
faq.answer: Send it to Shri Gaurav Bisht, Section Officer (Admn.), O/o CRCS, 9th Floor, Tower-E, World Trade Centre, Nauroji Nagar, New Delhi-110 029.

faq.question: Q6. How long is the contract?
faq.answer: The first term is one year. It may be extended after review, at the discretion of the Office or Ministry.

faq.question: Q7. Will I get travel allowance for the interview?
faq.answer: No. No TA/DA is paid for attending the interview or for joining the post.

faq.question: Q8. How much leave does the Consultant get?
faq.answer: You get 1.5 days for each completed month. No single spell of leave can be longer than three days, and unused leave is not paid for.

faq.question: Q9. Can I work somewhere else during the contract?
faq.answer: No. The post is full-time, and you may not take any other assignment in a public or private organisation.

faq.question: Q10. Do I need to live in Delhi?
faq.answer: Candidates should preferably live in Delhi NCR. The work is at the CRCS office in Nauroji Nagar, New Delhi.

content_sections.heading: About IIMB
content_sections.text: The notice describes the Indian Institute of Management Bangalore (IIMB) as a leading management school in Asia. Under the IIM Act of 2017, IIMB is an Institute of National Importance. Its sector is listed as Higher Education. This post sits in the Executive Education (EEP) open programmes team.

content_sections.text: The salary is paid monthly. The final pay depends on the candidate's profile.

rows.pay: ₹7.30 Lakhs per annum (indicative), plus additional benefits

content_sections.heading: Role and Responsibilities
content_sections.text: Open Enrolment programmes are either Short-duration Programmes (SDPs) of 3-6 days or Long-duration Programmes (LDPs) that run over 6 months to 1 year. This is an individual contributor Sales role in a B2C and B2B context. The job is to generate leads (aspirants), engage with them and turn them into paid participants for each cohort. The duties are: Handle all inbound and outbound leads and close each sale when the finalised candidate pays. Follow up with direct aspirants and sponsoring organisations by phone, email and in person. Provide data analytics and feedback on what is and is not working, to fine-tune Digital Marketing campaigns. Understand how social media campaigns are run and what goes into social media posts. Work with the DM team to design marketing collaterals, such as videos, graphic artwork and text for webpages, brochures and testimonials, across different media platforms. At the top end of the role, own the end-to-end Sales and Marketing of the assigned programmes and devise a go-to-market strategy for them. Analyse past data to spot broad trends and build data-driven strategies. Understand similar products in the market. Lead end-to-end execution of the Marketing Plan: campaign planning, analysis, execution, tracking, reporting and troubleshooting. Monitor and optimise campaigns. Work with internal and external stakeholders, such as faculty, other departments, corporate L&D/HR, vendors and the digital marketing team. Create MIS and dashboards for all stakeholders. Give inputs for case studies, brochures and videos for social media and the website.

content_sections.heading: IIMB Open Programmes Marketing – EEP Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: The candidate should be a graduate. At least 3 years of experience in Sales and Marketing in a B2B or B2C environment. An MBA or postgraduate degree in a relevant discipline from a reputed institution. Prior sales experience in the higher education sector (an added advantage). Sales and Marketing skills Influencing and persuasion skills, along with an understanding of competing programmes Analytical, planning, market scanning and market sensing skills Self-motivation and ownership of tasks, with timely completion Excellent oral and written communication across levels of managers and senior leadership Organised and meticulous working, and the ability to multi-task Excellent interpersonal skills with internal and external stakeholders Check the official notification for the full eligibility for this post.

content_sections.heading: About ISTM
content_sections.text: The Institute of Secretariat Training and Management is a Central Training Institute under the Department of Personnel and Training (DoPT), Ministry of Personnel, Public Grievances and Pensions, Government of India. It is an ISO 9001:2015 institution. Its office is in the Administrative Block, JNU Campus (Old), Olof Palme Marg, New Delhi-110067.

content_sections.heading: ISTM Joint Director and Deputy Director Vacancy Details 2026
content_sections.text: The Joint Director post falls vacant from 17 March 2027. The Deputy Director post has been vacant since 1 May 2020. Both posts are classified as General Central Service Group 'A' Gazetted, Non-Ministerial. The selected officer can draw either the pay of the deputation post, or the basic pay drawn in the parent department or cadre plus a training allowance on it. The Government of India sets the training allowance rate from time to time. At present it is 12% of basic pay. Schedule, organise and direct training programmes for supervisory and operating level officers of the Central and State Governments, autonomous bodies and similar organisations. Produce training materials, case studies, practical experiences and similar material. Assist the Director of the Institute in administrative and training matters.

content_sections.heading: ISTM Joint Director and Deputy Director Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: Age limit: For both posts, applicants must not be over fifty-six (56) years of age on the closing date for receipt of applications. Who can apply: Officers under the Central Government who either: hold an analogous post on a regular basis in their parent cadre or department; or have five years' regular service in the grade at Level 11 (Rs. 67700-208700) in the pay matrix, or an equivalent post, in their parent cadre or department. Essential: Bachelor's degree from a recognised University or institute; and Five years' experience in Administrative or Establishment or Financial Matters in ministerial posts of the Government of India. Desirable: Master's degree in Public Administration or Economics from a recognised University or institute. DoPT Certified Master Trainer, or Recognised Trainer, or trained in Direct Trainer Skills (DTS) or Design of Training (DoT) under the Trainers Development Programme (TDP). Experience in one or more of these areas: one year in matters related to training; or one year in an Integrated Finance Division or in Administrative Vigilance at pay level 10 (Rs. 56100-177500) or above; or one year in developing online training modules, instruction design or curriculum design. Who can apply: Officers under the Central Government, State Governments, Union Territory Administrations, Universities, recognised research institutes, public sector undertakings, or autonomous or statutory organisations, who either: hold an analogous post on a regular basis in their parent cadre or department; or have five years' regular service in the grade at Level-10 in the pay matrix, or an equivalent post, in their parent cadre or department. Essential: Desirable: Master's degree in Economics or Business Administration (Finance) from a recognised University or institute. Two years' teaching or training experience in Economic Policy, Financial Management or Planning. DoPT Certified Master Trainer, or recognised Trainer, or trained in Direct Trainer Skills (DTS) or Design of Training (DoT) under the Trainers Development Programme (TDP). Experience in one or more of these areas: one year in training-related matters; two years in Administrative, Establishment or Financial matters at pay level 10 or above; one year in an Integrated Finance Division or in Administrative Vigilance at pay level 10 or above; or one year in developing online training modules, instruction design or curriculum design. content_sections.text: Mira Bhayandar Municipal Corporation is the civic body for Mira Bhayandar in Thane district, Maharashtra. Its Public Health Department works from Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Bhavan, Nagar Bhavan, Mandli Talav, Bhayandar (W). content_sections.heading: MBMC Mammography Technician Vacancy Details 2026
content_sections.text: The honorarium is paid according to biometric attendance. Extra work beyond normal hours is not paid for.

content_sections.heading: MBMC Mammography Technician Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: A degree in the science faculty from a recognised university, with Radiology as a subject. 3 years' experience as a Mammography Technician in a government-recognised hospital. Knowledge of Marathi is required. The application form also has a section for computer qualifications (MSCIT or an equivalent recognised course). Check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions for this post.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: MBMC will check the applications it receives and prepare a draft merit list of eligible candidates. Appointments will be made from this list in order of merit, based on MBMC's needs and the notice's terms and conditions. Selected candidates must report for appointment with their original eligibility and experience documents, a passport-size photograph and one set of self-attested photocopies. MBMC will not write to candidates who are found ineligible.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: The first appointment order will be for six months, on an honorary, purely temporary basis. The selected candidate must join within 3 days of receiving the appointment order. The job requires at least eight hours of duty a day, depending on the hospital's needs. The head of department sets the working hours. Because this is an essential service, extra work may be needed when required. The post is entirely honorary and on contract. It gives no right to claim a permanent post, absorption into MBMC service or the benefits of permanent staff. Candidates also cannot take this claim to court. MBMC may end the appointment without notice. It does not have to give one month's notice. To resign, you must give at least 15 days' written notice. If you do not, that month's honorarium will not be paid. Service can be ended without notice for doubtful integrity, misconduct or improper behaviour, misleading seniors, absence or disobeying orders. It can also be ended at any stage if your work is not satisfactory. The Medical Health Officer or head of department decides what the work involves. The Commissioner may change the number of posts or other details, change the process, or cancel the recruitment at any stage without giving a reason. Your candidature will be cancelled automatically if you are found ineligible or if you use misconduct or pressure at any stage. If you have already been appointed, the appointment will be ended.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for MBMC Mammography Technician Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Download the prescribed application form from the MBMC website . The notice says applications not made on this form within the deadline will not be accepted. Paste a passport-size photograph in the box on the form and sign below it. Fill in your full name in Marathi and in English capital letters. List your educational qualifications from Class 10 upwards, giving percentages only. Do not give grades, SGPA or CGPA. Then add any additional qualifications and your computer qualification. Give details of your experience: the institution, whether it is government, semi-government or private, the period, the total time and why you left. Answer the question on court, criminal or disciplinary cases, list the copies you are attaching, and sign the declaration. Complete and sign the undertaking (हमीपत्र) stating that no criminal case is registered against you. Submit the application by 5.00 pm on 10 November 2026 at: Public Health Department, Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Bhavan, Nagar Bhavan, Mandli Talav, Ground Floor, Bhayandar (W), Tal. Dist. Thane - 401101. Attach self-attested true copies of your mark sheets and certificates as proof of age, educational qualification, marks and experience. Applications will be rejected if candidates are not eligible, if the form is incomplete or wrongly filled, or if these copies are missing. The Public Health Department can be contacted at [email protected] or by phone on 022-28192828 / 28193028.

content_sections.heading: About NHSRC Consultant - Human Resources
content_sections.text: National Health Systems Resource Centre (NHSRC) acts as a technical support institution under the National Health Mission, Ministry of Health & Family Welfare. The organization collaborates closely with MoHFW and States for health systems strengthening, supporting interventions across eight core divisions. Working with a transdisciplinary team at NHSRC provides a unique opportunity to contribute to public health administration, human resources for health, and universal health coverage at scale.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates must meet the essential qualification requirements prescribed by the notification. Only full-time regular bachelor's degrees (minimum 3 years) and full-time regular postgraduate qualifications (minimum 2 years) are considered. Diploma, certificate, executive programmes, and qualifications obtained through distance, online, part-time, or correspondence modes are not considered. Only post-qualification experience is counted. Essential Qualification & Experience: Graduation in any stream along with a regular MBA in Human Resources from a recognized university/institution with a minimum of five (5) years of post-qualification work experience in Recruitment & other HR functions. Desirable Qualifications: Diploma/Certification in Computer Application covering MS Excel, Word, PowerPoint, database management, and Access; Diploma/Certification in Business Management; working experience in Government / Social Sector; knowledge and experience of governmental recruitment, documentation, filing & correspondence process in Human Resource Management; excellent verbal & written communication skills; ability to complete multiple tasks under pressure and be a team player. Formal educational qualifications & experience could be relaxed for suitable candidates.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The fee offered is within the band of Rs. 60,000/- to Rs. 1,20,000/- per month, commensurate with qualification and experience. In addition to remuneration, consultants are entitled to free accidental insurance, subsidized medical insurance, mobile bills reimbursement, laptop reimbursement (as per NHSRC policy), 30 days consolidated leave, fully paid maternity leave (for female consultants) as per Government of India policy, performance-linked increments, and TA/DA and per diem for on-duty visits. The initial contract remains valid until 31st March 2028, with further extension subject to satisfactory performance.

content_sections.text: Indian Institute of Management Kozhikode (भारतीय प्रबंध संस्थान कोषिक्कोड़) is a management institute at IIM Kozhikode Campus P.O., Kunnamangalam, Kozhikode, Kerala State, India – PIN 673570 (Tel: 0495 2809160/ 366). Direct hands-on exposure to at least one such content creation/authoring tool is a must. One or more visual tools such as Adobe Photoshop, Adobe Illustrator, OBS Studio or Adobe Audition. Working knowledge of instructional design (desirable). The ability to keep organised and accurate written and electronic records of all relevant production work. content_sections.heading: IIM Kozhikode Video Editor – Digital Learning Job Description
content_sections.text: According to the notice, the role covers post-production of course content written by faculty, including editing, motion graphics and storyboard development. The aim is to turn raw recordings into polished, learner-ready video modules delivered across Digital Learning platforms. The key responsibilities are: Edit raw faculty recordings into finished, learner-ready video modules, including cuts, pacing, graphics, captions and audio cleanup. Work regularly with faculty, the production team and other stakeholders so that course videos are recorded, edited and ready for delivery across platforms. Develop digital learning materials, including interactive content, animations, illustrations and motion graphics, and support the creation of online simulations and games. Design and create storyboards and post-production media, along with related course elements such as video/audio editing, images and graphics. Handle complete post-production activities, including editing, graphic design, encoding to different online learning platform specifications (e.g., Open edX, Coursera, SWAYAM), tracking/versioning, and sound. Apply Digital Learning's visual and branding standards consistently across all published video content. Coordinate with the Videographer before editing to understand the shoot intent, available takes and continuity notes. Manage version control, review cycles and the incorporation of faculty feedback through to final sign-off. Organise and archive project files, footage and final assets in line with Digital Learning's content management practices. Coordinate with other departments and technical experts, including IT, to resolve technical issues in production and delivery. Analyse requirements and design/modify eLearning modules using authorised tools across Digital Learning platforms. Identify possible improvements and new course development/editing tools to raise production quality.

content_sections.heading: AAI SSCO Consultant Engagement 2026 Remuneration & Allowances
content_sections.text: As per DoPT OM F. No. 3-25/2020-E.IIIA dated 09.12.2020, a fixed monthly remuneration is admissible, arrived at by deducting the basic pension from the pay drawn at the time of retirement. This fixed amount remains unchanged for the entire term of the contract – there is no annual increment or percentage increase during the contract period. HRA: Not admissible. Transport Allowance: A fixed amount for commuting between residence and place of work, not exceeding the rate applicable to the appointee at the time of retirement; this amount also remains unchanged during the appointment. TA/DA on official tour, if any, is admissible as per the consultant’s entitlement at the time of retirement. TDS will be deducted at source from the remuneration.

content_sections.heading: AAI SSCO Consultant Engagement 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: There is no written examination. Only candidates who fulfil the eligibility criteria and are shortlisted will be called for Application Verification followed by an Interview . Final selection is based on merit ranking of the interview alone. The schedule for verification/interview will be intimated to shortlisted candidates only on their registered email ID. No TA/DA will be paid for attending the application verification/interview, for joining the assignment, on its completion, or at any point during the engagement process. Mere submission of an application, or meeting the eligibility criteria, does not entitle a candidate to be called for interview/selection. Prior to commencement of the contract, AAI may require the selected consultant to submit a Medical Fitness Certificate (equivalent to defence medical standards) from a recognized physician, duly certified by the ATS In-Charge of the Joint User Defence Airfield where deployment is likely.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for AAI SSCO Consultant Engagement 2026
content_sections.text: Important: Applications through any mode other than the specified email will NOT be accepted. Ensure the email ID given in the application remains active, as all call letters and further information will be sent by email only.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Duly filled Application Form (Annexure-1), including: name, date of birth, age as on 01.10.2026, father’s name, gender, service branch (Army/Navy/Air Force/Coast Guard), date of joining and date of discharge from the Armed Forces, permanent and correspondence addresses, mobile number and email ID Details of Educational/Professional Qualification – exam/qualification, university/college, month & year of passing, percentage of marks Details of Work Experience – organization/department, designation with level, period (from-to), total experience, nature of work (attach a separate sheet if required) Self-attested copies of all supporting documents substantiating educational qualification and work experience claims A recent photograph, and the candidate’s signature with the declaration on the application form

content_sections.heading: Important Conditions
content_sections.text: Initial engagement is for 1 year only, extendable by 1 more year at a time; the total cumulative period cannot exceed 5 years, and no extension can take the consultant beyond 55 years of age. The engagement is full-time; consultants will not be permitted to take up any other assignment during the engagement period. A formal Contract/Agreement specifying the terms and conditions will be drawn up between the selected consultant and AAI. Consultants will assist and support Air Traffic Control (ATC) operations at the concerned Joint User Defence Airfield, including ATC/SMC operations, watch extension, and other ATC-related activities as assigned by the ATS In-Charge. Leave is allowed at 1.5 days for each completed month of service. Consultants must mark attendance daily at their place of reporting/engagement. Unavailed leave in a calendar year is neither carried forward nor encashed into the next year. Absence beyond admissible leave and notified holidays results in a proportionate deduction from the consultancy remuneration. AAI may terminate the engagement if the consultant remains absent without intimation to the supervisory authority for more than 3 working days. In case of death, injury or illness of the consultant attributable to the performance of services under the contract, AAI shall not be responsible for any compensation. False or insufficient information, or lack of proof to ascertain eligibility, will lead to summary rejection of candidature at any stage, with appropriate action as deemed fit. AAI reserves the right to upgrade the eligibility criteria if a large number of applications are received, and to cancel/modify/withdraw/postpone this engagement notice. AAI may terminate a consultant’s services at any time by giving 1 month’s notice or remuneration/fees in lieu of the notice period, and AAI management’s decision is final. A consultant may similarly seek termination by giving AAI 1 month’s notice or remuneration/fees in lieu.

content_sections.heading: About NMPA
content_sections.text: New Mangalore Port Authority is a port under the Govt. of India (Ministry of Ports, Shipping and Waterways), located at Panambur, Mangalore - 575010. Its letterhead calls it "Fully Solar Powered" and "An ISO 9001:2015, 14001:2015, 45001:2018 & ISPS Compliant Port", and it carries the Sagarmala logo. The office phone numbers printed on the notice are 0824 - 2407341 and 2887399.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The vacancy is open to eligible and willing officers of Major Port Authorities who have the qualifications and experience set out in the Recruitment Rule (RR) in Annexure I. The RR was published in the Gazette of India: Extraordinary. It classes the post as Class-I and as a selection post, with a scale of pay of 10750-300-16750 (pre-revised). The crucial date for deciding eligibility is 20 November 2026 . Under the RR, absorption/deputation will be of officers holding analogous posts, or the post of Asst. Secretary Gr-I in the scale of pay of Rs.9100-15100 with 5 years regular service in the grade, in a Major Port Trust. The RR lists the following qualifications for direct recruitment: Essential (i): A degree from a recognised university. Essential (ii): Five years experience in executive cadre in the field of General Administration, Personnel, Industrial Relations etc. in an Industrial/Commercial/Govt. Undertaking. Desirable: Post Graduate degree/diploma in Personnel Management/Industrial Relations/Social Work/Labour Welfare or allied subjects or degree in Law from a recognised university/institution. According to the RR, the educational qualifications for direct recruits will apply in the case of promotion/absorption/deputation, but the experience for direct recruits will not. The RR prints an upper age limit of 35 years for direct recruitment. It also states that this age limit does not apply in the case of promotion/absorption/deputation. The RR fills the post by promotion. If that fails, the post is filled by absorption/deputation, and if both fail, by direct recruitment. The feeder posts for promotion are Asst. Secretary Gr.I or Hindi Officer in the pay scale of Rs. 9100-15100. The RR gives a period of probation of 2 years. Candidates should check the official notification (Annexure I) for the full eligibility details of the post.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The post is in the scale of pay of Rs.50,000-1,60,000 (Pre to pre revised Rs.10750-16750). Annexure VI sets out the following terms and conditions of deputation at New Mangalore Port Authority: Period of deputation: 3 years, extendable to 4 years. In exceptional circumstances it can be extended to 5 years. The Central Government decides this for a post whose holder is regarded as the Head of Department, and the Chairman decides it for any post below the level of Head of Department. Pay: The employee may choose to have pay fixed in the deputation post under the normal rules. Or the employee may draw the pay of the post held in the parent department plus a deputation allowance, under the conditions as modified from time to time. Dearness allowance: Paid under the rules of the parent department or of NMPA, depending on whether the employee keeps the parent department's scale of pay or draws pay in the Port's scale. Local allowance: If the deputationist chooses the parent department's pay, H.R.A. is payable as per the parent department's rules at the rates applicable to NMPA employees. Joining time pay and transfer T.A.: T.A. and joining time are given both when joining the deputation post and when returning to the parent department, under the Port's rules. The Port bears this cost. Travelling allowance: Travelling allowance for journeys on duty during deputation is regulated under the rules of NMPA. Leave and pension: The leave and pension rules of the parent organisation continue to apply. Provident fund: The employee keeps subscribing to the Provident Fund of the parent organisation. If the deputationist is governed by the Contributory Provident Fund Rules, the Port pays the employer's contribution for the period of deputation. Medical facilities: As available to employees under the rules of the New Mangalore Port. Residential accommodation: If the Port allots accommodation, rent is recovered as per the Rules/Regulations of the New Mangalore Port. Residuary matters: Service conditions not covered above are governed by the rules and orders of the parent Department/Organisation.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in NCH Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 8 vacancies: 3 Deputy Secretary, 1 Deputy Legal Adviser, 1 Under Secretary and 3 Section Officer. All of them are filled by deputation.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date for NCH Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must be sent within 30 days from the date the advertisement is published in the Employment News.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed for the NCH Deputy Legal Adviser post?
faq.answer: The notice requires a bachelor's degree in law with eight years of experience of handling legal and legislative matters, or a Master's degree in law with five years of such experience. It lists this together with condition (a): an analogous post, or five years of regular service in Level 11 with experience of legal and legislative matters.

faq.question: Q4. What qualification is needed for the Deputy Secretary, Under Secretary and Section Officer posts?
faq.answer: Each of these posts asks for a bachelor's degree from a recognised university or institute and five years of experience in Accounts or administration or establishment work in a Government Office, Public Sector Undertaking or Statutory Body. Each also has its own condition (a): an analogous post, or regular service in the feeder level (five years in Level 11, six years in Level 8 or eight years in Level 7 respectively).

faq.answer: The maximum age limit for appointment by deputation is not more than 56 years as on the closing date of receipt of applications.

faq.answer: Deputy Secretary and Deputy Legal Adviser are at Level 12 (Rs.78800-209200/-). Under Secretary is at Level 11 (Rs.67700-208700/-), and Section Officer is at Level 08 (Rs.47600-151100/-).

faq.answer: The period of deputation shall ordinarily not exceed three years. This includes any deputation in another ex-cadre post held immediately before this appointment.

faq.answer: No. Department officers in the feeder category who are in the direct line of promotion are not eligible for appointment by deputation, and deputationists are not eligible for appointment by promotion.

how_to_apply: Get the Bio-data/Curriculum Vitae proforma (Annexure-II) from the circular. The circular says it is available on the website www.censusindia.gov.in.

Write the post you are applying for at the top. Fill in all items, including the eligibility and qualifications of the post set against what you hold (items 5(A) and 5(B)), your employment history and your present pay. Then sign it.
Attach self-attested certificates and documents supporting the qualification and experience you claim, and the certificates listed below.
Have the application certified by your Controlling Officer, and have the Employer/Head of Office/Forwarding Authority/Cadre Controlling Authority complete the certificate at the end of the proforma.

Have the application, in duplicate, forwarded through proper channel to: The Under Secretary, Admin-III Section, Office of the Registrar General & Census Commissioner, India, Ministry of Home Affairs, Janganana Bhawan, 3rd Floor, 2-A Mansingh Road, New Delhi-110011.
Make sure the application reaches within 60 days from the date the circular is published in Rozgar Samachar/Employment News.
Bio-data in duplicate as per the proforma in Annexure-II.
Supporting self-attested certificates/documents in support of the qualification and experience claimed, including supporting documents for items 5(A) and 5(B) of the proforma.
Cadre clearance certificate.
Statement giving the details of major or minor penalties imposed on the officer, if any, during the last ten (10) years.
Vigilance clearance/Integrity Certificate.
Photocopies of APARs for the past five years (2020-21 to 2024-25), attested on each page by an officer not below the level of Under Secretary or equivalent, or the CR Dossiers in original.

The certificate by the Employer/Head of Office/Forwarding Authority/Cadre Controlling Authority. It confirms that the details are correct and that the officer will be relieved immediately if selected. It also certifies that no vigilance or disciplinary case is pending or contemplated, certifies the officer's integrity, and states whether any major or minor penalty was imposed in the last 10 years.
As the proforma's note puts it, documents related to eligibility conditions "such as Bachelor's Degree, Experience Certificate (duly attested) and APARs for the period 2020-21 to 2024-25".

If your organisation does not follow Central Government pay scales: the latest salary slip, showing basic pay with the scale of pay and rate of increment, dearness pay/interim relief/other allowances with break-up, and total emoluments.
Officers already on deputation: the application must be forwarded by the parent cadre/Department along with cadre clearance, vigilance clearance and integrity certificate.
important_instructions: Applications that are incomplete, received after the closing date, or not certified by the forwarding authority will not be entertained. Candidates who apply will not be allowed to withdraw their candidature later. Only officers who can be spared immediately if selected should be forwarded. Applications must be forwarded strictly in line with the circular and its annexures. Pay Band and Grade Pay granted under ACP/MACP are personal to the officer and must not be shown as the pay of the post. Show only the pay of the post held on regular basis, and give ACP/MACP details in the separate table in the proforma. The information in the bio-data and the documents for essential qualification and work experience will be assessed by the Selection Committee at the time of selection. Lending departments must give their specific comments confirming the essential qualification and work experience of the candidate for the post applied for. Supervise Senior Research Officer(s) (Map) and provide technical guidance for Policy and Standards implementation. Coordinate Web/mobile application deployments, manpower allocation, capacity building, technical reviews, and institutional strengthening. Recommend technical standards, SOPs, manuals, and quality assurance protocols for geospatial data related work. Coordinate with Central Ministries, Government bodies, ORGI Divisions and Directorates, on technical and administrative matters. Coordinate with District/Sub-district authorities for collection and verification of administrative boundary and field data. Assist the Research Officer (Map) in technical review and quality assurance of geospatial databases and map products. Validate spatial and attribute data for accuracy and compliance with standards. faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in ORGI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 26 posts: 1 Assistant Registrar General (Map), 12 Research Officer (Map), 3 Research Officer (Drawing), 1 Research Officer (Language)/Linguist and 9 Map Analyst.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for ORGI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must be forwarded within 60 days from the date the circular is published in Rozgar Samachar/Employment News. Applications received after the closing date will not be entertained.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed for ORGI Research Officer (Map)?
faq.answer: Research Officer (Map) needs a Master's Degree in Geography or Applied Geography or Geoinformatics or Remote Sensing and Geographic Information System from a recognised University or institution. Candidates also need three years' work, research or teaching experience in Geographic Information System or Remote Sensing in the field of Geography or Cartography.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for ORGI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for appointment by deputation (including short-term contract) is not exceeding 56 years as on the closing date of receipt of applications.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for ORGI deputation posts?
faq.answer: Assistant Registrar General (Map) is in Level-12 (Rs.78800-209200). The three Research Officer posts are in Level-10 (Rs.56100-177500), and Map Analyst is in Level-8 (Rs.47600-151100). Pay is regulated under DoPT O.M.No.16/8/2009-Estt.(Pay-II) dated 17 June 2010.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for ORGI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the Annexure-II proforma in duplicate, attach the required certificates and have it certified by your Controlling Officer. It must then be forwarded through proper channel to The Under Secretary, Admin-III Section, Office of the Registrar General & Census Commissioner, India, Ministry of Home Affairs, Janganana Bhawan, 3rd Floor, 2-A Mansingh Road, New Delhi-110011.

faq.question: Q7. Can candidates from non-Government organisations apply?
faq.answer: According to the application proforma, only officers under the Central or State Government are eligible for deputation, and candidates of non-Government organisations are eligible only for short-term contract. Officers of Semi Government organisations may apply only for Research Officer (Language)/Linguist.

faq.question: Q8. Is ORGI Recruitment 2026 a permanent job?
faq.answer: No. The posts are filled by deputation (including short term contract), initially for 3 (three) years or until further orders, whichever is earlier.

faq.question: Q9. Which APARs must be enclosed with the ORGI application?
faq.answer: Photocopies of APARs for the past five years (2020-21 to 2024-25) must be enclosed, attested on each page by an officer not below the level of Under Secretary or equivalent.

faq.question: Q10. Can I withdraw my ORGI application after applying?
faq.answer: No. The circular says candidates who apply will not be allowed to withdraw their candidature later.

content_sections.heading: About NDMA Intern
content_sections.text: The National Disaster Management Authority, Government of India, has instituted this exclusive internship program as part of its organizational structure. The initiative aims to engage young talent with various divisions of NDMA and leading organizations of India, providing research support and experiential learning in the domain of disaster management.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: At least ten interns will be inducted during a year across various divisions of NDMA. The engagement is based on the skills and interest areas of the interns across broad thematic verticals, including Governance and Institutional Strengthening for DM, Risk Analysis and Mitigation (Includes loss and damage assessment in the context of disaster vulnerability and resilience), Disaster Management Plans, Community Based Disaster Management, Information Knowledge Management System/s (IKMS) for Disaster Management, School Safety, Urban Risk Management, Disaster Risk Reduction, Climate Change Adaptation, and Risk Insurance in Disaster Management.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates must be Indian nationals enrolled as postgraduate/research students in reputed University/Institute within India or abroad, or have recently graduated with a university degree in concerned subject. Essential Qualification: Be enrolled in postgraduate degree programme in Disaster Management or in an equivalent post graduate degree program such as Development Studies, Economics, Humanities, Sciences, Management, Engineering, Health Studies etc. or have recently graduated with a university degree in concerned subject. If the student pursues a different academic discipline, there should be a clear linkage with disaster management. Desired Qualifications: Excellent computer knowledge (Microsoft Office applications), excellent written and spoken English, and excellent interactive and interpersonal skills, and flexibility to work in a multicultural environment.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The interns will be paid a remuneration of 12,000/- per month. The duration of the internship shall be at least six to eight weeks and not exceeding two months. NDMA will provide working space, internet facility and other necessities deemed fit by the divisional head. The interns will be required to have their own laptops. Internship based out of remote locations/work from home will be considered.

content_sections.heading: NDMA Intern Job Description
content_sections.text: The intern will assist/collate research/analysis in the following fields: SOP and Guidance Notes Project Assignments Research Assignments Training/Capacity Building and Documentation Process Documentation Day to day assignment- On the job training Any other tasks as assigned by the Supervisor
