Upload scanned copies of all the mandatory documents. Please note once the applicant submits the form, they will not be able to edit the same. Multiple submission of any candidate might lead to rejection of application. Application will be considered only when candidates duly complete filling up the form from both the links. In case of any deficiency of any type in the documents, the candidates would automatically stand cancelled any time on finding such a deficiency.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Interested candidates may send the duly filled in internship application form along with a Statement of Purpose and CV through NDMA Jobs. The applications will be reviewed by NDMA Members/Officers to select the interns on the basis of the skills that meet the requirements of the organization. If required, personal interviews will be conducted to ascertain the eligibility and interest of the candidate. Institute/University may recommend their students for internship and send their application.

Member Secretary, NDMA will have the power to relax any of the conditions mentioned above, in respect of any deserving candidate. On successful completion of requisite period, an experience certificate of the internship shall be issued by the Joint Secretary/Advisor of the concerned subject division or the Member’s Office. content_sections.heading: GeM Assistant Risk Officer Job Profile
content_sections.text: The job profile includes working in a dynamic, data-driven work environment involving collaboration with employees from the Government and Private Sector. The role of the Assistant Risk Officer involves identifying, analysing, assessing, and mitigating operational, financial, and strategic risks. The indicative list of responsibilities includes: Assist the Risk/Vigilance Officer in day-to-day preventive, punitive, and participative vigilance functions relating to transactions on the GeM portal. Carry out bid-cycle analysis, short-duration bid analysis, and bid decryption checks to detect cartelisation, price manipulation, bid-rotation, and other irregular bidding patterns. Monitor and analyse participation of suspended, blacklisted, or debarred sellers on the platform, and flag violations or attempts at circumvention for further examination. Undertake seller-profile analytics and buyer/seller behaviour analysis to identify anomalous transaction patterns, unusual pricing, or related-party arrangements warranting scrutiny. Assist in preliminary scrutiny and fact-finding on complaints received through CPGRAMS, CVC, whistle-blower mechanisms, and other channels, and prepare notes for the Risk/Vigilance Officer. Maintain vigilance case records, complaint registers, and trackers, and compile periodic statistical returns for submission to the Risk/Vigilance Officer/CVO. Build and maintain analytical queries, scripts, and dashboards (e.g. Python, SQL, Power BI/Tableau) for continuous, rule-based, and statistical transaction monitoring. Assist in compiling inputs for the Annual Vigilance Report, the Agreed List, the List of Officers of Doubtful Integrity, and other periodic returns required under CVC guidelines. Coordinate with the IT/Product teams for implementation of system-level red flags and preventive vigilance controls on the portal. Any other responsibility as assigned by the Vigilance Officer/Chief Vigilance Officer from time to time.

content_sections.text: The selection process consists of four stages: an Objective Type Test containing multiple-choice questions, a Shorthand (English) Test, a Typing Speed Test on Computer, and an Interview. Stage 1: Objective Type Test (100 marks, 1.5 hours) containing questions on General English, General Knowledge, provisions relating to the Judiciary in the Constitution of India, Supreme Court Rules 2013, and Knowledge of Computer operation. Minimum qualifying marks: 50. Stage 2: Shorthand (English) Test at the speed of 110 words per minute (7 minutes dictation, 45 minutes transcription). Maximum marks: 100, minimum qualifying marks: 50. Stage 3: Typing Speed Test on Computer in English language with minimum speed of 40 w.p.m. (duration: 10 minutes). Maximum marks: 20, minimum qualifying marks: 10. Stage 4: Interview (Maximum marks: 30, minimum qualifying marks: 15).

content_sections.heading: SCI Senior Personal Assistant Exam Pattern 2026
content_sections.text: The scheme of examination for the tests is detailed below: There will be no negative marking in the Objective Type Test. Permissible mistakes for Shorthand Test: 5% of total words dictated. Permissible mistakes for Typing Speed Test: 3% of total words typed.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Officers from the Central Government holding analogous posts on regular basis in the parent cadre/department, or with three years of regular service in the Pay Matrix Level 7 of the 7th Central Pay Commission (Rs. 44,900 – Rs. 1,42,400) or with five years of regular service in the Pay Matrix Level-6 (Rs. 35,400 - Rs. 1,12,400); OR officers from State Government, Public Sector Undertaking, or Autonomous Organisation holding regular posts in corresponding grades with requisite experience. Leave shall be regulated by the Central Civil Services (Leave) Rules, 1972, and DoPT guidelines. In case of appointment from an organisation whose pay structure and/or Dearness Allowance pattern is dissimilar to that in UIDAI, only the pay shall be protected and not the perquisites.

Departmental candidates attach the Head of Office certificate and attested APARs for the last 5 years.

Send the application through proper channel so that it reaches Shri Jainul Abadin, Under Secretary, Homoeopathy Section, Ministry of Ayush, Ayush Bhavan, B-Block, GPO Complex, INA, New Delhi-110023 within 60 days from publication of the advertisement in Employment News/Rozgar Samachar.

application_fee.details: The Processing Fee is non-refundable and is to be paid only in the Online Mode at the Careers Portal. As a separate form is needed for each post, the fee applies to each form.

qualification.details: Other eligibility points printed in the notice: | Applications are invited from Indian nationals, including Overseas Citizens of India (OCI) Cardholders under Section-7A of the Citizenship Act, 1955. Qualifications, experience and other eligibility conditions will be reckoned as on the last date of submission of the Application Form. The relaxation in the percentage of marks will be given as per the rule of the Government of India, wherever applicable. The prescribed qualifications and experience are minimum; holding them alone does not entitle an applicant to be called for interview. For Madrasa background applicants, a certificate equivalent to High School or Graduation will be considered if obtained from Madaris/Institution recognized by the University, wherever applicable. | Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post. | Only persons with a degree of relevant disability of at least 40% may apply for posts earmarked for PwD candidates. They must upload a Disability Certificate on the prescribed Proforma (Appendix-I) issued by the Competent Authority. Applicable categories: (A) Blindness and low vision (VH); (B) Deaf and hard of hearing (HH); (C) Locomotor disability including cerebral palsy, leprosy cured, dwarfism, acid-attack victims and muscular dystrophy (OH); (D) Autism, intellectual disability, specific learning disability and mental illness; (E) Multiple disabilities from amongst persons under clauses (A) to (D) including deaf-blindness. The Proforma/Format at Appendix-1 is available on https://www.amu.ac.in, https://www.amuregistrar.com and https://careers.amuonline.ac.in. content_sections.heading: About NHSRC
content_sections.text: National Health Systems Resource Centre (NHSRC) is based in New Delhi. NHSRC issued this Terms of Reference on behalf of the Ministry of Health & Family Welfare. The post supports CTD in the planning of the NTEP programme and in coordination with donors and States.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: MBA in Healthcare Management / Master's Degree in Public Health (MPH) / PGD in Healthcare Management. Working knowledge of computers. The following are preferred. The notice does not list them as essential requirements. At least five years of experience working with public health programs. Skills in program planning, budgeting, donor relationships, proposal development and project management are an added plus. Knowledge of tuberculosis control is advantageous. The age limit is "Upto 65 years". Candidates must also be ready to travel extensively. The notice does not print an "as on" date for counting age or any age relaxation. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions of the Technical Officer (Planning and Donor Coordination) post.

content_sections.heading: NHSRC Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: The Technical Officer (Planning and Donor Coordination) will have these responsibilities: Provide technical support to CTD in the development and revision of the NTEP program implementation plan. Assist CTD in the development of proposals for bilateral donor agencies. Facilitate CTD interactions with Donors, including Donor reporting, joint Donor missions, Mid-term review, etc. Assist CTD in building the capacity of States in planning and budgeting. Assist CTD in reviewing and advising on budgeted annual action plans from State/UTs, within the context of overall State NHM PIPs. Assist CTD in coordinating with States for PIP/donor related issues, reviews, reporting, etc. Work in collaboration with technical officers of other thematic areas of the program on cross cutting issues. Facilitate change management with respect to the use of ICT and Nikshay tools for data entry, validation and their use for public health action. Any other job assigned as per program need.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for NHSRC Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Go to the NHSRC website, http://nhsrcindia.org . Fill in the online application for the Technical Officer (Planning and Donor Coordination) post correctly. Submit the application in the prescribed online application format. Applications in any other format will not be accepted. Make sure the application is received by 30 November 2026, the last date for receiving applications. The notice does not list the documents to upload, and it does not mention an application fee.

content_sections.text: The post is offered purely on a contractual basis. If the recruitment process includes a written test, the minimum qualifying mark will be 70%. Candidates must be ready to travel extensively.

content_sections.heading: About the Institute
content_sections.text: National Institute of Technology Rourkela is an institute in Rourkela, Odisha. content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Besides the 2 years of relevant experience, applicants need proven experience in at least one of these areas: Campus placement operations at a reputed Institute or University. Recruitment and talent acquisition within a Corporate House or MNC. Manpower development, corporate training and talent management. Working or having experience in IITs/IIMs/IISERs/NITs/CFTIs. Excellent written and verbal communication skills with high proficiency in English, and strong interpersonal skills to build rapport with students, corporate recruiters, faculties and executives from national and international organizations. Proven competencies in office planning, organizing and team management; strong quantitative and analytical skills with a solid understanding of data analysis and management. Ability to build and maintain strategic relations with public/private sectors and State and National government bodies. Proficiency in maintaining database, Open AI tools, social media, data management and report generation, with updated knowledge of standard computer applications (MS Windows, word processing, spreadsheets, presentations). Experience with ERP portals or similar data management tools that handle campus placements. The notice says "preferably below 45 years as on the last date of application". content_sections.heading: NIT Rourkela Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: Look after the training and placement activities and internship of the students. Oversee the end-to-end placement process, including candidate sourcing, screening, job offers and on boarding. Generate regular reports and analytics to track placement metrics, identify trends and evaluate program effectiveness. Monitor post-placement feedback and promptly address issues or concerns raised by employers or participants. Keep close liaison with industry, Government and non-Government organizations for placement of students. Work with the Coordinators for Industry–Institute Interaction to organize lectures, expert talks and interactive sessions by industry professionals. Guide students for competitive examinations such as TOEFL, GRE, GATE, CAT, etc. Arrange and organize study tours of the students. Accompany and provide facilities, including hospitality, to the HR Team of the companies during campus placement drives. Arrange training programmes for soft skills and interview facing skills using institutional and external expertise. Organize entrepreneurship workshops, hackathons, etc. Create a database on Alumni and their present position. Develop a database on placement records of graduated students and a database of recruiting industries and organizations. Support activity in branding and promotional activities. Willingness to travel occasionally for placement-related meetings, employer visits or recruitment events, and readiness to work in flexible office timing. Any other duties assigned from time to time by Head, CDC or Competent Authorities.

basic_details.job_title: IIT Hyderabad Project Research Scientist III Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: Indian Institute of Technology Hyderabad is hiring one Project Research Scientist- III (Medical) on a Wellcome Trust project, "Validation of a Translatable Chronobiological Signature of Early Relapse in Bipolar Disorder". The post is purely temporary for 5 months and pays INR 93,000/- + 27% HRA. The essential qualification is MBBS with an MD (or MBBS with MPH/PhD), plus 3 years of post-qualification experience. Indian nationals can apply through a Google form by 22 November 2026.

how_to_apply: Check that you meet the qualification, experience and age conditions above.
Fill in the Google form at https://forms.gle/wL8bYWADqPh9ZrTy6 by 22 November 2026.
Complete every part of the form, because incomplete applications will not be evaluated.
Send queries to Dr. Sandipan Ray at [email protected] (Department of Biotechnology).
The notice does not name any documents to attach.
important_instructions: Incomplete applications will not be evaluated. The posting is at a clinical study site at New Delhi. The appointment is purely temporary, for 5 months.

content_sections.text: The notice is issued by Indian Institute of Technology Hyderabad and is dated 06-11-2026. It advertises a project post funded by the Wellcome Trust. Queries go to Dr. Sandipan Ray at the Department of Biotechnology.

content_sections.text: Only Indian nationals can apply. The notice asks for applicants with an excellent academic and research background. The notice says candidates with prior experience in the following areas will be given preference: MD in Psychiatry with experience in mental health research with scientific publications in standard psychiatry-related journals Experience in clinical projects involving human subjects with mental disorders Experience in circadian biology and sleep research Age limit: not more than 45 years as on the last day of application. Relaxations for SC/ST/OBC are as per standard government norms.

content_sections.text: The remuneration is INR 93,000/- + 27% HRA. The appointment will be on a purely temporary basis for 5 months, starting as soon as possible. The Principal Investigator (PI) reserves the right to leave the position vacant if no suitable candidate is found.

content_sections.heading: IIT Hyderabad Project Research Scientist- III (Medical) Job Description
content_sections.text: Screening and recruitment of subjects at a clinical study site at New Delhi Structured interviews of mental health patients (Bipolar Disorder) Actigraphy measurements for Rest-activity rhythms (RARs), Isolation of mononuclear cells from peripheral blood Data analysis, presentation of work, and manuscript writing Any other work related to the project or as assigned by the PI

The notice does not name any documents to attach.

content_sections.text: Candidates will be shortlisted for the interview based on their academic records and relevant work experience. Only shortlisted candidates will be notified by email about the online interview. Meeting the eligibility criteria does not guarantee a call for an interview. content_sections.heading: Posts and Eligibility
content_sections.text: All four posts are Post Graduate Teacher (PGT) posts, one per subject, all in English medium and all on the same fixed remuneration. A candidate must meet one of the two qualification routes printed in the notice: Post Graduate from recognized University in respective subject with at least 50% marks and Bachelor of Education (B.Ed.) from National Council for Teacher Education (NCTE) recognized institution; or Post Graduate with at least 50% marks from recognized University in respective subject and B.A.Ed. / B.Sc.Ed. from any National Council for Teacher Education (NCTE) recognized institution. Medium condition: for medium-specific teachers, the medium of study in SSC should be the same as the medium in which the candidate is applying. The notice adds that this is not applicable for language subjects such as Gujarati, Marathi, Hindi and English. All four posts in this notice are English medium. The age limit is not exceeding 30 years. The upper age limit is relaxable as per Orders/Guidelines issued by the Central Government from time to time. The notice does not print a cut-off date for counting age; the application form asks for age in years, months and days "as on last date of Application". Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility of each subject.

content_sections.heading: What to Bring
content_sections.text: The application in the prescribed format (the form on pages 3 and 4 of the notice), with the post and subject ticked and a self-attested recent passport size photograph pasted on it. The signed declaration printed with the form. Self-attested copies of all relevant documents/certificates. Supporting documents named on the form: Leaving Certificate, Caste Certificate, SSC, HSC, Graduation, Post Graduation, Professional qualification and Experience Certificate. Original documents, which must be produced for verification at the time of interview. The application form asks for name, father's name, residential address, mobile number, email ID, date of birth, gender, caste category (SC/ST/OBC/Un-reserved), whether the candidate belongs to the Physically Handicapped or another special category, marital status, domicile of DNH/Daman/Diu, medium of study in SSC, education details (SSC, HSC, Graduation, Post Graduation, B.Ed. with board/university, year, marks and percentage), experience and any other achievements related to the post.

content_sections.heading: What Happens on the Day
content_sections.text: Selection on 25 November 2026 has two stages: Written Test – conducted for PGTs on the same day, before the interview. Interview – only candidates securing a minimum of 40% marks in the written test are eligible for the interview. Original documents are verified at the time of the interview.

content_sections.heading: About Nalanda University
content_sections.text: Nalanda University, Rajgir is described in the notice as an avant-garde "International" University, designated as an institution of "National Importance" and established by an Act of the Indian Parliament (Nalanda University Act, 2010) under the aegis of the Ministry of External Affairs, GOI. content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The notice announces 2 posts in total, one for each position. It gives no category-wise break-up.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Applicants must be citizens of India. The qualifications and experience below are the minimum requirements, and meeting them does not entitle a candidate to be called for an interview. Preferred: Master's degree in Physical Education (M.P.Ed.), Sports Science, Sports Management, Physical Education & Sports, or an equivalent relevant discipline from a recognized institution. Experience: minimum 5 years of relevant experience in university/college sports, sports administration, facility management, coaching, sports academy operations or a comparable environment. Recognised coaching certification/diploma from SAI/NSNIS, National Sports Federation or another recognised institution will be an advantage. Demonstrated coaching expertise in at least one recognised sport is desirable. Participation/coaching experience at University, State, National or International level will be an added advantage. Experience in managing sports facilities, organising tournaments, handling equipment/inventory and developing student teams will be strongly preferred. Desired competencies: hands-on, energetic and student-oriented, with strong leadership, coaching, planning and execution capabilities. The role requires regular on-field presence and willingness to work during early mornings, evenings and weekends, depending on training and competition schedules. Experience: minimum 3 years of relevant experience as a Gym Instructor, Fitness Trainer, Personal Trainer or Strength & Conditioning Trainer or Physical education & Health Teacher. Prior experience working in a University, educational institution, sports centre, fitness centre or professional gym will be an advantage. The notice also lists "Certification in sports and sporty injury" under experience. Desired skills: sound knowledge of fitness training, strength and conditioning, gym equipment, exercise techniques and safety protocols; strong communication and interpersonal skills; comfortable working closely with students. The ideal candidate should be energetic, disciplined, approachable and hands-on, with a strong commitment to promoting fitness and well-being within the University community. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post.

content_sections.heading: Nalanda University Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: Sports Infrastructure & Facilities: oversee the day-to-day functioning, utilisation and upkeep of playgrounds, courts, gymnasium, indoor/outdoor sports facilities and equipment; coordinate maintenance, repairs and infrastructure upgrades. Sports Planning & Execution: develop and execute the University's annual sports calendar, including regular activities, tournaments, leagues, annual sports meets, fitness initiatives and recreational programmes. Coaching & Student Development: conduct/supervise regular coaching and practice sessions, identify sporting talent, mentor students, develop University teams and prepare students for competitive events. Competitions & Events: organise intra-University and inter-university competitions and coordinate team selection, registrations, equipment, travel and other logistics. Sports Administration: maintain records of facilities, equipment, inventory, student participation and achievements; support procurement and budget planning; prepare periodic reports. Team & Stakeholder Coordination: coordinate with coaches, trainers, ground staff and relevant University departments for smooth and safe conduct of all sporting activities. Student Engagement & Sports Culture: drive participation across the student community while promoting fitness, teamwork, discipline, sportsmanship and competitive excellence. Supervise the day-to-day functioning of the women's gymnasium, games and physical education, and ensure a safe, disciplined and welcoming fitness environment. Conduct regular fitness, strength, conditioning, mobility and general exercise sessions for students. Guide users on the correct and safe use of gym equipment, exercise techniques and appropriate workout routines. Develop basic individual and group fitness programmes based on fitness levels and goals. Monitor students during workouts and provide guidance on posture, form, warm-up, cool-down and injury prevention. Conduct basic fitness assessments and track progress, wherever required. Ensure gym equipment is properly used, maintained and stored; promptly report maintenance or safety concerns. Maintain required records related to gym usage, equipment and activities. Support the University in organising fitness challenges, wellness activities, sports camps and related student-engagement initiatives. Ensure adherence to University rules, gym timings, safety standards and hygiene protocols.

The engagement is purely temporary and contractual. It is co-terminus with the tenure of the project or 06 years, whichever is earlier. It is initially up to 30 November 2026, extendable up to November 2027, subject to availability of fund and requirement. It may be extended or curtailed based on the conduct and performance of the incumbent and the requirement of the institute, and may be extended further on the recommendation of the Review Committee. If there are a large number of applications, the committee may shortlist by percentage of marks in the essential qualification, higher educational qualifications than the minimum, desirable qualification/experience, or any other methodology it deems fit. Based on interview performance, the result of selected candidates for each post code is declared and posted on the CFTRI website. Selection for engagement, the panel of waitlisted candidates and its validity are as per CSIR rules vide OM No. 5-1(342)/2017-PD dated 02.09.2024, amended from time to time. No TA/DA is given for attending the interview. The notice does not give the interview date or venue.

content_sections.heading: NIFTEM-Kundli Senior Research Fellow (SRF) Job Description
content_sections.text: Product Development and Characterisation: prepare composite flours and food prototypes with partially hydrolysed guar gum; conduct physicochemical and nutritional analyses. Analytical Techniques: perform laboratory characterisation using FTIR, DSC, GPC, solubility/viscosity tests, fibre content and prebiotic index evaluation. Shelf-life and Sensory Studies: conduct texture analysis, sensory evaluation (hedonic scale) and monitor shelf-life under ambient and accelerated conditions. In Vitro and Ex Vivo Assays: carry out enzyme inhibition assays, glycaemic index evaluation, cell culture studies (glucose uptake, insulin signalling, antioxidant activity) and intestinal loop/everted sac models. In Vivo Animal Studies: induction of diabetes in animal models, monitoring metabolic parameters (blood glucose, insulin, lipid profile, HbA1c), and assisting in histological and biochemical analyses. Documentation and Reporting: maintain detailed records of experiments, prepare data reports, and contribute to publications and project deliverables.

Its address is Canal Road, Jammu, Jammu & Kashmir - 180001. The posts are project-based, purely temporary, and tenable at CSIR-IIIM, Jammu.

content_sections.text: The notice advertises 2 posts in total, one position for each post code. The notice says the number of positions may vary depending on project requirements at the time of interview. It gives no category-wise break-up.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates with prior experience working in BSL-3 laboratories and handling BSL-2 and BSL-3 pathogens will be preferred. Those with experience in microbiology, molecular biology or related disciplines will also be preferred, along with expertise in drug efficacy and cytotoxicity assessment using ex vivo and in vivo models, and familiarity with enzymatic assays, gene expression profiling and target validation techniques, as demonstrated by peer-reviewed publications. Candidates with PhD in Biotechnology/Microbiology/Pharmaceutical Sciences/Zoology from a recognized university or equivalent would be preferred. Candidates with previous experience in multistep organic synthesis, structural optimization, molecular modelling, pharmacokinetic profiling, AI modelling and scientific writing, as evidenced by peer-reviewed publications, will be preferred. Candidates with PhD in Chemistry from a recognized university or equivalent would be preferred. The upper age limit is 35 years for both posts. Age is reckoned as on the last date of application. content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: Both posts carry monthly emoluments of ₹56,000/- plus HRA. HRA is payable only if institutional accommodation is not availed or provided. The engagement is initially for one year or until the project duration, whichever is earlier. It may be extended or curtailed depending on the project duration, requirements and the performance or conduct of the incumbent. The current duration of the project is up to 21.05.2028. The tenure is co-terminus with the project. The total tenure cannot exceed five years, including engagement in all CSIR labs. Performance is reviewed periodically, and unsatisfactory performance may lead to termination without any notice or reason. The posts are purely temporary and on behalf of the sponsor. They give no right to a claim, implicit or explicit, for absorption on any post in CSIR-IIIM/CSIR.

Essential qualification: Postgraduate degree in Statistics, Biostatistics, Public Health, Population Sciences, Economics, Social Sciences, or a related discipline. Proficiency in data analysis using STATA or similar statistical analysis packages. Preferred skills: sound knowledge of public health programmes, health systems, research ethics, family planning, RMNCH+A, and relevant national and international frameworks. Preferred skills: strong analytical, quantitative research, problem-solving and report-writing skills. Preferred skills: familiarity with other statistical software and data visualization tools would be an advantage. Preferred skills: strong written and spoken Hindi, along with good written and spoken English. Preferred skills: ability to work independently and in a multidisciplinary team, attention to detail, and adherence to research ethics and confidentiality. Essential qualification: Postgraduate in Statistics / Demography / Economics / Mathematics / Geography / Management degree / Public health and other relevant fields from an institute of repute. Experience: more than 10 years of relevant experience in managing public health research studies, surveys, evaluations, or implementation research projects. Demonstrated experience in planning, coordinating and overseeing large-scale quantitative surveys or multi-site research studies. Experience overseeing data quality assurance and monitoring systems for research or M&E projects. Proven experience working with government health systems, research institutions, development partners, or NGOs. Experience in reproductive, maternal, newborn, child health, family planning, or women's health programmes is highly desirable. Preferred skills: leading large survey teams, stakeholder management including engagement with government officials, and fluency in English and Hindi. Preferred skills: knowledge of survey budgeting, operational research management, community-based research and public health programmes, particularly RMNCH+A. Preferred skills: proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel, PowerPoint and Word. Knowledge of STATA, SPSS, R etc. will be an added advantage. content_sections.heading: KGMU Manager cum Data Analyst Job Description
content_sections.text: The Data Analyst will be responsible for managing, processing, analysing and interpreting survey data. The role includes ensuring data quality and accuracy, and contributing to analytical reports, presentations and other research outputs. Contribute to developing and refining survey tools, manuals and other research-related documents. Train and support field and research staff on data collection, data management and quality assurance procedures. Manage and maintain survey datasets and the data collection system. Monitor data collection across study sites, and conduct data cleaning, validation, recoding and labelling. Prepare analysis-ready datasets, codebooks and data dictionaries, and develop statistical analysis plans. Perform statistical analyses using STATA or other relevant software, and prepare analytical summaries, tables and reports. Ensure data security, confidentiality, regulatory compliance and documentation, and adhere to Gender Equality, Diversity and Inclusion, and Safeguarding and PSHEA initiatives. Plan, budget, coordinate and manage household- and facility-based surveys, studies, trials and pilot projects from inception to completion. Lead field logistics, communication, coordination and documentation processes. Act as the lead liaison with the Chief Medical Officer, CMS, MoICs and HoDs of survey facilities/districts. Oversee the development, translation, adaptation, pilot testing and finalization of survey tools and manuals. Lead training for research staff, field teams and facility personnel, and supervise research coordinators and research officers. Monitor study progress, data quality, deliverables, timelines and budgets, and prepare progress reports. Organise regular review meetings, and support reports, presentations, policy briefs and dissemination of findings. Participant identification and recruitment: identify eligible participants attending OPDs, screen them against study criteria, explain the study, and enrol them. Obtain written informed consent as per the approved study protocol. Provide family-planning counselling without bias, address myths, and support informed and voluntary choice. Data collection: collect baseline information, administer questionnaires, and complete case record forms. Data entry and records: enter data into the electronic data-capture system and maintain study records. Participant follow-up: maintain the follow-up schedule, and record method continuation, side effects and adverse events. Administrative work: prepare monthly recruitment and follow-up reports, and assist the Principal Investigator with progress reports.

content_sections.heading: About CTIL
content_sections.text: The Ministry of Commerce and Industry, Government of India, established the Centre for Trade and Investment Law to provide legal and technical inputs on international trade and investment law issues. CTIL works as a think tank and advisory centre on legal issues under the World Trade Organisation (WTO), free trade agreements and other international economic law issues. Its office is at 6th Floor, NAFED House, Siddhartha Enclave, Ashram Chowk, Ring Road, New Delhi -110014. CTIL also hosts the Trade Remedies Advisory Cell (TRAC). TRAC supports the domestic industry in preparing applications, collating information or data, and providing legal advice for trade remedial investigations before the anti-dumping and safeguard authorities of India. The notice is signed by the Registrar, IIFT.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates must be Indian nationals and qualified ICWA/CMA/CA. They must also meet the following post-specific criteria printed in the notice: Must hold a master's degree in areas such as cost accounting (ICWA/CMA/CA) or a related discipline. Consistently good academic record with at least 55% (or an equivalent grade on a point scale wherever the grading system is followed) at bachelor's and master's levels. Must have a minimum of 8 years post-qualification experience (PQE), out of which a minimum of 3 years must be in the relevant field, for example Trade Remedies, international trade and allied field. PQE means work experience obtained after the candidate's successful qualification as an ICWA/CMA/CA. Excellent cost accountancy skills, with a demonstrated interest and/or experience in trade remedies and related fields. Strong written and spoken communication, and presentation skills in English. Ability to provide sound and rigorous cost accounting analysis. Strong research, drafting and analytical skills, specifically in trade and investment law fields. Relevant work experience or research and studies produced in trade remedies, international trade or a related discipline is desirable. Strong preference will be given to candidates who have experience in trade remedies, international trade and allied field. The upper age limit is 50 years, counted on the last date of receiving the applications, as the notice's table heading states. The eligibility criteria also state that the candidate must not be more than 50 years of age at the time of recruitment. The notice does not mention any age relaxation. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions of the post.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The selected candidate will be paid a fixed monthly remuneration in the range of ₹1,45,000–2,65,000 for PhD candidates and ₹1,37,500–2,65,000 for candidates without a PhD. The remuneration will be fixed on the following basis: The range of remuneration given for the position. Years of experience (overall and relevant experience); or Last pay drawn. This will be considered only in special cases where the Selection Committee determines that the candidate is exceptional. The appointment will be on a contractual basis, initially for a period of one year. The contract may be extended further based on performance and requirements. CTIL wants the selected candidate to join immediately.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Applicants are shortlisted for an online interview on essential qualification, age limit, percentage of marks in Bachelor's/Master's Degree, specialization relevance in Masters, research experience and publications (papers published in journals and books, papers presented in workshops, seminars, symposiums or conferences), as per WII rules. Meeting the minimum qualification and experience does not automatically entitle an applicant to an interview. Canvassing in any form is liable to rejection of the candidature. The Institute's decision on eligibility, acceptance or rejection and mode of selection is final and binding. content_sections.heading: About PESCO
content_sections.text: The Punjab Ex-Servicemen Corporation (PESCO) is a Punjab Government Undertaking with its Head Office at SCO 89-90, Sector 34-A, Chandigarh. According to the notice, its work includes finding employment and self-employment avenues for Ex-Servicemen, Widows and Dependents, and providing specialised manpower or security services. PESCO is also moving from a manual system to a fully automated, paperless, ERP-based system, which the DGM (IT) will lead.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: PESCO requires medically fit retired Defence Services personnel for these posts. Working knowledge of Punjabi, Punjab Domicile and proficiency in computers are required for all appointments. An experienced retired Defence Services officer of the rank of Col/Lt Col/Maj or equivalent with good knowledge of computers as OIC/Administrator (ESM or Non-ESM). Master Degree in Computer Science, IT, Info Systems or Software Engineer. Vendor certification like SAP Certified Application Associate, Oracle / ERP Certification, Scrum Master / Agile Certifications. Experience: 5-10 years. Punjabi proficiency – 10 certificate and Punjab domicile mandatory. Preference will be given to candidates from premier Institutes like IIT, IIIT or NIT, and to ESM. An experienced retired Defence Services officer (ESM) of the rank of Lt Col/Maj or equivalent with good knowledge of computers. Background: Retired Commissioned Officers of Defence Services. Education: Post Graduate (preferably MBA or equivalent). Experience: Minimum 5 - 10 years of leadership experience. Communication: Fluent in English, Punjabi, and Hindi. Punjab Domicile and Punjabi certificate 10th Mandatory. Resident of Punjab/ Chandigarh with understanding of the Punjab industrial ecosystem is highly desirable. Open only to Ex-Servicemen. Col/Lt Col/Maj should have commanded a unit/sub unit/est or equivalent level and medically fit. The notice does not mention a separate educational qualification for this post, apart from the Punjabi, Punjab Domicile and computer proficiency required for all appointments. All three posts are on contractual basis. DGM (IT): initial contract will be for one year, extendable on annual basis on discretion of the Management. DGM (Project & Ventures): the job would require regular travel across Punjab & neighbouring states, and the officer will report to the Managing Director. DGM (IT): the officer will report directly to the Managing Director, PESCO and General Manager (Admin).

content_sections.heading: PESCO Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: PESCO intends to hire an IT Officer who will be overall in charge of the entire IT setup at PESCO, i.e. existing software in use, legacy database, cyber security and network, and ERP implementation to ensure seamless business operation. The DGM IT will be the Chief Technology Officer of PESCO, responsible for ensuring: Digital transformation of PESCO from manual to a fully automated, paperless, ERP-based system. Single Point of Contact (SPOC) between PESCO and Software Development Agency. Technical skills listed for DGM (IT): Hands-on experience with major ERP systems like SAP, Oracle, MS Dynamics 365, Ramco etc. Proficiency in database management and query language like SQL. Knowledge of coding / scripting language (Java, Python, XML). Experience connecting ERP modules with their parts applications, AIPS, cloud infrastructure etc. Ability to run system diagnostics, troubleshoot errors, data migration, backup etc. Framework knowledge of Project Management. Data Centre / Network Administrator. Network Security and Cyber Security aspects. Tableau / Data Visualisation / report generation tools. Suggest AI Tools to be incorporated in ERP / Software used. DGM (Project & Ventures) is a strategic leadership position focused on bridging the gap between the workforce of ex-servicemen (ESM)/Dependents and the evolving industrial landscape of Punjab. Job purpose: to identify, evaluate and secure new avenues for the employment and self-employment of Ex-Servicemen, Widows and Dependents, and to act as primary liaison between PESCO and the private sector, industrial bodies and skill-building agencies. Key responsibilities (Business Development & Opportunity scouting): Market Intelligence: Conduct regular market research to identify emerging sectors in Punjab/Chandigarh that can absorb ESM manpower. Tender & Project Management: Scout for government and private tenders where PESCO can provide specialized manpower or security services. Skill Gap Analysis & Liaison. Industry Mapping: Visit industrial hubs to understand specific technical and soft skill requirements. Training Partnerships: Connect with Punjab Skill Development Mission (PSDM), National Skill Development Corporation (NSDC) and private "skilling agencies" to design customized bridge courses for retiring ESM/Dependents. Curriculum Integration: Ensure that military training is mapped to civilian job roles to facilitate easier transition. Entrepreneurship Support: Identify small-scale venture opportunities for ESM. Any other responsibility given by the Management.

content_sections.heading: Duties and Reporting
content_sections.text: The officer will be the Chief Technology Officer of PESCO and overall in charge of its IT setup, covering existing software, legacy database, cyber security, network and ERP implementation. The role includes: Digital transformation of PESCO from manual to a fully automated, paperless, ERP-based system Acting as Single Point of Contact (SPOC) between PESCO and the Software Development Agency Reporting directly to the Managing Director, PESCO and the General Manager (Admin) This strategic leadership position links the workforce of ex-servicemen and dependents with Punjab's industries. The officer acts as primary liaison between PESCO and the private sector, industrial bodies and skill-building agencies, and reports to the Managing Director. The responsibilities are: Regular market research to identify emerging sectors in Punjab/Chandigarh that can absorb ESM manpower Scouting government and private tenders where PESCO can provide specialised manpower or security services Skill gap analysis and liaison Visiting industrial hubs to understand technical and soft skill requirements Connecting with Punjab Skill Development Mission (PSDM), National Skill Development Corporation (NSDC) and private skilling agencies to design customised bridge courses for retiring ESM/Dependents Ensuring military training is mapped to civilian job roles Identifying small-scale venture opportunities for ESM Any other responsibility given by the Management

content_sections.heading: About AIIMS Rishikesh Project
content_sections.text: The post sits in an extramural funded research project at AIIMS Rishikesh that evaluates the efficacy and safety of Suprabrain® in children with autism spectrum disorder. The notice is issued by the Principal Investigator, AIIMS Rishikesh, and the interview venue is the Department of Pediatrics, AIIMS, Rishikesh.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The notice lists one post, Research Assistant (Vacancy-1). Age: the notice gives the maximum age limit as 35 years, counted as on the last date of application. Age relaxation, wherever applicable, is admissible in accordance with prevailing Central Government/ICMR and AIIMS Rishikesh rules. The notice does not list the relaxation by category. Experience is counted only after the minimum essential qualification prescribed for the post has been obtained. Candidates must make sure they meet the qualification, experience and age requirements. False or incorrect information found at any stage leads to cancellation of candidature or appointment and may invite appropriate action. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of the post.

rows.essential_qualification: A Master's Degree in any subject related to medical science (like psychology or psychiatry) or life science from a recognized university or equivalent

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The consolidated fixed salary is Rs 25,000/- per month. No allowances or facilities other than the approved consolidated emoluments and admissible HRA, if any, are payable. The post is purely temporary, contractual and co-terminus with the project. The initial appointment is for three months. It may be extended, based on satisfactory performance, project requirements and availability of funds, up to one year or until completion of the project, whichever is earlier. Any extension is subject to a satisfactory performance evaluation by the Principal Investigator and approval of the Competent Authority. Leave is admissible as per the rules applicable to project staff/contractual employees of AIIMS Rishikesh.

The notice does not print a subject line for the email or a format for the application form.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Candidates may be shortlisted on the basis of the information in the application form, qualifications and relevant experience. Only shortlisted candidates may be called for the selection process. The method of selection may include a written test, an interview, or both, as decided by the Selection Committee. If required, a written test may be held before the interview. The Selection Committee is constituted with the approval of the Competent Authority, AIIMS Rishikesh, and its decision is final. The interview is held at the Department of Pediatrics, AIIMS, Rishikesh, and the date will be communicated on the AIIMS, Rishikesh website. The interview is conducted only after physical verification of original documents. Requests for an online interview are not entertained. Permission to appear in the selection process does not mean a candidate fulfils the eligibility criteria. Eligibility is finally determined after verification of original documents.

content_sections.heading: About ICMR
content_sections.text: The Indian Council of Medical Research, headquartered at V. Ramalingaswami Bhavan, Ansari Nagar, New Delhi-110029, deals with biomedical and health research in various areas in collaboration with national and international agencies. According to the notice, ICMR works through its Headquarters at New Delhi and 28 Institutes/ Centres and a large number of field stations across the country. The Director posts in this circular head five of these institutes.

content_sections.heading: Posts and Research Areas
content_sections.text: The vacancy circular lists five Director posts. All five share the same pay, qualification and age limit; the area in which the Research & Development experience must have been gained differs from post to post. *The posts of Director, ICMR-NIMR, Dwarka, New Delhi and Director, ICMR-NITM, Belagavi are against lien vacancies and are subject to reversion of the lien holder.

Director-National Institute of Traditional Medicine (NITM), Belagavi*

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Applications are invited from Indian Citizens. The same essential qualification and experience apply to all five Director posts. MD/MS or equivalent degree recognised by MCI/NMC OR MBBS or equivalent degree recognised by MCI/NMC with MPH from a recognised University OR Master's Degree in a subject related to Biomedical Sciences or MBBS or equivalent degree, recognised by MCI/NMC, with Ph.D. from a recognised University in a subject related to Biomedical Sciences 15 years, which must include: 05 Years in a managerial position and has handled R&D projects independently (viz. PI or Co-PI of Scientific studies, Head of Research Groups/ Centres/ Institutes/ Laboratories), AND 02 Years regular service in the pay matrix level-13-A or 07 Years regular service in the pay matrix level-13, or equivalent as amended from time to time Experience in Research & Development related to Biomedical Sciences in Govt./ Public sector/ Private Institutions will be admissible, in the area set for each post in the table above. Ph.D. will be considered as 4 years' experience (irrespective of the duration taken to complete the degree). MD/MS or equivalent to be considered as 3 years' experience. MVSc will be considered as 2 years' experience. MPH/M.Tech/ME will not be considered as any experience. The period spent on obtaining the minimum essential educational qualification shall not count towards experience. For applicants from the private sector or laboratories/ institutions abroad, the Screening Committee shall decide the equivalency of Pay Scale. The qualifications and experience may be relaxed in the case of exceptionally meritorious candidates, with the approval of the President, Governing Council, ICMR, for reasons to be recorded in writing. Scientists from the Central Government or State Government or recognised autonomous organisations of the Central Government or State Government or Research Institutes or Universities who are: Holding an analogous post on regular basis; or Possessing the same essential qualifications and experience prescribed for direct recruits. ICMR Scientists shall not be eligible for appointment on deputation; they shall apply under Direct Recruitment. The age limit for the Director posts is not exceeding 58 years . For appointment by deputation, the maximum age limit shall not exceed 58 years as on the last date of applications. Age relaxation applies as per the existing Government of India instructions. In addition, the age limit may be relaxed for exceptionally meritorious candidates, based on their CVs/experience, with the approval of the President, Governing Council, ICMR, for reasons to be recorded in writing. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: All five Director posts are in Level-14 of Pay Matrix (Rs.1,44,200-2,18,200) (7th CPC), with usual allowances as admissible to ICMR employees. The posts are filled on regular basis, with all India transfer liability under the Council. 5 years, extendable by maximum 5 years, or till superannuation, whichever is earlier. During the tenure as Director, ICMR Scientists shall hold lien on their substantive post at ICMR. ICMR Scientists, on completion of the tenure (including extension, if any) as Director, shall be given the position of Scientist 'G' in any of the Institutes/Centres/HQ of ICMR, till superannuation; pay and allowances shall be protected in accordance with rules. A Non-ICMR Scientist holding the tenure post of Director can be considered for absorption in ICMR as Director's Grade Scientist, i.e., Scientist 'G', subject to availability of vacancy in the scientific cadre, on completion of minimum 5 years of continuous regular service as Director. The tenure of deputation shall be 5 years (extendable maximum by 5 years, only if the incumbent is absorbed in ICMR). The period of deputation, including deputation in another ex-cadre post held immediately before this appointment in the same or other organisation/Department of the Central Government, shall ordinarily not exceed 5 years. The Director on deputation can be considered for absorption in ICMR as Director's Grade Scientist, i.e., Scientist G/Head, subject to availability of vacancy in the scientific cadre, on completion of minimum 5 years of continuous regular service as Director. The fee is paid through the online link given in the application form.

faq.question: What qualification is needed for the ICMR Director post?
faq.answer: MD/MS or equivalent recognised by MCI/NMC, or MBBS with MPH, or a Master's Degree in a subject related to Biomedical Sciences or MBBS with Ph.D. in a subject related to Biomedical Sciences, along with 15 years' experience.

faq.question: What is the age limit for ICMR Director recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The age limit is not exceeding 58 years; for deputation it is 58 years as on the last date of applications, with relaxation as per Government of India instructions and for exceptionally meritorious candidates.

faq.question: What is the salary of an ICMR Director?
faq.answer: The post is in Level-14 of Pay Matrix (Rs.1,44,200-2,18,200) (7th CPC), with usual allowances as admissible to ICMR employees.

faq.question: What is the application fee for the ICMR Director posts?
faq.answer: The fee is Rs.1500/- (non-refundable), paid through the online link in the application form; SC/ST/Women/PwD/EWS candidates are exempted.

faq.question: How do I apply for ICMR Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Apply only online on https://recruitment.icmr.org.in, enclosing self-attested proof of date of birth, educational qualifications and experience certificates.

faq.question: How will ICMR select the Directors?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates are shortlisted, ICMR may shortlist further if numbers are high, and shortlisted candidates are called for interview.

faq.question: Is the ICMR Director post permanent?
faq.answer: It is a tenure post of 5 years; for direct recruits it is extendable by maximum 5 years or till superannuation, whichever is earlier, and for deputationists it is extendable by 5 years only if absorbed in ICMR.

faq.question: Can I apply for more than one ICMR Director post?
faq.answer: Yes. A separate online application must be submitted for each post, along with the prescribed application fee wherever applicable.

faq.question: Can ICMR Scientists apply on deputation?
faq.answer: No. ICMR Scientists are not eligible for appointment on deputation and must apply under Direct Recruitment.

content_sections.heading: About IICA
content_sections.text: The Indian Institute of Corporate Affairs is an autonomous institution registered under the Societies Registration Act, 1860 by the Ministry of Corporate Affairs, Government of India. Its 14-acre campus is at Plot No.6, 7 & 8, Sector-5, IMT Manesar, District-Gurugram, Haryana. It provides knowledge and professional training through five Schools and eleven Centres, and also serves as a Government think tank on corporate laws, policies and governance.

content_sections.heading: Duties of the Posts
content_sections.text: Conduct general research connected to CSR and sustainability Organize research on needs and impact assessment, baseline studies and SROI, including proposals, literature reviews, questionnaires, field surveys and data collection Collect, record, analyse and evaluate data and facts Support, facilitate and maintain CSR data Do any other duty entrusted by the Competent Authority Collaborate with the WNS Research team, Finance and Administration stakeholders and experts to ensure smooth project execution Assist in opportunity reviews to identify key tenders and relevant studies in CSR and sustainability Support research administration, including record-keeping and documentation Handle the Centre's office files, coordinate with other units, schools and centres of IICA, and arrange logistics Maintain records, prepare data sheets and update content modules Follow up on invoices and settlement of advances for ongoing and upcoming projects Handle or coordinate the Learning Management System

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: All applications received by the due date are screened against the minimum educational qualifications and experience prescribed. The duly constituted Selection Committee shortlists candidates. The Institute reserves the right to devise its own shortlisting criteria. Shortlisted candidates are called for a presentation and/or interview at IICA Campus, Manesar or through video conference, on a date and time communicated separately. Holding the minimum qualifications does not by itself entitle a candidate to be called. IICA communicates only with shortlisted candidates and does not entertain interim correspondence or personal enquiries. No TA/DA is permissible for attending the interview. Final results will be published on the IICA website once the process concludes. Selected candidates may have to undergo a medical examination, if required.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: The engagement is for one year at first, and may be extended or curtailed depending on performance and requirement. WNS Project positions can be extended up to the duration of the Project, as they are co-terminus with it. The assignment is full time. The person must attend office on all working days, and on holidays if required. Selected candidates must sign a contract with IICA and join the duties immediately. Either side can end the contract with two months' notice, or two months' consolidated emoluments in lieu. A consultant cannot apply for any position inside or outside IICA while the contract is valid, or before 02 years of joining the position (where the contract provides for extension after one year), whichever is later. To apply internally for another position, the consultant must terminate the present contract. Leave and increments are as per the policy of the Institute.

content_sections.heading: Duties of the Verbal and Communication Trainer
content_sections.text: Train students in verbal and communication skills, covering vocabulary-building, grammar, syllogisms, critical reasoning and comprehension. Encourage and motivate students to communicate fluently and confidently. Prepare students for higher-study exams such as CAT and GRE, and train them in special skills like public speaking and debate. Conduct exams regularly and give immediate feedback, so students can rate their progress and identify weak areas. Give training based on industry requirements, so students can face placement tests. Be ready to imbibe new technology-based training. Identify students who lack communication skills and give them special training to overcome their limitations. Provide career counselling and guidance, and record the data in the required formats. Actively participate and contribute in the special training drives organised by CIR for Amrita students. Stay updated on university accreditation requirements under CIR's learning and development activities. Contribute to periodic curriculum revisions in verbal and communication skills, in line with current industry requirements. Keep students' knowledge current by sharing the latest question papers, vocabulary-building techniques and newly coined words through the Amrita University Management System (AUMS) software.

content_sections.heading: About Jamia Hamdard
content_sections.text: Jamia Hamdard is a Deemed to be University at Hamdard Nagar, New Delhi, declared by the Government of India, Ministry of Education, through a Gazette Notification dated 10 May 1989. The notice describes it as a research oriented organization, accredited by NAAC in the 'A+' Category. It also says the university is ranked among the top 50 Universities in India and 1st in the Pharmacy category in NIRF-2025.

content_sections.heading: Jamia Hamdard Registrar Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: A Master's degree with at least 55% of the marks or an equivalent grade in a point scale wherever grading system is followed. Candidates also need one of the following: At least 15 years of experience as Assistant Professor in the Academic Level 11 and above. Eight years of service in Academic Level 12 and above including as Associate Professor, along with experience in educational administration. Comparable experience in research establishment and/or other institutions of higher education. 15 years of administrative experience, of which 8 years shall be as Deputy Registrar or an equivalent post. The minimum qualification, pay and other benefits shall be as per the UGC/Statutory bodies/Jamia Hamdard norms. The official notification has the full eligibility conditions for this post.

Meeting the minimum qualification and experience does not by itself entitle a candidate to be short-listed. Group discussion, if any, and further selection process. Interview/Selection Committee. No correspondence will be entertained about the conduct or result of a group discussion, or the reasons for not being called for it or for further selection.

content_sections.text: The flagship research programs of the Institute of Advanced Virology address the need to build indigenous capacity in molecular diagnosis, therapy and prevention to combat emerging viral diseases. content_sections.heading: IAV Project Associate-I Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: Age limit: 32 years as on 1 November 2026. Minimum essential qualification: Master's degree (with minimum 60% marks) or equivalent degree in Virology/Biotechnology/Microbiology/Biochemistry from a recognised University/Institute. Desirable experience: Research experience in the field of molecular biology, cell culture techniques, and mouse handling. All educational qualification certificates shall be from a recognized Board/University/Institute. content_sections.heading: Application Fee
content_sections.text: The application fee is Rs. 200 + GST, and the amount to be paid through SBI Collect is Rs.236/-.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Screening: only candidates who fulfil all the essential qualifications and qualify the screening by a duly constituted screening committee will be short-listed. Selection: short-listed candidates will be selected through a process comprising a written test and/or interview.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: The position is purely temporary, and the appointment is initially for one year and coterminous with the project. Extension beyond one year depends on obtaining the prescribed grading in the yearly progress evaluation by the Program Monitoring Committee (PMC). The evaluation will be strictly based on achievements against the milestones set at the beginning of the program. If progress is not satisfactory, no further extension will be granted. Selection does not entitle the candidate to any claim for future positions at IAV, permanent or otherwise. The selected candidate will be required to work at any of the collaborating institutions as per the directions of the PI. Selected candidates are required to join within 15 days from the date of the appointment order.

faq.answer: No. The interview provision has been removed, and every candidate receives a uniform 6 marks under that head.

faq.question: Q2. What score do I need to qualify?
faq.answer: The minimum qualifying score for appointment is 16 marks.

faq.question: Q3. Can a diploma holder apply?
faq.answer: A diploma is accepted only when suitable candidates are short. Diploma holders get 10 marks like PG degree holders, but are placed below them in the merit list.

faq.answer: Yes. DNB / DNB Super Speciality is treated as a valid qualification under the Medical Institutions (Qualification of Faculty) Regulation, 2025.

faq.question: Q5. I have already done a Senior Residency. Can I apply?
faq.answer: Not in the same subject if you completed the three-year tenure. You can apply in a different subject, and your earlier work in Bihar's government or semi-government colleges earns experience marks.

faq.answer: Submit a separate application for each department and mention this in the online form. Once selected in one subject, you cannot be selected in another.

faq.answer: Yes, 20% of the posts are for doctors with a PG degree from recognised institutions outside the state. However, applicants who are not natives of Bihar get no reservation benefit.

content_sections.heading: About TISS Data Officer
content_sections.text: The Tata Institute of Social Sciences (TISS), Mumbai is inviting applications for a short-term research project titled "Saksham Pramaan - Programme Evaluation for National AIDS Control Programme (NACP)". The project is conducted in consultation with the National AIDS Control Organisation (NACO) to design and conduct concurrent and mid-term evaluations of select programmatic interventions under NACP across the country. The Data Officer will work under the technical supervision of a research associate and Manager/s leading the research studies at Saksham Pramaan, TISS.

content_sections.heading: TISS Data Officer at a Glance

rows.details: Tata Institute of Social Sciences (TISS), Mumbai

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Essential Qualification: Postgraduate degree in Social Sciences/Social Work/Population Studies/Public Health and allied fields. Experience: Minimum 2-3 years of experience in research projects in the field of HIV/AIDS is desirable. Preference will be given to candidates having experience of working with High Risk Groups (HRG) population, ICTC and ART Centres. Conversant in local language in addition to English. Well-versed in reporting and documentation. The candidate should have the necessary research skills of quantitative and qualitative data collection, data management, and analysis. She/he shall have experience in conducting FGDs/IDIs with HRGs and Bridge population. Essential Skills and Attributes: High level of commitment and integrity and ability to work independently, excellent interpersonal skills, excellent co-ordination and organisational skills, ability to strategise and implement field planning, quantitative and qualitative data collection skills and knowledge, willingness to travel, and sensitivity towards issues relating to HRG communities and PLHIVs. Desirable: Knowledge of the National AIDS Control Programme and programmatic evaluations.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The selected candidate will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 45,000 to 50,000 per month, depending upon experience and qualifications. The position is purely on a contractual basis for a short-term research project with an initial duration of 3 months, which can be extended up to March 2026 within the 6-month project time frame.

content_sections.heading: TISS Data Officer Job Description
content_sections.text: Study the quantitative and qualitative tools, suggest changes, refine the tools to make them user-friendly, and prepare APP-based forms for collecting data Coordinate and follow up with all the stakeholders and participants for data collection across all the data collection sites Develop a plan for data collection with the guidance of research associate and the study manager Organize the training for the consultants at the state/district level Monitor overall fieldwork and data collection process Travel across different states for data collection Assist in primary (quantitative) data collection, collation and cleaning Follow up for secondary data across all the data collection sites Overlook the data management, including transcription, translation processes Carry out secondary data analysis using NACO data Undertake qualitative as well as quantitative data analysis Assist in report writing Support other Saksham Pramaan work as needed/requested by the Programme Team

content_sections.heading: About IIT Kanpur National Aerosol Facility
content_sections.text: The National Aerosol Facility is a unit of the Indian Institute of Technology Kanpur, coordinated by Prof. Sachchida Nand Tripathi. This project post is based in Ahmedabad, where the work covers air quality and environmental monitoring, data analysis and GIS work. Details of the group are on its page at iitk.ac.in/atman.

content_sections.text: Post graduate degree in environmental science/ engineering, atmospheric science, climate studies, or a closely related field. Basic proficiency in the MS Productivity Suite, including MS Word, Excel and PowerPoint. Working knowledge of Python or R for scientific and environmental data processing and analysis. Basic working knowledge of ArcGIS or QGIS for spatial data processing and visualization. Basic understanding of air quality monitoring, atmospheric/environmental data and scientific measurements. Good analytical, problem-solving and communication skills, with attention to detail. Ability to work both independently and as part of a team. For the full eligibility conditions of the post, see the official notification.

content_sections.heading: Duties and Responsibilities
content_sections.text: Provide scientific and administrative support to the project manager, project executive officer, post-doctoral fellows and project team. Assist in air-quality and environmental monitoring, including field deployment, data collection and monitoring of sensors and scientific instruments. Process, clean, analyse and quality check scientific and environmental data, and present trends and patterns through graphs, charts, tables and reports. Assist in statistical, time series and QA/QC analysis, including identification of trends, patterns and pollution hotspots. Assist in GIS-based processing and visualization of environmental and spatial datasets using ArcGIS/QGIS. Conduct literature reviews and help prepare technical reports, handbooks, policy documents and other project deliverables. Maintain organised records of project data, field activities, equipment and instruments, observations, reports and other technical documentation. Undertake other project-related scientific, technical or administrative tasks as assigned.

Prepare regular reports, dashboards and presentations for the University leadership. Work with the IT team on system integration, security, data backup and compliance. Evaluate existing strategies, methodologies and systems to improve the socio-economic conditions of the UT. Create and facilitate cross-learning platforms, and document the SIT's activities and good practices. Support the preparation of UT-level, regional and sectoral reports on a regular basis. Support regular updates on the UT's progress through the dashboard/portal maintained by NITI Aayog. Support the organisation of workshops and other SIT events, including preparing the relevant inputs. Perform any other tasks assigned by the supervisor (Team Leader) in the interest of the Mission.

content_sections.heading: Berhampur University Senior Research Fellow Vacancy Details 2026
content_sections.text: These fellowship rates depend on specific approval from the funding agency, the availability of sanctioned project funds and the applicable institutional rules. The project is titled "Satellite detection and evaluation of phytoplankton size classes during recurring bloom events in coastal waters of the north-western Bay of Bengal." The SRF will do seasonal water sampling in the Rushikulya Estuary from a country boat or local boat. The role also covers radiometer operation, satellite data analysis, sample analysis, data interpretation and report preparation.

content_sections.heading: About OEA
content_sections.text: The Office of the Economic Adviser is an attached office of the Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade (DPIIT), which comes under the Ministry of Commerce & Industry, Government of India. It works from GPOA-3, Netaji Nagar, Bhikaji Cama Place, New Delhi. The people selected will work in its different divisions.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Every application is screened for qualification and completeness. Complete applications are sorted, and suitable candidates are shortlisted for interview. Not every applicant may be called. The concerned Evaluation Committee holds the interviews and selects candidates based on criteria, performance and a qualitative assessment. Selected candidates are placed on a panel that stays valid for two years from the date it is created. OEA sends offers of engagement in order of merit, as and when it needs people.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: This is purely a contractual engagement for specific requirements or projects. It is full-time, and you may not take up any other assignment during the period. The initial period is 03 years, renewed every year based on a performance appraisal. It can be extended by up to 2 more years with the competent authority's approval. Place of posting: OEA, DPIIT, GPOA-3, Netaji Nagar, Bhikaji Cama Place, New Delhi - 110023. Working hours are normally 9 AM to 5.30 PM. When work demands, you may be asked to stay longer or to come in on Saturdays, Sundays and gazetted holidays. Paid leave builds up at 1.5 days for each completed month (18 days in a year) and cannot be carried forward. Female Junior Consultants and Consultants may be granted maternity leave of up to 26 weeks. For official tours, TA/DA and hotel accommodation are given as admissible to Central Government employees drawing grade pay of Rs. 5400/- (Junior Consultant) or Rs. 6600/- (Consultant). Either side can end the engagement with 30 days' notice or pay in lieu of notice. Police verification is required. If you are engaged urgently, you must submit the report within 02 months. You will be bound by the Indian Official Secrets Act, 1923, and you need prior sanction before publishing or broadcasting anything on your assigned work. You will be an independent consultant, not a staff member of DPIIT. The engagement gives no right to a permanent or regular job.

content_sections.text: The Tata Institute of Social Sciences is located at V.N. Purav Marg, Deonar, Mumbai 400 088. content_sections.heading: TISS Senior Research Associate Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: A Master's degree in Social Sciences, Humanities, Development Studies, Education, Management or another relevant discipline, from a recognised university. At least 2 years of relevant experience in research or academic project coordination. Experience in higher education or research institutions is preferred. Preference goes to candidates with a PhD or advanced doctoral-level research experience, especially in disciplines relevant to the academic programmes. Strong research, analytical and academic writing skills Excellent written and spoken English Ability to prepare research proposals, project reports, presentations and institutional documents Strong project coordination, planning and organisational skills Proficiency in MS Office, data management tools and digital collaboration platforms Ability to coordinate with faculty, researchers, international partners and administrative teams Ability to handle several tasks at once, meet deadlines, and work both independently and in a team In exceptional cases, the Institute may relax the qualification, experience or age limit. It may also do so for a person who already holds an analogous position in a Government Department, a Research and Academic Institution, or Industry. For full eligibility details, see the official notification.

content_sections.text: Support the coordination and implementation of international research projects, programmes and collaborative academic initiatives Coordinate with international partner institutions, researchers and stakeholders on project planning, implementation, meetings and academic activities Help track project timelines, milestones, deliverables, budgets and documentation Keep systematic records, databases and documentation of international research collaborations, academic programmes and project outcomes for institutional reporting and review Help develop and maintain institutional systems, processes and databases for managing international collaborations Support compliance with institutional policies, partnership agreements, regulatory requirements and reporting procedures Carry out research, data collection and analysis for planning, monitoring and evaluating international research projects and academic programmes

content_sections.heading: IIM Bodh Gaya Faculty Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: For academic positions, the qualification, experience and related requirements are governed by the Ministry of Education guidelines. Candidates should have a demonstrated ability to make relevant intellectual contribution to experienced and potential managers through teaching, training research and published work. Candidates should also have a strong academic background and understanding of current developments in the related field. Faculty members are expected to carry out research, design and teach courses, engage in institution development, and conduct training programs and consultancy. Meeting the minimum qualifications and experience does not by itself entitle a candidate to be called for the interview.
