content_sections.text: The notification gives the following pay scale under the 7th CPC and the entry pay for each faculty position. The pay carries all other allowances such as DA, HRA/Leased Accommodation, LTC, Medical re-imbursement, Children Education Allowance, NPS, re-imbursement of telephone bills, incentive for research publications, faculty development fund for attending national and international conferences, membership of professional bodies etc. as per IIM Bodh Gaya Rules. The maximum consolidated remuneration for the Senior Consultant (Academics) post on contract is Rs. 1,50,000/- per month. basic_details.short_information: The Gujarat Subordinate Service Selection Board (Gujarat Gaun Seva Pasandgi Mandal), Gandhinagar, is recruiting for 84 Food Safety Officer, Class-3 posts under GSSSB Recruitment 2026. The posts are in the office of the Commissioner, Food and Drugs Control Administration, under the control of the Health and Family Welfare Department. The pay is a fixed Rs. 40,800 per month for the first five years. Selection is through a one-stage MCQ competitive examination (CBRT/OMR). Candidates must be 18 to 37 years old on 10 November 2026. Applications are accepted only online on ojas.gujarat.gov.in, from

application_fee.details: The fee is paid online only, after the application is submitted and a confirmation number is generated, by 13/11/2026 (23:59 hours). No other mode is accepted, and no late fee is accepted. Payment can be made by Debit Card, Internet Banking, UPI or Wallets. Go to the Online Application tab on OJAS, then Print Application Form / Pay Fees, then Online Payment of Fees. The transaction charge is paid on top of the fee. Candidates must keep a printout of the fee receipt or the e-receipt. If no receipt is generated, the fee is not treated as paid. The receipt can be printed again through Print Application Form / Pay Fees, then Online Payment Receipt. The fee is refunded, through the mode used to pay it, to candidates who appear in the examination. Candidates who do not appear get no refund. This is why the bank account details asked for in the form matter. An application without the fee is rejected without notice. The fee is not refunded if the Board rejects an application.

age_limit.details: On 10/11/2026, candidates must be at least 18 years old and not more than 37 years old. Candidates already in Gujarat Government service may get a relaxation of the upper age limit under the Gujarat Civil Services Classification and Recruitment (General) Rules, 1967. | Only SC, ST, SEBC and EWS candidates of Gujarat origin get the age relaxation and reservation benefits. Reserved-category candidates who apply against an unreserved post get no age relaxation or any other relaxation. SEBC: One of these certificates is needed: a non-creamy layer certificate in the Gujarati format of Annexure-4, based on income for 2023-24, 2024-25 and 2025-26, obtained between 01/04/2024 and 10/11/2026; or the Government of India Annexure-A certificate, obtained between 01/04/2026 and 10/11/2026. Married SEBC women must give a certificate based on their parents' income. If the certificate is based on the husband's income, the application will be rejected. EWS: One of these certificates is needed: Annexure-KH (English) or Parishisht-G (Gujarati), issued between 11/11/2023 and 10/11/2026; or the Government of India Income and Asset Certificate based on 2025-26 income, obtained between 01/04/2026 and 10/11/2026. No other certificate is accepted. Certificates issued for Gujarat government scheme benefits are not accepted in any case. SEBC and EWS candidates must enter the certificate number and issue date in the online form and show the same certificate in original at verification. A new certificate obtained after the last date will not be considered. A candidate who cannot produce the certificate, and who is above the age limit for unreserved candidates, will have the candidature cancelled. Candidates with disabilities: The 10-year relaxation (maximum 45 years) depends on a medical certificate from a Superintendent or Civil Surgeon, issued as set out in the Health and Family Welfare Department circular dated 15/12/2025 (No. HFWD/MSM/e-file/7/2024/1833/A). The disability and its percentage must be entered under Personal Details in the online form. The Disability Certificate must be in Form V, VI or VII under the Rights of Persons with Disabilities Rules, 2017. Candidates with disabilities who apply against an unreserved post are judged by unreserved standards. Ex-servicemen: The relaxation applies to those who have served at least six months in the Army, Navy or Air Force and hold the competent authority's identity card and discharge book. Ex-servicemen who are due to retire within one year of the last date may also apply.

The latest of these is the resolution dated 18/10/2023 (No. Kharch-2002-57-(Part-4)-Z.1). If service is found satisfactory at the end of five years, the candidate becomes eligible for regular appointment in the Level-5 pay scale. This is subject to the General Administration Department resolution dated 23/10/2015 and the Finance Department resolutions dated 28/03/2016 and 18/01/2017. selection_process: One-stage MCQ competitive examination (CBRT or OMR)
with Part-A and Part-B in a single question paper. Provisional result for all candidates who appear
published on the Board's website. Document verification for about two times the number of posts in each category
chosen by total marks from among candidates who meet the qualifying standard in both parts. If enough candidates are not available after this
more candidates from the provisional merit list may be called by category. Selection list
and a waiting list where applicable
prepared by category on merit (General Administration Department resolution dated 27/07/2018). The Board recommends the selected candidates to the department concerned for appointment
in order of Merit Number.

Widows: Widow candidates get 5% of their CBRT/OMR marks added for preference in selection. They must not have remarried at the time of appointment and must produce proof in original. A woman who becomes a widow after applying gets the benefit from the stage of the process still remaining after she submits proof. Sportspersons: Candidates who have represented in (i) national or international
(ii) inter-university or (iii) All India School Federation competitions get 5% of their marks added. This applies to these sports: Athletics (including track and field)

exam_pattern.details: The examination is MCQ-based and is held in one sitting on CBRT/OMR. The paper is set at the level of the educational qualification, and the syllabus content follows that qualification. | There are 90 questions in Part-A and 120 in Part-B, 210 questions in all. Candidates get 3 hours (180 minutes) for Part-A and Part-B together. Negative marking: 1/4 of the marks for the question is deducted for each wrong answer. Qualifying standard: at least 40% in Part-A and at least 40% in Part-B, each counted separately. The minimum is not lower than 40% for any category. After the exam, a provisional answer key will be published. The final answer key will be published after the representations on it are considered. If a question is cancelled, its marks are shared out pro-rata among the remaining questions, and negative marking applies to the pro-rata marks. The Board will set the exam centres according to the number of candidates. Candidates must attend at the centre on their admit card at their own expense.

how_to_apply: Applications for Advertisement No. 465/202627 are accepted online only, on ojas.gujarat.gov.in, from 27 October 2026 (18:00 hours) to 10 November 2026 (23:59 hours). Only candidates with an OTR (One Time Registration) on OJAS can apply. Candidates who have not registered must complete the OTR first.
Go to https://ojas.gujarat.gov.in. Click Apply under "On line Application" and select GSSSB.
Click the name of Advertisement No. 465/202627, Food Safety Officer, Class-3, and then Apply. Read the advertisement under More Details, then click Apply now.
Enter your Registration No. and date of birth, then click "Apply with OTR". The Personal Details are already filled in from your registration. Fill in every field marked with a red asterisk (*).
Enter your SSC details: roll number, month and year of passing, and the board name as printed on the marksheet.

For the fee refund, enter your bank account details (name as in the passbook, bank name, IFSC code and account number). Upload the first page of the passbook in JPEG, JPG or PNG format. These details cannot be changed offline once submitted.
Fill in the Educational Details. Under "Declaration", select "Yes" and click "save" to generate the Application Number.

Click Upload Photograph and enter the application number and date of birth. Upload the photo (5 cm high, 3.6 cm wide) and the signature (2.5 cm high, 7.5 cm wide), each in jpg format and no larger than 15 kb. The photo must be passport size, with a white background and the date it was taken printed on it. That date must not be more than one year before the last date to apply.

Click "Confirm Application" in the Online Application tab, check all details, edit if needed, and confirm. Note the "confirmation number". Then use Print Application, select the advertisement, enter the confirmation number and date of birth, and print the application. Pay the fee online by 13 November 2026 (23:59 hours).

No change of any kind is possible after the application is confirmed. To change any detail, candidates must apply again before the last date, get a new confirmation number and pay the fee for it. The category entered cannot be changed later.

Only one application should be made. If there are several, the last confirmed one is accepted. For unreserved candidates, it is the last confirmed application with the fee paid. Fees paid on the earlier applications are not refunded.
The Application Form cannot be downloaded after the last date.
Candidates should keep five copies of the photograph. The same photo must be pasted on the exam attendance sheet and shown at every later stage.
For help with qualification, age, the online form or fee payment, call the Board's office at 079-23258916.

A scribe or compensatory time is given, on request, to candidates with a benchmark disability who have limits on writing, and to candidates with a temporary disability who cannot write. This follows Office Memorandum F.No.34-02/2015-DD-III dated 29/08/2018 and the Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016.

After the admit card notice is published, get the form from the "Umedvar Upyogitao" tab, under "For Divyang candidates", on the Board's website, or from https://gsssb.gujarat.gov.in/Home/ph. Email the filled form with the required certificates to [email protected] at least two days before the exam. Requests received later are not considered.

Candidates with locomotor disability (both arms affected, BA, at least 40%) need only the disability certificate. Other candidates also need the Appendix-I certificate from the Chief Medical Officer, Civil Surgeon or Medical Superintendent.

Compensatory time is 20 minutes per hour. The Board's decision is sent to the candidate by email. On exam day, the candidate must show the original certificates and the approval letter to the centre in-charge.

content_sections.heading: GSSSB Selection Process 2026
content_sections.text: One-stage MCQ competitive examination (CBRT or OMR), with Part-A and Part-B in a single question paper. Provisional result for all candidates who appear, published on the Board's website. Document verification for about two times the number of posts in each category, chosen by total marks from among candidates who meet the qualifying standard in both parts. If enough candidates are not available after this, more candidates from the provisional merit list may be called by category. Selection list, and a waiting list where applicable, prepared by category on merit (General Administration Department resolution dated 27/07/2018). The Board recommends the selected candidates to the department concerned for appointment, in order of Merit Number. Widows: Widow candidates get 5% of their CBRT/OMR marks added for preference in selection. They must not have remarried at the time of appointment and must produce proof in original. A woman who becomes a widow after applying gets the benefit from the stage of the process still remaining after she submits proof. Sportspersons: Candidates who have represented in (i) national or international, (ii) inter-university or (iii) All India School Federation competitions get 5% of their marks added. This applies to these sports: Athletics (including track and field), Badminton, Basketball, Cricket, Football, Hockey, Swimming, Table Tennis, Volleyball, Tennis, Weightlifting, Wrestling, Boxing, Cycling, Gymnastics, Judo, Rifle Shooting, Kabaddi, Kho-Kho, Archery, Horse riding, Shot put, Rowing, Chess and Handball. A certificate in the prescribed format from the authorised officer is needed at document verification. If it is found later that the certificate is not valid, the extra 5% is withdrawn and the merit is worked out again.

content_sections.heading: GSSSB Exam Pattern 2026
content_sections.text: The examination is MCQ-based and is held in one sitting on CBRT/OMR. The paper is set at the level of the educational qualification, and the syllabus content follows that qualification. There are 90 questions in Part-A and 120 in Part-B, 210 questions in all. Candidates get 3 hours (180 minutes) for Part-A and Part-B together. Negative marking: 1/4 of the marks for the question is deducted for each wrong answer. Qualifying standard: at least 40% in Part-A and at least 40% in Part-B, each counted separately. The minimum is not lower than 40% for any category. After the exam, a provisional answer key will be published. The final answer key will be published after the representations on it are considered. If a question is cancelled, its marks are shared out pro-rata among the remaining questions, and negative marking applies to the pro-rata marks. The Board will set the exam centres according to the number of candidates. Candidates must attend at the centre on their admit card at their own expense.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply Online for GSSSB Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: No change of any kind is possible after the application is confirmed. To change any detail, candidates must apply again before the last date, get a new confirmation number and pay the fee for it. The category entered cannot be changed later. Only one application should be made. If there are several, the last confirmed one is accepted. For unreserved candidates, it is the last confirmed application with the fee paid. Fees paid on the earlier applications are not refunded. The Application Form cannot be downloaded after the last date. Candidates should keep five copies of the photograph. The same photo must be pasted on the exam attendance sheet and shown at every later stage. For help with qualification, age, the online form or fee payment, call the Board's office at 079-23258916. A scribe or compensatory time is given, on request, to candidates with a benchmark disability who have limits on writing, and to candidates with a temporary disability who cannot write. This follows Office Memorandum F.No.34-02/2015-DD-III dated 29/08/2018 and the Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016. After the admit card notice is published, get the form from the "Umedvar Upyogitao" tab, under "For Divyang candidates", on the Board's website, or from https://gsssb.gujarat.gov.in/Home/ph. Email the filled form with the required certificates to [email protected] at least two days before the exam. Requests received later are not considered. Candidates with locomotor disability (both arms affected, BA, at least 40%) need only the disability certificate. Other candidates also need the Appendix-I certificate from the Chief Medical Officer, Civil Surgeon or Medical Superintendent. Compensatory time is 20 minutes per hour. The Board's decision is sent to the candidate by email. On exam day, the candidate must show the original certificates and the approval letter to the centre in-charge.

DRDO has signed an MoU with Mizoram University to set up the DRDO - Industry Academia Centre of Excellence, Mizoram University (DIA-CoE, MZU) for directed research. It carries out multidisciplinary directed applied research in four areas: Agro Bio Resources for Soldier Survival, Harnessing Environment for Soldier Survival, Defence Waste Management and Human Cognition Studies.

Project Associate-I (others who do not fall under (i) above)

content_sections.heading: What Happens on the Day
content_sections.text: Selection for NIH Roorkee Project Associate-I is made through the walk-in interview. Candidates can come directly to NIH on the set date and time with the documents listed above. No one will be admitted once the interview has started. No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview. Candidates from outside Roorkee must arrange their own boarding and lodging.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: The appointment is for one year and is likely to be extended until the project closes in June 2029. The first term and any extension will be decided case by case, depending on the job and the time needed to finish it. Selected candidates will be engaged for a fixed period to provide high-quality services to the institute for specific, time-bound jobs. The appointment is full-time. The appointee may not take up any other assignment during the consultancy with NIH. The appointment is purely temporary and co-terminus. It gives no claim, implicit or explicit, to any NIH post, and the institute can cancel it at any time without giving a reason. No TA/DA will be paid for joining the appointment, which is on a contract basis. The selected candidate will get TA/DA for official travel within India.

The project runs under Principal Investigator Dr. Sagar Khadanga, Additional Professor, Department of General Medicine, AIIMS Bhopal.

content_sections.heading: Posts and Eligibility
content_sections.text: AIIMS Bhopal has 02 posts of Project Technical Assistant (Project Technical Support – III as per ICMR nomenclature), both shown as UR. The place of posting is AIIMS Bhopal. The essential qualification follows the ICMR guidelines for Project Technical Support – III and is either of the following: Three years Graduate degree in relevant subject/field + three years post-qualification experience; OR Post Graduate degree in relevant subject/field. Good understanding of the healthcare delivery system. Research/field work experience in public health projects. Good working knowledge of computer applications, such as MS Word and Excel. Excellent verbal & written communication skills. The essential qualifications are as per the ICMR Guidelines for Non-Institutional Project Human Resource Positions, as amended vide letter No. 16/29/2023/Admn dated 18.10.2024. All educational qualifications and certificates shall be from a recognised Board/University. Experience shall be preferably from Government organisations and is counted after the date of completion of the minimum essential qualification. Experience in the relevant field/area, as required for the project, will be considered. All community certificates shall be issued by the authorised officers of the Government. The prescribed qualifications are the minimum, and meeting them does not guarantee selection. The age limit is a maximum of 35 years as on the date of walk-in (10 November 2026). Age relaxation is admissible for SC/ST/OBC candidates, retrenched Government employees, departmental candidates (including projects) and ex-servicemen, in accordance with instructions issued by the Central Government from time to time. As per ICMR guidelines, the Head of the Institution may also grant an age relaxation of up to 5 years, on a case-to-case basis, to deserving candidates with experience of working in Government Research Organisations. The remuneration of Rs. 35,000/- per month is consolidated, as per the sanction of the funding agency, and includes HRA. No other allowances are paid. Paid leave is 1.5 days per completed month of engagement, as per ICMR guidelines. The tenure is 8 months. The post is purely temporary and co-terminus with the project (up to 20/05/2027), subject to satisfactory performance and continuation of funding. Any extension depends on the funding agency extending the project. The appointment gives no claim to a regular post at AIIMS Bhopal or at the funding agency (DHR/MoHFW). The Principal Investigator may extend or end the employment. The contract ends automatically at the end of the specified period unless it is renewed, and either party can end it with 30 days' notice or salary in lieu thereof. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post.

content_sections.heading: What to Bring
content_sections.text: Incomplete or incorrect applications will be rejected. A valid email ID and mobile number are mandatory for communication.

content_sections.heading: What Happens on the Day
content_sections.text: Updates on the walk-in written test/interview and the results will be posted on the AIIMS Bhopal website. No individual intimation will be sent.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: No TA/DA is paid for attending the test or interview. The Institute will not provide accommodation. Any misinformation at any stage may lead to legal action, disqualification or termination. A selected candidate may still be disqualified during document verification if the essential criteria are not met. Any form of canvassing or submission of false information will lead to disqualification. The decision of the competent authority in the selection process is final. Candidates are expected to follow the institute's rules and disciplinary conduct. All disputes will be subject to the jurisdiction of courts in Bhopal. For further information, contact [email protected] .

content_sections.heading: DIAT Job Description
content_sections.text: Selected candidates are required to perform specific roles according to their departments and specializations: Post Code 01 (Professor - School of Quantum Technology): Expertise in developing methods and devices for high sensitivity quantum sensing of magnetic fields, rotation, and gravity; design and development of advanced experimental platforms for quantum optics and quantum technologies, and advanced training based on them; expertise in quantum sensing and metrology with atomic vapours and laser-cooled atoms; quantum sensing with non-invasive quantum measurements and weak measurements; experience in precision optical and interferometric measurements. Post Code 02 (Assistant Professor - Aerospace Engineering & Autonomous Systems): UAV Design / Aircraft Design / Missile Design : UAV/Drone Design and Development, Aircraft Conceptual and preliminary Design, Missile configuration and System Design, Multidisciplinary Design Optimization. Post Code 03 (Assistant Professor - Electronics Engineering): VLSI & Embedded System / Semiconductor IC Design/Hardware Security. Post Code 04 (Assistant Professor - Joint appointment, Electronics Engineering jointly with School of Defence Technology & Management): Communication (Digital / Wireless / Mobile / Satellite) Electronic Warfare/ Advanced Modulation and Coding. Post Code 05 (Assistant Professor - Joint appointment, School of Defence Technology & Management jointly with Aerospace Engineering & Autonomous Systems): Advanced UAV design & integration, counter UAV technologies, simulation & autonomous navigation, Proficiency in software-in-the-Loop and Hardware-in-the-Loop simulation, Autonomous flight control algorithms, Prognostics and Health management for UAVs. Post Code 06 (Professor of Practice - Aerospace Engineering and Autonomous Systems): Area of Specialization: Missile Guidance and Control, Aircraft Control and Control of Robotic Systems. Essential Expertise: Working and research experience in the areas of missile, aircraft and robotic control. Post Code 07 (Professor of Practice - Electronics Engineering): Area of Specialization: SONAR system design, Radar systems, SONAR / Radar signal processing, Underwater acoustic communication, Array signal processing, Communication systems, EMI/EMC, Hardware security & cryptology, VLSI & Embedded systems, Semiconductor IC design, Electronic warfare, Detection and estimation theory. Essential Expertise: Working, research and hands-on experience in any of the above areas.

CPM/PM (Mechanical) to fill at its Ahmedabad Unit on deputation basis, for IRSME officers of Indian Railways. CPM (AGM Level): Central/State Govt. officers working in analogous grade (Level-13A) in the relevant discipline or in Selection Grade (Level-13) with minimum 12 years in Group A in the relevant discipline or in Rs. 90000-240000 (IDA) (E6) with four years' service in the grade. content_sections.heading: DFCCIL Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: Planning and monitoring enroute examination of IR stock and maintenance of DFC owned rolling stock in co-ordination with IR. Co-ordinate for safe & trouble-free working of crew on DFC network in co-ordination with IR. Develop and implement strategies for locomotive troubleshooting. Co-ordination with IR for restoration work in case of accidents, derailments or liquidation of IR stock marked sick on DFC network. Develop emergency response team/equipment for early restoration of traffic in case of rolling stock defect enroute. Planning and deployment of wayside equipment/diagnostic technologies, preferably AI driven technologies for rolling stock. Data analytics captured through DFIS, FMM, FOIS, SLAM, CMS to formulate and implement strategies to minimise failures and detentions of rolling stock on DFC network. Maintenance and calibration of EFWMBs wherever applicable.

Attested APARs ratings for the last five years (for proper appreciation of APARs, the organisation should forward its guidelines for rating criteria). VIGILANCE/D&AR clearance. Certificate advising requisite information about the employee, which may be issued by the officer empowered to forward the application, as per the format enclosed.

The overview below summarizes the vacancies, qualifications, age, stipend, training period, eligibility restrictions, application process, selection procedure and official contact details. Important: These are apprenticeship training positions, not regular permanent KMRL employment. The vacancy count is indicative and may change according to company requirements and statutory provisions.

application_fee.details: Kochi Metro Rail Limited has confirmed that there is no application fee for the Apprenticeship Programme 2026-27.

age_limit.details: KMRL requires apprenticeship applicants to have completed 18 years of age. Candidates below 18 years are not eligible.

qualification.details: Candidates applying for Kochi Metro Rail Apprenticeship Recruitment 2026 must have completed the relevant qualification through a full-time regular course from a government-recognized institution. Educational qualifications obtained through part-time, correspondence, distance education or online modes are not accepted. | Applicants must have completed a full-time regular four-year B.Tech or B.E. degree in one of the engineering disciplines notified by KMRL. | Applicants must possess a full-time regular three-year degree in BBA, B.Com or BCA from a recognized institution. | Candidates must possess a full-time regular three-year engineering diploma in the relevant notified discipline. | Applicants must have completed a full-time regular ITI course in the relevant advertised trade. | Candidates must have passed the qualifying examination within five years from the application closing date of 10 November 2026. The notification also requires candidates to be medically fit under the provisions of the Apprentices Act, 1961. | Candidates awaiting final examination results. Candidates who have not completed 18 years of age. Candidates who have already undergone apprenticeship training in any organization for any duration. Candidates currently undergoing apprenticeship training. Candidates whose qualification was obtained through part-time education. Candidates holding correspondence, distance education or online-mode qualifications. Candidates who do not meet the prescribed qualification or medical fitness requirements.

salary_details.details: The monthly stipend depends on the apprentice's qualification category. Graduate apprentices receive Rs. 12,300, diploma apprentices Rs. 10,900 and ITI trade apprentices Rs. 9,600. An additional Rs. 1,200 per month is payable as food/messing allowance. | The notification states that Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) under the NATS scheme will provide Rs. 6,150 for graduate apprentices and Rs. 5,450 for diploma apprentices. The remaining applicable stipend will be paid through KMRL's arrangements, as prescribed. | The DBT amounts form part of the notified monthly stipends and are not additional payments.

selection_process: The KMRL Apprenticeship Recruitment 2026 selection process does not include a written examination or interview. Candidates will be shortlisted from the applications received and called for verification of original documents and certificates.

Application Screening: KMRL will review applications for completeness and eligibility. Shortlisting: Eligible candidates will be shortlisted for document verification. Certificate Verification: Candidates must present their original qualification

identity and other prescribed documents. Medical Fitness and Police Verification: Selected candidates must satisfy the applicable requirements before engagement. Apprenticeship Contract: Engagement will require acceptance of the tripartite apprenticeship contract through the NATS/NAPS system.
Incomplete or ineligible applications will be rejected without individual intimation.
how_to_apply: KMRL has prescribed a two-stage application process. Candidates must first obtain the applicable NAPS or NATS registration number and then submit the completed Apprentice Bio-Data Form with required documents to the KMRL office.
ITI candidates must register as Candidate/Student on the NAPS portal at https://apprenticeshipindia.gov.in/.
Graduate and Diploma candidates must enrol under NATS at https://nats.education.gov.in/.
Complete or update the applicant profile on the applicable portal.
Upload the required qualification and supporting documents.
Obtain the NAPS/NATS registration or enrolment number.
Download or print the Apprentice Bio-Data Form attached to the official notification.
Enter the NAPS/NATS registration or enrolment number.
Select the applicable apprenticeship category and trade or discipline.
Complete the personal, educational and contact details in CAPITAL LETTERS as instructed.
Affix a passport-size photograph.
Fill in the educational qualification information and sign the declaration.
Attach the prescribed documents, including proof of NAPS/NATS registration.
Submit or send the completed application in the attached format to the KMRL office address.
Ensure the application reaches the prescribed office within the notified application period.

content_sections.heading: Kochi Metro Rail Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Candidates applying for Kochi Metro Rail Apprenticeship Recruitment 2026 must have completed the relevant qualification through a full-time regular course from a government-recognized institution. Educational qualifications obtained through part-time, correspondence, distance education or online modes are not accepted. Applicants must have completed a full-time regular four-year B.Tech or B.E. degree in one of the engineering disciplines notified by KMRL. Applicants must possess a full-time regular three-year degree in BBA, B.Com or BCA from a recognized institution. Candidates must possess a full-time regular three-year engineering diploma in the relevant notified discipline. Applicants must have completed a full-time regular ITI course in the relevant advertised trade. Candidates must have passed the qualifying examination within five years from the application closing date of 10 November 2026. The notification also requires candidates to be medically fit under the provisions of the Apprentices Act, 1961. Candidates awaiting final examination results. content_sections.heading: Kochi Metro Rail Apprentice Stipend 2026
content_sections.text: The monthly stipend depends on the apprentice's qualification category. Graduate apprentices receive Rs. 12,300, diploma apprentices Rs. 10,900 and ITI trade apprentices Rs. 9,600. An additional Rs. 1,200 per month is payable as food/messing allowance. The notification states that Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) under the NATS scheme will provide Rs. 6,150 for graduate apprentices and Rs. 5,450 for diploma apprentices. The remaining applicable stipend will be paid through KMRL's arrangements, as prescribed. The DBT amounts form part of the notified monthly stipends and are not additional payments.

content_sections.text: Selected candidates will undergo apprenticeship training for a period of one year from their date of joining. The training will end automatically upon completion of the one-year period, and no extension is permitted.

content_sections.heading: About NDC
content_sections.text: The National Defence College is located at 6 - Tees January Marg, New Delhi and functions under the Ministry of Defence, Government of India. The Consultant (SME) will support the NDC course, and according to the Terms of Reference the Consultant engaged at NDC would be working as Senior Directing Staff for all practical purposes.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Qualification: NDC course or equivalent, with expertise in National Security & Strategies. Profile: The candidate must be a practitioner-scholar with preferably a PhD degree, an outstanding professional record within national security establishments, and a distinguished academic and publishing record. Additional qualifying requirements: Necessary teaching and research assignments in India and/or abroad. Knowledge and ability: Candidates would need to demonstrate a sound knowledge of the national security system and possess the ability to suitably mentor operational practitioners undergoing the NDC course. Age limit: Age of the candidate should not be more than 65 years as on 31 December 2027. The notice does not mention any age relaxation. For the full eligibility conditions of the post, candidates should check the official notification.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The maximum monthly remuneration of the Consultant (SME), depending upon pay level, is Rs 65,000/- (Rupees Sixty-Five Thousand only) to Rs. 80,000/- (Rupees Eighty Thousand only). TDS as admissible will be deducted from the monthly remuneration, and the concerned Drawing and Disbursing Officer will issue a TDS certificate on demand.

content_sections.heading: NDC Consultant (SME) Job Description
content_sections.text: Under the Terms of Reference (Annexure-II), the Consultant (SME) would be expected to carry out the following minimum tasks: Conduct Integrated Analysis Group (IAG) meetings. Conduct one of the modules as assigned by the College. Guide the Course Members (up to a maximum of 18 members) assigned to him/her in selection of topics, completion of thesis and their internal evaluation/assessment, including viva voce. Attend selected lectures, panel discussions and presentations conducted as part of training activity and promulgated in the weekly training programme of NDC. Assess all written assignments submitted by the assigned Course Members, including recommendation for publication in NDC Journal. Supervise presentations given by the assigned Course Members. Attend all faculty meetings and other deliberations organised in connection with running of the NDC course. Tasks are to be completed as per the published Block Calendar and weekly training programme for the current NDC course.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for NDC Consultant (SME)
content_sections.text: Recent passport size photograph Copy of retirement order Copy of last pay drawn Copy of education/technical qualification certificate/mark sheet Copy of PPO Brief particulars of experience of the last 10 years (assignment-wise) – a separate sheet may be annexed The form also asks for date of birth, contact details, address for communication, date of joining government service, age, whether SC/ST/OBC, whether physically handicapped, the Ministry/Department/Organisation from which retired, and details of computer knowledge.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Applications completed in all respects will be screened by a Screening-cum-Selection Committee of three members: the Commandant, NDC (Chairman), the Senior most Senior Directing Staff, NDC (Member) and the Secretary, NDC (Member). The Committee shall hold a personal interaction with the shortlisted candidates, if required. Selection would be purely on merit in accordance with qualification and experience, and the decision of the Committee is final. The selected candidate will receive an offer letter with the terms and conditions of engagement, and no Consultant (SME) is allowed to join without first submitting an undertaking accepting those terms.

exam_pattern.details: The written examination consists of multiple-choice questions (MCQs) in English only, carrying 1 mark per question with no negative marking. Duration is 80 minutes.

syllabus.details: General Knowledge & Reasoning: Current affairs (national/international), awareness of events, Indian history, Indian freedom movement, art & culture, geography, economics, general polity and constitution, awards and honors, sports, gender and weaker sections sensitivity, environmental issues, common abbreviations, current technological developments, Ladakh history, art, culture, geography, and current affairs. faq.answer: MGUVV Recruitment 2026 is an official recruitment drive conducted by Mahatma Gandhi Udyanikee Evam Vanikee Vishwavidyalaya, Durg, Chhattisgarh, to hire eligible candidates for 50 vacant posts of Dean, Assistant Professor, and Assistant Librarian.

faq.answer: Candidates require a Master's Degree in the concerned discipline with at least 55% marks (or equivalent grade) with a good academic record, along with passing the NET examination conducted by ICAR/UGC/CSIR (or holding a Ph.D. as per UGC regulations).

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for Assistant Professor and Assistant Librarian posts?
faq.answer: The applicant's age shall not be more than 35 years for the post of Assistant Professor/Assistant Librarian, with age relaxations applicable for bonafide residents of Chhattisgarh belonging to SC, ST, OBC, women, and Divyang categories as per C.G. Govt. rules.

faq.answer: The maximum age limit for appointment to the post of Dean shall be 62 years as on the last date for submission of application.

faq.answer: The application fee is Rs. 1000/- for UR and OBC candidates, while it is Rs. 500/- for SC and ST candidates.

faq.answer: Candidates can apply online through the official university website at mguvv.ac.in by filling out the application form, uploading necessary certificates and documents, and paying the required fee online.

faq.question: Q9. Is the post of Dean permanent or on contract?
faq.answer: The appointment to the post of Dean is on a tenure basis for a period up to 05 years or till attaining the age of superannuation (62 years), whichever is earlier.

faq.question: Q10. What are the selection criteria and scorecard weightage for Assistant Professor?
faq.answer: Selection is based on a scorecard system totaling 100 marks, which includes educational qualifications and examinations passed (55 marks), academic excellence (10 marks), performance in co-curricular activities (02 marks), publications/research excellence (08 marks), experience (05 marks), knowledge of agro-ecological/climatic conditions of Chhattisgarh (05 marks), and personal interview by the selection committee (15 marks).

content_sections.heading: DTU Research Score Requirements 2026
content_sections.text: Applicants must meet the minimum research score specified for their post and provide evidence supporting all claimed research achievements. The notification identifies the following activities for calculating academic and research scores. Research papers published in eligible indexed or approved journals. Books authored and eligible translation works. Innovative teaching pedagogy, curricula, MOOCs and electronic content. Research guidance and completed or ongoing research projects. Consultancy activities. Patents, policy documents, awards and fellowships. Invited lectures, seminars, conferences and eligible conference publications. The detailed score must be calculated according to Annexure-II and the criteria referenced from the UGC Notification dated 18 July 2018.

content_sections.heading: DTU Academic and Research Screening Score 2026
content_sections.text: The university evaluates candidates using Academic Record and Experience and Research Performance scores for shortlisting. The academic record is initially assessed using a 50-point schedule and scaled down to 20 points. Experience and research performance are initially assessed using a separate 50-point schedule and scaled down to 40 points. Important: The detailed marks awarded for publications, patents, research projects and related achievements depend on authorship, publication category, project value and other criteria in the notification. Candidates must calculate the score using the prescribed table rather than claiming the maximum points automatically.

content_sections.heading: DTU Recruitment 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: DTU will select candidates through eligibility screening, academic and research evaluation, document and point verification, teaching presentation and interview. Online application and submission of the required printed documents. Initial scrutiny under the discipline-specific Recruitment Rules. Publication of provisional eligibility lists. Consideration of candidates' representations, where applicable. Shortlisting based on Academic Record and Experience and Research Performance scores. Original Document and Point Mark Verification. Presentation assessing teaching aptitude and ability. Interview evaluating domain knowledge and interview performance. Final selection according to the prescribed assessment criteria. The university normally calls 10 candidates for the first vacancy and five candidates for each subsequent vacancy for interview, subject to recruitment requirements. Shortlisting for document verification is based on the combined 60-point score for Academic Record and Experience and Research Performance. Candidates tied at the shortlisting cut-off may also be included in the provisional shortlist according to the notification. Candidates shortlisted for verification must produce original certificates and relevant supporting evidence for the academic and research points claimed. If a candidate has not uploaded or attached evidence for a claimed assessment component, the university will award zero points for that component. Candidates unable to produce the required original documents will not be permitted to participate in the presentation and interview stages. Candidates successfully completing document and point verification must attend: Presentation: Assessment of teaching aptitude and ability. Interview: Assessment of domain knowledge and interview performance. Final selection takes account of academic record, experience, research performance, teaching aptitude, domain knowledge and interview performance.

content_sections.heading: About JMI Faculty of Dentistry
content_sections.text: The Faculty of Dentistry is a faculty of Jamia Millia Islamia, a university in New Delhi (PIN 110025). This notice offers the one-year BDS internship there to students from other dental institutions. The internship is run under the Ordinances of Jamia Millia Islamia.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Use the prescribed application form attached to the notice and submit it with the required documents to this address: Office of the Dean, Faculty of Dentistry, Jamia Millia Islamia, New Delhi-110025. The deadline is 16 November 2026, 04:00 PM. The notice says the Institute will not be responsible for any delay in postal delivery or in delivery through any other agency, so the application has to reach the office by that time. The notice does not say what to write on the envelope. The application form has these parts: Personal details: name of the student, father's name, date of birth, nationality, religion, marital status, whether you belong to OBC/SC/ST, address for correspondence, email ID and mobile number. Academic details: the name and full address of the institution where you are doing the BDS Programme, the name and address of the affiliated university, the date you joined the BDS Programme and the date you passed the final BDS Examination. Reason and documents: your reason for seeking internship at Jamia, and a list of the documents and certificates you have attached (you may add extra sheets). Detail of BDS Examination Passed: for each year (I, II, III and Final) and each paper (Paper No. I to VIII), give the subject name, the number of extra attempts, the percentage of marks in the subject and any distinction or medal in the subject. Then give the overall percentage. Photo and undertaking: paste a self-attested photograph on the form, then sign the undertaking and write your name in block letters. In the undertaking you declare that your statements are true. If facts are found to be hidden or misrepresented at any stage, your candidature for internship may be cancelled without any liability on Jamia Millia Islamia.

It must also certify that it was not de-recognised by the National Dental Commission at any time from your admission until you passed out. University permission: you need permission from the university your college is affiliated to. Stipend: the prescribed stipend of ₹3000/- only per month. Training fee: ₹1,75,000/- (Rs. One Lakh and seventy five thousand only), paid only if you are selected. Pay it by Demand Draft in favour of "Registrar, JMI", payable at New Delhi, before the internship starts. The fee will be non-refundable after the training period starts. Duration: one year, as per the NDC guideline. Part internship is not permissible, and selected candidates undertake not to ask for an extension of the internship period. Rules: the internship is governed by the provisions of the Ordinances of Jamia Millia Islamia. For the full eligibility conditions, see the official notification.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Attach these documents to the application. They come from the notice and its checklist of documents: An application giving your reasons for wanting to do the internship at the Faculty of Dentistry, JMI, with documentary proof. Self-attested photocopies of the marksheets of all BDS Annual Examinations (each part/year). An attempt certificate issued by the University/College, showing the number of attempts and the percentage of marks in each part/year. A No Objection Certificate from your parent institution, covering its recognition as described above. Permission from the university your college is affiliated to, allowing you to do the internship at the Faculty of Dentistry, JMI, subject to selection. A certificate of good character and conduct from your parent institution. Documentary evidence of any distinction or medal awarded in any subject in a University Examination. An undertaking with three parts: (a) you are prepared to do the internship on the stipend of ₹3000/- per month and will deposit ₹1,75,000/- as the fee if selected; (b) you will follow the rules and regulations of the Faculty of Dentistry, JMI's internship program and will not ask for an extension; (c) you will maintain good conduct, discipline and decorum, and you accept that the University authorities have the right to expel you for misconduct, indiscipline or unsatisfactory work without any liability on the University. basic_details.job_title: SVNIT Professor Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: Sardar Vallabhbhai National Institute of Technology, Surat (SVNIT) has announced recruitment for 5 Professor vacancies under advertisement number Estt. /2026/ Prof/1600. Eligible candidates applying for the Professor post must possess a Ph.D. in relevant discipline with first class in preceding degrees, with appointments made on probation for a period of one year at Pay Level 14A. Applicants must complete the online application process starting from 18 October 2026 up to 2 December 2026 (5:00 p.m.), and also send the printout of the signed application along with self-attested supporting docume

application_fee.details: The non-refundable application processing fee must be paid online through the recruitment portal. Fees once paid are non-refundable under any circumstances.

age_limit.details: Fresh appointment beyond the age of 60 years is discouraged except for candidates with exceptional research and ongoing or approved externally funded research projects. The date for determining eligibility in all respects, including the preferred age limit, qualification, and experience, is the closing date of the online application (02.12.2026).

post_wise_qualification.essential_qualification: Ph.D. in the relevant discipline and first class in the preceding degrees (Bachelor’s Degree onwards). Where first class is not mentioned, at least 6.5 CGPA (on a 10-point scale) or 60% marks in aggregate is required.

qualification.details: All degrees must be from an Institute/University recognized by UGC, AICTE, AIU, or GOI. Foreign degrees are accepted if from national universities or institutions ranked up to 500 in QS/THE World Rankings. For candidates with a Ph.D. from SVNIT Surat, a three-year inbreeding gap between Ph.D. notification and the application deadline applies (not applicable to existing SVNIT faculty).

how_to_apply: Open the online recruitment portal at https://svnitrec.samarth.edu.in/ between 18.10.2026 and 02.12.2026 (up to 5.00 p.m.).
Complete the online application form and fill in the credit point summary sheet and details sheet.
Upload a recent colour passport-size photograph (taken within 3 months, without cap, scarf, or sunglasses) along with relevant certificates.
Pay the non-refundable processing fee of ₹1000 online, if applicable.
Submit the online form and download the completed application form along with the credit point summary sheet.
Number and sign all pages of the printed application form, and write the total number of pages on the first page.
Enclose self-attested copies of all testimonials, educational certificates, experience certificates, category proof, and fee payment proof.
Place the documents in an envelope superscribed as "Advertisement No. Estt. /2026/ Prof/1600, Dated 16.10.2026, Department of [Name of Department], Application ID no. [ID]".

Send the packet so as to reach the Deputy Registrar (Establishment), Sardar Vallabhbhai National Institute of Technology, Ichchhanath, Dumas Road, Surat – 395 007, Gujarat on or before 09.12.2026 (5:00 p.m.).

content_sections.heading: Department-wise Vacancies
content_sections.text: The total number of tentative vacancies for the post of Professor across the departments is 5: 01 (UR), 01 (SC), and 03 (ST). The number of posts may vary at the time of final selection or recruitment.

content_sections.heading: Qualification and Experience
content_sections.text: All degrees must be from an Institute/University recognized by UGC, AICTE, AIU, or GOI. Foreign degrees are accepted if from national universities or institutions ranked up to 500 in QS/THE World Rankings. For candidates with a Ph.D. from SVNIT Surat, a three-year inbreeding gap between Ph.D. notification and the application deadline applies (not applicable to existing SVNIT faculty).

rows.qualification: Ph.D. in the relevant discipline and first class in the preceding degrees (Bachelor’s Degree onwards). Where first class is not mentioned, at least 6.5 CGPA (on a 10-point scale) or 60% marks in aggregate is required.
rows.experience: As per Schedule ‘E’ of the NIT Statute published on 24th July 2017. Experience at the level of Associate Professor with AGP ₹9000 and/or ₹9500 (Pay Level 13A1 and/or 13A2). More than six months of experience in a regular position in CFTI / Institute of national importance / state government funded institute or university / centrally funded lab and organization under CSIR, DRDO, DAE, DBT, DST, DSIR, ISRO, MOCIT, MOEF, MNRE, MOP, MOWR, NPL etc., educational institutions ranked by NIRF up to 100 in overall/Universities/Engineering for any two years, foreign institutions/universities in QS/THE world ranking up to 500, or industrial experience in PSU, autonomous organization, or private industry with turnover of more than ₹500 crores.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: The post carries Pay Level 14A of the Pay Matrix, with basic pay ranging from ₹159,100 to ₹220,200 per month along with admissible allowances. All appointments are made on probation for a period of one year, wherever applicable. On successful completion and confirmation, appointees hold office until the age of superannuation specified by the Ministry of Education, Government of India. Additional benefits include Cumulative Professional Development Allowance (CPDA), provision for industrial consultancy, children's tuition fee reimbursement up to Class XII, LTC, medical facilities for self and dependent family, campus accommodation with nominal licence fee or HRA, coverage under the National Pension System (NPS-2004), and reimbursement of telephone and data charges.

content_sections.heading: SVNIT Professor Age Limit
content_sections.text: Fresh appointment beyond the age of 60 years is discouraged except for candidates with exceptional research and ongoing or approved externally funded research projects. The date for determining eligibility in all respects, including the preferred age limit, qualification, and experience, is the closing date of the online application (02.12.2026).

content_sections.text: The non-refundable application processing fee must be paid online through the recruitment portal. Fees once paid are non-refundable under any circumstances.

qualification.details: Qualifications and experience follow the Four-Tier Flexible Faculty Structure as per Ministry of Education guidelines (F.No.27-11/2011 TS.1 dated 23 April 2014). All degrees acquired by the applicant must be from an Institute / University recognized by the UGC/AICTE/AIU/GOI. All applicants shall have a Ph.D. in the relevant or equivalent discipline and First Class in the preceding degrees (Bachelor's Degree onwards). In case First Class is not mentioned in the preceding degrees by the University/Institution, candidates should have passed and secured at least 6.5 CGPA (on a 10-point scale) or 60% marks in aggregate. Conversion from CGPA to percentage or vice versa given by an individual Institute/University will not be considered or allowed for determination of eligibility. | Other Essential Requirements: None. Additional Desirable Requirements: One publication in an SCI Journal. | Other Essential Requirements: One paper accepted for publication in an SCI Journal. Additional Desirable Requirements: Two papers in SCI Journals or one patent; may be based on Ph.D. work. | Other Essential Requirements: 04 papers in SCI journals after Ph.D.; one Ph.D. guided as sole or principal supervisor plus one continuing; two projects ongoing or one ongoing plus one completed; two experiments or computational projects added to teaching laboratories where appropriate; academic outreach activity equivalent to two self-financed short-term courses. Additional Desirable Requirements: 01 or more patents; supervising two or more students for Ph.D.; strong liaison with industry; offering courses through application of ICT. | For Engineering: B.E./B.Tech. or equivalent and M.E./M.Tech. or equivalent degree in the relevant discipline. Candidates possessing a Ph.D. directly after B.Tech./B.E. from reputed institutions are also considered provided they have First Class at the Bachelor's level. For Mathematics: First Class at both UG and PG levels (60% marks or 6.5/10 CGPA) with Ph.D. in the relevant discipline. Countable Experience: Only experience rendered on a regular basis in applicable pay scales as per UGC, AICTE, Government of India, or PSUs is counted. Experience rendered on part-time, ad-hoc, daily wage, visiting, guest faculty, fixed remuneration, contractual, or temporary basis will not be considered. Equal Treatment: There shall be no distinction between external and internal candidates with regard to the requirements of qualification and experience. content_sections.heading: About IIIT Sonepat Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Indian Institute of Information Technology Sonepat is an Institute of National Importance established in 2014 under the provisions of the Indian Institute of Information Technology PPP- Act, 2017. The institute has its permanent campus at Kilohrad, Sonepat, and operates from its office at IIT Delhi Sonepat Campus, I-Tech Technopark Plot No 4 Rajiv Gandhi Education City, Rai, Sonipat, Haryana. The institute is dedicated to imparting high-quality technical education and cultivating a rigorous culture of innovation and research in Information Technology and its allied disciplines.

content_sections.heading: Department-wise Vacancies
content_sections.text: A total of 6 vacancies for the post of Assistant Professor are advertised across Pay Levels 10, 11, and 12 without a predetermined number earmarked for any specific Pay Level. Candidates fulfilling the prescribed criteria may submit separate applications for each Pay Level. The institute also follows horizontal reservation in case of PwD candidates. Computer Science and Engineering / IT / CSE (DSA) / CSE (AI): Full Stack Development, Enterprise Java, Blockchain, High-Performance Computing, Industrial Internet of Things, Machine Learning, Advanced Data Structure and Algorithm, Deep Learning, Natural Language Processing, Artificial Intelligence, Computer Vision, Data Analytics, Quantum Computing, Web Technologies, Generative AI. Electronics and Communication Engineering: VLSI, IoT, Embedded System, Quantum Computing, Semiconductor Devices, Visible Light Communication, 5G/6G & Wireless, RF Systems. Mathematics: Mathematics for Data Science, Applied Mathematics, Scientific Computing, Optimization Techniques, Computational Complexity, Numerical Linear Algebra.

content_sections.heading: Qualification and Experience
content_sections.text: Qualifications and experience follow the Four-Tier Flexible Faculty Structure as per Ministry of Education guidelines (F.No.27-11/2011 TS.1 dated 23 April 2014). All degrees acquired by the applicant must be from an Institute / University recognized by the UGC/AICTE/AIU/GOI. All applicants shall have a Ph.D. in the relevant or equivalent discipline and First Class in the preceding degrees (Bachelor's Degree onwards). In case First Class is not mentioned in the preceding degrees by the University/Institution, candidates should have passed and secured at least 6.5 CGPA (on a 10-point scale) or 60% marks in aggregate. Conversion from CGPA to percentage or vice versa given by an individual Institute/University will not be considered or allowed for determination of eligibility. Other Essential Requirements: None. Additional Desirable Requirements: One publication in an SCI Journal. Other Essential Requirements: One paper accepted for publication in an SCI Journal. Additional Desirable Requirements: Two papers in SCI Journals or one patent; may be based on Ph.D. work. Other Essential Requirements: 04 papers in SCI journals after Ph.D.; one Ph.D. guided as sole or principal supervisor plus one continuing; two projects ongoing or one ongoing plus one completed; two experiments or computational projects added to teaching laboratories where appropriate; academic outreach activity equivalent to two self-financed short-term courses. Additional Desirable Requirements: 01 or more patents; supervising two or more students for Ph.D.; strong liaison with industry; offering courses through application of ICT. For Engineering: B.E./B.Tech. or equivalent and M.E./M.Tech. or equivalent degree in the relevant discipline. Candidates possessing a Ph.D. directly after B.Tech./B.E. from reputed institutions are also considered provided they have First Class at the Bachelor's level. For Mathematics: First Class at both UG and PG levels (60% marks or 6.5/10 CGPA) with Ph.D. in the relevant discipline. Countable Experience: Only experience rendered on a regular basis in applicable pay scales as per UGC, AICTE, Government of India, or PSUs is counted. Experience rendered on part-time, ad-hoc, daily wage, visiting, guest faculty, fixed remuneration, contractual, or temporary basis will not be considered. Equal Treatment: There shall be no distinction between external and internal candidates with regard to the requirements of qualification and experience. Age Limit: Fresh appointment beyond the age of 60 years is discouraged except in the case of faculty with an exceptionally brilliant research career and with an ongoing or approved externally funded research project. The crucial date for determining eligibility and preferred age limit is 21 November 2026.

content_sections.heading: BEEI Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: The notice prints one list of duties and responsibilities for all the teacher posts: Set annual goals before the end of June every year and prepare an annual programme of work. Be present in the school 15 minutes before the commencement bell, attend the morning prayer and assist in maintaining discipline during it. Leave 15 minutes after the closure bell, after reporting to the HOI or Administrative Officer. Draw up daily lesson plans, study books relevant to the subject and use relevant teaching aids. Update computer skills and customised online teaching. Identify learning disabilities through diagnostic tests, chalk out a bridge course, and prepare an action plan and individual education plan (IEP) for remedial teaching. Engage classes as per the time table, with a lesson plan, so that students achieve the prescribed learning outcomes. Prepare a resourceful activity bank, use electronic media and facilitate participatory learning. Give meaningful homework, correct mistakes, guide needy students and report habitual defaulters to the HOI. Conduct periodical tests and examinations, evaluate performance, make entries in the marks card / SATS software, communicate with parents and help students who lag behind. Assist students to overcome mental blocks or other deficiencies by counselling or persuasive means, without resorting to punishment. Develop students' talents through programmes like elocution, essay writing, quiz, painting and sports meet, consulting the HOI / Administrative Officer. Be responsible for the overall academic and co-curricular performance of the class, completion of lessons, maintenance of registers and achievement of prescribed learning outcomes. Maintain the work done diary and documents pertaining to Continuous and Comprehensive Evaluation. Attend meetings of the institution unless exempted by the Head of the Institution, and assist the HOI in carrying out the HOI's duties. Participate in all functions, programmes and developmental activities organised by the school. Resolve genuine grievances of students and parents. Conduct extra classes even on holidays if the prescribed syllabus is not taught within the stipulated period. Engage extra classes in the absence of teachers on leave or OOD, and special classes for remedial teaching when entrusted by the HOI. Do not skip practical classes in the respective subjects; maintain a logbook of practicals. Complete any other work entrusted by the Management Committee, Administrative Officer and HOI, working in team spirit. Co-operate with colleagues, subordinates, superiors, students and parents for the smooth completion of curriculum activities. Discharge any additional work entrusted by the HOI, higher ups or Management within the time frame.

The written test carries 70% of the marks and the interview 30%. The venue for the written test and interview will be intimated through e-mail. Candidates who pass the written test will be called for interview in a 1:5 ratio. The names of candidates shortlisted for the written test or interview, and the final selections, will be notified on the BEEI website. Short listing is carried out purely on the information declared in the application form. Merely meeting the minimum qualification and experience gives no right to be called for the interview.

content_sections.heading: NLSIU Assistant Professor Recruitment 2026 Notification-wise Details
content_sections.text: The HAL Defence Public Sector Chair was established in 2012 through an endowment corpus from Hindustan Aeronautics Limited. The key objective of the Chair is to expand teaching and research on relevant areas of business laws, which include contracts management, defence sector procurement, dispute settlement, and environmental compliance among other areas. The Chair further seeks to strengthen academic learning and pedagogy, contribute to policy dialogue and reform, foster a community of world class researchers and academics, facilitate training programmes, hold national and regional convenings, and produce high-impact legal research. The Chair will be part of a dedicated team of faculty members working to advance learning and scholarship in the areas of contract law, property law, and other areas of business law intersecting with the defence sector. The responsibilities include: Teaching Deliver undergraduate and postgraduate courses; Supervise student assignments, submissions, and thesis (as required); Evaluate students through examinations, presentations, and assignments as required. Research Contribute to designing and expanding the research agenda of the Chair; Publish in academic journals, books, and media platforms; Develop research proposals and grant applications; Organise guest lectures, public talks, and panel discussions on subject areas of the Chair as required; Develop training programmes in the areas of contracts, dispute resolution, negotiations etc. with special reference to defence sector; Conceptualize and organize an annual conference on defence sector laws; Participate in stakeholder meetings and contribute to policy and reform dialogues as required. content_sections.heading: NLSIU Assistant Professor Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Eligibility is defined through Appendix A of each notification, titled “Minimum Qualifications for Recruitment to Regular Posts of Teachers in the University (per UGC Regulations, 2018)”. All six notifications require the Essential Qualifications in Section I. The two permanent-post notifications (Nos. 20/2026 and 21/2026) additionally refer to Section II.1. content_sections.heading: NLSIU Assistant Professor Qualification
content_sections.text: A Master’s Degree with at least 55% marks (or an equivalent grade in a point-scale, wherever the grading system is followed). A relaxation of 5% may be provided at the graduate and master’s level for the Scheduled Caste, Scheduled Tribe and Differently abled categories for the purpose of eligibility and for assessing good academic record during direct recruitment to teaching positions. A relaxation of 5% may be provided to the Ph.D Degree holders who obtained their Master’s Degree prior to 19 September 1991. The eligibility marks of 55% marks or an equivalent grade in a point scale prescribed by these regulations and the relaxation of 5% to the categories mentioned above are permissible, based on only the qualifying marks without including any grace mark procedures. Section II.1 is titled “Assistant Professor (Law)” in Notification No. 20/2026 and “Assistant Professor (Humanities & Social Sciences)” in Notification No. 21/2026. The conditions are the same in both and are given below as per the notifications. Option A: The candidate must have cleared the National Eligibility Test (NET) conducted by the UGC or the CSIR, or a similar test accredited by the UGC, like SLET/SET, subject to the following exemptions: OR Option B: The Ph.D degree has been obtained from a foreign university/institution with a ranking among the top 500 in the World University Ranking (at any time) by any one of the following: (i) Quacquarelli Symonds (QS), (ii) the Times Higher Education (THE) or (iii) the Academic Ranking of World Universities (ARWU) of the Shanghai Jiao Tong University (Shanghai). Notification Nos. 22/2026, 23/2026, 24/2026 and 25/2026 refer only to Section I of Appendix A. Section II.1 (NET/Ph.D. conditions) is not referenced in these four notifications. Section II.1 does not form part of the Appendix A attached to them.

Work experience certificate showing date of joining, relieving, duties and responsibilities, and the signature and seal of the authorised person. content_sections.heading: About NITTTR Bhopal Post Doctoral Fellow
content_sections.text: National Institute of Technical Teachers' Training and Research (NITTTR) Bhopal offers this Post Doctoral Fellowship specifically focused on the Indian Knowledge Systems (भारतीय ज्ञान परम्परा) tradition. The fellowship aims to promote advanced, high-quality research connecting traditional knowledge with modern research approaches in disciplines such as Indian Philosophy, Yoga, Ayurveda, Vedas, Sanskrit, Indian Literature, and Science.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates must possess a Doctorate (PhD) in a relevant field such as Indian Philosophy, Ayurveda, Yoga, Vedas, Sanskrit, Indian Literature, Science, or other disciplines related to Indian Knowledge Systems. The doctoral research must be focused on topics related to the Indian Knowledge System. Experience in conducting advanced, high-quality research post-PhD. Ability to undertake independent or collaborative research projects in the domain of Indian Knowledge Systems with demonstrated novelty and rigor. Research papers published in reputed national and international journals. Experience presenting research findings at conferences and seminars related to Indian traditional knowledge, with a strong command over Indian Knowledge Systems topics. Ability to work independently as well as part of a research team, with an understanding of how to connect traditional knowledge with modern research approaches. Interest in teaching or mentoring may be preferred but is not always mandatory. The upper age limit is 35 years. As per Government of India guidelines, a five-year age relaxation shall be provided to candidates belonging to SC, ST, and OBC categories, women, and persons with disabilities, as applicable under relevant rules.

basic_details.job_title: GMC Jalna Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 20 Professor, Associate Professor and More Posts
basic_details.short_information: Government Medical College, Jalna is filling 20 teaching posts on contract: 6 for Professor, 2 for Associate Professor and 12 for Assistant Professor, across 15 medical subjects. Applicants need an MD, MS or DNB in the subject and must be citizens of India living in Maharashtra. You hand the filled form in person at the college office by 5.00 pm on 12 November 2026, and interviews take place on 17 November 2026. The monthly consolidated pay is Rs. 1,00,000 to Rs. 2,00,000, depending on the post.

application_fee.details: The fee is Rs. 200/- for each application. You need a separate application for each post you apply for.

age_limit.details: Professor and Associate Professor: below 70 years. Candidates from private and other sectors can apply if they hold the qualifications prescribed by the National Medical Commission (NMC). Assistant Professor: 40 years for the open category and 45 years for backward classes. This follows Government Resolution MES-1508/94/08/MED dated 07.09.2011 and the NMC notifications of 14.02.2022 and 30.06.2025.

qualification.details: Professor and Associate Professor: below 70 years. Candidates from private and other sectors can apply if they hold the qualifications prescribed by the National Medical Commission (NMC). Assistant Professor: 40 years for the open category and 45 years for backward classes. This follows Government Resolution MES-1508/94/08/MED dated 07.09.2011 and the NMC notifications of 14.02.2022 and 30.06.2025. | You must be a citizen of India and a resident of Maharashtra. | An MD / MS / DNB postgraduate qualification in the subject, or an equivalent postgraduate qualification, from a recognised university. You must also be qualified under the norms of the Maharashtra Medical Council and the National Medical Commission, New Delhi (as per the notification of 30.06.2025). Registration under the Indian Medical Council Act, 1956, and valid registration with the Maharashtra State Medical Council under the 1965 Act. A certificate showing you have completed BCME and BCBR training, as per NMC norms. | Professor: 4 national and international research papers in total, 2 of them written while serving as Associate Professor (NMC notification of 30.06.2025). Associate Professor: 2 national and international research papers written while serving as Assistant Professor. | Professor: at least 3 years as Associate Professor in a medical college that is eligible under NMC norms. Associate Professor: at least 4 years as Assistant Professor in a medical college that is eligible under NMC norms. Assistant Professor: 1 year as Senior Resident. The subject table puts this as 1 year as Senior Resident or Tutor in the subject, in a recognised medical institution. | A postgraduate MD/MS/DNB degree in the subject, as per the notifications of 14.02.2022 and 30.06.2024. You should have completed the basic course in biomedical research, or be required to undergo it. You should have completed the basic course in Medical Education Technology from an NMC-designated institution, or be required to undergo it. | For the full subject-wise eligibility of each post, see the official notification.

how_to_apply: Download the blank application form from www.gmcjalna.org. It is available from 29 October 2026 to 12 November 2026.

Write the post you are applying for and fill in your details: name in capital letters, postal address, mobile number, email ID, date of birth, age, caste category, internship completion date, whether you are bonded or non-bonded, registration number, and up to three subject preferences.

Give your UG and PG qualifications (year of passing, college, university, M.M.C./M.C.I. registration with date), your aggregate marks in final M.B.B.S. and in the PG degree or diploma, and the number of attempts you took for each M.B.B.S. year.
List your research papers (national or international year of publication, first or second or corresponding author, indexing) and your teaching experience with dates.
Paste a photograph, sign the declaration and attach attested copies of your documents.
Hand in the application in person at the inward section of the Government Medical College, Jalna office by 5.00 pm on 12 November 2026. Public holidays are excluded.
