content_sections.heading: About GMC Jalna
content_sections.text: Government Medical College, Jalna is a Maharashtra Government medical college. It works under the Commissioner, Medical Education, Research and AYUSH, Mumbai, and the Directorate of Medical Education and Research, Mumbai. Its address is Global Gurukul School, opposite Sushiladevi Lawn, Ambad Mantha Road, Jalna - 431213. Its phone number is 02482-299907.

content_sections.heading: Application Fee
content_sections.text: The fee is Rs. 200/- for each application. You need a separate application for each post you apply for.

rows.event: Last date to hand in the form

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Candidates are selected through the Departmental Selection Board and the Local Selection Board, by interview. The interview starts at 11.00 am sharp on 17 November 2026 in the Dean's chamber at Government Medical College, Jalna. You must bring the originals of every document you attached to your application. You travel to the interview at your own cost, and no allowance is paid. For Professor and Associate Professor, the college accepts the applications, interviews the candidates and then sends the eligible candidates' applications to the Commissioner, Medical Education and Research, Mumbai, for the appointment process.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: The appointments follow Government Resolution LEC-2024/Pr.Kr.181/Vaiseva-3 dated 21 August 2024 and Government Resolution MES-1508/94/08/MED dated 07.09.2011.

faq.question: Q1. Which subjects have Assistant Professor vacancies at GMC Jalna?
faq.answer: There are 12 Assistant Professor posts: Anatomy 2, Biochemistry 2, Pharmacology 2, and 1 each in Physiology, Medicine, Skin & VD, ENT, Anaesthesiology and Radiology.

faq.question: Q2. Can I send the application by post or email?
faq.answer: No. You must hand in the filled form in person at the inward section of the college office, Global Gurukul School, opposite Sushiladevi Lawn, Ambad Mantha Road, Jalna - 431213.

faq.question: Q3. How much fee do I pay if I apply for two posts?
faq.answer: The fee is Rs. 200/- per application, and you apply separately for each post. Two posts means two applications, at Rs. 200/- each.

faq.question: Q4. What experience do I need for the Professor post?
faq.answer: At least 3 years as Associate Professor in an NMC-eligible medical college. You also need 4 national and international research papers, 2 of them from your time as Associate Professor.

faq.question: Q5. Do I need to be from Maharashtra?
faq.answer: Yes. You must be a citizen of India and a resident of Maharashtra, and you attach a domicile certificate with your form.

faq.question: Q6. Can I resign partway through the contract?
faq.answer: Not before the end of at least one academic session after your appointment. You must give an affidavit to this effect before you are appointed.

faq.question: Q7. What should I bring to the interview on 17 November 2026?
faq.answer: The originals of every document you attached to your application. The interview starts at 11.00 am sharp in the Dean's chamber, and no travel allowance is paid.

faq.question: Q8. Which training courses must Assistant Professor candidates have?
faq.answer: The basic course in biomedical research and the basic course in Medical Education Technology from an NMC-designated institution. You should have completed them or be required to undergo them.

faq.question: Q9. Will this contract post become permanent?
faq.answer: No. The appointment gives no claim to a regular post. It lasts 364 days or until a regular candidate is available, whichever comes first.

content_sections.heading: About IIIT Pune
content_sections.text: IIIT Pune describes itself as an "Institute of National Importance". It was set up by an act of Parliament under the Public Private Partnership (PPP) model, under the Ministry of Education, Government of India. The Institute runs B.Tech, M.Tech and Ph.D. programmes from its permanent campus in the foothills of the Western Ghats at Talegaon (Maval), Dist. Pune, Maharashtra - 410507.

content_sections.heading: IIIT Pune Assistant Professor Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: Nationality: Indian nationals, including Persons of Indian Origin and Overseas Citizens of India (OCIs). All new entrants must have a Ph.D. in the relevant or equivalent discipline and a first class in the preceding degree(s). If the university or institution does not specify what counts as first class, minimum 60% marks or 6.5 CGPA is treated as first class. Only continuous relevant experience on a regular scale of more than six months is counted. Candidates who obtained their Ph.D. from IIIT Pune are considered only if they have 3 years of outside experience after the Ph.D. Eligibility in all respects is judged on the closing date for online applications. Post-doctoral experience in reputed institutions in India or abroad is an added advantage. Industry professionals can also apply if they have substantial professional and R&D experience and a good number of quality publications in leading journals or patents in the relevant field. Departments consider the specialisations in Annexure-I when they shortlist. Annexure-III also awards points for administrative roles (such as HoD, Dean, Warden and committee chairs), workshops and FDPs, conferences organised, extra teaching, service beyond the minimum, outreach and placement results. The caps for these items are counted from the last appointment. For the discipline-specific eligibility of each post, see the official notification and its annexures.

faq.question: Q1. Can I apply for Grade-II without any experience?
faq.answer: Yes. Annexure-II lists Nil experience and Nil credit points for Assistant Professor Grade-II. You still need a Ph.D. in the relevant or equivalent discipline and a first class in your preceding degrees.

faq.question: Q2. How much experience is needed for Assistant Professor Grade-I?
faq.answer: You need 03 years after the Ph.D., or 06 years of total teaching and research experience in a reputed academic institute, R&D lab or relevant industry. You also need 20 cumulative credit points.

faq.question: Q3. What counts as first class if my university does not define it?
faq.answer: The notice treats minimum 60% marks or 6.5 CGPA as first class.

faq.question: Q4. Is the Grade-II post permanent?
faq.answer: No. It is purely contractual. The contract runs one year at a time and is renewed on performance, up to a maximum of 5 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the written test cut-off?
faq.answer: The cut-off is 35% for SC/ST/PWD candidates and 40% for all other categories. The test is qualifying only, and the final merit depends entirely on the presentation-cum-interview.

faq.question: Q6. Do women candidates pay a lower fee?
faq.answer: Yes. Female candidates pay the same as SC/ST/PwBD candidates: 1000 + GST 18%, which is Rs. 1180/-.

faq.question: Q7. I want to apply in two departments. Is one form enough?
faq.answer: No. You need a separate complete application and fee for each post or department. A single form covering more than one department is summarily rejected.

faq.question: Q8. Where do I send the hard copy?
faq.answer: Send it to The Registrar, Indian Institute of Information Technology Pune, PO – Talegaon, Pune, Maharashtra – 410507. It must arrive by 9 December 2026, 05:30 PM.

faq.question: Q9. I did my Ph.D. at IIIT Pune. Can I apply?
faq.answer: Only if you have 3 years of experience outside IIIT Pune after your Ph.D. This is the notice's in-breeding restriction.

faq.question: Q10. Will travel expenses be paid for the test or interview?

content_sections.text: All India Institute of Medical Sciences, Nagpur is an autonomous institute of national importance established under the Pradhan Mantri Swasthya Suraksha Yojana (PMSSY) by the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, Government of India. content_sections.heading: OAVS Vacancy 2026
content_sections.text: OAVS has notified 815 regular vacancies across 17 Principal and teaching post categories. The category-wise vacancy table includes UR, SEBC, SC and ST reservations along with women reservation. The notification also provides 15 vacancies for Ex-Servicemen and 6 vacancies under Sports Person reservation. PwD reservation includes 9 posts for Blindness and Low Vision, 9 for Hard of Hearing with suitable aids, 7 for Locomotor Disability and 7 for the specified combination of disability categories.

content_sections.heading: OAVS Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: A candidate must be a citizen of India, be of sound mind and must not have more than one spouse living. Candidates should have passed MIL Odia up to Middle English standard. Candidates who have not passed Odia up to M.E. standard may apply, but they must pass the prescribed Odia examination conducted by BSE Odisha within three years of joining. Candidates must have: Master's Degree from a recognized University with at least 45% aggregate marks. B.Ed. prescribed by NCTE from an NCTE-recognized institution affiliated to a recognized University. Required administrative/teaching experience as specified below. The prescribed experience can be fulfilled through any one of the notified routes: Holding an analogous post or Principal post in Central/State Government or an Autonomous Organization in the prescribed equivalent pay level. Vice-Principal/Assistant Education Officer with combined service of 3 years as PGT and 2 years as Vice-Principal. PGT/Lecturer with at least 7 years of regular service in the prescribed grade. 10 years combined regular service as TGT and PGT, including at least 3 years as PGT. For PGT English, Physics, Chemistry, Biology and Mathematics, candidates should have either a 2-year Integrated Post Graduate Course or Master's Degree in the concerned subject with at least 50% marks, or 45% for SC/ST/SEBC/PwD candidates, along with B.Ed. Candidates need at least 50% aggregate marks, or 45% for SC/ST/SEBC/PwD candidates, in any one of the following: M.Sc. Computer Science / IT MCA M.E./M.Tech in Computer Science / IT Proficiency in teaching through Odia and English medium is required. The notification states that for subsequent promotion, the incumbent has to acquire B.Ed. or equivalent degree. Candidates must have either a 4-year Integrated Degree course in the concerned subject with at least 50% aggregate marks, or 45% for SC/ST/SEBC/PwD, or a Bachelor's Degree in the concerned subjects with the prescribed marks along with B.Ed./3-year integrated B.A. B.Ed. from an NCTE-recognized institution. All TGT candidates must also have passed OSSTET/OTET Paper-II conducted by BSE Odisha or CTET Paper-II conducted by CBSE, as applicable. Candidates should have a Bachelor's Degree in Fine Arts/Visual Arts from a recognized University with the prescribed aggregate marks and proficiency to teach in both Odia and English medium. Candidates should possess a Degree/Post Graduate Degree in Physical Education such as B.P.Ed./M.P.Ed. from a recognized University/Institution and meet the prescribed percentage requirement. Proficiency in Odia and English medium is required. Candidates should have the prescribed marks and any one of the following qualifications: B.E./B.Tech in Computer Science or IT MCA M.Sc. IT M.Sc. Computer Science DOEACC/NIELIT 'B' Level in Computer Science BCA B.Sc. Computer Science Competence to teach through English and Odia medium is required. content_sections.heading: Qualification and Experience
content_sections.text: The notice states the eligibility as "A or B". The full conditions are: Option A, part 1: an eminent scholar with a Ph.D. degree in the concerned/allied/relevant discipline, with published work of high quality and active engagement in research. This needs a minimum of 10 research publications in peer-reviewed or UGC-listed journals and a total research score of 120 as per Appendix II, Table 2 of UGC Regulations, 2018. Option A, part 2: a minimum of ten years of teaching experience in a university/college as Assistant Professor/Associate Professor/Professor and/or research experience at an equivalent level at a University/National Level Institution, with evidence of having successfully guided a doctoral candidate. Option B: an outstanding professional with a Ph.D. degree in the relevant/allied/applied disciplines, from any academic institution (not included in A above) or industry. The candidate must have made a significant contribution to the knowledge in the concerned/allied/relevant discipline, supported by documentary evidence, and must have ten years' experience. The upper age limit for direct recruitment to college teaching posts is 45 years for candidates of the General Category. The relaxation for Reserved Categories applies correspondingly, and age relaxation is applicable as per the government rules and regulations as amended from time to time. The notice prints no age cut-off date for this limit.

content_sections.heading: ESIC Adjunct Faculty Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: Not exceeding 67 years on the date of the walk-in interview (11 November 2026). A postgraduate degree as prescribed, or a recognized qualification equivalent thereto, in the department of Radiodiagnosis. Eight years of work experience in the concerned specialty after obtaining the PG degree. The candidate must be registered with the State Medical Council/NMC, as applicable, before joining. Research publications are not mandatory for faculty retired, resigned or voluntarily retired from Government or other medical colleges when re-engaged on the same designation. The application form asks for the age as on the date of interview and whether experience is recognised by MCI/DCI. For the full eligibility details of each post, check the official notification.

content_sections.heading: Scope of Work
content_sections.text: Teaching responsibilities, with at least four sessions a month, each lasting not less than 3 hours. Sessions may be theory, small group discussions, practicals, community-based sessions, clinical/bed-side teaching, or radiological imaging, diagnosis and reporting. Visiting faculty will not do routine administrative work of the department and will not replace full-time faculty. The medical college will collect feedback on their teaching every six months.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Document verification: candidates report with the filled application form. Only those whose documents are verified can attend the interview. Interview: selection depends on performance in the interview before the Selection Board. Professor and Associate Professor candidates face a combined interview. Offer: issued on the recommendation of the selection committee, considering the functional requirements. The result will be sent by e-mail and displayed on the website. Selected candidates must join immediately after receiving the offer of engagement.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: Purely contractual engagement for one year, which the Dean may extend for another year based on performance and feedback. The engagement may end for unsatisfactory work or misconduct; gross misconduct or negligence leads to termination without notice or payment in lieu of notice. No right or preference for regular engagement. No claim to PF, pension, gratuity, medical allowances, medical benefits, seniority or promotion. Absence of fifteen days without permission counts as voluntary abandonment and automatic termination. content_sections.text: The post is temporary and is based at IIT Madras, Chennai.

content_sections.heading: IIT Madras Principal Project Officer Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: All eligibility conditions are checked as on the closing date for online applications, 12 November 2026. You need one of these: A Master's degree in engineering with 10 years of experience A Master's degree in science with 15 years of experience A Ph.D. with 3 years of experience Only relevant experience gained after the minimum qualifying degree is counted. Technical experience: Hands-on familiarity with fabrication processes and equipment, such as lithography, deposition, wet or plasma etching, thermal processing, or metrology. Core capabilities: Cleanroom safety, SOP implementation, maintenance and troubleshooting, staff and user coordination, and technical documentation. Professional skills: Strong organization, communication and practical problem-solving, and proficiency in spreadsheets and reporting tools. 3–5 years of relevant and exclusive experience in a semiconductor nanofabrication cleanroom facility will be considered an added advantage. Experience managing, or helping to manage, a shared research or fabrication facility, including vendor coordination, facility administration and funded-project reporting. You must be a citizen of India. Persons who migrated from Pakistan intending to settle permanently in India, and subjects of Nepal, are also eligible. They will need a certificate of eligibility from the Government of India, applied for through the Ministry of Home Affairs. For exceptionally outstanding candidates, the minimum qualification and/or experience can be relaxed. For SC/ST candidates, the institute may relax the experience requirement if not enough candidates from these communities with the required experience are likely to apply. The prescribed qualifications are the minimum. Having a higher qualification does not by itself get you an interview call. Check the official notification for the full eligibility details of the post.

content_sections.heading: Duties of the Principal Project Officer
content_sections.text: The Principal Project Officer will take substantial responsibility for day-to-day technical and operational management. The work is done with faculty and technical staff to support safe, reliable and efficient fabrication and characterisation activities. Facility operations: Coordinate daily activities, equipment bookings, user access and competing requests, and tell users clearly when equipment is available or down. Equipment reliability: Support troubleshooting and preventive maintenance, keep service records, and coordinate vendors, repairs and spare parts. Safety and protocols: Implement cleanroom and laboratory safety procedures, maintain SOPs, support user induction, and make sure established protocols are followed. Staff and user coordination: Work with technical staff, students, faculty and external users, and organise training and equipment authorisation with the responsible teams. Records and administration: Maintain usage logs, inventory and consumables records, and support procurement documentation, billing and payment follow-up. Project documentation: Prepare technical and progress reports, track deliverables, and maintain financial and supporting records with the project and administrative teams. Stakeholder communication: Deal with faculty, vendors, external users and funding-agency or ministry officials, and support meetings and project reviews. Operational improvement: Find recurring process and coordination gaps, and improve scheduling, documentation and service continuity.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Candidates are shortlisted for a test and/or interview based on the information in their online applications. The institute may limit the number of candidates called for a written test, skill test or interview to a reasonable number. It decides this on qualifications, on experience that is higher in level and more relevant than the minimum, and on other academic achievements. The institute decides how applicants are screened and tested for shortlisting and selection. Only shortlisted applicants will be contacted. All contact is by e-mail. Applicants already working in any project at IIT Madras must apply through proper channel. Otherwise they must produce a No-Objection Certificate at the document verification, test or interview. Without it, they will not be allowed to appear.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: The post is temporary and purely on contract. Duration: initially one year, later extendable based on performance. Completing the contract gives no right to further extension, regularization or permanency at the institute. Work location: IIT Madras, Chennai. Documents and antecedents may be verified at any time, including during service. Services are liable to be terminated if documents are fake or information was suppressed.

content_sections.heading: About CCSID
content_sections.text: CCSID is a multidisciplinary centre of the Indian Institute of Engineering Science and Technology, Shibpur, Howrah 711 103. It was set up in 2025 with an endowment from an alumnus of the Institute. Faculty members from the Engineering, Science, Management and Humanities departments can be associated with the Centre for research, training and education.

content_sections.heading: IIEST CCSID Chair Professor and Adjunct Associate/Assistant Professor Vacancy Details 2026
content_sections.text: The notice does not fix how many positions go to each level. The expert committee will recommend whether the two positions are filled at the Chair Professor level, the Adjunct Associate/Assistant Professor level, or both. The Centre wants multidisciplinary research in sustainability and technological innovation. It places particular emphasis on: Clean energy systems and next-generation energy storage with transmission Carbon Capture, Utilization, and Storage (CCUS) technologies Smart, Clean & Green Campus Sustainable Materials Disaster Mitigation and Adaptation Sustainable Transportation Green Buildings Frugal Revolution Biodiversity and Nature-based Solutions Steer the Centre's research activities in its focus areas Cultivate partnerships with academic, government and industry stakeholders Develop proposals to get external grants Cultivate academia-industry collaboration for skill development and training, research, innovation, consultancy and entrepreneurship Help build a vibrant research team by promoting a culture of research excellence and innovation Organise seminars, workshops and awareness programmes on a regular basis Undertake any other activities aligned with the objectives of the Centre

content_sections.heading: IIEST CCSID Chair Professor and Adjunct Associate/Assistant Professor Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the minimum educational qualification. Eligibility depends on the applicant's current position at IIEST Shibpur: All applicants also need: A brilliant research record with proven recognition Proven success in securing competitive research funding Expertise in the Centre's research focus areas Strong communication, networking and team-building skills The ability to spend reasonable time at the Centre while still carrying out their duties in the parent department For the full eligibility of each post, see the official notification.

rows.who_is_eligible: A Professor from any Department of IIEST Shibpur
An Associate/Assistant Professor from any Department of IIEST Shibpur

content_sections.heading: Recognition and Benefits
content_sections.text: The designation of Chair Professor or Adjunct Associate/Assistant Professor The chance to lead multidisciplinary research Dedicated building space for the Centre's activities Use of the available endowment for research, travel, conducting workshops and similar work A monthly honorarium paid on top of regular salary: Rs. 30,000 for a Chair Professor and Rs. 20,000 for an Adjunct Associate/Assistant Professor

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: An expert committee will make the selection. Applicants may be asked to interact with the committee. The committee's recommendation decides whether the two positions are filled at the Chair Professor level, the Adjunct Associate/Assistant Professor level, or both.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: The tenure is initially 3 years, with an annual appraisal. Either party (the faculty member or the Centre) may end the association with 90 days' prior written notice. Selected faculty keep their responsibilities in their parent department while working with the Centre.

content_sections.heading: About SBI Risk Specialist Recruitment
content_sections.text: The Central Recruitment & Promotion Department of the State Bank of India, located at the Corporate Centre in Mumbai, conducts regular recruitment for specialist cadre officers. This recruitment cycle invites applications for the Risk Specialist position under Middle Management Grade Scale-II (MMGS-II) to handle expected credit loss modelling, macroeconomic overlays, and model risk management.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The recruitment offers a total of 3 regular vacancies for the Risk Specialist post under the Unreserved (UR) category (with PwBD-VI horizontal reservation of 1 vacancy). The post-wise and category-wise break-up is detailed below.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates must fulfill the mandatory educational qualification, age limits, and post-qualification experience requirements as on 31.10.2026. Age Limit: Minimum 25 years and Maximum 35 years as on 31.10.2026. Upper age limit is for unreserved category candidates. Relaxation in upper age limit is available to reserved category candidates as per Govt. of India guidelines (wherever applicable). Essential Qualification: Mandatory: (i) CA or (ii) CFA or (iii) MBA / PGDM or equivalent degree in Finance / Data Analytics / Business Analytics from a recognized institute. Preferred Qualification / Certification: Financial Risk Manager (FRM) by GARP OR Professional Risk Managers by PRMIA (valid as on 31.10.2026). Work Experience: Minimum 2 years of post-qualification work experience in dealing with Expected Credit Loss (ECL) related modelling in Risk Management Department of any Bank / Financial Institution / Rating Agency / Brokerage firm or Risk Advisory in Consulting Firm as on 31.10.2026. Training & teaching experience will not be counted for eligibility.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: Selected candidates are appointed in Middle Management Grade Scale-II (MMGS-II) on a regular basis with a basic pay scale of 64820-2340/1-67160-2680/10-93960. The official will be eligible for DA, HRA, CCA, Provident Fund, Contributory Pension Fund i.e. NPS, Leave Fare Concession (LFC), Medical Facility, other perquisites etc. as per Bank’s salary structure.

content_sections.heading: SBI Risk Specialist Job Description
content_sections.text: Selected candidates will be assigned roles and Key Responsibility Areas (KRAs) that include: Development of Probability of Default (PD), Loss Given Default (LGD) and Exposure at Default (EAD) models for various loan portfolio and investments on which ECL is applicable. Development of Macroeconomic Overlays models required as per regulatory guidelines. Implementation of PD, LGD and EAD Models in OFSAA. Period Monitoring, Maintenance and validation of above models. Preparation of Framework for Determination of Stage under ECL. Identification of Significant Increase in Credit Risk (SICR) triggers along with setting qualitative and quantitative triggers for various portfolio. Coordinate with Auditors & Regulator, BUs & other stakeholders throughout model lifecycle. Maintain proper Model documents and database required for audit & regulatory supervision. Develop models required for ECL computation using industry best practices and using statistical and machine learning techniques.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: The selection process consists of two stages: Shortlisting: Mere fulfilling the minimum qualification and experience will not vest any right to candidate for being called for interview. The shortlisting committee constituted by the Bank will decide the shortlisting parameters and thereafter, adequate number of candidates, as decided by the Bank, will be shortlisted for interaction. Interview: Interview will carry 100 marks. The qualifying marks in interview will be decided by the Bank. Merit list for selection will be prepared in descending order on the basis of scores obtained in interview only.

content_sections.heading: SBI Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: The selected candidate will support the development and delivery of customized solutions to clients. The job profile includes: Conducting research followed by development of new derivative products in line with the prevailing market. Evaluating the performance of the product on an ongoing basis. Assisting marketing of derivative products to the clients. Providing periodic updates to the Top Management. Key Responsibility Areas (KRAs): Lead product conceptualization and development of new derivative instruments. Conduct advanced macroeconomic and interest rate research to support product suitability. Prepare product notes, risk disclosures and documentation for approval committees. Evaluate product performance and recommend product positioning strategies. Coordinate with internal departments such as risk, legal, IAD and ITTSS for timely approvals and clearances within the regulatory and internal compliance framework. Coordinate closely with CTMU/RTMUs to drive derivative penetration across the bank's corporate and retail clients. Handle the end-to-end process of product development and approval. Assist in automation and integration of compliance workflows. Mentor AVP-level team members and contribute to strategic product planning. Any other related work as assigned. Design tailored products based on the client's need and market dynamics, and keep up with developments in derivative products and regulatory frameworks. Conduct Fundamental and Technical research across Equities, Forex and Debt Markets. Analyse macroeconomic trends, central bank policies and geopolitical developments, and assess their market impact. Generate and maintain financial models and prepare valuation reports. Monitor the markets and assess the client's requirements. Provide necessary support in product development. Liaise with various departments involved in designing and developing new products. Provide regular updates to the stakeholders and Top Management. Track and analyse corporate earnings, bond yield movements and currency fluctuations. Prepare and present research notes, market outlook and sectoral reports. Collaborate with the trading desk to align strategies with research insights. For the Manager post, the KRAs may be finalized after selection. content_sections.heading: About Bank of Baroda
content_sections.text: Bank of Baroda is a public sector bank. Its letterhead calls it "India's International Bank" and marks its 119th Foundation Year. The notice was issued from Mumbai on 28 October 2026 by the Chief General Manager (HRM & Marketing).

content_sections.heading: Salary and Pay Scale
content_sections.text: The pay scales are MMG/S-II (basic pay Rs. 64,820 to Rs. 93,960), MMG/S-III (Rs. 85,920 to Rs. 1,05,280) and SMG/S-IV (Rs. 1,02,300 to Rs. 1,20,940). Salary and other pay follow the industry-level bipartite settlement and the Joint Note for officers in the banking sector. On top of basic pay, officers may get bank-specific allowances, perquisites and other facilities under the bank's policies.

content_sections.heading: Roles and Responsibilities
content_sections.text: Project Finance – Infrastructure & ESG: credit policy and pricing, using ESG and sustainability factors to assess credit proposals, independent credit risk evaluation of loan proposals, and sector analysis. MSME Credit Risk Management: risk-return evaluation of the loan portfolio, stress testing and scenario analysis for capital adequacy, and monitoring credit risk capital. Enterprise and Operational Risk Management: the bank-wide risk framework, risk appetite and limits, CRAR and economic capital, the ICAAP exercise and Pillar III disclosures. Fraud Incidence and Root Cause Analysis: root cause analysis of frauds, including digital risks, and loss data and incident management in line with RBI guidelines on Operational Risk. Manager - Digital Fraud: fraud tools and rules for Debit cards, Internet and Mobile Banking, IMPS and UPI, plus dashboards. Uses SAS/SQL and credit data from sources such as CIBIL and Equifax. MSME Relationship: finding MSME business, meeting revenue targets, cross-selling, recovering long-outstanding debts and checking financial statements. Business Finance: performance MIS, Funds Transfer Pricing, cost management, capital budgeting and balance sheet and accounting policy advice. Chief Manager - Internal Controls: the Internal Controls Framework, ICOFR, reconciliation of office accounts, GL review under IRAC norms, and work with Statutory Auditors on IFC audits.

content_sections.text: Pay online by Debit Card, Credit Card, Internet Banking or UPI. Your registration is complete only when the fee is paid by the last date. The fee is not refunded, even if no online test is held or you are not shortlisted.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection may include application scrutiny, an online test, a psychometric test or any other suitable test, followed by Group Discussion and/or Interview or several rounds of interviews. Shortlisting may be based on online test scores, qualifications, work experience, domain expertise, skill set and suitability. The bank does not share its shortlisting criteria. If an online test is held, you need a minimum score in each section and overall. Candidates tied at the cut-off mark are ranked by age, oldest first. The minimum qualifying mark in the Personal Interview is 60% for General and EWS candidates and 55% for reserved categories. The bank may change these marks. The final merit list combines the online test and/or interview scores. The bank may consider you for a different position if you meet that position's eligibility.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: Probation: 12 months (1 year) of active service from the date of joining. Service bond: serve at least 3 years, or pay the bank three months' gross salary (capped at Rs. 3 Lakhs) if you leave earlier. Posting: any branch or office of the Bank anywhere in India. Only candidates willing to serve anywhere in India should apply. Selected candidates sign an employment contract. Serving government, PSU and bank employees must produce a No Objection Certificate at the interview and a relieving letter on joining.

content_sections.text: Work with PACS and other primary cooperatives and guide them in carrying out the initiatives of the Ministry of Cooperation, Government of India. Solve day-to-day problems PACS face with computerisation, business plans, projects, financing and various approvals. Prepare and share a weekly status report on these initiatives, in coordination with the DCCB/StCB. The scheme aims to take the cooperative movement down to the grassroots. It also lets professional graduates learn how cooperatives work in practice and builds a pool of experienced cooperative professionals.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: This is purely an internship programme for one year only. NCDC funds it, and the bank carries no liability. It is not an appointment or employment and does not promise one. No intern has any right or claim to a job with the bank because of this internship. The internship is full-time. The intern must keep the bank's working hours. The bank may post or transfer interns according to its functional needs. Interns get 10 days of Casual Leave for the year and no other leave. Any other leave is treated as "Leave without remuneration". The bank's holidays may apply to interns. The internship may end at any time, with no financial benefit, if performance is not satisfactory or the intern is absent without the bank's permission. The bank may also end it at any time without giving a reason. Interns must keep all documents, reports and information confidential. Breaking this rule has legal consequences. Interns may not deal with or represent the bank to print, electronic or social media. They may not post their work on social media without express permission from the competent authority. Interns must follow the rules and regulations of the bank and behave professionally with the bank and the public.

content_sections.heading: Department-wise Vacancies
content_sections.text: The notice lists 14 vacancies for Junior Resident Doctors. One post is reserved for Persons with Benchmark Disabilities in the non surgical departments as per Government of India policy. The notice does not give a department-wise break-up; it gives the reservation-wise table below. The Persons with Benchmark Disabilities reservation is one percent each for persons with benchmark disabilities under clauses (a), (b) and (c), and one percent for those under clauses (d) and (e): (a) Blindness and low vision (b) Deaf and hard of hearing (c) Locomotor disability including cerebral palsy, leprosy cured, dwarfism, acid attack victims and muscular dystrophy (d) Autism, intellectual disability, specific learning disability and mental illness (e) Multiple disabilities from amongst persons under clauses (a) to (d) including deaf-blindness, in the posts identified for each disability EWS posts are not carried forward or treated as backlog vacancy if unfilled. Candidates of other categories may therefore apply provisionally, and are considered as UR candidates only if the EWS seat is otherwise not filled.

content_sections.heading: Qualification and Experience
content_sections.text: Persons possessing qualifications included in Part II of the 3rd Schedule must also fulfil the conditions specified in section 13(B) of the Act. The notice does not print an experience requirement. Candidates should check the official notification for any discipline-specific eligibility. The age limit is 30 years, counted as on 18 November 2026, the last date for submitting applications (the notice uses this date to determine age, educational qualification and experience). Age is relaxable up to 5 years for SC/ST and 3 years for OBC (Non-creamy layer) candidates, in respect of vacancies reserved for them. Age relaxation for physically handicapped candidates is as per Govt. of India norms.

rows.qualification: Medical qualification included in Schedule I & II of the 3rd Schedule of the Indian Medical Council Act 1956; satisfactory completion of the compulsory internship; registration with the Central/State Medical Council.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: Pay: Level 10 of Pay Matrix with entry pay of Rs.56,100/- plus NPA and other allowances as admissible under rules. Accommodation: subject to availability, Resident Doctors are provided accommodation in the RMO Hostel. HRA: if no accommodation can be provided, HRA admissible as per rules is paid. Reservation and age relaxation are provided as per Govt. of India norms; EWS reservation follows the Office Memorandum No. 36039/1/2019-(Estt (Res) dated 19 January 2019 and 31 January 2019.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The essential requirements also include willingness to work in shifts, including night duties, to ensure 24 × 7 study coverage. content_sections.heading: JIPMER Project Nurse-III Job Description
content_sections.text: Screening eligible very preterm infants for participation in the SAFE-FEED trial. Assisting with participant enrolment and obtaining written informed parental consent in accordance with the approved protocol and delegated responsibilities. Performing study-related assessments and recording baseline maternal, antenatal and neonatal information. Supporting implementation of protocol-based feeding procedures in coordination with the treating clinical team. Applying sensors and performing NIRS monitoring according to the study protocol. Recording the study parameters/clinical data at specified monitoring time points. Monitoring study participants for protocol-defined outcomes and promptly communicating relevant clinical findings to the treating team. Maintaining accurate and timely case record forms, screening logs, enrolment logs, monitoring records and other study documentation. Ensuring adherence to the approved study protocol, standard operating procedures, infection prevention measures and participant confidentiality requirements. Coordinating with the study investigators and clinical team to ensure completion of scheduled study procedures and assessments. Working in shifts, including night duties, to provide 24 × 7 study coverage. Performing other duties related to the project as assigned by the Principal Investigator.

A candidate applying for two or more different posts must fill in a separate form for each post and send each in a separate email. A valid email ID and mobile number are compulsory. Certificate in support of age (Tenth equivalent or High School Certificate). Degrees/Diplomas. Experience certificates. Any others, if relevant (specify). Proof of prior research experience, if any. The form also asks for educational qualifications from SSLC/Matriculation onwards (self-attested photocopies enclosed), details of previous employment with PDFs of proof of work, a description of previous work experience in up to 500 words, and contact details of previous employers. It carries a declaration signed by the applicant.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Applicants are shortlisted on the details in the application, CV and documentary proof. The list of eligible candidates will also be displayed on the JIPMER website. Final selection is based on CV, application, written test and in-person interview. After the application form is evaluated, the recruitment process is a written test followed by an interview. The written test topics are neonatal nursing care, care of preterm and growth-restricted infants, enteral feeding practices and feeding protocol implementation, infection prevention and control, patient monitoring and documentation, research-related nursing responsibilities, and recognition and reporting of adverse events. Only shortlisted candidates will be called for a written test and/or interview. If the number of applications is very large, more stringent criteria than those specified may be used to determine eligibility. The interview may be conducted in person or by videoconferencing at the discretion of the Principal Investigator. For a videoconference, the candidate must arrange a device (computer, laptop or mobile) with audio and camera and an adequate internet connection. The date and time of interview will be notified one week in advance.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Applications will be initially screened, and eligible candidates will be called for Interview / Written examination. The notice also refers to an MCQ / Skill Test / VIVA. The Institute reserves the right to restrict the number of candidates called for the Written Examination / Interview / Skill test to a reasonable limit, on the basis of the qualifications and experience of the applicants. It may also fix a minimum eligibility standard / bench mark and cut-off marks (Group / Stream / Discipline / Category-wise etc.), taking into account factors such as the number of vacancies and percentage of marks in Graduate / Post Graduate degrees. Merely fulfilling the prescribed qualifications does not entitle an applicant to be called. The decision of the Director, Dr. B Borooah Cancer Institute in this regard shall be final and binding. The list of shortlisted candidates for the MCQ / Skill Test / VIVA will be uploaded on the official website of Dr. B Borooah Cancer Institute. Information on the date of the interview / written examination will be sent by email to eligible candidates only. The notice does not give an exam pattern or an interview date.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for BBCI Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Open the online application link given in the notice: https://tmc.gov.in/fta/frm_Registration.aspx (candidates must apply through "Online Application" only). Apply for the chosen post in the prescribed format, giving full details of qualifications and experience, as these will be checked against original documents later. Provide a valid email ID, because all correspondence will be done through email only. Complete and submit the online application by 15 November 2026, up to 05:30 p.m. (Indian Standard Time). Incomplete and online non-submitted applications will be summarily rejected. Watch your email (including spam / bulk folders) and the BBCI website for the shortlist and the interview / written examination date. For further enquiry, candidates can email [email protected] . This address is for enquiries only, not for sending applications.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Candidates called for the Interview / Written Examination / Skill Test must carry original documents along with one set of copies supporting the details given in the online application, failing which they will not be allowed to appear. Identity proof (i.e. Aadhaar, PAN & Voter) Date of Birth: Birth Certificate / School leaving certificate / S.S.C passing certificate Educational Qualification: Mark sheet & Passing Certificate of final examination Experience Certificates – Current Employment: Appointment letter, Last month's Pay Slip and NOC Original testimonials for qualifications and experience, with one set of copies

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Accommodation will not be provided to outstation candidates. No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview. If a candidate does not fulfil the eligibility criteria or has furnished incorrect / false / incomplete information or suppressed any material fact, the candidature will be cancelled; if detected after appointment, services are liable to be terminated forthwith. The Institute reserves the right not to call any candidate for the written examination / Interview / Skill test without assigning any reason. The Institute does not take responsibility for non-receipt of online applications, or for emails lost because of an invalid / wrong email ID or delivery to spam / bulk mail folders. Candidates are responsible for receiving, downloading and printing related documents sent by email. Canvassing / bribing in any form will be a disqualification and would lead to cancellation of candidature.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: The appointee is entitled to remuneration as per pay-scale. The notice does not name HRA separately; it states NPA and "other usual Allowances, as applicable". No travelling or other allowances are paid to the candidate for joining the post. The appointee shall reside in the residential accommodation provided by the Institute during the tenure, subject to availability. Tenure: 89 days or up to the next regular interview, whichever is earlier. The appointment gives no right to claim permanent absorption or continued contractual appointment, which may be renewed or terminated as the Institute decides after evaluating performance. The post is full time, and private practice of any kind is prohibited. Leave entitlement is as per the Central Residency Scheme and Institute policy. The appointee has to work in shifts and can be posted at any place or Centre attached to the Institute at the discretion of the MS/Dean/Executive Director. No extra allowance is admissible for such assignment. Senior Residents may be assigned to one or more departments and will need to work in emergency on rotation as needed. The appointee is not entitled to Provident Fund, Pension, Gratuity, Seniority, Promotion or other benefits available to regularly appointed Government servants. Either side may end the appointment at any time by giving one month's notice or paying one month's salary, without assigning any reason. A candidate who joins and leaves, resigns or is terminated before the tenure ends may do so with one month's prior notice, or by depositing pay and allowance in lieu for the shortfall. Earlier engagement as Senior Resident is counted along with this engagement against the prescribed period for SR ship. After selection, candidates are given 15 days to join at AIIMS Bibinagar; the Competent Authority may extend this in exceptional situations with reasonable justification.

content_sections.heading: About DMFT Chatra Medical Officer
content_sections.text: The Office of the Deputy Commissioner, Chatra, Jharkhand issued this recruitment notice for the District Mineral Foundation Trust (DMFT), Chatra. The DMFT will engage Medical Officers on a contractual basis at various health facilities under DMFT Chatra. According to the notice, the DMFT is floating these vacancies to strengthen the health sector of the district. The notice is signed by the Deputy Commissioner-cum-Chairperson, DMFT, Chatra.

content_sections.heading: Department-wise Vacancies
content_sections.text: The notice has 15 Medical Officer posts. The table below shows how these posts are divided by category. The notice defines these categories as per the Government of Jharkhand, and the Government of Jharkhand's reservation policy applies. Jharkhand candidates who claim reservation in their category (ST, SC, BC-I, BC-II) must submit the latest caste certificate in the prescribed format. This certificate must be issued by the competent authority of Jharkhand State. EWS candidates must attach the latest income certificate issued by the Govt. of Jharkhand.

content_sections.heading: Qualification and Experience
content_sections.text: Candidates must have valid medical registration with the National Medical Commission (NMC) / State Medical Council. The candidate should not have been convicted by any court of law. Candidates who are currently employed must enclose a "No Objection Certificate" from the employer, if applicable, as listed on the application form. The age limit is not specified in the notice. For the full eligibility conditions of the Medical Officer post, see the official notification.

rows.qualification: MBBS degree from an institution recognized by the National Medical Commission (NMC) with valid registration
rows.experience: Experience not mandatory

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: A Medical Officer receives ₹ 75000/ Month (Consolidated, full-time). The notice does not name any other allowance. TDS will apply as per Government rules. Salary and choice of posting are non-negotiable and rest purely with the selection committee, Chatra. The service is purely contractual for a period of one year and is a full-time role. Successful candidates must execute the one-year contractual agreement. The contract may be renewed subject to satisfactory performance. No claim for regularisation of the position will be entertained. Performance will be reviewed after completion of three months of service. Continuation depends on satisfactory performance during the probation period. If performance is unsatisfactory, the probation period may be extended by one to three months, as the competent authority deems appropriate. Either party may terminate the contract by giving one-month prior notice. Services may also be terminated if performance is not satisfactory. Leave is availed according to the provisions of the State Government. Selected doctors must serve full-time in the posted health institution. They will be posted as per requirement in any block or health institution of Chatra district. If the Government of Jharkhand or the Department of Health, Medical Education & Family Welfare, Jharkhand deploys Medical Doctors in Chatra district in the near future, the post will be dissolved and the contract terminated.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for DMFT Chatra Medical Officer
content_sections.text: Get the prescribed application form from the recruitment section of the official website https://chatra.nic.in/ or from the Office of the DMFT, Chatra. The form is also printed on pages 5 and 6 of the notice. Fill in the form and paste a self-attested photograph. Then sign the declaration. Attach self-attested copies of the documents listed below. Write "Application for the Post of Medical Officer under DMFT, Chatra" clearly on the envelope. Submit the application by hand or send it by Registered Post/Speed Post to: The Deputy Commissioner-cum-Chairperson, 2nd Floor, District Mineral Foundation Trust (DMFT), Office of the Deputy Commissioner, Chatra, Jharkhand – 825401. The application must reach the office by 18/11/2026, till 05:00 PM. Applications received after the deadline will not be considered. The hiring process is a personal interview, and marks obtained in the interview are the criteria for selection. The interview date will be notified on the official website of Chatra district, https://chatra.nic.in/ . Candidates must bring the printout of the application form, all original documents/certificates and one set of self-attested copies to the interview. Candidates who do not bring these will not be allowed to appear in the interview. No TA/DA will be provided for attending the interview.

content_sections.heading: About JIPMER
content_sections.text: JIPMER, at Dhanvantari Nagar, Puducherry, was declared an Institution of National Importance by an Act of Parliament in 2008 and runs a hospital with more than 2000 beds. Its second campus, JIPMER Karaikal, was established in 2016 and trains students at the 506-bedded Government General Hospital, Karaikal. JIPMER has also set up a Multi-specialty Consulting Unit at Yanam to provide health care in selected specialties.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: JIPMER has advertised 9 Senior Resident posts in six departments. The department-wise and category-wise break-up is as follows. All Senior Residents recruited at JIPMER, Puducherry shall be posted to work at the JIPMER Karaikal Campus on rotation basis. Senior Residents recruited in the Department of Radiodiagnosis will be deputed to the Yanam Campus regularly and will make periodic visits to the Karaikal campus on rotation basis. Reservation for Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBDs) is 4%, provided on a horizontal basis. The minimum degree of disability is 40%, assessed by the JIPMER Medical Board, whose decision will be final. The acceptable disabilities for each department are given in JIPMER O.M No.Admin-I/DR/PwD/2021, dated 18-03-2023. Applicants of any category may be considered for a reserved seat only when no applicant of that reserved category is available; candidates of other categories, including Unreserved, will then be considered for appointment not exceeding beyond 40 days, which may be extended further by the competent authority if required. The vacancy position may be revised or changed as per requirement.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: JIPMER invites applications from eligible Indian candidates. The essential qualification for each department is as follows. The crucial date for eligibility with regard to age and educational qualification is 16.11.2026. Candidates must complete all requirements for the qualifying degree, such as passing the examination and completing the mandatory period of Junior Residency, if any, by 16.11.2026. Those who do not fulfil these conditions need not apply. Appearing in the written exam or interview does not imply that a candidate is finally eligible. The full name in the application must match both the Govt. Photo ID card (Aadhaar, PAN, identity card, driving licence etc.) and the undergraduate degree certificate, in the same spelling and order. The upper age limit is not exceeding 45 years as on the crucial date, 16.11.2026. Age relaxation beyond the upper age limit is permitted as follows. OBC: a valid OBC certificate for posts under the Central Government, stating that the candidate does not belong to the Creamy Layer, issued in the current financial year, in the Annexure-I format. It must not be older than one year before 16.11.2026. EWS: persons not covered by SC, ST or OBC reservation whose family has a gross annual income below ₹ 8 lakh from all sources for the financial year before the year of application. A valid EWS certificate in the Annexure-III format is required, failing which the candidature will be rejected. SC/ST: a valid certificate in the Annexure-II format. SC, ST, OBC (NCL) and EWS certificates should be issued by a Tahsildar or higher authority. A certificate in a regional language must be uploaded with an English version attested by a Gazetted Officer. Disability: a certificate from a duly constituted Medical Board of a State or Central Govt. hospital or institution, countersigned by the Medical Superintendent/CMO/Head of Hospital, in the Annexure-V format. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in JIPMER Recruitment 2026 for Senior Residents?
faq.answer: There are 9 Senior Resident posts: 2 in Neurology, 1 in Neurosurgery, 2 in Obstetrics & Gynaecology, 1 in Pathology, 2 in Radiodiagnosis and 1 in Transfusion Medicine (UR 6, OBC 2, SC 1).

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to register for the JIPMER Senior Resident posts?
faq.answer: Online registration through the Google Form closes on 16 November 2026 at 04.30 PM. It opened on 2 November 2026 at 11.00 AM.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed for the JIPMER Senior Resident posts?
faq.answer: An NMC/MCI-recognized MD/MS/DNB in the respective discipline is required. Neurosurgery needs MS/DNB in Surgery, and Neurology needs MD/DNB in Medicine/Paediatric, with MCh/DrNB or DM/DrNB holders also allowed to apply. The degree and Junior Residency must be complete by 16.11.2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for JIPMER Senior Resident Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The age must not exceed 45 years as on 16.11.2026. Relaxation is 5 years for SC/ST, 3 years for OBC, and 10, 13 and 15 years for PwBD candidates of UR/EWS, OBC and SC/ST respectively.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of a JIPMER Senior Resident?
faq.answer: The pay is Rs.1,28,359/- per month consolidated, with no enhancement during the contract period.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for the JIPMER Senior Resident posts?
faq.answer: The fee is Rs.500 for General (UR), OBC (NCL) and EWS candidates and Rs.250 for SC/ST candidates; Persons with Disabilities are exempted. It is paid only online through SBI Collect and is not refundable.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply for JIPMER Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Register through the Google Form linked on the www.jipmer.edu.in home page, upload the photograph, signature and certificates, pay the fee through SBI Collect, and upload the payment copy in the Google Form by 16.11.2026, 04.30 PM.

faq.question: Q8. How are JIPMER Senior Residents selected?
faq.answer: After certificate verification on 18.11.2026, candidates whose certificates are in order appear for an in-person interview. The interview carries 100% weightage, and candidates may be shortlisted if many applications are received.

faq.question: Q9. Where will the JIPMER Senior Residents be posted?
faq.answer: Senior Residents recruited at JIPMER, Puducherry will work at the JIPMER Karaikal Campus on rotation basis. Radiodiagnosis Senior Residents will be deputed to the Yanam Campus regularly, with periodic visits to Karaikal.

faq.question: Q10. Is the JIPMER Senior Resident job permanent?
faq.answer: No, it is a contract appointment advertised for 11 months. The terms state 12 months at a time, continued up to 3 years on the HOD's recommendation and the Competent Authority's discretion.

content_sections.text: To apply for the post of Demonstrator, a candidate must have a valid MSc Degree and PhD in the same subject, i.e., Anatomy, Biochemistry, Pharmacology, Physiology, and Microbiology, as per NMC Norms. Candidates must fulfil all prescribed educational qualifications and other eligibility conditions as on the prescribed date. content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: The notice does not print an amount or list the individual allowances. The opening paragraph of the notice gives an initial period of 01 (one) year. This is extendable by up to 02 (two) additional years, subject to satisfactory performance, availability of the post and other terms. The maximum tenure is 03 (three) years, or until the joining of the Bonded Junior Resident, whichever is earlier. The "Terms of Contract" section gives an initial tenure of 01 (one) year, extendable by up to 01 (one) additional year. The engagement is liable to termination when the Bonded Junior Resident designated as Tutor or as Demonstrator joins. It can also end under ESIC Headquarters guidelines, whichever is earlier. The engagement is purely temporary. An extension does not give any right or claim to regular appointment in ESIC. The engagement is subject to the rules, instructions and guidelines of ESIC Headquarters/Government of India issued from time to time. Private practice of any kind is not permitted after joining ESIC Medical College & Hospital, Faridabad. Either side may end the engagement with one month's notice, in accordance with the terms and conditions of appointment. Candidates finally selected as Junior Resident/Tutor/Demonstrator must submit a demand draft of Rs. 20,000/- at the time of joining as a security deposit. The draft must be in favour of ESI Fund Account No. 1, payable at Faridabad. The deposit is refunded only if the candidate serves at least six months after joining. If the candidate resigns within six months of joining, the deposit will be forfeited and will not be refunded under any circumstances.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: The notice describes these stages: scrutiny of applications, then Document Verification, then a Written Test. ESIC will notify on its website whether the Written Test is required. Document Verification will preferably be held on the same day as the candidate's written test, so that candidates do not have to visit the institute more than once. After the last date, a designated committee/authority will scrutinise all applications for educational qualifications, age, registration, reservation and other eligibility conditions. Every candidature remains subject to detailed verification of eligibility and original documents. The date, time and venue will be notified separately on the official ESIC website. Only candidates who meet the eligibility conditions and whose documents are found satisfactory will be allowed into the next stage of selection. Whether a Written Test is needed will be decided by the number of eligible applications for each post compared with the vacancies advertised for that post. ESIC will notify the date, time, venue and other details on its website. The syllabus is based on the MBBS curriculum, and the qualifying criteria is 50% marks in the written examination. The list of selected candidates will be notified on the ESIC website through a separate notice and also sent by mail to the candidates concerned.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for ESIC Faridabad Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Applications are accepted in both online (email) and offline mode from 3 November 2026 to 13 November 2026. Fill in the Application Form in the prescribed format at Annexure-I and sign it. Attach clear and legible self-attested copies of all supporting documents. For fee-paying candidates, this includes the Demand Draft details or a copy of the Demand Draft. Online mode: email the application to [email protected] . The form and all documents should preferably be in one consolidated PDF file. Name the PDF file with your name followed by your mobile number. For example, Rahul with mobile number 9845322*** would name the file Rahul9845322***. Use this email subject line where possible: "Application for the post of _ [Name of Candidate]". Offline mode: submit the application in Room No.9, Academic Block, ESIC MC&H, Faridabad. Make sure the complete application is received by 13 November 2026. Applications received after 13.11.2026, or applications that are incomplete, unsigned or missing the required documents, are liable to be rejected. The Annexure-I form asks for: Personal details: name in block letters, father's/husband's name, date of birth, age, gender, nationality, PAN and Aadhaar number. Permanent address. Contact details: mobile, alternate mobile and email. Educational qualifications, latest first. Professional experience, latest first. A list of documents enclosed. A recent passport-size self-attested photograph affixed on the form. A signed declaration.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Enclose self-attested copies of these documents with the application: Class 10th/Matriculation Certificate as proof of Date of Birth All relevant Mark Sheets and Degree Certificates MBBS Degree Certificate, wherever applicable M.Sc./Ph.D. Degree Certificate, wherever applicable Valid EWS/OBC-NCL/SC/ST/PwBD Certificate, wherever applicable, in the prescribed format for appointment to Central Government posts Valid and updated NMC/State Medical Council Registration Certificate, wherever applicable Experience Certificate, wherever applicable Recent passport-size photograph Relieving Certificate/NOC from present/previous employer, wherever applicable Aadhaar Card/valid identity document Demand Draft towards the prescribed Application/Interview Fee, wherever applicable Any other document/certificate required for determining eligibility for the post Bring the following to Document Verification: All original certificates/documents submitted with the application One complete set of self-attested photocopies The original Demand Draft, wherever applicable Valid registration certificate, wherever applicable Original experience certificate, wherever applicable Original caste/category certificate, wherever applicable Any other document specified in the Document Verification notice Failure to produce original documents, or failure to satisfy the Document Verification Committee about their authenticity/validity, will result in cancellation of candidature.

content_sections.heading: AMCH Technical Coordinator Job Description
content_sections.text: Act as a focal point for Rare Disease Clinic as the CoEs. Provide technical and strategic support for planning, coordination and implementation of rare disease-related activities. Coordinate with clinical departments for diagnosis, investigations and formulation of treatment plans. Facilitate documentation, application review and approval process for patient support. Liaise with MoHFW, State Governments, and other stakeholders for fund disbursement and compliance. Coordinating with the spokes in matters of proposal for equipment and consumables procurement, demand for funds, submission of utilization certificates etc. Track drug procurement and ensure timely availability and logistics for therapy. Guide and monitor ABHA ID generation and digital health record maintenance. Ensure timely and accurate data reporting and analytics for MoHFW and interval reviews. Organize capacity-building sessions, trainings and awareness program at the CoE. Develop and disseminate IEC materials and media content for public and stakeholder awareness. Support development of treatment guidelines, SOPs, and other technical documentation. Manage patient data and regularly update the Rare Disease Registry and associated digital platforms. Assist in preparation of reports, summaries, and digital dashboards. Maintain proper patient records in both digital and physical formats, ensuring confidentiality. Provide counselling, guidance, and continuous support to rare disease patients and their caregivers.

content_sections.text: The appointment is initially for one (01) year, extendable up to three (03) years. content_sections.text: Reservation for SC/ST/OBC/EWS and PwBD candidates is as per Central Govt. rules/policy. Candidates claiming reservation must attach a copy of a valid category certificate issued by the appropriate authority. SC/ST: Category certificate as per the format in Annexure-I. OBC: Certificate from the competent authority as per Annexure-II for Central Government jobs, along with a certificate that the candidate does not belong to the Creamy Layer. The non-creamy layer certificate should be valid for the financial year 2026-2027; certificates issued from 1st April 2026 to the date of interview are considered valid. EWS: Reservation as per Govt. of India policy (Office Memorandum No. 36039/1/2019-Estt (Res) DoPT dated 19th January 2019 and 31st January 2019). EWS persons not covered under SC, ST and OBC reservation get 10% reservation. The certificate must be in the form prescribed in Annexure-III, valid for the financial year 2026-2027; certificates issued from 1st April 2026 to the date of interview are considered valid. PwBD: 4% of total vacancies is horizontally reserved for Persons with Benchmark Disabilities, as per Government of India guidelines. The disability certificate should be issued by a duly constituted and authorized Medical Board of the State or Central Govt. Hospitals/Institutions, conforming to Ministry of Social Welfare and Empowerment guidelines, and countersigned by the Medical Superintendent/CMO/Head of Hospital/Institution as the case may be. Annexures I, II and III (certificate formats) were not included in the documents provided, so their contents are not reproduced here.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection is on the basis of the interview only. If the number of applicants is high, the Institute will hold a screening test of MCQs in the subject concerned and then interview the shortlisted candidates. Document verification takes place before the interview, and the Screening Committee may shortlist candidates based on the verification of original documents. Candidates report to the Ground Floor, Admin and Library Building, AIIMS Mangalagiri, Guntur (Dist), Andhra Pradesh, 522503. Marks of the written test (if applicable) or interview are not displayed, and there is no re-checking or re-evaluation. Interview turns may be delayed depending on the number of applicants. No travelling or other allowances are paid for attending the screening test or interview, or for joining the post.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: The appointment is under the Government of India's Residency Scheme, and engagement is regulated as per the CCS (Temporary Service Rules). Either side can end the appointment by giving one month's notice or paying one month's salary, without assigning any reason. The appointment can also be terminated for failure to complete the period of three months to the satisfaction of the competent authority. Appointees may work in shifts and can be posted at any place in the Institute, at the discretion of the Medical Superintendent, Dean or Director. Additional duties may be assigned, with no extra allowance. Provident Fund, Pension, Gratuity, Medical Attendance Treatment, Seniority, Promotion and other benefits of regular Government servants are not available. Leave follows Institute rules and Government of India instructions. No NOC will be given within one month of joining, and no experience certificate will be given to those resigning within 1 month after joining. Selected candidates must be declared medically fit by the competent Medical Board. Selected candidates get 14 days to join. An extension may be granted in exceptional situations, and if a candidate does not join, the offer stands cancelled and the post goes to a waitlisted candidate, if any. Candidates must not have been convicted by any Court of Law, and any pending disciplinary proceedings must be reported in writing at document verification. Canvassing leads to disqualification, and incomplete applications are rejected. Disputes are subject to the jurisdiction of the High Court, Andhra Pradesh.

faq.question: Q1. Is this a walk-in interview at AIIMS Mangalagiri?
faq.answer: No. The notice states "No Walk-in Interview", so candidates must first apply through the Google Form.

faq.question: Q2. Can M.Sc candidates apply for these posts?
faq.answer: Yes, in Anatomy and Pharmacology, if they also hold a Ph.D as specified for that department. Their pay is Rs. 56,100 in Level-10 plus other allowances.

faq.question: Q3. Do I pay again if I apply to two departments?
faq.answer: Yes. A separate fee is required for each department, so a General candidate applying to two departments pays Rs. 1500/- for each.

faq.question: Q4. How long does the appointment last?
faq.answer: It is a whole-time appointment for 12 months at a time and can continue up to 3 years. Continuation depends on the HOD's recommendation and the Competent Authority's discretion.

faq.question: Q5. Will there be a written test?
faq.answer: Only if the number of applicants is high. In that case, an MCQ screening test in the subject concerned comes before the interview.

faq.question: Q6. Can I apply if my postgraduate result is still awaited?
faq.answer: Only candidates declared successful in the qualifying degree examination, who will complete its tenure on or before 21 November 2026, are eligible.

faq.question: Q7. I work in a government institute. What do I need?
faq.answer: You must apply through proper channel and produce an original No Objection Certificate from your employer at the interview. It must clearly state that you will be permitted to join AIIMS Mangalagiri if selected.

faq.question: Q8. Can a Senior Resident do private practice?
faq.answer: No. Private practice of any kind is prohibited, and appointees cannot accept any other assignment, paid or otherwise, during the contract.

faq.question: Q9. Can UR candidates be selected against EWS posts?
faq.answer: Yes, they may be considered if suitable EWS candidates are not found. There are 5 EWS posts in this advertisement.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Applications received will be scrutinized. Only shortlisted candidates will be called for interview. Candidates fulfilling the eligibility conditions shall be considered on relevant criteria such as qualification, experience, suitability and other requirements of the Centre. A Committee shall be constituted for the purpose of selection.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: The appointment is purely contractual, for one year from the date of joining or until the candidate attains the age of 65 years, whichever is earlier. It may be extended after the first year, subject to satisfactory performance, review and functional requirements of the Centre. Either side may terminate the appointment at any time by giving 30 days' notice. The Centre may instead pay one month's remuneration in lieu of notice, without assigning any reason, including where performance or discharge of duties is not found satisfactory by the Competent Authority. The place of duty is Dhanvantari, JNCASR, Main Campus, Jakkur, and allied facilities in Bengaluru, namely Sahyadri Campus, Chamundi Campus and Arkavathi Campus. Normal duty is in general shift (9.00 AM to 2.00 PM or 2.00 PM to 6.00 PM) every day. Appointees are on call during nights and provide weekend coverage (9.00 AM to 2.00 PM or 2.00 PM to 6.00 PM). Attendance must be marked online. Appointees perform the duties assigned by the Competent Authority and work under the Chief Medical Officer (CMO). Other duties may be assigned as and when required, with no extra or additional allowance. Only basic facilities and infrastructure required for the assigned duties are provided. No transport facility or telephone/internet facility at the residence is provided. There is no entitlement to Provident Fund, Pension, Gratuity, Medical Attendance/Treatment, Seniority, Promotion or other benefits available to regular Government servants. The appointee has no claim or right to regular appointment to any post under the Centre. The Centre is not responsible for any loss, accident, damage or injury arising out of or in connection with the assigned work, including related travel. On appointment, the appointee must take an oath of allegiance to the Constitution of India or make a solemn affirmation in the prescribed proforma. The contract and its continuation are governed exclusively by the stated terms and conditions, as amended from time to time.

content_sections.text: Screening of documents and caste certificate. Walk-in interview before an Interview Board constituted by SSP, whose decision is final and binding. A screening test, if required. Medical screening of the selected candidate to ascertain medical fitness, which must be cleared before joining.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: Place of work: Salem Steel Plant's main hospital / Occupational Health Service Center (OHSC), Salem. Initial tenure is one year, which can be extended by one year at the Company's discretion. Engagement under the same contract cannot exceed three years. Working hours are a minimum of 8 hours a day for six days a week, or 48 hours a week. The doctor must also serve in emergent conditions or beyond normal hours, with no claim for extra pay. Performance is reviewed every year by the Head of Medical, Salem Steel Plant; the tenure can be curtailed or extended depending on performance. Either side can end the engagement with one month's notice. Poor performance or absence without permission can lead to termination. The company can also terminate forthwith for prolonged medical unfitness, moral turpitude, conviction, insolvency, loss of licence to practise, misconduct or financial irregularity. The engagement is purely contractual and gives no right to regular appointment in Salem Steel Plant. All company assets must be used properly and returned at the end of the contract.
