content_sections.heading: ESIC Job Description
content_sections.text: Senior Resident engaged at ESIC Medical College & Hospital may be assigned duties such as attending emergency, floor duty and other clinical duty as assigned by the Competent Authority, and performing duties in other departments as assigned by the competent authority.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Tenure of 3 years subject to satisfactory annual performance evaluation; no extension beyond 3 years Contractual agreement on a stamp paper of Rs.100/- Security deposit of Rs. 30,000/- by DD at joining, forfeited if the candidate leaves within one year Contract can be ended with one month's notice or one month's emoluments No right or preference for regular appointment; no PF, pension or other service benefits

content_sections.heading: Application Fee
content_sections.text: Payment mode: Demand Draft in favour of 'ESI Fund Account No.1' drawn on any scheduled bank payable at Chennai, submitted with the application form.

content_sections.heading: How Will ESIC Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Scrutiny of applications and document verification Screening test (MCQ) if turnout exceeds 1:10 per post Walk-in interview before the Selection Board Applications scrutinised by the scrutiny committee; only eligible candidates attend the interview If turnout exceeds 1:10 per post, a screening test of multiple choice questions in the concerned discipline may be held Top five from the screening test will be called for the interview Screening test marks are not linked to final selection Selection solely on performance in the interview before the Selection Board

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Identity proof and address proof Date of birth certificate (10th Certificate/Birth Certificate) and Class 10th & 12th mark sheets MBBS, MD/MS/DNB and experience certificates as applicable; internship completion certificate Registration with NMC / State Medical Council Reservation category certificate in Government of India format; NOC if applicable Two recent passport size photographs and Demand Draft for Rs.500/-

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: Candidates may apply for only one post, except Emergency Medicine, Physical Medicine & Rehabilitation, ICU and super-speciality departments No candidate is entertained for document verification after 11.00 AM Change in interview date, if any, will be intimated on the website only No TA/DA for interview or joining Candidates already working in the institution must submit prior intimation and not attend the interview while on duty Result will be published on www.esic.gov.in/recruitments

content_sections.heading: About Zilla Parishad Nagpur
content_sections.text: Zilla Parishad Nagpur is a district body of the Government of Maharashtra. Its Health Department runs Ayurvedic, Allopathic and mobile squad (phirte pathak) health units in Nagpur district. A selection committee chaired by the Collector of Nagpur is running this recruitment. The member secretary of that committee is the District Health Officer, Zilla Parishad Nagpur.

content_sections.heading: Zilla Parishad Nagpur Medical Officer Vacancy Details 2026
content_sections.text: These are temporary, ad hoc posts filled on contract for 11 months.

rows.post: Medical Officer (BAMS), Group B, contract, in the Ayurvedic / Allopathic / mobile squad units

content_sections.heading: Zilla Parishad Nagpur Medical Officer Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: You must not be older than 57 years. You can prove your age with a school leaving certificate (TC) or a birth certificate. BAMS. Bring the mark sheets for every year of your BAMS and of any PG degree or diploma. In the online form, enter only your final-year marks. A degree certificate and, if you have one, a PG degree or diploma certificate. A valid, regular registration certificate from the Medical Council is mandatory. A PG degree counts only if the Additional Qualification has been updated on your registration certificate. The notice accepts government service experience only when the appointing authority has signed the certificate. Examples are the Chief Executive Officer, the Civil Surgeon, the District Health Officer, the Medical Officer of Health of a Municipal Corporation, or another appointing authority. Certificates signed by a Taluka Health Officer or a Medical Superintendent are not accepted. Contract medical officers now working in Nagpur district need a favourable performance report from the Medical Officer of their Primary Health Centre and from the Taluka Health Officer. Candidates from within or outside the district who have complaints against them, or who were removed from work for poor performance, will not be put on the eligible list. Medical officers who were absent without permission, who took part in a strike, or who were removed from government service through disciplinary action cannot apply. Check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions for this post.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection is based on merit and has these stages: online application, verification of original documents, a provisional merit list, objections, a final merit list, and counselling. Verification takes place at Abasaheb Khedkar Sabhagruh, Zilla Parishad Nagpur, from 10.00 am to 2.00 pm. Your day depends on your application number. After verification, the provisional merit list will appear on the website. Objections must be submitted with supporting proof. The final merit list will be published on the website, and candidates at serial numbers 1 to 100 must report to the Health Department, Zilla Parishad Nagpur, for counselling. The committee's decision at counselling is final.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: The appointment is temporary and ad hoc, on contract, for 11 months. Candidates on the merit list who are not selected go on a waiting list for 1 year. They will be called from that list as posts fall vacant. If any political party applies direct or indirect recommendation or pressure for a candidate, that candidate will be declared ineligible without prior notice and removed from work.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Zilla Parishad Nagpur Medical Officer Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Go to www.nagpurzp.com and fill in the online application. In the marks field, enter only your final-year marks. Submit the form by 6.00 pm on 13 November 2026. The link closes after that time. Go for original document verification at Abasaheb Khedkar Sabhagruh on the day set for your application number. Look for your name on the provisional and final merit lists on the website. If you object to the provisional list, submit your objection with proof. If you are within serial numbers 1 to 100 on the final list, report for counselling. Promote AVNL products during naval exhibitions, maritime security forums and defence industry events. Identify export opportunities for logistics, security and support vehicles. Prepare long-term business diversification plans covering maritime logistics, coastal security, disaster response and defence infrastructure support.

content_sections.heading: NHM Jharkhand Recruitment 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection of Specialist Medical Officers will be conducted through a facility-wise financial bidding process, subject to the prescribed eligibility requirements. Applications will be shortlisted based on the prescribed eligibility criteria. Candidates may select a maximum of three facilities in one application. For each facility, the eligible candidate quoting the lowest acceptable monthly remuneration will be considered the L-1 bidder. If two or more candidates quote the same amount, preference will be determined according to the prescribed tie-breaking criteria, including postgraduate qualification, relevant experience, and date of birth. Preference and negotiation provisions for applicable reserved categories and Persons with Disabilities will be considered according to the recruitment rules. If the selected L-1 bidder does not join, the department may consider the next eligible bidder according to the prescribed procedure. The department reserves the right to reject bids that are considered unacceptable.

content_sections.heading: Nature and Tenure of Engagement
content_sections.text: The recruitment is for contractual engagement of Specialist Medical Officers. The engagement is contractual and does not constitute regular government employment. The agreement may initially be executed for three years, subject to the conditions stated in the notification. Continuation and renewal will be governed by the prescribed terms, including provisions relating to regular specialist postings. Selected candidates will not acquire a claim to regular appointment, absorption, seniority, or regular government service benefits. The allotted facility will be non-transferable. Selected candidates must comply with the prescribed duties and service conditions.

content_sections.heading: About AIIMS Bhopal
content_sections.text: All India Institute of Medical Sciences, Bhopal is a medical institute at Saket Nagar, Bhopal – 462020, Madhya Pradesh. This walk-in is conducted under the Dean (Academics), AIIMS Bhopal. Candidates selected will work as Junior Residents (Non-Academic) within the Institute.

content_sections.heading: Posts and Eligibility
content_sections.text: The notice advertises one post, Junior Resident (Non-Academic), with 20 vacancies. Eligibility is judged as on the date of interview, 19 November 2026. The 20 vacancies are split by category as shown below. The 20 posts include 01 post for PwBD candidates. PwBD reservation follows Government of India norms, with 4% of the total vacancies horizontally reserved for candidates with benchmark disabilities. A Medical Degree viz. MBBS in respective disciplines recognized by NMC/Institute of National Importance. Internship completed within 5 years of the date of interview. Valid registration with NMC/State Medical Council. Only candidates who have been declared passed in their qualifying degree exam and will complete their course tenure on or before the date of interview are eligible. Foreign medical graduates must produce an FMGE certificate conducted by NBE. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post. The upper age limit is 33 years as on the last date of submission of application, which is the date of interview (19 November 2026). The upper age limit is relaxed as follows: A Junior Resident (Non-Academic) gets Rs. 56,100/- (Level-10, Cell No. 01 as per 7th CPC) plus usual allowances including NPA as admissible under rule(s). The appointment is for 6 months and can be extended for another six months. In selected cases, the Institute can give an extension beyond two terms. The appointment is purely contractual and need-based. Applicants whose services were terminated on any disciplinary ground cannot be considered for the Junior Resident (NA) post, even if they otherwise qualify. Reservation for SC/ST/OBC/EWS and PwBD candidates follows Central Govt. rules/policy. Candidates claiming reservation must attach a copy of a valid category certificate issued by the appropriate authority: SC/ST: category certificate in the format at Annexure-I. OBC: certificate from the competent authority in the format at Annexure-II for Central Government jobs, along with a non-creamy layer certificate valid for the financial year 2026-2027. Certificates issued from 1 April 2026 to the date of the walk-in interview are valid. EWS: certificate from the competent authority in the form at Annexure-III, valid for the financial year 2026-2027. Certificates issued from 1 April 2026 to the date of the walk-in interview are valid. EWS reservation follows DoPT Office Memorandum No. 36039/1/2019-Estt (Res) dated 19 January 2019 and 31 January 2019. It gives 10% reservation to EWS persons not covered by the SC, ST and OBC reservation scheme. PwBD: a disability certificate from a duly constituted and authorized Medical Board of a State or Central Govt. hospital or institution. It must be countersigned by the Medical Superintendent/CMO/Head of Hospital/Institution, as the case may be. The Medical Board must follow the guidelines of the Ministry of Social Welfare and Empowerment, Govt. of India. The fee is paid only by Demand Dr

content_sections.heading: What to Bring
content_sections.text: There is no online application. Candidates bring the duly filled application form in the prescribed format, which is available on the AIIMS Bhopal website, www.aiimsbhopal.edu.in. Along with the form, bring the following originals and one set of self-attested copies: Proof of fee deposited (Demand Draft), if applicable Certificate showing Date of Birth (10th Certificate/Birth Certificate) Photo Identity Proof (PAN Card, Passport, Driving License, Voter Card, Aadhar Card etc.) Address proof UG all Mark Sheets and Degree/Certificate Internship Completion Certificate Registration with National Medical Commission/State Medical Council/Respective Council Category Certificate (OBC/SC/ST/EWS/PwBD) issued by the competent authority, if applicable Attempt Certificates FMGE certificate conducted by NBE (for foreign graduates) NOC, if applicable Photographs – 5 Nos. Copies of any other relevant documents Candidates who do not produce these original documents at the interview will not be considered or allowed into the selection process.

content_sections.heading: What Happens on the Day
content_sections.text: The notice says selection will be by a written test, an interview or both, as decided by the Institute authority. Written test: This is held if there are more than 20 candidates for any particular post. The top 15 merit candidates for each post are shortlisted for the interview. Written test marks only decide who qualifies for the interview. Interview: Selection is based on interview performance alone. Ties: If two or more candidates have the same interview marks, the older candidate (earlier date of birth) is ranked higher.

content_sections.heading: About AIIMS Kalyani Senior Resident
content_sections.text: AIIMS Kalyani is a statutory body under the aegis of the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, Government of India. It is located at NH-34 Connector, Basantapur, Saguna, Kalyani, District Nadia, West Bengal 741245. The notice describes it as an Institute of National Importance and one of the new AIIMS set up under the Pradhan Mantri Swasthya Suraksha Yojana (PMSSY) to correct regional imbalance in tertiary healthcare and to reach self-sufficiency in graduate, postgraduate and higher medical education and training.

content_sections.heading: Department-wise Vacancies
content_sections.text: AIIMS Kalyani has 12 Senior Resident (Non-Academic) vacancies across five departments. The notice gives the category break-up only for the total, not for each department: 4% of the total vacancies are horizontally reserved for Persons with Disabilities (PwD)-OPH (OL) category candidates, as permissible under the Rules. The physical requirements for these posts are S (Sitting), ST (Standing), W (Walking), MF (Manipulation by Fingers) and RW (Reading and Writing). Reservation will be as per Government of India Policy. The Competent Authority of AIIMS Kalyani reserves the right to vary the vacancies, including reserved vacancies, and AIIMS reserves the right to increase or decrease the number of vacancies. All candidates may apply against the post earmarked for EWS, on these conditions: their candidature will be considered only if EWS applicants are not available; they will be treated as UR candidates only, with no relaxations otherwise allowed to their own categories; and under no circumstances will the fees be refunded. If no eligible candidates are found from the advertised category, candidates from other categories may be considered for interview against the concerned category on a temporary basis.

content_sections.heading: Qualification and Experience
content_sections.text: All the terms and conditions of the Residency Scheme will be applicable. The essential qualification, experience and maximum age limit are counted up to the date of publishing the notification on the Institute website. Applicants without the required qualifications by that date will not be considered. Any period of experience that is prescribed is counted after obtaining the prescribed qualification. Qualifications and experience must be recognised by the Government of India. A candidature will be cancelled at any stage if the qualification or experience is found to be not recognised. Qualifications and experience may be relaxed in exceptional cases at the discretion of the Selection Committee, with prior approval of the Competent Authority. Candidates must not have been convicted by any Court of Law. For the Senior Resident post, the age limit is not exceeding 45 (Forty-Five) years as on the date of publishing the notification on the Institute website. No age relaxation is available to SC/ST/OBC candidates applying for unreserved vacancies. Age relaxation for other categories of candidates also applies as per the DoPT instructions, and all age relaxation is regulated as per the DoPT instructions. Candidates applying against SC/ST/OBC/OH/EWS posts are considered subject to a Caste/OH Certificate issued by the appropriate Competent Authority in the prescribed format. The community must be clearly and legibly mentioned in the certificate. OBC eligibility is based on the castes in the Central List of the Government of India. OBC candidates must not belong to the Creamy Layer, and their sub-caste must match the entries in the Central List of OBC. Otherwise their candidature will not be considered against any reserved category post they applied for. Only persons with not less than 40% physical disability are eligible for reservation under the OH quota. They must submit a Disability Certificate issued by a Competent Authority in the prescribed format. For Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PWBD), the disability certificate must be signed by a duly constituted and authorised Medical Board of State or Central Govt. Hospitals/Institutions and countersigned by the Medical Superintendent/CMO/Head of Hospital/Institution. The candidate will be allowed to join only after medical fitness certification by a duly constituted Medical Board. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility for each department.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: Allowances and perks are admissible as per the rules, in addition to Pay and NPA (for medical candidates only). All the posts carry the usual allowances admissible to Central Government Employees of similar status at Kalyani (West Bengal). AIIMS Kalyani will try to provide residential accommodation, subject to availability, but campus accommodation is limited and may not be possible in every case. Where no accommodation is provided, HRA as admissible to Central Government Servants of similar status stationed at Kalyani, West Bengal will be provided. Nature of appointment: Senior Resident (Non-Academic), a tenure post on contract for a maximum period of 3 years as per the Central Residency Scheme. Rules: The post is regulated by the provisions of the Central Residency Scheme and governed by the CCS (Temporary Service) Rules. Service under the Institute is governed by the Act of Parliament that established AIIMS as an autonomous body, and by the Rules and Regulations framed under it. Whole time: The post is whole time, and private practice of any kind is prohibited. Posting: Candidates are likely to be posted at the rural health and urban centre attached to the Institute, for a period decided by the Institute. Joining: Only candidates who can join within fifteen days from the date the Offer of engagement is issued may apply.

content_sections.heading: About KSMHA
content_sections.text: The Keralam State Mental Health Authority is a statutory authority constituted under section 45 of the Mental Healthcare Act 2017. Its office is at Red Cross Road, Thiruvananthapuram. The vacancies are in the Mental Health Review Boards at Kannur and Kozhikode, which were constituted as per Notification no. A/217/2017/KSMHA dated 25.01.2021 (available at www.ksmha.org). KSMHA has sent this notification to the Director of Health Services, the Director of Medical Education, the Director of Indian Systems of Medicine, the State Mission Director of the National Health Mission and the Project Director of the e-Health Mission, Thiruvananthapuram, and asked them to publish it on their official websites and notice boards.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Each post has its own application form in the notification: "Application Form for the Appointment of Member in Mental Health Review Board, Kannur" for the Member - Psychiatrist post, and "Application Form for the Appointment of Member in Mental Health Review Board, Kozhikode" for the Member - Medical Practitioner post. The application, with self-attested copies of the certificates and documents proving age, educational qualifications, experience, etc., may be submitted by post or by hand. Address: Chief Executive Officer, Keralam State Mental Health Authority, Red Cross Road, Trivandrum – 695 035 Write on the envelope: "Application for the appointment of Member of the Mental Health Review Board, Kannur/ Kozhikode" Mode: By post or by hand Last date of submission: 10 November 2026 (Tuesday), before 5.15 PM The application form asks for: Name Gender Date of birth, with an attested copy of a certificate proving the date of birth Address, with phone number and email id Educational qualification Occupation (current/past) The documents to attach: self-attested copies of the certificates of degree, post graduation and medical council registration A description of your experience in the field of mental health (a separate sheet may be attached) Curriculum Vitae (to be attached), marked YES or NO on the form The form ends with a declaration, signed with the place and date, that all the information submitted is correct, true and valid, and that the applicant will present the supporting documents as and when requested. The KSMHA letterhead gives the phone/fax number 0471 2472866 and the email address [email protected] .

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: The notice invites applications from interested persons who have the required qualifications. For each post, the qualification is set by the section of the Mental Healthcare Act, 2017 shown in the table. The application form for both posts asks for a description of the applicant's experience in the field of mental health. Candidates should check the official notification and the sections of the Mental Healthcare Act, 2017 it cites for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post. Under section 74(2) of the Mental Healthcare Act, 2017, a person shall be disqualified from appointment as the chairperson or a member of a Board, or be removed by the State Authority, if he: has been convicted and sentenced to imprisonment for an offence which involves moral turpitude; or is adjudged as an insolvent; or has been removed or dismissed from the service of the Government or a body corporate owned or controlled by the Government; or has such financial or other interest as is likely to prejudice the discharge of his functions as a member; or has such other disqualifications as may be prescribed by the Central Government. Rule 19 of the Mental Healthcare (Central Mental Health Authority and Mental Health Review Boards) Rules, 2018 (notified by the Central Government as G.S.R. 507 (E) dated 29th May, 2018) adds two more. A chairperson or member of the Board appointed by the State Authority shall stand disqualified if he holds: any full-time or part-time assignment that prevents him from giving adequate time and attention to the work of the Board under the provisions of the Act and the rules made there under; or any office in any political party during his tenure of office in the Board. The same honorarium rules apply to both posts. The honorarium and other allowances payable to a member of the Board are fixed by G.O.(Rt) No. 2188/2023/H&FWD dated 24.08.2023: A Member of the Board holds office for a term of five years or up to the age of seventy years, whichever is earlier. A Member is eligible for reappointment for another term of five years or up to the age of seventy years, whichever is earlier. The Chairperson of the State Authority makes the appointment of the members of the Board.

Desirable Qualifications: Experience in counselling adolescents aged 18 to 30 years, preferably in a residential institution, counselling centre, or psychiatric clinic. The closing date for submission of applications is considered as the cut-off date for age.

content_sections.heading: SVNIT Counselling Psychologist Job Description
content_sections.text: Individual Counselling & Psychological Support: Provide confidential, professional, one-to-one counselling services to students experiencing psychological, emotional, academic, social, behavioural, interpersonal, or personal concerns. Support students in managing stress, anxiety, depression, examination pressure, homesickness, adjustment difficulties, relationship concerns, grief, trauma, low self-esteem, loneliness, and other psychosocial challenges. Conduct psychological screening and assessments, develop individualized support plans, and provide follow-up and continuity of support. Crisis Intervention & Emergency Psychological Response: Provide timely psychological first-line support and crisis intervention in cases of acute emotional distress, suicidal ideation, self-harm risk, substance-use concerns, violence, harassment, trauma, or severe behavioural concerns. Undertake risk identification, safety planning, and intervention. Coordinate with Institute authorities, medical personnel, hostel administration, wardens, and emergency services while maintaining confidentiality. Mental Health Promotion, Awareness & Preventive Program: Design and conduct a structured calendar of mental health awareness, preventive, and wellness programs. Organize workshops, awareness campaigns, and interactive sessions. Conduct sensitization programs for students, faculty, staff, and other stakeholders to improve awareness and early identification of mental health concerns.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Duly filled application form in the prescribed format. Duly attested copies of all certificates and mark-sheets. Appropriate conversion formula to percentage or CGPA/GPA calculator (in case of CGPA/GPA). All supporting documents, which must be self-attested.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: The selection process consists of shortlisting followed by a personal interview. Shortlisting: The Institute will decide shortlisting parameters, and adequate numbers of shortlisted candidates will be called for interview. Fulfilling minimum qualifications and experience does not vest any right in a candidate for being called for an interview. Interview: Final selection is based on the performance of the candidate during a personal interview held at SVNIT Surat. No TA/DA is admissible for appearing in the interview.

basic_details.short_information: IICA Recruitment 2026 covers one Chief Program Executive post and one Program Executive post in the National Foundation for Corporate Governance (NFCG) at the Indian Institute of Corporate Affairs (IICA), Manesar, under the Ministry of Corporate Affairs. Both posts are purely contractual, with a monthly consolidated pay of Rs. 1,00,000/- to Rs. 1,25,000/- for Chief Program Executive and Rs. 60,000/- for Program Executive. A Qualified CS or a Postgraduate in law or economics can apply online through the separate link for each post by 8 November 2026.

age_limit.details: The age limit for both posts is below 63 years as on closing date. The crucial date for determining eligibility, educational qualifications, experience and age limit is the last date prescribed for submission of applications, 8 November 2026. The notice does not mention any age relaxation.

qualification.details: The prescribed essential qualifications are the minimum, and possessing them alone does not entitle a candidate to be called for the presentation and/or interview. Mark sheets alone in place of Degree/Diploma/Certificates will not be accepted. Provisional claims regarding the eligibility criteria will not be accepted. | Annexure-I of the official notification gives the eligibility conditions for each post.

how_to_apply: Applications are open through the link for each post until the last date. Late applications will not be entertained under any circumstances.
Make sure you meet the age, educational qualification and experience criteria for the post before filling in the application form.
Use the link for your post. Chief Program Executive: https://forms.gle/4ibQYQU78jfV1N599. Program Executive: https://forms.gle/9WUV5aEm7ZDiSQ5v8.
Submit your CV and cover letter through the application link.
Mention all qualifications and experience in the relevant area over and above the minimum prescribed, with complete, accurate and correct details.
Attach self-attested copies of the documents listed below.
Send the application so that it reaches IICA on or before 8 November 2026.
Matriculation or equivalent certificate in support of the declaration of age.
Degree or Diploma Certificate or other certificate, including mark-sheets, in support of educational qualifications.
If the qualification is equivalent, the authority (with number and date) under which it has been so treated.
Certificate/(s) from the Head/(s) of Organization/(s)/Department/(s) for the entire experience claimed, on Letter Head and duly stamped by the Competent Authority.

The experience certificate must mention the duration of employment (date, month and year), the basic pay and consolidated pay as the case may be, and the nature of duties performed or experience obtained.

Original certificates should not be sent with the application. They should be produced at the time of presentation and/or interview. An application received without copies of these certificates will be rejected, and no appeal against the rejection will be entertained.
important_instructions: Candidature shall stand cancelled if a candidate does not fulfil the eligibility criteria, furnishes incorrect or false information, certificates or documents, or suppresses any material fact. Certificates or documents must not carry any correction, alteration or tampering, whether in the document or in its attested copy. If two or more documents or their attested copies are inconsistent, an explanation regarding the inconsistency should be submitted. Only the date of birth recorded in the Matriculation, Higher Secondary Examination Certificate or an equivalent certificate will be accepted. No later request to change it will be considered or granted. IICA will in no case be responsible for non-receipt of an application or any delay in its receipt. Candidates must be of sound health. If selected, they will have to undergo such medical examination and satisfy such medical authority, if required. No interim correspondence or personal enquiries shall be entertained, and IICA will not correspond with candidates about reasons for non-selection. Canvassing in any form will disqualify the candidate. Any dispute arising out of this recruitment process shall be subject to the sole jurisdiction of the Courts in Haryana.

content_sections.heading: About DCCM Salem
content_sections.text: The District Climate Change Mission, Salem is a district-level mission in Salem. The District Collector, Salem issued this recruitment notification. The Technical Assistant will report to the Mission Director / District Climate Officer and work at the Salem District Collectorate and the District Forest Office, Salem, following the DCCM guidelines.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates should possess an Undergraduate Degree in: Life Sciences Environmental Sciences Ecology Forestry Wildlife Public Policy Similar / allied fields Candidates should also have basic typing skills in both Tamil and English. The notice gives priority to candidates with at least 1 year of relevant work experience. It does not list experience as a requirement to apply. The notice prints these points: Minimum 1 year of relevant work experience will be given priority. Candidates having 1 year of relevant experience, preferably in a Government Department / Government Office, are preferred. Experience in Data Entry and Data Management. Experience in official file maintenance, record keeping and documentation. Proficiency in MS Word, MS Excel and MS PowerPoint. Ability to prepare official reports, letters, statements and PowerPoint presentations. Experience in data compilation, tabulation and office documentation. Good communication, coordination and organisational skills. Ability to coordinate with Government Departments and stakeholders. The notice also says that the DCCM guidelines specifically give priority to candidates with at least one year of work experience. The candidate must be a resident of Salem District. The candidate should not have exceeded 40 years of age while applying for the post. For the full eligibility conditions of the Technical Assistant post, see the official notification.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The Technical Assistant will be engaged on contract and paid a consolidated remuneration of ₹22,000/- per month. The engagement lasts 19 months, as per Government sanction. The post includes official travel connected with the activities of the Department of Environment and Climate Change, as per applicable Government norms.

content_sections.heading: DCCM Salem Technical Assistant Job Description
content_sections.text: The notice lists these key responsibilities, which it says follow the Technical Assistant role in the DCCM guidelines: Coordinate DCCM activities with Government Departments and stakeholders. Assist in implementation and monitoring of climate change and environmental activities. Organise and support capacity-building programmes. Collect, compile and maintain climate and environmental data. Prepare reports, official correspondence, statements, presentations and documentation. Maintain official files, records and Mission-related documents. Assist in conducting DCCM meetings, workshops, training and awareness programmes. Document successful climate initiatives and district-level best practices. Undertake field visits related to District Climate Change Mission activities. Perform any other duties assigned by the Mission Director / District Climate Officer.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for DCCM Salem Technical Assistant
content_sections.text: Applications must be sent by 8 November 2026. The notice gives two ways to apply: Download the application form from the official Salem District website, salem.nic.in. Fill in the application form. Send the form with your updated Resume/CV and details of your educational qualifications and work experience to the email address [email protected] . Or submit the application at the office: Room No: 118, P Section, District Collector Office, Salem. content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates must satisfy the following educational and fellowship requirements to apply for the Junior Research Fellow positions: Educational Qualification: Candidates should have passed their M.Sc., M.Tech., M.Pharm., M.V.Sc., or 4-year graduate program or equivalent qualification in Life Sciences and allied subjects (Biochemistry, Biotechnology, Bioinformatics, Biophysics, Chemistry, Microbiology) with at least 55% marks without rounding off. Candidates awaiting final results may apply, but must produce their final mark sheet before joining. Fellowship Requirement: Candidates must have qualified in CSIR/UGC-JRF, DBT-JRF, UGC-RGNF, ICMR-JRF, or any other nationally competitive fellowship offered by the Government of India for PhD studies, having a valid fellowship for five years. If the original certificate is not available, a photocopy of the original admit card and the result page highlighting the roll number must be provided along with the application. Score sheet holders must submit their certificate at the time of the interview if shortlisted. Age Limit and Relaxation: Candidates should be below 28 years of age as of the last date of application submission (9 November 2026). The upper age limit is relaxed up to 5 years for SC, ST, Persons with Disability (PwD), and female applicants, and 3 years for OBC (Non-Creamy Layer) applicants.

content_sections.heading: About BSF
content_sections.text: The Border Security Force functions under the Ministry of Home Affairs, and its Directorate General is located at Block No.10, CGO Complex, Lodhi Road, New Delhi - 110 003. This recruitment is for the BSF Law Cadre and is being conducted by the Personnel branch, with the circular signed by Shekhar Gupta, DIG (Pers), on 10 September 2026.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: The nomination goes to this address: Dy. Inspector General (Pers), Directorate General, BSF, Block No. 10, CGO Complex, Lodhi Road, New Delhi, 110003. The notice says that applications received directly from the candidates will not be entertained, so the nomination must come through the officer's department. The notice does not mention the postal mode (speed post or registered post) or any text to be written on the envelope.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: Notwithstanding anything contained in the rules, only persons in medical category SHAPE-I are eligible for appointment, as specified in the BSF (Law Officers) RRs-2023 and amended RR-2026. This applies to deputation, absorption and re-employment. Candidates must meet the medical condition above and one of the following: (i) BSF officers: (a) any Officer serving in the Border Security Force having Bachelor Degree in Law from a recognised University or Institute; and (b) five years' experience rendered after appointment in Group-A service in the Border Security Force, with minimum three years' experience in dealing with law. OR (ii) Officers of the Central Government or State Government or Union territory Administration: (a) holding an analogous post on a regular basis in the parent cadre or department, or with five years' regular service in Level-10 (Rs. 56100-177500) in the pay matrix; and (b) possessing Bachelor Degree in Law from a recognised University or Institute and minimum six years' experience in dealing with law. Armed Forces personnel due to retire, or who are to be transferred to reserve within a period of one year, having the experience and qualifications prescribed for deputation and having held an equivalent post, shall also be considered. Such persons would be given deputation terms up to the date on which they are due for release from the Armed Forces; thereafter they may be continued on re-employment. The maximum age limit for appointment by deputation is not exceeding fifty-six years as on the last date of receipt of applications. Departmental candidates in the feeder category who are in the direct line of promotion shall not be eligible for consideration for appointment on deputation. Similarly, deputationists shall not be eligible for consideration for appointment by promotion. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions of the post.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Bio-data in the enclosed proforma, with photograph Photocopy of the Degree in Law Copies of CR dossiers / ACRs for the last five years, duly attested on each page Certificate from the employer / head of office / forwarding authority The Bio-data asks for: name, date of birth, educational qualifications, medical category, employment details in chronological order (office, post held, from, to, scale of pay and basic pay, nature of duties), present scale of pay and pay with next increment, whether the candidate belongs to SC/ST, any penalty imposed or in force, training programmes attended, nature of present employment, details of any present deputation or contract (date of initial appointment, period, parent office), revised scale of pay, total monthly emoluments now drawn, and additional information supporting suitability, followed by the candidate's signature and address.

content_sections.heading: About President's Secretariat
content_sections.text: The President's Secretariat is at Rashtrapati Bhavan, New Delhi, and its Administration Section issued this notice. The Under Secretary (Admin) invites the applications on behalf of the President of India. The post serves Rashtrapati Niketan, Dehradun, with its work centred on Rashtrapati Udyan.

content_sections.heading: President's Secretariat Park Superintendent Vacancy Details 2026
content_sections.text: The line above the notice's pay table refers to "05 posts", but its pay table and opening paragraph both give 01 post. The Secretariat may also alter the number of positions at any stage without notice. The remuneration is fixed and paid monthly by direct bank transfer. Pay for part of a month is pro rata, taking 30 days in a month. No other allowances are admissible. Pay is due only for the period of actual service under the Contract Agreement. Additional work outside the Terms of Reference, done with the Secretariat's prior authorization, carries no additional fee.

content_sections.heading: Job Responsibilities
content_sections.text: Day-to-day operational management and coordination of Rashtrapati Udyan. Planning and monitoring visitor management and visitor facilities. Coordinating with the office of Rashtrapati Niketan and reporting to the Manager, Niketan. Supervising and coordinating manpower deployed at the Udyan and monitoring their duties. Coordinating and monitoring outsourced agencies and service providers. Monitoring cleanliness, upkeep, facilities and overall service standards. Preparing operational plans and schedules, and submitting reports from time to time. Coordinating special events, programmes, visits and other activities in the Udyan. Identifying operational gaps and suggesting ways to improve efficiency, visitor experience and resource utilisation. Any other work assigned by the competent authority.

content_sections.heading: President's Secretariat Park Superintendent Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates upto the age of 45 years as on 30 September 2026 are eligible. The notice separately says all eligibility conditions will be reckoned as on the last date of the application. Bachelor's degree in any discipline from a recognised university. At least 3 years of post-qualification professional experience in operations, management, administration, visitor management, hospitality, tourism, event management or any related field. MBA from a recognized university. Working knowledge of computer skills, including proficiency in MS Office, data management and internet applications. The official notification (PDF) gives the full eligibility conditions for this post.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: A Selection Committee set up by the President's Secretariat carries out the entire selection process. Shortlisted applicants are informed by mail, e-mail or telephonic message for interview/written test. Eligible candidates have to appear for a Personal Interview before the Selection Committee. A selected applicant cannot withdraw candidature and must join within the time set by the Secretariat. From the opening of applications until selection is finalized, applicants should not contact the Secretariat about their application. Any effort to influence the process may result in rejection.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: The notice is inconsistent on medical cover: its pay section says no medical facility shall be extended, while its Health Cover section says the Park Superintendent is eligible for medical facilities from President's Estate Clinic. Other printed conditions: A declaration about marital status is required. The engagement will be terminated if the candidate has more than one spouse living, unless exempted under the rules or laws. An oath of allegiance or a solemn affirmation to the Constitution of India is required. Absolute integrity and confidentiality must be maintained, and any actual or potential conflict of interest must be disclosed. Corrupt, fraudulent, collusive or coercive practices can lead to disqualification, either indefinitely or for a stated period. The Park Superintendent is liable to pay taxes under the applicable laws of India, and to pay damages decided by the Secretariat for losses caused by negligence. Before resignation is accepted, all office property must be handed over to the Manager and a 'No Demand Certificate' obtained from Rashtrapati Niketan, Dehradun. Disputes go to the Secretary to the President, who may appoint an arbitrator. Court jurisdiction is within Delhi, and the language of arbitration is English.

rows.details: 01 year from joining; may be extended for one further year based on performance and progress of activities, on mutually agreed terms
Not on the regular cadre; no right to claim regular appointment or continued engagement

Paid leave may be allowed at 1.5 days per completed month; it cannot be claimed as a right, and there is no accumulation beyond the contract tenure and no encashment
No TA/DA, transport, telephone or residential accommodation from the President's Estate Pool of Accommodation
No pensionary benefit on account of this engagement
By either side after one month's notice, or at once on payment of one month's remuneration
Engagement can be terminated at any time, without notice or compensation

faq.question: Q1. Is an MBA compulsory for the Park Superintendent post?
faq.answer: No. An MBA is a desired qualification; the essential qualification is a Bachelor's degree in any discipline from a recognised university.

faq.question: Q2. What kind of experience counts?
faq.answer: The notice accepts at least 3 years of post-qualification professional experience in operations, management, administration, visitor management, hospitality, tourism, event management or any related field.

faq.question: Q3. Can the contract run beyond one year?
faq.answer: Yes, it may be extended for one further year based on performance and progress of activities.

faq.question: Q4. Is accommodation provided?
faq.answer: No residential accommodation is provided from the President's Estate Pool of Accommodation.

faq.question: Q5. Do I get allowances on top of ₹45,000?
faq.answer: No. The notice allows no other allowances, and TA/DA, transport and telephone facilities are also excluded.

faq.question: Q6. Can I keep another job or assignment during the contract?
faq.answer: No. The engagement is full-time, and no other assignment is allowed during this period.

faq.question: Q7. I am currently employed. What do I need for the interview?
faq.answer: You need a "No objection Certificate" from your employer. Without it, you will not be allowed to appear for the interview.

content_sections.heading: About IIFT
content_sections.text: The Indian Institute of Foreign Trade is a Deemed to be University. It is an autonomous body under the Department of Commerce & Industry, Government of India. The notice describes it as a premier institution of education, training and research in International Business, set up by the Department of Commerce. The Department of Commerce set up the Centre for WTO Studies in 1999 as a professional body. The Centre provides research and allied inputs to the government for negotiations at the WTO and for other WTO mandated committees. It now works under the Centre for Research on International Trade (CRIT), which is part of IIFT.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Write the application addressed to the Registrar, IIFT, New Delhi. Make the application clearly state that it is the "application for the post of Head, Centre for WTO Studies". Attach your CV. Attach a brief one-page write-up explaining why you consider yourself suitable for this post. Applications received without the write-up shall be rejected. Government officers send the application through the proper channel, with the documents listed under Enclosures. Email the application to [email protected] latest by 9 November 2026. Only persons with the qualification and experience below should apply.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: Three kinds of candidates can apply for the post of Head, Centre for WTO Studies. Each kind has its own conditions. Candidates must meet the essential qualification and experience on the last date of application. Direct or indirect experience in international trade, economics, economic diplomacy, international law, investment, public policy or a related discipline. At least 10 years of experience in international trade, economics, economic diplomacy, law, international law, investment, public policy or a related discipline. This can be sectoral (or Officer Level) experience, or research and teaching experience. Eight of those years should be at the level of Assistant/Associate Professor. Experience at the level of Associate Professor carries more weight. Candidates with relevant research or teaching experience should have at least four years as an Associate Professor in a premier institution such as the IITs, IIMs, IISc, National Law Schools, Central Universities or other institutions. Ph.D. shall be essential. A consistently good academic record with at least 55% (or an equivalent grade on a point scale wherever the grading system is followed) at bachelor's and master's level, or an equivalent qualification in a related discipline. Desirable: published work, particularly research papers in a peer-reviewed journal. Extensive direct experience of at least three years in international trade, economics, economic diplomacy, international law, investment, public policy or a related discipline. Work experience in international trade, economics, economic diplomacy, law, international law, investment, public policy or a related discipline that is significant and can be recognised at the National/International level. Desirable: ten years of managerial experience in industry/profession. A consistently good academic record with at least 55% marks (or an equivalent grade on a point scale wherever the grading system is followed) at Graduation and Post-Graduation level. From the Government: officers on deputation from the Government of India under Central Government/State Governments and their Attached offices, Subordinate offices, Public Sector Undertakings, Autonomous Bodies, Local Bodies etc. They are appointed on the basis of length of service and expertise in international trade, economics, economic diplomacy, international law, or a related discipline. content_sections.heading: IIFT Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: The Head of the Centre for WTO Studies is the Chief Executive of the Centre. The responsibilities include: Planning, implementing and monitoring the annual work programme of the Centre. Supervising the day-to-day functioning of the Centre, so that its objectives under Clause 4 of the Bye-laws of the Centre are met effectively. Undertaking research to help India's trade negotiators and policy makers take part effectively in the WTO and in related multilateral/bilateral trade negotiations. Improving stakeholders' understanding of key trade issues through outreach and dissemination activities. Helping to build consensus, and building capacity in India and other developing countries to analyse WTO and other trade-related issues through training programmes.

content_sections.text: Selection has two stages: shortlisting of applications, then an interview. The library operates from 9:00 AM to 12:00 Midnight, and the selected candidates may be required to work in shifts on a rotational basis, including weekends and holidays.

content_sections.heading: NLSIU Library Trainee Job Description
content_sections.text: The Library Trainee will work closely with the librarians at NLSIU and will be responsible for the following tasks: Catalogue Management (KOHA & Manual Records): Undertake copy cataloguing using Z39.50 (Library of Congress), edit and standardise records as per MARC21 and RDA/AACR2, correct bibliographic fields (author, title, edition, publication, pagination, subjects, classification), verify holdings data, and update legacy records where automated data is unavailable (1st Priority). Digitised Collections Management (Calibre): Review scanned PDFs for completeness and quality, add and standardise metadata, and update accession numbers, call numbers, and edition details to ensure accurate digital records (2nd Priority). DANS (Institutional Repository) Maintenance (DSpace): Correct dissertation titles and URLs, update abstracts, and complete or refine metadata to enhance accuracy, consistency, and discoverability (Last Priority).

basic_details.job_title: CMD Kerala Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 2 Company Secretary, Assistant Manager Posts
basic_details.short_information: The Centre for Management Development (CMD), Thiruvananthapuram, an autonomous institution under the Government of Kerala, invites online applications on behalf of a reputed Public Sector Undertaking for 2 posts of Company Secretary and Assistant Manager on a contract basis for a period of 03 (Three) years at a consolidated pay of Rs. 51,300/- per month. Eligible candidates possessing engineering graduation or membership of the Institute of Company Secretaries of India may apply online through www.cmd.kerala.gov.in from 22 October 2026, 10.00 AM to 10 November 2026, 05.00 PM.

how_to_apply: Visit the official portal of the Centre for Management Development at www.cmd.kerala.gov.in.
Navigate to the online application link for Notification No.CMD/10/2026/01.
Enter all relevant details accurately in the online application form.
Upload a scanned copy of your latest photograph in *.JPG format (file size must be less than 200 kB).
Sign in full on white paper (initials or capital letters are not permitted) and upload the scanned signature in *.JPG format (file size must be less than 50 kB).
Upload the original certificate or provisional certificate of your educational qualification issued by a competent authority (mark sheets or statements of marks are not accepted).

Upload valid work experience certificates clearly mentioning date of joining, relieving, duties and responsibilities, and the signature and seal of the authorized person. For latest experience, an affidavit containing these details may be uploaded.
Submit the online application before the closing time of 05.00 PM on 10 November 2026.
important_instructions: Applicants must compulsorily fill up all relevant fields; incomplete or incorrect applications will be summarily rejected. CMD will not entertain any information furnished by candidates subsequent to submission under any circumstances. Uploading mark sheets, consolidated mark sheets, or statements instead of original or provisional degree certificates will lead to rejection. Appointment letters, salary certificates, or pay slips will not be accepted in lieu of a work experience certificate. Applications with blurred or illegible photographs, signatures, or ambiguous experience certificates will be rejected. Applicants must maintain an active personal email ID and mobile number throughout the recruitment process, as intimations and call letters will be sent electronically. CMD reserves the right to call for any additional documentary evidence from candidates in support of educational qualifications, experience, or other notified eligibility requirements. CMD reserves the right to modify, cancel the notification, revise the number of posts at any time without assigning any reason, or stop the recruitment process altogether. CMD reserves the right to debar any candidate for malpractice, including fraudulent claims of benefits, relaxations, or misconduct.

content_sections.heading: About IIM Udaipur Incubation Centre
content_sections.text: The IIM Udaipur Incubation Centre is a Technology Business Incubator that fosters innovation and entrepreneurship. It is supported by IIM Udaipur and the National Science and Technology Entrepreneurship Development Board (NSTEDB) under the Department of Science and Technology, Government of India. The centre is starting projects to improve the livelihood of rural and tribal communities in Rajasthan and to scale micro-enterprises, and the Chief Operating Officer will lead and monitor these projects so that deliverables and milestones are met on time.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Master's degree in Management (MBA/PGDM), Social Work (MSW), Development Studies, Rural Management, Public Policy, or any related discipline. A Bachelor's degree with substantial relevant experience may also be considered. 10–15 years of executive/leadership experience, preferably in the social sector, rural development, livelihood or development programs. Experienced in strategic planning, project execution and risk mitigation. Strong professional network with foundations, not-for-profit organisations, CSR institutions and social-sector enterprises. Innovative and entrepreneurial mindset with the ability to identify and develop new business opportunities, market linkages and revenue streams for micro-enterprises. The age limit printed in the notice is "Preferably above 30 years". The notice prints no age relaxation and no cut-off date for counting age.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: The consolidated remuneration is 14-20 Lakhs (Gross, Annual), commensurate with experience. The nature of the post is contractual. The Chief Operating Officer reports to the Chief Executive Officer. The notice does not state the length of the contract or any allowances.

content_sections.heading: IIM Udaipur Incubation Centre Chief Operating Officer- Impact Programs Job Description
content_sections.text: Lead the overall planning, execution and monitoring of Impact Programs. Develop strategic plans, operational frameworks, timelines and performance targets. Oversee end-to-end implementation of rural development, tribal entrepreneurship and livelihood initiatives. Lead, manage and mentor project managers, field teams and implementation partners. Build and maintain relationships with government departments, funding agencies, NGOs and other key stakeholders. Monitor project budgets, resource allocation, expenditure and compliance with funding guidelines. Establish monitoring and evaluation systems to track program progress, outcomes and impact. Ensure timely preparation of high-quality project reports, MIS and donor/government reports. Conduct regular field visits to review implementation and resolve operational challenges. Identify project risks, develop mitigation strategies and ensure timely achievement of program deliverables. Strengthen operational processes, SOPs and systems for effective program delivery.

content_sections.heading: About IIT Jammu
content_sections.text: IIT Jammu (Indian Institute of Technology Jammu) is a technical institute in Jammu. It has a Central Instrumentation Facility (CIF) that runs a Water Testing Lab (WQTL), which tests water from the institute's Jagti and Paloura campuses and from outside organisations. The Outsource Agency is hiring the selected candidate and will depute them to work at IIT Jammu.

rows.pay: Consolidated salary package of Rs. 45,000-55,000/- per month

content_sections.heading: IIT Jammu Project Officer Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: The age limit for the post is 37 years. Candidates must meet one of the following two conditions: M. Tech degree in Environmental Engineering/Chemical Engineering or allied engineering branches with at least one year of relevant experience in Academics (Teaching post), NABL /accredited laboratory /research facility / industry and 60% marks or equivalent CGPA in the qualifying degree from a recognized University/ Institute. M.Sc. degree in Environmental Sciences / Chemistry or equivalent qualification in appropriate field with a minimum of 2 years of relevant experience in Academics (Teaching post), NABL /accredited laboratory /research facility / industry and 60% marks or equivalent CGPA in the qualifying degree from a recognized University/Institute. Good knowledge of computer applications is also a must. This covers email, word processing, spreadsheets, presentation software and operating systems such as MS-Windows. Preference goes to candidates with hands-on experience of equipment such as GC-MS, HPLC, Spectrophotometer and Atomic Absorption Spectrophotometer. The official notification gives the full eligibility for the post, so check it before applying.

content_sections.heading: Duties of the Project Officer
content_sections.text: The Project Officer will manage the water testing lab at the Central Instrumentation Facility (CIF) of IIT Jammu. The work includes tests on water quality parameters such as pH, conductivity, hardness, BOD, COD and heavy metals, including testing in the field. The officer will also handle 2-3 major scientific instruments at the CIF lab. The key responsibilities are: Each month, collecting samples of drinking water and waste water from 60 water filters and 6 STPs on the Jagti and Paloura campuses. Testing these samples for 10+ water quality parameters in triplicate and writing a report every month. External sampling when the WQTL receives requests. Field sampling as needed, for both external and internal samples. Operating the major sophisticated equipment in the WQTL, mainly gas chromatography, ion chromatography, atomic absorption spectrophotometry and ICP-MS. Maintaining the equipment at the WQTL, IIT Jammu. Other related work, such as processing bills and raising indents.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Only shortlisted candidates will be called for a Trade Test/Interaction. Having the qualifications does not guarantee a place on the shortlist. The Institute may set a cut-off higher than the minimum to keep the number of candidates reasonable. Candidates must bring all their original documents for verification at the Trade Test/Interaction.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: Period of engagement: 1 year, extendable each year based on performance and need. Nature of engagement: outsource basis. The Outsource Agency will depute the selected candidate to IIT Jammu. This is a purely temporary engagement. Being selected gives no claim to regularisation against any regular post, or against any future vacancy in any cadre or post at IIT Jammu.

rows.essential_qualification: MBBS / MD / PhD
rows.desirable_qualification: Experience in clinical research or clinical trials, preferably in neonatal/pediatrics research for at least 1 year; experience in multicentre research; knowledge of clinical trial randomization procedures, data entry software like RedCap, willingness to travel to the participating centers across India for investigator training, site initiation, and other study-related activities; good written and verbal communication skills in English and Tamil.

content_sections.heading: JIPMER Project Research Scientist-I (Medical) Job Description
content_sections.text: The engaged Project Research Scientist-I (Medical) will be responsible for the following duties: Overall coordination and day-to-day management of the multicentre SAFE-FEED trial at the coordinating centre. Coordinating with all participating centres to ensure uniform implementation of the study protocol. Organizing site initiation activities, investigator training, and periodic investigator meetings. Monitoring participant screening, recruitment, enrolment, and follow-up progress across centres. Ensuring protocol adherence, quality assurance, and consistency of study procedures across participating centres. Overseeing the implementation of the study randomisation process and ensuring adherence to the approved randomisation procedures and allocation concealment requirements. Overseeing data integrity, data quality checks, and timely completion of study documentation. Coordinating central monitoring, source data verification, and follow-up of protocol deviations. Coordinating regulatory documentation, progress reports, and communication with participating investigators. Assisting the Principal Investigator in overall project fund management, including budget monitoring, expenditure tracking, and preparation of financial statements and utilisation reports in coordination with the relevant institutional sections. Coordinating the procurement of study-related equipment, consumables, and other materials in accordance with the approved project budget and institutional procurement procedures. Monitoring study timelines and facilitating timely completion of project activities. Contributing to analysis, interpretation, and dissemination of study findings, including scientific reports and publications. Travel to the participating centers across India for investigator training, site initiation, and other study-related activities. Performing other duties related to the project as assigned by the Principal Investigator.

content_sections.text: Applicants will be shortlisted based on the details furnished in the application, CV, and the documentary proof provided. Topics for evaluation/syllabus: Clinical research methodology, clinical trial conduct, randomised controlled trials and randomisation procedures, Good Clinical Practice (GCP), research ethics, neonatal and paediatric research, basic biostatistics, clinical trial data management (including REDCap), multicentre study coordination, and interpretation of clinical research findings.

content_sections.heading: IIT Gandhinagar Research Associate II Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: This position follows Funding Agency norms, not Institute norms. Ph.D./MD/MS/MDS or equivalent degree, or 3 years of research, teaching and design and development experience after MVSc/M.Pharm/ME/M.Tech, with at least one research paper in a Science Citation Indexed (SCI) journal. From graduation onwards: minimum 60% or equivalent grade. Class 10th and 12th: 55% or equivalent grade. Research experience in Pharmacy, Pharmacology, Bioinformatics, Computational Biology, Computational Chemistry, Biophysics, or allied disciplines. Demonstrated expertise in molecular dynamics (MD) simulations, molecular docking, cheminformatics, virtual screening, molecular modelling, and computational analysis of protein-ligand interactions. Proficiency in relevant computational tools and platforms (for example GROMACS, AMBER, AutoDock, Schrödinger, RDKit) and programming languages such as Python. Familiarity with AI/ML approaches for drug discovery or molecular property prediction, which will be an added advantage. Evidence of relevant research expertise through peer-reviewed publications or demonstrated research outcomes. Check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of this post.

content_sections.heading: Job Description
content_sections.text: The Research Associate will contribute to computational research activities under the project. The key responsibilities are: Perform MD simulations, molecular docking, and computational studies of protein-ligand interactions. Undertake cheminformatics analysis, virtual screening, and structure-based identification and optimization of potential therapeutic molecules. Develop and implement computational workflows for molecular modelling, simulation, and analysis of biological systems. Integrate computational predictions with experimental findings to support hypothesis generation, compound prioritization, and validation. Collaborate with experimental and AI/ML research teams to support interdisciplinary research objectives. Analyze and interpret computational results, prepare scientific reports and manuscripts, and contribute to project deliverables.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Meeting the minimum eligibility criteria will not guarantee shortlisting or appointment, and a higher cutoff level may be used. The Institute reserves all rights not to call an applicant for a selection test, and not to fill the position through this round of selection, without assigning any reason.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: This is a temporary position, and the appointment is for one year.

faq.answer: Yes. Research scholars who have submitted their theses and are likely to defend soon may also submit the application.

faq.answer: You need a minimum of 60% or equivalent grade from graduation onwards, and 55% or equivalent grade in class 10th and 12th.

faq.answer: No. The consolidated monthly remuneration already includes HRA.

faq.answer: It is computational, but the Research Associate will also work with experimental and AI/ML research teams and integrate predictions with experimental findings.

content_sections.heading: About NHSRC Senior DBA
content_sections.text: National Health Systems Resource Centre (NHSRC) is a technical support institution under the National Health Mission (NHM), Ministry of Health & Family Welfare. The centre works closely with the MoHFW and the States for health systems strengthening. Work at NHSRC is organised around eight divisions, including the IT Division which oversees technical and database infrastructure for healthcare systems.

The consultancy is a short-term position for 11 months. Preference will be given to candidates residing within the Delhi/NCR region, and the selected candidate will be required to join within 7 days.

content_sections.heading: NHSRC Senior DBA Job Description
content_sections.text: The roles and responsibilities for the Senior DBA include: Design, implement, and maintain enterprise healthcare database systems. Install, configure, upgrade, and maintain diverse database ecosystems across Relational (MySQL, PostgreSQL, Oracle, SQL Server, MariaDB) and NoSQL (MongoDB) platforms. Engineer and manage highly scalable, secure, and resilient cloud-native and hybrid database environments. Ensure database performance optimization, tuning, indexing, partitioning, and capacity planning. Configure and manage Master-Slave (Primary-Replica) replication topologies to ensure high availability, data redundancy, and read-workload offloading. Monitor and troubleshoot replication lag, synchronization errors, and connectivity issues. Execute failover procedures and disaster recovery drills, promoting replica nodes to primary status to minimize downtime. Monitor database health, availability, and uptime for critical healthcare applications. Handle database upgrades, migrations, patching, and lifecycle management. Implement database security controls including encryption, role-based access, auditing, and vulnerability management. Ensure confidentiality, integrity, and availability of patient healthcare data. Develop and maintain backup, recovery, failover, and disaster recovery strategies. Conduct DR drills and ensure business continuity for operations. Assist in healthcare data warehousing and interoperability initiatives. Write complex queries and aggregation pipelines.

The notice is issued by the Khelo India Events wing and signed by Gunupuru Madhu Harsha, AD, Khelo India Events, Sports Authority of India. It is an engagement for the conduct of the Games.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the minimum educational qualification. What it requires is officiating credentials, judged as follows: National Technical Officials: only the officiating examination/certificate issued by the competent authority till the year 2026 shall be considered. International Technical Officials: the relevant certificate issued by the International Federation. Experience: officiating experience at State/National level and in Khelo India Games/National Games earns marks; only tournaments held between 2021-2026 shall be considered. Age: a candidate of age 60 or more shall not be considered. The notice prints no cut-off date for counting age. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions of the post.

rows.preference: Preference shall be given to international Technical Officials

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: SAI selects the Technical Officials by scrutiny of applications on a total of 100 marks. The notice does not mention a written test or an interview. Valid license/pass in officiating examination: 20 marks For both experience heads, only tournaments held between 2021-2026 shall be considered. A total number of 40 TOs shall be selected for the Games. The ratio of male to female Technical Officials shall be maintained at 60:40. Female TOs scoring a minimum of 50 marks are to be selected directly. A maximum of 5 TOs per State/UT are to be selected. A candidate of age 60 or more shall not be considered. In case of a tie due to the above conditions, the steering committee will finalise the shortlisted official(s).
