content_sections.heading: About CSIR-TKDL
content_sections.text: The CSIR-Traditional Knowledge Digital Library Unit is a constituent of the Council of Scientific and Industrial Research (CSIR), located on Satsang Vihar Marg in New Delhi. It protects and preserves India's traditional knowledge found in ancient texts by digitizing it into modern languages in a structured format. Its key objective is to prevent misappropriation of this knowledge through the wrong acquisition of intellectual property rights.

content_sections.heading: CSIR-TKDL Project Associate-I Vacancy Details 2026
content_sections.text: Both positions are under the project "The Importance of Traditional Wisdom: Environmental Consciousness in Vedic and other literature and its Relevance for Modern Climate Strategies (GAP-000001)". Rs. 31,000/- + HRA applies to candidates who have qualified CSIR UGC/ICAR/ICMR/NET, including lectureship/assistant professorship, or GATE. It also applies to those who have qualified national-level examinations conducted by Central Government Departments like DBT/DST, or equivalent, and/or their agencies or institutions. Rs. 25,000/- + HRA applies to all other candidates. HRA is payable as per the extant Government of India rules applicable to CSIR employees. A panel of waitlisted candidates, in order of merit, will be formed to fill vacancies that may arise in the near future. The panel remains valid until the project is completed.

content_sections.heading: CSIR-TKDL Project Associate-I Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: The age limit is 35 years, and the upper age limit is calculated as on the date of the interview. Age relaxation for SC/ST/OBC/PwD/woman candidates applies as per CSIR/Govt. of India rules. Essential qualification: Master's/Integrated Master's Degree in Natural Sciences or Forestry/Ecology or related fields from a recognized University or equivalent. Desirable: Experience in field surveys, resource mapping, monitoring ecological indicators, and development of conservation and management strategies for natural resources. Job description: Data compilation, establishing correlation between traditional knowledge on agriculture, forestry and ecology and modern sciences/contemporary practices, and assistance in report preparation. Essential qualification: Masters/Integrated Master's Degree in Environmental Sciences/Environmental Management/Environmental Studies/Environmental Engineering from a recognized University or equivalent. Desirable: Experience in handling environmental monitoring/climate change related project activities will be preferred. Job description: Establishing correlation between traditional knowledge and modern sciences/contemporary practices to mitigate arising environmental challenges. Candidates must have acquired the essential qualification with the result declared, and should hold at least a provisional certificate. Experience is counted from the date after acquiring the essential minimum educational qualification. Dissertation or thesis work done during the academic period is not counted as experience. Part-time, daily wages and visiting/guest faculty experience is not counted when shortlisting candidates for interview. Time spent acquiring a minimum higher qualification is not counted as experience over the essential qualification. Check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection is through a walk-in interview, with original certificates checked for age, qualification, marks obtained and experience. Meeting the minimum qualification does not by itself give a candidate any right to selection. The decision of the Head, CSIR-TKDL Unit, is final and binding.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: The engagement is purely temporary, time-bound and on contract basis, and is co-terminus with the project. Total tenure as project staff, including all CSIR postings and under one or more projects, cannot exceed six years. Performance is reviewed periodically, and staff not found up to the mark could be terminated without assigning any reason. Either side may end the contract with one month's notice or one-month stipend in lieu. The engagement gives no right to continuation beyond the tenure, absorption or regularization in CSIR, and no claim for a permanent position will be entertained. Project staff will not be upgraded in the same or any new project. The selected candidate is expected to join within the timeframe in the offer letter, after formalities such as medical examination and character verification. Other terms follow the guidelines of the funding agency/CSIR-TKDL Unit for project staff, as amended from time to time.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for CSIR-TKDL Project Associate-I Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Take the prescribed application form from the official notification or from www.csir.res.in . Fill it in completely, paste your photo and sign across it. An incomplete application in any form will be rejected. Complete and sign the declaration, including the years, months and days you have already served as project staff in CSIR. Report in person between 9:30 AM and 10:30 AM on 12 November 2026 at CSIR-TKDL Unit, 14, Satsang Vihar Marg, Qutub Institutional Area, New Delhi – 110067. Duly filled application form All original certificates/testimonials supporting age, qualification, marks obtained and experience One set of self-attested photocopies of those certificates Certificate for age relaxation, if you claim it No-Objection Certificate from your current employer, if you are employed

faq.question: Q1. Can final semester students attend the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: No. Result-awaited and final semester candidates are not eligible where the minimum essential qualification is mandatory. A provisional certificate is the minimum proof needed.

faq.question: Q2. Is prior work experience compulsory?
faq.answer: No experience is listed as essential for either post. Experience in areas such as field surveys or climate change related project activities is listed only as desirable.

faq.question: Q3. Will candidates get travel allowance for the interview?
faq.answer: No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview.

faq.question: Q4. What must a currently employed candidate bring?
faq.answer: An employed candidate must furnish a No-Objection Certificate from the current employer at the time of the interview.

faq.question: Q5. Can the job extend beyond the current contract?
faq.answer: The current engagement is limited to 15 January 2027 or the project duration. Even across several CSIR projects, a person's tenure cannot exceed six years.

faq.question: Q6. What happens to candidates who are not selected at first?
faq.answer: Candidates placed on the waitlisted panel may be considered in order of merit if vacancies arise before the project is completed.

faq.question: Q7. Can the number of positions change?
faq.answer: Yes. The Head, CSIR-TKDL Unit, may increase or decrease the positions, and may cancel the process at any stage.

faq.question: Q8. What can lead to disqualification or cancellation?
faq.answer: Canvassing in any form disqualifies a candidate. CSIR-TKDL Unit can also cancel or withdraw an offer if a discrepancy is found at any stage.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Desirable qualification: A strong knowledge and working experience in machine learning, and data analytics Experience of using neural networks and deep learning Ability to read research papers from standard conferences and journals, comprehend the methodology used and implement to reproduce the result quoted in the paper Experience of working on large real time projects GATE/NET/MPhil qualification Annexure-A (the Terms and Conditions for the Visvesvaraya PhD Scheme – Post Doctoral Fellowship) adds these eligibility conditions: The applicant must have obtained a PhD degree from a recognized University with first class (in terms of grades, etc.) in all preceding levels and a good academic record throughout. The PhD must have been completed within the past 5 years on the last date of submission of the application. The applicant should not have completed the PhD at the same institution (host institution) where the fellowship is to be awarded. The fellowship is awarded to researchers with a proven academic record, including peer-reviewed publications and recognitions. The applicant should be an Indian citizen. Applicants currently in regular employment will not be considered. Scientists or researchers with temporary positions in academia or research institutions will be considered, but they must give up their current roles if selected. A candidate who has already availed the fellowship under the scheme will not be eligible for support. Upper age limit: 40 years on the date the application is submitted to the eligible participating institution (host institution). The applicant's research proposal, submitted to the institution, should define clear objectives, outcomes and deliverables against the award. Preference will be given to applicants who have active industry linkages and whose research proposal is directed towards industry-specific problems. Desirable qualification and interest: A strong knowledge and working experience in machine learning and data analytics Experience of using neural networks and deep learning Ability to read research papers from standard conferences and journals, comprehend the methodology used and implement to reproduce the result quoted in the paper Experience of working on large real time projects Interest in working with theme areas of research related to: EEG data, Data communication, Natural Language Processing and Embedded System Instrumentation Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: PhD Fellow: Rs 46,250/- to Rs.52,500/- per month, plus Rent, Contingencies of Rs. 1.20 Lakhs and a Visit to Lab abroad. The position lasts five years or until the PhD is completed, whichever is earlier. Post-Doctoral Fellow: Annexure-A gives the financial support as follows: Fellowship: ₹1,08,393/month. Contingency Grant: ₹1,00,000/year, paid on a pro-rata basis (for example ₹25,000/quarter). It may be used only for minor equipment, consumables and research-related items. It cannot be used to hire research staff. Contingency spending in the last quarter is reimbursed to the institution as per eligibility. No advance is given. Travel support up to the prescribed limit of Rs. 2.10 Lakhs, admissible only for: (a) the visa fee and one-time travel support for overseas faculty/applicants returning to India to take up the fellowship; and (b) taking part, on invitation from PhD Cell, DIC, in activities, events and workshops of the Visvesvaraya PhD Scheme, following the host institution's norms for class and mode of travel. The awardee must claim reimbursement through the institution, and no advances are given for events. The Post Doctoral Fellowship is a full-time, non-transferable, temporary position tenable in India only. It is valid for 1 year, and no extension beyond one year is admissible under the scheme. Female candidates may take up to 6 months of maternity leave with fellowship support, subject to a maximum of 12 months of total fellowship support under the scheme. During maternity leave, only the fellowship is admissible. Awardees not registered under the scheme with the PhD Cell, Digital India Corporation (DIC), MeitY are not eligible for support. There is no provision to replace or transfer an awardee.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Qualification and experience must be in the relevant discipline or field and from a reputed institution or organisation recognised by the relevant authority. Experience counts from the date the minimum educational qualification was completed. Candidates with more than one eligible qualification must choose only one for the selection process. Persons already in regular time scale service under any Government Department or Organisation are not eligible. The age limit for both posts is a maximum of 35 years, counted as on the date of interview (13 November 2026). Relaxation of the upper age limit is allowed as per rules. Candidates with the following backgrounds are particularly well suited for this role: MPH with specialization in Epidemiology or Health Policy Master's in Public Policy (MPP) with health focus Health Economics or Health Systems Research training Candidates with experience working on NCD epidemiology, cancer control, or public health surveillance programmes Candidates with experience in conducting systematic review and meta-analysis Desired experience: At least 3 years' experience in public health research, policy analysis or evidence synthesis Experience working with government health programmes, national institutes, or policy think tanks Candidates with the following backgrounds are particularly suited: Science Communication / Health Communication specialists Public Health graduates with strong communication skills Candidates with experience translating scientific research into public communication Desired experience: At least 3 years' experience in science communication, health communication, or digital media Experience working with research institutes, universities, or public health organizations Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: Both posts pay a consolidated salary of Rs.42,000/- per month (All inclusive). Income tax and any other tax due under the prevailing rules is deducted at source before the monthly emoluments are paid. The engagement is purely temporary and contractual. The initial term is one year. An extension, if any, will be considered case by case, depending on job requirements, satisfactory performance and the Institute's need for the services. The selected candidate will not be treated as an "employee" or "official" of ICMR for any purpose. He or she will have no claim to an extension beyond the contract, to regularisation of service in ICMR or any of its Institutes/Centres or the Govt. of India, or to a regular appointment in the Council. The contract can be ended at any time without prior notice and without a reason. In the normal course, however, either side may end it by giving at least one month's notice at any time, without giving a reason.

content_sections.heading: ICMR NINE Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: Conduct missing data analysis, support documentation and reporting and adapt to evolving project needs. Develop policy briefs, evidence summaries, and policy notes based on NINE/NCRP research outputs. Translate epidemiological and surveillance findings into policy-relevant communication for ministries, national health programmes, and international agencies. Conduct rapid evidence synthesis and literature reviews related to cancer epidemiology, environmental risk factors, and NCD prevention strategies. Assist in preparation of technical reports, white papers, and national policy background documents. Support preparation of presentations, briefing materials, and strategic communication documents for senior policymakers and program managers. Contribute to evidence-based policy recommendations related to cancer surveillance, environmental determinants of cancer, and NCD control strategies. Key skill sets required: Policy and Research Skills: ability to translate epidemiological research into policy-relevant insights; strong capability in rapid literature review and evidence synthesis; experience drafting policy briefs, background notes, or policy summaries. Analytical Skills: understanding of public health data interpretation; familiarity with NCD epidemiology, cancer surveillance, and health system issues. Communication Skills: strong scientific writing and policy communication; ability to prepare concise policy summaries for decision makers. Technical Skills: familiarity with reference management tools (EndNote, Zotero); basic knowledge of data interpretation from epidemiological datasets. Develop communication products based on NINE research publications and NCRP reports. Prepare research highlights, summaries, and simplified explanations of scientific findings. Create infographics, visual abstracts, and communication materials for reports and publications. Support dissemination of NINE outputs through website, newsletters, digital platforms, and social media channels. Develop multimedia communication content including short videos, explainer graphics, and social media posts. Assist in organizing webinars, outreach events, and research dissemination activities. Key skill sets required: Scientific Communication Skills: ability to convert technical research findings into clear and engaging communication; experience preparing visual abstracts, summaries, and knowledge translation products. Digital Communication Skills: experience managing social media communication for research institutions; familiarity with digital dissemination strategies for scientific content. Creative and Technical Skills: ability to design infographics and visual communication materials; experience with tools such as Canva, Adobe Illustrator, PowerPoint design, or similar platforms. Editorial Skills: strong writing and editing skills for scientific summaries and public communication; ability to maintain accuracy while simplifying complex research findings.

content_sections.heading: About NRLM Karnataka Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: The National Rural Livelihoods Mission (NRLM) Karnataka, under Sanjeevini · KSRLPS, is facilitating entrepreneurship development activities by establishing One Stop Facility (OSF) centres. This recruitment aims to manage operations of the OSF centre in Nanjangud taluka of Mysuru district to support rural entrepreneurs and value chains.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Post Graduate in Management, Commerce, or Engineering from an institution of repute. Preference will be given to Young Professionals who have served in NRLM with any Post Graduation. Minimum 0–1 years of experience working in non-farm livelihoods promotion or in a business organisation, preferably in rural-based value chains. Minimum age: 18 years. Maximum age: 50 years.

content_sections.heading: NRLM Karnataka Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: The Block Manager – Entrepreneurship has the responsibility of operations of the One Stop Facility (OSF) centre. She/he has to ensure that entrepreneurs in the blocks are provided the required services. The specific role is: Ensure provision of Business Support Services by OSF to all the entrepreneurs in the block. Ensure that OSF has the required technical information (information about schemes etc.) for the services that need to be rendered. Create various data sets of enterprise and entrepreneurs in the block including the baseline survey of existing enterprises; ensure that this data is updated at regular intervals. Assist in preparing the necessary content for training and capacity building of various stakeholders. Ensure that financial requirements of enterprises are met, both from CEF and through Formal Financial Institutions. Coordinate amongst TSA, OSF, CBOs and project staff for effective implementation. Assist in identification and selection of Community Cadre and Mentors for OSF. Institutionalise OSF and governance mechanisms (infrastructure, opening bank account, appointment and rotation of signatories, etc.) as per norms. Support the CBOs in operationalising the various activities under the programme and in building their capacities to take over all the programme elements at the end of the project period. Identify new business opportunities and markets for setting up enterprises. Ensure regular monitoring and reporting of entrepreneurship development activities in the block. Ensure that both the quantitative and qualitative targets are met. Ensure MIS and monitoring reports are submitted as per the defined timelines. Provide handholding and business management support to the clusters / incubated enterprises being supported in the block.

content_sections.heading: Skills and Competencies
content_sections.text: Strong in numeracy, analytical, and business skills. Good team player with strong ability to work in teams and with people with no direct reporting relationships. Data driven, open to learning and adaptable, should be willing to adapt to ground realities. Compassionate for the poor and willing to look at issues from their lens. Honest, fair and objective in work. A Self-starter and a target-oriented person. Willing to travel extensively in the field and stay in a village for 15 days a month.

content_sections.heading: About CMD
content_sections.text: The Centre for Management Development is an autonomous institution under the Government of Kerala that provides management consultancy, project management and training to Central and State Governments, local self-governments, development agencies and private and public sector institutions. The Travancore Devaswom Board is a statutory body constituted under the Travancore-Cochin Hindu Religious Institutions Act. It administers more than 1,250 temples and other religious institutions across southern Kerala. As per the directions of the Hon'ble High Court of Kerala, TDB has undertaken a digital transformation of its administrative, financial and operational systems, with Kerala State IT Infrastructure Limited (KITFRA) as Technical Consultant. This notification is a revised version of Notification No. CMD/TDB/03/2026 dated 17.10.2026, as amended by Addendum-1 (No. CMD/TDB/03/2026/Addendum-1) dated 19.10.2026.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Educational qualification: MCA, M.Tech, or an equivalent recognised postgraduate qualification in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a closely related discipline. The qualification must be from a recognized University/Institute. Applicants with an equivalent qualification must submit an equivalency certificate issued by the competent authority; without it their applications will not be considered. Experience (cut-off date for experience is 13 November 2026): Minimum 10 years of relevant experience in the IT industry, including substantial experience in project or programme management. Proven experience delivering enterprise software platforms and cloud-native solutions. Experience leading multidisciplinary delivery teams of 20 or more members. Demonstrated ability to manage project scope, schedules, budgets, resources, risks and quality. Experience translating business requirements into scalable solutions with measurable outcomes. Proven experience managing delivery in Agile environments. Recognised project management or Agile certifications, such as PMP, PRINCE2 or equivalent. Experience delivering products or platforms incorporating AI capabilities. Experience in public-sector digital transformation or other regulated environments. The upper age limit is 50 years, counted as on 13 November 2026. No age relaxation is allowed for any category. Only candidates professing the Hindu religion are eligible to apply. Applicants must be citizens of India. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility details of the post.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: Monthly consolidated pay: Rs. 1,50,000 to Rs. 1,80,000. A 10% increment in remuneration will be granted for the second year, subject to satisfactory performance. The contract period is two (2) years or until completion of the programme, whichever is earlier. It is extendable for one further term based on performance and requirement. The appointment of Project Manager is purely based on the approval of the Travancore Devaswom Board (TDB). Selected candidates will be deployed at the PMU, TDB Enterprise Digital Transformation Programme, Thiruvananthapuram.

content_sections.heading: CMD Project Manager Job Description
content_sections.text: Develop and maintain project plans, milestones, resource allocations and delivery metrics. Coordinate technical teams, business stakeholders and implementation partners. Monitor progress, resolve delivery issues, and manage risks and dependencies. Ensure that solutions meet approved business requirements and quality standards. Oversee deployment readiness, user adoption and operational handover. Report project performance and outcomes to the PMU and designated authorities. Project planning, governance, reporting and change control. Backlog management in collaboration with product owners, MVP definition, prioritisation and release planning. Estimation, capacity planning and cross-functional coordination. Working knowledge of enterprise architecture, cloud technologies, APIs, integrations and DevOps practices. Understanding of information security, data privacy, quality assurance and applicable compliance requirements. Strong communication, team leadership, vendor coordination and stakeholder management skills.

content_sections.heading: About GBU
content_sections.text: Gautam Buddha University is a university in Greater Noida, Gautam Budh Nagar, Uttar Pradesh. This walk-in is for its Department of Education of Training under the School of Humanities and Social Sciences. The posts are for Academic Session 2026-27.

content_sections.heading: Posts and Eligibility
content_sections.text: The notice offers 02 posts of Assistant Professor (On Contract for Fixed Duration) in the Department of Education of Training, School of Humanities and Social Sciences. The required specialization and qualification printed in the vacancy table is Core Botany. Candidates must hold their qualifications at the time of submitting the application. These qualifications must meet the norms prescribed by the concerned regulatory bodies, such as CoA/AICTE/UGC. The notice also says that applicants should be from a reputed Institute/University. They may have evidence of published research work and teaching experience at the University/IIT/NIT level. The University follows the reservation norms of the U.P. Government for SC, ST, OBC and PwDs. Only the approved list of SC, ST and OBC categories is applicable at Gautam Buddha University. The conditions for reserved categories are: SC/ST and OBC-NCL candidates must produce a copy of the caste certificate in the format prescribed by the Government, as and when required. OBC candidates under the creamy layer will not get the advantage of reservation under the OBC category. Candidates who claim to be from the Economically Weaker Section (EWS) must fulfil the criteria under U.P. Government rules. The notice does not give a category-wise break-up of the 02 posts. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of the post.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: The monthly emolument (honorarium) for Assistant Professor (OCFD) is Rs. 57,700/- (Rs. Fifty Seven Thousand Seven Hundred only) per month for those having NET or Ph.D., as per UGC/CoA guidelines and other regulatory bodies like AICTE, at the entry level of Assistant Professor. The notice adds in brackets: "Candidates having M.Tech or equivalent in I.C.T./Engineering/PG Qualification in the relevant discipline/subject in accordance with the UGC regulations/rules of Concerned Regulatory Bodies". The honorarium finalized by the Selection Committee at the interview is final and stands for the entire duration of the engagement. A change in qualification after the interview will not change the honorarium. Selection does not give a right to the allowances and benefits admissible to regular faculty. The terms of engagement printed in the notice are: The engagement is for Academic Session 2026-27 only, for a maximum of 11 months or as per the requirement indicated. The Assistant Professor (OCFD) will be a full-time worker for the entire contract period and must follow the administrative and disciplinary regulations of GBU. Failure to comply is a ground for termination without notice. Working hours and days are the same as for regular employees of GBU. No extra benefit is allowed for working beyond office hours. Casual leave is 05 (five) days per semester. Academic leave is 05 (five) days at most for the entire engagement in Academic Session 2026-27, for academic meets and training programmes. Selected candidates may be provided accommodation on the University campus as per availability, on the University's terms and conditions. Selected candidates may bring any type of project from a Govt./Corporate funding agency, on the conditions laid down by the University. Selected candidates will not be allowed to accept or hold any other full-time or part-time assignment, online or offline, during the engagement.

content_sections.heading: CSIR CFTRI Technician Eligibility Criteria 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates must meet the prescribed educational and trade requirements as on 18 November 2026. The minimum qualification is Class 10 or equivalent with Science subjects and at least 55% marks, along with one of the accepted trade qualifications or experience routes. Applicants must meet the Class 10 Science and 55% marks requirement and satisfy any one of the following conditions in the relevant trade: ITI certificate or National/State Trade Certificate in the concerned trade. Two years of full-time apprenticeship training in the concerned trade from a recognized institution. Three years of work experience in the concerned trade in an eligible Central or State Government department, public sector undertaking or autonomous organization, as specified in the notification. The required ITI certificate or experience must correspond to the trade selected in the application. Candidates should check the exact trade name and supporting-document conditions in the official notification. The minimum age for CSIR CFTRI Technician Recruitment 2026 is 18 years and the maximum age is 28 years as on 18 November 2026. Relaxation in the upper age limit is available to eligible candidates under Government of India rules. Additional relaxation provisions apply to eligible widows, divorced women and women judicially separated from their husbands who have not remarried. Candidates seeking relaxation must provide the prescribed supporting certificates.

content_sections.heading: ISRO URSC Salary 2026
content_sections.text: The starting basic pay is Rs. 21,700 per month for Technician-B under Level 3 and Rs. 19,900 per month for driver posts under Level 2, plus admissible allowances. Selected employees will be governed by the applicable National Pension System or Unified Pension Scheme provisions. URSC/ISRO also provides eligible employees with benefits such as medical facilities, subsidized canteen facilities, leave travel concession and other facilities subject to the prescribed conditions. The advertised posts are described as temporary but likely to continue. Candidates should not confuse this classification with a short-term outsourced contract.

content_sections.heading: ISRO URSC Recruitment 2026 Application Fee
content_sections.text: All applicants must initially pay Rs. 500 per application . The recruitment carries a non-refundable application fee of Rs. 100 for applicable candidates, with refunds processed only for candidates who appear in the written examination. Important: The refundable amount is conditional on appearing in the written examination. Candidates who do not appear in the written test are not eligible for the refund. Payment is accepted online through the Bharatkosh payment gateway using Internet Banking, Debit Card, Credit Card or UPI. Applicable payment service charges are borne by the applicant. Refunds will normally be made to the original payment method. Candidates should provide correct bank account details for cases where the original refund method fails.

content_sections.heading: ISRO URSC Recruitment 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: The selection process includes initial application screening, a Written Test or Computer Based Test (CBT), and a qualifying Skill Test. For driver posts, the Skill Test is a practical driving assessment. Initial Screening: Applications will be screened using academic performance and other prescribed parameters. Written Examination / CBT: Screened-in candidates will appear for the applicable objective examination. Skill Test: Candidates shortlisted based on written examination performance will be called for a qualifying skill or driving test. Document Verification: Original educational, experience, reservation and other eligibility documents will be verified. Final Selection: Selection will follow the prescribed written examination merit and qualifying skill test requirements.

content_sections.heading: ISRO URSC Technician-B Exam Pattern 2026
content_sections.text: Reserved-category qualifying standards apply only where the relevant vacancy is reserved. The Technician-B written examination syllabus is based on the prescribed trade curriculum.

content_sections.heading: ISRO URSC Driver Exam Pattern 2026
content_sections.text: The written test for Heavy Vehicle Driver-A, Light Vehicle Driver-A and Staff Car Driver-A consists of 100 multiple-choice questions to be completed in 120 minutes. Each correct answer carries one mark, and 0.25 marks are deducted for every incorrect answer . Candidates must secure 50% marks in Part A. Candidates must also secure 50% marks in Parts B, C and D taken together. The notification provides 25% relaxation in passing marks for eligible reserved categories where the respective post is reserved. The practical driving Skill Test carries 100 marks, with 60 marks required to qualify . No relaxation in Skill Test qualifying marks is allowed for any category. Candidates qualifying in the written examination will be shortlisted for the Skill Test in a 1:10 ratio. The Skill Test is qualifying in nature.

content_sections.heading: SAI Deputy Director Job Description
content_sections.text: Functions as a Section Head, assisting and reporting to the Divisional Head in matters relating to sports administration, policy implementation, and programme management. Exercises overall supervision, coordination, and management of assigned divisions or centres, ensuring effective implementation of SAI schemes and Government of India guidelines. Maintains and monitors data related to athletes, personnel, and schemes. Oversees administrative and financial matters and ensures compliance with applicable rules and procedures. Conducts inspections of offices, training centres, and field units to ensure smooth functioning of operations and optimal execution of training programmes. Handles inter-divisional coordination, communication with stakeholders, and supports decision-making processes at higher levels to achieve organizational objectives.

content_sections.text: The following documents must accompany the application: Application in the prescribed format (Annexure-I), duly completed, signed by the candidate, and countersigned with official seal by the Cadre or Appointing Authority. Integrity Certificate. Vigilance Clearance Certificate issued by the Competent Authority. No Major or Minor penalty certificate for the last 5 years of service. A certificate to the effect that the particulars furnished by the candidate have been verified and found correct as per service records (Annexure-II). Cadre Clearance Certificate.

content_sections.heading: About NIFT
content_sections.text: The National Institute of Fashion Technology (NIFT) was set up in 1986 under the Ministry of Textiles, Govt. of India. It is a statutory institute governed by the NIFT Act 2006 and has 20 campuses across the country. Its head office is at NIFT Campus, Hauz Khas, New Delhi. NIFT describes itself as an institute of fashion education that also works as a knowledge service provider to the Union and State governments in design development and in the positioning of handlooms and handicrafts.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Send the application, with self-attested copies of documents in support of qualification, experience, age and so on, to this address: The Registrar, NIFT Campus, Hauz Khas, Near Gulmohar Park, New Delhi- 110016. It must reach that address on or before 20 November 2026 by 05:00 PM. Every letter from NIFT, including any interview/interaction letter, will be sent only to the email address you give in the application form. Item 11 of the form asks for the full postal address with PIN code of your forwarding authority, along with that authority's name, telephone number and email address. Item 13 is for your three campus preferences if you are applying for Campus Director.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: All four posts are at the same pay: Level – 13 (7th CPC) / PB – 4 [Rs. 37400 – 67000/- + Grade Pay Rs. 8700/- (6th CPC)]. The pay of a candidate selected on deputation will be regulated under the DoP&T O.M. No. 6/8/2009-Estt.(Pay II) dated 17.06.2010, as amended from time to time. The 16 Campus Director locations are Bengaluru, Bhopal, Bhubaneswar, Chennai, Gandhinagar, Hyderabad, Jodhpur, Kangra, Kolkata, Kannur, Mumbai, New Delhi, Patna, Raebareli, Shillong and Srinagar. Officers of the Central Govt. / State Govt./ UT/ Autonomous Organization / PSUs who hold analogous posts on regular basis, with at least 2 years' experience on a post at the level of Director of Govt. of India or equivalent, and with relevant experience in administrative / establishment / admissions/ Academic matters. You must give 3 choices of campus in order of preference. The posts are transferable across all NIFT campuses. The Competent Authority is free to transfer a Campus Director to any NIFT campus. NIFT reserves the right to post the selected candidate to a campus outside the choices given. Age limit: the maximum age for appointment shall not exceed 56 years as on the closing date of receipt of applications. Period of deputation: three years. The tenure shall not be extended further. Vigilance Clearance Certificate (in original) (Annexure – IV) Cadre Clearance Certificate (in original) (Annexure – V) Attested photocopies of the APARs (Annexure – VI) for the last five years (2020-21 to 2024-25). The application will not be considered without them. Matriculation Certificate (as proof of age) Self-attested copies of your educational qualification, experience and caste/ category certificates (wherever applicable) Each page should be attested by an officer not below the rank of an Under Secretary to the Govt. of India. content_sections.heading: APPSC Group 2 Eligibility Criteria 2026
content_sections.text: The minimum educational qualification for most APPSC Group 2 posts is a Bachelor's degree from a recognized university. However, Finance and Law Assistant Section Officer posts and Accountant positions have specific qualification conditions. Qualification Cut-off: Candidates must possess the required qualification on the date of the detailed notification. Graduates from a recognized university can apply for Post Codes 01 to 08, subject to the remaining eligibility conditions. These include Deputy Tahsildar, Municipal Commissioner, Sub-Registrar and several other posts. However, the Finance and Law Assistant Section Officer posts and Accountant posts have additional or specific qualification requirements. Candidates applying for Sub-Registrar Grade-II must possess a Bachelor's degree from a recognized university. The notification gives preference to candidates who also hold a recognized Law degree. Candidates applying for Assistant Section Officer in the Finance Department must possess a Bachelor's degree in Mathematics, Economics or Commerce from a recognized university, or an accepted equivalent qualification. Applicants for Assistant Section Officer in the Law Department must possess a Bachelor's degree in Law from a recognized university or an accepted equivalent qualification. For Senior Accountant and Junior Accountant posts, the notification specifies Commerce, Economics or Mathematics degrees and also provides eligibility through other recognized degrees with the prescribed computer-related certificate qualifications, or specified computer-related degrees. The accepted certificate course examinations conducted by the Board of Technical Education and Training, Andhra Pradesh, include: Office Automation. PC Maintenance and Trouble Shooting. Web Designing. Candidates should compare their exact degree and certificate combination with the detailed eligibility provisions before applying for Post Codes 11 and 12. Candidates applying for Prohibition and Excise Sub-Inspector under Post Code 07 must satisfy the physical requirements prescribed for the post. APPSC has directed applicants to refer to the detailed notification for these requirements.

content_sections.heading: APPSC Group 2 Selection Process 2026
content_sections.text: The APPSC Group 2 recruitment notification provides for an offline OMR-based Screening Test and a Main Examination. The annexure also contains a Computer Proficiency Test scheme. Candidates should check the detailed notification for the complete post-wise selection rules. The preliminary screening examination will be conducted offline in objective-type OMR format. The test contains 150 questions for 150 marks, with a duration of 150 minutes. The main examination consists of two objective-type papers carrying 150 marks each, for a total of 300 marks. The brief notification includes a Computer Proficiency Test scheme covering computer operations and office automation. The applicability of this test to individual posts should be confirmed from the detailed notification.

content_sections.heading: APPSC Group 2 Exam Pattern 2026
content_sections.text: The APPSC Group 2 examination scheme includes a 150-mark Screening Test and a 300-mark Main Examination. The notification prescribes negative marking of one-third of the marks assigned to each incorrect answer. Exam Mode: Offline OMR-based examination. Negative Marking: One-third of the marks prescribed for a question will be deducted for each incorrect answer in the Screening Test and Main Examination.

content_sections.heading: APPSC Group 2 Syllabus 2026
content_sections.text: The APPSC Group 2 syllabus includes Indian History, Geography, Indian Society, Current Affairs, Mental Ability, Andhra Pradesh History, Indian Constitution, Economy and Science and Technology. Indus Valley Civilization and Vedic Age. Buddhism and Jainism. Mauryan and Gupta Empires. Delhi Sultanate and Mughal Empire. Bhakti and Sufi Movements. Rise of the Maratha Empire. 1857 Revolt and Indian National Movement. Post-Independence Consolidation and Reorganization. Physical Geography and Major Landforms. Climate, Atmosphere and Ocean Currents. Geography of India and Andhra Pradesh. Natural Resources, Agriculture and Industries. Transport, Communication and Tourism. Human Development, Population and Urbanization. Natural Hazards and Disaster Management. Family, Marriage, Kinship, Caste and Tribe. Religion, Ethnicity and Women. Social Issues and Regionalism. Crime Against Women and Child Labour. Public Welfare Policies and Programmes. Constitutional and Statutory Provisions for Vulnerable Groups. International Current Events. National Current Events. Andhra Pradesh Current Affairs. Logical Reasoning and Analytical Reasoning. Statement and Assumptions. Statement and Arguments. Statement and Conclusions. Number and Letter Series. Coding and Decoding. Relations and Shapes. Percentages, Ratio and Proportion. Simple and Compound Interest. Time and Work, Time and Distance. Data Interpretation and Basic Numeracy.

content_sections.heading: APPSC Group 2 Mains Syllabus 2026
content_sections.text: The Group 2 Main Examination includes two papers covering Andhra Pradesh social history, the Indian Constitution, Indian and Andhra Pradesh Economy, and Science and Technology. Prehistoric Cultures in Andhra Pradesh. Satavahanas, Ikshvakus and Vishnukundins. Eastern Chalukyas and Andhra Cholas. Social and Cultural Development from the 11th to 16th Century. Andhra Under British Rule. Growth of the National Movement in Andhra Pradesh. Andhra Movement and Formation of Andhra State in 1953. Formation of Andhra Pradesh and Important Developments from 1956 to 2014. Constitutional Development and Salient Features. Preamble, Fundamental Rights and Directive Principles. Fundamental Duties and Constitutional Amendments. Legislature, Executive and Judiciary. Judicial Review and Judicial Activism. Centre-State Relations. Constitutional Bodies, RTI, Lokpal and Lokayukta. Elections, Electoral Reforms and Anti-Defection Law. 73rd and 74th Constitutional Amendments. Structure of Indian Economy and Economic Planning. National Income, Economic Growth and Development. Economic Reforms and NITI Aayog. Money, Banking, RBI and Monetary Policy. Inflation, Fiscal Policy and GST. Agriculture, Industry and Services Sector. Andhra Pradesh State Economy and Public Finance. AP Agriculture and Allied Sectors. Industrial Development, MSMEs and IT Sector in Andhra Pradesh. Science and Technology Policies and Missions. Space Technology and Indian Space Missions. Defence Technology and DRDO. Information Technology, Digital India and Cyber Security. Nuclear Technology and Energy Policy. Renewable and Non-Renewable Energy. Ecology, Ecosystems and Biodiversity. Environmental Pollution and Waste Management. Climate Change and Sustainable Development. Public Health, Disease Burden and Healthcare Initiatives.

content_sections.heading: About APDCL
content_sections.text: APDCL is a distribution licensee whose office of the Chief General Manager (HRA) is at Bijulee Bhawan, Guwahati. The State Level CGRF is the forum that hears consumer grievances, and its work is governed by the Assam Electricity Regulatory Commission (Redressal of Consumer Grievances) Regulations, 2022. This notice fills the seat of the Consumer Representative that APDCL nominates to the Forum.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Candidates meeting the eligibility criteria may send their application in the prescribed format (Annexure I) in hard copy only to this address: O/o the CGM (HRA), APDCL, Bijulee Bhawan, Paltanbazar, Ghy-781001 Use only the prescribed format, Annexure I. content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: The post is Consumer Representative (APDCL's nominated), a member of the State Level CGRF. The official notification does not specify the minimum educational qualification. The eligibility conditions printed in the notice are: The member shall not be in employment of the distribution licensee (APDCL) or any of its agencies, in any capacity, for a period of three years preceding the date of being appointed as member of the Forum. The member should have good antecedents. The member should not have any outstanding dues of electricity or cases pending with APDCL during the time of appointment. Desirable: members of CGRF are well conversant with the official language of the State. No member shall hold office after attaining the age of 70 (Seventy) years. The notice gives no other age limit. The nominated members of the State Level Forum are entitled to a sitting fee of Rs. 3000/- for every sitting of the Forum. This amount may be revised by the Commission (AERC) in consultation with APDCL from time to time. The nominated Members are also entitled to conveyance allowance for attending the official duties of the Forum. The duties and responsibilities are as stipulated in the Assam Electricity Regulatory Commission (Redressal of Consumer Grievances) Regulations, 2022, as amended from time to time by AERC/Competent Authority. Every nominated member holds office for a term of three years from the date of entry into the office. A selected Member will be given short notice to join in the respective office. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions of the post.

content_sections.heading: About OIL Domain Expert (Critical Minerals)
content_sections.text: Oil India Limited describes itself in the notice as a Maharatna Public Sector Undertaking and the second largest national upstream Oil & Gas Company with a pan India presence and global footprint. In line with the Government of India's National Critical Mineral Mission (NCMM), OIL has diversified into exploration and development of critical and strategic minerals and has secured two strategic critical mineral blocks under the Composite Licence (CL) regime: Phop Block in Arunachal Pradesh and Jorkian Block in Rajasthan. The Domain Expert is being empanelled for specialised assignments under this programme.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Applications are invited only from retired officers . The essential requirements for the Domain Expert (Critical Minerals) post are: Masters in M.Sc./M. Tech. in Geology / Applied Geology from Government recognized College/ Universities/ Institution. Retired from a Government mining/geoscientific organization in the pay scale of at least ₹1,82,200– ₹2,24,100. A minimum of 25 years of relevant professional experience. Candidates who have worked with the Geological Survey of India and have at least one year of experience in Critical Mineral Assessment would be preferred. Good interpersonal, delegation, liaison, networking and communication skills to establish effective relationships internal and external to the organization. Experience in technical planning of an Exploration project for deep-seated and critical minerals. Preparation of Prospecting & Exploration plan for the composite and mining lease blocks, including Geological, Geophysical and Geochemical techniques. Estimation and evaluation of resource/reserve of bedded, deep-seated and critical minerals as per the United Nations Framework Classification for Resources (UNFC), with follow-up of The Minerals (Evidence of Mineral Contents) MEMC Rules 2015 and The Australasian Joint Ore Reserves Committee (JORC) Rules. Ability to provide expert advice for searching deep-seated minerals in uncovered areas. Experience in selecting and exploring lithium, cobalt, graphite, nickel, copper, potash, REE and other associated critical minerals. Experience and knowledge of various facets of work related to Geology & Mining, Policy & Regulation of Mines and Minerals. Good understanding of mining leases and familiarity with government procedures and policies. Ability to prepare technical components of RFPs for the engagement of consultants for critical mineral exploration. The candidate should not be more than 68 years of age as on 05/12/2026. The candidate must also have a minimum of 02 remaining years before attaining the maximum permissible age limit of 70 years at the time of application. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions of the post.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The Domain Expert on call duty is paid a per-day honorarium according to level/grade: Travel, local conveyance, boarding and lodging will be arranged by OIL as per the entitlements of regular executives of their status in OIL. No other facilities will be extended or borne by OIL. The period of empanelment is 02 (Two) years, and the selected candidate shall be engaged on a contract basis. The engagement will be on-call basis from time to time during the project period. Domain experts will be engaged up to 100 days during the year, starting from the date of the empanelment. A non-binding understanding between the Project Proponent and the Domain Expert on the Project Plan will be the basis of engagement. The empanelment is terminable at any time by serving 01 (One) month notice in writing by either party. The expert will report at CoEES, OIL, Guwahati, and may be required to visit areas in and outside India occasionally for business development and as per operational requirements.

content_sections.heading: OIL Domain Expert (Critical Minerals) Job Description
content_sections.text: The Domain Expert shall provide technical guidance for ongoing and upcoming activities associated with the exploration and development of the Phop, Jorkian and other critical mineral blocks, including: Geological mapping Trenching and drilling Core studies and laboratory data interpretation Hydrogeological investigations Beneficiation studies Resource estimation and other associated activities

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for OIL Domain Expert (Critical Minerals)
content_sections.text: Fill in the application only in the prescribed format, "Application for Empanelment as Domain Expert (Critical Minerals)", attached to the notice. Affix a recent passport size photograph and give personal details, educational qualifications, membership of professional bodies and experience details, with a write-up on relevant experience of maximum 300 words. Sign the declaration with date and place. Enclose self-attested copies of proof of date of birth and proof of relevant experience/educational qualification. Send the application to Chief General Manager (HR-Acquisitions), OIL Human Resources Office, Oil India Limited, 3rd Floor, P.O. Duliajan, Assam-786602, or by email to [email protected] . Make sure it is sent on or before 23:59 hours of 05/12/2026. Recent passport size photograph (affixed on the form) Proof of Date of Birth Proof of relevant experience/Education Qualification

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Online application received after 23:59 hours of 05/12/2026 will be rejected. Applications submitted without supporting documents for proof of date of birth, educational qualification and relevant experience will also be rejected. If the information provided is found incorrect or false, the empanelment may be cancelled at any time without informing the candidate.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for Assam Chief Minister's Fellow Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application is 14 November 2026 at 11:59 PM.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for Assam Chief Minister's Fellow Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold an MBA, MBA-equivalent qualification or Master's degree in Social Sciences, Public Policy or Development Studies, with at least 60% marks or equivalent CGPA in the qualifying postgraduate qualification.

faq.question: Q4. Is 60% required in Class 10, Class 12 and graduation?
faq.answer: No. The notification explicitly states that the 60% requirement applies to the qualifying postgraduate degree or MBA-equivalent qualification only.

faq.question: Q5. What is the remuneration for Assam Chief Minister's Fellows?
faq.answer: The annual remuneration is Rs. 6,00,000 in the first year and Rs. 6,60,000 in the second year, including the prescribed travel expense components.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit for Assam Chief Minister's Fellow Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The recruitment advertisement does not specify a minimum or maximum age limit.

faq.question: Q7. How can eligible candidates apply for this position?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates can apply exclusively through the online mode by visiting the official website of the CMAAA Society Assam and submitting their forms before the deadline.

faq.question: Q8. What is the duration of the Chief Minister’s Fellowship?
faq.answer: The fellowship is awarded for a total duration of 24 months, subject to periodic performance evaluations every six months against Key Performance Indicators (KPIs).

faq.question: Q9. Is there any application fee required to apply?
faq.answer: No application fee is specified in the official recruitment notification for applying to the Chief Minister’s Fellow post under CMAAA Society Assam.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official website and notification link?
faq.answer: The official website can be accessed at cmaaa.assam.gov.in, and direct links to the notification PDF and online application portal are provided in the important links section of this article.

content_sections.heading: OIL Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: To be posted at Rajasthan under CoEES, Oil India Limited, Guwahati, Assam. Deployment at field exploration activities such as geological mapping, trenching, sampling, drilling and coring supervision, and coordination with Exploration Agency. Monitoring and documentation of exploration progress and quality of field data. Coordinating and sample preparation for laboratories for sample testing. Office-based work at the project site, including data compilation and preparation of reports. Assisting OIL's in-house geologists in supervising exploration activities and ensuring timely execution of the approved exploration programme. Awareness and adherence to OIL's HSE policies and Code of Conduct. Other allied jobs as assigned by the concerned Reporting Officer/HoD. Skills and experience listed: Detailed geological mapping and structural studies; systematic sampling and supervision of drilling operations. Continuous field monitoring and quality control of exploration activities executed by the Exploration Agency; coordinating with laboratories for sample testing. Coordination with local administration, State authorities and statutory agencies like DGM, IBM, PCCF, CGWB etc. Compilation, validation and interpretation of geological data and preparation of technical reports, including inputs for Geological Reports to be submitted to IBM/State authorities. Excellent communication skills with fluency in English; general technical ability and safety awareness; good IT and database skills; ability to work as part of a team. To be posted at Arunachal Pradesh under CoEES, Oil India Limited, Guwahati, Assam. Deployment at field exploration activities such as geological mapping, trenching, sampling, drilling and coring supervision, and coordination with Exploration Agency. Monitoring and documentation of exploration progress and quality of field data. Coordinating and sample preparation for laboratories for sample testing. Office-based work at the project site, including data compilation and preparation of reports. Assisting OIL's in-house geologists in supervising exploration activities and ensuring timely execution of the approved exploration programme. Awareness and adherence to OIL's HSE policies and Code of Conduct. Other allied jobs as assigned by the concerned Reporting Officer/HoD. Skills and experience listed for this post are the same ten points as for the Rajasthan post: mapping and structural studies; sampling and drilling supervision; field monitoring and quality control; laboratory coordination; coordination with local administration and agencies such as DGM, IBM, PCCF and CGWB; data compilation and technical reports; fluency in English; technical ability and safety awareness; IT and database skills; teamwork. Facilitation of Training Programmes and Support in Training Module Development. Coordination of field studies, stakeholder consultations, workshops and capacity-building programmes. Liaison with government departments, development partners and community stakeholders. Project documentation, monitoring and dissemination of research outputs. content_sections.text: The PGIMER Labour Officer application is not sent directly by the candidate. It goes through the officer's own employer: Fill the prescribed proforma for the post of Labour Officer (Pay Level-10) on deputation basis, which is available on the official website of the Institute (it is also printed as the last page of the notice). Paste your latest passport size photograph in the box on the proforma and sign it. Attach attested copies of your ACR/APARs for the preceding five years. content_sections.heading: About GGU
content_sections.text: Guru Ghasidas Vishwavidyalaya, Bilaspur (C.G.), is a Central University established by the Central Universities Act, 2009, and describes itself as NAAC Accredited with A++ Grade. This post is in the university's Department of Biotechnology. It serves a research project funded by ICMR, New Delhi, led by Dr Santosh Kumar, Associate Professor and Principal Investigator.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The notice accepts either of the following: Three-year Bachelor's degree in Life Sciences, Biotechnology, Biochemistry, Microbiology, or any other relevant biological science from a recognised university/institution, with a minimum of two years of post-qualification experience in the relevant field. OR Postgraduate degree in Life Sciences/ Biotechnology/ Biochemistry/ Microbiology or other relevant biological sciences from a recognized university/institution. The two years of post-qualification experience is required only with the three-year Bachelor's degree. The notice does not ask for experience with the Postgraduate degree. Hands-on experience in mammalian cell culture, molecular biology, cell-based assays and routine laboratory techniques. The age limit is below 30 years on the date of interview. Project duration: maximum 3 years. The post is purely temporary, for a limited period or for the duration of the research project funded by the funding agency.

content_sections.text: The selected candidate's roles and responsibilities, as printed in the notice: Assist in routine laboratory activities. Maintenance of cell cultures. Preparing project-related documents, progress reports and manuscripts. Other administrative and coordination activities as assigned by the Principal Investigator.

content_sections.heading: About NHSRC
content_sections.text: National Health Systems Resource Centre (NHSRC) is based in New Delhi. Under these Terms of Reference, it is recruiting on behalf of the Ministry of Health & Family Welfare for the Central TB Division. The post deals with Public-Private Partnerships for TB control in India under the National TB Elimination Programme (NTEP).

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The notice lists the following essential qualification and requirements for the Technical Officer (Public Private Partnership) post: M.A. in Sociology/ Master of Social Work (MSW)/ PGD in Social Work (PGDSW)/ PGD in Rural Development/ M.A. in Rural Development/ MBA in Rural Development/ M.A. in Social Science or PGD in Social Science, OR MBA. Working knowledge of computers. The notice lists these as preferential qualifications and skills. They are not part of the essential qualification. Experience of working in the field of public health programs at National/ State level, preferably in Public Private Partnerships and/ or the health system. At least five (05) years of experience in case of Post Graduate Diploma qualification, and three (03) years of experience in case of Post Graduate Degree qualification. At least 3 years' experience in project management is desirable. The age limit is "Upto 65 years". The notice does not print an age cut-off date or any age relaxation. Along with the age requirement, the notice says that candidates must be ready to travel extensively. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions of the post.

content_sections.heading: NHSRC Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: The notice lists the following responsibilities for the Technical Officer (Public Private Partnership): To handle day to day correspondence at Central TB Division pertaining to Public-Private-Partnerships for TB control in India. To assist the CTD in maintaining database of stake holders in PPP (including mapping and regular updating). Coordination with different Core Committees and Technical Working Group for PPM. To assist in updating and revising PPP guidelines according to the policy revisions. To facilitate the national/regional trainings on PPP. Implement, review and evaluate NTEP partnership with medical colleges including facilitation of NTF, ZTF, STF and Core Committees of Medical Colleges involved in NTEP. Plan, coordinate and facilitate involvement of corporate hospitals and DNB institutions in NTEP. Coordinate and facilitate involvement of other public health sectors and institutions like CGHS, ESI, Railways etc. Coordinate with MCI, NCI, PCI and AYUSH councils for incorporation of NTEP in curricula. To conduct supervisory visits to states/districts to monitor PPP implementation and report to CTD. To assist in monitoring the enrolment of health facilities, Private Practitioners and NGOs under various PPP schemes, their performance and disbursal of Grand in Aids. To assist in monitoring the PPP performance of the States/UTs and districts based on relevant indicators derived from respective quarterly reports and PPP reports, and providing feedbacks to states/districts. To assist in compiling PPP reports to the Government of India and PPP stakeholders. To assist in conducting meetings with partners, documenting the minutes, compiling reports on action taken and providing feedbacks. To work in collaboration with technical officers of other thematic areas of the program on cross cutting issues. To identify and foster innovative and sustainable financing mechanism for effective programme implementation and assist in stake holder consultation. To assist Central TB Division in organizing periodic review meeting of State PPM Coordinators at national level, and to facilitate change management with respect to use of ICT and Nikshay tools for concerned data entry, validation and its use for public health action. Any other job assigned as per programme need.

To ensure proper functioning of supply chain management of second line drugs, and to initiate actions to fill the gaps. This is done by reviewing: the quarterly PMDT reports; district/state quarterly reports on program management and logistics; monthly state drug store reports on second line drugs. To support mortality reduction activities like differential TB Care among TB patients. To assist in timely revisions/updates of technical and operation guidelines based on evidences and changes in policies. To assist in preparing reports on program performance for the government and stake holders based on pre-defined indicators. To support ADR monitoring and management activities. To conduct supervisory visits to states/districts as per program needs. To assist and or conduct in organising trainings/meetings. content_sections.heading: About MoPSW Consultant
content_sections.text: The Ministry of Ports, Shipping & Waterways is a ministry of the Government of India. Its Estt. Section at 425, Transport Bhavan, 1, Parliament Street, New Delhi - 110001 issued this vacancy circular dated 6 November 2026. The Consultant will assist the ministry's PD-I Section in handling matters related to the Adjudicatory Board for Major Ports. The selected candidate will be appointed for specific tasks and duration and will be assigned clear output-related goals.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: The circular asks eligible persons to submit their application in the prescribed proforma (attached as Annexure I) to the undersigned, latest by 27 November 2026. The undersigned is Sumit Nandan, Under Secretary to the Govt. of India, Estt. Section, Ministry of Ports, Shipping & Waterways, whose office address on the letterhead is 425, Transport Bhavan, 1, Parliament Street, New Delhi - 110001. The notice does not mention a postal mode (speed post, registered post or by hand) or any wording to write on the envelope. The proforma at Annexure I asks for the following details: Name (in Block Letters) Date of Birth (attach copy of Aadhar card/PAN card) Correspondence Address Permanent Address Contact Number & Email ID Date of Entry into service Date of Entry into Govt service/PSU/Autonomous Org (if applicable) Date of Retirement Name of Ministry/Deptt./Organisation from where Retired Educational Qualification/Additional Qualifications, if any Brief particulars of service with nature of duties performed (if required in separate sheet in chronological order) Post held at the time of retirement with scale of pay Additional information, if any The form ends with a declaration that all statements are true and complete and that the candidate agrees with the terms and conditions for the appointment in case of selection, followed by date, signature and name.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: The circular is for one (01) Consultant on contract basis. The eligibility conditions are: Open to Retired Central Government Employees. The applicant should preferably have at least ten (10) years of experience in a Central Government Ministry/Department and be a retired Section Officer or above or equivalent. The applicant should have knowledge/work experience in the field/subjects specified in Annexure II (the job description below). Age: not more than 63 years on the last date of submission of application. The applicant should not have been retired as a matter of punishment. The official notification does not specify the minimum educational qualification; the proforma only asks applicants to list their educational and additional qualifications, if any. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions of the post. Pay: The monthly remuneration/Consultancy fees of the Consultant would be fixed by deducting Basic Pension from the pay drawn at the time of retirement, plus TA (as decided by the Ministry). Consultants shall not be eligible for any benefit, compensation or allowances under the provisions of any Act/Rules in addition to what the circular mentions. The initial period of engagement is one year from the date of joining. This period may be extended, if required. The appointment is of temporary nature and can be terminated at any time without assigning any reason. The appointment would be on full-time basis; the selected Consultant would not be permitted to take up any other assignment during the period of consultancy with the Ministry. The Consultant shall be allowed to avail leave up to 18 days in a calendar year. An agreement of Consultancy will be signed by the selected Consultant. Specific deliverables against time limit will be conveyed at the time of signing the agreement. Consultants shall maintain discipline and absolute integrity in accordance with the CCS (Conduct) Rules, 1964.

content_sections.heading: MoPSW Consultant Job Description
content_sections.text: Annexure II (Terms of Reference / Job Description for Consultant, PD-I Section) lists these duties related to the Adjudicatory Board for Major Ports: Processing and handling the quarterly release of Grant-in-Aid to the Adjudicatory Board for Major Ports, ensuring timely submission and compliance with prescribed procedures. Liaising and coordinating with the Pay and Accounts Office (PAO) for online release of funds, reconciliation of accounts, and budgetary tracking. Coordinating with the Ministry of Finance for facilitating the appointment of the Comptroller and Auditor General (CAG) for audit of the Annual Accounts of the Adjudicatory Board and ensuring follow-up action. Managing the process relating to the laying of Annual Administrative Reports and Audit Reports of the Adjudicatory Board before both Houses of Parliament, in accordance with laid down procedures and timelines. Handling administrative matters of the Adjudicatory Board, including processing proposals for appointment of officers and staff, and related service matters. Processing proposals for extension of tenure of Chairperson/Members of the Adjudicatory Board in accordance with applicable rules and guidelines. Scrutinizing agenda notes/items for meetings of the Adjudicatory Board to ensure completeness, accuracy, and alignment with Ministry policies and guidelines. Providing secretariat assistance for meetings of the Adjudicatory Board, including preparation of briefs, minutes, and follow-up actions. Undertaking any other work assigned by the competent authority/higher officers from time to time.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: The application in the prescribed proforma (Annexure I), signed and dated. Copy of Aadhar card/PAN card as proof of date of birth. Copy of the PPO. Mobile/telephone number and e-mail address must be mentioned in the application. A medical certificate of fitness is not an enclosure with the application: candidates will have to submit it on the day of interview/joining.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: The interview, if required, of the eligible/shortlisted candidates will be held in the coming weeks after the closing date. No interview date has been fixed in the circular. Candidates must bring a medical certificate of fitness on the day of interview/joining.

Give details of your work experience and the Advertisement Number (IITD/IRD/314/2026) in the form.
Email the filled form to Prof. Neetu Singh at [email protected], with the advertisement number in the subject line.
Send it so that it is submitted by 17 November 2026, 5.00 p.m.
For any clarification on eligibility, contact Prof. Neetu Singh at [email protected].
important_instructions: Only Indian nationals may apply. Meeting the advertised qualification does not guarantee an interview call, since higher short-listing criteria may be fixed. Updates on short-listing and interview details will appear at http://ird.iitd.ac.in/shortlisted.

content_sections.heading: Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: The engagement is at the level of Associate and is purely on a contractual basis. The engagement is initially for one year, including a probation period of three weeks. It may be extended year-to-year depending on performance evaluation. After three years no further extension is permissible under any circumstances. The period of engagement commences from the date of joining at APEDA. It confers no claim or right to subsequent engagement or employment with APEDA or any other Government Department. Working hours are normally 9.00 AM to 5.30 PM on working days, including a half-hour lunch break. In exigencies of work the Associate may be required to sit late and to work on Saturday, Sunday and other holidays. The Associate is eligible for 20 days of leave in a year on pro-rata basis, with prior written approval of the controlling officer. Un-availed leave cannot be carried forward. Leave up to one month without remuneration can be considered with prior approval. A female Associate may be eligible for maternity leave as per the Maternity Benefit (Amendment) Act, 2017. The engagement can be terminated at any time by APEDA with 30 days' notice or pay in lieu. The Associate may also resign after giving similar notice.

The candidate must not be facing any disciplinary proceedings before the Bar Council of India and/or the Bar Council of the State concerned or any other authority. | For the complete eligibility conditions, refer to the official notification and the enclosed 2023 Guidelines.

how_to_apply: Use the prescribed application form (Schedule-I) attached to the notice. Address it to the Principal District & Sessions Judge (South), Saket Court Complex, New Delhi.

Fill in all 13 items of the Applicant's Profile, including your qualifications with percentage of marks, your experience, your computer knowledge, the number and date of your enrolment as an Advocate with the place of enrolment, and your present employer, if any.
Paste a latest passport-size coloured photograph on the form, then sign it with the place and date.
Attach the relevant documents listed below.

Submit the duly filled form in the General Branch, South District, Saket Courts Complex, New Delhi, through the Receipt and Issue Branch, (South District), Room No. 401, Saket Court Complex, New Delhi.
Submit it on any working day between 10.00 A.M. and 05.00 P.M., latest by 20 November 2026. Applications received after the due date and time will not be entertained.

Undertaking/Declaration in Schedule-II. The notice refers to the proforma "as per Schedule-I & II", and the guidelines require the selected candidate to sign it before joining.

For three years after the engagement ends, the Law Researcher must not appear in any case handled by that District Judge during the period they worked together, whether or not the Law Researcher worked on the case. Strict secrecy must be kept about matters learnt during the engagement, including after it ends, unless disclosure is legally required. A "No Dues Certificate" must be obtained from all branches of the District Courts on completion of the engagement or on leaving early.
