content_sections.heading: About Saket Court
content_sections.text: The Office of the Principal District & Sessions Judge (South) is located at the District Court Complex, Saket, New Delhi. This engagement follows the "Guidelines for Engagement of Law Researchers for the District Judges (Commercial Courts) in Delhi, 2023", which the High Court of Delhi approved and enclosed with the notice. Under those guidelines, every District Judge (Commercial Court) in Delhi is entitled to the services of one Law Researcher.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Applications are invited from Members of the Bar who meet these conditions: Qualification: A graduate in law from a recognized law school/college/university/institute established by law in India and recognized by the Bar Council of India. The candidate needs not less than 55% marks in the aggregate and must be eligible for enrolment as an Advocate with the Bar Council. Preference: Preference may be given to candidates having a Post Graduation Degree in Law or other relevant experience. Computer skills: The candidate must have good working knowledge of computers. Nationality: The candidate must be a citizen of India. Age: The candidate must not be above 32 years of age as on the date of making the application for engagement. The notice does not mention any age relaxation. The candidate must not be engaged, or appointed/employed elsewhere, on an honorarium/payment/salary basis during the engagement as Law Researcher. The candidate should not have been convicted of, or involved in, any criminal case relating to an offence involving moral turpitude. The candidate must not be facing any disciplinary proceedings before the Bar Council of India and/or the Bar Council of the State concerned or any other authority. For the complete eligibility conditions, refer to the official notification and the enclosed 2023 Guidelines.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The Law Researcher will be paid a fixed monthly honorarium of Rs.50,000/- or such honorarium as may be revised from time to time. The Law Researcher is not entitled to any other allowance or perks. The engagement is on a purely short-term contractual basis for one year. It can be extended by another term of one year under the orders of the Principal District and Sessions Judge, on the recommendation of the District Judge (Commercial Court). The engagement does not confer any right or claim to regular appointment or to continuance in service beyond the actual period of engagement. A Law Researcher may be prematurely discharged with immediate effect, without any reason being given. A Law Researcher who wishes to leave early must give at least one month's prior notice in writing to the Principal District and Sessions Judge. This requirement may be waived in appropriate cases or extenuating circumstances. Casual leave may be granted up to a maximum of 12 days per year, in proportion to the period of engagement. Special casual leave may be granted for 10 days in June and 5 days during the winter vacation. Extraordinary medical leave of up to 10 days on half remuneration may be granted in extreme cases. No stipend is paid for unauthorized absence or for leave beyond the permissible limit. Leave needs approval from the District Judge (Commercial Court). In an emergency, the Law Researcher may proceed on leave after giving prior intimation. An experience certificate may be issued after a minimum of six months of engagement, subject to the approval of the Principal District and Sessions Judge.

content_sections.heading: Saket Court Law Researcher Job Description
content_sections.text: Render assistance to the concerned District Judge (Commercial Court) in judicial functions. Assist with the administrative functions of the District Judge (Commercial Court), as assigned. Work under the direct control and supervision of the District Judge (Commercial Court), and under the overall administrative control of the Principal District and Sessions Judge. Work during the Court working hours of the Delhi District Courts. The Law Researcher may also be required to work after Court hours, and to attend the office or residential office of the District Judge on gazetted or local holidays. The Law Researcher may be posted with any District Judge (Commercial Court) in the district and may be transferred from one Commercial Court to another within the district. During the engagement, the Law Researcher will have access to the Court room. At the discretion of the District Judge (Commercial Court), the Law Researcher may also have access to the Judge's chamber, the Library and the Residential Office.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Saket Court Law Researcher
content_sections.text: Use the prescribed application form (Schedule-I) attached to the notice. Address it to the Principal District & Sessions Judge (South), Saket Court Complex, New Delhi. Fill in all 13 items of the Applicant's Profile, including your qualifications with percentage of marks, your experience, your computer knowledge, the number and date of your enrolment as an Advocate with the place of enrolment, and your present employer, if any. Paste a latest passport-size coloured photograph on the form, then sign it with the place and date. Attach the relevant documents listed below. Submit the duly filled form in the General Branch, South District, Saket Courts Complex, New Delhi, through the Receipt and Issue Branch, (South District), Room No. 401, Saket Court Complex, New Delhi. Submit it on any working day between 10.00 A.M. and 05.00 P.M., latest by 20 November 2026. Applications received after the due date and time will not be entertained. A latest passport-size coloured photograph pasted on the form Documents pertaining to educational qualification(s) Documents pertaining to experience Documents pertaining to publication(s) Undertaking/Declaration in Schedule-II. The notice refers to the proforma "as per Schedule-I & II", and the guidelines require the selected candidate to sign it before joining.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Selection has three stages: shortlisting, a personal interview, and verification of documents. Shortlisting: The office of the Principal District and Sessions Judge shortlists candidates from the applications received, according to the eligibility criteria in the guidelines. Selection Committee: The committee consists of the Principal District and Sessions Judge (Chairperson), the Principal Judge (Family Court) and the senior most District Judge (Commercial Court) of the district. Personal interview: Shortlisted candidates are called for a personal interview by the committee. The final selection is made on the basis of this interview. Merit list: A final merit list is prepared and published on the website, along with a waiting list. The waiting list is valid for one year. Candidates on it are offered engagement for the remaining period, in order of merit, if a selected candidate does not join, leaves early or is discharged. Engagement letter: Engagement/appointment letters are issued by the Principal District and Sessions Judge after the requisite documents are verified.

rows.event: Last date for submission of application

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: During the engagement, the Law Researcher must not accept any other assignment or practise as an Advocate in any Court of Law, Tribunal or other Authority. After the engagement ends, the Law Researcher must not appear before the attached District Judge (Commercial Court) for a minimum period of one year. For three years after the engagement ends, the Law Researcher must not appear in any case handled by that District Judge during the period they worked together, whether or not the Law Researcher worked on the case. Strict secrecy must be kept about matters learnt during the engagement, including after it ends, unless disclosure is legally required. A "No Dues Certificate" must be obtained from all branches of the District Courts on completion of the engagement or on leaving early. The dress code under Chapter IV of Part VI of the Bar Council of India Rules applies. On any matter not covered by the Guidelines, the decision of the Chief Justice, High Court of Delhi, is final and binding.

As its notice describes, NPC promotes productivity consciousness in the country for sustainable socio-economic development through consultancy, research and training activities. This engagement is being made by the HRM Group at NPC Headquarters, New Delhi.

content_sections.text: The application must be sent by email; the notice gives no postal route. Fill in the application in the prescribed format at Annex-AF ("Application for engagement as contractual person in NPC"), printed in the notice. Give the details of experience in the proforma "APPENDIX" (Details of Experience), starting from the latest position, with the name of the office or organisation, post, remuneration or pay band with grade pay (if applicable) and a description of duties performed. Attach self-attested copies of all requisite documents and a recent photograph. Write the post code HRM-01 in the subject line of the email. Send the email to [email protected] on or before 16 November 2026 at 3:00 PM. Incomplete applications and applications without self-attested copies of supporting documents may be rejected.

content_sections.text: There is one post: Training Officer (Senior Professional) – Training Business Development & Programme Management, post code HRM-01, number of persons required 1. MBA in any discipline from a recognized institution. Specialization in Marketing or Human Resource Management is preferred. Minimum two years of relevant professional experience in marketing, business development, client relationship management, training coordination, event management or a related field. Experience in marketing training programmes, corporate learning and development, private-sector client acquisition or hospitality coordination is desirable. Excellent written and oral communication skills. Strong interpersonal, networking and follow-up skills. Proficiency in MS Office, social media and digital communication tools. Ability to independently coordinate training programmes and willingness to travel as required. The age limit is not specified in the notice. The application form asks for the date of birth with a self-attested proof. Remuneration: consolidated remuneration up to ₹50,000 per month, in accordance with the applicable Administrative Instructions of NPC and the marks/recommendations given by the selection committee. Annual increments and other entitlements: as per the applicable Administrative Instructions of NPC. Type of engagement: full-time contractual. Contract period: one year, extendable on a need basis up to a maximum total period of three years, subject to satisfactory performance and approval of the competent authority. Travel: official travel and admissible expenses shall be governed by applicable NPC rules and instructions. Place of deployment: HRM Group, NPC Headquarters, New Delhi. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility details of the post.

content_sections.heading: NPC Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: The notice lists the work responsibilities of the Training Officer (Senior Professional) under six heads. Publicize HRM training programmes through email campaigns, follow-ups and participant mobilisation. Identify Government, PSU and private-sector clients; maintain a database of prospective participants and organisations. Generate leads, prepare/follow up proposals, and develop customized residential, in-company and online programmes, including webinars. Identify opportunities for pre-promotion and other specialized/customised training programmes. Identify potential consultancy requirements related to HRM while performing the above activities. Coordinate residential, in-company and online programmes, including participant communication, faculty and client liaison, venue/hotel arrangements and on-site management; travel as required. Welcome and assist participants, represent NPC in routine programme coordination, and coordinate conduct of training, participant departure and programme closure. Coordinate attendance, feedback, bills, supporting documents, participants' fee and internal invoicing follow-up, and programme completion reports. Maintain records and periodically report on nominations, occupancy, proposals, new client leads, consultancy leads and hotel empanelment to the Group Head (HRM). Coordinate the annual preparation of NPC's Training Calendar by collecting programme details from all Groups and Regional Directorates (RDs). Compile and standardise the information, and follow up with the concerned units for timely submission and revisions. Coordinate its publication on the NPC website after obtaining the approval of the competent authority. Coordinate hotel empanelment across India for NPC Groups and RDs. Maintain an updated location-wise database of hotels, facilities, tariffs, validity and service quality. Follow up renewals, address non-availability or withdrawal issues related to hotels, and identify suitable alternatives at key locations. Undertake any other duties and responsibilities as may be assigned by the Group Head (HRM) from time to time, based on the functional requirements and needs of the office.

The engagement is initially for a period of one year, with a remuneration of Rs. 4.8 lakh per annum. Applications are accepted only online through the Google Application Form given in the notice, within 30 days from the date of issue of the Vacancy Notice dated 3 November 2026, which is about 3 December 2026 (30 days from 3 November 2026).

content_sections.heading: About NCW
content_sections.text: The National Commission for Women, located at Plot No. 21, Jasola Institutional Area, New Delhi-110025, has been established as a statutory body. According to the notice, its work covers the constitutional and legal safeguards provided to women, reviewing existing legislation and suggesting amendments, looking into complaints involving deprivation of women's rights, and monitoring the implementation of laws enacted to protect the rights of women.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The Commission intends to engage professionals having LLB/LLM as Junior Technical Experts (Legal). The notice does not specify a minimum period of experience, but candidates will be shortlisted on the basis of their educational qualification and experience. The job requirements printed in the notice also include the ability to work under strict deadlines and allot priorities across multiple responsibilities, and willingness to undertake travel when required and adopt flexible working hours. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility of the post.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: Remuneration: Rs. 4.8 lakh per annum. The engagement is on contract basis initially for a period of one year. The engagement shall be purely on contract basis for a short period from the date of joining, which may be extended/curtailed subject to satisfactory performance, on requirement basis. Leave: 12 (Twelve) days in a year on pro-rata basis, which may be availed during the period of contract. In addition, Medical Leave of 7 days and 2 days Restricted Holidays. Additional leave without pay is permitted only upon approval by the Competent Authority. The selected candidate will not be eligible for Government Accommodation, House Rent Allowance, CGHS facility etc. No TA/DA is admissible for joining the assignment or at the time of its completion. TA/DA for work-related travel on official business is given as per entitlement. Only basic working facilities/infrastructure will be provided. No telephone/internet facility at the residence and no subordinate staff will be provided.

content_sections.heading: NCW Junior Technical Experts (Legal) Job Description
content_sections.text: Putting up the precedents on matters referred for Legal Advice/conduct of litigation/proposing new bills/amendments in laws. Submission of notes and drafts on matters referred for Legal Advice/conduct of litigation/proposing new bills/amendments in laws. Reference and Research work, wherever necessary. Drafting of background notes for various consultations/seminars/programmes. Preparing para-wise comments for various court matters. Examining media reports/judgments passed by various courts wherein intervention of the Commission is warranted. Setting measurable/quantifiable targets for self and ensuring timely achievement. Preparing periodic/annual reports on the subject. Assisting the Expert/Working Group/committee that may be constituted by NCW, including its meetings, minutes and correspondence. Maintenance of data and updation of the database of the Commission on a regular basis. Relationship building and networking with Govt. resource agencies, academia and legal experts to achieve the mandate of the Commission. Initiating/organizing seminars/workshops/consultations on women-related issues to build opinion on developing and adopting progressive policy. Examining/reviewing the safeguards provided under various women laws for the protection of women's rights and suggesting measures for effective implementation. Any other work assigned by the superiors from time to time.

content_sections.heading: Delhi University Assistant Salary 2026
content_sections.text: The Assistant post carries Pay Level 4 under the 7th Central Pay Commission , with allowances admissible under University rules.

content_sections.heading: Delhi University Assistant Selection Process 2026
content_sections.text: The selection process consists of a Preliminary Test, Main Examination and qualifying Skill Test . The Preliminary Test is used for shortlisting, while the Main Examination determines merit, subject to qualification in the Skill Test. Preliminary Test - Objective MCQ examination. Main Examination - Descriptive examination. Skill Test - Computer proficiency, office procedures, noting, drafting and typing. Document Verification - Verification of qualification, experience and other eligibility claims. Final Merit - Based on Main Examination marks, subject to applicable selection rules.

content_sections.heading: Delhi University Assistant Exam Pattern 2026
content_sections.text: The Preliminary Test consists of 100 multiple-choice questions carrying 200 marks , with a duration of two hours and 30 minutes. Important: The Preliminary Test is only for shortlisting and does not carry weightage in final merit. The qualifying cut-off is determined using 50% of the average score of the top 5% of candidates appearing in the test, subject to the special calculation provisions in the notification. The notification provides a five-percentage-point relaxation for SC/ST candidates and a ten-percentage-point relaxation for PwBD candidates in the prescribed cut-off. For shortlisting to the Main Examination, the University prescribes 30 candidates for one vacancy and 15 additional candidates for each further vacancy, subject to merit and ties at the cut-off. The Main Examination is descriptive in nature and carries 200 marks, with a duration of two hours. The Main Examination assesses knowledge of higher education administration, financial rules, university procedures, procurement, pension rules, grievance handling and administrative management. The Skill Test carries 100 marks and is qualifying in nature. Candidates must obtain at least 50 marks to qualify. The Skill Test covers the Manual of Office Procedures, noting and drafting, computer operations and typing proficiency.

content_sections.heading: NMET Consultant (Accountant) Vacancy Details 2026
content_sections.text: The pay is worked out once and stays the same for the whole contract. Each month's payment is released only after the concerned controlling officer gives a satisfactory performance certificate. Income Tax and any other tax are deducted at source as per Government instructions. During the engagement the Consultant keeps drawing pension and Dearness Relief on pension. The engagement does not count as re-employment.

content_sections.heading: NMET Consultant (Accountant) Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: Applicants must be below 63 years of age on the closing date of applications, 25 November 2026. They must also be in good health so they can carry out their official duties. The official notification does not specify the minimum educational qualification. The mandatory conditions are: Retired from the post of SO/ASO in a Central Government Ministry or Department. At least 5 years of working experience in Government Accounts. Good knowledge of GFR, DFPR, PFMS and similar rules and systems. Fluent with MS Word and MS Excel, with skill in noting and drafting and in office procedure. Fair knowledge of computer applications such as MS Word, MS Excel and Power Point. Remuneration, eligibility, leave and working hours follow Department of Expenditure O.M. No. 3-25/2020-E.IIIA dated 09.12.2020, as amended from time to time. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions of the post.

content_sections.heading: Duties of Consultant (Accountant)
content_sections.text: Work as a dealing hand and, if required, carry out supervisory functions. Process the claims of employees posted in NMET. Start proposals relating to claims in E-Office. Process bills in PFMS. Maintain the Bill Register, Expenditure Register, Grant in Aid Register, Advance Register and other registers. Report to the officers of the Finance & Accounts Division and do the tasks they assign.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: Contract period: one (01) year at first. It may be extended or cut short depending on need and the Consultant's performance. The term cannot go beyond 5 years after superannuation. Place of posting: NMET office, New Delhi. Nature: purely contractual. It gives no right to a regular appointment in NMET. Working hours: normal office timings. The Consultant may also be called in on a Saturday, Sunday or holiday when work requires it. Leave: paid leave at 1.5 days for each completed month of service. Leave cannot be carried over beyond a calendar year. Confidentiality: the intellectual property in all data and deliverables belongs to NMET. Nothing may be shared with a third party without NMET's written consent. The full set of records must be handed over before the contract ends and before the final payment. Conflict of interest: the Consultant must not advise anyone against NMET's interest or take on any activity outside the contract. Termination: NMET may end the contract if the Consultant cannot handle the work, if the quality of work does not satisfy the Controlling Officer or Competent Authority, or if the Consultant is found lacking in honesty and integrity. The Competent Authority may also end it at any time without notice or reason. Resignation: 15 days' written notice is required. The Consultant is relieved only after handing over all files, records, data and assets. The Competent Authority may waive or shorten the notice period. NMET may accept or reject any or all applications, in part or in full, without giving a reason.

faq.question: Q1. Who can apply for the NMET Consultant (Accountant) post?
faq.answer: Retired Government servants who left service as SO/ASO in a Central Government Ministry or Department and who have at least 5 years of experience in Government Accounts.

faq.question: Q2. What is the maximum age?
faq.answer: You must not have reached 63 years of age on 25 November 2026, the closing date for applications.

faq.question: Q3. How is the monthly remuneration calculated?
faq.answer: It is your last basic pay drawn, minus your basic pension, plus the Transport Allowance that applied when you retired. The amount stays fixed for the whole contract.

faq.question: Q4. Will my pension stop during the engagement?
faq.answer: No. You keep drawing pension and Dearness Relief on pension, and the engagement is not treated as re-employment.

faq.question: Q5. Where will the Consultant be posted?
faq.answer: At the NMET office in New Delhi, working with the officers of the Finance & Accounts Division.

faq.answer: One year at first. It may be extended or cut short based on need and performance, but never beyond 5 years after superannuation.

faq.question: Q7. Which software and rules should applicants know?
faq.answer: Good knowledge of GFR, DFPR and PFMS, and working skill in MS Word, MS Excel and Power Point. The job involves processing bills in PFMS and starting claim proposals in E-Office.

faq.question: Q8. How much leave does the Consultant get?
faq.answer: Paid leave at 1.5 days for each completed month of service. Leave cannot be carried over beyond a calendar year.

faq.question: Q9. Where should the application be sent?
faq.answer: To the Joint Director (Admn. & Legal), NMET, 9th Floor, Jeevan Prakash Building, 25 Kasturba Gandhi Marg, New Delhi-110001. It must arrive by 5:00 PM on 25 November 2026.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The appointment is on deputation on foreign service terms basis for three years, subject to satisfactory performance. It is governed by the instructions in DOPT OM No.6/8/2009-Estt.(Pay II) dated 17 June 2010, as amended from time to time. It is also governed by GoI Notification No. GSR 670 (E) dated 14 September 2009, as amended from time to time, on the conditions of service of Officers and other employees of CCI. Apart from basic pay, the post carries DA, HRA and Transport Allowance etc. at the rates applicable to Central Government employees from time to time. The fixation of pay and deputation (duty) allowance is governed by instructions issued by DOP&T from time to time. Medical reimbursement is admissible as per the CCI service rules. This is in lieu of CGHS benefits, which are not admissible to the Officers of CCI. CCI is an eligible office for allotment or retention of Government accommodation from the General Pool.

content_sections.text: Eligibility for DTU Assistant Professor Recruitment 2026 depends on the discipline. The reduced fee is available only where the applicant applies against an appropriately reserved vacancy and meets the applicable conditions. Payment Mode: Online only. content_sections.heading: DTU Assistant Professor Selection Process 2026
content_sections.text: The DTU Assistant Professor Recruitment 2026 selection process includes initial academic screening, detailed scrutiny, document and point-mark verification, teaching presentation and interview. The final assessment considers academic record, teaching or research experience, research performance, teaching aptitude, domain knowledge and interview performance. Initial application screening based on the notified 100-point criteria. Publication of the provisional consideration-zone list. Submission and scrutiny of supporting documents by candidates in the consideration zone. Provisional shortlisting according to eligibility and screening scores. Document and Point Mark Verification. Teaching Aptitude and Ability Presentation. Domain Knowledge Assessment and Interview. DTU will use a 100-point initial screening system. The score is based on Ph.D. qualification, the prescribed pre-Ph.D. degree and qualifying national-level tests or scholarships. The pre-Ph.D. degree score is calculated according to the notification's formula: 35 + 0.5 × (X − 50), where X is the percentage obtained in the eligible pre-Ph.D. degree. The calculation is subject to the prescribed maximum score and recruitment rules. The online application also requires academic and research credentials under a separate 50-point framework. This is distinct from the 100-point initial screening criteria. The academic section considers undergraduate marks, postgraduate marks, Ph.D. qualification and relevant qualifying examinations. The experience and research section considers eligible teaching, research and industrial experience, publications, books, projects, patents and research guidance.

content_sections.heading: National Authority- CAMPA Under Secretary Job Description
content_sections.text: Under Secretary: Excellent note-taking/drafting skills; experience of dealing with Court Cases, Parliament matters, Vigilance, RTI, etc.; minimum 5-10 years' experience of handling budget and accounts matters in Ministries/Departments of the Government of India; Output-Outcome Monitoring Framework including submission of the same to the CEO; matters related to Parliamentary Standing Committee including preparation of Background Note and Action Taken Replies; submission of replies to RTI applications; looking after works related to establishment, finance, General Administration, framing of rules and regulations, and regulatory matters. Senior Account Officer: Pre-audit, passing of bills, and preparation of Accounts. Section Officer: Establishment, administration, finance and accounts, and regulatory matters. Technical Officer (Forestry): Examination of the Annual Plan of Operations/Policy matters of the State Authorities, monitoring of different activities, formulate proposals for new schemes. Assistant Section Officer: Initial examination of the proposal relating to establishment finance and regulatory matters, and maintenance of a record of the Section. Accountant/Auditor: Preparation of bills and pre-auditing calculations and deduction of dues, taxes, and depositing them with the concerned department. PPS: Providing all types of secretarial assistance to Members like other CSSS Officers. Sr. PS / PA: Providing all type of secretarial assistance to Senior Officers. Legal Assistant/Law Officer: Keeping all legal records ready and preliminary examination of cases from legal angle, submission of draft Petition/ Rejoinders etc.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates must fulfill the prescribed educational qualifications and age limits to apply for the Research Associate - I positions. Ph.D. in Chemistry / Applied Chemistry / Biochemistry / Applied Biochemistry / Biotechnology / Pharmacology / Forensic Science; OR Having 3 years of research, teaching and design and development experience after M. Pharm; AND With at least one research paper in Science Citations Indexed (SCI) journal with Impact factor > 1.0; Age not more than 35 years. Relaxation up to 3 years is applicable for OBC(NCL) candidates and 5 years for SC/ST category candidates.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: Selected candidates will receive a consolidated monthly stipend of Rs. 58,000/- plus HRA as applicable. The engagement is purely on a contract basis for an initial period of one year, which is extendable for another two years maximum, or subject to curtailment based on satisfactory performance and conduct. Performance is reviewed yearly, and the contract can be terminated by either side with a notice of one month in advance or one month's salary in lieu thereof.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for NDTL Research Associate - I
content_sections.text: Visit the NDTL website Career page at https://ndtlindia.com/career/ to access the online application form link. Complete the online application form with valid and active mobile numbers and email IDs. Upload a scanned copy of your photo identity proof (PAN Card, Voter ID Card, Driving License, or Passport) in jpg/jpeg format, ensuring the file size is between 50kb and 1MB. Preview the application form before final submission to verify all filled details, as changes cannot be made after final submission. Submit the online application form on or before the last date.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: The prescribed qualifications are the bare minimum, and mere possession does not entitle candidates to be called for interview. The notification regarding the list of shortlisted candidates will be displayed on the NDTL website, and shortlisted candidates will be informed about the date of the interview through email.

content_sections.text: The total number of vacancies is 20, which are distributed across participating Research Councils as follows:

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates must fulfill the essential educational qualification and eligibility criteria prescribed for the Ph.D. fellowships. Candidates from Non-Ayush (Non-Medical) background must have qualified the concerned National Eligibility Test, namely Joint CSIR-UGC test for JRF and LS(NET), DBT- JRF in Biotechnology, Bio technology Eligibility Test (BET), ICAR's AICE- SRF(PGS), and ICMR JRF and willing to undertake research on AYUSH related projects for pursuing Ph.D. programmes in the University/ Institution of their choice. Research project shall be in the fields of Biomedical Sciences with emphasis on Life Sciences such as Microbiology, Physiology, Molecular Biology, Genetics, Human Biology, Bioinformatics, Biotechnology, Immunology, Pharmacology, Zoology, Environment Science, Botany, Veterinary Sciences, and Pharmacy etc.; Chemical Sciences such as Biochemistry, Chemistry including Analytical Chemistry, Inorganic Chemistry, Physical Chemistry and Organic Chemistry - Phyto Chemistry, Medicinal Chemistry & Natural Product Chemistry etc.; Physical Sciences including Biophysics; Social Sciences such as Psychology for Mental diseases and Sociology for Demographic Survey etc.; and Biostatistics.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The fellowship will be provided for pursuing Ph.D. under a recognised University/ institution of choice by the candidates and during their fellowship, they will be termed as Junior Research Fellows (JRFs) for 2 years extendable as Senior Research Fellows (SRF) for 2-3 years, total for maximum 5 years. The monthly emoluments will be Rs. 37,000/- for JRF and Rs. 42,000/- for SRF + House Rent Allowance per month + annual contingency of Rs. 20,000/- to the University/ Institution. In addition, the fellow may submit a project proposal to obtain one time Research Contingency Grant-in-Aid up to Rs. 01.00 lakh within 3 months of joining the fellowship.

content_sections.heading: GSSSB CCE 2.0 Recruitment 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Gujarat Subordinate Service Selection Board has released for the Gujarat Subordinate Services Class-3 (Group-A and Group-B) Combined Competitive Examination. The official 38-page Gujarati notification contains complete department-wise vacancies, eligibility criteria, age relaxation, fixed pay, reservation provisions, application instructions, examination fee, selection process and preliminary and main examination syllabi. Official Notification Source: GSSSB Official Website Detailed Notification: GSSSB CCE 2.0 Recruitment 2026 468/202627.

content_sections.heading: GSSSB CCE 2.0 Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Candidates must possess a Bachelor's degree or an equivalent qualification recognized by the Government . Basic computer knowledge and adequate knowledge of Gujarati or Hindi are also required. The prescribed degree must be obtained from a university established or incorporated under the applicable Central or State legislation, a recognized institution or an institution meeting the relevant University Grants Commission provisions. Yes. Applicants must possess basic knowledge of computer applications under the Gujarat Civil Services Classification and Recruitment (General) Rules, 1967. However, the notification permits candidates who do not currently possess the required computer knowledge certificate to apply. Such candidates must obtain and produce acceptable computer knowledge certification before appointment. The accepted evidence may include a recognized computer course certificate, degree or diploma involving computer studies, or Class 10 or Class 12 qualification with a computer subject, according to the applicable rules. The recruitment notification requires adequate knowledge of Gujarati or Hindi or both . Candidates should also prepare for the Gujarati language portions of the competitive examination and the descriptive Gujarati paper where applicable.

content_sections.text: The preliminary examination fee is Rs. 500 for unreserved candidates and Rs. 400 for eligible reserved or concession categories . content_sections.heading: GSSSB CCE 2.0 Selection Process 2026
content_sections.text: The recruitment follows a two-stage competitive examination process: a common preliminary examination and separate main examinations for Group-A and Group-B. Online Application: Candidates register and submit the application through OJAS. Preliminary Examination: A common 150-mark objective examination is conducted for Group-A and Group-B. Shortlisting for Mains: Separate Group-A and Group-B eligibility lists are prepared based on preliminary examination performance. Main Examination: Group-A candidates appear for descriptive papers, while Group-B candidates appear for an objective main examination. Merit List: Final selection lists are prepared using the applicable main examination results, reservation provisions and qualifying standards. Document Verification: Shortlisted candidates must satisfy the prescribed educational, age, category and other eligibility conditions. GSSSB will shortlist candidates for the main examinations separately for Group-A and Group-B, generally up to seven times the number of category-wise vacancies , based on the prescribed preliminary examination merit process. Preliminary examination marks are used for screening and are not counted toward the final selection merit.

content_sections.heading: GSSSB CCE 2.0 Preliminary Exam Pattern 2026
content_sections.text: The common preliminary examination will contain 150 multiple-choice questions for 150 marks , with a duration of 120 minutes. Eligible candidates with disabilities will receive additional examination time according to the notification's provisions, including 20 minutes per hour where applicable.

content_sections.heading: GSSSB CCE 2.0 Group-A Main Exam Pattern 2026
content_sections.text: The Group-A main examination is descriptive and consists of three papers carrying a combined total of 350 marks. The Gujarati descriptive paper carries 100 marks and includes essay writing, expansion of ideas, précis writing, prose comprehension, press notes, letter writing, discussion articles, reports, translation and Gujarati grammar. The English descriptive paper carries 100 marks and covers essay writing, formal letters, report writing, interpretation of visual information, formal speech, précis writing, reading comprehension, grammar and translation. The General Studies paper carries 150 marks. Its syllabus covers Indian history, Gujarat history, cultural heritage, the Constitution, governance, economy, geography, science, environment, current affairs and other subjects prescribed in Appendix-H of the official notification.

content_sections.heading: GSSSB CCE 2.0 Group-B Main Exam Pattern 2026
content_sections.text: The Group-B main examination is an objective-type examination carrying 200 marks with a duration of 120 minutes. The notification prescribes a minimum qualifying standard of 40% for the preliminary and main examinations, including the applicable papers. The qualifying standard cannot be reduced below 40% for any category. Meeting the minimum qualifying standard does not automatically guarantee shortlisting or selection, as the competitive merit cut-off may be higher.

content_sections.text: The notification prescribes JPG-format photograph and signature uploads, each not exceeding 15 KB. The photograph must have a white background and display the date on which it was taken. It should not be older than one year as measured against the application closing date. Candidates should retain additional copies of the same photograph for the examination and verification stages.

content_sections.heading: GSSSB CCE 2.0 Reservation and Important Eligibility Conditions
content_sections.text: Eligible candidates must possess valid certificates issued by the competent authorities. The detailed notification specifies the applicable disability types and post suitability requirements. Candidates claiming PwBD benefits must meet the disability percentage and certification conditions prescribed for their selected cadre. Special provisions are included for eligible Ex-Servicemen and candidates holding qualifying sports achievements. The notification provides additional merit-related conditions for eligible sports candidates, including a prescribed 5% marks benefit where applicable.

content_sections.heading: About AIIMS Rajkot
content_sections.text: AIIMS Rajkot describes itself on its letterhead as a Central Autonomous Institute of National Importance under PMSSY, MoH & FW, Government of India. Its campus is at Village Khandheri, Tehsil Paddhari, District Rajkot, 360110. The notice is signed by the Dean (Academics).

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The notice lists two courses with one seat each, 2 seats in total. The notice states that no constitutional reservation seats are available or applicable for any seats for any Fellowship courses.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: * DNB in a subject from an Institute or Medical College recognized by MCI/NMC with experience according to NMC Guidelines. The notice reproduces clause 4A of the Minimum Qualifications for Teachers in Medical Institutions (Amendment) Regulations, 2018 on equivalence of DNB with MD/MS: (a) DNB training in an institution which now runs MCI recognized postgraduate degree courses in a given subject: the DNB is at par with the MCI recognized qualification in that subject only. (b) DNB training in a multi-speciality teaching hospital with at least 500 beds, involved in various postgraduate/super-speciality teaching programmes, provided one out of three DNB supervisors qualifies as postgraduate teacher as per MCI norms in his/her previous appointment and one out of the remaining two qualifies as postgraduate teacher as per MCI regulations: considered at par. (c) Three years teaching experience in the subject as Resident/Registrar/Demonstrator/Tutor, or work experience gained during DNB training, in other locations/institutions (100 or more bedded hospitals): one additional year as senior resident in an MCI recognized/permitted institution is required for equivalence. (d) The same three years of experience from an institution not covered in (a) to (c): two additional years as Sr. Resident/Research Associate (CSIR) in an MCI recognised/permitted medical college/institution are required for equivalence. The candidate should pass the qualifying examination by 28 February 2027 and the result should be declared on or before that date. Candidates who have appeared for the exam or viva voce with the result awaited may appear in the theory exam and/or interview provisionally. If the result is declared after 28.02.2027, the candidature stands cancelled. The upper age limit as on the last date of application is 45 years. The notice prints no minimum age. Only Indian citizens are invited to apply. Refer to the official notification for the full eligibility details of each course.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The pay scale is ₹ 18,750 + 6,600 (Grade Pay) + NPA (Non-Practicing Allowance) plus other usual allowance, or revised pay scale as per 7th CPC as applicable: Level 11 of the Matrix (pre-revised PB-3), entry pay of ₹ 67,700/- per month + NPA plus other usual allowance admissible under rules. Course fee: the selected candidate pays ₹ 50,000/- per annum (one time) on the day of admission. Bond: selected candidates execute a bond of ₹ 2,00,000/- on a Non-Judicial Stamp Paper of ₹ 100/- along with 2 sureties. Leave is as per the Senior Residency scheme, MoH & FW, Government of India. The appointment gives no right to claim permanent absorption; the contractual appointment may be renewed or terminated as decided by the Institute.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Eligible applicants will be notified to appear in an MCQ-based exam followed by an interview. Candidates are shortlisted in the ratio of 1:6 per vacancy according to marks obtained in the exam. The final criteria give 80% weightage to the examination and 20% to the interview. Appearance in the interview does not entitle a candidate to selection. The date and venue of the exam and interview will be notified on the Institute's website. The list of eligible and subsequently selected candidates will be uploaded on www.aiimsrajkot.edu.in . The notice does not give the exam pattern, marks or duration.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for AIIMS Rajkot Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Apply online through the Google form link printed in the notice: https://forms.gle/2LL2aEJ4Db4psyL3A . The notice says applications can be made through online registration on www.aiimsrajkot.edu.in from 03 November 2026. Submit the application by 12 December 2026, 12:00 Hrs. Pay the application fee online only, using the payment link in the notice: https://erp.eshiksa.net/DirectFeesv3/AIIMSRajkotRecruitment . The fee, once remitted, is not refunded. Do not send a hard copy of the online application or any document. Bring a print copy of the online application form at the time of document verification. Do not submit more than one application against a seat/department/subject. Duplicate applications lead to cancellation of all such applications without intimation, and the registration fee is forfeited. For any query, write to [email protected] . Candidates bring the original documents and one set of self-attested photocopies, with the application form: Identity proof (PAN Card, Passport, Driving License, Voter Card etc.) Address proof (Ration Card, Passport, Driving License, Aadhar Card etc.) Certificate showing date of birth (10th Certificate/Birth Certificate) Class 10th and 12th marksheets and certificates MBBS and MD/DNB/MS/M.Ch marksheets and certificates FMGE certificate conducted by NBE (for foreign graduate MBBS) Attempt certificate and internship completion certificate Registration with Medical Council of India/State Medical Council Experience certificate No Objection Certificate (in case of working in government sector) Publications and any other relevant documents Candidates who do not produce the original documents at the interview will not be considered for selection.

content_sections.text: Candidates in service in any Government institution must submit a No Objection Certificate from the employer at the time of interview; without it they will not be permitted for the interview. The Legal Assistants will handle its legal work, including Supreme Court cases and the directions of the Supreme Court Committee on Road Safety.

content_sections.heading: Gujarat Road Safety Authority Legal Assistant Job Description
content_sections.text: The notice lists the following scope of work: Coordinating cases pending before the Hon'ble Supreme Court and working with the advocates engaged by the State Government. Preparing Para-wise Remarks, Affidavit, Reply, Written Submission and similar documents for cases in the Hon'ble Supreme Court. Ensuring compliance with the Hon'ble Supreme Court's orders, in coordination with the concerned branches. Implementing the guidelines of the Hon'ble Supreme Court Committee on Road Safety and obtaining compliance from the various stakeholder departments. Preparing and issuing legal notices to government departments, local self-government bodies and other agencies for negligence in road safety work. Drafting agreements, MoUs, guidelines and other legal documents. Examining the legal aspects of the Authority's administrative and road safety decisions. Giving opinions on the legal aspects of applications under the RTI Act, 2005, and handling appeal-related work. Interpreting the laws and rules connected with the Authority's work and preparing proposals for necessary amendments. Other legal work assigned by the Hon'ble Commissioner.

content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the application fee or the minimum educational qualification.

content_sections.heading: GNLU Deputy Registrar Vacancy Details 2026
content_sections.text: The position is un-reserved. It comes with the full scale and benefits including HRA, TA and DA, as per University norms.

rows.pay: 7th CPC Level 12, basic pay Rs. 78,800 to Rs. 2,09,200

content_sections.heading: GNLU Deputy Registrar Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: Age limit: maximum 55 years. Eligibility is determined on the last date of receipt of the application. Mandatory qualification: The official notification does not specify the minimum educational qualification. Mandatory experience: applicants must be officers in the Central/State Government, Universities or other autonomous Organisations who meet one of these conditions: Holding an analogous position on regular basis in Pay Level 12 Five years of regular service in Pay Level 11 Eight years of regular service in Pay Level 10 Desirable: Experience in dealing with General Administration, Establishment Personnel and HR related affairs or Procurements Experience in dealing with N-Procure and GeM Stores, computer-based Finance and Accounts, Audit or Academics Knowledge of UGC Rules and Regulations and DoPT Rules Who is not eligible: Anyone convicted by a Court of Law at any time during their career Persons dismissed by, or involved in disciplinary cases with, the Union Government, a State Government, a Local Authority or a Government Corporation owned or controlled by the Central or State Government Employees of a Government Organisation or PSU with a Vigilance, Disciplinary or Criminal case pending or contemplated against them Check the official notification (PDF) for the full eligibility conditions of this post.

rows.date: Detailed schedule to be sent by email to eligible candidates

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: The University shortlists candidates and then holds an interview. After the last date, it informs eligible shortlisted candidates through the email address given in the application form. The list of eligible candidates will also be uploaded on the GNLU official website. Original certificates must be produced at the time of the selection process. Employed candidates called for selection must produce a No Objection certificate in the prescribed format given in the application form. Without it, they will not be allowed to appear. No shortlisted candidate will be considered after the prescribed date and time, whatever the reason. Canvassing in any form will result in disqualification.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: Place of posting: GNLU Silvassa Campus, Dadra & Nagar Haveli-396230. The selected candidate may also be deputed to the Gandhinagar campus as and when required. Tenure: three years initially. This may be extended year to year on need and performance, with due approval of the Competent Authority, up to a maximum of five years. No extension follows after that. Performance: reviewed annually. Services shall be terminated in case of unsatisfactory performance. No claim to a permanent post: the appointment gives no right to renewal, extension or conversion into permanent appointment, and it ends on expiry of tenure. Joining: the selected candidate must join on the date the University specifies. The University may decline to appoint a candidate who cannot join by then. Verification: antecedents may be verified at any time during recruitment or service. If the information is found incorrect, the application or service shall be terminated without notice.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for GNLU Deputy Registrar Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Fill in the application in the prescribed format and affix a recent passport size photograph. Incomplete applications and those in any other format will not be accepted. Attach the documents listed below. Submit the application through proper channel. You may send an advance copy directly to the University. Write this on the envelope: "Application for the position of Deputy Registrar (On Deputation basis) at GNLU-Silvassa Campus". Send it by Registered Post, Speed Post or Courier to: The Registrar, Gujarat National Law University, Attalika Avenue, Knowledge Corridor, Koba, Gandhinagar, Gujarat-382426, India. Applications or resumes sent by email will not be considered, and neither will applications that arrive late because of postal delay or any other reason. Documents to send: Self-attested copies of certificates and mark-sheets from SSC onwards Vigilance clearance Attested copy of the last five years' ACR/APARs Do not send original certificates with the application.

faq.question: Q1. Can a Pay Level 10 officer apply for the GNLU Deputy Registrar post?
faq.answer: Yes, if the officer has eight years of regular service in Pay Level 10. Officers in Pay Level 11 need five years of regular service.

faq.question: Q2. Where will the selected Deputy Registrar work?
faq.answer: The posting is at the Silvassa Campus in Dadra & Nagar Haveli. The candidate may be deputed to the Gandhinagar headquarters as and when required.

faq.question: Q3. How long can the deputation last?
faq.answer: The term is three years at first and can run to a maximum of five years, following the 03+01+01 pattern in the notice.

faq.question: Q4. Does the post include HRA and DA?
faq.answer: Yes. The position carries the full scale with benefits including HRA, TA and DA as per University norms.

faq.question: Q5. Can the application be sent by email?
faq.answer: No. It must go by Registered Post, Speed Post or Courier to the Registrar at the Koba, Gandhinagar address.

faq.question: Q6. Is the post reserved for any category?
faq.answer: No. The notice states that the advertised position is un-reserved as per the norms.

faq.question: Q7. Which service records must employed candidates send?
faq.answer: They must send vigilance clearance and an attested copy of the last five years' ACR/APARs, through proper channel.

faq.question: Q8. Will the University pay travel costs for the interview?
faq.answer: No. The notice says no TA/DA shall be paid for attending or participating in the selection process.

content_sections.text: Evaluation of applications by the Screening Committee Interview by the Committee Marks awarded under Proforma B-1 or B-2 Evaluation report and CCIT recommendation sent to the Board in Proforma-B The Committee examines expertise in direct tax matters, aptitude for interpretation and suitability to represent the Department in an interview. Marks are awarded on the Proforma B-1 or B-2 parameters, out of a maximum of 100. The Committee fixes a minimum benchmark; candidates below it are not considered irrespective of vacancies. Senior candidates' suitability considers drafting quality, assistance to appearing counsels and co-ordination with officers. A panel buffer of at least 25% or a workable buffer should be considered; buffer names receive no remuneration.

This notification invites reputed partnership firms, proprietary concerns, and Limited Liability Partnerships (LLPs) of Chartered Accountants for empanelment to carry out special audits under section 268(5) of the Income-tax Act, 2025 (u/s 142(2A) of the erstwhile Income-tax Act, 1961).

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Applicants must meet the following minimum eligibility criteria as of 31/03/2026: Firm Constitution: The applicant should be a reputed partnership firm, a proprietary concern, or a Limited Liability Partnership (LLP) having its office in the area(s) falling within the territorial jurisdiction of the Principal Chief Commissioner of Income Tax, Gujarat. Primary Profession: Primarily engaged in the profession of accountancy and auditing. Staff Strength: A staff strength of at least 15, including a minimum of 3 Chartered Accountants who have been working continuously with the applicant for at least the last one year as on 31/03/2026. Professional Receipts: Filed returns of income regularly up to AY 2026-27 with Gross Professional Receipts exclusively from professional services like accountancy and auditing of not less than Rs. 50 lakhs in any two out of the last five preceding financial years (from 2021-22 to 2025-26). Experience: Accountancy and auditing experience for a minimum period of 10 years as on 31/03/2026. Tax Audit Track Record: Audited books of accounts for tax audit of at least one business entity having a turnover of Rs. 50 cr or more in any two out of the last five preceding financial years (from 2021-22 to 2025-26). Legal and Ethical Standing: No proceedings with regard to income tax evasion, demand, penalty, or prosecution pending against the applicant or any partners on the date of application; not held guilty under the Income-tax Act, 2025 or erstwhile Income-tax Act, 1961; not indulged in unethical professional practices; not convicted under any Central, State, or other law; no professional misconduct or complaint u/s 21 of the Chartered Accountants Act, 1949 before the Institute of Chartered Accountants of India.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: Remuneration including expenses of and incidental to any special audit shall be decided on a case-to-case basis in accordance with Rule 172 of the I.T. basic_details.job_title: Bilaspur District Tehsildar / Naib Tehsildar / Kanungos Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: The Office of the Deputy Commissioner, Bilaspur, District Bilaspur (HP) has invited applications for the re-engagement of retired Tehsildar, Naib Tehsildar, and Kanungos on a remuneration basis as a stop-gap arrangement for vacant posts and posts likely to become vacant this year in district Bilaspur. Eligible retired officials must submit their applications to reach the office of the Deputy Commissioner, Bilaspur (HP) on or before 20/11/2026 within working hours.

post_wise_qualification.essential_qualification: Against the Vacant posts in District Bilaspur (HP)
Against the Vacant posts in District Bilaspur (HP)
Against the Vacant posts in District Bilaspur (HP)

qualification.details: Eligibility Conditions: Must have rendered minimum 5 years services in any wing of revenue Department of HP before their superannuation and having no departmental / disciplinary proceedings pending against them. The retirees to be engaged should not be more than 65 years of age on the date 31.10.2026.

selection_process: The retired Tehsildar/Naib Tehsildar/Kanungos will be considered for the respective post by the concerned appointing authority on the recommendation of the committee duly constituted by the department. If the applications exceed the number of vacancies advertised by concerned appointing authority
the candidates who are junior in age will be given preference for engagement against such post.
important_instructions: The retired Tehsildar/Naib Tehsildar/Kanungos will be re-engaged for 03 months in the first instance. It may be extended further depending upon the performance of the candidate & the requirement. The period of engagement will not be counted for any benefits whatsoever in the service rendered by them before their superannuation. The service of such retired persons will be purely on temporary basis and is liable to be terminated by the respective appointing authority at any time during the period of such re-engagement. The persons to be engaged will be entitled for one day's Causal Leave after putting one month service. No leave of any kind will be admissible to him/her. Unauthorized absence from the duty without the approval of the controlling officer shall automatically lead to the termination of such engagement. They will not be entitled for emoluments for the period of absence from duty. They will be entitled to TA/DA if required to go on tour in connection with his/her official duties at the same rate as applicable to regular counterpart officials at the minimum of pay scale. He/she shall continue to avail medical facilities and re-imbursement of Medical Expense as admissible to him/her as retiree. The monthly remuneration shall be paid to the re-engaged retirees on the basis of performance/work conduct certificate, which shall also include the details of cases dealt/disposed of by him/her. This certificate shall be issued by the concerned Controlling Authority to the re-engaged retiree at the end of the month. After clearance of pendency of revenue cases, the services of retired persons shall be terminated by the appointing authority. The promotion of existing Tehsildar/Naib Tehsildar/Kanungos shall not be affected on account of re-engagement of above retirees & the posts occupied by them will be considered vacant for the purpose of promotion. Their re-engagement is liable to be terminated on availability of regular officials.

The competitive examination for appointment of District Judges by direct recruitment consists of a written examination and a viva-voce examination.

three from each part. Viva-voce Examination: Carries 40 marks.

content_sections.heading: About JSERC
content_sections.text: Jharkhand State Electricity Regulatory Commission is a statutory body functioning under the Electricity Act, 2003. Under Section 86 of the Act its work includes determination of electricity tariffs, regulating power purchase and procurement processes, granting of licences and adjudication of disputes. Its office is on the 1st Floor, Jharkhand State Housing Board (Old Headquarter), Harmu Housing Colony, Ranchi - 834002.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The single Director post is open to four kinds of applicants, each with its own qualification and experience. Age and experience will be calculated as on 30 September 2026 . Degree in Economics, Master's Degree in Business Administration, Electrical Engineering from a recognized university. 10 years of experience in analogous post. Long experience in government owned Power Sector/Utility or PSU/Commission (Central or State), or an officer holding an analogous post on regular basis in Central/State Government, any PSU under Central/State Government, or a Central or State Electricity Regulatory Commission. The candidate should have held a position of Director (Tariff) in a Central/State Electricity Regulatory Commission, or should have experience in the tariff determination process of Generating/Transmission/Distribution/Load Dispatch centre or any other utilities in the electricity sector in India. Degree in Economics, Master's Degree in Business Administration, Electrical Engineering from a recognized university. 10 years of experience in analogous post. Post-retirement experience in the power sector will also be considered. Bachelor Degree in Electrical Engineering/Economics or MBA from a recognized University. Minimum 10 years' experience in an analogous post. The candidate should be holding, or should have held, a position in substantive/officiating capacity. Experience in Regulatory Affairs, Tariff Determination process/Commercial function in a Power Utility or a Consultancy organization working in the power sector in India. The notice lists the same additional qualifications/experience for all routes: Professional experience in developing tariff modules in the interest of electricity consumers and expertise in commercial analysis. Professional experience in the power sector, including electricity generation, transmission and distribution in large public utilities, along with experience in developing electricity tariffs. Experience in handling administrative and establishment-related matters in Central/State Government organizations. Experience in managing litigation and related matters. Specialization in Regulatory Law. Candidates claiming SC/ST/OBC benefits must furnish certificates; the validity of the certificate is the candidate's responsibility at the time of application and at verification. See the official notification for the full eligibility of each route.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: Pay: ₹ Pay Band ₹15600-39100, Grade Pay ₹7600/- (Pay Matrix Level as per 7th Pay Commission – Rs.78,800/-). Pay, allowances and other terms of deputation are regulated by the JSERC (Officers and Staff Recruitment Rules and Service Conditions) Regulation 2012. Tenure: initially one (01) year, which may be extendable as per the requirement of the Commission. The selected candidate may be sent back to his/her parent department before the deputation period ends, and shall have no lien or claim on the Commission's regular establishment. Retired Director (Tariff) and other retired officers: monthly contract pay is a lump sum calculated as Last Pay Drawn minus Full Pension, plus other allowances as approved by the Commission. Private sector: Initial Basic Pay of ₹78,800/- plus other allowances as approved by the Commission. Tenure: initially one (01) year, which may be further extended at the discretion of the Commission and on the candidate's annual performance. If not extended, the contract ends automatically on expiry, with no separate order. There will be an annual performance assessment during the contract period. TA/DA as applicable to regular officers in the equivalent cadre in the Commission, as per rules adopted from time to time. Leave: all holidays notified by the State Government and 13 days casual leave annually, subject to prior approval. Either party may end the contract early with one month's notice or one month's salary in lieu; the Commission reserves the right to waive the notice period or notice pay or both. The selected candidate will execute a contract agreement with the Commission. The Commission reserves the right to terminate it before the tenure ends, and the appointment confers no right or claim to a regular appointment in the Commission.

content_sections.heading: NHM Jharkhand Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: When assigned, the Legal Retainer / Empanelled Advocate will: Appear and represent NHM Jharkhand before the concerned Court, Tribunal, authority or legal forum. Draft, settle, vet and file petitions, writ petitions, appeals, revisions, reviews, applications, affidavits, counter affidavits, replies, rejoinders, written submissions and other legal pleadings. Give legal opinions / advice on civil, criminal, service, contractual, administrative, constitutional and other matters. Do legal research, including on applicable laws, rules, notifications, judgments, precedents and relevant case law. Prepare case briefs, hearing notes, factual summaries and written submissions for officers / senior law officers. Coordinate with and brief Senior Advocates, Government Advocates or other Counsel, wherever required. Monitor cases, report hearing dates and give timely updates on material developments. Obtain and provide certified / authenticated copies of orders and judgments, wherever required. Advise on the legal implications of proposed actions, notices, contracts, agreements, claims and other matters. Take on any other legal work the Competent Authority may reasonably assign. Reporting duties: keep NHM Jharkhand informed of important developments, hearing dates, orders and directions. Submit a periodic statement of assigned cases in the prescribed format. Report any adverse order, urgent development or limitation issue to the concerned officer without delay. Failing to attend a matter, meet timelines or give timely updates may count against you when continuation is reviewed.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Completed and signed Application Form (Annexure-A) Valid Bar Council enrolment/registration certificate and Certificate of Practice, wherever applicable Proof of qualification and relevant professional experience Details/list of significant cases handled, with copies of judgments/orders wherever required Details of previous empanelment with Government Departments / Government Institutions / PSUs / other organizations, if any Proof of professional address and contact details Declaration-cum-Undertaking (Annexure-B) Any other document NHM Jharkhand specifically asks for

basic_details.short_information: For an initial tenure of five years, Central Mine Planning & Design Institute Limited (CMPDI), a subsidiary of Coal India Limited, invites online applications from enrolled advocates and law firms for empanelment as Advocate for Supreme Court of India, Advocate for High Court of Delhi, Advocate for High Court of Jharkhand, and Advocate for Subordinate Courts / Tribunals. Candidates must apply online through the official portal from 30 October 2026 to 15 November 2026.

how_to_apply: Visit the designated online application portal at aeap.cmpdi.co.in.
Fill in the online application in the prescribed proforma.
Select and mention the forum or forums (Courts) where empanelment is sought (applicants applying exclusively for tax matters must select the relevant option).
Upload self-attested scanned copies of your bio-data and relevant supporting documents, ensuring seals, stamps, signatures, names, authorities, and dates are clearly visible.
Submit the completed online application on or before 15 November 2026.
Applications submitted through email or in hard copy will not be entertained. Advocates and law firms already empanelled with CMPDI or who have previously applied must submit a fresh application.

Advocate for Supreme Court of India, Advocate for High Court of Delhi, Advocate for High Court of Jharkhand, Advocate for Subordinate Courts / Tribunals

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Applicants must be Advocates enrolled under a Bar Council as per the Advocates Act, 1961. In the case of a law firm, the application must be submitted through an Advocate enrolled under a Bar Council as per the Advocates Act, 1961. The qualifying experience is reckoned from the date of enrolment mentioned on the Certificate of Enrolment issued by the Bar Council for High Courts or Subordinate Courts/Tribunals. Cumulative experience is counted, but at the date of application, the applicant must be actively practising in the forum for which empanelment is sought. For empanelment before the Supreme Court of India, Advocates who are regularly practicing in the Supreme Court (including Advocates-on-Record) will be considered. Designation as an Advocate-on-Record in the Supreme Court of India, Orders or Judgments of the Supreme Court noting appearance, or a Certificate of Practice serves as valid proof of 10 years of practice. Applicants must possess excellent communication skills, drafting skills, and court craft, and maintain a fully functional working office with adequate infrastructure. Due weightage will be given to Advocates having experience in handling cases of Central Public Sector Enterprises and Government Departments. Applicants should also be familiar with relevant branches of law, including Mining Laws (Coal Mines), Land Acquisition Law, Competition Law, Constitutional Law, Company Law (including SEBI Guidelines), Forest and Environmental Law, Service Law, Labour Law, Law of Contract, Commercial Law, Property Laws, and Taxation, and be well conversant with practice rules in Supreme Court, High Courts, Subordinate Courts, and Tribunals.

Performance will be reviewed periodically and at least annually. The empanelment tenure may further be renewed for another three years at the discretion of CMPDI. CMPDI reserves the right regarding the assignment of cases and revocation of empanelment without assigning any reason.

content_sections.heading: CMPDI Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: The duties and responsibilities apply to all empanelled advocates and law firms across all designated forums: Represent Central Mine Planning & Design Institute Limited (CMPDI) and its officers/officials before the Supreme Court of India, High Court of Delhi, High Court of Jharkhand, and other Courts and Tribunals within the jurisdiction of Delhi High Court and Jharkhand High Court at Ranchi. Provide CMPDI with legal advice and legal opinions as and when requested.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for CMPDI Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Visit the designated online application portal at aeap.cmpdi.co.in. Fill in the online application in the prescribed proforma. Select and mention the forum or forums (Courts) where empanelment is sought (applicants applying exclusively for tax matters must select the relevant option). Upload self-attested scanned copies of your bio-data and relevant supporting documents, ensuring seals, stamps, signatures, names, authorities, and dates are clearly visible. Submit the completed online application on or before 15 November 2026. Applications submitted through email or in hard copy will not be entertained. Advocates and law firms already empanelled with CMPDI or who have previously applied must submit a fresh application.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Applications received will be scrutinized by CMPDI, and suitability will be adjudged based on the following parameters: Length of practice and specialization in the area of law relevant to the company. Proper and adequate infrastructure, such as office premises, number of junior advocates, assistants, clerks, fax, mobile phone, fixed phone, and internet connection. Annual income-tax return filed with the Tax Authorities for the last three years. Current and past empanelment by other organizations, establishments, regulators, and especially by Public Sector Enterprises and Government Departments. Notable achievements. The decision reached by CMPDI will be final and binding, and no communication will be entertained in this regard.

content_sections.text: The candidate must be a Citizen of India. All candidates must fulfill eligibility criteria on or before 01.10.2026.

rows.qualification_required: Minimum Essential: Ph.D in Remote Sensing & GIS / Geo-informatics / Geology / Forestry / Geophysics / Earth & Atmospheric Sciences / Agriculture / Water Engineering and Management / Civil Engineering / Environmental Science or equivalent from recognized university OR having 3 years of research, teaching and design and development experience after M.Sc / ME / M.Tech with first class in above mentioned discipline. Additional Requirement: One research paper in Science Citation Indexed (SCI) journal. Desirable: Proficiency in image processing & GIS software and DGPS Survey; Experience in Data Collection through drone survey and DGPS and processing of data; DGCA approved Remote Pilot Certificate (RPC) holder for flying of drone will be preferred.

Minimum Essential: M.Sc or M.Tech in Remote Sensing & GIS / Geo-informatics / Geology / Forestry / Geophysics/Earth & Atmospheric Sciences / Agriculture / Water Engineering and Management / Civil Engineering / Environmental Science or equivalent with first class from recognized university. Desirable: Working experience in image processing and GIS software.

basic_details.job_title: ICAR-IIHR CHES Senior Research Fellow Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: Under the project "Development of DUS Test guidelines for Rambutan (Naphelium lappaceum L.)", the Central Horticultural Experiment Station (CHES), Chettalli, Kodagu, of ICAR-Indian Institute of Horticultural Research has invited applications for one temporary Senior Research Fellow post at Rs. 42,000/- + 10% HRA up to 2027-28. The essential qualification is M.Sc. in Agriculture / Horticulture / Botany. Applications must be sent in the prescribed proforma by post and reach the CHES office by 24 November 2026, 5.00 p.m. (email applications are not accepted). The personal interview is on 1 Decemb

how_to_apply: Fill in the application in the prescribed proforma ("Application Format", printed with the notice). It asks for personal details, educational qualifications, whether NET qualified, whether pursuing Ph.D., experience and publications. It needs a recent passport size photograph and the candidate's signature.
Write the Item No. and the name of the post clearly on the application and on the envelope. The notice says the application is likely to be rejected otherwise.
Attach attested copies of the educational / technical qualifications and the experience certificate.
Send the application to: Office, Senior Scientist & The Head(I/c), ICAR-Central Horticultural Experiment Station, Chettalli, Kodagu-571 248.
Make sure it reaches the office by 24 November 2026, 5.00 p.m. Applications received after the due date, including because of postal delays, will not be entertained.

Applications that are not in the prescribed proforma, are incomplete or unsigned, lack the project name, photo or Item No., or are ONLINE applications are liable to be rejected. Email applications will not be accepted. For clarifications, the notice gives the numbers 7892882351 and 9005847283 and the email [email protected].
Application form
SSLC marks card / Date of birth certificate proof
SC/ST/OBC certificate, if any
Degree certificates and marks cards

No Objection Certificate from the concerned PI, for in-service SRF, JRF, YP's, Field Worker and other contractual staff engaged under schemes / projects at this Institute
important_instructions: Eligible candidates must bring all educational / technical qualification certificates, Date of Birth and experience certificates in original, plus two recent passport size photographs, for verification. Candidates without original or provisional educational qualification certificates will not be allowed to attend the interview. Candidates who are not present at the Institute campus by 9.00 AM on 1 December 2026 will not be allowed to attend the interview. Vacancies may increase or decrease as per the requirement of the Institute. The Director, ICAR-IIHR reserves the right to fill all the posts or any of them without assigning any reasons. The declaration in the application form says that the candidate has never been punished or debarred from government (central/state) autonomous organisations and ICAR service, and has not been convicted by a court of law for any offence.

content_sections.heading: About the Centre

content_sections.text: The notice also says "Eligible candidate between the age group of 23-40 years may apply" in its introduction, while the "Other Terms and Condition" section gives 35 years for men and 40 years for women. The post's own limit is given above. No age relaxation is listed in the notice. Candidates should check the official notification for the exact eligibility conditions.

content_sections.text: The remuneration is Rs. 42,000/- + 10% HRA up to 2027-28. The position is purely temporary and co-terminus with the project. On reporting, the selected candidate has to deposit a sum equal to one month's remuneration as a "refundable caution deposit". No TA/DA is paid to RA, SRF, JRF, YP's, Project Associate and Field Worker attending the interview.
