content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Selection is through a personal interview. The applications received are screened, and only shortlisted candidates face a panel / personal interview. The list of eligible candidates for the interview will be displayed on the ICAR-IIHR website, and no separate call letters will be sent. Any change in selection or the interview schedule will be notified on the Institute's website only. The interview will be held from 10.00 A.M. onwards on 1 December 2026 at the CHES, Chettalli office. Only candidates whose duly filled applications arrive before the due date are permitted to take part. A wait-listed candidate in the reserve panel may be engaged for another project with the approval of the C.A.

content_sections.heading: IIITB Physics Laboratory In-charge Job Description
content_sections.text: The primary responsibility of the Laboratory In-charge is to support the effective and efficient teaching and learning of Physics at the Institute. The selected candidate will perform the following duties across key functional areas: Prepares laboratory materials in the Two Semesters: Consult and plan with laboratory instructor(s); set up equipment for students and instructors; perform technical duties related to physics laboratory activities including giving technical assistance and conducting laboratory sessions; assist with preparation and/or lab cleanup for physics lecture demonstrations as appropriate. Upkeep of the Physics Laboratory: Assist instructor(s) regarding laboratory procedures, location and use of materials, and operation of equipment; recommend and/or perform general cleaning; recommend and/or perform maintenance or repairs of equipment; distribute laboratory equipment and materials; ensure laboratories are locked, and lights and equipment are switched off at the end of the day. Safe Environment: Keep current with safety regulations; carry out safety checks on equipment before and after use; explain safety procedures to individuals using the laboratories; dispose of and disassemble redundant or unsafe equipment in consultation with instructor(s). Stock and Purchasing: Operate and maintain stock control of equipment, undertake annual stock-take, and ensure the stock book is kept up to date; source and cost stock, ordering as necessary; monitor expenditure, keep accurate purchasing records, and assist with the departmental budget process. Design and Development: Construct and/or modify apparatus as required; improve on existing experiments or design new experiments and equipment as needed; suggest new experiments. General Duties: Attend and participate in meetings as required; help with conducting quizzes and tests associated with the physics curriculum.

content_sections.heading: About NSIL
content_sections.text: NewSpace India Limited (NSIL) is a Government of India company under the Department of Space (DOS). It was incorporated in March 2019 to provide space-related products and services and to help Indian industry grow in technologically challenging space activities. NSIL's office is at the ISRO Headquarters Campus, New BEL Road, Bengaluru-560 094.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Only Indian Nationals are eligible to apply. The post is Un-Reserved (UR). Where no reservation exists for a category, candidates from that category may apply for the unreserved post if they meet its minimum eligibility criteria. Rules on qualifications: All qualifications should be from a University/Institute recognised by the Government of India. Courses should be approved by an AICTE/UGC-approved college/Institute or a recognised University. You can apply with a qualification earned through distance learning or part-time study, as long as the relevant statutory bodies recognise it for employment to Central Government posts and services. Equivalence is decided on the equivalent certificate provided by the University/Institution. If your qualifying degree does not mention the specialisation that the essential qualification requires, you must submit a certificate from your University/Institution/College that shows the specialisation. The date the result is declared or the mark sheet is issued counts as the date you acquired the qualification, and there is no relaxation on this point. You need 16 years of post-qualification experience in Accounts and Finance. At least 2 of those years must be in the immediate lower grade/scale of IDA: 70,000 - 3% - 2,00,000, or the equivalent level in the private sector (Rs. 15 lacs p.a. CTC). Experience is preferably in a PSU, aerospace/Joint ventures of PSEs/Central Govt/State Govt/Private Sector. You should also be proficient in ERP-based accounting systems and financial software. How NSIL counts experience: Internships or project work placements that were part of your course do not count. Only paid internships done after you obtained the minimum essential qualification count as relevant post-qualification experience. One completed year of apprenticeship under the PM Internship program counts as experience. Teaching experience does not count as relevant work experience. Work done before you completed the minimum essential qualification does not count. Experience certificates or documentary evidence from your previous and present employers must clearly show the period of employment and the positions held. Experience without supporting documents will not be considered, and NSIL's decision on the relevance of experience is final. The upper age limit is 48 years as on the closing date, 25 November 2026. The cut-off date for age, minimum post-qualification experience and qualification is also 25 November 2026. Relaxations for SC/ST/OBC (NCL)/PwBD/EWS/Ex-servicemen/J&K domicile follow Govt. of India guidelines. Persons with 40% or more disability are eligible for reservation under the PwBD category. Reserved-category candidates must submit their caste/category certificate in the Government of India format, issued by the Competent Authority. content_sections.text: The Chief Manager - Accounts & Finance post is in Grade E5, with a pay scale of Rs.80,000 - 3% - 2,20,000/- under the IDA pattern. Total Emoluments & Allowances include: Basic Pay in the pay scale Dearness Allowance House Rent Allowance (at the rates that apply at the place of posting) Cafeteria Allowance, etc. Officials can also use the Group Health Schemes that the company has adopted. The appointment is on a regular basis. You must be willing to be posted anywhere in India where NSIL has an office, and to travel across India as required.

content_sections.heading: NSIL Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: The key responsibilities of the Chief Manager - Accounts & Finance are: Oversee financial planning, budgeting, forecasting, and financial analysis to support strategic decision-making. Ensure compliance with government financial regulations, tax laws, and statutory requirements. Coordinate with regulatory bodies such as CAG, GST authorities, and other financial auditors. Provide leadership in investment planning and risk assessment, and lead a team so that the department functions efficiently. Develop and implement financial policies, procedures, and best practices. Support management in financial decision-making through in-depth financial analysis and reports. Liaise with banks, financial institutions, and government agencies for financial transactions.

The Institute has its main campus in Koramangala, Bengaluru and CREST Campus at Hosakote, Bengaluru. It operates field stations at Kavalur & Kodaikanal in Tamilnadu, Gauribidanur in Karnataka, and Leh/Hanle in Union Territory of Ladakh. content_sections.heading: About Pathanamthitta District Court
content_sections.text: The District Court, Pathanamthitta is the district court of Pathanamthitta district in Kerala. The notice is issued by its Sheristadar on behalf of the District Judge. The posts are in the Special Fast Track Court, Pathanamthitta. This court was sanctioned in Pathanamthitta district to dispose of cases registered under the POCSO Act. It was set up under the Kerala High Court's OM No.D7A(1)-56450/2018 dated 24.02.2020 and the Government of Kerala orders GO(Rt) No.65/2020 SJD dated 06.02.2020 and GO(Ms) No.125/2020/Home dated 12.06.2020. The District Court is preparing a panel for contract appointment. The panel is meant for vacancies expected to arise in December in this court.

Applicants must have retired in the post they are applying for (Office Attendant) or in a higher post. The official notification does not specify the minimum educational qualification. Tenure: the appointment lasts only until the earliest of these: 179 continuous days, the appointee completing 62 years of age, or the court ceasing to function. Agreement: the person appointed must sign a contract agreement in the prescribed format before the District Judge.

content_sections.heading: About FACT

The notice is issued by the Deputy General Manager (HR), and applications go to the HR Department, FEDO Building, Udyogamandal.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The post is Officer (Legal Services), post code 1. The essential qualification is Graduation in Law with 2 years post-qualification experience in the relevant field. If there are not enough candidates with the prescribed 2 years of experience, candidates with 1 year of relevant experience may be considered. A 5-year integrated dual degree in Law (B.A. LL.B./B.B.A. LL.B./B.Com. LL.B. or equivalent) is also considered. The minimum two years of post-qualification experience must be in the relevant field as either of these: Law/Legal Officer in the legal department of a Central Public Sector Undertaking, State Public Sector Undertaking, Central Government Department, State Government Department, University or Private Limited Company sector organisation; OR An advocate before any court of law/Tribunal. The experience counts only after enrolment with the Bar Council, and the Bar Council registration certificate must be uploaded with the online application. Experience in either or both capacities may be counted, provided the periods do not overlap. Only post-qualification experience as on 01.11.2026 is considered. The educational qualification must be approved or recognised by UGC, AIU or the Bar Council of India. Candidates with qualifications from foreign universities must produce the order or letter under which AIU approved or recognised it. The qualification must be from a full time regular course. Candidates who studied part time or through correspondence, distance, private study or off campus courses are not eligible to apply. For ex-servicemen, the essential qualification acquired or awarded as part of their service, with a certificate issued by the Armed Forces, is considered eligible. The relevant date for qualification, experience, age and all other eligibility criteria is 01.11.2026. The age limit is a maximum of 35 years as on 01.11.2026. Eligible candidates should have been born on or between 01.11.1991 and 31.10.2008. Matriculation / School leaving certificate granted by the Board of Secondary Education is the only acceptable proof of age. Reservation for SC, ST, OBC (NCL), EWS, PWBD and Ex-Servicemen applies as per Government Directives. For discipline-specific eligibility, candidates should refer to the official notification.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure

Candidates appointed with one to less than two years' experience are paid a consolidated Rs.31,930 per month. Both get an increase of 3% on successful completion of each year. Leave, ESI, Provident Fund, and TA & DA for duty travel apply based on eligibility, as per the Rules of the Company. The engagement is for two years, renewable for a maximum period of 2 spells of one year each, at the discretion of the Management, subject to requirement, performance and assessment. It is liable to be terminated by the Management with 15 days' notice or pay in lieu of notice, at its discretion and without assigning any reason. The engagement is for a fixed term only and gives no right to extension, permanent appointment or preferential treatment in appointment in the Company.

basic_details.job_title: Kerala High Court Research Assistant Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 48 Posts
basic_details.short_information: Law graduates and final year/semester law students can apply to the High Court of Kerala for 48 (Anticipatory) temporary Research Assistant vacancies on contract basis under Recruitment No. 23/2026. The tenure is 1 year and the honorarium is ₹35,000/- per month. Applications are accepted only online through hckrecruitment.keralacourts.in from 2 November 2026 to 30 November 2026.

how_to_apply: Candidates shall apply online through the recruitment portal of the High Court. No other means or modes of application will be accepted.
Complete 'One Time Registration' using the 'One Time Registration Login' link at https://hckrecruitment.keralacourts.in. The steps are given in the 'How to apply' link on the website.
Keep ready the scanned images of photograph and signature, details of qualification, etc.
Enter the required details in 'My Profile'.
Apply for the post from 'Apply Now' in 'Dashboard' and proceed as per the instructions on the screen.
If you are a differently abled candidate who needs a scribe, indicate this in the online application form.
Check the preview of the application before submission. Once submitted, no changes, editing or modification can be made.

Candidates who wish to apply from abroad have to send an email detailing their location with public IP address to [email protected]. They will then be allowed access to the recruitment portal, and they also have to inform the High Court by email after completing the online application process.

The fee can be paid with the system generated Fee Payment Challan, or online through Debit Card, Credit Card or Net Banking by following the instructions on the screen. Bank transaction charges, if applicable, will have to be borne by the candidate.
Online fee payment closes on 30 November 2026, along with the online application. Offline fee payment runs from 4 December 2026 to 11 December 2026.

To claim the fee relaxation, the Caste/Community Certificate or Disability Certificate, as the case may be, must be valid on the last date of closure of filing of the online application or on the date of certificate verification. Failure to produce these documents will result in invalidation of the application.
important_instructions: An application once filed will not be allowed to be withdrawn. Applications that do not comply with this notification, the guidelines and the instructions on the recruitment portal shall be rejected. Documents in original to prove age, qualifications, etc. should be produced as and when called for, failing which candidature will be cancelled. Anything not specifically claimed in the application against the appropriate field will not be considered at a later stage. If a candidate is found not to fulfil the eligibility norms, or to have given incorrect or false information or suppressed material facts, the candidature will stand cancelled. If this is detected even after appointment, the service is liable to be terminated. A candidate who attempts to appear or appeared with an edited or modified admission ticket will be disqualified from the selection process and may be debarred permanently or for such period as decided by the High Court. Candidates who misbehave or commit any malpractice during the written test or interview are liable to be disqualified or debarred by the High Court and/or from applying for any post in the High Court, permanently or for any period it decides. The High Court reserves its right to modify or cancel the notification at any stage of the selection process. Its decisions on eligibility, conduct of tests and selection are final and binding, and no representation or correspondence will be entertained. content_sections.heading: About Kerala High Court Research Assistant
content_sections.text: The High Court of Kerala, Kochi, is recruiting Research Assistants for temporary appointment in the High Court through its own recruitment portal. The notification dated 29 October 2026 (HCKL/7351/2026-REC2-HC KERALA) was issued by order under the name of Rajeev K. S, Registrar (Recruitment). The notification does not list the work of the post. The 'Code of Conduct' and 'Duties and functions' of Research Assistants are available in the 'Downloads' link of the recruitment portal, https://hckrecruitment.keralacourts.in .

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The notice calls the 48 vacancies anticipatory and does not give a category-wise break-up. Vacancies that may arise during the validity of the ranked list shall also be filled up from that list. The ranked list shall remain in force for a minimum period of one year from the date on which it is brought into force. It shall continue until a fresh list is published or until two years expire, whichever is earlier.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Nationality: Applications are invited from qualified Indian Citizens. Essential qualification: Graduation in Law. Final year/semester law students: They are also eligible to apply. Their applications will be considered only on production of all the certificates and the consolidated mark sheet at the time of certificate verification, prior to the viva voce examination. Age: Candidates born between 1 December 1994 and 30 November 2004 (both days inclusive) are eligible to apply. The notice does not mention any age relaxation. Degrees from outside Kerala: Candidates whose degrees are not awarded by the Universities in Kerala should obtain a certificate of recognition from any of the Universities in Kerala and keep it with them. It should be produced as and when called for, and failure to do so will entail cancellation of candidature. The full eligibility conditions for the post are in the official notification for Recruitment No. 23/2026.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The Research Assistant honorarium is ₹35,000/- per month and may be enhanced on the basis of Government sanction. The appointment is temporary and on contract basis. The tenure of 1 year may be extended to a 2nd year on the basis of Government sanction for continuance of the post and performance assessment.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Kerala High Court Research Assistant
content_sections.text: Candidates shall apply online through the recruitment portal of the High Court. No other means or modes of application will be accepted. Complete 'One Time Registration' using the 'One Time Registration Login' link at https://hckrecruitment.keralacourts.in . The steps are given in the 'How to apply' link on the website. Keep ready the scanned images of photograph and signature, details of qualification, etc. Enter the required details in 'My Profile'. Apply for the post from 'Apply Now' in 'Dashboard' and proceed as per the instructions on the screen. If you are a differently abled candidate who needs a scribe, indicate this in the online application form. Check the preview of the application before submission. Once submitted, no changes, editing or modification can be made. Candidates who wish to apply from abroad have to send an email detailing their location with public IP address to [email protected] . They will then be allowed access to the recruitment portal, and they also have to inform the High Court by email after completing the online application process. The fee can be paid with the system generated Fee Payment Challan, or online through Debit Card, Credit Card or Net Banking by following the instructions on the screen. Bank transaction charges, if applicable, will have to be borne by the candidate. Online fee payment closes on 30 November 2026, along with the online application. Offline fee payment runs from 4 December 2026 to 11 December 2026. To claim the fee relaxation, the Caste/Community Certificate or Disability Certificate, as the case may be, must be valid on the last date of closure of filing of the online application or on the date of certificate verification. Failure to produce these documents will result in invalidation of the application.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Selection will be on the basis of the written test and/or Scientific/Computer based Test and Viva Voce examination. Certificate verification takes place prior to the viva voce examination, with eligibility checked against original documents at that stage. Candidates should log in to their profile on the recruitment portal to download the Admission Ticket or Call Letter. Admission Tickets will be ready for download three weeks prior to the test, and Call Letters two weeks prior to the interview. Candidates will be intimated through SMS/e-mail. A candidate unable to download the document should contact the High Court at 0484-2562235. If no communication reaches the High Court at least one week before the test or interview, the candidate alone is responsible for non-receipt. The notice asks candidates to visit the recruitment portal at least once a week to know the schedule of the test or interview. Admission to the test or interview is purely provisional, based on the information in the online application and subject to verification of all eligibility conditions. Issue of an Admission Ticket or Call Letter does not mean that the candidature has been finally cleared or that the application entries have been accepted as true and correct. Differently abled candidates whose writing speed is affected can avail the services of a scribe, under the guidelines prescribed by the High Court. Such candidates must produce a medical certificate and declaration at the time of the test, in the prescribed format available in the recruitment portal. The scribe's qualification shall be at least one step below the minimum qualification prescribed for the post. Differently abled candidates, whether availing a scribe or not, will be allowed compensatory time of 20 minutes and/or part thereof for every hour of the examination. This requires a Medical Certificate stating that the candidate has a physical limitation to write. The format of the medical certificate is given in the 'Downloads' section of the recruitment portal.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: An application once filed will not be allowed to be withdrawn. Applications that do not comply with this notification, the guidelines and the instructions on the recruitment portal shall be rejected. Documents in original to prove age, qualifications, etc. should be produced as and when called for, failing which candidature will be cancelled. Anything not specifically claimed in the application against the appropriate field will not be considered at a later stage. If a candidate is found not to fulfil the eligibility norms, or to have given incorrect or false information or suppressed material facts, the candidature will stand cancelled. If this is detected even after appointment, the service is liable to be terminated. A candidate who attempts to appear or appeared with an edited or modified admission ticket will be disqualified from the selection process and may be debarred permanently or for such period as decided by the High Court. Candidates who misbehave or commit any malpractice during the written test or interview are liable to be disqualified or debarred by the High Court and/or from applying for any post in the High Court, permanently or for any period it decides. The High Court reserves its right to modify or cancel the notification at any stage of the selection process. Its decisions on eligibility, conduct of tests and selection are final and binding, and no representation or correspondence will be entertained. basic_details.job_title: Cochin Port Authority Master Tugs Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: Cochin Port Authority (CoPA), Willingdon Island, Kerala, is filling 2 posts of Master Tugs (Class – I). Both posts are unreserved (UR) and are filled on a regular basis by direct recruitment. The pay scale is Rs. 50000-160000, and candidates need a Certificate of Competency as Master (NCV) or Mate of a foreign going ship. Applications are accepted only through the online application portal. Online registration and fee payment run from 27 October 2026 to 27 November 2026.

how_to_apply: Candidates must apply through the online application portal linked on the Cochin Port careers page (www.cochinport.gov.in/careers). The notice says this is the only valid method and that no other application mode will be accepted. Documents relating to Age, Qualification, COC, CDC and so on must be submitted with the online application.
Open the online application portal from the Cochin Port careers page and complete the basic registration. Note the "Application reference No." you receive.

Go to State Bank Collect (onlinesbi.sbi/sbicollect), click "Govt. Departments" and select "Cochin Port Trust" from the dropdown. You can also use the direct payment link in the "Payment details" window of the application portal.
In the payment category, select the post you are applying for. Enter your Application reference No., any remarks and the mandatory details.
Tick the box agreeing to the Terms and Conditions and enter the Captcha.
Pay the application processing fee of Rs.400/- by Net banking, card payment or another mode offered. You must also bear any extra payment gateway or bank charges.
Download the payment receipt and upload it in the "Payment details" window of the application portal.
Fill in all the necessary details, upload the documents relating to Age, Qualification, COC, CDC and so on, and make the final submission.

No changes or modifications are allowed after submission. Each candidate may submit only one complete application, and submitting more than one will lead to rejection of all of them. Candidates who apply on the last date may not get troubleshooting help or technical support by email or phone after 1600 hrs on 27 November 2026.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Cochin Port Authority reserves the right to shortlist candidates and to limit the number called for a written test and/or personal interview. content_sections.heading: About CDB
content_sections.text: The Coconut Development Board works under the Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare, Government of India. Its office is at Kera Bhavan, SRV Road, Kochi – 682 011, Kerala. The vacancy circular is signed by Pramod P Kurian, Secretary of the Board.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Officials who are eligible and willing, and who can be released at once if selected, must send the application in triplicate in the prescribed proforma (Annexure-I, the Bio-Data/Curriculum Vitae Proforma attached to the circular). It goes through proper channel, meaning through the applicant's present employer, to this address: Chief Executive Officer, Coconut Development Board, Kera Bhavan, SRV Road, Kochi – 682 011

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: The notice states that these vacancies are subject to change. Both posts are open to Staff Car Drivers working in Central or State Governments or Universities or recognized research institutes or public sector undertakings or semi-Government or statutory or autonomous organizations. They must also meet the conditions given below for their post. (a)(i) Holding an analogous post on a regular basis in the parent cadre or department; or (a)(ii) With 6 years' service on a regular basis in Level 4 (₹25,500-81,100) in the pay matrix or equivalent in the parent cadre or department; and (b) Subject to passing a trade test of appropriate standard specified by the Central Government. (a)(i) Holding an analogous post on a regular basis in the parent cadre or department; or (a)(ii) With 9 years' service on a regular basis in Level 2 (₹19,900-63,200) in the pay matrix or equivalent in the parent cadre or department; and (b) Subject to passing a trade test of appropriate standard specified by the Central Government. The official notification does not specify the minimum educational qualification. The Annexure-I proforma still asks applicants to list their educational qualifications and to say whether they meet the qualifications the post requires. Candidates should check the official notification for the full post-specific eligibility for each post. The maximum age limit for appointment by deputation is not exceeding 56 (fifty-six) years as on the closing date of receipt of applications. This limit applies to both posts. An official selected on deputation basis can choose one of two options. The first is to draw his or her existing basic pay plus deputation (duty) allowance. The second is to have pay fixed in the scale of the post in accordance with DoPT OM No. 6/8/2009-Estt. (Pay-II), dated 17.06.2010, as amended from time to time. The deputation period shall ordinarily not exceed three years. This includes any deputation in another ex-cadre post held immediately before this appointment, in the same or another organisation or department of the Central Government.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: The application in triplicate in the Annexure-I proforma, with a passport size colour photograph affixed Attested copies of complete and up-to-date APAR for the last 5 years Integrity Certificate Vigilance Clearance Certificate The Certification by the Employer/Cadre Controlling Authority, countersigned with seal. It must confirm that no vigilance or disciplinary case is pending or contemplated, and that the applicant's integrity is certified. It must also state either that no major/minor penalty was imposed in the last 10 years, or attach a list of such penalties, as the case may be. The CR Dossier in original, or photocopies of the ACRs/APARs for the last 5 years attested on each page by an officer of the rank of Under Secretary to the Govt. of India or above, must be enclosed. For officers already on deputation: the application must be forwarded by the parent cadre or department with Cadre Clearance, Vigilance Clearance and Integrity Certificate For applicants from an organisation that does not follow Central Government pay scales: the latest salary slip issued by the organisation, showing basic pay with scale of pay and rate of increment, dearness pay/interim relief/other allowances (with break-up) and total emoluments A separate sheet, signed by the applicant, if the space in the form for employment details or additional information is not enough

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: For both posts, eligibility is subject to passing a trade test of appropriate standard specified by the Central Government. In the Annexure-I declaration, the applicant accepts that a Selection Committee will assess the information in the Curriculum Vitae, together with the documents on essential qualifications and work experience, at the time of selection.

basic_details.job_title: MPPSC Law Officer Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: Madhya Pradesh Public Service Commission (Madhya Pradesh Lok Seva Aayog), Indore, has invited online applications for one permanent Law Officer (Vidhi Adhikari) post in the Commission, a Gazetted Class I post in the pay scale of Rs. 15600-39100 (Grade Pay 6600). Candidates need a law degree with at least 60% marks and five years of advocacy in Service Matters before the High Court. Applications are accepted online on www.mponline.gov.in and www.mppsc.mp.gov.in from 23 November 2026 to 22 December 2026. The signed application with documents must reach the Commission office by 28 December 2026 a

age_limit.details: The candidate must have completed 21 years of age but must not have completed 40 years, counted as on 01.01.2027. As the post is unreserved, no age relaxation is admissible. Only the date of birth recorded in the 10th (High School) marksheet is accepted, and the name, father's name and date of birth in the online form must match that marksheet.

qualification.details: Graduate degree in Law with a minimum of 60 percent marks from a recognised university. If the marksheet uses a grading system instead of marks, the candidate must submit an affidavit on the percentage value of the grade, supported by the relevant records of the university concerned. The affidavit must show the formula or principle used to calculate the percentage.

how_to_apply: Fill in the online application from 23 November 2026 to 22 December 2026 on www.mponline.gov.in or www.mppsc.mp.gov.in, either at an authorised MPOnline kiosk or from home or an internet cafe.

Keep scanned files of a recent passport-size colour photograph (light or white background, no cap, hat or dark glasses, no selfie) and your signature ready for upload; kiosks scan them free of charge.
Submit the form, check the details in the popup window (Cancel to correct, OK to submit), then click "proceed for payment"; the form stays "Unpaid" until the fee is paid.

Pay the fee by credit card, debit card or internet banking, or in cash at the kiosk (take the receipt). Check that the printout shows the amount and "Payment Done", and keep the application number for all correspondence.
Download the Attestation Form, Personal Details Sheet and Attendance Sheet from the "Download Formate" link on www.mppsc.mp.gov.in, fill them in and make three, six and one photocopies respectively.

Sign the online application at the marked place and attach self-attested copies of all documents and one copy each of the three forms. Keep the remaining copies for the interview, where they must be shown with the original documents.

Put the set in a large envelope marked "Advertisement No. 14/2026 dated 04.11.2026, Law Officer, Application for the post of Madhya Pradesh Public Service Commission", with your name and address as sender, and send it by registered post or speed post to: Secretary, Madhya Pradesh Public Service Commission, Residency Area, Indore (Madhya Pradesh) PIN - 452001. An envelope without the advertisement number and post or department name will not be considered.

The application must reach the Commission office by 28 December 2026 at 6:00 PM. It may also be handed in at the office on working days between 10:00 AM and 6:00 PM, against a receipt. Keep one set of everything you send.

No bank draft or cheque is accepted. The fee is refunded online to the candidate's account only if the advertisement is cancelled, and refund claims for excess or wrong payment are not accepted. Apart from the application fee and portal fee, no other amount is payable; if a kiosk operator asks for more, complaints can be made to the MPOnline helpline 0755-6720200.
From 29 December 2026 to 04 January 2027, documents are accepted with a late fee of Rs. 3000/-.

For registered applicants who have not submitted documents even by 04 January 2027, the Commission will issue a notice of cancellation of candidature on its website; documents will then be accepted for 10 office days from that notice with a late fee of Rs. 25000/-.

Candidates submitting with a late fee must first give an undertaking that they hold all qualifications and experience as per the advertisement. The late fee is not refunded if the candidature is later cancelled.
Applications received late without the late fee are rejected, and the online fee is not refunded.
Attendance Sheet – 1 original; Personal Details Sheet – 1 original and 5 photocopies (copies submitted separately and not numbered); Attestation Form – 3 originals.
Declaration of not being debarred from any selection or examination – 1 original.
High School marksheet, Higher Secondary marksheet, and the marksheets of all years of graduation with the degree.
Experience certificate as per Appendix-3.
Madhya Pradesh domicile/local resident certificate, if applicable (manual certificates must show round seal, dispatch number and date).

Caste certificate of the Madhya Pradesh Government from the competent authority (Sub-Divisional Officer, Revenue) if from a reserved category, issued on or before 22 December 2026; married women need a certificate in their own name with the father's name; certificates from other states are not valid; OBC candidates must also give the non-creamy layer declaration.

Disability certificate, if applicable: certificates issued on or after 01.06.2021 are valid only through the UDID portal http:\\www.swavlambancard.gov.in, and reservation benefits apply only with 40% or more permanent disability.
Affidavit for change of surname after marriage (women applicants).

Government servants: No Objection Certificate from the department, or a copy of the NOC application made on or before 22 December 2026, plus an undertaking (1 original) if serving in Madhya Pradesh; non-government employees: a certificate of being in service.
Ex-servicemen: proof of ex-serviceman status issued on or before 22 December 2026 and a copy of the service details sheet.
Identity proof (any one): Aadhaar card, voter ID, PAN card, bank passbook copy, employer-issued ID for government employees, or driving licence.
Where a court case is involved, 3 photocopies of the related documents mentioned in the Attestation Form.
important_instructions: Corrections can be made online only, during 25 November to 24 December 2026, at Rs. 50/- per correction per session; the candidate's name cannot be corrected, and errors cannot be corrected at the interview stage. Changing a reserved-category application to unreserved costs the fee difference of Rs. 250 plus the correction fee; changing from unreserved to reserved does not refund the difference. Results are declared on the category, gender and government-servant status filled in the form. A candidate who applies without meeting the essential qualifications may be debarred from the Commission's examinations. False information or more than one application leads to cancellation of candidature, debarment and possible legal action. Offline caste certificates without the issuing officer's signature, designation seal, caste name, case number and round seal will not be accepted on interview day. Name, date of birth, category and gender in the online form must match the original certificates, or the candidature will be cancelled. Calling a candidate for a written test or interview does not mean that eligibility has been accepted. The signature on the application must be used on the interview attendance sheet and all correspondence; a mismatch may cancel the candidature. Notices and results are published only on www.mppsc.mp.gov.in, and the Commission may send updates by e-mail and SMS to the contact details given in the form. Help with the online form: MPPSC, Indore (0731) 2701624, 2701983; MPOnline helpline 0755-6720200.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Applications are invited from citizens of India and from candidates of other categories recognised under the Constitution of India. The single vacancy is unreserved (UR). None of the posts is reserved for women or candidates with disabilities. Graduate degree in Law with a minimum of 60 percent marks from a recognised university. If the marksheet uses a grading system instead of marks, the candidate must submit an affidavit on the percentage value of the grade, supported by the relevant records of the university concerned. The affidavit must show the formula or principle used to calculate the percentage. The qualification, experience and all other eligibility conditions must be held by the online last date, 22 December 2026. A candidate who acquires them after that date will be treated as ineligible. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions of the post. The candidate must have completed 21 years of age but must not have completed 40 years, counted as on 01.01.2027. As the post is unreserved, no age relaxation is admissible. Only the date of birth recorded in the 10th (High School) marksheet is accepted, and the name, father's name and date of birth in the online form must match that marksheet. Under the Madhya Pradesh Civil Services (General Conditions of Service) Rules, 1961: A candidate convicted of any offence against women is not eligible for appointment; where such a case is pending in court, the appointment will be kept pending until the final decision of the criminal case. A candidate who has more than two living children, one of whom was born on or after 26 January 2001, is not eligible. A candidate who already has one living child and whose next delivery on or after 26 January 2001 results in two or more children is not disqualified.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The Law Officer post is permanent (sthayi) and classed as Gazetted Class I, in the pay scale of Rs. 15600-39100 (Grade Pay 6600). Selected candidates will be appointed on a probation period of two years. The age of superannuation will follow the Madhya Pradesh Government Servants (Superannuation Age) Act, 1967, as amended from time to time.

content_sections.text: Legal responsibility related to court cases.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for MPPSC Law Officer
content_sections.text: Attendance Sheet – 1 original; Personal Details Sheet – 1 original and 5 photocopies (copies submitted separately and not numbered); Attestation Form – 3 originals. Declaration of not being debarred from any selection or examination – 1 original. High School marksheet, Higher Secondary marksheet, and the marksheets of all years of graduation with the degree. Experience certificate as per Appendix-3. Madhya Pradesh domicile/local resident certificate, if applicable (manual certificates must show round seal, dispatch number and date). Caste certificate of the Madhya Pradesh Government from the competent authority (Sub-Divisional Officer, Revenue) if from a reserved category, issued on or before 22 December 2026; married women need a certificate in their own name with the father's name; certificates from other states are not valid; OBC candidates must also give the non-creamy layer declaration. Disability certificate, if applicable: certificates issued on or after 01.06.2021 are valid only through the UDID portal http:\\ www.swavlambancard.gov.in , and reservation benefits apply only with 40% or more permanent disability. Affidavit for change of surname after marriage (women applicants). Government servants: No Objection Certificate from the department, or a copy of the NOC application made on or before 22 December 2026, plus an undertaking (1 original) if serving in Madhya Pradesh; non-government employees: a certificate of being in service. Ex-servicemen: proof of ex-serviceman status issued on or before 22 December 2026 and a copy of the service details sheet. Identity proof (any one): Aadhaar card, voter ID, PAN card, bank passbook copy, employer-issued ID for government employees, or driving licence. Where a court case is involved, 3 photocopies of the related documents mentioned in the Attestation Form.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Selection for the MPPSC Law Officer post will be made on the basis of an interview. After scrutiny of documents, 12 candidates, in order of the marks obtained in the qualifying examination, and candidates with marks equal to the cut-off, will be called for interview, subject to eligible candidates being available. The interview carries 100 marks, and the minimum qualifying mark is 41. Final selection will be in order of merit of marks obtained in the interview. If more than 500 candidates apply, a written examination will be held. Candidates equal to three times the advertised posts in each category or sub-category, and those with equal marks, will then be called for interview. Final selection will be on the combined written and interview marks, and in that case there are no minimum qualifying marks for the interview. If a written examination is held, its scheme and syllabus will be published on mppsc.mp.gov.in in due course.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Corrections can be made online only, during 25 November to 24 December 2026, at Rs. 50/- per correction per session; the candidate's name cannot be corrected, and errors cannot be corrected at the interview stage. Changing a reserved-category application to unreserved costs the fee difference of Rs. 250 plus the correction fee; changing from unreserved to reserved does not refund the difference. Results are declared on the category, gender and government-servant status filled in the form. A candidate who applies without meeting the essential qualifications may be debarred from the Commission's examinations. False information or more than one application leads to cancellation of candidature, debarment and possible legal action. Offline caste certificates without the issuing officer's signature, designation seal, caste name, case number and round seal will not be accepted on interview day. Name, date of birth, category and gender in the online form must match the original certificates, or the candidature will be cancelled. Calling a candidate for a written test or interview does not mean that eligibility has been accepted. The signature on the application must be used on the interview attendance sheet and all correspondence; a mismatch may cancel the candidature. Notices and results are published only on www.mppsc.mp.gov.in , and the Commission may send updates by e-mail and SMS to the contact details given in the form. Help with the online form: MPPSC, Indore (0731) 2701624, 2701983; MPOnline helpline 0755-6720200.

basic_details.short_information: The Marine Department of Jawaharlal Nehru Port Authority (JNPA) is engaging 3 Pilots on fixed term employment, with total monthly remuneration of Rs 1,50,000 during training and up to Rs 3,75,000 at full tonnage. Applicants must hold a certificate of competency as Master of a foreign going ship and have one year of post-qualification experience as Master / Chief Officer of a foreign going ship, with a maximum age of 55 years. The posts are 01 ST, 01 SC and 01 OBC (NCL). The application in the Annexure III form goes to [email protected] or by mail/courier to the Deputy Conservator on or before

how_to_apply: Fill in the prescribed application form, Annexure III, "Application for the post of Pilot fixed term employment basis". It asks for name, addresses, contact details, date of birth, nationality, SC/ST/OBC status, qualifications, certificate of competency details, employment history, date from which the applicant holds the post of Master, sailing experience as Chief Officer/Master, languages known and any other information. A passport-size photograph is affixed.

Applicants employed in Govt / Semi-Govt organisations, PSUs or Autonomous Bodies also need the certificate to be given by the Head of Department / Competent Authority, printed with the form. It certifies the particulars, that no disciplinary case is pending or contemplated, and integrity and vigilance clearance.
Send the application to [email protected], or by mail/courier to Deputy Conservator, Administrative building, Jawaharlal Nehru Port Authority, Nhava- Uran Navi Mumbai 4000707.
Send it on or before 30.11.2026.
Submit duly self-attested copies of the Master FG COC, post qualification experience certificates, educational qualification, caste certificate and identity proof.
important_instructions: Canvassing, directly or indirectly, may disqualify the candidature. JNPA management reserves the right to postpone or cancel the interview in unavoidable or unforeseen circumstances. The decision of Management is final and binding on eligibility, acceptance or rejection of applications, reservation, mode of selection and cancellation of the selection process in part or full. No correspondence will be entertained. A selected candidate has no claim to regular employment in JNPA during the term of employment, and cannot claim any right, title or interest on par with regular employees of the Port. JNPA retains 20% of the (B+FI+PI) monthly package, subject to a ceiling of Rs 3,00,000, during the first contract. After the first contract the ceiling of the retained amount is Rs 1,50,000. The retained amount is forfeited if the contract is ended without three months' notice, if the Pilot leaves before completing 3 years, or on disciplinary action under clauses 4.3 and 4.4. The notice says the terms are to be reviewed after 5 years, and that JNPA rules on conduct and discipline apply. Applicability of GST and gratuity under the new Labour code is under review by JNPA management. Documents named in the engagement letter for reporting for duty: proof of date of birth (SSC or school leaving certificate), certificate of educational/technical qualification, certificate of competency, DG Shipping endorsement (if applicable), experience certificate and CDC, a filled character and attestation form, caste certificate (SC/ST/OBC candidates), and a relieving certificate for those employed in a Govt. organisation. The engagement letter asks for originals and attested copies.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The notice invites applications for 3 Pilots on Fixed Term Employee basis. If no candidate is available for a reserved category, the notice says the Pilot, being an essential operational position, will be engaged from other available categories.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The gross emoluments payable per month depend on the tonnage slab. The notice gives them as follows (Rs per month). The fixed incentive includes transport and mobile expenses. After one year as a full tonnage pilot, a Pilot on fixed term employment is eligible for a yearly increment of 6% of the (B+FI) amount. Working on a day off or public holiday is paid at (B+FI)/30*1.5, and leave encashment is at (B+FI)/30 per day. Remuneration is for one calendar month, and one day's remuneration is pro-rata on a 30-day month. The pilotage incentive shown is for 20 working days or pro-rata. It is paid only for working days and casual leave, and not for earned leave or leave encashment. Extra movements are paid by length overall (LOA) of the vessel, in Rs. Other terms in the notice: The initial contract is for 3 years. It may be extended for 3 years each, with at least a minimum one-day break at mutual consent. The Pilot is employed as a Trainee Pilot on FTE basis until he obtains the Pilotage licence from MoPSW. Training is six months or more, including 2 months at MbPA and the ELPT course conducted by IMU. Rs 20,000 per year or pro-rata is paid for purchase of PPE, which excludes the life jacket. Lodging and boarding at the JNPA Guest House is free during working hours, with the cost of meals restricted to Rs 2,250 per month. Any expense above that is deducted from the monthly remuneration. Leave: 30 days earned leave and 20 days casual leave, or pro-rata, per calendar year. Earned leave is credited at 2.5 days per month. Earned leave may be carried forward or encashed within the 3-year contract period, while casual leave is neither encashed nor carried forward. Health insurance up to Rs 60,000 is reimbursed for self, spouse, parents and two children (up to age 25 years) for the first contract appointment after completion of one year. On renewal it is reimbursed on submitting the receipt. The Pilot is covered by JNPA's Group Personal Accident Insurance policy. Transport within the port area and up to the JNPA port township is provided, and accommodation in the port township is allotted if available, on a chargeable basis.

content_sections.heading: JNPA Pilot Job Description
content_sections.text: Duties and responsibility are as defined in the operational manual of Marine. Carry out a minimum of two movements per 12-hour day shift and one movement in the night shift, on a cycle of 2 days, 2 nights, shift off and weekly off over six days. Day shift is 0800 to 2000 hrs and night shift 2000 hrs to 0800 hrs next day. Carry out all duties assigned during the twelve-hour shift on a rotational basis, including early arrival or late departure as the movements require. Keep the Pilotage licence and the Master (F.G.) certificate valid throughout the contract period and while piloting. Complete all movements allotted during duty hours as directed by the Dock Masters / Harbour Master / Deputy Conservator. Inform the Deputy Conservator / Harbour Master when out of station (Mumbai Metropolitan Region area). Wear the uniform as per the Harbour Master Office Circular while on pilotage duty.

content_sections.heading: NFDC GENERAL MANAGER (NORTH) Job Description
content_sections.text: Head of the Regional office, responsible for its operational and financial efficiency: business development, making the cost center profitable, business acquisition, liaising and coordination with all stakeholders, high-quality business strategies and plans, policy and strategy alignment with organizational goals, managing various verticals of the regional office, internal control, budgets, optimum utilization of resources and efficient manpower management. Identifying and deciding alternatives to make Promotion, Programming and Production units profitable. Identifying and implementing growth plans in the light of technological and environmental changes. Providing policy guidelines for the departments and sections below him/her. Liaisoning with other Regional Offices, Ministries of Central & State Governments, Departments and external agencies to fulfill the business targets. Resolving and controlling budgets and resources to achieve targets. Developing continuously the motivation level and competence level of the people working in the Head office, Mumbai. Directing and controlling the Regional functions, departments and sections to achieve the plans and targets. To identify and implement strategic options and viable long term, medium term and short term plans to make the business competitive and profitable, and to manage the various business activities of the given territory in order to generate profit for NFDC. To provide leadership to the group of people working with him to draw maximum contribution from them and to steer to achieve the set revenue and growth targets.

faq.answer: There are 3 contract posts: 1 Accounts Officer and Cash Accountant and 2 Assistant Administrative Officer.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for SCEA Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application period runs from 2 November 2026 to 18 November 2026. Applications received after the prescribed period will not be considered.

faq.question: Q3. Who can apply for SCEA Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Only officers/employees retired from any department of the Maharashtra State Government may apply. They must have retired from the relevant pay scale and have at least 3 years' experience in the proposed pay scale or the special qualification required for the specific work.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for SCEA Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Retired officers/employees who have not completed 65 years of age are eligible. Those appointed can work only up to the age of 65.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for SCEA contract posts?
faq.answer: The monthly remuneration will be fixed at an amount equal to the pension with dearness allowance admissible on the date of appointment, as per the GAD GR dated 10 June 2025. It stays the same for the contract period of up to 3 years.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for SCEA Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Send the prescribed form to Member Secretary, State Cooperative Election Authority, Maharashtra State, Pune, Old Central Building, Ground Floor, Pune 411001. You can send it by post, submit it in person, or email it to [email protected].

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for SCEA Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The applications received will be scrutinised and candidates will be called for an oral interview.

faq.question: Q8. How long is the SCEA contract appointment?
faq.answer: The appointment is for a maximum of one year at a time. It may be renewed every year if the Authority needs it, but the total period will not exceed three years.

faq.question: Q9. Which pay scales are required for the two posts?
faq.answer: For Accounts Officer and Cash Accountant, the applicant must have retired from the pay scale (S-15) 41800 - 132300. For Assistant Administrative Officer, the scale is (S-14) 38600 - 122800.

content_sections.heading: About TISS
content_sections.text: TISS is located at V.N. Purav Marg, Deonar, Mumbai, and is declared a Deemed to be University under Section 3 of the UGC Act, 1956. Prayas, the project behind this recruitment, is a field action project of its Centre for Criminology and Justice, initiated in 1990. It responds to the needs of disadvantaged groups who come in contact with the Criminal Justice System. It aims to facilitate the socio-legal and economic rehabilitation of persons at risk of criminalisation, exploitation in commercial sex, and those living in destitute conditions.

content_sections.heading: About MACS-ARI
content_sections.text: MACS-Agharkar Research Institute (ARI), Pune is an autonomous institute of the Department of Science and Technology (DST), Government of India. It describes itself as committed to promoting science and technology, with emphasis on high standards of research and development. Its research covers the biological sciences in six thematic areas: Biodiversity & Palaeobiology, Bioenergy, Bioprospecting, Developmental Biology, Genetics & Plant Breeding, and Nanobioscience.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The notice advertises 2 Scientist-C posts on a direct recruitment basis. The place of work for the first post is the Genetics & Plant Breeding Group of ARI, Pune. For the second post, it is the Developmental Biology Group of ARI, Pune.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: ARI invites applications from eligible Indian citizens and from scientists and employees of Central or State Governments, universities, recognised research institutions, public sector undertakings and other government-funded organisations. Essential: First Class M.Sc in Agriculture with specialisation in Genetics and Plant Breeding or allied disciplines from a recognised university or Institute, or equivalent qualifications. Four years of research and development experience in the required areas, as evidenced by publications in journals of repute, after obtaining an academic degree. Desirable: Doctoral degree in Genetics & Plant Breeding/ Plant Breeding/ Crop Improvement or allied disciplines from a recognised University or Institute. Proven experience in crop breeding and genomics-assisted research. Hands-on experience with field experimentation, phenotyping and data analysis. A demonstrated record of high-impact scientific publications and of taking part in acquiring and carrying out research projects. Ability to work collaboratively in interdisciplinary research programs. Experience in a research laboratory after obtaining an M.Sc in the relevant field. Essential: First Class M.Sc in Life Sciences, Biochemistry, Biotechnology or related fields, or equivalent qualifications. Four years of research and development experience in the required areas, evidenced by publications in reputed journals, after obtaining an academic degree. Desirable: Ph.D in areas of life science including Molecular biology, cell biology, and developmental biology or related areas. At least 3-5 years of post-doctoral experience in cell and developmental biology, with experience in cell culture and model organism research, and a good publication record in reputed journals. Experience of working in a research laboratory after obtaining an M.Sc. Time spent acquiring the essential qualifications does not count towards experience. However, time spent on a Doctorate degree from a recognised University or Institution (up to a maximum of two years) counts as experience. So does time spent on Post Doctorate research in a University or research institute, up to a maximum of two years, when it is shown by a certificate from that University or Institute and by research published in journals of repute. All educational, professional and technical qualifications must be from a recognised Board or University. For both posts, the upper age limit for direct recruitment shall not exceed 40 years. The crucial date for deciding the age limit and eligibility is the closing date for submission of applications. For the discipline-specific eligibility of each post, check the official notification.

The notice says the pay, allowances and other benefits include NPS, Medical reimbursement, LTC etc., which are presently admissible as per the rules of the Institute. content_sections.heading: ARI Pune Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: Undertake a breeding programme in wheat, soybean and grape for high yield, improved quality and tolerance to biotic and abiotic stresses. Implement genomic-assisted breeding approaches, including GWAS, QTL mapping, SNP-based analyses and genomic selection (GS). Develop, manage and evaluate bi-parental, multi-parent (MAGIC/NAAM) and RIL breeding populations. Conduct biofortification research and trait discovery for nutritional and quality-related traits. Plan, conduct and analyse multi-location and multi-season field trials. Carry out germplasm characterisation, evaluation and core collection development. Apply marker-assisted selection (MAS) and integrate molecular tools into breeding pipelines. Perform plant phenotyping using morphological, physiological and biochemical methods. Conduct quality analyses, including oil, protein, minerals, fatty acid compositions and volatile profiling. Contribute to seed production programmes and varietal release pipelines as per institutional and national guidelines. Publish research outcomes in peer-reviewed journals with a high impact factor. Prepare and submit research project proposals and secure extramural funding from national and international agencies. Assist in mentoring research scholars and contribute to departmental and institutional academic and other activities. Initiate and develop independent projects in new and emerging frontiers of cell and developmental biology, organelle biology and diseases. Secure extramural funding. Enthuse, motivate and supervise research scholars. Take part in teaching and training programs, and in teaching and training students. Contribute towards the development and maintenance of Institutional infrastructure. Facilitate and carry out various academic outreach activities. Advance research in cell and developmental biology and start new transnational areas of research. Contribute to Institutional work as entrusted from time to time.

content_sections.text: The last date is 45 days from the date of publication in the Employment News for candidates in Meghalaya, Arunachal Pradesh, Mizoram, Manipur, Nagaland, Tripura, Sikkim, Ladakh Division of J & K State, Lahaul and Spiti District and Pangi Sub Division of Chamba District of Himachal Pradesh, Andaman and Nicobar Island and Lakshadweep. The Institute is not responsible for incomplete, pending or failed online fee transactions; in such cases candidates may contact the bank concerned. Printout of the online application. Passport size photograph. Self-attested copies of qualifications and certificates, including educational qualifications, date of birth, PwBD category, SC/ST/OBC/EWS and experience. Receipt of the online fee payment (for candidates who pay the fee). Experience or employment certificates that clearly show the date of joining, the date of relieving and the post held. For PwBD and SC/ST/OBC/EWS candidates, a latest copy of the caste certificate(s). Candidates who claim a concession or relaxation need the relevant certificates from the Competent Authority in the prescribed proforma. List of publications/patents etc. For SCI journal publications, a list with copies of the 4 best papers written in the last 5 years. List them chronologically, giving the names of the authors, title of the paper, name of the journal, volume, pages (from-to), year, citation count and impact factor of the journal. For candidates working in Government Departments, Public Sector Undertakings or Autonomous Organisations, a No Objection Certificate (NOC) in the Annexure-I format, signed by the Head of the Organisation/Office with the office seal. If the NOC is not uploaded with the application form, it must be submitted at the time of interview. Candidates must produce the original certificates as and when required. Certificates or documents that are illegible or incorrect may lead to rejection of the candidature.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Having the essential qualifications does not by itself entitle a candidate to an interview. A committee decides whether a qualification is equivalent to the essential and desirable qualifications. If many applications are received, the Institute may limit the number of candidates called for interview through shortlisting. The shortlisting criteria may include desirable qualifications and/or experience beyond the minimum. Only shortlisted candidates will be informed by email of the date, time and venue of the next stage of selection. Outstation candidates called for interview will be paid two-tier AC rail fare both ways by the shortest route. A reserve panel, in order of merit, will be prepared from the candidates called for interview. It remains valid for one year from the date of interview and may be used to fill the advertised vacancy and vacancies arising later.

basic_details.short_information: The High Court of Orissa, Cuttack is filling 38 posts in the cadre of District Judge by direct recruitment under Advertisement No. 03 of 2026, in the pay scale of ₹ 1,44,840 – ₹ 1,94,660 with usual D.A. and other allowances. how_to_apply: Go through this advertisement and the "Instructions to Candidates for Filling up of Online Application Form" on the Court's website.
Log in to www.orissahighcourt.nic.in and open Recruitment Corner → Examination Portal → Direct Recruitment to the Posts in the Cadre of District Judge, 2026.
Fill the online form, choosing the correct category; enter the name exactly as in the High School Certificate, or the changed name if it has been changed.
Upload clear and legible scanned copies of the documents listed below.
Pay the fee online, unless exempted.
Submit between 10:00 A.M. of 9 November 2026 and 11:59 P.M. of 25 November 2026. Applications sent in any other mode will be rejected.
The fee is non-refundable and non-adjustable and is paid online by Net Banking, Debit card, Credit card or UPI.
Aadhaar card.
Matriculation/High School Certificate Examination or equivalent certificate for name and date of birth.
Certificate from the competent authority showing passing of Odia of Middle School Standard.
Bachelor's Degree in Law.
Certificate of legal practice (Annexure-I) showing years of practice at the Bar, wherever applicable.
Certificate of Judicial Service (Annexure-II) showing years served as a Judicial Officer, wherever applicable; applicants with both Bar practice and judicial service submit both annexures.
Public Prosecutors: appointment letter containing the date of joining, or the appointment letter with the notification containing the date of joining.
Recent passport size colour photograph and full signature (signature on white background), both clearly visible with proper orientation.
Category certificate from the Competent Authority for S.C./S.T./S.E.B.C. (Non-Creamy Layer); disability or medical certificate from the Competent Medical Board or Authority for PwBD.
Gazette notification for change of name/surname and No Objection Certificate/Standing Order of NOC or undertaking for government servants, wherever applicable.

The certificate of legal practice must be certified by the Principal Judicial Officer of a Court, or by an advocate of that Court with at least 10 years' standing endorsed by the Principal Judicial Officer of the district or station.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: Out of the 38 posts, 03 posts will be filled by horizontal reservation for Persons with Benchmark Disabilities having physical disability as specified in the Schedule to the Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016 (49 of 2016), excluding cerebral palsy. The number of vacancies is subject to change at the discretion of the Court, and the Court reserves the right to cancel the entire recruitment process or any part of it at any stage.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The candidate must be a graduate in Law from a recognized University or an Institution recognized by the Government. The candidate must meet one of these four conditions: be an advocate in continuous practice for not less than seven years as on the date of application; or be an advocate who has previously served in the judicial service and possesses a combined experience of not less than seven years as judicial officer and as an advocate, as on the date of application; or be a Judicial Officer who has completed seven years of continuous practice as an advocate before joining the judicial service; or be a Judicial Officer who possesses a combined experience of not less than seven years as an advocate and as a judicial officer, as on the date of application. Years of practice are counted from the date of provisional enrolment or registration with the concerned State Bar Council. Public Prosecutors may apply if they have the required qualification, experience and age; they must inform their Heads of Offices in writing and obtain a No Objection Certificate from their controlling authority. The candidate must be able to speak, read and write Odia fluently and must have passed an examination in Odia Language equivalent to Middle English School standard. The candidate must not be below 35 years of age and not above 45 years of age as on the date of application. A candidate who comes under more than one category gets only one age relaxation, the one most beneficial to him or her. A person who is not a citizen of India. A person dismissed from service by any High Court, Government or Statutory or Local Authority. A person convicted of an offence involving moral turpitude, or permanently debarred or disqualified by any High Court, the Union Public Service Commission or any State Public Service Commission from its examinations or selections. A person who directly or indirectly influences the recruiting authority for his or her candidature. A married candidate with more than one spouse living, unless the Government exempts the person on the grounds stated in the notice. A person who cannot speak, read and write Odia, or has not passed a test in Odia equivalent to Middle School Standard. Candidates should check the full eligibility conditions in the official notification before applying.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Selection has two parts: a Written Examination and an Interview, held under the O.S.J.S. and O.J.S. Rules, 2007. Paper-1 group (3), 40 marks, covers the Transfer of Property Act, the Specific Relief Act, the Limitation Act, the Law of Contract, the Odisha Consolidation of Holding and Prevention of Fragmentation of Land Act, the Odisha Estate Abolition Act, the Odisha Land Reforms Act, the Law relating to Motor Accident and Claims, the Arbitration and Conciliation Act, 1996 and the Commercial Courts Act, 2015. Paper-2 group (4), 10 marks, covers the Narcotics Drugs and Psychotropic Substance Act, the Food Safety and Standard Act, 2006, the Prevention of Corruption Act, the Essential Commodities Act, the Environment Protection Act, the Water (Prevention and Control of Pollution) Act, 1974, the SC and ST (Prevention of Atrocities) Act, 1989, the Protection of Women from Domestic Violence Act, 2005, the POCSO Act, 2012 and the Juvenile Justice (Care and Protection of Children) Act, 2015. Paper-3 (General English) has translation from Odia to English, ten lines (10 marks); re-translation from English to Odia, ten lines (10); a short essay of about 150 words (30); précis writing of 300 words (30); and one passage of maximum 500 words with 5 questions (20). Candidates must secure a minimum of 45% in Paper-3. The interview carries 30 marks. Candidates are called in the proportion of 1:10, provided they get at least 45% in each of the written papers and 50% in aggregate. Candidates with benchmark disabilities are called in the proportion of 1:10 with at least 40% in each paper and 45% in aggregate. Document verification is held before the interview; candidates must bring original certificates, Aadhaar Card, photograph (same as uploaded), a self-attested copy of the online application and self-attested copies of the uploaded certificates, failing which they will be debarred from the interview. The final merit list is prepared on the marks of Paper-1, Paper-2 and the Interview. A candidate is not included unless he or she secures at least 40% in the interview.

Failure to satisfy the prescribed medical examination will bar appointment to the service.

content_sections.heading: Method of Selection
content_sections.text: Selection is based solely on a Written Test (OMR/CBT Mode). Questions are prepared as per the syllabus published on the SSB Odisha website ( ssbodisha.ac.in/syllabus ). In case of a tie, preference goes to the candidate with higher aggregate marks in the Bachelor's Degree (or equivalent); if the tie persists, the older candidate is selected. If conducted in OMR mode, the exam is held in different districts of Odisha (based on candidates' preferred district); if conducted in CBT mode, it is held in multiple shifts at designated centres across the state.

content_sections.heading: NITJ TBI Chief Executive Officer (CEO) Job Description
content_sections.text: The CEO will be responsible primarily for achieving the objectives and goals of the NITJ Technology Business Incubator in a sustainable and growth-oriented manner. The CEO will be the prime interface for entrepreneurs and will manage the operations, planning, marketing and development of NITJ TBI. The notice says the position requires a team player with proven leadership qualities, excellent marketing and organisation skills, and a professional attitude. The CEO will be responsible for the overall leadership, growth and management of NITJ TBI. The duties include, but are not limited to: Developing and implementing strategic plans for incubation and entrepreneurship development. Creating incubation plans and implementing them, assisting in writing business plans, keeping track of the incubation process, and helping incubatees prepare proposals for funding. Marketing the Incubator and actively promoting it through various channels. Identifying, attracting, mentoring and supporting startups and innovators. Building partnerships with industry, government agencies, investors, incubators, accelerators and other ecosystem stakeholders. Facilitating access to funding through venture capitalists, angel investors, government schemes and CSR initiatives. Managing incubation programs, startup support services, events, workshops and outreach activities. Strengthening the mentor and expert network of the incubator. Ensuring compliance with guidelines of the Government of India and other funding agencies. Managing financial resources, statutory requirements and administrative functions of the Incubator. Promoting innovation, intellectual property creation and technology commercialization. Coordinating with faculty, students, researchers, alumni and industry partners to foster entrepreneurship. Preparing proposals, reports, utilization certificates and other documents required by funding agencies and stakeholders. Undertaking any other responsibilities assigned by the Board of Directors/Governing Body of NITJ TBI.

content_sections.heading: ZSI Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: Conduct novel research on long term ecological monitoring of arthropods in the LTEO sites across India in terrestrial and freshwater ecosystems using integrated approaches. Work on community ecology, stream ecology, GIS and use of remotely sensed data, molecular studies, and responses to environmental stresses in the context of global change. Location of work: (1) Nilgiri Biosphere Reserve (2) Central India (3) Gujarat (4) Western Himalaya (5) Eastern Himalaya (6) Andaman Islands. Maintain, curate and analyse data collected from LTEO sites using relevant statistical techniques and GIS. Prepare scientific and technical reports and manuscripts. Location of work: Chennai.

Convert the completed form, certificates and enclosures into a single PDF file. Email the PDF to [email protected] on or before 20 November 2026. The application is addressed to The Officer-in-Charge, Zoological Survey of India, Southern Regional Centre, #130, Santhome High Road, Chennai - 600 028. The notice does not give a subject line for the email. Self-attested copies of certificates (School/College such as Transfer Certificate, Mark Sheet, Degree Certificates etc.). Copies of Address and Aadhar card proof. Evidence documents for the experience listed in the form. No Objection Certificate from present employer (if employed).
