Set up systems and procedures that bring positive results, and arrange random checks on how they work. Get feedback and take corrective measures to improve systems and procedures. Manage company affairs and related legal matters. Build skills in managing company affairs, and create a work culture with less scope for conflict. Assign responsibilities to executives and staff according to their skills, and keep working relations sound within groups, between departments and with other organisations. Motivate staff to work effectively as a group. Overall charge of developing and maintaining financial and accounting policies and procedures. Corporate fund planning and financial management. Statutory compliance in finance functions and under company law and other legislation. Advising on material procurement/ work contracts. Controlling billing and revenue collection, and monitoring outstanding dues through recovery action plans. Providing information for ARR and tariff filing, and implementing Regulatory Commission matters. Coordinating with other functionaries and outside agencies. Giving guidance on company law and other legal issues, with special emphasis on company law. Training and development to upgrade the skills of officers and staff.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection will be based on interview only. Only shortlisted candidates will be called for the interview. If necessary, applicants may be shortlisted by written test, academic records, or higher educational qualifications and experience. The decision of the Screening Committee and Appointing authority on shortlisting is binding. No T.A. / D.A. will be paid for attending the interview. The selection committee may relax any of the terms for selection and appointment.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: The appointment is contractual for 3 (three) years. The appointing authority may extend it by mutual consent. There is no pension from the Government of Tripura or TPGL. EPF benefits are available if desired and applicable. Either party can end the contract by giving 30 days' notice or paying 1 (one) month's salary. Other service conditions will be the same as for Tripura State Civil Service Officers of equivalent grade. A Government of Tripura officer appointed on deputation will be governed by the service conditions of his original employment. In-service candidates may apply directly to TPGL. If selected, they must submit a 'Release Order' or 'Deputation Order' from their present employer when joining, or the joining will not be accepted. The number of posts may increase or decrease. The Corporation may also choose not to fill the vacancy.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for TPGL CFO cum Company Secretary Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Fill in the bio-data in the prescribed format attached to the notice. It covers personal information, qualifications from Matriculation/ Madhyamik onwards, CA/ ICWA/ CS membership details, posts held, training, honours, and the minimum time you need to join if selected. Affix one recent passport-size photograph and sign the declaration. Attach self-attested copies of the documents listed below. On the envelope, write: "Application for the post of Chief Financial Officer (CFO) – cum – Company Secretary (CS) in TPGL" . Address it to: Managing Director, Tripura Power Generation Limited, Corporate Office, Bidyut Bhavan (Old Building), North Banamalipur, Pin – 799001 . Post it so that it reaches the office by 30 November 2026, 05:30 PM. The Corporation is not responsible for postal delays. Self-attested photocopies of certificates and mark-sheets from Matriculation/ Madhyamik onwards. Testimonials as proof of age, academic attainment, experience and state of domicile. Do not send originals. Bring them to the interview for verification. Applications received after the last date, incomplete applications, and fresh papers or enclosures sent after the closing date will not be considered. Canvassing in any form will lead to disqualification. If documents are found to be fake, or if a candidate hid a doubtful background, the candidate's services will be terminated.

content_sections.text: The notice is issued by the Office of the Chairman, Selection Committee / District Judge, Unnao, for the District Court (Janpad Nyayalaya) Unnao. The re-employment of retired employees is being done in compliance with the Hon'ble High Court Allahabad's C.L. No. 14/Admin. (D) Section dated 15.10.2022. Two separate notices were issued on 05.11.2026: one for retired Class III employees (Junior Assistant) and one for retired Class IV / Sweeper employees.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Applications must be made in the prescribed format attached to the notice and submitted at the Administrative Office, District Court, Unnao by 17 November 2026, 5:00 PM. The notice does not print a full postal address with PIN code and does not mention sending the application by post or email. Use the prescribed application form attached to the notice ("Application for employment on a vacant post to be filled through re-employment of retired employees in District Court Unnao"). Write the name of the post applied for at the top of the form. Fill in the details asked: name, father's / husband's name, date of birth, date of retirement, last post held and the name of the district court from where you retired, photo identity card details (ID card / Aadhaar card / other valid ID), permanent address, temporary address, mobile number, email ID and educational qualification. Attach a copy of the last drawn pay and the pension order – the form says this is mandatory. Sign the undertaking printed on the form, with the date and place (Unnao). Submit the application at the Administrative Office, District Court, Unnao before 5:00 PM on 17 November 2026.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: For each post, the pay is the last drawn pay the applicant received on the related post, from which the pension amount is deducted; the balance is paid as honorarium. The notice does not print a fixed amount. The applicant should be physically and mentally fit. The applicant's character roll for the previous 5 years should be correct (clean). No criminal or civil case should be pending and registered against the applicant. The form asks for the educational qualification, but the notice does not specify a minimum educational qualification. The notice does not prescribe an age limit for applying; the tenure ends on completion of 65 years of age at the latest (see Important Instructions). Candidates should check the official notification for the exact eligibility for each post.

To the applicant's knowledge, no penalty or entry was given during service that would bar re-employment. No criminal proceedings are pending against the applicant. No criminal or civil case against or relating to the applicant is pending in District Court Unnao. All information is true; the applicant accepts full responsibility and any action if it is found false, and has read and accepts all application rules and conditions.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: The notice states that the applicant's past record and ACR (Annual Confidential Report) will be the basis of appointment. The notice does not mention a written test or an interview.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Tenure: 1 year from the date of joining, or until the post is filled by direct recruitment or promotion, or until the employee completes 65 years of age – whichever is earlier. The appointment will be purely temporary and may be terminated without any prior notice if service is not found satisfactory. Applications received after the prescribed time (5:00 PM on 17 November 2026) will not be considered. The notice is to be circulated among retired employees of the district court, pasted on the court notice board, and uploaded on the websites of District Court Unnao and the High Court. A copy has been sent to the District Information Officer, Unnao, for free publication in at least two daily newspapers.

content_sections.heading: About AIIMS Raebareli
content_sections.text: All India Institute of Medical Sciences, Raebareli is an autonomous institute under the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, Government of India, located at Munshiganj, Raebareli. The post is in its Department of Physiology (Integrative Neurophysiology Lab). It serves the research project "Aspartame and Neurotoxicity: A Neurobiology and Translational Genomics Study", funded by CSIR-HRDG, New Delhi under the CSIR-HRDG Research Scheme (File No. 60(0126)/26/EMR-II).

content_sections.heading: Posts and Eligibility
content_sections.text: One Junior Research Fellow (JRF) post has been sanctioned. The project is led by Dr. Arbind Kumar Choudhary, Associate Professor, Department of Physiology, AIIMS Raebareli (Principal Investigator). The Co-PIs are Dr. Sanjay Yadav, Prof and HOD, Department of Biochemistry, AIIMS Raebareli, and Dr. Prem N. Yadav, Principal Scientist, CSIR-CDRI, Lucknow. The notice lists a valid CSIR-UGC NET (LS) and GATE qualification as "(Desirable)". The documents list asks for a valid CSIR-UGC NET (JRF) certificate or scorecard. The age limit for JRF is not more than 28 years, as per the revised CSIR JRF-NET guidelines (w.e.f. 01.03.2023). The notice prints no date for counting age. The upper age limit is relaxable up to 5 years for candidates belonging to Scheduled Castes, Scheduled Tribes, OBC (Non-Creamy Layer), women and physically handicapped (PwD) candidates. The JRF fellowship is Rs. 37,000/- per month for the first two years, plus HRA as admissible under CSIR norms. On Ph.D. registration within two years and satisfactory assessment by the Expert Committee, the fellow may be upgraded to SRF at Rs. 42,000/- per month from the third year. The notice says upgradation is subject to Ph.D. registration and assessment by a three-member Expert Committee. No application fee applies: the notice lists the fee as Nil. The project tenure is 36 months from the date of commencement. The fellowship is co-terminus with the project and the post is purely temporary.

rows.qualification: Master's degree life sciences or equivalent (CSIR/UGC norms) with at least 55% marks (50% for OBC-NCL/SC/ST/PwD/Third gender)
rows.pay: Rs. 37,000/- per month for the first two years, plus HRA as admissible under CSIR norms

content_sections.heading: AIIMS Raebareli Junior Research Fellow (JRF) Job Description
content_sections.text: The notice describes the work as full-time work on the project, covering: Animal handling and neuro-behavioural studies Molecular biology techniques (RNA/DNA extraction, RT-PCR, western blot, immunohistochemistry) Cognitive and EEG/ERP assessments Sample collection and storage Data entry and analysis Coordination with CSIR-CDRI, Lucknow, and report writing

content_sections.heading: What to Bring
content_sections.text: The notice says interested candidates with the stated eligibility can appear directly for the walk-in interview. The documents to bring are: Filled CSIR Form-G application (given on page 4 of the notice) Photo identity proof (Aadhaar card/ Driving Licence/ Voter ID card/ PAN card/ Passport) Address proof Proof of date of birth (10th Certificate/ Birth certificate) One recent passport size photograph Relevant mark sheets and certificates (10th, 12th, Bachelor's and Master's degree) Valid CSIR-UGC NET (JRF) certificate / scorecard Category certificate (OBC-NCL/SC/ST/EWS/PwD), if applicable Experience certificates clearly showing date of joining and relieving, if any Original certificates and one set of self-attested photocopies must be produced. Without them the candidate will not be allowed to participate in the interview. A candidate already in service must submit a No Objection Certificate from the present employer at the time of interview. Form-G is the Council of Scientific and Industrial Research application form for Junior/Senior Research Fellowships under a CSIR Research Scheme. It asks for: Name, present and permanent address, date of birth, nationality and father's/husband's name Whether the applicant belongs to SC/ST/OBC, with the certificate enclosed Educational qualifications from Bachelor's degree onwards, in a table of degree, university, subject, year of passing, division/grade and marks % Whether registered for a higher degree, or proposing to register Research or teaching experience, previous research fellowships, and publications with reprints or copies attached A signed declaration that the candidate will work whole time on the research under the Principal Investigator The form also has an attestation section for the Principal Investigator and the Head of the Institution.

content_sections.heading: About UoA
content_sections.text: The University of Allahabad describes itself on its letterhead as a Central University. It is in Prayagraj, Uttar Pradesh. The fellowship is based in the Department of Electronics and Communication, Science Faculty, and is offered under the Visvesvaraya Ph.D. Scheme of Digital India Corporation, MietY, Government of India (Implementation Order No.: PhD-02/PDF-2026/97).

content_sections.heading: UoA Postdoctoral Fellowship Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: The upper age limit is 40 years on the date the application is submitted. Reservation follows Government of India norms. A Ph.D. degree with research focused on Electronics System Design & Manufacturing (ESDM) or Information Technology/IT Enabled Services (IT/ITES). The Ph.D. must be from a recognised institution, with first class (in terms of grades, etc.) at every earlier level and a good academic record throughout. The Ph.D. must have been completed within the past 5 years, counted on the last date for applications. Candidates who earned their Ph.D. from the University of Allahabad are not eligible. Applicants must be Indian citizens. The fellowship goes to researchers with a proven academic record, including peer-reviewed publications and recognitions. Applicants in regular employment will not be considered. Scientists or researchers in temporary academic or research posts may apply, but they must give up those posts if selected. Anyone who has already received this fellowship under the scheme is not eligible. The research proposal must set out clear objectives, outcomes and deliverables against the award. Preference will go to applicants who have active links with industry and whose research proposal addresses industry-specific problems. See the official notification for the full discipline-specific eligibility for this post.

content_sections.heading: About IIT BHU
content_sections.text: The Indian Institute of Technology (BHU) is a technical institute in Varanasi. This JRF post belongs to its Department of Pharmaceutical Engineering and Technology. The project is funded by the National Mission for Clean Ganga. The notice gives its full title as "Characterization of Microbes and Micro-pollutants in the Ganga Basin: A Fingerprint Analysis Approach Based on the water sources and their implication in the Ganga Basin". The notice also says the post is part of the Smart Laboratory on Clean Rivers (SLCR) project.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The notice gives this essential qualification for the Junior Research Fellow (JRF): M. Pharm, M.S.(pharm.), M.Tech (pharm) in Pharma/Medicinal chemistry, Natural product Pharmacognosy, Analysis, etc with GATE/GPAT/CSIR-NET equivalent examination. Experience: Prior research experience in the relevant research fields. Experience in Analytical, HPLC, LCMS and Spectroscopic characterization is desirable. Microbial experience: collection, DNA isolation, Sequencing. Research Skills: Understanding of Sample preparation, water quality assessment, and environmental science. Technical Skills: Proficiency in statistical software, data analysis tools. Communication Skills: Strong written and verbal communication skills for reporting and presenting research findings. Analytical Skills: Good problem-solving skills and the ability to interpret complex data. Personal Qualities: Detail-oriented, proactive, and eager to contribute to innovative research solutions. The upper age limit for the Junior Research Fellow (JRF) is 28 years. The post table gives a relaxation of 5 years to "SC/ST/Physically Handicapped Female candidates". The general conditions add that relaxation of marks and age may be granted to SC/ST/OBC/EWS/Women/physically challenged candidates as per GOI norms. All things being equal, SC/ST candidates will be preferred as per GOI rules. For the discipline-specific eligibility of the post, see the official notification.

content_sections.heading: IIT BHU Junior Research Fellow (JRF) Job Description
content_sections.text: The notice says the JRF will work on scientific research and help develop new solutions for identifying micro-pollutants and microbes in small rivers. The work covers quantitative and qualitative analysis of micro-pollutants and microbes. The JRF will work closely with the other JRF and PA. The JRF will be responsible for: Design and execute the experiment, data acquisition and analysis, and preparation of project report and manuscripts. Research Support: Expertise in advanced analytical method for water quality assessment, knowledge of sophisticated state-of-art technology (Spectroscopic Techniques). Data Management: Analyse complex data sets and provide strategic insights to inform project decisions. Report Preparation: Prepare comprehensive research reports, Papers, Posters and technical reports.

Manage patient data and regularly update the Rare Disease Registry and associated digital platforms. Assist in preparation of reports, summaries, and digital dashboards. content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Your parent office/department forwards the application through proper channel. content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Applications are invited from eligible Indian citizens. Area 1: Assessment of wildlife habitats (terrestrial/aquatic), including use of RS & GIS, with at least 02 publications in peer-reviewed journals. Area 2: Ecology or conservation of endangered species, with at least 02 publications in peer-reviewed journals. The notice attaches the OBC certificate format (Annexure-1) and the EWS Income & Asset Certificate format (Annexure-2). The EWS format certifies a gross annual family income below Rs.8 lakh and lists the assets the family must not own. content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Selection is through screening and shortlisting, a written examination and a personal interview, with a final merit list based on aggregated performance. Applications will be evaluated by a Screening Committee. Fulfilling the minimum eligibility criteria does not automatically entitle an applicant to be called for the test/interview. Shortlisting for interviews will maintain a 1:5 ratio (05 candidates per vacancy), and the institute may at any time increase or decrease this ratio. The written examination comprises subject-specific Multiple Choice Questions (MCQs) with 1/3rd negative marking for incorrect answers. Minimum qualifying marks are 50% for UR/EWS/OBC and 40% for SC/ST/PwBD. The Institute's Committee for Recruitment & Selection (ICRS) will assess candidates on academic record, experience in the relevant field, special achievements/awards, teaching experience, publications, and extension/education/institution building. The Written Test carries 70% weightage and the Personal Interview (including presentation) 30%. The final merit list will be prepared on aggregated performance in the written examination and interview. The date(s) of the written test and interview will be hosted on the WII website and intimated to the shortlisted candidates.

content_sections.heading: About IIT Roorkee Post-Doctoral Fellow (PDF)
content_sections.text: The Institute Instrumentation Centre is a centre of the Indian Institute of Technology Roorkee in Roorkee, Uttarakhand. It is offering this Post-Doctoral Fellowship to work on a research project on GaN-on-diamond heterostructures that use magnetron sputtered AlN interfacial layers for advanced electronic devices. The mentor is Prof. Ramesh Chandra of the Institute Instrumentation Centre, IIT Roorkee.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: PhD in Physics / Applied Physics. The PhD/research work should be in areas related to thin-film fabrication, surface/interface engineering. Hands-on experience with material characterisation techniques such as Thin Film XRD for crystal quality and Epitaxial growth, XPS, AFM, and Spectroscopic Ellipsometry, etc. Prior experience working with RF magnetron sputtering, particularly for the deposition and optimization of AlN thin films. Exposure to thin-film fabrication and heterostructure development, particularly involving AlN/diamond and GaN/AlN/diamond systems, including studies of crystallographic orientation, surface morphology, interface quality, optical properties, and film adhesion. The institute invites applications from "outstanding and enthusiastic researchers" and says the candidate should be passionate about working on cutting-edge research, leading to high-impact publications. See the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility for the post.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The position is full-time for two years. PDF positions are purely temporary. Post-Doctoral Fellows will be registered as students and may use the library, the computer centre and the available hospital facilities. Fellows get 2.5 days of leave per completed calendar month. Leave cannot be carried forward beyond a calendar year. The selected candidate is expected to join the Centre as soon as the offer letter is released.

content_sections.text: Research activities under the project "Development of GaN-on-Diamond Heterostructures Using Magnetron Sputtered AlN Interfacial Layers for Advanced Electronic Devices". Other academic responsibilities, including mentoring UG/PG students. Participating in research discussions. Other activities as deemed fit by the mentor.

Compile all of them in a single PDF file named "Candidate Name_. Institute_Year of Ph.D". Address the application to The Head, Institute Instrumentation Centre, Indian Institute of Technology Roorkee, Roorkee -247667, Uttarakhand, India. content_sections.heading: JCI Deputy Manager (Law) Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: The upper age limit is 35 years as on 30 September 2026. Age, qualification and experience are all reckoned on this date. 3 years full-time bachelor's degree in law (L.L.B) or 5 years full-time integrated law course (B.A. L.L.B/ B.Sc. L.L.B), recognized by the Bar Council of India (BCI), from a recognized Indian university/institute. 60% or more marks in the qualifying degree examinations. If the university or institute awards letter grades or a point scale, a certificate from it linking the grade or point scale to percentage of marks must be submitted. Where only grades such as CGPA, OGPA, GGPA or SGPA are awarded, the application must mention the equivalent percentage and a grade-to-percentage conversion document from the university or institute must be submitted. Unless the university prescribes a method, the principle of proportion applies: on a 10-point scale, a grade of 6.0 is considered 60%. Candidates need one of the following: Minimum 05 years' post-qualification experience as a practising advocate. Under Bar Council Enrolment, the candidate must be eligible to enrol or currently enrolled as an Advocate with the State Bar Council/Bar Council of India (and pass the All-India Bar Examination/AIBE as applicable). Minimum 05 years' post-qualification experience in a reputed organisation. The candidate should be well conversant with the Contract Act, Labour Arbitration, in particular general laws, and proficient in drafting agreements/conveyance deeds and other service regulation in government services. Only full-time work experience counts, from the date of registration with the Bar Council and/or the date of joining employment, as applicable. Internships during the LLB programme are not considered experience. Preference will be accorded to incumbents from Govt./CPSEs/Autonomous bodies. Only Indian nationals are eligible to apply. Computer proficiency is essential for the post. Reserved-category candidates who meet the criteria may apply for this UR post as per Govt. rules. They will be treated as General candidates, and no relaxation in any criteria will apply to them. For the complete eligibility conditions of this post, see the official notification.

No other payment mode is acceptable. Write your name, mobile number and address on the reverse of the draft. A General, EWS or OBC application without a proper draft will be summarily rejected, as will one with a wrong, incomplete, tampered, damaged or expired draft. Paying a lesser amount also leads to rejection, and fee paid by ineligible candidates is forfeited.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Management may introduce additional stages if considered necessary. Meeting the minimum qualification and experience does not give a right to be called for interview. Document verification takes place at the Corporation's Head Office at Kolkata, on the date and time sent to the candidate's registered e-mail. Missing it is treated as unwillingness to continue, and the candidate is not considered further. All original documents must be produced at verification. Otherwise the candidate cannot appear for the interview and Travelling Allowance is not reimbursed. Only original documents that were submitted along with the application are considered. Submitting any additional, fresh or revised document leads to rejection of the candidature. Candidates presently working in Central or State Govt., PSUs, PSBs or autonomous bodies, including nationalised banks and financial institutions, in a permanent, regular or contractual role must furnish a hard copy of a No Objection Certificate at verification. It must be dated on or after the release of this notification, and no such candidate can appear without it. Tie breaker: if candidates secure the same marks, rank or position in the final merit list, the older candidate gets the higher rank. Scores are reported with decimal points up to two digits. Candidates may be considered for a lower post (E1) if otherwise suitable, depending on qualifications, experience, present position and interview performance. JCI may prepare a Panel/Waiting List based on interview performance, valid for one year from publication of the result. Inclusion gives no right to appointment. Candidates not shortlisted or not selected will not be told the status of their candidature. Outstation candidates who qualify for the Document Verification stage are reimbursed to-and-fro AC 3-Tier rail fare by the shortest route, on submission of valid tickets. Air travellers are reimbursed only up to the equivalent AC 3-Tier railway fare. Local transport is not reimbursed. Payment is made only through ECS after the selection process ends, so bring bank details or proof, such as a passbook or cancelled cheque. Candidates who do not qualify the Document Verification, and those travelling by rail on wait-listed tickets, receive no reimbursement.

faq.answer: No. JCI accepts applications only by Speed Post, and those sent by e-mail, fax, hand or courier are treated as rejected.

faq.question: Q2. Does the 16 November 2026 deadline apply to posting or receipt?
faq.answer: It applies to receipt. Applications received after 4:00 PM on that date will be rejected.

faq.answer: Write "APPLICATION FOR THE POST FOR DEPUTY MANAGER (LAW) – Notification No. 01/2026". JCI will reject an envelope without it and will not inform the candidate separately.

selection_process: Part Subject Questions Marks Duration
A.i) General Awareness (Objective) 20 20 120 minutes (02 Hours)
A.ii) Quantitative Aptitude (Objective) 20 20
A.iii) General English (Objective) 20 20
A.iv) Logical Reasoning (Objective) 20 20
B. i) Hindi (40% objective and 60% subjective questions) - 100
Selection has two stages: a Written Examination
then a Personal Interview
both at Kolkata. Candidates who qualify in the written test will be called for the Personal Interview
which carries 20 marks. Original documents will be verified at the time of the interview.
The Hindi paper covers translation from Hindi to English and vice-versa
Hindi Grammar
Comprehension
Summary Writing
Letter Writing

etc. (both in Hindi and English). General English and Quantitative Aptitude will be of Class-X level. General Awareness and Logical Reasoning will be moderately difficult. There will be no negative marking.
Visually impaired PwBD candidates whose writing speed is affected may use their own scribe
at their own cost
during the written examination. These rules apply:

The candidate must be eligible to use a scribe under the Government of India rules for the recruitment of Persons with Disabilities. The candidate arranges the scribe at his or her own cost. The candidate must say so in the application and attach supporting documents that show eligibility to use a scribe. A person who is a scribe for one candidate cannot be a scribe for another candidate. The scribe may be from an academic stream different from the one prescribed for the post. The candidate and the scribe must both give an undertaking that the scribe meets the eligibility criteria. If it later turns out that the scribe did not meet them or hid material facts
the candidature will stand cancelled
whatever the result of the examination. Candidates who use a scribe get compensatory time of 20 minutes for every hour of the examination
or as otherwise advised. If the scribe is found answering the questions independently at any stage
the exam session will be terminated and the candidature cancelled. The candidature will also be cancelled if the test administrator personnel report this after the examination.

If an application is found to be incorrect or false even after selection, the appointment is liable to be terminated at once. content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Write the application in the prescribed format (Annexure-I, the last page of the notification). Only hard copies are accepted. Put the complete application in a sealed envelope and write this on it clearly: "Application for the post of Sr. Assistant Secretary (Official Language) at KDS of Syama Prasad Mookerjee Port, Kolkata (erstwhile Kolkata Port Trust)". Address the envelope to: The Secretary, General Administration Department, Syama Prasad Mookerjee Port, 15 Strand Road, Kolkata – 700001. Fill in the Annexure-I form. It asks for your name, father's or husband's name, date of birth (Board Admit Card/Adhaar/Voter ID/Passport), permanent address (Adhaar/Driving License/Voter ID/Passport), address for communication, phone number, e-mail address, nationality, marital status, religion and category (SC/ST/OBC/EWS/UR). Fill in your educational qualifications with the percentage of marks and the class or division for Secondary/Madhyamik (or equivalent) Diploma, Higher Secondary, Graduation and Post Graduation. Then add your professional qualification. Fill in your working experience: company name, scale of pay and present basic pay, post or designation, and the period (DDMMYYYY to DDMMYYYY) with its duration. You can add any other relevant information. Paste one recent passport-size photograph, duly signed, in the place marked on Annexure-I. Sign the form, write the date, and attach the enclosures listed below. Seal everything in the envelope with the superscription above and send it to the address so that it is received by 26 November 2026. Applications that are incomplete, unsigned or received after the deadline may not be considered. Submit only one application. If a candidate sends more than one, only the latest valid (completed) application will be retained.

The qualifications must be from a recognized Indian University approved by the UGC or a recognized Indian Institute approved by AICTE. Candidates must hold a valid Mark-sheet / Degree / Diploma / Certificate / Membership for the necessary qualification and experience as on 01.10.2026. For the full discipline-specific eligibility of the post, check the official notification. The minimum age is 18 years and the maximum age is 30 years, counted as on 1 October 2026. The upper age limit is relaxed as follows: Candidates who claim age relaxation must submit copies of the required certificate(s). They must also show the original certificate(s) for verification at the scrutiny or verification of documents, or at any stage of the recruitment process when the Authorities ask for them. The post is identified as suitable for PwBD candidates but is not explicitly reserved for them. The suitable categories are: a) B (Blind), LV (Low Vision) b) D (Deaf), HH (Hard of Hearing) c) OA (One Arm), BA (Both Arms), OL (One Leg), BL (Both Leg), OAL (One Arm and One Leg), BLOA (Both Leg & One Arm), BLA (Both legs Arms), CP (Cerebral Palsy), LC (Leprosy Cured), Dw (Dwarfism), AAV (Acid Attack Victims), MDy (Muscular Dystrophy) d) MI (Mental Illness) The physical requirements are S (Sitting), RW (Reading & Writing), SE (Seeing), C (Communication) and MF (Manipulation by Fingers).

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection has two stages: a Written Examination, then a Personal Interview, both at Kolkata. Candidates who qualify in the written test will be called for the Personal Interview, which carries 20 marks. Original documents will be verified at the time of the interview. The Hindi paper covers translation from Hindi to English and vice-versa, Hindi Grammar, Comprehension, Summary Writing, Letter Writing, etc. (both in Hindi and English). General English and Quantitative Aptitude will be of Class-X level. General Awareness and Logical Reasoning will be moderately difficult. There will be no negative marking. Visually impaired PwBD candidates whose writing speed is affected may use their own scribe, at their own cost, during the written examination. These rules apply: The candidate must be eligible to use a scribe under the Government of India rules for the recruitment of Persons with Disabilities. The candidate arranges the scribe at his or her own cost. The candidate must say so in the application and attach supporting documents that show eligibility to use a scribe. A person who is a scribe for one candidate cannot be a scribe for another candidate. The scribe may be from an academic stream different from the one prescribed for the post. The candidate and the scribe must both give an undertaking that the scribe meets the eligibility criteria. If it later turns out that the scribe did not meet them or hid material facts, the candidature will stand cancelled, whatever the result of the examination. Candidates who use a scribe get compensatory time of 20 minutes for every hour of the examination, or as otherwise advised. If the scribe is found answering the questions independently at any stage, the exam session will be terminated and the candidature cancelled. The candidature will also be cancelled if the test administrator personnel report this after the examination.

content_sections.text: The appointment will be made purely on merit basis. While applying for the post, the applicant should ensure that he/she fulfils the eligibility and other norms, and that the particulars furnished by him/ her are correct in all respects; and suppression of material information would lead to disqualification at any stage. Interested candidates shall be ready to work in remote / hard areas as and when directed and also may have to travel to remote/hard areas as required. Incomplete/defective applications, applications without photograph of the candidates shall be summarily rejected. Candidates shall/ may be shortlisted for the Interviews, based on the criteria approved by the competent authority. No individual call letters will be issued for appearing in the interview. No TA/DA shall be payable for appearing in the interview.
